data.title: Senior Application Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Oracle NetSuite builds cloud business applications that help organizations manage financials, operations, commerce, and more. 

We're looking for a Senior Application Software Engineer who combines strong technical fundamentals with curiosity about better ways to build software. You'll design and deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for enterprise customers, collaborate across engineering, product management, and help improve how the team develops and operates software. 

This is a hands-on role with ownership from understanding the business problem through design, implementation, testing, release, and production support. We value engineers who use AI-assisted development thoughtfully while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and maintainability of their work

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Translate business and customer requirements into clear technical designs, identifying dependencies, edge cases, and implementation tradeoffs. 
 - Own the delivery of features and improvements across design, coding, testing, release, and production support. 
 - Develop and maintain services, APIs, database-backed applications, and user-facing capabilities with attention to reliability, security, performance, and scalability. 
 - Investigate complex issues, understand unfamiliar code, and improve existing systems through practical, incremental changes. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted tools to support code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. Independently validate generated output and remain accountable for its correctness and quality. 
 - Build quality into development through automated tests, code reviews, and validation of data integrity, backward compatibility, and performance. 
 - Collaborate with product management, UX, QA, and other engineering teams to clarify scope, resolve dependencies, and deliver useful customer outcomes. 
 - Contribute to technical decisions, explain tradeoffs, and identify opportunities to simplify architecture and reduce technical debt. 
 - Mentor engineers through constructive feedback, design discussions, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Improve development workflows through automation and AI, assessing benefits through delivery effectiveness, quality, and maintainability. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional software development experience, including independently delivering features or substantial system improvements. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java or a comparable object-oriented programming language, such as C# or Python. 
 - Solid understanding of software design, data structures, algorithms, and debugging. 
 - Strong SQL and relational database skills, including data modeling, transactions, query optimization, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing web applications or services, with an understanding of how browser, service, API, and database layers interact. 
 - Ability to design maintainable solutions and evaluate tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, complexity, and delivery effort. 
 - Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and continuous integration. 
 - Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively, or learn them quickly, while critically reviewing their output and following security and data-handling requirements. 
 - Clear communication skills and experience collaborating across functions and mentoring engineers. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ERP, financial, or other enterprise business applications. 
 - Familiarity with NetSuite and SuiteScript. 
 - Experience building or supporting distributed systems and diagnosing production performance or reliability issues. 
 - Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or modern frontend development. 
 - Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications using model APIs, retrieval, or tool integrations, including evaluating output quality and handling failures. 
 - Examples of improving engineering productivity or software quality through automation and AI-assisted workflows. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Engineering Manager
Test Automation Engineer II
data.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. 

  

By "Connecting Convenience" across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.   We're a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. 

  

Role Overview

  

Do you love building software that thrills your customers? Do you obsess over the quality of your software? Do you insist on the highest standards for the software your team develops? Are you an advocate of measurable quality? Can you dive deep and still maintain the big picture of your solution's components and the customer experience? Well, if this is you, then come join an energetic team of engineers building future of PDI software solutions.   

As a Test Automation Engineer (a. k. a. Software Engineer in Test) you will be part of an Agile team and involved in all aspects of our projects' lifecycle from inception through release working closely with the team's product owner, architects and engineers. Your mandate on the team will be to: (a) maximize the quality, measurability and supportability of the production features being developed, (b) maximize the testability of the software by finding and closing gaps in test coverage (c) minimize the team's overall internal defect escapes by shifting the balance of how we manage quality from end-of-cycle defect detection & containment (bug-finding & fix cycles) to up-front defect prevention (automation backed coverage of all our application features).   

You will not be writing production code. You will however be writing a lot of code in the form of tools, emulators, mocks, fakes, stubs, unit, component and integration tests. You will also be working closely with the Engineering DevOps teams helping enhance our integration with our continuous integration (CI) systems, our virtual labs and helping build out fully automated reporting of all the various project quality metrics with a vision of achieving "push-button" reporting of a project's software quality and trending (code coverage, static analysis, test surface coverage).   

Key Responsibilities

- Setting up test environments as required including client and web applications, services and databases.   

- Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, smoke, and regression tests

- Build and enhance scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks

- Review user stories and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios, risks, edge cases, and quality gaps

- Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines

- Perform functional, integration, end-to-end, and performance testing as required

- Test APIs, microservices, web applications, databases, and distributed system integrations

- Collaborate closely with developers to improve testability, automation coverage, and overall product quality

- Troubleshoot automation, application, environment, and test-data-related failures

- Participate in Agile ceremonies, release planning, and continuous improvement activities

- Leverage AI-assisted tools for test-case generation, automation development, code reviews, debugging, test-data generation, and failure analysis while applying appropriate engineering review and validation

- Mentor and support junior Test Automation Engineers and contribute to engineering best practices

Qualifications

- 4-7 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or software development

- Experience working with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python

- Experience with automation technologies such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, SpecFlow, Cucumber, or similar frameworks

- Strong experience testing REST APIs using Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright, or equivalent technologies

- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL

- Build mocks, emulators, fakes, stubs and test case libraries driving towards 100% acceptance test coverage of stories  

- Experience with Git and CI/CD technologies such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins

- Understanding of modern quality practices including Shift Left Testing, Test Pyramid, risk-based testing, and continuous testing

- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and container technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes is an advantage

- Experience with or willingness to adopt AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies for test automation and quality engineering

- Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills

- Ability to independently contribute while collaborating effectively within distributed engineering teams

- Experience in Convenience Retail, Fuel, Payments, Wholesale, Loyalty, or Logistics domains is preferred

Behavioral Competencies

- Ensures Accountability

- Manages Complexity

- Communicates Effectively

- Balances Stakeholders

- Collaborates Effectively

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.   This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.   Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Title

Senior Engineer - Infrastructure Automation & Windows Platform Engineering

When you join us at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll become a member of a hard-working, motivated team that aligns with your enthusiasm for exploration and discovery. With revenues exceeding $40 billion and the largest investment in R&D in the industry, we provide our people with resources and opportunities to make significant contributions to the world. 

How Will You Make An Impact

Work on backend platform software that powers advanced scientific instruments used in semiconductors, life sciences, and materials research. We are seeking an experienced senior developer (6-10 years) to drive reliable, scalable VM infrastructure automation and CI/CD execution for engineering workflows such as smoke and integration testing, regression, and continuous integration. This role will lead the delivery of automation services and tooling built primarily in Python and C#, with strong emphasis on Windows platform engineering, Jenkins (Groovy/shared libraries) and operational reliability. 

The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on technical depth with the ability to set direction, improve system stability, mentor engineers, and support rapid troubleshooting when CI pipelines or VM automation workflows encounter issues. 

What Will You Do

- Drive development of backend automation services (Python/C#) for process execution, file operations, health checks, and environment management. 
 - Establish strong reliability practices (logging/monitoring, retries/backoff, idempotency, concurrency controls, safe cleanup, traceability). 
 - Provide deep Windows platform expertise (Event Logs, Registry, services) to diagnose and resolve complex automation and CI issues. 
 - Lead VM lifecycle automation across Windows and Linux (provisioning, configuration, monitoring). 
 - Support incident response and hands-on troubleshooting to reduce downtime and improve resilience. 
 - Guide test execution optimization (including incremental testing) to improve CI cycle time and stability. 
 - Influence technical design and architecture and maintain clear runbooks and documentation for operational readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers through code reviews, best practices, and technical leadership. 

Required Skills

- Strong hands-on experience with Python and C# in complex, production-grade engineering environments. 
 - TypeScript / Node. js exposure for tooling, services, or automation utilities. 
 - Strong Windows automation and troubleshooting skills using PowerShell and BATCH scripting, including deep knowledge of Windows internals (Event Log, Registry, services). 
 - Experience with both relational and non-relational databases (e. g. , MariaDB, MongoDB). 
 - Practical troubleshooting mindset and comfort handling ad-hoc firefighting / incident response scenarios. 
 - Working knowledge of software design/architecture fundamentals and testing concepts, including incremental testing approaches. 
 - Exposure to . NET build/test workflows to support cross-team collaboration. 

Desirable Skills

- Experience with Go and/or PHP in platform or automation contexts. 
 - Familiarity with artifact publishing and release governance practices (e. g. , JFrog CLI, promotion patterns). 
 - Own Jenkins automation at scale (Groovy pipelines/shared libraries), improving reliability through standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns. 
 - Proficiency in OpenStack services like Nova (compute), Neutron (networking), and Cinder (storage). 

Preferred Qualifications

- BTech degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - Experience operating in regulated or security-focused environments require auditability and traceability.

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase.

Incident & Operational Support

Collaboration & Mentorship

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development.

 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written).

 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS.

 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

data.title: Lead Software Engineer, Data Engineering
data.description:
About ValGenesis
ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle. 

Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https: //www. valgenesis. com/about

About the Role: 

Responsibilities

- Architect, Design, develop, and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines (batch and real-time)
 - Build and optimize data Lakehouse architectures using Azure Synapse, Delta Lake, or similar frameworks
 - Integrate and manage structured and unstructured data sources (SQL/NoSQL, files, documents, IoT streams)
 - Develop and operationalize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, or Apache Spark
 - Collaborate with Data Scientists to prepare and serve ML-ready datasets for model training and inference
 - Implement data quality, lineage, and governance frameworks across pipelines and storage layers
 - Work with BI tools (Power BI, Superset, Tableau) to enable self-service analytics for business teams
 - Deploy and maintain data APIs and ML models in production using Azure ML, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Ensure scalability, performance, and observability of data workflows through effective monitoring and automation
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to translate insights into action
 - Mentor junior team members and review their work

Requirements

- Experience: 6 to 12 years in Data Engineering or equivalent roles
 - Programming: Strong in Python, SQL, and at least one compiled language (C#, Java, or Scala)
 - Databases: Experience with relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB) systems
 - Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Azure Data Lake, Databricks
 - ETL/ELT Tools: Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow, or dbt
 - Messaging & Streaming: Kafka, Event Hubs, or Service Bus for real-time data processing
 - AI/ML Exposure: Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and MLOps concepts
 - Visualization & Analytics: Power BI, Apache Superset, or Tableau
 - Cloud & DevOps: Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps
 - Best Practices: Solid understanding of data modeling, version control, and CI/CD for data systems

Preferred Skills

- Preferred Skills (Nice to Have): 
 - Experience in knowledge graph or semantic search solutions
 - Understanding of LLM-based data retrieval (RAG) patterns
 - Exposure to data mesh, data fabric, or domain-oriented data architecture
 - Familiarity with MLflow, Delta Live Tables, or Data Bricks Unity Catalog

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills
 - Attention to detail and ability to work with large, complex datasets
 - Creativity and ability to automate repetitive workflows
 - Passion for continuous learning and innovation in data and AI technologies

We're on a Mission
In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world's first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard. 

Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end-to-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose-built systems with world-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations. 

The Team You'll Join
Our customers' success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity's quality of life, and we honor that mission. 

We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done. 

We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward. 

We're in it to win it. We're on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won't settle for anything less than being a market leader. 

How We Work
Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company. 

ValGenesis is an equal-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.description:
Department: Development

Location: Hyderabad

Description

Infor's AI Studio represents an agentic platform that enables teams to author, configure, and deploy Infor OS and ERP solutions utilizing natural language processing capabilities. We are seeking an Lead Quality Assurance Engineer to join the AI Studio team and lead the QA team to thoroughly validate the agent architecture of AI Studio. The testing will spread across components like ION, Data Fabric, Birst, EPM, RPA/IDP, CSD, and Portal. This initiative constitutes a strategic priority for Infor, designed to accelerate velocity suite sales, enhance customer experience, and facilitate more effective collaboration between Cutomers and Sevices, FDEs, Partners and SCs

We are seeking a Team Lead for Quality Assurance to lead the testing efforts to deliver high quality software solutions across our cloud product portfolio. 

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

A Day in the Life Typically Includes: 

- Define and own the overall QA strategy for AI Studio - covering search relevance, multi-agent coordination, schema validation, tenant isolation, and LLM output quality. 
 - Lead a team of QA engineers, assign test coverage areas, review test plans, and ensure quality gates are met before each release. 
 - Collaborate with the AI Studio architecture team, component teams, and FDEs to understand new features, contribution model changes, and agent updates - translating these into test requirements. 
 - Drive the design of evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic Orchestrator outputs - defining what "correct" means for gap maps, dependency graphs, and blueprint quality across varying user inputs. 
 - Oversee search relevance regression testing - ensuring that as the knowledge corpus grows, existing query-result quality does not degrade. 
 - Define and enforce tenant isolation testing standards, ensuring no cross-tenant data leakage across sessions, project history, or search results. 
 - Report quality metrics to engineering leadership - solution generation success rates, clarification round counts, agent failure rates, and corpus coverage gaps. 

Basic Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 8-10 years of experience in software quality assurance with at least 3 years in a lead or principal QA role. 
 - Proven experience leading QA for an AI or data-intensive product in production - not just familiarity with concepts but hands-on ownership of quality outcomes. 
 - Deep understanding of RAG system testing - search relevance validation, embedding quality assessment, hybrid search behaviour, and corpus quality measurement. 
 - Strong experience with multi-agent or distributed system testing - tracing failures across service boundaries, validating inter-agent contracts, and verifying execution ordering. 
 - Experience building and maintaining automated test suites in Python, with the ability to define quality frameworks from scratch rather than inheriting them. 
 - Solid understanding of LLM evaluation methodologies and tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent - with the ability to select and adapt them to non-standard evaluation problems. 
 - Experience with REST API contract testing and integration testing across multi-service architectures. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS (Preferred), Azure, or GCP. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills - ability to translate quality findings into clear risk assessments for engineering leadership and product teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience leading QA for agentic AI systems or LLM orchestration pipelines where output correctness is semantic rather than deterministic. 
 - Familiarity with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other vector and hybrid search platforms - ideally with hands-on experience designing relevance test suites. 
 - Knowledge of prompt adversarial testing - designing inputs that expose reasoning failures, hallucinations, incorrect component selection, or silent gap map errors. 
 - Experience with MLOps or LLMOps observability tooling - defining monitoring standards, alert thresholds, and trace inspection processes for AI pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS security testing, particularly tenant isolation and session boundary enforcement. 
 - Exposure to Infor OS, ERP systems, or enterprise workflow automation products - understanding the domain context that AI Studio operates in. 
 - Experience establishing QA contribution processes for knowledge-driven systems where test data quality directly determines test coverage effectiveness. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices - ability to integrate quality gates into automated deployment workflows. 

About Infor

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next.

data.title: Director, MTS (DevOps)
data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers. 

The Director of DevOps & Platform Engineering Gracenote India will be central to the success of our infrastructure, cloud platform, and engineering enablement teams across geographies. This role is fundamental to the growth and technical excellence of the Gracenote engineering organization as a whole. Key goals of this role are to establish technical rigor, operational efficiency, and a robust platform engineering culture. You will be responsible for managing compute infrastructure, cloud native and managed services, observability stacks, and cloud cost optimization (FinOps), while collaborating closely with local and global stakeholders to ensure high availability, scalability, and security for Gracenote's products. 

Responsibilities

- Manage and scale multiple teams of DevOps, and Cloud Infrastructure engineers in India, with direct and indirect managerial responsibilities. 
 - Work with local and global management across all relevant organizational partners to ensure the success, productivity, and operational alignment of assigned teams. 
 - Create a culture based on Nielsen values, fostering collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence across platform operations. 
 - Establish operating rhythm and cadence within areas of responsibility to ensure transparent communication, inclusive leadership, and a positive, high-retention environment for engineers. 
 - Track and drive key performance indicators (KPIs) including system availability/SLA performance, incident resolution times, infrastructure productivity, cloud spend efficiency, and employee retention. 
 - Oversee and manage Gracenote's AWS footprint, including large-scale compute resources and AWS-managed services such as AWS Glue, Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka), EKS, EMR, RDS, and S3. 
 - Drive Kubernetes platform operations (Amazon EKS), focusing on automated scaling, cluster management, workload security, and operational reliability. 
 - Own and evolve the in-house observability stack based on Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, and related telemetry tools to ensure end-to-end visibility across microservices and data pipelines. 
 - Lead FinOps and cloud cost management initiatives, establishing robust cost tracking, forecasting, efficiency benchmarks, and continuous resource optimization strategies without compromising performance. 
 - Apply an automation-first mindset to Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and self-healing systems. 
 - Coordinate and maintain a strong talent pipeline. 
 - Continuously assess, streamline, and improve DevOps processes, incident management workflows, and infrastructure reliability standards. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to toolings, governance, and security best practices within the Product Development Lifecycle. 
 - Represent the India DevOps and Platform Engineering organization in cross-functional engagements (e. g. , Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science). 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of experience working in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record in people management, team building, and leading multi-disciplinary DevOps teams in a global environment. 
 - 8-10 years of hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD tools, Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform, CloudFormation), and scripting (Python, Shell, Go, etc. ). 
 - 5+ years of dedicated experience managing production AWS environments at scale, specifically focusing on Amazon EKS and AWS native managed services (AWS Glue, MSK, EMR, S3, RDS, DynamoDB). 
 - Deep expertise in open-source and custom observability tools, particularly Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or ELK stack. 
 - Proven track record in FinOps-managing cloud budgets, identifying cost inefficiencies, implementing auto-scaling/spot instances, and tracking cloud spend metrics. 
 - Strong foundation in Kubernetes architecture, containerization, microservices deployment, and networking/security policies. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise workflow and business tools such as JIRA, Confluence, OpsGenie, Gitlab, and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI). 
 - Strong critical thinking, incident response leadership, and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Sense of curiosity, operational discipline, and high attention to detail. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One. 

Job Description

Job Description: Senior Software Engineering Manager - MMC (India)

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead engineering delivery for the Money Movement Capability (MMC) application in India. This leader will play a critical role in building and scaling U. S. Bank's India engineering presence for MMC by managing a high-performing team of software developers and quality engineers, strengthening engineering practices, and partnering closely with U. S. -based leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 

This is a managerial leadership role for a technically strong engineering leader who can operate with broad direction, focus on the bigger picture, and drive execution across multiple domains. The ideal candidate combines deep technical experience with people leadership, architectural judgment, delivery rigor, and a strong understanding of payments systems. This role requires business knowledge in the Payments domain, including Zelle, RTP, and FedNow, along with the ability to build software products that are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned to business strategy. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & India Organization Build-Out
 - Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers and QEs in India supporting the MMC application
 - Help establish and scale the India engineering organization, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and creating a strong engineering culture for U. S. Bank
 - Drive career development, technical mentoring, performance management, and succession planning across the team
 - Create an accountable, inclusive, and high-performing environment focused on quality, ownership, and continuous improvement
 - Engineering Delivery & Execution
 - Manage under broad direction and objectives, with a focus on business outcomes, delivery quality, and operational stability
 - Drive execution of the product roadmap on time and within budget while ensuring security, compliance, and reliability of core systems
 - Guide teams toward strong coding practices, solid software design decisions, and high-quality delivery with minimal disruption to production
 - Set expectations across the organization and ensure dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints are identified and addressed early
 - Promote urgency, prioritization, and thoughtful trade-off decisions aligned to organizational strategy
 - Technical Leadership & Architecture
 - Provide high-level architectural guidance and help teams align solution design to business requirements, enterprise standards, and regulatory needs
 - Ensure technical designs are clear, well thought out, and account for dependencies, failure states, maintainability, testability, scalability, and ease of support
 - Develop and maintain high-level and detailed architecture designs for complex technology solutions across multiple platforms, frameworks, and languages
 - Lead architectural review sessions and technical design discussions across the organization
 - Simplify product and technical design where possible to improve speed, resilience, and supportability
 - Cross-Team Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership
 - Partner with business leaders, product managers, architects, and engineering teams in an agile environment to gather requirements and drive execution
 - Participate in roadmap discussions and provide feedback to product and business teams based on engineering strategy, technical constraints, and delivery considerations
 - Understand adjacent teams' business domains and influence cross-team decisions to deliver business value efficiently
 - Communicate technical decisions, architecture strategies, and delivery risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Quality, Operations & Incident Leadership
 - Drive a culture of quality, timely code reviews, release readiness, and engineering discipline across the organization
 - Coach teams on systematic debugging, problem diagnosis, and effective use of tools for troubleshooting
 - Lead incident response as needed and establish processes and tooling that improve issue detection, root-cause analysis, and repeat-issue prevention
 - Ensure teams proactively handle risk, change, and ambiguity, escalating concerns early with practical solution options

Technical Scope

The Senior Software Engineering Manager is expected to bring strong hands-on technical credibility and experience building modern distributed systems. This role will guide teams delivering software products and APIs in a payments ecosystem with high expectations for availability, performance, resiliency, and compliance. 

Expected technical experience includes: 

- Experience building highly maintainable, extensible, and testable distributed systems
 - Experience in microservices and API development using Java and Spring Boot
 - Experience designing low-latency, high-throughput applications built for scalability and reliability
 - Experience implementing user interfaces against REST APIs
 - Experience with Kafka, event-driven patterns, and open-source technologies used in modern application development
 - Experience with containerization and platform tooling such as Kubernetes, Rancher, Istio, Apigee, Jenkins/CloudBees, and GitLab
 - Familiarity with source control management best practices, DevOps principles, and agile software delivery lifecycle practices
 - Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and driving resolution in production environments

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
 - 10 to 12 years of relevant technical experience
 - 5 or more years of leading a software engineering team
 - Proven experience leading software engineers and offshore teams to deliver complex products with multiple stakeholders
 - Strong understanding of software development processes, architecture, and engineering tools in enterprise environments
 - Comprehensive knowledge of how business strategy aligns with technical and engineering strategy
 - Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills
 - Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, product owners, scrum masters, business partners, vendors, and customers

Preferred Qualifications

- Business domain knowledge in Payments, especially ACH, Wires, Zelle, RTP, and FedNow
 - Experience in Business Banking, Payment Services, Financial Services, or other regulated industries
 - Advanced knowledge of distributed systems architecture, microservices architecture, API management, and integration platforms
 - Experience overseeing integration of new systems and technologies into existing environments
 - Experience balancing technical debt, feature delivery, and operational reliability at scale
 - Certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, Cloud, or Azure are a plus

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a leader who: 

- Thinks beyond a single team and considers impacts across multiple domains
 - Has a complete understanding of the team's domain, key features, affected users, impacted flows, and business purpose
 - Takes initiative to clarify ambiguity, identify risk early, and guide teams toward sound decisions
 - Fosters a culture of strong design patterns, coding standards, quality engineering, and accountable delivery
 - Brings a mix of technical acumen, strategic thinking, execution discipline, and talent-building capability
 - Can represent the India team effectively while partnering across global stakeholders and enterprise functions

If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants. 

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants. 

This is an U. S. Bancorp India posting. U. S. Bancorp India is a part of the U. S. Bank family.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Enterprise Investment Technology team, you will report to the Lead, Software Engineer and will partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to enhance and evolve the development of Investment Cloud / iRisk. You will develop and modernize cloud-native investment and risk platforms through scalable engineering, data processing, and AWS-based solutions to delight our customers! In addition to applied experience, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong business insight, an inclusive leadership attitude and a continuous learning focus to all that you do. 

What You Can Expect

- Build applications ensuring that the code follows latest coding practices and industry standards, using modern design patterns and architectural principles; actively code against the roadmap
 - Develop high-quality, well-documented and efficient code adhering to all applicable Prudential standards
 - Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
 - Write unit, integration tests and functional automation, researching problems discovered by quality assurance or product support, developing solutions to address the problems
 - Bring an applied understanding of relevant and emerging technologies, begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others, and embed learning and innovation in the day-to-day
 - Work on complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors
 - Use programming languages including but not limited to Java, AWS, Fargate, Postgres, Redshift, EventBridge, Python, or JavaScript and React, Springboot, and Node. js frameworks

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or experience in related fields
 - 5-7 years of experience in: Java, AWS, Fargate, Postgres, Redshift, EventBridge
 - Ability to leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts and perspectives to the benefit of the organization
 - Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
 - Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
 - Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
 - Applied experience with several of the following: 
 - Programming Languages: Python, Java or Java Script; working in distributed systems, object oriented programming, design patterns and design methodology; JAVA services using Spring CLI, Maven, Microservice, multi-threading, Concurrency and parallel processing
 - Frameworks: React, Springboot, Node. js, such as Full / MEAN / MERN stack
 - Data Store: NoSQL or Relational Data structures; MongoDB BPM tools
 - Data Streaming: SQS, Kinesis
 - Application Programming Interfaces (API): Consumption & Development; implementing service oriented architecture (SOA) patterns; Web service technologies such as APIs, REST, JSON, SOAP, XML, JDBC, MySQL
 - Unit, interface and end user testing concepts and tooling (functional & non-functional)
 - Automated testing
 - Accessibility awareness
 - Software security skills including secure coding, web application security and DevSecOps; Solid grasp of security concepts (authentication, authorization, encryption, digital signature, JWT), SSL, web service proxies, firewall, SAML 2. 0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2. 0)
 - DevOps Tools & Practices: Branching techniques and usage of GitHub, Bitbucket or Subversion; DevOps, Jenkins
 - Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Monitoring and logging techniques
 - AWS Core Services: AWS Services such as CloudWatch, Code-Deploy

What will set you apart?

- AWS Development
 - Architecture Patterns
 - Design Thinking
 - Financial/Insurance industry knowledge is a plus
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

Job Title: Testing-Insurance Automation-Senior

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY-Consulting-Insurance-Automation-Testing- Senior

The opportunity

As a Business Tester, you will be accountable & responsible to Prepare test strategy, test plan, test scenario, test scripts based on the project requirements. Execute functional and regression test cases. Report the defects in tracking tool and ensure its closure through STLC process. Involve in review meetings and walk through meetings. Candidate should have knowledge / experience in Guidewire - Policy-Claims-BillingCenter / Insurance domain. Having experience in Agile methodology is a must. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Deft knowledge on Agile Scrum
 - Strong hands-on experience in Guidewire - PolicyCenter with Rating, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter and GW Portal Products
 - Strong knowledge in GW Integrations points. 
 - Very Strong Knowledge in P&C Insurance Domain with multiple LOBs. 
 - Candidates must have experience in Automation and/or AI testing. 
 - Experience in SQL basics
 - Understanding the entire modules and their functionality by verifying the Functional Specification and Style guide issued by the client. 
 - Responsible for writing and executing the Test Cases for Functional Testing. 
 - Maintaining the Bug Reports and delivery Note details. 
 - Involved in Peer-Review of the test cases, Sanity Testing, Smoke Testing, Regression Testing, System Testing and User Acceptance Testing. 
 - Should be a Team player and has experience in Stakeholders management
 - Involved in review meetings and walk through meetings. 
 - Attend status calls as needed to report on testing progress

To qualify for the role, you must have

- BE/BTech/MCA/M. Sc. 
 - 5 -8 years of UAT/Business testing experience in in Guidewire - Policy-Claims-Billing centre / Insurance domain with Agile methodology. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Should have excellent communication skills & should be able to articulate concisely & clearly
 - Should be ready to do an individual contributor and lead role as well. 

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. 

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Company Description

Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR) is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends-we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms. 

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

data.title: Software Development Engineer I (Backend)
data.description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is India's leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15, 000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1. 5B+ customer conversations, we're building the operating system for commerce growth. 

Why This Role Matters

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer I to build and maintain backend services for GoKwik's commerce platform. The platform supports multiple merchants, handles large volumes of API traffic, and integrates with external systems and third-party applications. 

In this role, you will develop backend features using Node. js and TypeScript, work with SQL databases and APIs, and contribute to the reliability, performance, and scalability of production systems. You will own small-to-medium features end to end, from design and development to testing, deployment, and post-release monitoring, with guidance from senior engineers. 

The role also requires the effective use of AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality, security, and reliability. 

What You'll Own

- Backend Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Node. js and TypeScript. 
 - Feature Ownership: Take ownership of small-to-medium features from initial design and data modelling through implementation, testing, rollout, and post-release monitoring. 
 - API Design and Development: Build REST APIs with appropriate validation, error handling, pagination, status codes, and idempotent write operations. 
 - Database Design and Optimisation: Write efficient SQL queries, work with indexes and data models, analyse query execution plans, and identify opportunities to improve database performance. 
 - Multi-Tenant Data Management: Ensure that database queries, cache keys, APIs, and background jobs correctly scope data to the relevant merchant and maintain data isolation. 
 - Database Migrations: Implement schema changes and database migrations with guidance from senior engineers, ensuring safe execution and rollback options in production environments. 
 - Integrations and Background Processing: Develop third-party integrations and background jobs that handle retries, timeouts, API rate limits, and partial failures. Use queues and Redis where appropriate. 
 - Caching and Idempotency: Apply caching, queuing, and idempotency patterns to improve performance and ensure reliable processing when requests or jobs are retried. 
 - Production Monitoring and Debugging: Add structured logs, metrics, and traces to new code paths. Use application performance monitoring tools to investigate production issues and document root causes. 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot for design, coding, testing, code review, and debugging. Validate generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability before deployment. 
 - AI and LLM-Based Features: Contribute to LLM-powered features, including prompt design, structured outputs, and tool calling, with guidance from senior engineers where required. 
 - Code Reviews and Collaboration: Review code, incorporate feedback, document technical decisions, and collaborate with other engineers to maintain code quality and engineering standards. 

Who You Are

- Have 1-3 years of experience building production backend services using Node. js and TypeScript, including experience shipping and supporting at least one feature in production. 
 - Have a sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, problem-solving, and debugging fundamentals. 
 - Are comfortable writing SQL queries, using joins and indexes, reading query execution plans, and investigating slow queries. 
 - Understand multi-tenant architecture and the importance of correctly isolating merchant data across queries, caches, and background jobs. 
 - Have a practical understanding of caching, queues, retries, and idempotency, including how systems behave when requests fail or jobs execute more than once. 
 - Understand REST API design principles, including request validation, status codes, pagination, error handling, and idempotent writes. 
 - Use AI coding tools regularly and can evaluate generated code for correctness, security, test coverage, and maintainability. 
 - Have strong written communication skills and can document technical designs, pull requests, implementation decisions, and incident summaries. 
 - Take ownership of assigned features, communicate blockers early, seek clarification when requirements are ambiguous, and follow through after release. 
 - Are open to feedback, willing to learn from senior engineers, and committed to continuously improving your technical skills. 

Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you will work on production commerce infrastructure that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will gain hands-on experience building backend services, working with multi-tenant systems, and solving practical challenges in database performance, integrations, and production reliability. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will own features end to end, develop your system design skills, and learn to use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly in a production environment.

data.description:
Job Description: Functional Automation QA

Position: Functional Automation QA

Experience: 3 - 5 Years

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Work From Office)

About The Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Functional Automation QA Engineer with 3-5 years of hands-on experience in functional, regression, and automation testing of web and/or API-based applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and executing test scenarios, developing and maintaining automated test scripts, identifying defects, and ensuring the quality and reliability of software applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test cases based on business and technical requirements
 - Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using automation frameworks such as Selenium/Playwright/Cypress, or similar
 - Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to identify test scenarios and coverage
 - Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test data, and automation scripts
 - Perform functional testing to validate application features against defined business requirements
 - Execute regression and smoke testing during application releases and enhancements
 - Identify, document, and track defects using tools such as JIRA and work closely with development teams for resolution
 - Perform API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or similar
 - Validate UI functionality, business workflows, data validation, error handling, and cross-browser compatibility
 - Execute automated test suites and analyze test execution results and failures
 - Maintain and enhance existing automation frameworks and reusable test components
 - Participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, and retesting of resolved defects
 - Integrate automated test scripts with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar
 - Perform database validation using SQL queries to verify backend data and application transactions
 - Prepare test execution reports, defect reports, and test summary reports
 - Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and other QA team members throughout the SDLC
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
 - Support UAT activities and assist business users during validation cycles

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field
 - 3-5 years of experience in Functional and Automation Testing
 - Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and defect life cycle
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium / Playwright / Cypress or similar
 - Strong programming/scripting skills in Java, JavaScript, TypeScript or similar
 - Good understanding of Page Object Model (POM), data-driven testing, and reusable automation frameworks
 - Experience in writing and maintaining automated test scripts and test suites
 - Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools
 - Knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter is an added advantage
 - Good knowledge of SQL for database validation and backend testing
 - Experience with JIRA or similar defect/test management tools
 - Experience with Git/GitHub/GitLab or other version control systems
 - Good understanding of web application testing, browser compatibility, and responsive UI testing
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Work Details

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Work Mode: Work from Office - 5 days a week

data.title: Sr. Software Engineer I - API
data.description:
Who We Are

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value - and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders. 

Who You Are

Sr Software Engineer I, Tech Lead plays a key role in the design, development/configuration, unit testing, installation, and ongoing maintenance of Zinnia software platforms. Technical Lead work with stakeholders to develop solutions and/or products that fulfill the needs of Zinnia's internal stakeholders and clients. Those solutions and/or products help Zinnia and Zinnia clients to be more efficient and provide better service to end customers. Technical Lead interacts directly with project managers and business stakeholders and may periodically interact directly with Zinnia's clients. Technical Lead will facilitate, lead, and enable junior team members by acting as a mentor for soft skills and/or technical subject matter experts. 

What You'll Do

- Work as part of a global, cross-functional team to develop innovative software for Zinnia's stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to projects by creating well-designed, customized, testable, and efficient code for SE2 platforms. 
 - Assist our teams in providing ongoing support, troubleshooting, improvements, or custom enhancements to existing Zinnia platforms. 
 - Flexibility to support the challenging development and delivery needs of Zinnia. 
 - Collaborate with our global teams, internal stakeholders, and customers. 
 - Act as a mentor and technology expert for team members and conduct technical reviews. 
 - Architect, Design, develop and validate various requirements for the Zinnia platforms. 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, recognize and react to changing business needs and effectively prioritize tasks. 
 - Must be self-motivated and able to work independently and in conjunction with team members and business units. Enthusiasm and flexibility to work on a variety of projects. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent related professional experience
 - 7-11 years of experience with languages like JavaScript, Go, Java, Python or Ruby. 
 - Experience with writing REST APIs and documenting them using Open API specs. 
 - Patience and perseverance to overcome challenges, solve problems, and learn new computer languages and techniques. 
 - Working knowledge of managing APIs via API gateways (Kong is preferable). 
 - Working knowledge of OAuth, SAML, OpenID Connect protocols. 
 - Effective communication, interpersonal, and critical thinking skills. Effective troubleshooting skills. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

data.description:

Location: Remote(India)

Availability: Availability: Available to join immediately or within 15 days. 

Position Overview

data.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads platform projects crossing multiple teams, evolving runtimes or middleware patterns for interoperability and multi-tenant scale. Diagnoses and resolves complex cross-service issues; enforces versioning, compatibility, and safe rollout practices. Drives observability standards, capacity planning, and resilience patterns across several workloads. Produces migration guides and adoption playbooks that raise ecosystem consistency and developer experience. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Lead cross-team evolution of middleware patterns or runtimes to standardize interoperability at scale. 
 - Define and enforce versioning, deprecation, and rollout strategies that minimize downstream breaks. 
 - Drive shared observability baselines (SLOs, error budgets) and resilience patterns across several services. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. 
 - Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements comprehensive software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. 
 - Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. 
 - Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. 
 - Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture. 
 - Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues. 
 - Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad-reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members. 
 - Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently. 
 - Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
