data.description:
Overview

TekWissen is a global workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world. The below client is a global company with shared ideals and a deep sense of family. From our earliest days as a pioneer of modern transportation, we have sought to make the world a better place - one that benefits lives, communities and the planet

Job Title: Back-end Software Development Engineering Engineer III

Location: Chennai

Work Type: Hybrid (4 Days work From Office)

Position Description

- Employees in this job function develop and maintain the back-end/ server-side parts of an application, typically consisting of APIs, databases and other services containing business logic. 
 - They work with various languages and tools to create and maintain services on-prem or in the cloud. 

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with customers to understand their use-cases and requirements
 - Solve complex problems by designing, developing, and delivering using various tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies 
 - Align with architecture guidelines for unified and coherent approach to development 
 - Design, develop, and deliver new code using various tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies 
 - Develop and maintain back-end applications like APIs and microservices using server-side languages like Java, Python, C#, etc. 
 - Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user interface elements and with cross functional teams like product owners, designers, architects etc. 
 - Manage application deployment to the cloud or on-prem, health and performance monitoring, security hardening and disaster recovery for deployed applications 
 - Manage data storage and retrievals in applications by utilizing database technologies such as Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, etc. 
 - Promote improvements in programming practices, such as test-driven development, continuous integration, and continuous delivery 
 - Optimize back-end infrastructure and deployment practices to improve application resiliency and reliability 
 - Support security practices to safeguard user data including encryption and anonymization

Skills Required

- Spring Boot, AI, PostgreSQL, Java

Skills Preferred

- SonarQube, GCP, Pub/Sub

Experience Required

- Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 
 - 6+ years in IT; 
 - 4+ years in development

Experience Preferred

- Prompt Engineering: Experience crafting effective prompts and workflows for code understanding, documentation, and generation. 
 - LLM Integration: Exposure to building applications that integrate LLMs (e. g. , RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, LangChain, or similar frameworks). 
 - Python: Familiarity with Python for scripting, notebooks, and AI/ML tooling. 
 - Cloud: Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and their AI/ML services. 
 - Legacy Modernization: Prior experience reverse-engineering or modernizing legacy systems. 
 - Documentation Tooling: Experience generating architecture diagrams, API docs, or knowledge bases (including AI-assisted approaches). 

Education Required

- Bachelor's Degree

Additional Information

- Understand Complex Systems Fast: Use AI-assisted techniques (Copilot, LLMs, code-analysis notebooks) to explore, map, and comprehend large existing applications, services, and their interdependencies. 
 - Build & Maintain Backend Services: Design, develop, and optimize robust microservices and APIs using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Reverse-Engineer & Document Legacy Logic: Analyze undocumented or legacy code, extract business logic, and produce clear technical documentation, diagrams, and knowledge artifacts-leveraging LLMs to accelerate the process. 
 - Apply AI to Engineering Workflows: Use LLMs and notebooks for code comprehension, test generation, refactoring assistance, dependency analysis, and impact assessment. 
 - Establish good practices for prompt design, validation, and safe use of AI-generated output. 
 - Improve Developer Productivity: Champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, sharing patterns, tooling, and guardrails that help engineers work faster without compromising quality. 
 - Ensure Quality & Correctness: Write comprehensive tests and rigorously validate AI-assisted output-treating AI as an accelerator, never a substitute for engineering judgment. 
 - Collaborate: Work closely with architects, product managers, and fellow engineers to translate legacy understanding into modernization and enhancement plans. 

TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.

data.title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:

Leads a platform group; develops strategies and plans that standardize runtimes, APIs, and SDKs across several teams.  - Directs teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Directs teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Directs teams to design and develop software, systems, and services. 
 - Coaches managers to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct teams in conducting periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within and outside the organization to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus. 
 - Directs teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Defines processes and approaches to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders within and outside of organization, including executive leadership, to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - Directs teams to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues. 
 - Leads teams and sets direction to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences multiple teams to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Directs the implementation of training for customer issue and/or defect handling processes. 
 - Leads the investigation and troubleshooting of complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions. 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with teams and leadership to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, evolving/dynamic industry best practices and processes, and coding standards. 
 - Ensures clarity on key elements and objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria to impact development processes in the organization. 
 - Implements complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities that affect the organization. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Defines key elements for teams to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Ensures teams are aware of and adhere to service contract, terms, and conditions. 
 - Directs teams to proactively evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs. Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives. 

Problem Solving: 

- Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed. Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues strategic learning opportunities to maintain expertise and apply best practices at the organizational level. Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills. Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization. Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Coaches teams to gain buy-in for ideas and to seek feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement. Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments. 

Performance and Development: 

- Serves as a role model for driving performance across teams through tailored feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization. Ensures that individual development goals are aligned with organizational strategic initiatives. Collaborates with HR to implement talent strategy through hiring and promotion processes. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. data.title: Technical Co-Founder / Founding Engineer
data.description:
Company Description XIMPEX provides expert export management services tailored to the specific needs of each client, helping organizations expand their global reach. The company focuses on enabling international growth while minimizing operational and regulatory risks. By offering structured, data-driven export solutions, XIMPEX supports businesses in navigating complex international markets. The team is dedicated to building long-term partnerships and delivering measurable results for global success. 
Role Description The Technical Co-Founder / Founding Engineer will lead the design, development, and scaling of XIMPEX's core technology platform, with a focus on tools that streamline export management and international operations. This full-time remote role involves building and maintaining backend and frontend systems, integrating third-party data sources, and ensuring robust performance, security, and reliability. The person in this role will define technical architecture, choose and implement technology stacks, and create prototypes and MVPs based on customer feedback and market research. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing clean, testable code, reviewing contributions, managing cloud infrastructure, and collaborating closely with business and product stakeholders on feature prioritization and roadmap planning. As a founding team member, this role also contributes to product strategy, supports fundraising and customer demos, and helps establish engineering best practices and culture. 
Qualifications

- Strong analytical skills for solving complex technical problems, designing system architecture, and interpreting product and market data. 
 - Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate in a remote environment. 
 - Understanding of sales processes and customer engagement dynamics to support demos, technical discussions with prospects, and solution customization. 
 - Foundational marketing awareness, particularly in positioning technical capabilities, supporting product messaging, and providing input on go-to-market strategies. 
 - Solid research skills to evaluate technologies, study export management domain requirements, and incorporate user and market insights into product development. 
 - Proven experience as a full-stack or backend engineer (startup or early-stage experience preferred), with ownership of production systems. 
 - Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks (e. g. , JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar; common web frameworks; RESTful APIs). 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, GCP, or Azure), databases, and basic DevOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, security best practices). 
 - Ability to work autonomously, make pragmatic decisions under uncertainty, and thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; prior exposure to logistics, trade, or export domains is a plus.

data.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs and architects infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Exercises judgment when performing data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting. Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation. Communicates comprehensive information about services and proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of changes. Provides comprehensive support for technology and documents incidents. Conducts advanced experiments with new tools and develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends. 

Responsibilities

Mandatory

- 5+ years of hands-on experience across software development, site reliability engineering, monitoring, and automation, with demonstrated ownership of production platforms. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, REST APIs, integrations, and event-driven workflows. 
 - Proven experience building monitoring and observability solutions that collect and analyze alerts, metrics, logs, and service context. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into applications for incident analysis, contextual recommendations, and operational decision support. 
 - Ability to develop reusable agents that combine live monitoring data, historical incidents, and previous remediation actions to recommend next steps. 
 - Experience implementing alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and prioritization to reduce noise and improve incident detection. 
 - Strong experience developing automated remediation workflows with approval controls, execution validation, audit trails, and recovery safeguards. 
 - Experience integrating monitoring platforms with incident management systems, knowledge repositories, and notification or escalation services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, Linux, networking, databases, and application performance, with the ability to translate failure patterns into platform capabilities. 
 - Experience applying software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and secure development. 
 - Ability to evaluate platform reliability and AI output quality, measure operational outcomes, and improve capabilities using engineer feedback. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with monitoring teams, service owners, and engineers to onboard services and define requirements. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases. 
 - Knowledge of anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and predictive techniques for identifying recurring alarm patterns. 
 - Experience building centralized notification services, automated escalation calls, and incident communication workflows. 
 - Familiarity with OCI, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as OCI Observability, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to Oracle Database and Exadata monitoring, performance diagnostics, and remediation automation. 
 - Experience using AI coding assistants to improve operational scripts and validate proposed changes. 
 - Knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, and incident metrics such as detection time, recovery time, and recurrence rate.

Capacity Ingestion and Management:

 - Proactively identifies opportunities for prototyping and drives prototyping initiatives (e. g. , testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches. 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:

 - Takes proactive steps to monitor services, maintain up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and document their condition.

 - Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data. 
 - May perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. 
 - May experiment with new approaches for and performs decommissioning (e. g. , shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed.

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

data.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
What makes us Qlik?

A Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly. 

Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in. 

The Senior Automation QA Engineer Role

Qlik is seeking a highly skilled Senior Automation QA Engineer to design and develop automated testing solutions for our Salesforce and NetSuite platforms. 

This role combines strong QA automation engineering with hands-on AI agent development using Playwright. The engineer will use AI agents and modern automation techniques to accelerate testing, improve coverage and reliability, and provide faster quality feedback throughout the software development lifecycle. 

The role also requires a responsible approach to AI development, considering appropriate ethical, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight principles. 

What makes this role interesting?

The software testing landscape is rapidly evolving, and the biggest challenge we are tackling right now is balancing deployment speed with flawless reliability. You will be at the forefront of solving this by replacing manual bottlenecks with intelligent, AI-driven automation. 

Here Is Why You Will Love What You Do

- Pioneering AI in QA: You get to build and deploy advanced AI agents using Playwright, completely transforming how test creation, execution, and regression testing are handled. 
 - Accelerating development cycles: By seamlessly integrating your automated tests directly into CI/CD pipelines, you will give developers the immediate, reliable feedback they need to build faster. 
 - Elevating the testing framework: Instead of maintaining legacy code, you will design and develop highly reusable automation frameworks and utilities from the ground up, freeing yourself from repetitive maintenance. 
 - Championing ethical AI: You won't just blindly trust AI outputs; you will be the human-in-the-loop. You will apply vital oversight, evaluating AI-generated results to ensure our testing practices remain secure, fair, and highly accurate. 

Here's How You'll Be Making An Impact

Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely we deliver software. By joining us, you aren't just finding bugs-you are engineering a smarter, more efficient way to build products. 

- Driving strategic quality: You will partner closely with developers, product owners, and key stakeholders to identify risks early, shifting quality left and shaping the overall testing strategy. 
 - Transforming defect detection: Your sophisticated, AI-enhanced test scenarios will catch critical issues before they reach production, ensuring rock-solid reliability across our Salesforce and NetSuite environments. 
 - Streamlining QA processes: Your clear, actionable insights from test failures and meticulous tracking metrics will continuously elevate our entire software development lifecycle. 
 - Mentoring through innovation: By introducing AI-assisted testing practices and clear documentation, you will naturally elevate the technical capabilities of the wider team and establish new industry-leading standards. 

We're Looking For a Teammate With

- 5+ years of hands-on QA automation experience. 
 - Strong programming and automation experience with Playwright and Python; experience with Selenium or similar frameworks is beneficial. 
 - Proven experience building AI agents using Playwright for software testing or QA automation. 
 - Good understanding of AI models, LLMs, and AI agent development, including how agents use tools and interact with applications. 
 - Experience with AI/agent technologies such as OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce (Apex, Lightning) and NetSuite (SuiteScript, workflows, or saved searches). 
 - Experience developing end-to-end automation across complex enterprise applications and integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of QA fundamentals, including test planning, test design, regression testing, defect management, and Agile/Scrum. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD, Jira, and test management tools such as Zephyr. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering and effective use of LLMs in software engineering. 
 - Awareness of responsible AI practices, including ethical use, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight. 
 - Performance, load, or security testing experience is desirable. 
 - Salesforce or NetSuite certifications are desirable. 

The location for this role is: 

Bangalore, India

Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!

More About Qlik And Who We Are

Find out more about 'Life at Qlik' on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page. 

What else do we offer?

- Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs. 
 - Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness. 
 - Flexible, diverse, and international work environment. 

Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra "change the world" day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs

If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability, please submit your request via email to accessibilityta@qlik. com. Any information you provide will be treated according to Qlik's Recruitment Privacy Notice. Qlik may only respond to emails related to accommodation requests. 

Qlik is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Qlik via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Qlik. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Qlik as a result of the referral or through other means.

data.title: Senior Java DBA Engineer
data.description:
Overview

As the world's most global bank, Citi gives you the tools to be a trailblazer. We're not just building technology; we're building the future of banking. With thousands of employees located around the globe, we are an international team encompassing a broad range of teams, roles, and cultures, and we invite you to come and join us!

Citi's technology team supports business operations in 100+ countries, across multiple lines of business spanning both Institutional and retail businesses. 

The group works to optimize the IT environment by standardizing production platforms, reducing complexity, and introducing innovative solutions that provide new business capabilities, reduce total cost of ownership, and create a competitive advantage for Citi. 

We want to regularly engage with talented individuals who are passionate about producing clean, testable code as part of a high performing team. We have found this to be way more important than experience in the financial sector. 

We welcome applications from any industry and should you wish to apply your application will be reviewed for a multitude of Developer positions at varying levels. 

What We Do / The Team

- Citi FX has a physical presence in 83 countries with 1, 400 dedicated staff giving us the largest FX presence of any bank globally. Foreign Exchange has been one of the defining businesses of Citi for much of its 200 year existence. 
 - Citi has the largest FX presence of any bank globally and we proudly put this down to delivering unrivalled service and insight to our clients. Increasing investment in technology has seen us roll out award winning applications. Technology is a central pillar for our plans to sustain and grow our FX business. 
 - Above all, we seek individuals who seek exceptional attitude and aptitude in the people they work with and have a demonstrated passion for delivering FX technology in support of our #1 FX business. 

Role Overview/What will you do: 

- As a Senior Java Engineer, your mission is to help shape our team of innovators and technologists toward creating next-level solutions that improve the way our business is run. 
 - Hands on technical implementation of Prime Brokerage solutions across FX and Equities using modern, cloud-native technologies and CI/CD workflows, focusing on consolidation, automation, and scalability. 
 - Drive the design and development of system architecture, work with end-users of the systems, and enhance the quality of deliverables Ensure staff follows Citi documented policy and procedures as well as maintain desktop procedures and supporting documentation for filings on a current basis and in comprehensive manner
 - The successful candidate will work with teams across FX Technology implement solutions that benefit the business
 - Collaborate with stakeholders across FX Prime Brokerage trading , Quants and Product team to understand Payments needs, translate them into impactful data-driven solutions, and deliver these in partnership with technology. 
 - Design, Development, Testing of new features in the applications. 
 - Continual improvement of the software development lifecycle and quality of the product. 
 - 3rd line support of the production system (dedicated 24h support teams handle 1st / 2nd line). 
 - Mentoring junior members of the team. 
 - Contribute to defining and implementing best practices and processes for the department and ensure transparency and consistency across teams

Key Skills And Experience Required -

- Master's degree or above (or equivalent education) in a STEM discipline. 
 - Proven experience in software engineering and development, and a strong understanding of computer systems and how they operate. 
 - Hands on Experience in Java , Spring, Understanding of ultra-low-latency development practices. 
 - Proven understanding of FX highly preferred
 - Well versed with AI coding tools like Devin , Claude code and Codex and delivered production grade applications. 
 - Proven track record of building new systems, replacing legacy systems and renovating existing systems
 - Strong skill set in SQL / Databases
 - Strong understanding of Messaging tech like Kafka, Solace , MQ etc. 
 - Writing production scale applications to use the Caching technologies. 
 - The candidate will have systems (software, hardware, networks) knowledge required to define solutions and trouble shoot issues
 - Exceptional communicator who loves working with people, confident communicating at all levels from an individual team to the entire enterprise
 - Highly credible hands on engineer, confident to deep dive into a product and codebase and offer detailed, constructive analysis and feedback
 - Awareness of industry trends and leveraging new technologies as appropriate

Any Beneficial / Nice to have skills and experience: 

- Understanding of Openshift , Kubernetes
 - KDB knowledge

data.description:
Business / Organization Overview

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Java Technical Lead (C12) to join our Enterprise Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and architectural evolution of high-throughput, mission-critical enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional architecture, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed event-driven platforms. 

Role Summary

As a C12 Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical execution with engineering leadership. You will drive architectural decisions, govern development standards, mentor engineering talent, and deliver end-to-end resilient back-end and distributed messaging solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, modern DevOps practices, and cloud-native containerized delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Lead the technical design, system decomposition, and development of mission-critical microservices and event-driven architectures. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with organizational blueprints, compliance benchmarks, and engineering standards. 
 - Own technical governance, including architectural reviews, coding standards, automated testing frameworks, and non-functional requirements (resilience, scalability, low latency, fault tolerance). 

Hands-on Engineering & Delivery

- Design and implement robust, high-performance back-end services using Core Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs. 
 - Build and optimize event streaming and message-oriented middleware patterns using Apache Kafka and IBM MQ / JMS. 
 - Architect and tune high-volume data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL document stores (MongoDB). 
 - Drive containerization and deployment strategies targeting modern enterprise cloud platforms (ECS / Red Hat OpenShift). 

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

- Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce unit/integration test coverage standards, and eliminate technical debt. 
 - Mentor and coach junior and mid-level developers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks. 

Agile & DevOps Collaboration

- Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments. 
 - Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Business Stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum delivery model to translate complex business requirements into clear technical roadmaps and epics. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity. 

Primary (Core) Skills & Competencies

- Core Java & Frameworks: Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning. 
 - Spring Ecosystem: Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). 
 - API & Integration: Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns. 
 - Messaging & Event Streaming: Strong hands-on implementation experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, fault handling) and enterprise message queues (IBM MQ / JMS). 
 - Database Engineering: Relational: Oracle DB (complex SQL, PL/SQL, schema design, index tuning, transaction isolation). NoSQL: MongoDB (data modeling, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning). 
 - Design Patterns & Clean Code: Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns. 

Secondary Skills & Familiarity (Highly Desirable)

- Containerization & Platforms: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms such as ECS / Red Hat OpenShift. 
 - Frontend / Full-Stack Exposure: Familiarity with modern frontend development using Angular, React JS. 
 - Business Process Management: Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM. 
 - Application Servers & Middleware: Understanding of legacy or hybrid runtime environments including IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS / Liberty). 
 - CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk). 

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

- Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills with a proven track record of resolving complex distributed systems challenges. 
 - Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to non-technical business partners. 
 - Ownership & Drive: Demonstrated ability to independently lead engineering initiatives from ideation to production rollout. 
 - Collaboration: High team spirit and emotional intelligence to work across globally distributed engineering teams.

Mentor and develop high-performing engineering teams, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment. data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Business / Organization Overview

We are looking for a high-caliber Senior Java Technical Lead / Architect (C13) to spearhead the architecture, engineering strategy, and technical delivery of enterprise-scale distributed platforms. In this strategic technical leadership position, you will govern large-scale engineering initiatives, drive cloud-native modernization, set foundational architecture patterns, and mentor multiple agile engineering squads across globally distributed teams. 

Role Summary

At the C13 grade, you will operate as a subject matter expert and technical authority combining deep architectural mastery with strategic delivery oversight. You will lead end-to-end design, technology evaluation, security governance, and multi-system integration across distributed microservices, high-throughput event streaming, enterprise databases, and container platforms. You will partner with Directors, Enterprise Architects, Product Managers, and Business Leaders to ensure technology roadmaps align with business transformation objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Architecture & System Design

- Own end-to-end technical architecture, system decomposition, and integration strategy for complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems. 
 - Define architectural blueprints, domain models, and technical design standards for high-throughput, low-latency, and highly available microservices. 
 - Lead technology evaluation, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and modernization roadmaps (e. g. , legacy monolith/WebSphere decomposition to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures). 
 - Formally represent the application in Enterprise Architecture Governance, Security Reviews, and Technology Risk committees. 

Technical Governance & Engineering Leadership

- Provide technical leadership and architectural oversight across multiple development teams and technical leads (C11/C12). 
 - Enforce rigorous engineering standards, Clean Code practices, comprehensive automated testing (TDD/BDD), and robust CI/CD DevOps pipelines. 
 - Establish standards for non-functional requirements (NFRs) including system resilience, fault tolerance, high availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), low latency, and horizontal scalability. 
 - Drive modernization of messaging pipelines, event stream topologies, and polyglot persistence layers. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Executive Stakeholders to translate multi-year business strategies into actionable, phased technical roadmaps. 
 - Manage architectural risks, technical debt remediation, and capacity planning. 
 - Act as the senior escalation authority for critical production incidents, driving root cause analysis (RCA) and long-term architectural stability solutions. 

Mentorship & Talent Development

- Foster an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture emphasizing continuous learning, innovation, and technical rigor. 
 - Mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, building leadership pipelines and engineering talent across the organization. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Competencies

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
 - 15+ years of overall software engineering experience in enterprise-grade applications, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical lead, software architect or engineering leadership capacity. 
 - Proven track record of architecting, delivering, and supporting high-throughput, mission-critical systems in financial services, banking, or large enterprise domains. 

Primary Skills & Technical Mastery

- Core Java & Advanced JVM Engineering: Deep mastery of Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), high-concurrency programming, multithreading, memory management, garbage collection tuning (ZGC/G1), and low-latency optimization. 
 - Spring Ecosystem & Microservices Architecture: Extensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). 
 - Event-Driven Architecture & Distributed Messaging: 
 - Expert-level design and production operations with Apache Kafka (cluster architecture, partitions, consumer groups, Kafka Streams/Connect, schema registry, idempotent producers). 
 - Enterprise messaging and integration via IBM MQ / JMS and transaction management across distributed systems (Saga pattern, two-phase commit alternatives). 
 - API Strategy & Integration Patterns: Advanced RESTful API design, OpenAPI standards, API Gateways, gRPC, OAuth2/OIDC, and mutual TLS (mTLS). 
 - Polyglot Database Architecture: 
 - Relational: Oracle (advanced PL/SQL, partitioning, index optimization, query execution plan analysis, Active Data Guard). 
 - NoSQL / Document: MongoDB (sharding, replica sets, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning at scale). 
 - Resilience & Fault Tolerance Patterns: Proven experience implementing Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j), Rate Limiting, Bulkheads, and Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger). 

Secondary Skills & Modernization Competencies

- Containerization & Cloud Native Platforms: Architectural expertise in container platforms, specifically Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes and AWS ECS, including Pod autoscaling, ingress controllers, and Helm chart lifecycle management. 
 - Legacy Modernization & Middleware: Experience migrating workloads from legacy application servers (IBM WebSphere WAS/ND) and workflow orchestrators (IBM BAW / BPM) to modern microservices and cloud runtimes. 
 - Frontend Architecture Exposure: Solid understanding of modern SPA architecture, frontend integration, and frameworks like Angular (TypeScript, state management). 
 - DevOps & Automation: In-depth knowledge of modern CI/CD automation (Harness, Tekton, Jenkins), infrastructure-as-code, and automated security scanning tools (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, Prisma). 

Leadership & Executive Competencies

- Strategic Vision: Ability to conceptualize multi-year technical strategies and execute them incrementally within agile frameworks. 
 - Executive Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing both technical teams and senior executive leadership. 
 - Problem Solving & Decision Making: Strong analytical acumen with proven ability to make pragmatic architectural trade-offs under constraints. 
 - Delivery Ownership: High accountability for end-to-end software delivery, operational excellence, and production resilience.

data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

Keep GSK's standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section. 

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK's Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment. 

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform ownership: run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner's backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Reliability: achieve 99. 9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred. 
 - Everything as code: manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Secure by default: enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards. 
 - Golden paths: build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team's time. 
 - AI Agentic automation: Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails. 
 - Compliance: keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline. 
 - Toolchain rationalisation: be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting. 
 - Developer experience: measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours. 
 - Leadership: set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect's reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 
 - Area of Specialisation
 - Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
 - Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts. undefined
 - Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
 - Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
 - Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert). 
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. 
 - Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices
 - Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

Skills

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

data.title: Data Engineering Manager
data.description:
Company Description

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth. com and follow the company on LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Facebook. 

About The Role

Are you passionate about transforming healthcare through data-driven innovation? The Enterprise Data Platform team is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, evolution, and scaling of our AWS-based enterprise data platform that powers analytics, operational intelligence, AI-enabled solutions, and business-critical decision-making. This role is ideal for a technical leader who combines strong data engineering expertise with architectural vision, product thinking, and a passion for solving business problems through data. As a player-coach, you will contribute to architecture, technical design, and key implementations while mentoring engineers and shaping the future of our data platform. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business stakeholders to build scalable data products and platform capabilities that transform data into actionable insights, intelligent automation, and measurable business outcomes. Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Architect and evolve scalable, secure, and AI-ready data platforms across ingestion, storage, transformation, analytics, and data product layers. 
 - Define technical vision, architecture standards, and engineering best practices that balance business needs, scalability, governance, and innovation. Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business teams to define and execute the architectural vision for a modern data platform, influencing long-term technical direction while balancing current priorities with future growth. 
 - Lead the evolution of our AWS-centric data platform by continuously evaluating modern data architecture patterns, cloud-native services, and emerging AI technologies to ensure the platform scales efficiently with growing business needs and data volumes. 
 - Assess build-versus-buy opportunities and make pragmatic technology decisions that balance business value, scalability, maintainability, operational complexity, and cost. 
 - Champion modern data architecture patterns including data products, data contracts, observability, self-service capabilities, metadata-driven architectures, and AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Data Products & Business Impact

- 
 - Lead the design and delivery of data products that generate measurable business value through analytics, automation, AI/ML, and operational insights. 
 - Partner with stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities and translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Apply a product mindset to data solutions, ensuring investments align with business priorities and user needs. 
 - Define success metrics and drive adoption, reliability, and business outcomes for data products. 

Engineering Leadership

- Lead the design and evolution of scalable data platforms and engineering practices that enable reliable delivery of data products across analytics, AI/ML, and operational use cases. 
 - Guide technology, architecture, and engineering decisions across the data ecosystem to ensure scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Establish engineering standards for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data platforms across batch, streaming, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads. 
 - Contribute to architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and critical implementations. 
 - Promote engineering excellence through automation, testing, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as Code, and operational best practices. 

Team & Culture

- Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers. 
 - Coach engineers in system design, architectural thinking, engineering craftsmanship, and operational excellence. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, continuous improvement, and technical curiosity. 
 -

Governance & Reliability

- Ensure strong foundations in data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, security, and compliance. 
 - Drive platform reliability, monitoring, observability, and operational excellence. Partner with security and governance teams to implement best practices for handling sensitive and regulated data. 
 -

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related fields. 
 - 2+ years of experience leading and growing engineering teams. 
 - Proven experience building and scaling enterprise data platforms and data products. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering measurable business value through data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, automation, or a combination of these capabilities.

Straive is seeking a hands-on technology leader to serve as the senior technical authority for our AI, analytics, and software engineering solutions. 

About the Role: 

You will set technical direction, resolve complex engineering challenges, and move solutions from prototype to secure, scalable production. The role combines architecture and execution leadership including a mandate to improve enterprise AI economics through fit-for-purpose frontier, open-source, and smaller models. 

This is not a conventional delivery-governance role. You will remain close to the technology, lead critical design and code reviews, mentor teams, and take accountability for high-stakes technical outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Production-Grade Engineering

- Own engineering standards across architecture, development, testing, deployment, security, observability, and documentation. 
 - Ensure prototypes have a credible production path; introduce architecture and code reviews, automated testing, quality gates, and release-readiness checks. 
 - Close gaps in scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and security from design through deployment. 2. AI Architecture and Economics

- Define scalable, reliable, and cost-effective AI/GenAI architectures based on accuracy, cost, latency, privacy, and deployment needs. 
 - Lead selection, evaluation, fine-tuning, optimization, and deployment of frontier, open-source, small, and domain-specific models. 
 - Reduce operating cost through model routing, caching, quantization, batching, retrieval and prompt optimization; design robust RAG and agentic systems with evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and human oversight. 3. Technical Architecture and Platforms

- Serve as the final escalation point for complex architecture, performance, security, and deployment issues. 
 - Guide modular applications, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, AI services, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Promote reusable components and strong cloud-native, CI/CD, observability, data governance, and secure-development practices. 4. Team Capability

- Mentor architects, engineering leads, data scientists, and developers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical workshops. 
 - Build independent problem-solving capability, identify skill gaps, and support targeted hiring and development. 
 - Create a culture of engineering ownership, technical rigor, experimentation, and continuous improvement. 5. Client Solutioning and Innovation

- Partner with commercial, consulting, and delivery teams on client workshops, proposals, due diligence, and solution design. 
 - Assess feasibility, architecture, effort, risk, and operating cost; translate business problems into pragmatic technical roadmaps. 
 - Develop reference architectures and accelerators that strengthen Straive's differentiation and delivery speed. Required Experience and Qualifications

- 12-18 years across software engineering, architecture, data platforms, AI/ML, or related roles, including experience in a startup, product company, or similarly fast-moving environment. 
 - Proven ownership of enterprise-grade software, data, or AI products from architecture through production adoption. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering background, preferably in Python and modern backend/frontend technologies. 
 - Practical GenAI experience spanning RAG, vector search, agentic workflows, model evaluation, safety controls, and production monitoring. 
 - Strong command of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, cloud-native architecture, enterprise integration, and at least one major cloud platform. 
 - Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, secure development, and modern data platforms. 
 - Demonstrated ability to improve solution cost, latency, scalability, reliability, and engineering quality. 
 - Experience mentoring senior technical professionals and communicating complex decisions to business and client leaders. Preferred Experience

- Multi-tenant platforms, reusable AI accelerators, MLOps/LLMOps, model governance, or regulated and security-sensitive environments. 
 - Technical pre-sales, client workshops, proposals, solution estimation, and technical due diligence. 
 - A track record of taking multiple AI or software products from concept to sustained production use. Leadership Profile

- Hands-on and accountable: Stays close to code and architecture and drives critical issues to resolution. 
 - Commercially pragmatic: Balances technical ambition with client value, speed, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Constructive challenger: Identifies weaknesses early, challenges assumptions, and raises engineering standards. 
 - Capability builder: Develops strong, independent teams rather than becoming the sole source of expertise. Why Join Straive?

You will shape how enterprise-grade AI solutions are architected, built, and scaled with the mandate to influence technical strategy, strengthen engineering practices, develop high-performing teams, and deliver differentiated solutions for global clients.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience designing and delivering modern, distributed software systems.

 - Proven expertise building and scaling platform-based solutions with measurable business impact. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams in delivering complex, multi-stakeholder products in fast-paced, enterprise environments. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering practices, architecture patterns, and enterprise development tools. 
 - Ability to translate business strategy into technology and engineering outcomes, driving alignment across product, risk, and engineering.

 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, scrum teams, business stakeholders, and external partners. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong domain expertise in customer acquisition, credit underwriting, and Open Banking ecosystems. 
 - Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries, with an understanding of risk, compliance, and security requirements. 
 - Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, API platforms, and event-driven integration patterns. 
 - Experience leading modernization initiatives, including integrating new platforms with legacy systems in enterprise environments.

 - Experience with cloud-native platforms and engineering ecosystems (Azure, containers, CI/CD, API management). 
 - Relevant certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, or Cloud technologies are a plus. 

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a leader who: 

- Thinks and operates at a platform and ecosystem level, considering impacts across domains, customer journeys, and partner integrations. 
 - Demonstrates deep understanding of end-to-end acquisition and underwriting flows, including users, systems, and business outcomes.

You will work closely with our development teams and other architects to turn business needs into secure, scalable and sustainable technical solutions. 

Our environment is primarily built around AWS, but also Azure, using modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to technology while helping teams make good architectural decisions. You won't be working in isolation. Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort, and an important part of your role will be creating alignment and helping teams make sound technical decisions.

To join our journey

WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.
