data.description:
Description

Trintech is an award-winning AI driven Fintech SaaS organization transforming the way finance teams operate and we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Test Engineer to lead quality assurance efforts and ensure the delivery of reliable, high-performing software solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing and overseeing comprehensive test strategies across all phases of the software development lifecycle. Your expertise in test automation, performance testing and quality standards will guide the team in identifying and resolving issues effectively, fostering a culture of quality. 

As a senior member of the team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership to improve testing processes, tools and methodologies. Your role will have a significant impact on enhancing the efficiency, scalability and reliability of our products, ensuring an exceptional user experience. 

This position is ideal for a seasoned professional with a strong technical foundation, excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products. 

What You Will Do

- The Sr Software Test Engineer will be responsible for end-to-end testing activities. 
 - Develop and execute test plans consisting of both manual and automated test cases to validate software functionality against requirements and specifications. 
 - Identify, troubleshoot, report, and track software defects and issues. 
 - Perform functional, performance, and regression testing of software products. 
 - Report test results and defects to the development team and other stakeholders and work on the resolution. 
 - Provide suggestions and feedback to improve the quality of the software development process across teams. 
 - Stay updated with industry trends in software testing methodologies and tools. 
 - Active participation in planning, analysis, and estimation of backlog requirements. 
 - Configure test environments with different platform combinations for testing. 
 - Ability to work in a close team environment and engage with other departments. 
 - Able to work with minimal supervision and still meet job requirements and tight deadlines. 
 - Learn an automation tool (if new to automation) and automate the test cases. 
 - Learn a performance testing tool (if new to performance testing) and run the performance test cases. 

Who You Are

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering or related field (or equivalent work experience). 
 - 4-6 years of experience in software testing
 - Extensive experience with manual and automated testing methodologies, including functional, regression and performance testing. 
 - Experience in test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium or playwright
 - Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner or other related tools to validate scalability and system performance under load. 
 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, isolate and troubleshoot issues, ensuring high-quality test coverage. 
 - Proven ability to work effectively with developers, product managers and other stakeholders, ensuring that testing needs are integrated early in the development process. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills to clearly report issues, document test cases and collaborate with cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers, promoting best practices and continuous improvement within the team. 
 - Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript or similar. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-powered testing tools and working knowledge of how AI and ML model behaviors influence test strategy, test data design, and validation approaches. 
 - Experience testing cloud-native applications on Azure, or any other cloud platform, including validation of microservices, APIs, and cloud service integrations
 - Previous experience with Reconciliation and/or month-end close applications is preferred

Cultural Fit

- Excellent interpersonal skills
 - Superior analytical and problem-solving abilities
 - Desire to work in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
 - Detail-oriented with excellent organization skills
 - Strong writing and communication skills
 - Continuous improvement mindset
 - Creative and Innovative thinking
 - Embraces change, growth, and evolution

At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values - Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Scala Developer)
data.description:
Everything we do is for our customers!

Featured on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 list and G2's leaderboard, Maropost offers a unified commerce experience that our customers need, transforming ecommerce, retail, marketing automation, merchandising, helpdesk and AI operations with one platform designed to scale for fast-growing businesses. With a relentless focus on our customers' success, we are motivated by customer obsession, extreme urgency, excellence and resourcefulness to to power 5, 000+ global brands while we head to 100, 000+. 

Driven by the same customer-centric mentality as above, we empower businesses to achieve their goals and grow alongside us. If you're a driver and not passenger and are ready to make a significant impact and be part of our transformative journey, Maropost is the place for you. 

The Opportunity

Thrive on change and grow beyond limits! We are looking for a bold thinker who sees a chance to learn and define what's possible with every challenge! Ready to make an impact? Welcome to Maropost and you can turn ideas into action!

We are looking for an open-minded and enthusiastic intermediate-level Scala Engineer to join our backend team. We are a passionate and highly collaborative team with a bias for quality and continuous improvement. If you are looking for an environment where you can learn and see your ideas come to life, let's talk!

What You'll Be Responsible For

- Design and write sustainable, easy-to-read, and elegant code, rearchitecting and refactoring existing software where needed. 
 - Contributing to technical and product specs, and collaborating on architecture and design decisions together with the other stakeholders
 - Testing the software you build for reliability and robustness using different testing paradigms and libraries
 - Review feedback on the specs and the code as an opportunity for continuous improvement and collaborative design, and carrying out spec and code review for your coworkers
 - Make recommendations regarding introducing new tools and improving processes. 
 - Continuous learning of different programming paradigms and new technologies
 - Work with a highly collaborative group of engineers. 

What You'll Bring To Maropost

- 6+ years of experience in Scala backend development. 
 - 4+ years' experience with mapping business domains into SQL schemas. 
 - Experience with message-based architectures (we use Pulsar). 
 - Knowledge in API design (REST or GraphQL). 
 - Understand and work with modern cloud-native infrastructure (we deploy to Kubernetes). 
 - Responsible for builds and CI/CD processes (we use CircleCI for builds and GitOps with ArgoCD for back-end deployments). 
 - Excellent communication skills, a bias for feedback and continuous improvement, combined with the ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams. 
 - The ability to take ownership and initiatives over tasks/projects and share any new ideas with the team. 
 - Candidates whose primary experience is Scala-based data engineering, Spark, ETL, or Big Data development without significant backend/application development experience will not be considered. 
 - You exemplify Maropost's Values: 
 - Customer Obsessed
 - Extreme Urgency

data.title: Software Development Engineer II
data.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. 

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 

Introduction to the team

You will be joining Travels Foundation, Expedia Group's core platform powering pre and post-booking journeys at global scale. At its heart, the Ordering Services team owns the end-to-end lifecycle of every trip-from checkout to post-booking-across all major travel products. 

We're looking for an experienced backend engineer and strong technologist to build and evolve highly scalable, low-latency systems that power millions of bookings every day. 

Operating at the core of Expedia's transaction platform, our systems process millions of orders and updates daily, ensuring reliability, consistency, and auditability across brands and channels through domain-driven APIs. 

Join us to shape and scale the ordering platform that underpins Expedia Group's global travel marketplace. 

As an SDE II, you will design, build, and operate key components of Expedia Group's Ordering Services platform, powering critical booking, reservation, and order management experiences across the travel ecosystem. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality, scalable, and reliable services that support order creation, modification, fulfilment, and lifecycle management while ensuring a seamless experience for travelers and partner teams. 

You will be a hands-on engineer, contributing code, driving technical design discussions, improving system reliability, and collaborating closely with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Your work will directly impact the scalability, performance, and resilience of the Ordering Services domain, enabling millions of travel transactions to be processed accurately and efficiently while accelerating innovation across Expedia Group's customer experiences. 

In This Role, You Will

- Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance services and applications, contributing to end-to-end feature delivery across multiple domains. 
 - Implement clean, testable code, including system design (low-level design), API design, and data modeling, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable. 
 - Collaborate with peers, product, and operations teams to translate business and customer requirements into technical solutions, using data and metrics to guide decisions. 
 - Own the full software development lifecycle for your services, including code reviews, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational support in production environments. 
 - Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‐enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products. 
 - Contribute to shared platforms, libraries, and patterns that can be reused across teams, increasing engineering efficiency and enabling fungibility across multiple product and service areas. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.

 - Hands-on experience with object-oriented and functional programming languages(such as Kotlin, Java, or similar), data structures and algorithms, and core software engineering practices such as code reviews, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, and observability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design and implement service- or API-based solutions, including basic data modeling and system design within a single service or small set of services. 
 - Experience collaborating in an agile environment, owning features from design through deployment, and supporting them in production within a team or product area. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing and evolving service architectures, including thoughtful low-level design, API contracts, and data models that support reliability, performance, and extensibility. 
 - Proven experience operating systems at scale, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability, latency, and cost. 
 - Track record of using data and experimentation to drive engineering decisions, optimize user experiences, and improve system behavior. 
 - Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating AI/ML‐enabled capabilities into existing services. 
 - Experience contributing to technical direction within a team through code and design feedback, and applying modern engineering practices (e. g. , automation, security-by-design, performance tuning) to elevate overall code quality. 

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https: //expedia. service-now. com/askeg?id=job_accommodation. 

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels. com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. 

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Requisition ID: 77662

Description

The candidate will help staff, and lead MSB's IC Verification Team in Bengaluru with a mission of building a strong team focused on chip-level verification. This team will be a key part of our Mobile Solutions Business, which consists of highly integrated front end modules that integrate Filters, Switches, LNAs, and matching in densely packed & complex front-end modules for Cellular and WiFi applications. The team will work directly and closely with design teams in the US. 

As the Verification manager, you will be responsible for a team of engineers driving chip top level verification. You and your team will engage in frequent technical meetings and design reviews with chip leads and counterparts abroad. 

In this position, you have the opportunity to make uniquely large impact on the success of the company and will have visibility at the highest levels of the company. 

We are looking for a passion to win/contribute and ability to work in, and thrive in, a fast-paced dynamic team environment. 

Responsibilities

The candidate will report to the Engineering Director locally and have a team of Engineers reporting to them. These Engineers will have a matrix reporting structure to various teams in US leading IC design. 

Responsibilities Will Include, But Not Be Limited To

- Recruiting & Staffing: 
 - 
 - Jointly drive staffing & recruiting with HR to ensure a world-class team is brought together to execute on complex, highly critical programs. 
 - Technical Leadership: 
 - Act as the IC Verification & Technical Leader for a team focused on the verification of RFICs that are integrated into our complex front-end modules
 - Experience managing large technical teams
 - A track record of growing successful design teams
 - Ability to set & articulate clear goals and drive accountability to those 
 - Use of AI tools to improve productivity, efficiency, automation, bug-tracking and reporting
 - Communication: 
 - Drive company communications, strategy, and goals via team meetings and regular 1: 1 and reporting to chip leads and managers in the US. 
 - Travel to US will be required from time to time
Required Experience And Skills

- The candidate must have excellent written and spoken communications, sufficient to present program technical status & schedule progress to senior management. 
 - Technical requirements: 
 - Strong experience with the Cadence suite of EDA tools
 - Deep and broad expertise in functional AMS verification of RFICs including RF/Analog/Digital content
 - Develop and maintain verification plans, strategies and methodology
 - Perform functional, behavioral and regression verification
 - Collaborate with RF designers and chip leads for successful tapeout and release of products to guarantee first-pass success
 - Automate verification flows and reporting infrastructure
 - Strong debug and root-cause analysis skills
 - Circuit Analysis: 
 - Understanding of analog blocks including low bit count data converters (ADC & DAC blocks), Bandgaps, Op-Amps, Bias blocks, Charge-pumps, Temp sensor, LDO, ESD, e-fuse and other supporting cells. 
 - Knowledge of RF SOI technology including RF switch, tuning & RF LNA design. 
 - Digital Design including SPI & MIPI interface design, Decoding logic, and simple state machines. 
 - Semiconductor device and process knowledge including SOI, bulk CMOS, SiGe. 
Minimum Requirements

- BSEE; MS preferred
 - 10+ years of IC Design/Verification experience

At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Lead, DevOps

Job Description

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced DevOps erve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, assessing DevOps maturity, identifying capability gaps, recommending improvement opportunities, and guiding teams through the implementation and adoption of approved standards, practices, and enterprise capabilities. 

Responsibilities

- Own and advance a designated DevOps capability domain, defining its implementation patterns, adoption strategy, technical direction, roadmap, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Serve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, providing technical leadership, standards guidance, architecture direction, and capability adoption support. 
 - Lead DevOps excellence evaluations by establishing maturity baselines, assessing current-state capabilities, defining and tracking key performance indicators, performing gap analyses, measuring progress against target-state objectives, and recommending improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead DevOps capability adoption across product teams by assessing current-state maturity, identifying capability gaps, establishing implementation backlogs, defining roadmaps, and driving adoption of enterprise DevOps standards. 
 - Perform application, platform, and team readiness assessments to identify technical, operational, process, skills, and capability gaps. Conduct gap assessments against enterprise cloud requirements, engineering standards, architecture principles, security requirements, and DevOps standards, and define remediation plans to address identified deficiencies. 
 - Lead the planning and execution of DevOps transformation and implementation initiatives, including roadmap development, backlog establishment, work prioritization, effort estimation, resource planning, budget forecasting, and day-to-day delivery coordination. 
 - Assign, lead, and support DevOps Engineers embedded within product teams to accelerate capability adoption, standards implementation, platform modernization, and delivery improvements. 
 - Ensure all engagements include structured coaching, mentoring, knowledge transfer, documentation, and capability enablement activities that increase team self-sufficiency and reduce long-term dependency on embedded DevOps support. 
 - Establish clear engagement objectives, success criteria, transition plans, and exit criteria that enable operational ownership to be successfully transferred to product teams once capabilities have been adopted. 
 - Provide low-level solution architecture and low-level cloud architecture guidance, ensuring applications, platforms, delivery pipelines, and operational practices remain aligned with enterprise standards, architecture principles, and strategic technology direction. 
 - Design, review, and contribute Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application deployment specifications, automation scripts, and reusable implementations that improve scalability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead and promote observability and monitoring practices that improve visibility into application and platform health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Integrate security controls and tooling into development pipelines and partner with engineering teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Apply and promote DevOps good practices, industry standards, enterprise architecture principles, and approved engineering patterns across product teams and platforms. 
 - Define and promote standard implementation patterns, ensuring teams leverage approved enterprise platforms, shared services, and reusable capabilities whenever practical and appropriate. 
 - Track delivery milestones, capability adoption progress, implementation outcomes, and team objectives, proactively identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required. 
 - Perform code reviews, architecture reviews, standards compliance reviews, and change-control assessments to identify quality, security, reliability, and compliance gaps. 
 - Promote awareness and adoption of enterprise platforms, shared services, engineering capabilities, and reusable solutions available across the organization. 
 - Create opportunities for experimentation, proof-of-concepts, pilot implementations, and innovation initiatives that improve engineering effectiveness, accelerate adoption, and support the evolution of DevOps capabilities. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, automation practices, cloud capabilities, observability approaches, and AI-driven engineering techniques, recommending solutions that improve the repeatability, reliability, security, and efficiency of software delivery. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, maintain a continuous learning mindset, and support the ongoing evolution of the assigned DevOps capability domain. 

Requirements

data.title: Software Development Manager, PV Sports and Linear Tech / Live Events Publishing
data.description:
Description

Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers. 

We are a team of builders - from new graduates to seasoned architects - who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on. 

Who Are We

The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact. 

About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. You will set the technical direction, hire and grow engineers, and drive the bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystallize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who sets a high bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle, while hiring, coaching, developing, and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. We value a proactive mindset and a genuine passion for making complex systems simple. Your ability to build a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices. 

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning their project assignments, performance coaching, and career development while building a strong hiring pipeline

Define and communicate your team's roadmap and technical strategy to management, principal stakeholders, and partner teams, aligning priorities with customer needs

Facilitate systems design, architecture, and scaling discussions, making sound trade-offs across reliability, latency, and maintainability for the live sports catalog

Partner with product management and peer engineering managers to scope work, estimate effort, and deliver high-quality software that improves the live sports viewing experience worldwide

Champion operational excellence by establishing metrics, monitoring practices, and automation that keep your team's services healthy and your customers well-served

A day in the life

You start by syncing with product and partner engineering leads to scope upcoming work or unblock in-flight deliveries. Mid-morning you might review a design document with your engineers, pressure-testing assumptions around latency and scale for a new publishing workflow. After lunch you check operational dashboards, then shift to a one-on-one where you coach a team member through a promotion plan. Later you contribute to your team's technical strategy, weighing customer impact against engineering cost before wrapping up with a status update to stakeholders. 

About The Team

The Prime Video Sports Publishing (LEP) team is the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. The team builds and operates the suite of services behind our vision to be the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans to discover, purchase, and consume sports content on any device. 

We are a team that values inclusiveness, respect, and mentorship. Our technology choices and designs are driven by engineers, not handed down from above. We have a strong voice in shaping the product, pitching ideas up the chain rather than the other way around. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Validation Engineer
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

The Post-Silicon Validation team within the Performance Computing Power Division is building a world-class organization of highly skilled engineers across multiple global sites. Our mission is to push the boundaries of silicon validation for industry-leading integrated circuits enabling high-power, high-efficiency power management systems. 

We are committed to delivering the highest level of validation quality by continuously improving test coverage, measurement accuracy, repeatability, automation, and execution efficiency while reducing overall validation time. 

As a Validation Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary global development team and play a key role in ensuring that every new product fully meets its electrical, functional, and performance specifications before release to production. You will work closely with Design, Applications, Product Engineering, Quality, and System teams to identify, debug, and resolve silicon and system-level issues while supporting aggressive product development and New Product Introduction (NPI) schedules. 

For our office in Bangalore, we are looking for a passionate engineer who thrive on innovation, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and is committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. 

Principal Responsibilities : 

- Validate analog, digital, mixed-signal, and power management ICs against electrical, functional, and performance specifications. 

- Prepare advanced laboratory test setups for complex silicon evaluation. 

- Contribute to the design of custom evaluation boards and supporting hardware for silicon characterization. 

- Develop measurement scripts using Python. 

- Perform data acquisition, statistical analysis, result correlation, preparation of detailed technical reports and silicon evaluation summaries. 

- Evaluate silicon performance at device, board, and system level, identifying, documenting, and tracking silicon and application issues. 

- Collaborate closely with Design, Applications, Firmware, Product Engineering, and Quality teams to investigate and resolve silicon and system-level bugs. 

- Contribute innovative ideas that enhance validation quality, automation, productivity, and time-to-market. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline with about 2 years of work-related experience. 

- Good level of expertise in lab automation, ability to propose improvements to existing measurements techniques. 

- Proficiency with Python programming with particular use for lab automation hardware environments

- Basic knowledge of power management applications in consumer electronic

- Board level analog and digital circuit design expertise for PCB schematic creation

- Strong analytical and debugging skills with a systematic approach to problem solving. 

- Self-motivated, proactive, and able to manage priorities while delivering high-quality results under demanding project schedules. 

- Goals-oriented and able to deliver on-time results under tight schedules

- Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within international cross-functional teams. 

Important

- Concise and precise communication, internal and with customers

- Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity within multisite and multicultural environments

- Flexible to undertake occasional international travel

- Excellent command of verbal and written English

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

Job Role Description

Are you passionate about architecting enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines that empower embedded software teams to deliver with speed, quality, and confidence? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives. 

As our new Senior Software Integration Engineer, you'll be designing and maintaining automated build, test, and deployment workflows for embedded software products that accelerate DevOps adoption across Grundfos engineering teams. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging. 

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Embedded Software Integration & DevOps team, you'll create impact by driving engineering transformation by building scalable CI/CD infrastructure and automation frameworks that elevate software delivery across multiple product platforms. 

Your main responsibilities include: 

- Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines for embedded C/C++ software products, including automated build, test, validation, and deployment workflows
 - Define and enforce pipeline standards, quality gates, and governance practices while building reusable templates and shared automation frameworks across product teams
 - Integrate static code analysis, security scanning, unit testing, and compliance checks into delivery pipelines, implementing DevSecOps and software supply chain security practices
 - Drive DevOps adoption across engineering teams by mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and leading automation initiatives organization-wide
 - Develop Python-based solutions for build orchestration, deployment automation, and API integrations with DevOps and SCM platforms
 - Manage cross-compilation toolchains, artifact repositories, and firmware build/packaging/deployment processes while troubleshooting complex build and dependency issues

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a seasoned integration engineer with deep CI/CD expertise, a DevOps-first mindset, and the ability to drive standardization and automation across multiple embedded software teams. We'd also imagine that you are/have: 

- 9+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Build Engineering, DevOps, or CI/CD Automation with proven experience designing pipelines from scratch
 - Strong experience supporting Embedded C software development environments including cross-compilation, toolchain management, and firmware deployment
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and implementing DevSecOps practices including software supply chain security
 - Demonstrated ability to lead automation initiatives across multiple teams with excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

It's a plus if you also: 

- Familiarity with tools such as Black Duck, SonarQube, Coverity, or Fortify, and experience in regulated industries with cybersecurity requirements for embedded products
 - Track record of driving engineering transformation initiatives at scale

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations. 

Join Grundfos, apply today!

Essential Skills

 - Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.

All About You

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. 
 - Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams. 
 - Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing multi-region resiliency architectures, including active-active and active-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions. 
 - Champions operability and maintainability as first-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception. 
 - Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization. 
 - Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;

 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

About Quorum Software

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies. 

Who We Are Looking For

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation. 

The Opportunity

Quorum is seeking a Lead Full-Stack Engineer to own the technical design, development, and long-term success of a portfolio of AI-native platforms and operational solutions within Cloud Operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who enjoys building products, establishing practical engineering standards, and owning production outcomes. You will serve as the primary technical lead and code owner while partnering with Cloud Operations, engineering peers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders. 

The initial focus is QPOP, the Quorum Platform Operations Portal, an Azure-native internal platform that brings service management, change management, estate visibility, customer relationships, and operational workflows into a unified experience. As the portfolio grows, the role will also deliver governed AI agents, agentic workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 

What You Will Own

- Application architecture and code quality across the assigned portfolio, including module boundaries, integrations, data models, testing standards, and production readiness. 
 - Engineering standards for code review, automated testing, CI/CD quality gates, documentation, observability, security, and an AI-enabled software development lifecycle (AI SDLC). 
 - Technical delivery from design through production support, working with partner teams rather than operating as a standalone contributor. 
 - Repository governance, including code ownership, reusable development patterns, AI-development guidance, prompt and agent assets, evaluation criteria, and review controls. 

What You Will Do

- Deliver full-stack application modules from design through build, integration, verification, release, and ongoing support. 
 - Build workflow integrations with enterprise platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, PagerDuty, Microsoft Fabric, and related internal systems. 
 - Design reliable integration patterns using idempotency, webhooks, retries, reconciliation, failure recovery, and traceable audit records. 
 - Implement enterprise authentication and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0, Microsoft Entra ID, and role-based access control. 
 - Build metadata-driven forms, service catalogs, request workflows, and rules-driven user experiences. 
 - Design and develop governed AI agents, MCP servers, assistants, and agentic workflows that take approved actions through well-defined tools, permission checks, human approval points, and complete audit trails. 
 - Embed AI-assisted engineering into the SDLC, including planning, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, security validation, and controlled promotion, while ensuring engineers remain accountable for every change. 
 - Deliver applications and infrastructure through GitHub Actions, OIDC, Bicep, and controlled promotion across development, non-production, and production environments. 
 - Create automated unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests that provide confidence in releases. 
 - Participate in the appropriate production support and on-call rotation, with shared operational ownership across the team. 
 - Document architecture, operational procedures, key decisions, and support requirements as part of normal delivery. 
 - And other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience delivering production full-stack applications using modern React, Next. js, TypeScript, and server-side APIs. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and long-term ownership of a production codebase, including architecture decisions, engineering standards, code review, and mentoring. 
 - Experience delivering production software through an AI-enabled SDLC using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Ability to explain how AI-generated code, prompts, agent behavior, and tool integrations were reviewed, tested, evaluated, corrected, secured, and governed before production release. 
 - Experience building enterprise integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous messaging, retries, reconciliation, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong SQL data modeling experience, including schema migrations, entity resolution, and traceable audit records. 
 - Experience implementing enterprise identity and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0 and role-based access control. 
 - Proficiency with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code using GitHub Actions and Bicep, Terraform, or comparable technologies. 
 - Strong automated testing experience across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Production troubleshooting and observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, health checks, dashboards, and alerts. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across international teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Claude Code experience, including planning modes, subagents, repository guidance, hooks, skills, automated evaluations, or headless CI execution. 
 - Experience building and operating LLM assistants or AI agents with tool use, streaming responses, conversation state, evaluations, observability, safety controls, and orchestration of actions against real systems. 
 - Experience designing or consuming MCP servers and working with Anthropic APIs, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model gateways, or equivalent AI platforms. 
 - Experience building metadata-driven forms, low-code platforms, service catalogs, or rules-driven user interfaces. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps work-item APIs and service hooks. 
 - Experience with Fastify, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, and Azure Key Vault. 
 - Experience with durable orchestration using Azure Durable Task Scheduler, Temporal, or an equivalent platform. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Graph, Okta APIs, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI REST APIs, or Cloudflare Zero Trust. 
 - Experience with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. 

Success In The First 90 Days

- Become productive in the application architecture, codebase, delivery pipeline, and operational model.

 - Implement or improve module-level RBAC, health endpoints, automated testing, and observability where applicable.

Technology Environment

The current environment includes Next. js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Bicep, GitHub Actions with OIDC, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Service Bus, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Prisma, Fastify, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Anthropic Claude enterprise APIs, Cloudflare Zero Trust, and Vitest. data.title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

What You'll Do

Lead the service transformation teams

Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans. 

Turn architecture into shipped services

Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered. 

Establish the base service tier

Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application - and the AI agents and partners building on top of them - can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably. 

Protect compatibility and business continuity

Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved. 

Modernize the application foundations

Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over. 

Raise the bar for engineering quality

Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops - layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience - that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly. 

Drive AI-native ways of working

Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates - not manual inspection - prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Hire and grow strong engineers

Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through. 

Partner across the program

Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed. 

What This Is Not

This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes - while your engineers own the code. 

This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications. 

This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events. 

What You Bring

Proven engineering leadership

Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health. 

Service transformation depth

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments - and delivering those migrations to production. 

Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency

Enough hands-on depth - in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems - to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room. 

Migration safety instincts

You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs. 

Quality and operational discipline

You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built - and you hold that bar for your teams. 

People development

You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care. 

Cross-functional execution

You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute. 

An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering

You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning - and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective. 

Bonus Points

Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades. 

Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies. 

Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well. 

Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers. 

Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks). 

Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering. 

What Success Looks Like

The base service tier becomes real

Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired - reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered. 

Convergence advances without destabilizing the business

Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use. 

The platform compounds

New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver. 

The team gets stronger

Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change. 

Why This Matters

Everything ABC is building - the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform - stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted. 

This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
 - Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
 - Best Life Perk - we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
 - Premium Calm App - enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
 - Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don't just build technology-we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. 

ABC'S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn't just the right thing to do-it's a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness. com. 

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients. 

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness. com
