What You Will Do

In this role you will: 

- Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for building and operating Teradata's next-generation cloud platform and infrastructure services. 
 - Define and execute the technical strategy and roadmap for scalable, reliable, and secure cloud platform capabilities. 
 - Lead the architecture, development, and operation of distributed cloud services supporting provisioning, resource lifecycle management, orchestration, configuration, automation, and platform operations. 
 - Drive engineering excellence across the organization, including architecture, software quality, reliability, scalability, security, observability, and operational readiness. 
 - Build a strong culture of ownership where engineering teams are accountable for the complete lifecycle of their services-from design and development through production operations. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, Architecture, and Customer-facing organizations to translate business and customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities. 
 - Establish and drive execution across multiple teams, balancing near-term delivery commitments with long-term platform investments and technical debt reduction. 
 - Develop common platform frameworks and reusable capabilities that enable engineering teams to build and operate cloud services efficiently. 
 - Lead initiatives spanning multiple cloud providers and regions, with a focus on automation, resilience, cost efficiency, and operational consistency. 
 - Drive modernization of engineering processes through automation, AI-assisted development, intelligent operations, and self-service capabilities. 
 - Establish metrics and operating mechanisms for engineering productivity, service reliability, delivery predictability, quality, and customer impact. 
 - Represent the cloud platform organization in senior technical and product discussions and influence engineering strategy across the company. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant experience leading large-scale cloud or distributed systems organizations. 
 - 5+ years of engineering management experience, with demonstrated experience leading multiple teams and senior technical leaders. 
 - Proven experience building and operating production cloud platforms, distributed systems, infrastructure services, or SaaS platforms at scale. 
 - Strong technical background in cloud architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, containers, networking, security, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience leading engineering organizations through architecture, development, production deployment, and operational ownership of complex distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of multi-tenant cloud architectures, resource provisioning, lifecycle management, orchestration, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Experience working across AWS, Azure, GCP, or comparable cloud environments. 
 - Strong software engineering background with hands-on experience in one or more modern programming languages such as Java, Go, or Python. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at both strategic and technical levels, from organizational planning to architecture and critical technical decisions. 

What You Will Bring

- Experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, and technical leads across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience building high-performing engineering organizations with clear ownership, accountability, and technical leadership. 
 - Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to connect cloud infrastructure, control planes, data planes, applications, security, observability, and operations end-to-end. 
 - Experience establishing platform engineering practices that enable teams to move faster while maintaining reliability and security. 
 - Strong understanding of production operations, incident management, root cause analysis, service-level objectives, capacity management, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience driving engineering transformation through automation, self-service, developer tooling, and AI-enabled engineering practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to simplify complex architectures, eliminate duplicated capabilities, and establish reusable platform foundations. 
 - Strong business and product judgment with the ability to prioritize investments across customer value, engineering velocity, reliability, cost, and long-term platform strategy. 
 - Excellent communication and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to influence executives, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams. 
 - A passion for building platforms that enable other engineering teams to deliver reliable cloud products at scale. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.title: Director - Tech Operations
data.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Joining Amex Tech means helping build and operate technology that supports critical business capabilities at enterprise scale. We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead a portfolio within the Operations Data and Analytics organization spanning ServiceNow and IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategy platform engineering, and observability and operational analytics for the Customer Journey availability program. 

A significant area of focus will be the continued development and modernization of Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) capabilities that support these processes. This leader will help ensure these capabilities operate as integrated enterprise technology products, with strong engineering practices, reliable data, appropriate governance, and roadmaps aligned to the needs of the broader technology organization. 

This leader will be responsible for bringing together platforms, engineering practices, operational processes, and data to improve availability, resiliency, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes across mission-critical technology services. 

The role requires an experienced engineering leader who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels-setting direction and developing technical talent while maintaining sufficient depth to challenge architecture, engineering, reliability, platform, and service-management decisions. 

Responsibilities

How You Will Make an Impact

Engineering & Platform Leadership

- Lead engineering and platform capabilities supporting ServiceNow/ITSM, Strategy, and Customer Journeys. 
 - Establish and execute multi-year platform and engineering strategies aligned with organizational priorities. 
 - Drive modernization of platform architecture, engineering practices, automation, integrations, and data capabilities. 
 - Establish standards for software quality, testing, deployment, security, scalability, resilience, and maintainability. 
 - Ensure critical platforms meet expectations for availability, performance, scalability, security, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Develop strong technical talent and create organizational depth while establishing clear accountability and ownership. 

ServiceNow, ITSM & Operational Excellence

- Provide strategic and engineering leadership for ServiceNow and associated enterprise ITSM capabilities, with particular emphasis on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and CMDB development as it relates to those areas. 
 - Establish and evolve a technology roadmap for these capabilities that aligns ServiceNow development with enterprise operational, reliability, risk, product owners, and business priorities. 
 - Maintain a strong understanding of industry standards, established practices, and emerging trends across ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management and use that knowledge to inform platform strategy and engineering priorities. 
 - Ensure CMDB capabilities supporting Incident, Problem, and Change processes provide accurate, useful, and sustainable configuration and relationship data. 
 - Drive integration across Incident, Problem, Change, and CMDB capabilities so that configuration data strengthens impact analysis, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, operational decision-making, and automation. 
 - Partner with ITSM process owners and technology stakeholders to translate process strategy into scalable ServiceNow capabilities. 
 - Participate in and influence the ServiceNow roadmap through established governance, prioritization, and planning forums, representing the needs and priorities of SRE, Application Support, Operations Engineering, and other technology stakeholders. 
 - Build alignment across process owners, platform teams, engineering organizations, and senior leaders on ServiceNow priorities, investments, sequencing, and technical direction. 
 - Challenge unnecessary process or platform complexity while ensuring appropriate controls, governance, and auditability. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, eliminate process gaps, improve data quality, and reduce operational toil. 
 - Ensure ServiceNow capabilities evolve as engineered products rather than simply administrative workflows. 
 - Establish metrics demonstrating the effectiveness of ITSM capabilities and their impact on availability, reliability, engineering productivity, and operational outcomes. 

Observability, SRE & Availability

- Define and evolve observability capabilities using technologies such as Dynatrace, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and related enterprise tooling. 
 - Improve telemetry, monitoring, alerting, event correlation, and root-cause-analysis capabilities. 
 - Drive adoption of engineering practices that move teams from reactive monitoring toward proactive observability and reliability management. 
 - Partner with SRE and application teams to establish meaningful SLIs, SLOs, availability measures, and service-health standards. 
 - Use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns and prioritize engineering investments. 
 - Connect observability, CMDB, Incident, and Problem data to improve identification and resolution of reliability issues. 
 - Expand the footprint of our Customer Journeys and align them to critical business services. 

Strategy & Data Platforms

- Lead application development and production support for Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), including delivery execution and the long-term platform roadmap. 
 - Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of BI and analytics capabilities supporting critical business and operational decisions. 
 - Drive modernization of data architecture, tooling, and engineering practices. 
 - Partner with business and technology stakeholders to develop advanced analytics and data-driven operational insights. 
 - Create integrations with other operational solutions including agentic solutions. 

Customer Journey Availability

- Provide leadership across modern data ecosystems and workflow/orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow. 
 - Lead and expand capabilities for measuring end-to-end availability across critical customer journeys. 
 - Establish visibility and accountability across application, infrastructure, platform, and business teams. 
 - Support 99. 99% availability objectives for designated critical journeys through standardized measurement, governance, and engineering practices. 
 - Establish controls and processes supporting reliability, risk management, auditability, and consistent delivery of business outcomes. 
 - Use observability and operational data to proactively identify risks affecting customer experiences. 

Financial & Organizational Leadership

- Build, attract, retain, and develop high-performing engineering talent. 
 - Lead effectively across globally distributed teams and stakeholders. 

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

- Significant experience leading enterprise engineering, platform engineering, SRE, production management, data, or technology operations organizations. 
 - Demonstrated experience providing leadership to senior engineers and technical leaders. 
 - Strong experience with ServiceNow and enterprise ITSM/ITIL processes, particularly Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management. 
 - Strong understanding of industry standards and established ITIL practices associated with Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Configuration Management. 
 - Experience developing or overseeing CMDB capabilities that directly support Incident, Problem, and Change processes. 
 - Demonstrated experience participating in and influencing ServiceNow platform roadmaps through established governance, planning, and prioritization forums in a complex enterprise environment. 
 - Ability to influence platform direction across organizations where roadmap ownership, process ownership, engineering execution, and business priorities may reside with different teams. 
 - Experience with enterprise observability platforms such as Dynatrace and Splunk, including modern telemetry and monitoring practices. 
 - Strong background in application development, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and production engineering. 
 - Experience defining and executing large-scale technology and platform strategies. 
 - Experience operating business-critical systems in highly available and regulated environments. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud, automation, and reliability engineering. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence peers and leaders and align teams across complex global organizations. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) or comparable enterprise BI platforms. 
 - Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable data orchestration technologies. 
 - Experience with Site Reliability and Operations Engineering in a large-scale application support organization. 
 - Experience establishing enterprise observability strategies. 

Leadership Qualities

Successful Directors in this role will demonstrate the ability to: 

- Set a clear technology vision and convert strategy into executable roadmaps. 
 - Develop senior engineers and technical leaders. 
 - Create clear ownership and accountability while empowering individuals to make decisions. 
 - Balance delivery speed with reliability, security, technical debt, regulatory requirements, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Communicate complex technical issues and tradeoffs effectively with both engineers and executives. 
 - Influence enterprise platform and process direction when decision-making is distributed across multiple organizations. 
 - Build consensus through established governance while being willing to constructively challenge priorities and approaches. 
 - Make sound decisions in ambiguous situations. 
 - Create an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, automation, continuous improvement, and learning. 
 - Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge teams without becoming the team's de facto principal engineer. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

data.title: Software Engineer - Senior
data.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and integration of AI capabilities (Generative AI, LLMs, and data-driven AI models) directly into core enterprise workflows and architecture. 
 - Drive technical execution, define coding and design standards, conduct high-level code reviews, and guide a high-performing engineering team based across multiple geographies (Germany and India). 
 - Architect and maintain cloud-native solutions using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) to ensure scalable, secure, and high-availability deployment of AI and data services. 
 - Oversee robust data exchange, integration frameworks, and data pipelines connecting disparate enterprise systems (e. g. , SAP, Teamcenter, and cloud data lakes). 
 - Establish best practices for MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, R&D leadership, and cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into elegant, AI-centric technical solutions. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

- 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3+ years in a Technical Lead or Principal Engineering capacity. 5+ years hands on experience with C++
 - Candidates with Teamcenter experience will have an added advantage. 
 - AI & Data Proficiency: 
 - Hands-on experience applying AI tools, frameworks (PyTorch, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Hugging Face APIs), and vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant). 
 - Strong foundation in data engineering, ETL pipelines, and handling large-scale enterprise data. 
 - Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm). 
 - Experience building robust integration frameworks and middleware (API-first design, REST/GraphQL, event-driven architectures). 
 - Excellent cross-cultural communication skills, with a proven ability to lead technical discussions and align distributed teams (Europe/India). 

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Senior Software Engineer

Overview

MasterCard is seeking talented individuals to join our Emerging Payments Technology team in Pune, India. 

MasterCard is researching and developing the next generation of products and services to enable consumers to securely, efficiently, and intelligently conduct transactions regardless of channel. 

Whether through traditional retail, mobile, or e-commerce, MasterCard innovation is leading the digital convergence of traditional and emerging payments technologies across a wide variety of new devices and services. 

Join our team and help shape the future of connected commerce!

Role

The Sr Engineer, Software Engineering is a hands-on developer specializing in Java development with a particular focus producing API services in support of MasterPass, our digital wallet solution. 

As a Sr Engineer on the Digital Payments Technology team, you will be responsible for helping design and implement Micro-Service API services across multiple products and services. You'll work closely with other team technical leads and with our Product Management team, and other stakeholders.

As an IT Test Automation Engineer, you will strengthen enterprise testing and quality engineering capabilities across global SAP and business application landscapes. You will also drive ongoing validation and quality assurance to ensure that deployed automation remains effective, efficient, compliant, and aligned with business requirements throughout its lifecycle, including monitoring automation quality, reviewing test assets, validating execution results, and driving continuous improvement of testing processes.

- Review and validate automation scripts, test cases, test data, and execution strategies.

data.title: SAP Test Automation Service Specialist – Tricentis Tosca
data.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As an IT Test Automation Engineer, you will strengthen enterprise testing and quality engineering capabilities across global SAP and business application landscapes. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, operation, governance, and continuous improvement of automated testing solutions, with a key focus on Tricentis Tosca and related Tricentis products to enable scalable, reliable, and maintainable test automation across SAP and integrated non-SAP environments. As SSO for the Test Automation Service, you will ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations while overseeing governance, risks, documentation, stakeholder collaboration, continuous improvement, and financial planning aligned with the service roadmap. You will also drive ongoing validation and quality assurance to ensure that deployed automation remains effective, efficient, compliant, and aligned with business requirements throughout its lifecycle, including monitoring automation quality, reviewing test assets, validating execution results, and driving continuous improvement of testing processes. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Review and validate automation scripts, test cases, test data, and execution strategies. 
 - Ensure compliance with established automation standards, naming conventions, and development guidelines, and define and continuously improve quality standards for automated testing. 
 - Conduct quality reviews of automation assets and automation frameworks, assess automation coverage, and identify opportunities to expand automation adoption. 
 - Establish controls to ensure consistency and reusability of test assets across projects and verify traceability between requirements, business processes, test cases, and execution results. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of testing methodologies and test automation practices. 
 - Ensure secure, compliant, reliable, and lifecycle-oriented operation of the Test Automation Service (SSO). 
 - Coordinate service governance and manage operational, technical, and compliance risks while maintaining service documentation and controls. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders, platform teams, vendors, and support organizations, and define and drive the service roadmap and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Support financial planning, forecasting, and budget monitoring. 
 - Monitor the health, quality, and effectiveness of deployed automated tests, analyse execution trends, automation success rates, and defect leakage, and coordinate root-cause analysis of failed executions. 
 - Ensure automation assets remain current following SAP releases, transports, upgrades, and business process changes, while managing the automation maintenance backlog and technical debt. 
 - Support the introduction of self-healing and AI-assisted automation capabilities where appropriate, and monitor and report automation KPIs and quality metrics. 
 - Support and optimise the enterprise testing toolchain, including Tricentis Tosca, Tricentis qTest, SAP Cloud ALM, and SAP Solution Manager, and collaborate with teams using these solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and AI-enabled testing capabilities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and testing transformation programs. 
 - Increase automation coverage across critical business processes, improve reliability and maintainability of automated test suites, reduce regression testing effort and execution time, and improve traceability and quality of test assets. 
 - Strengthen governance and quality controls in automated testing, provide transparency through meaningful testing KPIs and reporting, and enable faster, safer, and higher-quality SAP releases. 
 - Ensure reliable, compliant service delivery, continuous improvement, and effective budget management. 

What You Bring

- 8-10 years of overall experience in software testing, quality engineering, and test automation. 
 - Approximately 5 years of experience in software testing and test automation, with strong hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Proven experience in SAP testing environments and enterprise-scale test automation solutions; experience supporting large transformation, ERP, or SAP S/4HANA programs is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and SAP ECC is advantageous. 
 - Strong experience with End-to-End Business Process Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, and User Acceptance Testing. 
 - Experience with Tricentis Tosca, Tricentis qTest, API Test Automation, Web Automation, Data-driven Testing, and Model-based Testing. 
 - Experience with Test Management, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Solution Manager, Jira, Panaya, Defect Lifecycle Management, and Test Reporting & Analytics. 
 - Knowledge of Quality Metrics & KPI Management, Risk-based Testing, Root Cause Analysis, and Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 - Tricentis Tosca Certification and ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Certification are preferred. 
 - Experience with AI-enabled testing approaches and SAP Cloud ALM integrations is preferred. 
 - Experience establishing Testing Centers of Excellence or Test Governance frameworks is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise-scale testing operating models is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a quality-driven mindset and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to challenge existing processes and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across global and cross-functional teams. 
 - Passion for automation, innovation, and operational excellence. 

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100, 000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 

Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. data.title: Software QA Engineer
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence. 

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing. 

The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages. 
 - Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases. 
 - Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery. 
 - Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable. 
 - Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution. 
 - Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage. 
 - Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies. 

Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands-on experience in test automation. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger. 
 - Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation. 
 - Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner. 
 - Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts. 
 - Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies. 
 - Experience with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, X-Ray, TestRail, or Zephyr. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Job Description

We are seeking a highly capable Team Leader - Data Analytics (P4) to lead and manage the Data Analytics function within the UK&I Transport & Infrastructure PMO GCC.

 - Ensure reporting supports visibility across Cost, Schedule, Risk, Commercial performance, Resource and delivery metrics 
 - Integrate analytics outputs with project controls and PMO processes to strengthen governance and decision-making. 
 - Support alignment of reporting with project and portfolio performance frameworks. 
 - Enable joined-up reporting across PMO, controls, commercial, and operational functions. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration
 - Act as the primary analytics SPOC for collaboration between GCC and UK stakeholders on reporting and analytics requirements. 
 - Partner with PMO leadership, Project Directors, Project Managers, and functional leads to understand evolving reporting needs. 
 - Present insights through governance forums, showcases, leadership reviews, and stakeholder meetings.

 - Build trusted relationships and position the GCC analytics team as a value-adding strategic partner.

 - Drive the analytics capability roadmap for the PMO GCC, aligned to business needs and digital strategy.

Essential

QUALIFICATIONS

data.title: FS RC-FSRM - CSTC-MORTGAGE QUALITY CONTROL-QUALITY ASSURANCE-MANAGER
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM)

Mortgage Quality Control (QC) Analyst - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview

As part of the Mortgage Quality Control (QC) team, the Analyst will perform independent post-underwriting and post-funding reviews of US residential mortgage loans to evaluate the accuracy of underwriting decisions, adherence to internal credit policies, and compliance with investor and regulatory requirements. The role involves detailed examination of approved and funded loan files to identify underwriting deficiencies, documentation gaps, and control weaknesses, while providing actionable insights to enhance mortgage credit quality, operational processes, and overall risk management frameworks. 

Core Responsibilities

- Perform pre-funding and post-funding Quality Control (QC) reviews of residential mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and policy compliance
 - Independently validate key underwriting calculations, including FOIR/DTI, LTV/CLTV, income calculations, and borrower eligibility criteria
 - Review borrower documentation such as income proofs, employment verification, bank statements, tax returns, and credit bureau reports to assess consistency and accuracy
 - Validate collateral-related documents including property appraisals, title reports, insurance, and legal documentation for compliance with lending guidelines
 - Assess adherence to investor and regulatory requirements (e. g. , Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA guidelines) and internal credit policies
 - Identify, document, and classify QC findings (defects) based on severity levels; perform root cause analysis and highlight control gaps
 - Reconcile underwriting decisions by re-performing key credit assessments and highlighting discrepancies in credit approval decisions
 - Track and report defect trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across reviewed files to support continuous improvement initiatives
 - Prepare QC reporting outputs including detailed review summaries, dashboards, and management reports for stakeholders
 - Collaborate with underwriting, operations, credit policy, and compliance teams to discuss findings and support remediation actions
 - Participate in calibration exercises and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency in QC review standards and defect grading

Domain Skills Required

- Strong understanding of US residential mortgage products (conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, etc. ) and underwriting frameworks
 - Experience in mortgage QC/QA including pre-funding and post-closing reviews, defect identification, and compliance validation
 - Knowledge of underwriting guidelines such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and agency lending standards
 - Familiarity with QC methodologies including defect grading, sampling, re-performance of underwriting, and root cause analysis
 - Ability to analyze borrower financials (income, assets, liabilities) and validate underwriting calculations
 - Experience in preparing structured QC reports, trend analysis, and management-ready findings

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- MBA/CA or equivalent with 7-10 years of experience in mortgage QC, underwriting, or retail credit roles. 
 - Strong analytical skills with experience in loan file review and underwriting validation
 - Advanced Excel skills; exposure to reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL and Basic Knowledge in AI is an added advantage. 
 - Strong communication skills with ability to clearly articulate QC findings and recommendations. 

Good-to-have: 

- Certifications such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or mortgage-specific certifications
 - Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and underwriting platforms
 - Exposure to regulatory audits, QC audits, or internal control testing environments

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Design Manager-Piping
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Design Engineering Manager Piping support the Discipline Manager on achieving Jacob's project and engineering process and procedure. This dynamic position provides leadership, champions inclusion and diversity, drives global delivery, supports a culture of innovation applies a disciplined deployment and ensures Management responsibilities including performance appraisals, pay reviews, training and development. Manages professional employees and/or supervisors or manages multi-discipline teams of support employees accounting for a large/significant span of control. Has accountability for the performance and results of a team within own area of specialty. Adapts departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges and problem solving guided by policies, procedures and business plan; receives guidance from senior manager. Provides technical guidance to employees, colleagues and/or customers. Drives design consistency across projects by standardizing templates, specifications, and workflows. Promotes continuous improvement in design efficiency, digital tools, and engineering practices. 

The Piping Design Manager will lead and manage piping design activities for life sciences projects-including pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities, biotechnology plants, sterile/aseptic production suites, R&D laboratories, utility systems, and cleanroom environments. This role ensures that all piping design deliverables meet project requirements, regulatory standards, GMP compliance, and client expectations while driving innovation, efficiency, and quality. Ensure design deliverables meet quality and safety standards, regulatory expectations, and project specifications. Act as the primary point of contact for piping design matters with clients, PMCs, and EPC/EPCM partners. Participate in design workshops, HAZOPs, risk assessments, and constructability studies and provide technical support during construction, commissioning, and start‐up. 

Here's what you'll need

- 17-20 Years of Experience and Degree in full time BE/Btech - Chemical/Mechanical
 - Strong experience on design of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility / Speciality Chemical in terms of Piping design. 
 - Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility inter discipline requirements. 
 - Location- Navi Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Chennai (Candidate will be considered for Pharma & Lifescience only)

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

To be successful as a Full Stack Engineer - VP, you should have experience with:

 - Strong expertise in RESTful API design and development, microservices architecture, and service-to-service integrations in high-volume transactional environments.

 - Hands-on experience with modern UI technologies including React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, and frontend testing frameworks such as Jest or Jasmine. 
 - Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases, with strong focus on data integrity and performance. 
 - Strong knowledge of security standards and practices including OAuth2, JWT, authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure coding guidelines. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, build tools (Maven, Gradle), and secure deployments. 
 - Proficiency with version control systems (Git) and enterprise development workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, system resiliency, fault tolerance, observability, and production support in mission-critical environments.

data.title: Specialist Software Engineer, Full Stack — Decision Intelligence
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - Decision Intelligence

About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today. 

The opportunity

Amgen's AI & Data Science team is building decision-intelligence products that help teams make faster, more defensible decisions under uncertainty. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Decision Intelligence to join the Forecasting & Decision Intelligence team, within the AI & Data organization. This role will develop cutting edge scenario-planning capabilities, while creating reusable foundations for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and AI-assisted decision products across the enterprise. 

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer who can own meaningful product experiences end-to-end. You will build the interfaces people use to configure, launch, monitor, compare, and understand complex scenarios, as well as the APIs, data integrations, and execution services that make those experiences trustworthy. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, deploy, and operate end-to-end decision-support products across frontend, backend, data, and workflow layers. 
 - Create intuitive planner experiences for configuring scenarios, managing assumptions, launching and monitoring, comparing outcomes, and understanding uncertainty and trade-offs. 
 - Build responsive, accessible React/TypeScript user interfaces and reusable frontend components for scenario setup, results visualization, and decision workflows. 
 - Design and implement production APIs, backend services, data integrations, and execution workflows for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and AI-assisted decision products. 
 - Work closely with product managers, planners, data scientists, and adjacent engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into simple, valuable releases. 
 - Lead substantial workstreams independently, provide thoughtful code reviews, and mentor developing engineers. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of professional software-engineering experience, including ownership of complex production applications or major end-to-end capabilities. 
 - Strong full-stack engineering experience, including modern frontend development with React and TypeScript and backend API development with Python or another modern server-side language. 
 - Experience designing usable, data-rich web applications in partnership with product, design, and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience with relational SQL and data-intensive applications, including integration with warehouse, lakehouse, or operational data systems. 
 - Experience with asynchronous processing, queues, workflow engines, or resilient patterns for long-running workloads. 
 - Experience with cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, automated testing, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated commitment to code quality, accessibility, observability, documentation, and operational ownership. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with FastAPI, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, modular frontend architectures, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience building interactive visualizations and comparison workflows for analytical, operational, financial, or planning users. 
 - Experience embedding statistical models, optimization engines, simulation, or machine-learning capabilities into production applications. 
 - Experience with API and data-contract versioning, enterprise identity and access management, and secure integrations. 
 - Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, healthcare, finance, or another complex operational domain. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted product experiences and appropriate grounding, evaluation, and human-review controls.

IoT Software Developer

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies.

data.title: Quality Automation - Manager
data.description:
The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You'll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services-solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We'll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference-every day. 

We Are

A Quality Engineering practice that helps clients move from late-stage testing to continuous quality, efficiency, and resilience. We embed with product, engineering, and architecture teams, apply modern automation and AI-enabled testing, and take quality work from experiment into operational delivery at enterprise scale. 

You Are

A hands-on SDET and quality leader with 12+ years in test automation and software quality engineering. You write and review automation, set and execute the quality strategy for your program, and coach a team while remaining technically engaged. You are comfortable in global, collaborative delivery environments and you care about embedding quality across the full software development lifecycle - not only at the end of a sprint. 

The Work

You will lead quality for complex application delivery: partnering with product, development, and architecture teams; defining and executing a modern test strategy; and applying AI-enabled approaches where they deliver measurable value. You will take accountability for your team's delivery outcomes, technical direction, and continuous improvement, acting as both a technical lead and a client-facing quality partner. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Define and lead end-to-end quality for your program, including early validation, risk-based testing, and continuous testing. 
 - Own quality strategy, test planning, estimation, execution governance, defect management, and release-readiness assessment across your workstreams. 
 - Establish the appropriate balance of unit, API, UI, integration, regression, and exploratory testing based on product risk and architecture. 

SDET & Custom Application Quality

- Lead the design, development, and enhancement of automation frameworks and validation components - not test cases alone. 
 - Design, implement, and scale maintainable automation frameworks for web applications and services, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Build UI, API, and where required mobile automation using Playwright and comparable tools such as Appium and REST Assured. 
 - Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, coding standards, and shift-left quality practices. 

AI-Enabled Testing & Innovation

- Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and agentic test automation solutions to accelerate test design, implementation, maintenance, and analysis responsibly. 
 - Apply GenAI tooling (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to improve test design, code generation, debugging, and root cause analysis. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI-enabled testing tools through controlled proofs of concept and recommend adoption based on measurable value, security, accuracy, and maintainability. 

DevSecOps & CI/CD Integration

- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and define quality gates that provide fast, reliable feedback. 
 - Embed automated testing into delivery pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, covering version control and artifact management. 

Cross-Platform Quality Delivery

- Lead testing across web, API, and mobile (iOS/Android) layers as the engagement requires. 
 - Apply contract testing, test-data management, service virtualization or mocking, and observability practices. 

Client Engagement & Advisory

- Partner with client and business stakeholders to shape quality strategy and support transformation initiatives. 
 - Facilitate workshops and deliver pragmatic quality solutions in ambiguous or evolving delivery environments. 

Team Leadership & Delivery Accountability

- Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing quality engineering team, local or distributed, while remaining technically engaged. 
 - Own your team's delivery outcomes and guide day-to-day technical decisions. 
 - Coach team members, set technical direction, review automation code, and promote continuous learning and engineering discipline. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Collaborate across product, development, architecture, DevOps, security, and business teams to resolve dependencies and embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Continuous Improvement & Capability Building

- Improve test coverage, automation maturity, and delivery efficiency over time. 
 - Champion quality engineering best practices, reusable standards, automation patterns, and shared assets that build team capability. 

Reporting & Insights

- Produce clear test outcome reports covering execution status, coverage, defect trends, residual risk, release recommendations, and improvement actions. 
 - Track meaningful quality metrics and deliver dashboards that identify systemic issues, improve predictability, and reduce escaped defects. 

Security, Accessibility & Compliance

- Embed secure, accessible, and compliant quality practices into delivery, including in regulated environments such as financial services, public sector, and healthcare. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of experience in test automation, SDET, or software quality engineering roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex automation programs. 
 - Proven experience leading quality engineering teams, managing priorities, mentoring engineers, and influencing delivery outcomes. 
 - Hands-on coding proficiency in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, or Java, with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, clean-code principles, reusable framework design, version control, and code reviews. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright or a comparable modern UI automation framework. 
 - Strong API testing and automation knowledge, including REST services, authentication, data validation, error handling, and service-level test design. 
 - Strong grounding in functional testing techniques, including requirements analysis, test design, boundary and negative testing, risk-based testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with unit-testing frameworks and close collaboration with development teams to improve unit and component test coverage. 
 - Proven experience integrating testing into DevSecOps pipelines, including CI/CD, automated quality gates, reporting, source control, and artifact management. 
 - Strong experience in test strategy, test-data management, mocking, and observability. 
 - Ability to create effective test strategies and communicate concise, evidence-based test outcome reports to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder-management, written communication, and cross-team collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in SAFe Agile or other scaled Agile environments. 
 - Strong understanding of GenAI in the SDLC, including prompting techniques and AI-augmented testing approaches. 
 - Experience with contract testing and advanced observability frameworks. 
 - Background in cross-platform application testing across web and mobile. 
 - Experience in compliance-heavy or regulated industries such as financial services, public sector, or healthcare. 
 - Experience contributing to quality engineering transformation or digital testing programs. 
 - Experience leading quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, or distributed teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy automation suites or transitioning to Playwright and AI-enabled testing approaches. 
 - Familiarity with non-functional quality areas such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and observability. 
 - Relevant testing, cloud, Agile, DevOps, or engineering certifications are an advantage. 

Leadership Competencies

- Lead with accountability, sound judgment, and a strong customer-focused quality mindset. 
 - Communicate quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering leaders and business stakeholders. 
 - Build alignment across teams without relying solely on authority, and facilitate timely resolution of quality issues. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that supports coaching, knowledge sharing, and sustainable delivery. 
 - Continuously improve processes while balancing speed, reliability, maintainability, and business value.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Tooling & Automation
data.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3. 5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world's largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. 

Vultr Cares

- Medical Insurance stipend paid annually 
 - 9 Company-Paid Holidays 
 - Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
 - Professional Development Reimbursement 
 - Internet reimbursement 
 - Fitness membership reimbursement
 - Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Dev Engineer to serve as the technical owner connecting our engineering alerting to Vultr's new Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai, India, and to build the consolidated single-pane dashboard GIOC will operate from. The ideal candidate looks at five disconnected monitoring consoles and a dozen siloed alert feeds, winces, and then methodically builds the one dashboard that replaces all of them. This is a highly visible, focused role, requiring deep familiarity with Vultr's current architecture, monitoring stack, and operational workflows. This is your opportunity to build the operational backbone GIOC runs on from day one. 

Role Overview

The Senior Software Engineer - Tooling & Automation will own the development of automation, integrations, and unified monitoring capabilities for Vultr's GIOC in Chennai. The role will connect multiple monitoring, SIEM, infrastructure, and provider platforms into a single operational view, while automating alert routing, ticketing, paging, escalation, and SLA tracking. The engineer will work closely with Systems, Network, Security, and GIOC teams to improve observability, reduce manual intervention, and enable reliable 24×7 global infrastructure operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Analyze every engineering alert stream across Systems, Network, and Security-including Icinga, Grafana, and SIEM platforms-to determine the optimal integration strategy via webhooks, APIs, or native connectors. 
 - Develop a robust notification layer that funnels high-priority events into GIOC's operational toolkit, ensuring critical context remains intact for rapid L1 response. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional subject matter experts to align automated routing logic with established escalation and resolution protocols. 
 - Engineer seamless on-call notification workflows that drive strict adherence to acknowledgment SLAs without requiring manual intervention. 
 - Architect a comprehensive single-pane dashboard that aggregates monitoring across global providers like Equinix and Airtel, eliminating inefficient tool-switching. 
 - Define the initial scope for visualization projects alongside leadership to meet aggressive technical and operational milestones. 
 - Maintain continuous infrastructure visibility by managing side-by-side operations of legacy and modern tools during the GIOC transition phase. 
 - Integrate health and performance metrics-such as escalation precision and aging-into reporting modules for executive-level status updates. 
 - Produce detailed documentation for all routing systems and dashboards to ensure long-term maintainability by global operations teams. 

Qualifications

- 5-8 years of experience in Platform Engineering or similar domains, with significant expertise in NMS platforms, Grafana, and major SIEM environments. 
 - Profound understanding of Vultr's existing monitoring ecosystem, infrastructure stack, and standard operational procedures across multiple technical pillars. 
 - Proven track record of building complex integrations using Python and RESTful APIs over the last three years. 
 - Extensive experience crafting or customizing sophisticated dashboards via Kibana, Power BI, or similar visualization toolsets. 
 - Deep knowledge of ITSM workflows-specifically Jira and Mattermost-and the technical mapping of event severity to incident metadata. 
 - Preference for candidates with experience in 24x7 global NOC/SOC environments and multi-provider datacenter logistics. 

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted. 

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U. S. privacy rules and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures. 

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

Observability & Debuggability

data.title: Lead SDET
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Where you'll leave your mark?

- Own quality outcomes, not activities - the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint, " it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it. "
 - Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there - the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual intervention
 - Own bug leakage rate - target under 2-3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets through
 - Build the system that keeps flaky tests out of the suite - preventing flakiness from entering and quarantining it when it does
 - Shape automation coverage at the right layer - E2E where it matters, API where it's faster and more reliable, unit where developers should own it - not just chasing a coverage percentage
 - Stay 50-60% hands-on - writing Playwright TypeScript to evolve the framework, building diagnostic tools that analyse test-run data for flakiness patterns, and reviewing PRs to catch structural problems in AI-generated test code
 - Build AI-native quality infrastructure - systems that use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling to solve quality problems at scale, like pipelines that auto-analyse every PR for risk across security, product, and UX dimensions
 - Deliver engineering-wide quality impact - at least one initiative per quarter that changes how developers or PMs ship, not just how QA tests. Our current guardrail system prevents 90 bugs per month without manual QA; that's the bar
 - Partner and present - sit with product engineers to define quality gates before features ship, and present quality metrics (CI pass rate, bug leakage, flaky test trends) to engineering leadership

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- An engineer who has chosen quality as their specialisation - this is not a pure coding role and not a management role; it lives exactly in between (: 40-50% strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring)
 - Engineering-wide in scope, not QA-internal - you want to improve how the entire engineering organisation thinks about quality, not just how the QA team works
 - AI-native, not AI-assisted - you don't just use Copilot for test authoring; you build quality systems on LLMs and agents, and you can test AI features themselves - validating agent behaviour, checking LLM output quality, and handling non-deterministic systems
 - A test pyramid thinker, not just an E2E automator - with developers now writing feature automation themselves, you push testing responsibility to the developer layer while QA owns integration, workflow, and AI feature quality. A candidate who only thinks Playwright and E2E is too narrow
 - Fluent in the modern stack - Playwright, TypeScript, CI pipelines, and the data behind them
 - Comfortable influencing without authority - defining quality gates with product engineers and changing developer behaviour through systems, not mandates

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Director of Engineering to lead our high-impact engineering organization at Gracenote. In this role, you will be responsible for defining technical strategy, building scalable architectures, driving platform modernization, and leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams (including Engineering Managers and technical leads). 

You will lead the evolution of next-generation metadata processing pipelines-integrating modern data platforms, automated web crawling, content curation, real-time metadata serving, and AI/Machine Learning solutions. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, and Global Business leadership to ensure our technology directly powers market-leading media solutions. 

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technical Vision

- Define Engineering Strategy: Drive long-term technical vision and architectural direction for Gracenote's core metadata, ingestion, and serving platforms. 
 - Platform Modernization: Lead initiatives to platformize metadata processing pipelines, transitioning legacy flows into modern, intelligent, high-performance distributed architectures. 
 - AI & Data Science Integration: Partner with Data Science and AI teams to integrate machine learning, NLP, computer vision, and GenAI capabilities into core operational processes, content ingestion, and data enrichment pipelines. 

Team Leadership & Organizational Excellence

- Scale High-Performing Teams: Lead, mentor, and build an engineering organization of Engineering Managers, Architects, and Software Engineers. 
 - Culture & Retention: Foster an inclusive culture based on Nielsen values-promoting innovation, continuous learning, technical rigor, and high associate retention. 
 - Talent Management: Oversee succession planning, performance management, career growth frameworks, and talent pipelines (including university relations and new joiner programs). 

Business & Stakeholder Alignment

- Product & Strategy Collaboration: Partner directly with Product Management, Data Science, and cross-functional executives to align engineering deliverables with key business metrics and strategic revenue drivers. 
 - Global Execution: Coordinate across local and global stakeholders to ensure seamless integration, high productivity, and successful delivery of high-visibility projects. 

Operational & Technical Execution

- System Scale & Reliability: Ensure overall system health by defining Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)-focusing on high availability, fault tolerance, low latency, recoverability, and scalability across global delivery APIs. 
 - Process Improvement & Automation: Drive agile methodologies and apply an automation-first mindset to software delivery, CI/CD, testing automation, and operational monitoring. 
 - Engineering Governance: Establish robust quality assurance standards, operational cadences, and continuous process optimization across the Product Development Lifecycle. 

Qualifications

Basic / Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 

Experience

- 13+ years of total software development and engineering experience, with a proven track record of designing scalable, high-performance systems. 
 - 5+ years of direct management experience, including managing managers, technical leads, and multi-disciplinary global engineering teams. 

System Architecture & Tech Stack

- Deep expertise in object-oriented and functional programming languages (e. g. , Golang, Java, Python, Scala). 
 - Proven experience designing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems and microservices. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern data architectures: real-time streaming architectures (e. g. , Kafka), batch data processing (e. g. , Spark, Flink), and RESTful/GraphQL API serving. 
 - Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Cassandra), caching layers (Redis, Memcached), and search engines (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch). 
 - Solid expertise in cloud-native deployment environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud ecosystems. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.
