data.description:
TEAM LEAD - BACKEND / FULL STACK ENGINEER (FINTECH)

Impacto Digifin Technologies Pvt. Ltd. 

Bangalore (Brookefield) | Work from Office | Full-Time

Job Location

Bangalore (Brookefield) - Work from Office

Experience

3-5 Years

Employment Type

Full-Time

Department

Engineering / Product Development

Document Date

21 October 2026

Role Overview

We are hiring a hands-on Team Lead to design, build, and run the backend of our digital banking and payments products. You will lead a small team building Java and Spring Boot microservices, Apache Kafka event pipelines, and PostgreSQL data models that move real money for banks and their customers. 

The role is backend-first, with full stack ownership: you will also guide ReactJS and Next. js frontends that sit on top of these services. You will own the full lifecycle, from requirement analysis and system design to production deployment, monitoring, and 24x7 support. 

We want someone who treats correctness, auditability, and uptime as product features. 

Key Responsibilities

- Backend and Microservices Development
 - Design and build scalable, high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and third-party integrations with clear, versioned API contracts. 
 - Implement authentication, authorization, input validation, and secure coding practices across all services. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, backed by unit, integration, and API tests. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture with Apache Kafka
 - Build and maintain event-driven systems using Kafka producers, consumers, and Kafka Streams. 
 - Design event schemas, topics, partitioning, and retention to match business flows. 
 - Ensure exactly-once or idempotent processing so no event is lost or applied twice. 
 - Handle retries, dead-letter topics, consumer lag, and replay for failed or delayed events. 
 - Apply patterns such as Outbox, Saga, event sourcing, and CQRS where they fit. 
 - PostgreSQL Data Design and Management
 - Design normalized, transactional data models in PostgreSQL for accounts, ledgers, payments, and customers. 
 - Use ACID transactions, appropriate isolation levels, and row-level locking to keep balances correct under concurrent load. 
 - Tune queries, indexes, partitioning, and connection pooling for high-volume tables. 
 - Manage schema changes safely with versioned migrations (Flyway or Liquibase) and zero-downtime deployment. 
 - Plan data archival, backup, point-in-time recovery, and read replicas for reporting. 
 - Full Stack Ownership
 - Guide and contribute to responsive web applications built with ReactJS, Next. js, and TypeScript. 
 - Integrate frontend applications with backend services and keep API contracts in sync. 
 - Optimize end-to-end performance, responsiveness, and reliability. 
 - Team Leadership
 - Lead, mentor, and support developers in daily technical work. 
 - Break business requirements into technical specifications, tasks, and delivery plans. 
 - Assign work, track progress, and deliver milestones on time. 
 - Run code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design reviews. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Coordinate with Product, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, Business, and Management teams. 
 - Support technical interviews, onboarding, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Deployment and Production Support
 - Use Git-based workflows, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines for builds and releases. 
 - Own production health: troubleshoot incidents, fix performance bottlenecks, and lead root-cause analysis. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and deployment procedures. 
 - AI-Assisted Development
 - Use AI coding tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor for code, tests, debugging, and documentation. 
 - Review and validate all AI-generated output before it reaches production. 

Designing and Maintaining Banking Products

Designing Banking Products

- Ledger-first design: build double-entry ledgers in PostgreSQL where every debit has a matching credit and balances can always be rebuilt from entries. 
 - Transaction integrity: use idempotency keys, unique transaction references, and state machines so a request retried by a customer, bank, or network never posts twice. 
 - Payment flows: design end-to-end flows for UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, and card or wallet payments, including timeouts, pending states, reversals, and refunds. 
 - Distributed consistency: keep data consistent across microservices with Outbox, Saga, and compensating transactions instead of distributed locks. 
 - Core banking integration: integrate with core banking systems such as Oracle FLEXCUBE or Finacle, NPCI and switch interfaces, and partner bank APIs. 
 - Product configuration: model savings and current accounts, loans, deposits, and wallets so limits, charges, interest, and rules are configuration rather than code changes. 
 - Customer lifecycle: support onboarding, KYC and e-KYC, account servicing, and closure with clear status tracking. 
 - Security by design: encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit, mask PII in logs, manage keys through HSM or a vault, and apply least-privilege access. 
 - Regulatory compliance: build to RBI guidelines, including data localization, audit trails, and NPCI operating rules, and align with PCI DSS where card data is involved. 
 - Controls: implement maker-checker approvals, transaction limits, velocity checks, and hooks for fraud and AML monitoring. 

Maintaining Banking Products in Production

- Reconciliation: run daily automated reconciliation between internal ledgers, partner banks, NPCI, and settlement files, and resolve mismatches within agreed timelines. 
 - Settlement and batch jobs: own end-of-day and beginning-of-day processes, interest accrual, charges, and settlement runs, and make them safe to re-run. 
 - High availability: design for 24x7 uptime with no single point of failure, graceful degradation, and defined RPO and RTO for disaster recovery. 
 - Observability: track business and technical metrics such as transaction success rate, latency, and consumer lag in Prometheus and Grafana, with alerts before customers notice. 
 - Incident management: lead incident response, customer-impact assessment, root-cause analysis, and post-incident fixes for failed or stuck transactions. 
 - Safe change management: release through feature flags, canary or blue-green deployments, and backward-compatible APIs and schemas, with tested rollback plans. 
 - Audit and reporting: keep immutable audit logs and support regulatory reports, internal audits, and data requests from banks and regulators. 
 - Continuous improvement: track defects, performance, and technical debt, and plan regular upgrades of frameworks, libraries, and security patches. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

Candidates must have hands-on experience in the following areas: 

- Backend: strong Java (Core Java, Java 17+), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security. 
 - Messaging: Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, Kafka Streams, event design, partitioning, and offset management. 
 - Database: strong SQL and PostgreSQL, including data modeling, transactions, isolation levels, indexing, and query tuning. 
 - Architecture: microservices, distributed systems, event-driven design, OOP, and design patterns. 
 - APIs: designing and documenting RESTful APIs with JSON and OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Frontend: working knowledge of ReactJS, Next. js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript. 
 - DevOps: Docker, Git (GitHub or GitLab), and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Testing: unit and integration testing with JUnit and Mockito, plus debugging and code review. 
 - Leadership: experience guiding developers, reviewing code, planning tasks, and owning delivery. 
 - Problem solving: strong debugging skills for production issues in distributed systems. 

Mandatory Screening Requirement: Candidates must have strong backend experience in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL, plus working frontend knowledge in ReactJS or Next. js. Frontend-only profiles will not meet the core requirement. 

Good to Have

- Payments domain: experience with UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, NPCI integrations, or card and wallet systems is highly preferred. 
 - Message-driven patterns: event sourcing, CQRS, Saga, and Outbox. 
 - Performance: experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems, such as payments or UPI switches. 
 - Spring ecosystem: Spring Cloud, Spring Batch, Spring WebFlux, and Spring Integration. 
 - Security: OAuth 2. 0, JWT, OpenID Connect, encryption, key management, and OWASP practices. 
 - Data and caching: Redis, PostgreSQL replication and partitioning, and Oracle Database or Oracle FLEXCUBE exposure. 
 - Cloud and orchestration: Kubernetes, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, and AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Monitoring and quality: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, OpenTelemetry, and SonarQube. 
 - Compliance: working knowledge of RBI guidelines, PCI DSS, and audit requirements. 
 - Ways of working: experience in Agile/Scrum teams. 

Preferred Domain Experience

- Banking, Financial Services and FinTech. 
 - Digital payments, lending, or core banking platforms. 
 - Enterprise integrations and digital transformation projects. 

Skills: - Javascript, React. js, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, TypeScript, SQL, Microservices, Redux/Flux, GitHub, Docker, DevOps, PostgreSQL, RESTful APIs, HTML/CSS, Spring Security and NextJs (Next. js)

About Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www. morganstanley. com. 

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. 

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week. 

About The Team

The Investment Systems team at Parametric: 

We are building financial software that solves for some of the world's most complex financial opportunities. This includes building solutions to provide customized direct index exposure while making tax sensitive asset selection to improve overall after-tax portfolio returns. 

We design and build scalable multi-asset portfolio management solutions, secure platforms for creating financial applications and low-code workflows, and a core data platform that delivers trusted financial data. 

About The Role

We are looking for individuals that have a strong curiosity and passion for learning new things, while continuously challenging oneself to build things better and more scalable. 

The Principal Software Engineer is responsible for providing both technical and people leadership, project delivery, process development, training and support. The role partners across the Equity Investments and Client Activities team, Core Services, and the externally facing Digital Team to design and develop technology solutions that support Direct Indexing business priorities and improve business processes. The role spans multiple services within the team, building out underlying components that provide critical services to the Equity Portfolio Management Platform. These services help streamline rule-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing enabling exception driven portfolio management. 

This position will report into the Investments & Innovation Platform team and work closely with team leads across Technology teams, Business Analysis as well as Business Partners. In this role, you will lead developers and projects and provide mentoring opportunities to the development team. 

A critical objective for this role is to support the architecture and deliver scalable enterprise solutions, leveraging AWS cloud native technologies, designing and implementing micro-services and a relentless focus on performance and resilience. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Design and develop proprietary solutions for the Equity Direct Indexing portfolio management teams

 - Conduct code reviews of other developers

 - 12+ years of hands-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services. 

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. About the Role

As a Lead Developer, you will own and evolve the core platform services that power our AI-driven products. You will design and build production-grade APIs, LLM-based extraction and enrichment pipelines, and agentic workflows - ensuring they are reliable, performant, and scalable. 

You will work closely with AI engineers, front-end developers, and product stakeholders to translate investment use cases into robust back-end solutions. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who combines deep Python expertise with hands-on experience building LLM-driven applications and who thrives in a fast-paced, product-oriented environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain back-end services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, serving both internal and external consumers. 
 - Build and optimise LLM-based pipelines for information extraction, summarisation, and classification across diverse source types. 
 - Develop and maintain agentic AI workflows using LangGraph, including tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning chains, and feedback loops. 
 - Extend and operate the MCP server layer (FastMCP), enabling seamless integration of AI capabilities into third-party tools and workflows. 
 - Design and maintain data models and query patterns in MongoDB Atlas, leveraging both its document database and vector store capabilities for RAG pipelines. 
 - Build and manage data processing and scheduling pipelines using Apache Airflow, deployed on AWS EKS. 
 - Collaborate with front-end engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts and ensure efficient data flows. 
 - Implement robust testing strategies (unit, integration, end-to-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines for reliable, automated deployments. 
 - Participate actively in agile ceremonies, code reviews, and architectural discussions, contributing to a culture of engineering excellence. 
 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system reliability and performance across the platform. 

Experience

- Years of Experience: 10-17 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on Python back-end development. 
 - LLM & AI Development: At least 1 year of hands-on experience building LLM-based applications, including one or more of: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-based systems (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph), LLM-driven data extraction, or prompt engineering.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM)

Mortgage Quality Control (QC) Analyst - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview

As part of the Mortgage Quality Control (QC) team, the Analyst will perform independent post-underwriting and post-funding reviews of US residential mortgage loans to evaluate the accuracy of underwriting decisions, adherence to internal credit policies, and compliance with investor and regulatory requirements. The role involves detailed examination of approved and funded loan files to identify underwriting deficiencies, documentation gaps, and control weaknesses, while providing actionable insights to enhance mortgage credit quality, operational processes, and overall risk management frameworks. 

Core Responsibilities

- Perform pre-funding and post-funding Quality Control (QC) reviews of residential mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and policy compliance
 - Independently validate key underwriting calculations, including FOIR/DTI, LTV/CLTV, income calculations, and borrower eligibility criteria
 - Review borrower documentation such as income proofs, employment verification, bank statements, tax returns, and credit bureau reports to assess consistency and accuracy
 - Validate collateral-related documents including property appraisals, title reports, insurance, and legal documentation for compliance with lending guidelines
 - Assess adherence to investor and regulatory requirements (e. g. , Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA guidelines) and internal credit policies
 - Identify, document, and classify QC findings (defects) based on severity levels; perform root cause analysis and highlight control gaps
 - Reconcile underwriting decisions by re-performing key credit assessments and highlighting discrepancies in credit approval decisions
 - Track and report defect trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across reviewed files to support continuous improvement initiatives
 - Prepare QC reporting outputs including detailed review summaries, dashboards, and management reports for stakeholders
 - Collaborate with underwriting, operations, credit policy, and compliance teams to discuss findings and support remediation actions
 - Participate in calibration exercises and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency in QC review standards and defect grading

Domain Skills Required

- Strong understanding of US residential mortgage products (conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, etc. ) and underwriting frameworks
 - Experience in mortgage QC/QA including pre-funding and post-closing reviews, defect identification, and compliance validation
 - Knowledge of underwriting guidelines such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and agency lending standards
 - Familiarity with QC methodologies including defect grading, sampling, re-performance of underwriting, and root cause analysis
 - Ability to analyze borrower financials (income, assets, liabilities) and validate underwriting calculations
 - Experience in preparing structured QC reports, trend analysis, and management-ready findings

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- MBA/CA or equivalent with 7-10 years of experience in mortgage QC, underwriting, or retail credit roles. 
 - Strong analytical skills with experience in loan file review and underwriting validation
 - Advanced Excel skills; exposure to reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL and Basic Knowledge in AI is an added advantage. 
 - Strong communication skills with ability to clearly articulate QC findings and recommendations. 

Good-to-have: 

- Certifications such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or mortgage-specific certifications
 - Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and underwriting platforms
 - Exposure to regulatory audits, QC audits, or internal control testing environments

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

- Lead a multi-disciplinary organization of engineers, designers, technical leads, and specialists supporting ETO, COE, COD, wiring diagrams, application engineering, layout and design, and manufacturing support for LVA and Busway. 
 - Own engineering execution from customer specification and order configuration through customer-approval drawings, detailed electrical and mechanical design, bills of material, manufacturing release, as-built updates, and engineering-change closure. 
 - Deliver on-time engineering releases, first-time-right quality, productivity, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction while maintaining compliance with product standards and plant processes. 
 - Establish capacity, workload, outsourcing, and cross-training plans that provide flexible support across low-voltage assembly and busway demand. 
 - Drive operating rhythms for backlog, engineering completion, order complexity, quality defects, change notices, risk escalation, recovery plans, and plant support. 

Product-Line and Technical Leadership

- Serve as the technical and organizational leader for Low Voltage Assembly and Busway engineering. Ensure leaders and teams understand product architecture, application boundaries, configuration rules, electrical and mechanical interfaces, manufacturing constraints, installation dependencies, and test requirements. 
 - For LVA, guide engineering for Magnum PXR and Magnum DS low-voltage switchgear, including rear-access, front-access, arc-resistant, arc-quenching, NRX, OEM, indoor, and outdoor configurations supported by the product line. 
 - Ensure strong LVA knowledge of UL 1558 and UL 891 applications; main, tie, feeder, transition, auxiliary, metering, and control sections; breaker selection and application; horizontal and vertical bus; risers, runbacks, stabs, bracing, grounding and neutral systems; cable and conduit entry; control power; current and voltage transformers; protection, metering, communications, interlocks, automatic-transfer and power-control schemes; one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, and customer-connection requirements. 

Engineering Systems, Digital Thread, and Continuous Improvement

Business, Plant, and Cross-Functional Leadership

Talent and Organizational Development

Qualifications

- Bachelors/Masters in Electrical engineering or equivalent
 - 15+ years of engineering experience in low-voltage power distribution, switchgear, busway, or related electromechanical products, with substantial experience in Engineer-to-Order, Customer Order Engineering, Customer Order Design, application engineering, detailed design, or requisition engineering. Minimum 5 years of people-leadership experience leading multi-disciplinary electrical and mechanical engineering teams; experience leading leaders or multiple product-line teams is preferred. 

Skills

- Extensive knowledge of ETO order engineering, including specification and drawing review, configuration, feasibility assessment, customer-approval drawings, detailed design, bills of material, manufacturing release, change management, as-built documentation, and plant support. 
 - Demonstrated product knowledge in both Low Voltage Assembly and Busway engineering, or deep expertise in one product line with proven ability to build capability in the other. 
 - LVA knowledge: Magnum PXR and Magnum DS switchgear; front- and rear-access arrangements; arc-resistant and arc-quenching configurations; UL 1558 and UL 891 applications; breakers, bus, risers, runbacks, stabs, bracing, neutral and grounding systems; protection, metering, communication, interlocks, control power, automatic-transfer and power-control schemes; one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, and mechanical layouts. 
 - Busway knowledge: Pow-R-Way III, Pow-R-Way II, and supported busway offerings; feeder and plug-in busway; straight lengths and fittings; elbows, offsets, tees, crosses, flanges, joints, expansion and phase-transposition sections; transformer taps and throat connections; reducers, adapters, end feeds, end closers, hangers, power takeoffs, plug-in devices, layout drawings, final-field-fit requirements, and equipment coordination. 
 - Working knowledge of copper and aluminum conductor application, bus ampacity, voltage and short-circuit ratings, phasing, orientation, grounding, neutral arrangements, insulation, voltage drop, environmental ratings, clearances, supports, seismic requirements, installation constraints, and field coordination. 
 - Strong understanding of applicable ANSI, IEEE, UL, NEMA, NEC, NFPA, CSA, and IEC requirements, including low-voltage switchgear, busway, arc-resistant, testing, and installation requirements applicable to the supported portfolios. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, structure and compartment assembly, breaker and device fitment, bus fabrication and jointing, wiring, inspection, testing, packaging and shipping splits, quality systems, engineering changes, and product lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with BidManager or comparable configuration tools; AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical; Inventor or comparable 3D CAD; ENOVIA/3DX or comparable PLM; Design Automation; BIM; MAPICS/AS400; and manufacturing-release or order-management systems. 
 - Proven ability to lead design automation, BIM and digital-thread initiatives, reusable product definition, configuration validation, drawing and BOM automation, busway engineering automation, workflow optimization, and engineering-quality improvement. 
 - Demonstrated application of Lean, DMAIC, Design for Six Sigma, Agile, and continuous-improvement methods; Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred. 
 - Ability to evaluate competitor offerings, customer and market trends, product standards, installation practices, and technology developments relevant to low-voltage assemblies and busway.

 - Good understanding of mobile application testing principles and QA methodologies.

 - Understanding of functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.

 - Strong attention to UI/UX details and ability to compare implementations against Figma designs.

data.description:
Company Description

SoftSensor. ai is a data engineering, analytics, and artificial intelligence partner that helps enterprises transform fragmented data into measurable business outcomes. The team operates at the intersection of industry expertise, scalable data architecture, and applied AI to reduce operational inefficiencies and accelerate decision-making. By building enterprise data warehouses and deploying advanced analytics and GenAI solutions, SoftSensor. ai enables organizations to cut costs, improve accuracy, and speed up insight generation. Professionals joining the company can expect to work on impactful data and AI initiatives that directly support business growth and innovation. 

Role Description

The Quality Engineer role at SoftSensor. ai is a full-time, on-site position based in Jaipur. This role is responsible for designing and implementing quality standards and processes for data, analytics, and AI products, ensuring consistent product performance and reliability. Day-to-day tasks include developing and executing test plans, conducting root cause analysis, collaborating with engineering and product teams to resolve defects, and monitoring key quality metrics. The Quality Engineer will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, document quality procedures, and support compliance with internal and client quality requirements. 

Qualifications

- Candidates should possess skills in Quality Engineering and Product Quality to design, implement, and improve quality frameworks for data and AI solutions. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in Quality Assurance and Quality Control to plan tests, validate deliverables, and identify defects before release. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in Quality Management to define standards, track quality metrics, and support continuous improvement across projects. 
 - Experience with software testing methodologies, test automation tools, and defect tracking systems is highly beneficial. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and clear documentation practices. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate quality issues and recommendations in a clear, structured manner. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Familiarity with data pipelines, analytics platforms, or AI/ML workflows is a plus. 

Role objective

Own testing for assigned application modules and provide evidence-based recommendations on release readiness. 

Key responsibilities

- Review requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify gaps and define test coverage. 
 - Prepare test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability documentation. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, exploratory, and cross-browser testing. 
 - Validate REST APIs using Postman or equivalent tools. 
 - Use SQL to validate data and investigate defects when database access is available. 
 - Report reproducible defects with evidence, severity, and business impact. 
 - Coordinate defect triage, retesting, and UAT with developers and business stakeholders. 
 - Communicate testing progress, unresolved risks, and release readiness. 
 - Develop and maintain automated regression tests where applicable. 

Required skills

- 3-4 years of hands-on QA experience with web applications. 
 - Strong manual testing, API testing, and basic SQL skills. 
 - Understanding of software development and testing lifecycles. 
 - Familiarity with Jira or equivalent tools and Agile delivery. 
 - Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and written communication. 
 - Ability to independently manage testing priorities. 

Preferred skills

- Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD and performance testing. 
 - At least one of the two hires should ideally have practical automation experience.

data.title: AVP- Fullstack AI Engineer- HR Tech
data.description:
Job Description

About the Role

As Jefferies transitions from traditional SaaS workflows to an Agentic AI Operating Model, the skillsets required to manage the platform shift fundamentally. The platform relies on continuous monitoring, external signal processing (Watcher Agents), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) governance. 

We are seeking a hybrid engineering profile-a Lead AI Engineer-who bridges the gap between enterprise systems integration, LLM prompt governance, and complex business logic. This role goes beyond traditional "keep the lights on" IT support; this individual will act as the operational pilot of the AI platform, tuning agent behavior, ensuring data security, and evolving the system's capabilities to meet dynamic business demands. 

You will be the primary technical owner of the platform: operating and hardening it in production, extending its AI agent workflows and enterprise integrations, and driving the Phase 2 roadmap (candidate portal, scheduling, assessments, and further automation). 

Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
 - Backend: Python 3. 12+, FastAPI, Pydantic, async I/O, Server-Sent Events (SSE)
 - AI / Agents: LangGraph and LangChain agent pipelines with AWS-hosted LLMs (e. g. , Amazon Bedrock), human-in-the-loop approval gates, agent control room, prompt and eval management
 - Database: MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB (document modeling, async access via Motor)
 - Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, structured logging, metrics, tracing, audit trails
 - Enterprise integrations: Oracle ORC (HRIS - requisitions, candidates, scorecards), PeopleSoft incl. CSS (staffing & comp), background-check vendor APIs (e. g. , First Advantage - bidirectional), DocuSign e-signature, Microsoft Exchange / Outlook via Graph API, ServiceNow ITSM
 - Sourcing channel integrations: LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (One-Click Export ingest), Indeed Retrieve Candidates API (GraphQL + OAuth), Naukri ATS webhook ingest

Key Responsibilities

- Own production operations of the platform: monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and SLA adherence ("keep the lights on"). 
 - Evolve the platform on the delivered foundation: design, build, and ship new features across the React frontend and FastAPI backend. 
 - Maintain and extend agentic AI workflows - agent nodes, prompts, guardrails, tool bindings, and human-in-the-loop approval gates - including evaluation and bias-governance of AI scoring. 
 - Operate and extend the connector framework integrating Oracle ORC, PeopleSoft, BGC vendors, DocuSign, Exchange/O365, and ServiceNow. 
 - Maintain sourcing-channel ingestion pipelines - LinkedIn RSC candidate export, Indeed Retrieve Candidates API streaming, and Naukri webhook receivers - feeding the Sourcing Agent's scoring and shortlisting. 
 - Manage data models and pipelines in MongoDB/DocumentDB, ensuring data quality, sync integrity across systems of record, and auditability. 
 - Own the AWS infrastructure via IaC and CI/CD; manage environments, releases, security posture (SSO/RBAC), and cost. 
 - Maintain observability: dashboards, agent audit trails, structured logs, alerts, and operational runbooks. 
 - Partner with HR Ops, Recruiting, Legal/Compliance, and IT stakeholders to prioritize the backlog and translate business needs into platform capabilities. 
 - Agent Operations: Monitor, tune, and deploy updates to specialized AI process agents (e. g. , automated sourcing, offer generation, candidate triage) utilizing Jefferies' internal LLM gateways. 
 - Ontology & Knowledge Base Maintenance: Continuously update the system's Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge graph (e. g. , uploading new compliance policies, visa regulations, or compensation matrices) to ensure agents reason against the latest ground-truth data. 
 - Data Sovereignty & PII Handling: Proven ability to architect data-masking pipelines to ensure highly sensitive data (Compensation, SSNs, Diversity metrics) is encrypted, scrubbed, and strictly isolated from broader LLM reasoning engines. 
 - Algorithmic Bias & Regulatory Auditing: Familiarity with validating AI outputs against strict employment and compliance laws (e. g. , EEOC guidelines, NY Fair Chance Act constraints) to ensure automated workflows remain legally defensible and auditable. 
 - Lead knowledge transfer from the delivery partner and serve as the internal technical authority for the platform. 

Required Skills & Experience Skill AreaWhat We Expect

Full-stack engineering Strong professional software engineering experience, with ownership of production systems

Python backend (FastAPI) Async Python services, REST APIs, Pydantic data modeling, SSE/streaming patterns

React / TypeScript Modern React (hooks, router), TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS; component-driven UI

MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB Document data modeling, aggregation pipelines, async drivers (Motor), performance tuning

Enterprise integrations Building/maintaining API integrations with enterprise systems (HRIS, ITSM, e-signature, email/Graph API); webhook ingest, OAuth, and partner-API patterns (e. g. , LinkedIn RSC, Indeed, Naukri)

Observability & operations Structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, incident response, runbooks

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments. 

At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. The Principal GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI systems that combine LLM-powered GenAI and ADK-based agentic workflows on Google Cloud Platform. This role also requires leading and developing data pipelines for necessary data layer for AI/ML. This role sets architecture standards, leads multi-team delivery, and governs safety, reliability, and cost at enterprise scale-accelerating product teams to achieve monetization of AI based products through reusable patterns, platforms, and guardrails. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Architecture

- Define reference architectures for GenAI apps, RAG systems, and agent ecosystems (single/multi-agent) on GCP using ADK. 
 - Leverage capabilities of Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform in the Agentic AI Product development. 
 - Establish domain and platform standards: model selection, RAG/generation patterns, memory architectures, security baselines, observability, and LLMOps. 
 - Lead portfolio-wide technical decisions (build/buy, vendor selection, SLAs, quotas) with a focus on reliability, safety, and cost control. 
 - Define the data pipeline development for lakehouse, delta lake or feature engineering. 

Solution Design & Delivery

- Architect and lead implementation of production-grade GenAI solutions (Vertex AI models, Grounding, Pipelines, Evaluation) and agentic services (planning, tools, memory, HIL). 
 - Design multi-tenant and hub-and-spoke patterns with Okta/IAP/Apigee for secure API exposure and tenant isolation. 
 - Drive end-to-end delivery across teams: data ingestion (Dataflow/Composer), indexing (BigQuery vectors/Vertex Vector Search), services (Cloud Run/Workflows), events (Pub/Sub). 
 - Data Pipeline both near real time and batch. 

Platformization & Reuse

- Build and maintain prompt libraries, tool catalogs, agent templates, and evaluation harnesses for organization-wide reuse. 
 - Standardize LLMOps: CI/CD for prompts/models/agents, model registry, traceability, rollback, canaries, cost/performance scorecards. 
 - Enable a marketplace of agents/services with productized APIs, documentation, chargeback, and KPIs. 

Responsible AI, Security & Compliance

- Implement multi-layer guardrails: policy prompts, filters, memory governance, tool whitelisting, audit logs; ensure regulator-ready posture. 
 - Codify privacy, PII handling, data residency, and per-tenant isolation using VPC-SC, Secret Manager, IAM, and Apigee policies. 

Leadership & Enablement

- Mentor senior engineers and team leads; run architecture reviews, design clinics, and red-team exercises. 
 - Drive continuous evaluation programs and publish org scorecards for quality, safety, and cost. 
 - Partner with Product, Security, and SRE to align roadmaps, SLOs, and operational playbooks. 

Required Technical Competencies

- Dataflow and Apache Beam for data pipeline development. 
 - Strong on using SQL for data analysis. 
 - LLM & GenAI: Model selection (Gemini & Model Garden), prompt engineering, RAG/grounding, multimodal pipelines, fine-tuning/adapter methods. 
 - Agentic AI (ADK): Agent loops, planners, tool/function design, memory (episodic/semantic/long-term), HIL, policy enforcement. 
 - Data & Retrieval: BigQuery (including vector functions), Vertex Vector Search, Document AI, Dataplex for lineage and governance. 
 - Orchestration & Services: Cloud Run, Workflows, Pub/Sub, Dataflow/Composer; HA/DR, backpressure, circuit breakers. 
 - LLMOps/MLOps: Vertex AI Pipelines, registry, CI/CD, trace correlation, cost/performance monitoring. 
 - Security & Compliance: IAM, Secret Manager, VPC-SC, private service connect, DLP, Okta/IAP, Apigee API policies. 
 - Observability & Cost: Central telemetry, user feedback loops, drift/outlier detection, quota/capacity planning. 

Qualifications

- 12-15+ years in software/data/ML engineering; 1+ years hands-on with LLMs/GenAI and agentic systems. 
 - Proven delivery of enterprise-scale GenAI/agent platforms on GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Workflows). 
 - Demonstrated impact in platformization, governance, and multi-team technical leadership. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript (or equivalent) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/GCP Deployment Manager). 
 - Experience in security-by-design, privacy, and compliance audits. 
 - Proven delivery in building data pipeline using distributed computing frameworks such as Dataflow, Spark.

NVIDIA's GeForce NOW, the next-generation gaming service powered by NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud, transforms a Mac, PC, or mobile device into a high-performance gaming machine. Just click and play! Visit us at https: //www. nvidia. com/en-us/geforce-now. We are now extending this industry defining technology to a new range of applications including virtual and augmented reality, artificial intelligence and remote controlled robotics. 

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join a team of skilled and motivated engineers who develop a high performance, low latency streaming stack that delivers unprecedented video quality at lowest latency that makes gaming from the cloud the preferred gaming platform for millions. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Design and develop new video streaming functionalities delivering new interactive experiences
 - Innovate, design and develop features to improve image quality, performance, reliability, security and maintainability
 - Analyze GPU/ CPU performance for the video pipeline, isolate bottlenecks and implement solutions in collaboration with GPU hardware and software teams to deliver top performance
 - Develop tools to measure video quality experienced by users, refine to enable evaluation of quality improvements with high confidence
 - Leverage features and toolsets in latest video compression technologies to deliver high quality streaming solutions tailored for different interactive graphics applications
 - Develop quality-evaluation and analysis capabilities that use metrics along with encoder statistics to detect regressions, evaluate new video features, and guide codec and pipeline tuning. 
 - Apply machine learning and AI models to develop specialized video processing and adaptive streaming algorithms to minimize perceptible artifacts while delivering the lowest latency under different network conditions. 

What We Need To See

- 5+ years of experience with Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related area. 
 - Proficiency in C, C++, Python
 - Strong understanding of real-time GPU-accelerated video pipeline performance, including encoder behavior, color spaces, video scaling, transport efficiency, buffering, pacing, bitrate adaptation, frame handling, and latency-sensitive optimizations in distributed or cloud-based systems. 
 - Familiarity with API frameworks such as Vulkan, CUDA, OpenGL and DX
 - Solid understanding of toolsets in different video codecs like H. 264, HEVC, and AV1, including tuning codec configurations to meet application requirements and trade-offs. 
 - Experience debugging and improving reliability and stability in complex streaming systems, including issues related to degraded network conditions, packet loss recovery, telemetry, tracing, field validation, and long-running session behavior. 
 - Proficiency in telemetry, statistical data analysis, and performance monitoring to measure and optimize video quality, latency, and system performance in cloud infrastructures. 
 - Experience in using and integrating AI models into real-time video pipelines
 - Experience with objective video quality assessment using metrics such as VMAF, CAMBI, PSNR, and SSIM/MS-SSIM, and the ability to correlate those metrics with perceptual video quality across different content types and artifacts. 
 - Strong understanding of different layers of software stack including OS internals, user-mode and kernel-mode drivers, strong system software performance analysis, testing and debugging skills

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience in optimizing video pipelines on multiple GPU families such as Intel integrated and AMD GPUs
 - Experience writing or analyzing graphics rendering applications or advanced AI based graphics generation such as DLSS, RTX, FSR

Disclaimer: Candidates will initially be employed under ANSR and subsequently transitioned to A&F Co. Bengaluru. 

Quality Engineer I - Enterprise Systems

About the Role: 

We are looking for a Quality Engineer I (QE I) to support quality execution across our ERP and product-facing enterprise systems, including Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation, Inventory, and related integrations. 

In this role, you will work closely with engineers, product partners, and senior quality engineers to validate business workflows, data flows, and system behavior across complex, interconnected platforms. You will focus on learning enterprise business processes, executing well-designed test scenarios, and contributing to automation-first quality practices. 

This is an early-career growth role for engineers who are curious about how large-scale systems work end-to-end and want to build strong foundations in enterprise quality engineering. 

What You'll Do: 

Support Quality and Operations Across Enterprise Workflows: 

- Execute test cases for enterprise business processes across Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation, Inventory, and downstream systems. 
 - Validate functional behavior against requirements, acceptance criteria, and documented workflows. 
 - Identify defects related to business logic, data issues, integrations, or configuration errors and log them clearly with impact and repro steps. 
 - Assist in end-to-end testing of workflows that span multiple systems. 
 - Provide Operational assistance during GHO off-hours and report any callouts to Onshore counterparts. 

Data & Integration Validation: 

- Validate data accuracy across interfaces, APIs, batch jobs, and downstream system updates. 
 - Support testing of scheduled jobs, data feeds, and integration hand-offs. 
 - Compare expected vs. actual results for calculations, rules, and configuration-driven behavior. 
 - Help ensure data integrity for planning, inventory, and operational reporting. 

Automation & Engineering Practices: 

- Contribute to automated test suites for APIs, services, and enterprise workflows. 
 - Execute and maintain existing automated tests as part of CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Assist in creating reusable test data and validation scripts. 
 - Learn automation frameworks, tools, and best practices used by the team. 

Collaboration & Learning: 

- Participate in Agile ceremonies including refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 
 - Partner with developers and senior QEs to understand system design and test intent. 
 - Ask questions early to clarify requirements and uncover edge cases. 
 - Support release testing and post-release validation activities. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Review defects and production issues to understand root causes and prevention opportunities. 
 - Suggest improvements to test cases, automation coverage, and documentation. 
 - Continuously build knowledge of enterprise platforms, business processes, and quality practices. 

What You Bring: 

Required Qualifications: 

- 4-5 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, or a related role. 
 - Experience testing backend systems, APIs, or data-driven applications. 
 - Basic understanding of software testing fundamentals and defect lifecycle. 
 - Exposure to ERP or large-scale enterprise systems. 
 - Good at Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Familiarity with API testing concepts (REST, JSON, status codes, payload validation). 
 - Exposure to SQL or basic data validation techniques. 
 - Comfortable working in Agile or hybrid delivery models. 
 - Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and willingness to learn complex systems. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience with test automation tools or scripting (JavaScript, Python, or similar). 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution. 
 - Basic understanding of business domains such as Merchandising, Inventory, Planning, or Supply Chain. 
 - Experience working with batch jobs, integrations, or data pipelines. 

Why This Role Matters: 

Enterprise systems power critical business decisions and operations. As a Quality Engineer I, your work helps ensure that data is accurate, workflows behave as expected, and integrations remain reliable. 

This role provides a strong foundation in enterprise quality engineering-preparing you to grow into deeper system ownership, automation leadership, and end-to-end quality strategy over time.

(A&F Co. ) associate in our India Global Capability Center (GCC), you'll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced and results-driven Assistant Manager - BIM Mechanical to lead and manage Mechanical BIM project delivery, ensuring high-quality outputs, operational efficiency, and adherence to project schedules and BIM standards. 

The role involves overseeing BIM modeling and coordination activities, managing team performance, reviewing technical deliverables, and collaborating with BIM Leads, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. 

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Mechanical BIM, proven team management capabilities, and the ability to drive quality, productivity, and continuous improvement across projects. 

Key Responsibilities1. BIM Project Management & Delivery
 - Lead and oversee Mechanical BIM modeling, coordination, shop drawing production, and construction documentation activities. 
 - Plan project deliverables, allocate resources, establish priorities, and monitor progress against project schedules. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate delivery of BIM models, shop drawings, and other project outputs. 
 - Monitor team productivity and implement corrective measures to address delays, technical challenges, and quality concerns. 
 - Ensure project execution aligns with the BIM Execution Plan (BEP), project specifications, and established standards. 2. Team Leadership & Resource Management

 - Oversee Mechanical BIM models, shop drawings, and construction documentation to ensure compliance with project requirements. 
 - Establish and implement quality control procedures, review checklists, and model audit processes. 
 - Lead multidisciplinary coordination and clash detection activities using appropriate BIM tools. 
 - Review and resolve coordination issues with Architecture, Structural, Electrical, Plumbing, and other relevant disciplines. 
 - Ensure technical accuracy, model consistency, and compliance with applicable project standards before submission. 
 - Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive and corrective actions. 4. Stakeholder & Project Coordination

 - Support project planning, resource forecasting, workload distribution, and milestone tracking. 
 - Monitor project progress and identify potential risks affecting schedules, quality, and productivity.

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering | Technology Delivery Leadership — Azure Cloud, Web Applications, Salesforce, and Payments
data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end execution: Own planning, architecture alignment, engineering delivery, testing, release readiness, production launch, and post-production stabilization for a portfolio of strategic initiatives. 
 - Drive multi-platform delivery: Provide leadership across Azure Cloud services, web application ecosystems, Salesforce capabilities and integrations, and payment processing platforms. 
 - Translate strategy into outcomes: Partner with product, business, architecture, security, risk, operations, and infrastructure leaders to convert priorities into roadmaps, executable plans, and measurable results. 
 - Strengthen engineering excellence: Champion scalable architecture, secure coding, automation, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, reliability, and disciplined software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans. 
 - Coordinate globally: Align teams, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, ensuring clear ownership, effective handoffs, and timely escalation of risks and decisions. 
 - Manage delivery health: Establish transparent governance for scope, schedule, quality, budget, capacity, dependencies, risks, and technical debt; use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement. 
 - Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation. 
 - Influence technology direction: Evaluate emerging technologies, guide build-versus-buy decisions, and shape modernization plans that balance innovation, maintainability, cost, and risk. 
 - Communicate with impact: Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leaders and stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and enabling timely decisions. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Proven technology delivery experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects/initiatives in parallel. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering complex, enterprise-scale programs from concept through production and ongoing operations. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations. 
 - Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance. 
 - Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements. 
 - Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, resolve cross-team dependencies, and lead distributed teams across geographies. 
 - Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision-making skills. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Employees are encouraged to take extreme ownership of projects early in their careers, giving them opportunities to ship ideas quickly and see their direct impact on millions of users. 

- Immense Impact (Building for the Next Billion)

Unlike platforms targeting Tier 1 demographics, Meesho is dedicated to democratizing internet commerce for Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. To foster deep user empathy, the company implements unique rituals like "Listen or Die" (LOD)-mandating that team members gather direct user insights before beginning any project-and sponsors user-safari trips into smaller towns to study consumer habits firsthand. 

- Top-Tier Compensation & Financial Perks

Competitive base cash salaries.

- Application & Resume Screening: 
 - Candidates apply via official job portals, campus drives, or recruiter networks.

 - Online Assessment (OA):

 - Technical Interviews (1-2 Rounds): 
 - Round 1 (DSA / Problem-Solving): Focuses on core data structures, algorithms, and logical problem-solving (such as greedy algorithms, array manipulations, or DFS/trees). 
 - Round 2 (Machine Coding / Low-Level Design): A practical coding or LLD session (e. g. , implementing a carpooling system or ticket booking system in 60-75 minutes) to test code structure, scalability, and clean design under constraints. 
 - Hiring Manager / System Design Round: 
 - In-depth discussion on past projects, internships, concurrency, multi-threading, and CS fundamentals like CAP theorem. 
 - Evaluates system architecture and trade-offs. 
 - HR / Cultural Fit Round: 
 - Focuses on alignment with Meesho's core values, such as "extreme ownership, " a "user-first" mindset, and structured communication.

data.title: Engineering Manager — Advanced Manufacturing Systems (Mechanical)
data.description:
Company Overview - Leumas

Leumas is a venture-funded deep-tech company based in Bengaluru, building modular robotic factories and software-defined manufacturing systems for healthcare products. 

Our R&D ambition is to build the future of drug manufacturing across emerging therapeutic modalities. We are developing new manufacturing modules and technologies for peptide synthesis, oncology applications and other advanced drug-production processes, while exploring Physical AI to make manufacturing systems more capable, adaptive and autonomous. 

This work brings together mechanical engineering, chemistry, process development, electronics, firmware, AI and quality systems. Our engineers translate scientific and process requirements into machines, test them through experiments and develop them toward scalable manufacturing platforms. 

We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who wants to tackle unfamiliar engineering problems, build a strong multidisciplinary team and help define how future medicines will be manufactured. 

Industry Context

Our equipment must combine process performance, flexible configurations, hygienic design and practical manufacturing economics. Development succeeds when new mechanisms work repeatedly across realistic operating conditions. 

The Role

You will lead mechanical and manufacturing-system R&D for Leumas' next generation of technology modules, spanning peptides, oncology applications, Physical AI and emerging drug-manufacturing processes. 

Working closely with scientific, process, electrical, firmware and AI teams, you will translate new process requirements into equipment architectures, experimental systems and deployable manufacturing modules. You will guide development from early feasibility through prototypes, performance verification and transfer toward production. 

This role requires strong mechanical engineering depth, systems thinking and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You will build and mentor the engineering team while remaining personally involved in critical designs, experiments and technical decisions. 

What You'll Own

1. Technology roadmap - Translate manufacturing needs into development requirements, technical priorities and measurable acceptance criteria. Plan projects, resources and design milestones with leadership. 

2. Architecture & design - Lead mechanisms, motion systems, product-contact assemblies and modular interfaces. Review materials, tolerances, cleanability, maintainability and cost before releasing designs. 

3. Prototype learning - Plan experiments and instrumented trials; quantify dosing accuracy, throughput, repeatability or other relevant performance. Resolve failure modes through evidence and controlled design iterations. 

4. Cross-functional integration - Agree mechanical, electrical and software interfaces early. Coordinate process constraints, sensors, actuation, guarding and service access through complete-machine trials. 

5. Industrialisation - Own drawing and BOM quality, design-for-manufacture reviews and engineering change discipline. Transfer designs to build teams with assembly, test and operating documentation. 

6. Team & knowledge - Coach engineers, run technical reviews and maintain reusable design knowledge. Support invention documentation and protect confidential engineering information. 

7. New Manufacturing Technologies & Module Architecture - Work with scientists and process experts to understand the manufacturing requirements of new therapeutic modalities. Translate these into equipment concepts, module architectures and development plans. Evaluate technical feasibility, identify critical unknowns and build experiments that establish whether an approach can work. 

8. Physical AI & Adaptive Manufacturing - Collaborate with AI, robotics and controls teams to develop machines that can sense, interpret and respond to physical process conditions. Own the mechanical systems, actuation, sensing provisions and interfaces needed to test these capabilities. Establish measurable performance targets and appropriate safeguards with the responsible teams. 

You're a Fit If

·            BE/BTech, ME/Mtech, PHD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; typically 8-12 years in machine design and product development, including technical team leadership. A strong academic foundation from a leading engineering institution such as IITs, IISc, BITS or leading NITs is preferred. 

·            Track record delivering machines from requirements through prototypes, testing and manufacturing release. 

·            Strong fundamentals in mechanisms, machine elements, tolerances, materials and engineering analysis, with practical CAD proficiency. 

·            Ability to balance experimentation with schedules and lead cross-functional decisions using test evidence. 

·            You have developed novel machines or complex hardware where the solution was not fully defined at the outset. 

·            You can translate scientific or process requirements into engineering problems and work effectively with experts outside your discipline. 

·            You understand how mechanical design, sensing, actuation and software interact in a complete system. 

·            You can distinguish early technical feasibility from equipment ready for reliable manufacturing. 

Preferred: Candidates with a leading engineering-institution background and/or substantial R&D experience in a leading technology company / deep tech startups. Demonstrated engineering depth, delivery and startup adaptability will determine selection. 

How You Will Operate

You are a working technical leader who reviews details, invites critique and makes decisions explicit. You distinguish an interesting prototype from a design ready for deployment. 

What Success Looks Like

·            Priority development programs have clear requirements, test plans and accountable milestones. 

·            At least one agreed development milestone reaches documented performance verification and build handover. 

Why Join

·            Help build manufacturing technologies for emerging medicines and therapeutic modalities. 

·            Shape new modules spanning peptide processes, oncology applications and Physical AI. 

·            Work across engineering, science and AI to turn new manufacturing concepts into functioning machines. 

·            Build a capable R&D team and influence Leumas' technology roadmap. 

·            Take substantial ownership in a demanding startup where your work can define future manufacturing platforms.
