data.title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer, AI & Search
data.description:
Who We Are

Yieldmo is an advertising platform that helps brands invent creative experiences through tech and AI, using custom ad formats, proprietary attention signals, predictive format selection, and privacy-safe premium inventory curation. We believe all ads should be human-centered, tailored, and provoke emotion and action. Yieldmo helps brands deliver the best ad for every impression opportunity, merging creative and media for proven results. 

The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (5-10 years of experience) to help build Yieldmo's AI-powered search engine, which will change how users discover and engage with content across major publishers. This is a full-stack role with a strong ML component. You'll build backend services and ML-powered features, and ship the user-facing interfaces that bring them to life. We care most about builders: engineers who write production code, iterate quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and own their work end to end. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that power AI-driven search, including retrieval, ranking, and indexing components. 
 - Build and deploy ML features into production: embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and model evaluation. 
 - Develop responsive, performant front-end experiences that surface search results and AI features to users and internal teams. 
 - Build and maintain data and content ingestion pipelines that feed the search system. 
 - Own features end to end, from prototype through production, monitoring, and iteration. 
 - Partner with Product, ML, and Engineering teams to turn requirements into shipped features. 
 - Drive quality, performance, and reliability for the services you own, including testing, code reviews, and observability. 
 - Share knowledge and support teammates; senior engineers will mentor others and contribute to technical design decisions. 

Requirements

- Must be based in India. 
 - 5-10 years of professional software engineering experience, building and operating production systems. 
 - Strong backend skills in Python, with solid SQL and experience designing APIs and microservices. 
 - Hands-on front-end experience with a modern framework (React preferred) plus JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Practical ML experience in production: working with embeddings, vector databases, LLMs, RAG, or ranking/recommendation models. 
 - Experience with Docker, cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), and CI/CD. 
 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, system design, and testing. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working cross-functionally in a fast-moving, remote team. 
 - An ownership mindset: you ship, measure, and improve. 

Nice to Haves

- Deeper ML/AI backend experience: model serving, fine-tuning, training pipelines, or online/offline evaluation. 
 - Experience building search or retrieval systems (inverted indexes, BM25, hybrid search, rerankers). 
 - Familiarity with data tools such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or a modern data warehouse. 
 - Experience with publisher-scale content, recommendation systems, or adtech. 

Hiring Process

Selected candidates will be invited to a 30-minute screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll share full process details. The process typically includes: 

- A 30-minute video interview with the Hiring Manager. 
 - A remote round of video interviews with team members and leadership. 
 - An offer for successful candidates. 

Our Values

- Innovation: We encourage curiosity, embrace new ideas, and believe no idea is too bold. 
 - Agility: We embrace change, act quickly, and adapt with a focus on getting things done. 
 - Intelligence: We make decisions guided by data, aiming to deliver maximum value to our customers. 
 - Autonomy: We empower individuals to create their own paths with flexibility and independence. 
 - Togetherness: We foster teamwork, mutual support, and an environment where every voice matters. 

What We Offer

- Remote work: A fully distributed team, with annual offsites, holiday parties, and more. 
 - Company-paid health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. 
 - Equity: Share in Yieldmo's success through our employee stock option program. 
 - Flexible time off: Plus company slowdowns and Summer Fridays. 
 - Home office setup and stipend: Premium technology packages and a stipend for extra needs. 
 - Professional development: An annual stipend to grow your hard and soft skills.

data.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer - AI
data.description:
Are you passionate about building AI-driven software that transforms how professionals work? Join a dynamic and highly skilled team at Thomson Reuters, where we invest deeply in AI technologies and explore emerging fields with the backing of a global leader. As a Senior Software Engineer - AI, you will play a key role in developing intelligent systems that power the next generation of expert solutions across legal, tax, risk, and compliance domains. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer - AI II, you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of product managers, UX designers, and engineers to design, build, and deliver AI-powered solutions. 

- Architect and implement advanced AI systems, including multi-component pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom AI agents with multi-step reasoning. 
 - Integrate AI models into production software through robust APIs and scalable data pipelines. 
 - Adapt AI models and techniques to specialized domains, tailoring solutions for expert systems in areas such as legal, tax, and compliance. 
 - Evaluate and prototype cutting-edge AI techniques to solve business challenges. 
 - Conduct proof-of-concept projects for new AI-driven features. 
 - Stay current with AI research and emerging technologies. 
 - Break down functional requirements into scalable technical specifications. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and facilitate technical discussions 
 - Contribute to MLOps and LLMOps practices, both in design and implementation. 
 - Act as a thought leader, sharing expertise in company-wide forums and representing the organization in emerging technology areas. 
 - Implement comprehensive testing frameworks and monitoring systems for AI model performance 
 - Ensure compliance with ethical AI principles and security standards. 
 - Conduct systems analysis and recommend operational improvements. 
 - Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, designers and product teams to translate AI capabilities into real-world applications. 
 - Optimize AI system performance considering factors like latency and resource usage. 
 - Support application feature enhancements through AI capabilities. 

About You

You are a fit for the position of Senior Software Engineer- AI if your background includes: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in software engineering; at least 2 years focused on AI/ML. 
 - Proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks (e. g. , PyTorch, TensorFlow). 
 - Strong understanding of machine learning principles, evaluation, and system design. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps and the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-powered software applications. 
 - Experience integrating AI models into production systems using APIs and data pipelines. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience with AI-driven systems, agent-based architectures, or AI APIs from providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. 
 - Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, or search-based AI. 
 - Domain knowledge in legal, tax, or accounting. 
 - A portfolio of projects demonstrating creativity and skill building solutions with LLMs. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. 

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. 

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters. com.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Alexa AI (AURORA)
data.description:
Description

Interested in building Amazon Alexa, Machine Learning, and Generative Artificial Intelligence? We're building products and services that power state of the art for Amazon customers. Come join us!

The Alexa AI org is looking for a Principal Engineer to join Aurora (Alexa Understanding, Runtime, ORchestration, and Applied Sciences) - Alexa's AI runtime backbone and horizontal intelligence organization. Aurora is a science and engineering organization that advances research while delivering robust, scalable runtime solutions. We revolutionize conversational AI through three core pillars: architecting mission-critical AI runtime systems, advancing science solutions that connect key conversational capabilities, and transforming how builders create at scale. 

This role sits at the intersection of latest AI research and large-scale production systems, where you will architect and deliver Pragmatic AI capabilities - AI that is not just technically impressive, but reliably useful, trustworthy, and accessible to real customers in their everyday lives. 

What makes this role unique

You will be building AI experiences that work across the full spectrum of human interaction - multi-modal (speech, text, image, video), multi-lingual (global locales with distinct linguistic and cultural requirements), and multi-model (orchestrating and routing across frontier and specialized AI models to optimize for accuracy, latency, and cost). Your systems will serve customers across a diverse range of endpoints and form factors, from voice-first devices to screen-based and mobile experiences. 

AURORA influences the full Alexa+ agent execution path - from reasoning to evaluation to runtime - enabling you to operate in a structure designed to simplify interactions between components and the people who build them, accelerate feature development, and raise the bar on both operations and innovation velocity. 

Infrastructure & Systems Complexity

- Design and own the architecture for AI capability routing and orchestration at massive scale, including intelligent query classification, model selection, and fallback strategies across heterogeneous AI back-ends
 - Drive latency optimization across globally distributed inference pipelines, including model serving infrastructure, caching strategies, and real-time performance monitoring to meet strict customer-facing SLAs
 - Build evaluation and quality assurance infrastructure - including offline test sets, live traffic sampling, model and prompt release gating, and automated regression frameworks - to maintain high accuracy and reliability as models and locales evolve
 - Architect systems that support rapid iteration and safe deployment of new AI capabilities across global regions, with robust rollback, experimentation, and observability tooling
 - Lead the design of core AI runtime platforms that power conversational experiences end-to-end, including speech processing, intent orchestration, and unconstrained interaction models that move beyond rigid turn-taking structures

Technology Vision

- Define the long-term technical strategy for how Alexa+ delivers high-quality, low-latency AI experiences to a global customer base, including the evolution of model integration patterns as the AI landscape rapidly changes
 - Shape AURORA's platform vision to empower internal and external engineers and scientists worldwide with modular, reusable platforms that accelerate innovation - while delivering accurate, responsive, and reliable conversational experiences to millions of end-users through operational excellence at scale
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for responsible AI deployment - ensuring accuracy, safety, and fairness are first-class properties of every capability shipped
 - Influence the broader Alexa AI platform roadmap by identifying capability gaps, proposing architectural investments, and partnering with applied science, product, and platform teams to close them
 - Drive science-to-production integration for specialized conversational AI capabilities, including reasoning, classification, and language understanding models

What we're looking for

- Deep expertise in distributed systems, ML inference infrastructure, or large-scale AI platform engineering
 - Demonstrated ability to define technical direction in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces with significant customer and business impact
 - Experience driving cross-functional alignment across science, engineering, and product organizations - particularly in environments where unified ownership across research, runtime, and evaluation accelerates delivery
 - A track record of delivering production AI systems that serve diverse, global customer populations
 - Passion for building AI that is genuinely useful and trustworthy for real people

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

- Lead the org's technical direction, making critical decisions on architecture, infrastructure, and systems design for optimal performance, scalability, resilience and access patterns. 
 - Drive innovation in architectures with GenAI models
 - Design and implement scalable solutions to org's technical initiatives
 - Architect and build large-scale, distributed systems that integrate complex datasets and support different access patterns. 
 - Mentor and inspire a team of skilled engineers and scientists, fostering technical and professional growth
 - Collaborate across Amazon to align technical vision and priorities, influencing decisions at senior levels. 
 - Define best practices for system architecture and engineering processes, maintaining high standards for software quality and operational excellence
 - Lead engineering efforts that directly enhance customer experiences and business outcomes through Alexa+ and GenAI powered services. 

About The Team

The AURORA (Alexa Understanding, Runtime, ORchestration, and Applied Sciences) org is part of Alexa AI VP and Devices and Services SVP organization. AURORA is Alexa's AI runtime backbone and horizontal intelligence organization - a science and engineering organization that advances research while delivering robust, scalable runtime solutions. Our vision is to revolutionize conversational AI through three core pillars: architecting mission-critical AI runtime systems, advancing science solutions that connect key conversational capabilities, and transforming how builders create at scale. We are the horizontal Science and Engineering team that empowers Domains and Horizontal CX owners with transformative solutions that enable rapid, efficient scaling. AURORA represents a sophisticated global organization that spans multiple international locations including the US (Boston, Seattle), Canada, Poland, and India. The team's core mission is to deliver Pragmatic AI capabilities - AI that is not just technically impressive, but reliably useful, trustworthy, and accessible to real customers in their everyday lives - by developing and maintaining AI runtime systems and services that enhance the performance of core LLM models across various endpoints, modalities, and locales. 

Basic Qualifications

- 12+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 8+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes. 
 - Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing, building & operating large scale, highly available, secure cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience with AI software systems including Agents. 
 - 15+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - 10+ years of highly scalable systems experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to manage, optimize, and scale our cloud infrastructure supporting high-traffic digital news platforms, APIs, internal applications, and video delivery systems. 

The role involves managing AWS infrastructure, improving production reliability, automating operational tasks, strengthening security, troubleshooting performance issues, and optimizing cloud costs. The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of infrastructure and working closely with development teams. 

Key Responsibilities

• AWS Infrastructure Management: Manage and optimize EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, CloudFront, Application Load Balancers, Route 53, VPC, IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, and related AWS services. 

• Production Operations: Monitor infrastructure health, troubleshoot application and server issues, investigate outages, and improve system availability and recovery. 

• Linux & Web Servers: Administer Ubuntu/Linux environments, Apache, Nginx, PHP-FPM, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, and server-level performance configurations. 

• CI/CD & Automation: Build and maintain deployment pipelines, automate repetitive operational tasks, and improve release reliability using scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools. 

• Infrastructure as Code: Work with Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or equivalent tools to make infrastructure deployments consistent and repeatable. 

• Cloud Security: Implement least-privilege IAM, security group policies, WAF rules, secure origin access, certificate management, logging, and vulnerability mitigation. 

• Performance & Scalability: Troubleshoot traffic spikes, database and application bottlenecks, CDN behavior, caching issues, and network-related performance problems. 

• Cost Optimization: Analyze AWS usage and billing, identify unnecessary expenditure, optimize compute and database resources, evaluate commitment plans, and implement cost-saving measures. 

• Monitoring & Incident Response: Set up actionable alerts, dashboards, centralized logs, health checks, and incident documentation using CloudWatch and other relevant tools. 

• Collaboration: Work with developers to improve application deployments, environment management, secrets handling, reliability, and production readiness. 

Required Skills

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and production workloads. 

• Good understanding of Linux administration, shell scripting, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancing, and networking. 

• Experience with EC2, S3, CloudFront, ALB, Route 53, VPC, IAM, RDS, and CloudWatch. 

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. 

• Proficiency in Bash or Python scripting for automation and troubleshooting. 

• Practical knowledge of Terraform, CloudFormation, or other infrastructure-as-code tools. 

• Experience troubleshooting production incidents, analyzing logs, and identifying root causes. 

• Understanding of cloud security, backups, disaster recovery, and high availability. 

• Ability to independently investigate issues, document solutions, and take ownership of assigned systems. 

Good to Have

• Docker and containerization; Kubernetes experience is a plus, but not mandatory. 

• Experience with AWS WAF, DDoS mitigation, CDN optimization, and high-traffic web applications. 

• Experience optimizing AWS costs and analyzing billing reports. 

• Knowledge of Redis/Valkey, MySQL/Aurora, PostgreSQL, and database connectivity issues. 

• Experience with media streaming, video delivery, caching, or large-scale content platforms. 

What We Expect

A practical engineer who can independently manage infrastructure, solve production problems, automate routine work, and continuously improve reliability, security, and cost efficiency. We value troubleshooting ability and real-world AWS experience over certifications alone. 

ABCPL is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equality for all who apply and who perform work for our organisation irrespective of gender, race, age, ethnic origin, educational, social and cultural background, marital status, pregnancy and maternity, religion or belief, disability or part-time / fixed-term work, or any other status protected by applicable law. We encourage the same standards from our recruitment and third-party suppliers taking into account the context of grade, job and location. We also allow for reasonable adjustments to support people with individual physical or mental health requirements

data.title: Applied Science Manager ,  Catalog Quality
data.description:
Description

The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines. 

As an Applied Science Manager on the team, you will lead a team of scientists to define and execute a transformative vision for holistic catalog quality measurement, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. Your team will own the science solutions for foundational quality detection frameworks, metadata validation and correction technologies, state-of-the-art algorithms to identify and resolve catalog anomalies (violative content, duplicative/low value content, misattributed tracks, incorrect metadata), and/or agentic AI solutions that help internal teams quickly surface and fix quality issues to ensure customers receive accurate, complete catalog experiences. 

Key job responsibilities

You independently manage a team of scientists. You identify the needs of your team and effectively grow, hire, and promote scientists to maintain a high-performing team. 

You have a broad understanding of scientific techniques, several of which may fall out of your specific job function. 

You define the strategic vision for your team. You establish a roadmap and successfully deliver scientific solutions that innovate on catalog quality detection, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. 

You define clear goals for your team and effectively prioritize, balancing short-term quality improvements and long-term innovation in catalog intelligence. 

You establish clear and effective metrics and scientific process to enforce consistent, high-quality artifact delivery and measurable catalog quality improvements. 

You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks. You know when to escalate. 

You communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences. You author strategic documentation for your team. You communicate issues and options with leaders in such a way that facilitates understanding and that leads to a decision. 

You work successfully with customers, leaders, and engineering teams. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues. 

About The Team

We are a team of scientists and MLEs focused on music catalog quality and metadata intelligence. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, NLP, CV, Gen AI, and data quality systems with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, content operations teams, and other scientists with expertise in music metadata, content classification, and building scalable modeling and software solutions that keep the Amazon Music catalog accurate, complete, and trustworthy. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
 - Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics
 - 6+ years of applied research experience
 - Knowledge of machine learning approaches and algorithms
 - 3+ years of programming in Java, C++, Python or related language experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
 - Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - 5+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
 - PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Release & Platform Engineering
data.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

About This Role

Release Engineering is OutSystems' is a Platform Engineering function. The group owns the platform's build and deployment orchestration, empowering product and development teams to focus on delivering business value. 

North Star: to empower teams to focus on delivering business value, by creating a zero-touch, secure, reliable, and cutting-edge technology platform capable of orchestrating full build and production deployment processes. 

The group is organized into small, autonomous squads. Release Engineers work across the full software delivery lifecycle - from CI/CD and containerization to cloud infrastructure and release governance - and act as a trusted point of support for engineering teams across the company via the group's dedicated support channels. 

This is a hybrid role: part software engineer, part cloud/infrastructure engineer, and part release governance owner. Expectations scale with seniority - from being autonomous in your own work, to leveraging your knowledge to help the team hit its goals, to guiding others and balancing technical, business, and operational needs. 

Key Responsibilities

- CI/CD ownership: Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows) that power build, test, and deployment automation across OutSystems services. 
 - Container & image management: Maintain and secure the Docker base-image catalogue (ingestion, versioning, deprecation, scanning) and manage AMI/machine-image pipelines (Packer, EC2 Image Builder) for build and CI infrastructure. 
 - Cloud infrastructure: Manage and provision cloud resources across AWS (ECR, EC2, IAM/OIDC) and Azure (ACR, Azure DevOps), using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform via Spacelift). 
 - Versioning & packaging: Own semantic versioning and package management practices (GitVersion, SemVer, NuGet feeds) to keep releases consistent and traceable. 
 - Release governance: Operate release governance processes, including RFC/CAB change management, deployment gating, and rollback procedures for production changes. 
 - Operational support: Staff the Release Engineering support rotation, triaging and resolving developer requests and incidents raised through dedicated support channels. 
 - Monitoring & metrics: Build and maintain observability into pipelines and deployments using tools such as Grafana, Power BI, and Kibana. 
 - Security & compliance: Uphold security and compliance standards (SOC 2 and FedRAMP controls, vulnerability scanning via Wiz/Snyk) across the release pipeline. 
 - Leadership & enablement: As seniority grows, guide other engineers, mentor teams adopting CI platform/release best practices, and represent Release Engineering's roadmap to stakeholders across the company. 

Skills You Need to Succeed

Skills below are ranked by how central they are to day-to-day Release Engineering work. Must-haves are used constantly and span nearly every squad; good-to-haves add significant value but are more specialized or team-specific and can often be developed on the job. 

Must Haves

- CI/CD pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions - designing, debugging, and maintaining build/release workflows. 
 - OCI Lifecycle: Development and management of the full life cycle of OCI artifacts. 
 - Cloud platform fundamentals: AWS (ECR, IAM/OIDC, EC2, RDS) and Azure (ACR, Azure Machines and DBs, Azure DevOps) core services. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Image Building: Proficiency in Terraform, CloudFormation for cloud provisioning and experience with Packer and EC2 Image Builder are must-have skills. 
 - Ownership under pressure: A strong sense of urgency, customer focus, and reliability as a support point for other engineering teams. 

Good To Haves

- Git workflows & semantic versioning: Branching strategies, tagging, GitVersion/SemVer discipline, and NuGet/npm feed mechanics. 
 - Observability & monitoring: Hands-on experience designing, building, and managing end-to-end monitoring and alerting systems to gain operational insights across pipelines and platform components (e. g. , using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Power BI, or Kibana). 
 - Security & vulnerability scanning: Working knowledge of security practices, vulnerability scanning, and compliance standards such as SOC 2 and FedRAMP. 
 - Release & change governance: RFC/CAB processes and staged (ring-based) promotion models for production changes. 
 - GitOps & Kubernetes: Flux-based GitOps repositories and Helm release troubleshooting across multiple environment rings. 
 - Cross-team mentoring & leadership: Experience mentoring other engineers or representing a team's roadmap to stakeholders

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform. 

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact. 

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration. 

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1, 700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees. 

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries- such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA-who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact. 

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports. 

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems. 

What do we have to offer you?

- A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don't just react to AI innovation-we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse. 
 - Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there. 
 - A global collective of world-class talent, where you'll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries-they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together. 

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive equal consideration regardless of race, origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building reliable, secure, and maintainable SaaS applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about software architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, engineering excellence, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. What Success Looks Like

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3. 7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

THE ROLE

We are hiring a senior quality engineer to own System Testing for Pure's FlashArray products. You will validate stability, resiliency, and performance under sustained, production‐like workloads, far beyond basic functional testing. 

You will design and run multi‐week, customer‐like scenarios that combine workloads, failovers, upgrades, and fault injections, and use the insights to influence architecture, design, and release decisions. 

This is a hands‐on, high‐impact role at the intersection of architecture, systems, and large‐scale testing-acting as a key quality gate before releases reach Pure's customers. 

What You'll Do

- Own System Testing strategy for releases Define System Testing strategy and test plans for major features and releases, focusing on stability, longevity, and end‐to‐end behavior, not just feature correctness. 
 - Design realistic, high‐value scenarios Build scenarios that mirror Pure customer environments: mixed workloads (block, file, object), long‐running IO, failovers, NDUs, hardware events, and background operations (replication, snapshots, quotas, etc. ), combining automation with targeted "tortures". 
 - Drive execution and triage on System Testing beds Own System Testing environments (arrays, initiators, OSes, accessories); keep them healthy, representative, and well‐instrumented. Monitor runs, triage failures quickly, separate infra issues from product bugs, and file high‐quality defects with clear workload, scale, logs, and impact-driving them to closure with Dev, PM, and Release teams. 
 - Be a key voice in release readiness Act as a primary quality gate for Release Candidates: define System Testing entry/exit criteria, sign‐off requirements, and soak expectations (for example, 24-48h+ without critical events). Summarize findings, risks, and recommendations and provide data‐driven input on go/no‐go decisions. 
 - Lead technically and mentor others Coach mid‐level and junior QE engineers (System Testing and system test) on test design, debugging, triage, and long‐running validation best practices. Refine System Testing processes, playbooks, and governance in partnership with engineering managers and technical leaders. 
 - Advance automation, tooling, and observability Partner with automation teams to extend System Testing workflows (workload drivers, torture suites, health checks, dashboards). Improve observability for System Testing: metrics, alerting, and automated log/triage helpers that make issues obvious and actionable. 

What You Bring

- 10+ years in software QA / system test / performance / reliability engineering, with significant experience in system‐level or longevity testing of complex distributed or storage systems. 
 - Strong understanding of storage concepts (block, file, snapshots, replication, HA/failover, NDUs) and their behavior under sustained load and fault conditions. 
 - Proven ability to design and execute long‐running scenarios that surface race conditions, memory leaks, scaling issues, and resiliency gaps. 
 - Strong debugging skills across host, network, storage system, logs, and metrics. 
 - Hands‐on experience with Linux and at least one of VMware, Windows, or Kubernetes. 
 - Solid experience with test automation (Python, shell), CI pipelines, and result dashboards. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross‐functional collaboration with Development, System Test, Release, and Support. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting complex findings and risk assessments to senior engineers and leaders. 
 - Directory services and identity: AD, LDAP, Kerberos, ID mapping - and how per-tenant auth domains explode the test matrix. 
 - Linux systems skills: shell, networking (VLANs, sub-interfaces, routing, ip, tc), service debugging, log and core analysis at scale

Nice‐to‐have

- Background in enterprise storage. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, capacity / longevity modeling, or customer‐data‐driven test design. 
 - Exposure to AI‐assisted test design or triage and interest in using new tools to improve coverage and efficiency. 
 - Experience working with different hypervisors, backup applications, databases, video streaming or healthcare applications/workloads is a plus
 - Prior multi-tenancy / RBAC / virtual-array isolation work in storage or cloud. 
 - Replication and DR: async/ADR, sync-rep, ActiveCluster or metro-cluster, split-brain and resync validation. 
 - QoS and quotatest background. 

What You Can Expect From Us

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

data.description:
Job Description: V&V Tech Lead

Job Summary: Caterpillar Trimble Control Technologies (CTCT) is a joint venture between Caterpillar and Trimble whose purpose is to transform the way heavy equipment customers shape the world with solutions that differentiate Caterpillar and Trimble. 

As a V&V Tech Lead for CTCT grade control platform products, you will own the full verification and validation (V&V) lifecycle for your dedicated product team. Reporting through the validation organization, your primary objective is to ensure products meet end-user quality expectations by strategically shifting validation activities earlier in the development cycle using an end-to-end methodology. You will plan, direct, and execute these activities by leveraging team expertise, world-class evaluation methods, and enterprise best practices. Ultimately, your leadership will ensure that technical and program risks are accurately identified and quantified, and that all validation test plans are thorough, well-documented, and efficiently executed. 

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Alignment

- Customer & Feature Alignment: Collaborate directly with Product Owners to deeply understand product features, customer expectations, and ensure solutions are intuitive and user-friendly. 
 - Cross-Functional Bridge: Act as the vital link between Product and Development teams, translating feature requirements into clear, robust acceptance criteria and actionable V&V goals. 
 - Lifecycle Ownership: Fully understand the functionality and application of platform products, following them through their full lifecycle-from early development up to product deprecation. 
 - Feature Risk Assessment: Proactively identify and assess risks associated with specific features and functionalities, participating heavily in the product risk assessment process to ensure "Testing with a Purpose. "

Process & V&V Strategy

- Test Pyramid Optimization: Drive the overarching test strategy by mapping product functionalities to the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Push testing to the bottom of the test pyramid for earlier detection. 
 - Multi-Layered Coverage: Architect a comprehensive validation strategy spanning from low-level Component Test Specification (CTS) coverage, through the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) layer, up to final physical machine testing. 
 - Software Performance Validation: Proactively strategize, monitor, and validate against critical software failure modes, specifically focusing on system performance metrics like network bus loads and CPU loads. 
 - V&V Best Practices: Establish and enforce standard V&V processes, including rigorous test plan and result reviews, effective machine-test time planning, design margin testing, and driving exploratory testing initiatives. 
 - Standardized Documentation & Training: Drive the use of Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R) and Risk-Based Thinking. Educate product teams and mentor validation engineers on key processes, venues, and validation expectations. 

Tools & Environments

- HIL Simulation & Execution: Execute and oversee complex Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation using tools such as dSPACE (harnessing, modeling, and execution), Vector tools, Simulink, and Stateflow. 
 - API & Automation Frameworks: Design, develop, and maintain automated API verification frameworks using modern testing tools like Playwright and Postman. 
 - Next-Gen QA & AI: Leverage AI agentic QA tools and extensive automation experience to drive continuous improvement, speed, and efficiency in the software validation pipeline. 
 - Innovative Machine Simulation: Innovate and develop new, effective ways to simulate complex machine setups in lab environments to supplement and enhance physical testing. 
 - Hands-On Machine & Environmental Testing: Apply hands-on machine testing experience to practically evaluate product performance in real-world environments, alongside executing environmental and performance lab tests. 

How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting. 

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate. 

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words-they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.

 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.

 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.

But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. data.title: Software QA Engineer - Physics AI
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge SimcenterTM portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing. 

We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities. 

In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results. 

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results. 
 - Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities. 
 - Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate. 
 - Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment. 

Qualifications

- 4-6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation. 
 - 1-3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products. 
 - Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results. 
 - Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications. 
 - Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data. 
 - Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing. 
 - Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing. 
 - Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT-payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more-in one unified workforce platform. 

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees' payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps-like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500)

About Role

Rippling's Tax Platform is one of only ~5 companies globally that owns the full tax calculation and filing stack. We process over $30 billion in annual payroll for 1 million+ employees-growing 50% year-over-year. data.title: Platform Head
data.description:
Role Purpose

The Platform Head is accountable for leading end-to-end vehicle platform delivery. The role owns platform-level target setting, system-level cascade, cross-functional execution, trade-off decisions, deviation governance and launch readiness, ensuring achievement of TCP targets across all projects within the platform. 

Role Snapshot

Platform Target Setting

System Target Cascade

Engineering Integration

Purchase & Supplier Closure

Manufacturing Readiness

Deviation Governance

Cross-functional Trade-offs

TCP Delivery Ownership

Launch Handover

Exp - 18-25yrs

- Platform Strategy and Target Setting
 - Set TCP targets across all projects within the platform on time. 
 - Interface with Product Planning and Marketing to define platform targets including FI requirements. 
 - Ensure engineering, supplier, manufacturing, investment and cost feasibility are incorporated at target-setting stage. 
 - Incorporate planning and resource availability inputs from Program Portfolio Management. 
 - Ensure overall vehicle-level TCP targets are translated into effective system-level targets through Platform Engineering Heads. 
 - Delivery of Set Targets
 - Own achievement of TCP targets for all platform projects with support from platform team members and delivery organizations. 
 - Drive disciplined execution across engineering, purchase, manufacturing, quality and program teams. 
 - Review program health, highlight risks early and enable timely resolution of delivery bottlenecks. 
 - Engineering Leadership
 - Ensure effective translation of system-level targets into SORs, specifications, drawings and engineering deliverables through PEHs. 
 - Ensure inter-system trade-offs taken by PEHs are aligned with overall platform requirements. 
 - Resolve system and function interface conflicts to protect platform-level performance, cost and timing commitments. 
 - Purchase and Supplier Integration
 - Ensure timely closure and minimum reopening of technical deliverables through PEHs. 
 - Guide techno-commercial deliverable decisions through Platform Purchase Heads. 
 - Ensure vendor panel and Vendor on Board decisions by Strategic Sourcing Unit are aligned with platform requirements. 
 - Manufacturing and Industrialization
 - Ensure timely closure and minimum reopening of manufacturing decisions including make-vs-buy, manufacturing strategy and localization. 
 - Drive in-house part development decisions and manufacturing-related PPAP closure through Plant Manufacturing Heads. 
 - Partner with manufacturing, quality and plant teams to ensure readiness for vehicle handover. 
 - Governance and Trade-off Decisions
 - Lead inter-function and inter-project trade-off decisions to minimize or eliminate deviations in overall platform TCP targets. 
 - Oversee inter-project fund transfers and utilization where required. 
 - Debottleneck and veto system or function interface conflicts where platform outcomes are impacted. 
 - Reallocate material cost and investment within predefined limits. 
 - Deviation Management
 - Decide acceptance or rejection of TCP deviations based on feasibility, impact and overall platform priorities. 
 - Drive escalation and closure of approvals for necessary vehicle-level TCP deviations during delivery phase. 
 - Ensure deviation decisions are documented and aligned with business, engineering and launch priorities. 
 - Launch Readiness
 - Own timely vehicle handover to Manufacturing and Marketing & Sales teams. 
 - Ensure completion of all required quality clearances, validation milestones and launch gate requirements. 
 - Support smooth transition from development to launch and initial post-launch stabilization. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

- Senior automotive leader with strong experience in vehicle platform development, product engineering or program delivery. 
 - Strong exposure to engineering integration, manufacturing readiness, supplier collaboration and target-cost management. 
 - Ability to lead cross-functional stakeholders and take structured trade-off decisions under timeline and cost pressure. 
 - Proven experience in driving vehicle programs from concept stage to launch readiness. 
 - Strong governance mindset with ability to manage risks, escalations, deviations and stakeholder alignment.

Job Description

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. 

Legacy infrastructure doesn't retire itself. Someone has to build the pipelines, rehearse the cutover, and carry the release into production and that's this seat. As a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer, you serve our application and infrastructure modernization work: you own build and release cycles for customer projects, land migrations from legacy hardware to AWS, and make deployments boring in the best sense of the word. 

Agents change what this job looks like day to day. Aedeon and automation handle the repetitive discovery, mapping, and validation work that used to eat engineer hours. That leaves you the parts that actually need a senior engineer: infrastructure architecture, risk tradeoffs, release judgment, and the operational standards the whole team ships against. You'll work client-facing, embedded with customer teams, and the delivery commitment is one you carry personally. 

What we are looking for?

What you will do?

- Automate infrastructure creation with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation - infrastructure as code, not tickets and toil.

 - Own the build and release cycle for customer projects, end to end.

 - Help hire culturally aligned engineers and mentor them as they grow.

data.description:
Job Description

Greetings From Rakuten Symphony!

Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry's pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan's newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global. 

To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business - from sales to engineering, support functions to product development. 

Let's build the future of mobile telecommunications together! About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30, 000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https: //global. rakuten. com/corp/. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Lead/Senior QA Engineer to design, architect and lead end-to-end integration testing and validation strategies across our OSS (Operations Support Systems) platforms. In this role, you will drive quality governance for complex multi-vendor ecosystems spanning Configuration Management (CM / Config Manager), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM), Performance Management (PM), Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Cloud Observability workflows. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in telecom service assurance, network synchronization parameters and a strong background in validating highly distributed data layers- specifically leveraging Graph databases for complex network topologies alongside Redis for high through put, real-time caching and data streaming pipelines. 

Key Responsibilities : 

• Integration & E2E Validation: Architect and execute comprehensive integration testing strategies across highly interconnected OSS environments, ensuring flawless structural data orchestration between northbound/southbound APIs, multi-vendor EMS/NMS and physical/virtual network elements. 

• Configuration Management (CM) Validation: Design and drive automated validation frameworks for CM engines to audit network configurations, track baseline drift, validate parameters (e. g. , cell parameters, routing tables) and verify automated network provisioning rollbacks. 

• Database & Network Topology Testing: Validate large-scale Graph databases (e. g. , Janus Graph)utilized for real-time network topology mapping, complex entity relationship queries and cross domain dependency modeling. 

• Performance & Cache Validation: Performance-test and validate distributed Redis DB implementations, ensuring active data structures, eviction policies, session states and high frequency pub/sub message queuing behave reliably under simulated peak telecom traffic loads. 

• Test Automation Frameworks: Design, build and scale custom test automation frameworks from scratch using Java and/or Python leveraging industry-standard tools such as Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, TestNG and REST Assured. 

• Observability & Streaming Validation: Validate cloud-native observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) along with high-throughput distributed messaging and event data logs streams orchestrated via Apache Kafka clusters. 

• AIOps & Closed-Loop Automation: Lead end-to-end quality validation initiatives for AI/ML-driven root cause analysis (RCA), predictive network analytics, anomaly detection algorithms and closedloop self-healing operational workflows. 

• CI/CD/CT Quality Gates: Embed robust automated quality validation gates, automated continuous regression suites and infrastructure tests seamlessly into DevOps deployment pipelines via Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD/CT engines. 

Required Technical Skills & Competencies: 

OSS & Telecom Domain Expertise

• Comprehensive understanding of the FCAPS structural framework and modern Telecom Service Assurance principles. 

• Hands-on validation experience covering Configuration Management (CM), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM) and Performance Management (PM) domains. 

• Expertise in parsing network topology nodes, checking delta configurations and validating multivendor EMS/NMS integration points. 

Database & Architectural Skills

• Strong querying and structural knowledge of Graph Databases along with graph query languages. 

• Deep understanding of Redis DB core architecture, including data structures, replication, eviction policies, clustering and Pub/Sub functionality. 

• Proven experience verifying log, search and transactional accuracy across distributed data backends including Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL and Cassandra. 

Automation Engineering

• Advanced proficiency using Python or Java to design test libraries, custom keywords and object oriented testing suites. 

• Robust hands-on framework experience with programmatic API Testing Tools (REST Assured, Postman) and message brokers (Kafka). 

• Solid architectural knowledge of containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes orchestration and Helm charts. 

Experience & Qualifications

• 5-10 years of direct, hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering, with a heavy emphasis on Telecom OSS and Service Assurance systems. 

• Proven background validating highly distributed distributed systems with demanding high availability, real-time telemetry and complex data persistence requirements. 

• Excellent analytical, root-cause isolation and communication skills to collaborate efficiently across multi-vendor technical domains. 

• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical engineering field. 

Rakuten Shugi Principles: 

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. 

We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success. 

• Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen. 

• Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best. 

• Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory. 

• Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile. 

• Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.
