data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Castrol is one of the world's leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company's commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol. 

Job Description

About the Team: 

The Manager - Engineering (Electrical & Instrumentation) reports to the Senior Manager - Engineering & Projects and provides functional leadership for plant instrumentation, automation, control systems and associated electrical systems. 

You will be accountable for PLC/SCADA reliability, filling-line controls, field instrumentation, calibration, interlocks, control panels and automation projects, while ensuring essential electrical power reliability and statutory compliance. 

You will work across Production, HSSE, Quality, IT/OT, Procurement, contractors and the Mechanical Engineering Manager to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective operations. 

Key Tasks: 

Own reliability and lifecycle performance of PLCs, SCADA, HMIs, filling-line controls, industrial networks, safety interlocks and control panels. 

- Lead maintenance and troubleshooting of sensors, encoders, photoelectric and proximity devices, load cells, weighing systems, flow meters, transmitters, control valves, actuators, printers, labelers and vision interfaces. 
 - Plan preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to improve asset availability, MTBF and MTTR. 
 - Ensure calibration, functional testing and traceability of instruments, weighing systems, alarms, trips and protective devices. 
 - Maintain controlled PLC/SCADA programs, backups, access controls, software revisions, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm/interlock lists, loop drawings and network architecture. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and defect elimination for recurring filling-line, PLC, instrumentation and control-system failures. 
 - Deliver E&I scope for CAPEX and minor projects from concept, specification and technical bid evaluation through FAT/SAT, commissioning, performance verification and handover. 
 - Drive automation, digitization, data acquisition, predictive maintenance and process-control improvements with measurable business value. 
 - Manage critical spares, obsolescence risks, AMCs, vendors, contractors and assigned expenditure within approved budgets. 
 - Coach engineers and technicians in PLC diagnostics, calibration, filling-line controls, safe isolation and structured troubleshooting. 
 - Ensure essential electrical systems including HT/LT distribution, MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, earthing and protection remain safe, reliable and compliant. 

Responsible for HSSE in Engineering (both people and equipment) activities and compliance to Castrol HSSE standards. 

The person with be responsible as Contractor Assurance Manager (CAM) to manage the contractors at site for HSSE & Legal requirements for contract. 

The person will be responsible for Castrol Engineering Standards specifically Integrity Management Standards application for Engineering activities at site. 

Experience Required: 

Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent recognized engineering qualification. 

- Preferably 8-10 years of instrumentation, automation, maintenance and project experience in manufacturing or process industries, including team and contractor responsibility. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, I/O systems, SCADA, HMI, industrial communication networks, control loops, alarms, trips and interlocks. 
 - Hands-on experience with filling-line automation, sensors, encoders, load cells, weighing/filling systems, control valves, actuators, printers and labellers. 
 - Knowledge of Allen-Bradley PLC and SCADA platforms is an added advantage. 
 - Experience in calibration, loop checking, FAT/SAT, commissioning, functional testing, performance testing and as-built documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, protection, earthing and electrical drawings. 
 - Understanding of OT lifecycle controls including backups, access control, change management, recovery planning and cybersecurity coordination. 
 - Good project management, contractor management, communication, planning and commercial-judgement skills; proficiency in MS Project and MS Office is desirable. 

Privacy

The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy. response@castrol. com. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e. g. , accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc. ). 

If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.

data.title: SDET, Portworx
data.description:

SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE. . . 

We're in an unbelievably exciting area of tech, fundamentally reshaping the cloud-native, modern virtualization, and AI infrastructure landscape. Here, you'll lead with innovative thinking, grow alongside us, and work with some of the smartest minds in the industry. 

We're looking for engineers passionate about system testing, distributed systems, Kubernetes, storage, modern virtualization, AI workloads, and automation. You'll work on complex, real-world scenarios involving HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, scalability, and failure testing across large-scale Kubernetes environments. 

As enterprises modernize their infrastructure, containers, virtual machines, and AI/ML workloads are increasingly converging on Kubernetes. From traditional enterprise applications and VMs to GPU-accelerated AI training, inference, and data-intensive workloads, Kubernetes is rapidly becoming the common platform for running the next generation of applications. 

This role gives you the opportunity to test and influence how Portworx delivers enterprise-grade storage, data protection, availability, and resiliency across these workloads-including containerized applications, KubeVirt/OpenShift Virtualization VMs, and demanding AI/ML workloads running on Kubernetes. 

What You Will Do

- Own system-level quality for Portworx Enterprise across Kubernetes, storage, and modern virtualization environments. 
 - Develop comprehensive test plans, test strategies, and automation for multiple concurrent product and feature releases. 
 - Build and maintain scalable automation test suites, with a strong focus on Golang-based automation and code quality. 
 - Drive validation of HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, upgrades, scale, and failure scenarios in large-scale Kubernetes environments. 
 - Identify functional and automation coverage gaps, assess risks early, and drive improvements to overall product quality. 
 - Collaborate with development, QE, and architecture teams across geographies to troubleshoot complex system-level issues and ensure timely releases. 
 - Ensure CI/CD pipelines and automation infrastructure effectively execute the required functional, regression and system test strategies. 
 - WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BRING TO THIS ROLE: 
 - Strong SDET mindset - engineering for quality and ability to design complex distributed system test failure scenarios
 - Ability to lead by example and take end-to-end ownership of product quality. 
 - Strong programming and automation skills, preferably Golang, with Python experience also valuable. 
 - Strong debugging skills across Kubernetes, Linux, storage, virtualization . 
 - Ability to work on multiple concurrent product/feature releases. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams. 
 - Ability to mentor engineers, conduct automation/code reviews. 
Minimum Qualifications

- BS/MS with 8+ years of software testing/SDET experience, preferably involving distributed systems, infrastructure, storage, or virtualization. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Kubernetes application lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with VMWare/HyperV , KubeVirt or Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization is highly desirable. 
 - Strong background in enterprise storage (file/block/Object) and Kubernetes persistent storage/CSI. 
 - Strong Golang and/or Python programming skills, with Golang preferred. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes platforms such as OpenShift, EKS, AKS, or GKE is a plus. 
 - Working experience with public clouds such as AWS. , Azure and Google Cloud is preferable. 
 - Experience with tools such as Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, X-ray is preferable. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

data.title: SDE II - DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Auriga is looking for a DevOps / SRE Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and operational health of our production infrastructure. He will manage infrastructure end-to-end through code, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, respond to production incidents as part of an on-call rotation, and partner with engineering teams to embed reliability into every stage of our software delivery lifecycle. This is a hands-on ownership role - not a support or ticket-queue position. 

Key Responsibilities

On-Call & Incident Management

- Participate/ lead production incident triage, mitigation, and resolution. 
 - Define and track SLIs / SLOs and manage error budgets for critical services. 
 - Author blameless postmortems with root cause analysis and corrective action plans for all significant incidents. 
 - Build and maintain runbooks and incident response playbooks. 

Infrastructure as Code & Infra Management

- Own the full infrastructure lifecycle using Terraform exclusively - no manual console provisioning in production. 
 - Design modular Terraform modules for cloud resources: compute, networking, storage, IAM, DNS, databases. 
 - Manage environment parity (dev / staging / prod), drift detection, and immutable infrastructure principles. 
 - Use Ansible or equivalent for configuration management, patch management, and compliance at scale. 
 - Plan and execute capacity planning, scaling, and cost optimization initiatives. 

Kubernetes & Containers

- Provision, configure, upgrade, and maintain production Kubernetes clusters (EKS / GKE / AKS). 
 - Manage Helm charts, ArgoCD / FluxCD GitOps workflows, RBAC, network policies, and secrets management. 
 - Troubleshoot pod failures, resource constraints, scheduling issues, and node-level problems. 

CI/CD & Release Engineering

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins) with quality gates and automated rollback. 
 - Implement progressive delivery: blue-green, canary deployments, and feature flags. 
 - Conduct production readiness reviews before new service go-lives. 

Observability & Monitoring

- Implement and manage full-stack observability: metrics (Prometheus + Grafana), logs (Loki), traces (OpenTelemetry / Jaeger). 
 - Build SLO-driven alerting and dashboards covering the four golden signals; route via PagerDuty / OpsGenie. 

Linux, Networking & Security

- Administer production Linux systems (Ubuntu / RHEL / CentOS): performance tuning, hardening, troubleshooting. 
 - Manage VPCs, subnets, security groups, VPNs, load balancers, Nginx / HAProxy, CDNs, and SSL/TLS certificates. 
 - Manage secrets with Vault / AWS Secrets Manager; integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps). 

Database & Application Operations

- Manage operational health, backups, replication, and failover for MySQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Memcached. 
 - Support deployments for both monolithic and microservices architectures; validate DR procedures regularly. 

Requirements

- 3-5 years of hands-on production DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering experience. 
 - Proven on-call experience: incident ownership, RCA, and postmortem authorship in a real production environment. 
 - Strong Terraform proficiency: writing and maintaining modules, managing state, and working in team IaC workflow. 
 - Solid Linux administration skills at the OS level (not just application-layer). 
 - Kubernetes production experience: cluster admin, workload management, debugging, RBAC, network policies. 
 - CI/CD pipeline ownership experience (built pipelines from scratch, not just run them). 
 - Hands-on Prometheus + Grafana: alert rule design and dashboard creation. 
 - Python and/or Bash scripting for production automation. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS (primary), GCP, or Azure - able to architect and troubleshoot independently. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, VPCs, load balancers, firewalls. 

Preferred Qualifications

- CKA / CKAD, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification. 
 - GitOps experience with ArgoCD or FluxCD in production. 
 - Service mesh experience: Istio or Linkerd. 
 - Message queue / streaming experience: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS / SNS. 
 - Chaos engineering or DR game day experience. 
 - HashiCorp Vault or cloud-native secrets management experience. 
 - Exposure to FinOps, cost visibility tooling, and cloud cost optimisation. 

Preferred Technical Skill Set

- Cloud: AWS (primary) | GCP / Azure
 - IaC & Config: Terraform, Ansible
 - Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD / FluxCD
 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, PagerDuty / OpsGenie
 - Scripting: Python, Bash, Go
 - Databases: MySQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Memcached
 - Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS (preferred)
 - Networking: Nginx, HAProxy, CloudFront, Cloudflare, Vault, WAF
 - Workflow: Argo Workflows

data.title: Agentic AI Architect — Backend Platforms and Voice Agents
data.description:
Role Overview

We are hiring a hands-on architect to design the backend foundations and the shared agent platform

that every team builds products on. You will own architecture across products and client deployments

- service boundaries, data flows, agent execution, real-time voice infrastructure and operational

reliability - and consolidate the systems different teams use today into one platform that is faster and

safer to build on. You will set the engineering practices the whole company follows, and partner with

senior AI engineers on solution delivery and with inference engineers on model-serving interfaces. 

Key Responsibilities

Backend and distributed systems

- Design service boundaries, APIs, data models, databases, caching and event-driven integrations

that scale to [thousands] of concurrent agent sessions. 

- Make consistency, partitioning and replication trade-offs explicit, and design for partial failure

with timeouts, backpressure, circuit breakers and graceful degradation. 

- Scale real-time voice infrastructure: session routing, media servers, and horizontal scaling of

WebSocket, SIP and WebRTC connections. 

- Set reliability targets (SLOs), latency and cost budgets, and plan capacity across cloud and on-

premises deployments. 

- Manage all infrastructure as code with GitOps workflows, so every environment is reproducible, 

reviewed and auditable. 

- Track model, speech and infrastructure cost per team, product and client, and set up chargeback

so owners see and control their spend. 

Agent platform

- Build a shared agent platform: agent runtime, tool registry, enterprise connectors, memory and

retrieval services, and a model gateway with routing, fallbacks, rate limits and caching. 

- Architect durable agent execution with persisted state, checkpoints, retries, idempotency, 

timeouts, compensation for failed actions and human approval points. 

- Enforce tenant isolation, authentication, authorisation, tool permissions and audit trails at the

platform level, so every product inherits them. 

- Make the platform self-serve: SDKs, templates and documentation that let a team launch a new

voice or chat agent in days, not weeks. 

- Run an internal developer portal (such as Backstage) as the single place to find services, 

connectors, templates, owners and docs. 

- Provide shared evaluation, tracing and monitoring services that every agent uses by default. 
 - Build a data platform for call and agent analytics: transcripts, outcomes, tool usage and latency, 

feeding product insights, evals and client reporting. 

Consolidation And Company-wide Practices

- Audit existing agent and voice stacks, and consolidate duplicate pipelines, connectors and

prompt setups onto the platform with migration plans that keep live clients running. 

- Define reference architectures and golden paths for common use cases, such as voice agents, 

chat agents and document workflows. 

- Set engineering standards: architecture decision records, design reviews, API guidelines, testing

and eval requirements, release controls and incident management. 

- Maintain a tech radar of approved, trial and retired tools, and lead build-versus-buy decisions

for agent frameworks, model providers, speech vendors and infrastructure. 

Security, governance and resilience

- Design systems to meet security and compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and India's

DPDP Act, and support audits with evidence from the platform. 

- Set AI governance policy: red-teaming of agents before launch, model risk reviews, prompt-

injection defences and rules for which data each model may see. 

- Define disaster recovery targets (RPO and RTO), run regular recovery drills and use chaos testing

to prove agents and voice sessions survive failures. 

Technical leadership

- Translate business workflows into technical designs, build reference implementations and

review critical code. 

- Guide engineering teams through architectural decisions, and mentor senior engineers to make

sound design choices on their own. 

- Manage a team of [N] engineers: set goals, run one-on-ones and performance reviews, and

support their career growth. 

- Act as solution architect in pre-sales: scope client requirements, design proposed solutions, 

estimate effort and present the architecture to client technical teams. 

- Align product, infrastructure, inference and delivery teams around one implementable

architecture, and represent it to enterprise clients. 

Required Qualifications And Skills

- Strong backend and distributed-systems experience, including ownership of production

architecture and its evolution under growing scale. 

- Hands-on Python expertise and deep knowledge of APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, queues, 

caching, concurrency and consistency trade-offs. 

- Practical experience delivering LLM agents with tool integrations, stateful orchestration, 

retrieval and failure handling. 

- Understanding of real-time, low-latency systems such as voice or streaming, including

backpressure and connection scaling. 

- Experience building internal platforms or shared services adopted by multiple teams. 
 - A track record of leading system consolidations or architectural migrations without disrupting

production. 

- Ability to design for partial failures, long-running tasks and secure multi-tenant execution, 

supported by automated tests, tracing and deployment practices. 

- Ability to write clear design documents, explain trade-offs and align product, infrastructure and

delivery teams. 

- Experience managing engineers, and working directly with clients in pre-sales or solution design. 
 - A relevant technical degree or equivalent experience. 

Preferred Experience

- Workflow engines and agent orchestration frameworks such as Temporal or LangGraph, model

gateways, and vector search. 

- Additional backend languages such as Go or Java. 
 - Kubernetes, service meshes and infrastructure as code. 
 - Production voice systems at scale: SIP, media servers, LiveKit or similar. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS platforms and enterprise deployments with restricted infrastructure. 
 - Model-serving interfaces such as vLLM or Triton, and working with inference teams on

throughput and cost. 

- Multimodal agents that combine voice, text and vision. 

Success in the role

Success means one reliable platform that every team builds on, with clear architectural decisions and

measurable control of task completion, latency and cost. In your first year, that looks like: 

- Platform adoption: most new agents are built on the shared platform and found through the

developer portal, and the time to launch a new agent drops from weeks to days. 

- Consolidation: duplicate pipelines and connectors are retired, with no disruption to live clients. 
 - Scale and reliability: SLOs hold as traffic grows, agent runs recover cleanly from partial failures, 

and recovery drills meet their targets. 

- Cost control: every team and client can see its model and infrastructure spend, and per-task

cost stays within budget. 

- Security and governance: compliance audits pass, and every agent is red-teamed and reviewed

before launch. 

- Company-wide practices: design reviews, decision records, eval gates and release controls are

used across teams. 

- Team and clients: your team grows in skill and ownership, and clients sign off on architectures

you designed in pre-sales.

data.title: Sr. Tech Lead, Prod Dev (RAN, AI-Assisted RCA, Design & Development)
data.description:
Parallel Wireless is transforming its Feature-Validation & Stability organization into a single Prod-Dev team - in the AI era there is no longer a separate "development" vs "validation" team. We are building a group of strong System Engineers who own a problem end to end: understand the complete product behavior, find the actual root cause, and contribute directly to the fix - accelerated by Claude / AI-assisted engineering. 

This is a pro-development, system-level problem-solving role. You will take a field or test issue and drive it the whole way: 

Issue → Reproduction → Cross-layer analysis → RCA → Code investigation → Fix → Validation

You will not stop at "which component failed. " You will name the root cause, prove it, and fix it. 

What You Will Do

- Deep, cross-layer RCA on field and lab issues that span multiple modules, correlating evidence across the full stack: 

→ UE logs

- PHY logs
 - DU / MAC / SCH logs
 - CU / L3 logs
 - Core logs
 - Platform logs
 - RRH logs
 - System logs
 - field issues across EMS / system monitoring. 
 - Reproduce field/customer issues in the lab on production-like (Friendly-Operator) setups. 
 - Investigate code and deliver bug fixes - own the fix through to validation, not just the analysis note. 
 - Field-issue investigation with direct customer / field involvement; feed learnings back into design, regression and stability. 
 - Feature development driven by design/framework gaps and customer-driven requirements. 
 - Use AI tools (Claude / AI-assisted engineering) to accelerate code understanding, log analysis, debugging, correlation and RCA - especially on multi-module problems. 
 - Identify scenarios, improve monitoring/validation coverage, and raise the quality bar before issues reach the field. 

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

- Strong software engineering in C / C++ (and Python for tooling/automation) with the ability to read and fix production RAN stack code. 
 - Solid wireless/telecom system understanding across 2G / 4G LTE / 5G NSA / SA - RRC, S1AP/NGAP, X2/Xn, PDCP/RLC/MAC scheduling, PHY/FAPI, GTP-U, and the core/platform interfaces. 
 - Proven debugging & RCA skills: coredumps/gdb, log/PCAP analysis, memory/crash triage, KPI/counter reasoning. 
 - A system mindset - comfortable reasoning across UE ↔ RAN ↔ Core ↔ Platform ↔ EMS rather than a single layer. 
 - Willingness and aptitude to work with AI tools as a daily engineering accelerator. 
 - Ownership attitude: drives Issue → Fix → Validation to closure. 
 - Good to have
 - O-RAN / disaggregated CU-DU, fronthaul (split 7. 2), PTP/timing, IPsec/transport exposure. 
 - Experience with EMS / OSS, Kibana/KPI monitoring, PM counters. 
 - Prior field / customer-facing deployment or NPI experience. 
 - Scrum / Agile delivery experience

Addional details

What Success Looks Like

You turn an opaque field escape into a named, proven root cause and a merged fix. 

Your RCA is accurate - the cause you name is the one the fix confirms (evidence-cited, instrumented, graded). 

You reduce field escapes and the RCA load on the core development team. 

You grow into a complete-product System Engineer who can design, reproduce, debug and fix across any layer. 

Why join

You will work at the center of PW's Prod-Dev transformation - a "Friendly customer in the lab" operating model - using cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering to solve real, multi-layer telecom problems end to end, with direct customer impact and genuine system ownership. 

Academic Qualification

Relevant Degree in Bachelor of Engineering in computer science, Electronics , Information Technology or relevant field from reputed college/ University

data.title: Team Lead - Vessel Accounting
data.description:
Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex. 

We are looking for a passionate and result oriented Team Lead - Vessel Accounting. 

This position will be working with Wilhelmsen Ship Management, a comprehensive global maritime group providing over half of the merchant fleet with essential products and services, along with supplying crew and technical management to the largest and most complex vessels ever to sail. With a pool of more than 14, 000 seafarers and over 900 shore-based employees all over the world, Wilhelmsen Ship Management is one of world's largest third-party ship managers with a portfolio of more than 450 vessels and counting. 

Purpose: 
The Team Lead - Vessel Reporting is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day vessel reporting activities, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting, maintaining compliance with management agreements and reporting requirements, and leading a team of vessel reporting executives. The role acts as the key liaison between Vessel Accounting, Fleet Management Offices, Vessel Managers, Owners, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient reporting operations and continuous process improvements. 

Main responsibilities: 
Operational Management

- Lead and supervise the Vessel Reporting team to ensure delivery of accurate and timely financial reports. 
 - Review monthly and quarterly vessel management accounts, cash flow statements, SOA schedules, and supplementary reports. 
 - Ensure compliance with owner reporting requirements, management agreements, and internal procedures. 
 - Monitor reporting timelines and ensure all deliverables are submitted within agreed deadlines. 
 - Support vessel reporting activities across multiple management offices and client portfolios. 
Financial Reporting & Analysis

- Review vessel operating results and perform variance analysis against budget and prior periods. 
 - Analyze vessel expenditures, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations. 
 - Review cash flow forecasts and funding requirements. 
 - Monitor outstanding receivables, payables, and owner account balances. 
 - Provide management insights and recommendations based on vessel financial performance. 
Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary contact for Vessel Managers, Fleet Managers, Owners, and Regional Finance Teams. 
 - Respond to client queries relating to vessel management accounts and financial reports. 
 - Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Treasury, Vessel Accounting, Procurement, and Technical Management teams for issue resolution. 
 - Present financial reporting outcomes and analysis during stakeholder meetings when required. 
Process Improvement & Controls

- Identify opportunities for process standardization and automation. 
 - Strengthen internal controls to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency. 
 - Lead implementation of new reporting requirements and system enhancements. 
 - Develop and maintain SOPs, reporting templates, and knowledge management documentation. 
 - Ensure adherence to company policies, audit requirements, and compliance standards. 
Quality Assurance

- Perform final review of key vessel reports before submission. 
 - Monitor reporting quality through regular audits and KPI tracking. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce reporting errors and improve turnaround times. 
Qualifications: 
Mandatory requirements

- Degree in Accounting, Finance, Banking and/or Commerce. 
 - Minimum 5 years working experience in a related field. 
 - Have experience in managing others. 
 - Experience managing reporting for multiple vessel portfolios and stakeholders. 
 - undefined
Additional preferences

- Strong understanding of vessel management accounting principles. 
 - Knowledge of vessel operating expenses (OPEX), CAPEX, dry-docking, and owner reporting. 
 - Experience with SAP and vessel management systems. 
 - Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis capabilities. 
 - Strong reporting and presentation skills. 
Competency Requirement: 

- Excellent leadership and people management skills. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
 - Analytical mindset with attention to detail. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines. 
 - Continuous improvement orientation.

data.description:
About Navi

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale. 

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, 

Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold - building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience. 

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India's fastest-growing UPI platforms. 

About the Team

The Debt Management team is responsible for ensuring timely and efficient recovery of outstanding dues from customers. Their role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing collection strategies across various channels to minimize delinquencies and improve cash flow. The team focuses on balancing customer experience with recovery effectiveness by using data-driven insights, segmentation, and targeted action plans. 

What You'll Own

- Managing a team of ground Field Executives for effective & efficient recovery of overdue amounts from default customers through planned visits to customer addresses
 - Ensure proper planning for effective recovery through strong execution; guide and motivate the field team to reach monthly targets
 - Overview of day-to-day agent activities including regular performance monitoring, in-person visits for high-value accounts, and regular & timely follow-ups with customers

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale, and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you, 

Navi could be the place for you!

The Assistant Manager, Accounts Payable will be based in Chennai, India. In this position, you will report to the Senior Manager, Finance. This is an operations and people leadership role. The Assistant Manager partners with Procurement, Logistics, Treasury, AP Accounting, and other Finance teams to resolve issues, protect controls, and improve the end-to-end P2P experience across supported entities and regions. 

Watch "Culture is our Passion" to learn more about us

- Passionate drive to innovate and create
 - Integrity to the core
 - Enthusiastic customer focus
 - Consistent interactive teamwork
 - Desire for continuous improvement and top performance. 

Here Is a Glimpse Of What You Will Do

- Team leadership and development. Lead, coach, and support AP team members; set daily and period-end priorities; balance workloads; monitor quality and productivity; provide feedback; and build cross-training, accountability, and succession coverage. 
 - Invoice processing and workflow. Oversee timely and accurate processing of PO and non-PO invoices, including validation, coding, matching, approval routing, and resolution of holds, missing information, and other exceptions. 
 - Supplier service and escalations. Oversee timely responses to supplier inquiries, statement reconciliations, payment status requests, and escalated issues; coordinate with internal requestors and Procurement to resolve root causes. 
 - SLA and KPI management. Track and report measures such as invoice cycle time, processing accuracy, backlog and aging, exception resolution, payment timeliness, and close deliverables. Review trends with the team and implement action plans for gaps. 
 - Controls and compliance. Ensure adherence to AP policies, approval matrices, vendor onboarding and bank-detail controls, payment controls, documentation standards, and applicable SOX and audit requirements. Escalate control exceptions promptly. 
 - Month-end and accounting partnership. Coordinate AP close activities, cutoffs, required accrual inputs, unresolved invoice and receipt issues, and supporting schedules. Partner with AP Accounting to resolve reconciliation items, GRNI matters, Intercompany reconciliations and adjustments with clear ownership and support. 
 - Process improvement and systems. Identify opportunities to reduce rework, improve cycle time, and strengthen the supplier and employee experience. Support ERP, workflows, OCR, and automation enhancements through requirements, testing, rollout, and user adoption. 
 - Cross-functional P2P partnership. Work with Procurement, Logistics, Treasury, General Accounting, business requestors, and regional teams to resolve bottlenecks, clarify ownership, and improve end-to-end procure-to-pay processes. 
 - Global service coordination. Coordinate work across supported entities and time zones, maintain consistent processes, ensure clear handoffs, coverage, and communication for global AP activities. 

Here Is Some Of What You Will Need (required)

- Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - (8-10) years of experience in Accounts Payable or Procure-to-Pay operations with accounting background. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or coaching team members; experience managing workloads and service delivery is required. 
 - Strong knowledge of invoice-to-pay processes, PO and non-PO workflows, matching, payment controls, supplier account support, and month-end AP activities. 
 - Experience monitoring operational SLAs or KPIs and using performance data to improve timeliness, accuracy, and service quality. 
 - Working knowledge of internal controls, approval workflows, segregation of duties, and audit documentation. 
 - Experience with an ERP platform such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent; strong Excel skills and familiarity with workflow or reporting tools. 
 - Clear English communication skills and the ability to collaborate across regions and time zones
 - Required to work in US-hours mainly. 

Here Are a Few Of Our Preferred Experiences

- Working knowledge of internal controls, approval workflows, segregation of duties, and audit documentation. 
 - Experience with an ERP platform such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent; strong Excel skills and familiarity with workflow or reporting tools

Designation : Team Lead - AI & Data Science

Required Experience: 5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership. 

Job Description:   

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement. 

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production. 

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  

1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria. 

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs. 

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach. 

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications. 

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement. 

2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership-

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring. 

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern. 

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices. 

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently. 

3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows-

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate. 

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation. 

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior. 

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed. 

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops. 

4. Applied machine learning and data science-

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization. 

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly. 

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data. 

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role. 

5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps-

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation. 

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture. 

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover. 

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable. 

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities. 

6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment-

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support. 

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers. 

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts. 

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI-

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards. 

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk. 

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks. 

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

Required Qualifications and experience: 

                      

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                         

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience. 

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes. 

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations. 

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals. 

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations. 

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred. 

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support. 

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope. 

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills. 

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider. 

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline. 

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization. 

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable. 

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments.

This Team Is a Good Fit For You If

- You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in having a firsthand impact on Amazon's global customer base
 - You truly care about the business results of what you build, not just the elegance of the technology

Silk is Amazon's Chromium-based web browser built for Fire TV and multimodal devices, optimized for the unique constraints of embedded environments to deliver fast, reliable web experiences on television screens and Echo Show devices. #RunwiththePack

At Arctic Wolf, we're on a mission to end cyber risk. 

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity. 

More than 3, 000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference. 

We're constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level. 

About The Position

Job Description

We're looking for a Developer 3 to be part of making this happen. 

About The Role

You'll work on the software stack that runs inside Arctic Wolf's network sensors - physical appliances and

virtual sensors deployed across customer environments. The team owns everything from the on-sensor Go

services and Python tooling, to the AWS infrastructure that manages, monitors, and upgrades sensors at

scale. You'll write code that ships inside customer networks, runs 24/7 without human intervention, and

needs to be correct the first time. 

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain on-sensor Go and Python services - daemons, config managers, upgrade

pipelines, and tunneling infrastructure

- Own AWS infrastructure used for sensor management: ECS services, CloudFormation stacks, EC2

instances, S3 artifact pipelines, and CloudWatch observability

- Improve and extend the CI/CD platform: Jenkins pipelines, Docker build environments, Robot

Framework cell tests that spin up virtual sensors on AWS/Azure/VMware and validate end-to-end

behaviour

- Debug hard problems: kernel networking (eBPF/XDP, Suricata, iptables), multi-platform VM

orchestration, Ansible-based sensor provisioning, and production incidents traced through

CloudWatch Logs Insights

- Contribute to sensor upgrade and deployment automation (Ansible, Debian packaging, 

manifest-driven rollouts)

- Work across the full stack - from BPF maps pinned on a sensor's kernel to ECS services in AWS

serving REST APIs to the portal

What We're Looking For

- 3-5 years of professional software development experience
 - Strong AWS hands-on experience: EC2, ECS (Fargate + EC2 launch types), S3, CloudWatch (Logs, 

Metrics, Alarms), CloudFormation or CDK, IAM

- Proficiency in Python - writing production services, CLI tooling, and test automation (Robot

Framework or pytest)

- Comfort with Linux systems programming: systemd, networking (iptables, interfaces, routing), 

Debian packaging, shell scripting

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and Docker-based build

environments

- Strong debugging skills - able to trace a production problem from a CloudWatch log through to a

root cause in code

Nice to Have

- Ansible for fleet configuration and provisioning
 - Networking depth: VLANs, SPAN/TAP modes, DHCP, tunneling protocols (FRP, WireGuard)
 - eBPF/XDP or kernel networking (Suricata, nmap, packet capture)
 - Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or Azure for infrastructure testing
 - Familiarity with sensor/appliance software or embedded Linux

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that-by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk- we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. 

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All Wolves Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including

Equity for all employees

Flexible time off and paid volunteer days

RRSP and 401k match

Training and career development programs

Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services

Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services

Fertility support and paid parental leave

On-Camera Policy

Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. 

We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our

entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf. com. 

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees 
 - 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
 - Training and career development programs 
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
 - A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

Security Requirements

All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

data.description:
Job Description: AWS MDM Technical Lead

Experience: 8+ years

Role: Technical Lead - AWS Cloud & Master Data Management

Domain: Customer Master Data Management (MDM) and Enterprise Data Integration

About the Project

We are developing an AWS-based Master Data Management (MDM) hub to consolidate, cleanse, standardize, and manage customer data from multiple CRM systems. 

The solution will establish trusted golden customer records, support AI-assisted customer matching, orchestrate data processing and exception workflows, and integrate with Oracle Fusion. It will also include a web-based user interface that enables business users to review and manually resolve MDM exceptions. 

We are looking for an experienced AWS Technical Lead to drive architecture implementation, engineering execution, and end-to-end technical delivery. 

Role Overview

The AWS MDM Technical Lead will lead a cross-functional Agile engineering team comprising data engineers, full-stack developers, and DevOps engineers. 

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in AWS cloud-native application development, Python, SQL, distributed systems, and enterprise data integration, along with proven technical leadership and delivery experience. 

The successful candidate will own technical design decisions, engineering standards, solution quality, and production readiness while collaborating with solution architects, business stakeholders, and enterprise platform teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Lead the design, development, and implementation of the AWS-based MDM solution. 
 - Translate solution architecture and business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical implementations. 
 - Make architectural and technology decisions, establish engineering standards, and drive code quality.

 - Drive infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and deployment practices in collaboration with DevOps engineers. MDM and Data Integration

- Lead the implementation of customer data ingestion, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and consolidation pipelines. 
 - Implement customer matching, deduplication, golden record creation, and survivorship logic. 
 - Design reliable integrations with source CRM systems and Oracle Fusion. 
 - Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and reconciliation across integrated systems. Full-Stack Development and Exception Management

- Oversee backend services, REST APIs, and web-based user interfaces for MDM operations. 
 - Support the development of exception management workflows for manual review and resolution of uncertain customer matches. 
 - Ensure effective integration between the UI, backend services, data processing components, and workflow orchestration. Engineering Delivery and Production Readiness

- Lead Agile planning, estimation, sprint execution, and delivery tracking. 
 - Coordinate integration testing, performance testing, deployment, and release readiness. 
 - Identify and resolve technical blockers, integration issues, and production defects. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and production engineering requirements. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, and enterprise platform teams to deliver business outcomes. Required Skills and Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, including hands-on technical leadership of cloud-native application development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and developing AWS-based enterprise applications. 
 - Proficiency in AWS services, including: 
 - AWS Lambda
 - ECS Fargate and ECR
 - Step Functions and EventBridge
 - API Gateway
 - Aurora PostgreSQL
 - Strong programming skills in Python and SQL. 
 - Experience developing REST APIs, backend services, and distributed applications. 
 - Experience with data integration, data transformation, data quality, and relational database design. 
 - Familiarity with modern full-stack application development and web-based user interfaces. 
 - Proven experience leading cross-functional Agile engineering teams. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production support. 
 - Experience implementing security-by-design principles, including access control, encryption, and secure handling of enterprise data. 
 - Excellent technical problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into enterprise applications, particularly using Amazon Bedrock. 
 - Experience with entity resolution, fuzzy matching, customer deduplication, and AI-assisted data matching. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle customer data models, or Oracle Trading Community Architecture (TCA). 
 - Experience implementing enterprise MDM, customer master, or Customer 360 solutions. 
 - Exposure to AWS infrastructure as code and automated deployment frameworks. Key Success Criteria

The Technical Lead will be successful in delivering a secure, scalable, and production-ready MDM hub that: 

- Consolidates customer data from multiple CRM systems. 
 - Produces trusted golden customer records using effective matching and data quality rules. 
 - Enables business users to resolve data exceptions through an intuitive review workflow. 
 - Integrates reliably with Oracle Fusion. 
 - Meets enterprise standards for security, performance, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Is delivered through effective technical leadership and cross-functional Agile execution.

data.description:
Job Description

The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Backend Architecture and Hands-on Development: - Own the design and development of Ripik's backend platform built on Java 21+ and Spring Boot 4 x, including RESTful and gRPC APIs, microservices decomposition, event-driven pipelines, and integration layers that connect AI inference engines with factory-floor systems. - Architect for scale, reliability, and low latency: design services that handle high-throughput streams from industrial IoT sensors and vision cameras, process them through message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ), and persist results across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and time-series stores (TimescaleDB / InfluxDB). - Make key technology and design decisions: Spring Security and OAuth 2. 0 / JWT for multi-tenant authentication, Spring Data for repository abstractions, Spring Cloud for service discovery and configuration, and Hibernate / JPA for ORM while keeping the codebase clean, testable, and well-documented. - Drive API design standards (OpenAPI / Swagger), enforce contract-first development, and ensure backend services expose well-versioned, idempotent, and backward-compatible interfaces consumed by the frontend and external integrations. - Champion production engineering: build observability into every service with structured logging (ELK/Loki), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger), metrics (Prometheus/Grafana), and own SLAs and incident response for the backend stack. Full-Stack Product Delivery: - Lead end-to-end product builds from the ground up, translate product requirements into technical architecture, break them into epics and stories, and ship complete features spanning backend APIs, database schemas, and frontend UIs. - Collaborate closely with frontend engineers building operator dashboards and configuration portals (React/Next. js, TypeScript) to review UI/UX implementation, ensure performant API integration, and maintain a cohesive full-stack development workflow. - Own the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes on AWS / Azure / GCP), automate testing (unit, integration, E2E), and enforce quality gates so that every merge to main is production-ready. - Coordinate with the AI/Data Science teams to integrate ML model outputs (computer vision inferences, LLM responses) into the platform, designing the serving layer, result-caching strategy, and feedback loops that connect model predictions with user-facing features. - Manage cloud infrastructure decisions across Ripik's multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises installations at customer factory sites, balancing cost, compliance, and latency requirements. Team Leadership and Scrum Management: - Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of backend and frontend engineers; set clear expectations, conduct regular 1: 1s, drive career development, and foster a culture of ownership and technical excellence. - Run Scrum ceremonies end-to-end: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring the team delivers predictably while staying agile enough to respond to shifting priorities in a fast-moving start-up. - Conduct thorough code reviews and architecture reviews; enforce engineering best practices around testing (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers), code quality (SonarQube), and secure coding standards. - Hire and onboard strong engineers; raise the technical bar continuously through pairing, tech talks, design-document culture, and a bias toward building reusable, well-abstracted components. - Act as the primary engineering interface with Product, Design, AI, Field Engineering, and Customer - Success translating business needs into well-scoped engineering work and communicating trade-offs, timelines, and risks transparently to leadership. Requirements: - B. Tech / M. Tech in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. - 6-10 years of total software engineering experience with a strong backend focus, of which at least 2 years in a tech lead, engineering lead, or engineering manager role. - Deep hands-on expertise in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot 3 x / 4 x, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, and Spring WebFlux (reactive)). Ability to write production-grade code, not just review it. - Strong experience designing and building microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, event-driven systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and database layers (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis). - Proven track record of building applications from the ground up, greenfield product development in a SaaS or product-company context, and taking features from whiteboard to production. - Experience leading and managing teams of both backend and frontend engineers, comfortable reviewing React/TypeScript code, guiding frontend architecture decisions, and maintaining full-stack delivery velocity. - Hands-on experience running Scrum / Agile processes: sprint planning, backlog management, velocity tracking, and retrospectives with a practical, outcome-driven approach (not ceremony for ceremony's sake). - Strong DevOps and deployment experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins), and at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure / GCP also valued). - Solid understanding of system design fundamentals: caching strategies, load balancing, rate limiting, database indexing, horizontal scaling, and high-availability patterns. - Experience in a high-growth start-up or similarly fast-paced environment where shipping speed, scrappiness, and wearing multiple hats are the norm. - Excellent communication skills, able to articulate technical trade-offs to product and business stakeholders, write clear RFCs and design documents, and present to leadership. data.description:
Toast has grown to be a leading hospitality software company in the US and is now setting its sights on our next stages of growth. As the business continues to grow, there is increased demand to enhance the enterprise level of support in the product. Toast customers who managed several restaurants a few years ago are now expanding their business and adding new locations. New enterprise customers are looking to leverage Toast technology to support the growth of their business in new ways. These exciting new opportunities will require Toast to bolster our product offerings

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Fintech Payments team. In this role, you'll work across the entire Toast platform, including our partner ecosystem. 

As a Senior Engineer on the Funds Management team, you will help evolve our platform currently processing over $150B in annual GPV-to meet Toast's growing global needs. You'll contribute to building best-in-class, customer-facing FinTech products and developing foundational capabilities that empower partner teams to accelerate product delivery and scale efficiently. 

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

- Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features across Toast's enterprise management products
 - Lead complex projects that improve functionality and reliability for our customers 
 - Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast 
 - Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
 - Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success
 - Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features 
 - Mentor and coach other engineers

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

- Bachelor's or Master's degree preferred
 - 5+ years experience building backend services and APIs
 - Extensive experience working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin, with a deep understanding of testing, quality, and best practices
 - Experience shipping production services and balancing getting things done with platform stability and reliability
 - Experience building backend services and APIs and scaling distributed systems
 - Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus
 - Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
 - Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast's products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture. 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits.

data.title: SAP TOSCA Automation Tester
data.description:
Position: SAP TOSCA Automation Tester

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Hyderabad, India

Experience Required: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in test automation using Tricentis TOSCA with strong SAP functional context. 

Key Responsibilities

- Automation Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable model-based test automation frameworks using Tricentis TOSCA specifically optimized for SAP ecosystems.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Technical Experience: A minimum of 4 to 6 years of intensive QA experience, with at least 4+ years dedicated solely to Tricentis TOSCA Automation Testing within SAP environments. 
 - SAP Knowledge: Strong exposure to testing standard SAP business processes (Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report). 
 - TOSCA Certifications: Tricentis TOSCA AS1 and AS2 certifications are highly desirable (TOSCA Automation Engineer Level 1/2). 
 - Methodologies: Clear understanding of Agile/Scrum test processes and in-sprint automation practices. 
 - Core Competencies: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and documentation skills. Strong collaboration and communication skills to work alongside cross-functional AI and ERP teams.

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. 

The Knowledge Catalog team owns core search infrastructure and search quality frameworks, powering the discovery of billions of assets for Google employees. The mission is to make google's internal data discoverable for both Google employees and agentic workflows. 

You will lead the Knowledge catalog Search pillar, focusing on Core Search and Discovery Infrastructure, Search quality and evals frameworks. 

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google's flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google's products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Knowledge Catalog's (Core) hybrid semantic search infrastructure and search quality evaluation platform.

 - Build a scalable search infrastructure for agents and humans. 
 - Foster engineering excellence, robust system design, and production reliability across all search serving and indexing pipelines. 
 - Mentor and grow other Individual Contributors, establishing Bengaluru site as a Center of Excellence for search infra and quality use-cases.

Job Summary: 

You are a retrieval-oriented engineer with deep expertise in high-dimensional data, relational structures, and large-scale knowledge representation. You thrive on the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data and semantic understanding, building the backbone for next-generation AI and discovery systems. You are passionate about data topology, latent space optimization, and the performance tuning of complex query engines. You constantly strive to reduce "time-to-insight" and maximize the precision of information retrieval at scale. 

The pace of our growth is incredible-if you want to tackle the foundational challenges of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), knowledge graphs, and semantic search at a global scale, join us!

About the Team: 

Join our Video Understanding team as a Senior Software Engineer leading the charge in how we organize and retrieve the world's information. You will be the architect of the "brain" of our platform, solving the hardest problems in semantic search and graph-based reasoning at a scale few companies ever reach. This role offers a unique opportunity to define the data infrastructure strategy that powers our GenAI future. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design and development of hybrid retrieval architectures combining vector similarity search with structured graph traversals. 
 - Architect scalable data pipelines for the ingestion, embedding, and indexing of massive, multi-modal datasets. 
 - Innovate and prototype advanced retrieval techniques, including multi-stage re-ranking, graph-tooling for LLMs, and dynamic metadata filtering. 
 - Design and implement schemas for complex knowledge graphs, ensuring high-performance relationship mapping and ontological integrity. 
 - Build automated data validation and drift detection systems to monitor the quality of embeddings and the health of the vector space. 
 - Drive technical implementation of "Memory" systems for AI agents, focusing on long-term persistence, observability, and sub-second latency. 
 - Champion data organization standards, ensuring that disparate data sources are unified into a coherent, searchable knowledge base. 
 - Collaborate with AI Research and Product teams to evaluate emerging database technologies (e. g. , HNSW optimizations, GraphRAG) and integrate them into production. 

Skills and attributes: 

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering or backend systems with a focus on high-performance data retrieval and storage. 
 - BE/B. Tech in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent. MS or PhD in a related field is a plus. 
 - Expert proficiency in Python, Java, or Go, with a strong grasp of distributed system design patterns. 
 - Deep understanding of Vector Databases, including indexing strategies (HNSW, IVFFlat, PQ) and distance metrics (Cosine, Euclidean, Dot Product). Experience with Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, or Qdrant. 
 - Strong background in Graph Databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune, or ArangoDB) and query languages like Cypher or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Data Modeling and organization, specifically in building semantic layers, ontologies, and taxonomies. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and embedding models (OpenAI, HuggingFace, Cohere). 
 - Proficiency in large-scale data processing using Spark, Flink, or Kafka for real-time indexing and ETL. 
 - Understanding of Information Retrieval (IR) fundamentals, including BM25, TF-IDF, and reciprocal rank fusion. 
 - Experience with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes). 

Preferred Education & Experience: 

- B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university. 
 - 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery.
