It is a streamlined interface that enables transaction originators and receivers (e. g. , merchants, financial institutions, and processors) to connect to other players in the payment ecosystem. Our team of integrators, analysts, testers and subject matter experts work together to build four platforms that encompasses full lifecycle of payment processing. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager-Technical to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. 

We are looking for

An engineer who can whiteboard a globally distributed architecture, dive into JVM internals, explain TCP retransmissions, optimize database access patterns, troubleshoot complex production performance issues, and still write production-quality Java code. Someone who is deeply passionate about software engineering, innovation, and technology craftsmanship, thrives on solving the hardest scalability and distributed systems challenges, and influences the technical direction. 

Required Experience

Designed and developed highly available, fault-tolerant, and geographically distributed systems. 

Solved complex consistency, replication, concurrency, caching, and data partitioning challenges. 

Designed and developed systems capable of operating at massive scale with near-zero downtime. 

Driven an architecture review for critical applications and infrastructure platforms. 

Led capacity planning, performance engineering, and resiliency initiatives. 

Demonstrated mastery across the technology stack

- Programming Language Java (preferred)/Go
 - Layer 7 protocols (HTTP/REST/gRPC/API Gateway)
 - Messaging systems (Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ, Solace)
 - Kubernetes , Service Mesh and Microservices
 - Databases (SQL/NoSQL/NewSQL/Datawarehouse)
 - Operating Systems
 - Networking (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing)
 - Storage Systems
 - Compute, Memory and I/O subsystems

Understand system behaviour from application requests through network, storage, and hardware layers. 

Role

Lead architecture and design of large-scale distributed systems serving millions and billions of transactions. 

Design and build shared common reusable libraries and components. 

Drive engineering decisions across multiple products, services, and business domains. 

Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards, and platform roadmaps. 

Evaluate trade-offs across scalability, resiliency, performance, security, maintainability, and cost. 

Establish engineering patterns, frameworks, and reference architectures for enterprise adoption. 

Work on complex enterprise-wide initiatives spanning multiple services/programs and drives resolution. 

Work with business/product owners to architect and deliver on new services to introduce new products and bundles. 

Drive the architectural design, including dependent services, service interactions, and policies. 

Take ownership to improve the customer experience of an entire set of services/applications sold as products or bundled services. 

Simplify and improve the cost/benefit of a function/service/architecture strategy. 

Apply judgment and experience to balance trade-offs between competing interests. 

Venture beyond comfort zone to take on assignments across different areas of Software Engineering. 

Take on organization-wide and public speaking engagements and publishes white papers and blogs on relevant and emerging technical topics. 

Consult across teams and across program lines to identify synergies and reuse opportunities. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with 4 to 8 years of technical expertise to join our SRE and observability team within the CIO RUN function. In this role, you will act as a critical bridge between engineering and operations, driving system stability, proactive detection, and rapid incident mitigation across enterprise systems. 

You will be responsible for hands-on configuration of observability platforms, triaging system alerts and user reports, managing incident response workflows, and enforcing end-to-end ITIL lifecycles (Incident, Problem, and Change Management). 

Key Responsibilities

- Partner and collaborate with end users to understand administrative needs, resolve issues and meet business requirements. 
 - Handle both end user tickets and monitoring tickets from ITIL perspective with end to end ownership maintaining required response and resolution SLA targets. 
 - Liaise with the problem manager to identify repeated incidents and engage with level 2 or domain teams for permanent fixes. 
 - Able to manage high impact major incidents P1/P2 and able to perform initial level troubleshooting and triaging. 
 - Develop and mentor others around application customization via custom objects, validation rules, workflows, flows, process builder, etc
 - Implement, own and optimize internal processes to improve efficiency. 
 - Document procedures, policies, and systems in Runbooks, SOPs and KEDBs/KB Articles. 
 - Manage and own system administration and help streamline business functionality including: profiles/permissions, role hierarchy, security models, application customization, reports and dashboards, etc

Proactive Monitoring & Observability

- Perform hands-on configuration and tuning of synthetic monitors, application performance monitoring (APM), dashboards, and alert rules in platforms such as Datadog and Dynatrace. 
 - Drive continuous reduction of alert noise and fatigue by establishing alert correlation rules and actionable threshold triggers. 
 - Assist in application onboarding to ensure proper logging, tracing, and metric standards are enforced prior to operational go-live. 

Triage & Incident Management

- Actively triage incoming system alerts and user-reported issues, minimizing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore (MTTR). 
 - Participate in incident swarming and real-time operational response utilizing modern collaboration and ITSM tools such as Incident. io, Datadog, Jira, and Slack. 
 - Oversee the lifecycle of monitoring tickets, maintaining strict adherence to SLA compliance and response metrics. 

Problem & Change Management

- Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and facilitate Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) to eliminate recurring incidents. 
 - Maintain and expand the Known Error Database (KEDB) and runbook documentation to mitigate Single Point of Failure (SPOF) risks across operational workflows. 
 - Review and govern change requests, verifying risk assessments and rollback plans to maintain operational continuity. 

Tooling & Integration Management

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and support bi-directional SaaS integrations and data pipelines (e. g. , Salesforce-to-Zuora, Workato, AWS Lambda, and EHC/Zendesk platforms).

Required Qualifications

- Experience: 4 to 8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Operations, System Engineering, or NOC environments. 
 - Observability Mastery: Hands-on experience configuring observability stacks, including log aggregation, metric creation, APM tracing, and visual dashboards using tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, or New Relic. 
 - ITIL Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of ITIL frameworks, specifically Incident, Problem, and Change Management integration. 
 - Cloud & Architecture: Technical experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), API integrations, payload troubleshooting, and database querying via SQL. 
 - Scripting & Automation: Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Go, PowerShell, or Bash) for automating tasks, processing telemetry data, or building operational reports. 
 - Operational Drive: Proven track record in reducing alert fatigue, managing complex system environments, and maintaining composure during high-priority outage events. 

Nice to Have

- ITIL 4 Foundation certification or specialized certifications in Incident/Problem Management. 
 - Prior experience in service-based or consulting environments with broad, multi-client operational exposure. 
 - Background in a global technology company supporting enterprise-grade, business-critical SaaS systems and distributed topologies. 

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based. 

Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager. 

The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love. 

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. 

As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law. 

Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we're proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here. 

Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. Roles And Responsibilities - Shift Leads

The Shift Lead is responsible for supervising and guiding a team of customer service agents during a specific shift. They ensure operational efficiency, adherence to service standards, and delivery of high-quality customer support while acting as the primary point of escalation for the team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Management & Supervision
 - Lead and manage a team of Customer Service Representatives, ensuring all performance metrics (FRT, AHT, CSAT/NPS, Quality, Schedule Adherence) targets are consistently met. 
 - Supervise and guide agents to achieve performance targets and service level agreements (SLAs). 
 - Monitor agent attendance, adherence to schedules, and productivity during the shift. 
 - Provide real-time coaching, guidance, and feedback to agents to enhance performance. 
 - Assist in onboarding and training new team members as required. 
 - Facilitate the smooth transition of new agents by actively supporting their event handling, ensuring they quickly grasp comprehensive process knowledge. 
 - A Shift Lead must always be present on the floor during the shift. 
 - Maintain floor decorum and foster a professional work environment. 
 - Operational Oversight & Floor Support
 - Ensure smooth execution of daily operations, including queue monitoring, call/event assignments in coordination with ENS, and workload distribution. 
 - Oversee Reach and Talk desk platforms, managing queues efficiently. 
 - Monitor real-time metrics such as call volume, wait times, abandoned calls, and service levels to maintain operational efficiency. 
 - For resolutions provided during the call, the Agent retains primary ownership. The Shift Lead is designated as the secondary responsible party for validating the resolution and ensuring proper process adherence. 
 - Proactively Logging in to assist all LOBs during high call volume. 
 - Ensure breaks are punched in by associates on Talk desk. 
 - Shift Leads must maintain a shift-end tracker capturing all delay reasons, including half-day instances and any reasons leading to excess AUX usage. 
 - Send the shift-end report to @GCC-ERS-ENS using the format in the attached tracker.

 - Ensure agents deliver high-quality customer interactions aligned with company policies and customer expectations.

 - Follow up on detractor cases and send appropriate communication to the concerned associate. 
 - Assist with escalation calls and emails, ensuring prompt resolution. 
 - Reporting & Documentation
 - Generate shift reports, including key performance indicators (KPIs), service levels, and agent performance, for management review. 
 - Track and document operational incidents, escalations, and resolutions. 
 - Monitor the ERS Admin email distribution list and ensure timely action. 
 - Queue & Notification Management
 - Actively monitor queues and notifications to ensure timely responses and prevent delays. 
 - Communicate critical alerts and updates to relevant stakeholders promptly. 
 - Coaching & Development
 - Conduct coaching sessions for BQ associates when directed by Team Leads. 
 - Deliver real-time feedback to associates to drive performance improvement. 
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Serve as a bridge between management and agents to communicate updates, policies, and operational changes. 
 - Collaborate with Team Leads, workforce management, quality, and coaching teams to ensure smooth operations across all shifts.

 - Identify opportunities for process improvement, enhanced agent efficiency, or better customer service outcomes.

At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA's value proposition unique. 

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions. 

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the 'Digital Startup of the Year' category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category. 

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources. 

Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Front-End Engineer to take technical ownership of the Bank's client-facing applications, including Online and Mobile Banking, Onboarding and our corporate website, while leading our front-end engineering teams. 

You will own the front-end architecture and technology roadmap, actively shape solutions with Product, UX and architecture and backend engineering teams, and remain close to the code through design, code reviews, troubleshooting and development where required. This role combines deep technical leadership with team responsibility and is intended for someone who wants to remain an active engineer. 

Your AMINA To-Do List

- Act as the technical owner for Online Banking, Mobile Banking, Digital Onboarding and the corporate website. 
 - Own and evolve the front-end architecture, technology roadmap and engineering standards across web and mobile applications.

data.title: Embedded Systems Engineer ngine Control Unit (ECU)
data.description:
Experience: 1+ years | Location: Bengaluru | Type: Full-time

About the role: 

We are hiring an embedded systems engineer to own the ECU / FADEC (Full Authority Digital Engine Control) software for a small turbojet engine end-to-end - from control architecture and real-time firmware through drivers, communication, fault handling, and validation on bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and engine tests. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own the full engine control software lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, integration, and test. 
 - Design and implement the FADEC control state machine: startup sequencing, steady-state governing, shutdown, and fault/recovery states, with defined transitions and interlocks. 
 - Develop real-time firmware in C/C++ on STM32 / ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers under an RTOS: task partitioning, scheduling, interrupt structure, and deterministic timing. 
 - Write and validate peripheral and sensor/actuator drivers: ADC, PWM, timers, UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN. 
 - Implement sensor acquisition and filtering, actuator command generation, and closed-loop control (e. g. , fuel and speed governing) in coordination with hardware and controls engineers. 
 - Implement fault detection, safe-state logic, redundancy management, data logging, and telemetry. 
 - Integrate communication protocols (CAN and serial/RS-485; additional buses as required) for control, telemetry, and ground-support interfaces. 
 - Build and maintain test infrastructure: unit tests, bench scripts, HIL rigs, and engine ground-test support. 
 - Debug on target hardware using JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. 
 - Maintain code under version control with design, interface, and test documentation. 

Required Qualifications: 

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 
 - 1+ years of embedded development experience in C and C++. 
 - Real-time software experience on an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar): scheduling, priorities, and deterministic behavior. 
 - Hands-on STM32 / ARM Cortex-M development: peripherals, interrupts, memory constraints, and cross-compilation toolchains. 
 - Demonstrated finite state machine (FSM) design and implementation for real-time control systems. 
 - Driver-level protocol experience: CAN, UART/RS-485, SPI, I2C. 
 - On-target debugging proficiency (JTAG/SWD, oscilloscope, logic analyzer). 
Preferred Qualifications: 

- Exposure to FADEC, ECU, engine control, or motor/power-electronics control software. 
 - Control systems implementation (e. g. , PID loops, governing, tuning). 
 - Safety-oriented coding practices (MISRA C or equivalent). 
 - Fault-tolerant or redundant system design. 
 - Python for test automation.

data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an experienced DFT Architect to lead Design-for-Test strategy, architecture definition, and implementation for complex ASIC/SOC designs across advanced technology nodes. The ideal candidate will drive end-to-end DFT architecture including scan, MBIST, compression, boundary scan, and at-speed test methodologies while collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve high test coverage, quality, and silicon bring-up success. 

What You'll Do

- Define and own SOC-level DFT architecture and test strategy for complex semiconductor designs. 
 - Lead implementation of scan insertion, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, boundary scan, and test compression methodologies. 
 - Drive DFT planning and integration aligned with power, timing, area, and test coverage goals. 
 - Collaborate with RTL, Physical Design, Verification, and Product Engineering teams for seamless DFT integration and signoff. 
 - Analyze and resolve DFT-related timing, routing, and testability challenges. 
 - Support silicon bring-up, debug, diagnosis, yield analysis, and production test optimization. 
 - Develop and enhance DFT automation flows, methodologies, and reusable infrastructure. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across projects. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, or related field. 
 - 14+ years of experience in ASIC/SOC DFT implementation and architecture. 
 - Strong expertise in scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG, compression, and low-power DFT methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard DFT tools such as Siemens Tessent, Synopsys DFT Compiler/TestMAX, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of RTL design, timing, physical design constraints, and silicon debug. 
 - Experience with advanced technology nodes and large SOC integration. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell. 
 - Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with automotive safety standards such as ISO 26262. 
 - Exposure to chiplet-based architectures and 3D IC testing methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of diagnosis-driven yield improvement and silicon analytics. 

Success in This Role Looks Like

- Delivery of robust DFT architectures with high test coverage and efficient manufacturing test cost. 
 - Successful silicon bring-up with minimal DFT-related issues. 
 - Improved DFT methodology scalability, automation, and execution efficiency. 
 - Strong technical leadership and contribution to organization-wide DFT best practices. 

About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. 

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. 

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. 

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. 

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

data.title: Head – Satellite QKD (Systems Integration)
data.description:
QNu Labs is India's pioneering quantum cybersecurity company. We have built and deployed fibre-based Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) across terrestrial networks. Our next frontier is space. 

We're hiring a hands-on leader to take our satellite QKD programme from lab prototypes to a qualification-ready space payload and optical ground station. You will personally lead the integration and test campaign, not just oversee it. You'll report to the SVP - Innovation. 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Mission and system architecture: LEO downlink QKD (decoy-state and entanglement-based), requirements flow-down, ICDs, link budget and key-rate model

• Payload integration: quantum source, modulators, timing/control FPGA electronics, and the optical terminal and bus interfaces, taken from engineering model to qualification model to flight model

• Optical ground station: telescope, PAT loop, single-photon detectors, time sync and key post-processing

• AIT and qualification: vibration, shock, TVAC and EMC testing; V&V plans; anomaly closure; long-range free-space trials

• Programme leadership: schedule, risk, budget and SRR/PDR/CDR/TRR gates; single technical point of contact for platform, launch and ground-station partners

• Team: build and lead 8-12 engineers across optics, FPGA/embedded, software and mechanical/thermal

• Roadmap and IP: entanglement-based and inter-satellite links, constellation key management, patents

YOUR FIRST YEAR

• Show end-to-end quantum key exchange in the lab, from the payload engineering model to the ground receiver

• Freeze requirements, ICDs and the link budget with partners

• Get the qualification model into environmental test, complete a long-range free-space trial, and commit the mission timeline

YOU BRING

• Hands-on integration and test on at least one satellite project that reached flight model or flight. You were on the test floor, not just in the review room. 

• Ownership of system integration on a space or high-reliability programme: ICDs, AIT, environmental qualification and anomaly resolution

• Working knowledge of QKD (BB84/decoy-state, entanglement-based) and free-space optical links (link budgets, PAT, single-photon detection, timing)

• Experience integrating optics, FPGA/embedded and software into one working system

• Space engineering practice in the ECSS/NASA style: review gates, configuration management, parts and materials control

• A record of leading a multidisciplinary team to fixed external milestones

• A Master's or PhD in physics, EE, optics or aerospace, or equivalent expertise; typically 10+ years of experience

Bonus: laser-comm terminals, optical ground-station operations, space-qualified photonics or radiation testing, CubeSat or hosted-payload missions, and publications or patents in quantum communication. 

WHY QNU

- QNu is recognised under India's National Quantum Mission and has won the National Startup Award and National Technology Award (2022) and ET Best Tech Brands 2025. In this role you'll build sovereign space-quantum capability in India, for the world.

data.title: Regional Food Safety Microbiologist
data.description:
ABOUT US

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond-based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we're with, whatever we're doing, we always make it real. 

JOB IN SUMMARY

The Regional Food Safety Microbiologist for Asia Pacific will provide advanced scientific leadership and technical expertise in food microbiology, microbiological risk management, environmental monitoring, validation science and food safety systems. 

The role will support the implementation of global food safety strategies and initiatives across Asia Pacific while ensuring effective deployment of microbiological control programs, environmental monitoring systems, validation programs and risk management practices. The position will support ofi's Zero Incident Mindset through the application of sound science, robust risk assessments and continuous improvement of food safety controls. 

As part of the Global Food Safety COE, the role will work closely with regional Quality & Food Safety teams, site leadership, Operations, Engineering and global food safety experts to drive harmonization, capability building and consistent application of food safety standards across all product platforms. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Global Food Safety COE Deployment

- Act as the Asia Pacific representative of the Global Food Safety COE. 
 - Support implementation of global food safety strategies, standards and initiatives across all Asia Pacific sites. 
 - Drive alignment and harmonization of microbiological risk management programs across regions. 
 - Support continuous improvement of global food safety standards and governance processes. 
 - Participate in global communities of practice and technical working groups. Microbiological Risk Management

- Serve as the regional subject matter expert for food microbiology and microbiological risk management. 
 - Lead microbiological risk assessments for products, ingredients, processes and manufacturing environments. 
 - Identify current and emerging microbiological risks and develop mitigation strategies. 
 - Support the development of preventive food safety controls using scientific and risk-based approaches. 
 - Provide technical leadership during significant food safety incidents and investigations. Environmental Monitoring Programs

- Lead deployment and continuous improvement of environmental monitoring programs across Asia Pacific. 
 - Establish risk-based pathogen and indicator organism monitoring strategies. 
 - Support sites in trend analysis, program optimization and investigation of environmental positives. 
 - Drive standardization of environmental monitoring methodologies across the region. 
 - Provide technical guidance for environmental monitoring program design and governance. Thermal Process Validation Program

- Own and lead the validation program for thermal kill steps across all relevant manufacturing sites within Asia Pacific. 
 - Develop validation standards, protocols and scientific methodologies aligned with global requirements. 
 - Review and approve thermal process validation studies and challenge testing activities. 
 - Partner with Operations and Engineering teams to ensure validated processes are maintained and controlled. 
 - Support revalidation following process, product or equipment changes. 
 - Drive consistency of thermal process validation approaches across product platforms and regions. 
 - Maintain oversight of thermal validation effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Validation & Verification

- Provide technical leadership for food safety validation and verification programs. 
 - Support validation of preventive controls, sanitation programs and microbiological interventions. 
 - Review validation protocols and ensure scientific rigor in study design and interpretation. 
 - Support implementation of risk-based verification activities across manufacturing sites. 
 - Ensure effective documentation and governance of validation programs. Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis

- Lead microbiological investigations associated with food safety incidents, environmental positives and customer complaints. 
 - Support root cause investigations and development of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Review regional microbiological trends and identify recurring issues requiring systematic improvement. 
 - Provide guidance during product disposition decisions and crisis management activities. Capability Building & Training

- Develop and deliver advanced food microbiology and food safety training programs. 
 - Build microbiological capability across regional and site Quality & Food Safety teams. 
 - Coach and mentor food safety professionals across the region. 
 - Support development of technical competency frameworks for food safety and microbiology disciplines. 
 - Drive knowledge sharing through communities of practice and technical forums. 
 - Conduct Good Laboratory Practice internal audits for Micro Labs in the region
 - Review new test methods and support implementation at all Micro Labs.

 - Architecture 
 - RTL design 
 - Verification 
 - Physical design

AI Agents & Workflow Automation

 - Continuously benchmark and optimize model selection across:

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's/Master's/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field 
 - 12+ years of experience in AI/ML, systems, or platform engineering 
 - Strong experience in: 
 - LLMs and generative AI systems

 - Workflow automation systems

Key Attributes

- Strong systems thinker with end-to-end ownership mindset 
 - Ability to bridge AI and domain engineering (EDA/SoC) 
 - Highly proactive with a builder mentality 
 - Passionate about transforming traditional workflows using AI 
 - Strong communication and influence across teams

Success in This Role Looks Like

- Adoption of AI across engineering workflows 
 - Measurable improvements in productivity and quality 
 - Effective deployment of AI agents across multiple domains 
 - Secure and scalable AI infrastructure 
 - Reduced cost and improved efficiency of AI usage 
 - Engineers enabled to independently build and use AI agents

Why This Role Matters

This is a foundational role in shaping an AI-native semiconductor company. You will define not just tools, but how engineering itself is done, and directly impact the speed, quality, and innovation of our products. 

Location

Hybrid / On-site - Bengaluru

About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. 

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. 

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. 

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. 

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

We are seeking an experienced to own the end-to-end testing, characterization, and failure analysis strategy for complex, next-generation multi-die packages.

Additionally, you will apply statistical analysis and machine learning to test data-driving outlier detection, bench-to-ATE correlation, and predictive telemetry signals-without treating ML models as a substitute for true physical root-cause analysis.

data.description:
About Signify

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Join us, and together, we'll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world. 

More About The Role

If you are a seasoned Software (SW) professional, or a Quality professional with software background with an affinity to HW/FW, this could be a perfect next step to a senior role with a global engineering leader in IoT for Lighting. 

As a Lead Advanced Quality Engineer assuring the quality and reliability of our state-of-the art Connected Lighting & Controls Systems, the backbone of IoT and many other modern building systems. The AQE facilitates the Quality Management processes within R&D, enforcing best practices defined by Signify's Quality System, and champions the major quality pillars related to software & hardware design and development, supplier management, and industrial processes. 

We're on the lookout for forward-thinking innovators with a passion for sustainability. If you match this description, get in touch!

What You'll Do

- Accounts for all end-to-end quality-related deliverables in the NPDL process and fast track development projects. 
 - Coaches, trains and other functions on execution of quality activities such as CTQ, FMEA, Supplier selection, PPAP, QTP, Process validation, Reliability prediction, and Compliance. 
 - Presents the quality status in NPDL Gate and MS review and defines and drives corrective actions to meet deliverables. 
 - Assured that budget is defined in the project to meet quality deliverables. 
 - Sets quality KPI in NPDL Project. 
 - Defines requirements for quality test and measurement equipment. 
 - Closes feedback loops from customer complaints by embedding the learnings into new design rules, QTPs, FMEAs and other AQP tools. 
 - Lead problem-solving activities for internal and Customer concerns relating to assigned responsibilities and documenting all actions in the required format (e. g. 8D). 
 - Ensure project documentation review and authorization. 
 - Act as DfSS ambassador. 

Technical

Your qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field, providing foundational knowledge in quality principles and product development. Detailed knowledge of the theory and principles of APQP and statistical methods.

 - Strong analytical skills. 
 - Prior hands-on software development experience in roles such as Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Software Architect is considered a strong advantage.

Behavioural

 - Good communicator and presenter, willing to listen and speak-up. 
 - Strong collaborator who keeps stakeholders and team members informed, maintains continuous collaborative process, and drives key initiatives.

 - Result driven, pragmatic mindset, with attention to detail whilst keeping focus on Big Picture.

We're offering multiple opportunities for career development, like mentoring, coaching and stretch assignments, with strong international exposure for dynamic profiles. Learning is fundamental to our culture. Through continuous learning, we are transforming the industry. You have the chance to learn every day, acquire new skills and perspectives through customized online programs, and on-the-job experiences. 

See #SignifyLife through the eyes of our employees!

Signify is the world leader in lighting. We provide professional customers and consumers with quality, energy-efficient LED lighting. Everything we'll do for you

You can grow a lasting career here. We'll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We'll help you learn and progress in a way that's right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We'll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27, 000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together. 

Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

data.title: Senior Staff DFT Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are hiring a Senior Staff DFT Engineer to lead DFT strategy, architecture, and implementation for complex, high-performance SoCs. You will define methodologies, and drive DFT from RTL to silicon bring-up, ensuring optimal quality, cost, and time-to-market. 

What You'll Do

- Define DFT architecture and test strategy for SoCs, including scan, compression, MBIST, LBIST, and IO test. 
 - Lead ATPG pattern generation, optimization, and diagnosis flows across multiple fault models. 
 - Architect and oversee MBIST, BISR, and memory repair solutions for large memory arrays. 
 - Design and implement advanced test access mechanisms using JTAG, Boundary Scan (BSCAN), and IJTAG (IEEE 1687). 
 - Drive DFT timing closure, power-aware DFT, and hierarchical/multi-core test strategies. 
 - Own pre-silicon DFT verification (ATPG simulation, GLS) and coverage closure. 
 - Lead silicon bring-up, ATE test program development, post-silicon validation, debug, and yield improvement. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate DFT into the overall design flow and resolve complex issues. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers; contribute to methodology development and tool evaluation. 
 - Optimize test time, data volume, and manufacturing test costs. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's/master's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering. 
 - 10+ years of strong hands-on experience in DFT for complex SoC/ASIC projects. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, IJTAG, BSCAN, scan compression, and related areas. 
 - Proven track record in silicon bring-up, ATE support, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Deep understanding of full ASIC flow (RTL to Silicon) and DFT impact on PPA. 
 - Proficiency with leading EDA tools (Synopsys TetraMAX/DFTMAX, Siemens/Tessent SSN, TestKompress etc. ). 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills. 

Good To Have

- Knowledge of advanced topics like 2. 5D/3D packaging test, analog/mixed-signal DFT. 

Job Location

Hybrid/ On-site - Bangalore / Remote - India

About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. 

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. 

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. 

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. 

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

data.title: Software Development Engineer - Test
data.description:
At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) - The AI Factory Platform Company - we're building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide. 

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale. 

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision. 

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact. 

Job Overview

Penguin Computing is seeking an experienced AI QA / SDET Engineer to join our Software Engineering team. Penguin Computing's Scyld Software products are used to deploy, provision, manage, and monitor some of the largest computational systems in the world. As we expand these platforms with AI/LLM-powered and agentic capabilities , this role will drive quality engineering across both our core infrastructure software and emerging AI solutions. 

You will join our agile Software team and collaborate closely with Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Product Owners, Product Managers, and other teams across the organization to ensure our software meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, performance, and security . 

The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in software testing and automation with hands-on knowledge of LLM evaluation, AI agent testing, AI security testing, and modern AI quality methodologies . You will help define testing strategies, build scalable automation and AI evaluation frameworks, and continuously improve our testing processes and tools. 

This role requires strong technical problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work with a high degree of independence. You will have the opportunity to shape our evolving AI quality engineering practice and ensure that both traditional software and AI-powered capabilities are reliable, secure, measurable, and production-ready. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and execute end-to-end QA strategy for software, AI/LLM features, and AI agents. 
 - Design and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering API, UI, integration, regression, performance, and infrastructure testing. 
 - Build LLM/AI evaluation frameworks and automated evaluation pipelines integrated with CI/CD. 
 - Define evaluation datasets, test scenarios, golden datasets, and quality benchmarks for AI features. 
 - Evaluate LLM outputs for correctness, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, consistency, and task completion . 
 - Implement automated evaluation methodologies including LLM-as-a-Judge , deterministic checks, model-based grading, and human evaluation. 
 - Test AI agents and agentic workflows including reasoning, tool/function calling, multi-step execution, state management, error handling, and recovery. 
 - Validate RAG pipelines , including retrieval quality, context relevance, grounding, citation accuracy, and response quality. 
 - Perform adversarial and security testing of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, unsafe tool execution, excessive agency, and access-control violations . 
 - Apply AI security methodologies such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and use appropriate AI red-teaming/security testing tools. 
 - Build automated regression suites to identify behavioral and quality degradation across prompt, model, agent, and application changes . 
 - Define AI quality metrics, dashboards, release gates, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Test AI systems across different models and configurations to validate reliability and model-independent behavior. 
 - Replicate customer environments through simulated data and usage patterns for realistic end-to-end testing. 
 - Partner with Software Engineering, AI Engineering, Product, and Architecture teams to embed quality engineering early in the SDLC . 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across Linux, Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, and AI application layers. 

AI QA Methodologies & Tools

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable: 

- LLM Evaluation: LLM-as-a-Judge, golden datasets, pairwise evaluation, rubric-based scoring, human-in-the-loop evaluation 
 - Evaluation Frameworks: DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals or equivalent 
 - Agent Testing: tool/function-call validation, trajectory evaluation, task-completion testing, multi-agent workflow testing 
 - RAG Evaluation: retrieval precision/recall, context relevance, faithfulness/groundedness, answer correctness 
 - AI Security: prompt injection, jailbreak testing, data-exfiltration testing, privilege/access-control testing, adversarial testing 
 - Security Frameworks/Tools: OWASP LLM guidance, Garak, PyRIT, Promptfoo or equivalent AI red-teaming tools 
 - Observability: tracing and evaluation of prompts, model responses, tool calls, agent decisions, latency, token usage, and failures

Qualifications

- Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - 6-8 years of experience in QA, SDET, software engineering, or test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test architecture, and software development lifecycle. 
 - Strong coding/scripting skills in Python ; Bash, JavaScript, or C experience is beneficial. 
 - Experience building automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines . 
 - Strong Linux command-line, debugging, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Experience with API, functional, integration, regression, performance, and security testing. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and virtualization . 
 - Hands-on exposure to LLMs, Generative AI applications, RAG, AI agents or Agentic AI Platforms . 
 - Understanding of LLM-specific failure modes including hallucination, non-determinism, prompt injection, and unsafe agent behavior. 
 - Experience with Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, or similar testing frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of HPC/AI infrastructure, networking, GPUs, or distributed systems is a plus. 

What Success Looks Like

Build a modern quality engineering practice where traditional software testing and AI evaluation come together , enabling us to ship infrastructure software and AI agents that are reliable, measurable, secure, and safe to operate in production . 

Location

Bangalore

Travel

data.title: Lead Mobile SDET
data.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences. 

At OneSpan we are looking for a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) - a strong software engineer who specializes in test - to architect and own our QA automation frameworks and strategy across the entire Mobile Security Suite (MSS) SDK portfolio. Our Mobile Security Suite (MSS) spans multiple SDKs across iOS, Android, and server-side platforms (. NET and Java). 

This is a hybrid role: part hands-on automation engineer, part technical lead. You will work alongside our Android automation developer, manual QA engineer, and feature developers, contribute directly to test automation across all MSS SDKs, and design the frameworks, tooling, strategy, and roadmap that take our QA practice to the next level. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead Test Strategy: Assess current automation coverage across all MSS SDKs (iOS, Android, server-side), identify gaps, and define the testing strategy, tooling, and project setup needed to close them. 
 - Contribute Hands-On: Design, write, and maintain automated tests across iOS, Android, and server-side SDKs - using AI coding tools and partnering with feature developers on platforms where you need extra language or domain support. 
 - Own the Pipelines: Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines (YAML), Bash scripts, and Gradle builds across our multiple SDK pipelines to run automated suites, stand up local/test servers, and integrate with real-device testing cloud solutions. 
 - Drive Planning & Reporting: Prepare quality and coverage reports, and bring recommendations and next steps to quarterly planning with engineering leadership. 
 - Mentor the Team: Guide the automation developers, feature developers, and QA engineers who contribute to automation; help formalize processes, code review standards, and best practices. 
 - Keep Growing: Stay current with mobile and server-side testing tools and frameworks; proactively identify and fill missing skills or tooling gaps on the team. 

Required Technical Skills

- Automation Leadership: 6+ years in software test automation, including experience defining test strategy and leading or mentoring other engineers. 
 - Framework Architecture: Proven track record designing, building, and maintaining test automation frameworks and harnesses from the ground up - abstraction layers, reusable components, test data and fixtures - not just writing tests against an existing suite. 
 - Mobile Automation Expertise: Deep hands-on mobile test automation in at least one mobile stack - iOS (Swift, XCTest/XCUITest) or Android (Kotlin, Compose Test/Espresso/UI Automator) - with the ability to extend to the other and to server-side, using AI coding tools and feature-developer support to bridge gaps. 
 - Test Infrastructure: Builds and owns the test infrastructure that runs the suites, including integration with the third-party real-device cloud services we use for tests that need real hardware. 
 - CI/CD & Scripting: GitLab CI and YAML pipeline authoring, Bash scripting, Gradle. 
 - Version Control: Git and standard branching / pull request workflows. 
 - Comfortable working across a multi-language, multi-platform codebase and picking up a new language or framework when a project requires it. 

Nice to Have

- Server-Side: Java, Spring or Spring Boot, JUnit 4 and JUnit 5. 
 - . NET / C# experience, to extend automation coverage to . NET-based server components. 
 - Experience testing security-sensitive SDKs (e. g. , anti-tampering, threat detection, RASP) or working in a regulated / security-conscious product environment. 
 - Prior experience leading or building a QA automation function from an early stage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong leadership and mentoring instincts, with the ability to influence without formal authority. 
 - Clear communicator, comfortable presenting test strategy, status, and risks to management. 
 - Analytical and gap-driven - able to look at a large, multi-platform codebase and identify where quality risk actually lives. 
 - Eager to learn and self-directed in closing skill or tooling gaps.

Value Realization & Performance Tracking

data.title: Lead Security Research Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

As a Lead Security Research Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for vulnerability research, exploit analysis, exposure validation, and vulnerability signature development across the Qualys security platform. You will lead initiatives to identify, validate, and prioritise security risks based on real-world exploitability, helping customers distinguish theoretical exposures from confirmed attack paths. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead vulnerability research initiatives across operating systems, databases, enterprise applications, cloud services, container platforms, and network devices. 
 - Research newly disclosed, N-day, and actively exploited vulnerabilities. 
 - Lead the development of exploit-based exposure validation techniques to confirm real-world exploitability of vulnerabilities. 
 - Review technical designs, research methodologies, and code contributions to ensure quality and consistency. 
 - Partner with Engineering and Product teams to influence roadmap decisions and security content strategy. 
 - Design safe and controlled validation mechanisms that emulate attacker behavior without affecting production systems. 
 - Analyze vulnerability root causes, attack vectors, exploitability conditions, and potential business impact. 
 - Mentor and guide Security Research Engineers on vulnerability analysis, exploit analysis, and signature creation. 
 - Build validation logic capable of determining whether existing security controls such as WAFs, firewalls, EDRs, IPS, and compensating controls effectively prevent exploitation. 
 - Drive automation initiatives for vulnerability research, exploit validation, content generation, testing, and release processes. 
 - Establish best practices, coding standards, and quality guidelines for signature development. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 8+ years of hands-on experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing, detection engineering, or security research. 
 - Deep understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SSH, SMTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, and modern web protocols. 
 - Strong expertise in vulnerability analysis, exploit development, and attack techniques. 
 - Extensive knowledge of operating systems, databases, web technologies, cloud environments, and enterprise infrastructure. 
 - Strong coding background. 
 - Experience with packet analysis, network troubleshooting, and protocol reverse engineering. 
 - Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, common attack techniques, and modern threat actor tactics. 
 - Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading projects and mentoring technical teams. 

Additional Plus Competencies: 

Understanding of Lua (preferred), Bash, or Python. 

Knowledge of Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Oracle, etc. ).

OSCP, CISSP, or SANS GIAC certifications.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
About the job : 

Complyance is a fast-growing e-invoicing and tax compliance SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia's ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding their finance systems every time a regulation changes. 

We have built a strong base in MENA and India, our platform is live across 10+ jurisdictions, and we are now expanding into Europe and the US. 

We are building a developer-first e-invoicing platform for businesses, enterprises and ecosystem partners: secure, dependable APIs and integrations, with an exceptional developer and customer experience. 

Life at Complyance : 

We are a lean, high-ownership team that cares about doing the basics exceptionally well. Our work is visible, our decisions matter, and we are looking for people who want to shape how a company grows, not just keep it running. 

The mission : 

This is not a role for managing from the sidelines. You will be the hands-on engineering leader who shapes our technology platform, builds a high-performing team and sets the engineering practices needed to scale a regulated, transaction-focused SaaS business. 

You will report to the CTO and work closely with the founders and product leadership, with direct influence over product architecture, engineering culture and team formation. You will stay technically engaged: in architecture reviews, design discussions and the critical technical decisions. 

Where you'll leave your mark : 

•        Set the engineering direction:   Own engineering strategy and execution for our e-invoicing platform, including the technical roadmap, architecture decisions and the management of technical debt. 

•        Build APIs people trust:   Own the architecture and delivery of secure, scalable APIs, SDKs, webhooks and enterprise integrations, and the developer experience around them. 

•        Keep the platform reliable:   Own reliability, availability, observability, security and production operations. 

•        Grow the team:   Lead engineering hiring, mentoring, performance and team development. 

•        Raise the engineering bar:   Run the practices that keep quality high: design reviews, testing, releases, incident response and postmortems. 

•        Work across the business:   Collaborate with product, customer success, implementation, compliance and enterprise customers. 

The kind of leader we're looking for : 

You'll likely thrive in this role if you: 

•        Have 8-12 years of software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams. 

•        Have a strong background in backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms and API design. 

•        Are tech-savvy, with a strong command of advanced technologies and modern engineering tools. 

•        Have built or operated high-volume, transaction-oriented SaaS platforms. 

•        Can manage, coach and grow high-performing engineers. 

•        Know production reliability, observability, incident management and secure software delivery. 

•        Bring strong product thinking, execution discipline and customer orientation. 

•        Are comfortable in a fast-moving startup with ambiguity and significant ownership. 

•        Communicate clearly, in writing and in conversation. 

And as a person, you: 

•        Combine people leadership with strong technical judgement. 

•        Operate with high ownership and low ego. 

•        Make pragmatic decisions with limited time and resources. 

•        Move comfortably between architecture, hiring, delivery, customers and production issues. 

•        Build simple, reliable systems rather than introducing unnecessary complexity. 

•        Care deeply about API quality, security, documentation and developer experience. 

Bonus points : 

•        Experience in payments, fintech, invoicing, tax technology, accounting, ERP or compliance platforms. 

•        Experience with external APIs, SDKs, webhooks, authentication, rate limiting, versioning, retries and idempotency. 

•        Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and enterprise integration architecture. 

•        Experience handling sensitive financial or business information. 

•        Experience with government, tax-authority, Peppol or other regulated-network integrations. 

•        Experience at a FAANG company (Facebook/Meta, Amazon, Apple, Netflix or Google), Amazon/AWS, or another high-scale product engineering organisation. This is an added advantage, not a requirement. 

Why Complyance?

•        Competitive base salary. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates. 

•        Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family and paid time off. 

•        The chance to build for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world. 

•        A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter. 

How to apply

- Apply on LinkedIn, or share the profile of someone you think is a strong fit. Please include the candidate's current location, notice period, present role and LinkedIn profile.

About The Role

PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high-performance, low-latency, scalable, and privacy-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency. 

The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app-open, playable, and video ads. 

The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad-tech domain expertise and experience building real-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML-integrated and data-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic's mobile app ecosystem. 

What You'll Do

- Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in-app behavioral data using on-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities. 
 - Build and optimize SSP-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP-specific troubleshooting. 
 - Design mobile-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high-value in-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior. 
 - Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app-open, playable, and in-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward-callback correctness. 
 - Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well-represented, privacy-compliant, format-compatible, attribution-ready, and supply-quality-aware mobile app requests. 
 - Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app-ads. txt, sellers. json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low-quality partner supply detection. 
 - Support privacy-aware and attribution-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy-safe fallback when user-level identifiers are unavailable.

We'd Love for You to Have

Bonus Qualifications

Why Join Us?

data.title: I&E Design Engineering Lead
data.description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world's current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies. 

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world's growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all. 

About the position

Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a I&E Design Engineering Lead (LNG) to join the Facilities Design Engineering team. Reporting to the Facilities Design Engineering Manager, this role will be based in Chevron's office in Bengaluru. 

Supervises a team that designs, selects, tests, installs, monitors, modifies, and maintains safe and reliable process automation systems and electrical infrastructure ?for new and existing facilities. The team utilizes process automation systems (PAS) including process control systems (PCS), safety instrumented systems (SIS)/instrumented protective systems (IPS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems and associated applications. Optimize process automation system integrity, reliability, safety, and efficiency. In addition, the team supports site MOC work packages and project design assurance for the Instrumentation & Control (I&C) as well as Electrical engineering disciplines. 

Manages group and employee work to align with corporate/department objectives. Direct reports are typically technical individual contributors from I&C and Electrical disciplines. 

Key responsibilities

- Supervise, coach, mentor, and develop I&E Design Engineers providing leadership and guidance on standard tools and processes such as Engineering Work Orders, Management of Change, Chevrons Turnaround process and Root Cause Analysis techniques. 
 - Sets clear expectations and support creation and management of individuals' performance and development plans
 - Partner with customers and stakeholders to prioritize the team's workload. Ensure the team is appropriately resourced to meet the customer's needs and business plan commitments
 - Responsible for the timeliness and quality of team deliverables including Engineering Work Orders as well as technical and constructability reviews
 - Collaborate with other Designs Engineering Team Leads to manage Designs Engineering department organizational capabilities and competencies
 - Promote a continual improvement mindset while removing barriers and seeking simple, fit-for-purpose solutions
 - Provide leadership in sharing information and resources across the business units
 - Utilize Chevron and Industry Engineering Standards for Safety in Designs
 - Leverage expertise and knowledge of electrical power systems and codes, instrumentation and control design, safety instrumented systems, process control systems, field instrument selection and sizing, equipment procurement, field construction and repair practices, process safety information, management of change work process and process control and monitoring to coach and develop team. 
 - Support department recruiting and hiring efforts. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Minimum of 10-15 years relevant experience performing I&E Engineering in an Oil & Gas operating environment
 - Demonstrated supervisory experience will be highly regarded
 - Bachelor's degree in instrumentation or electrical engineering (B. E. /B. Tech. ) from a deemed/recognized (AICTE) university

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of refinery and LNG process technologies will be highly regarded
 - Knowledge of Australian electrical legislation and codes

What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way. 

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace. 

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work. 

Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration. 

Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron's values and business priorities. 

Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. 

Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise. 

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8: 00 AM to 5: 00 PM or 1: 30 PM to 10: 30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.
