data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Arista's cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network - using protocols like 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI - and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time. 

The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function - not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product. 

You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features - authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding - primarily in Go. 
 - Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e. g. , RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves. 
 - Build and extend internal test utility libraries - simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers - and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis on test failures - distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it. 
 - Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented - shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end. 
 - Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers. 
 - Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the team's test framework. 
 - Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews - identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field. 
 - 3-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering - not just manual testing. 
 - Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols - 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing - designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code. 
 - Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) - writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability. 
 - Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication - test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up. 

Good To Have

- Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS). 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) - knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior. 
 - Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios. 
 - Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) - validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted. 

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

Summary

Position Summary

Mobile Test Engineer

ConvergeSPORTS (USI) | Associate Analyst

About The Role

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics. 

This role sits within the Mobile App product team. The ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App is a fan-facing digital product that brings together content, identity, engagement, personalization, notifications, and commercial experiences. The team owns the end-to-end fan journey and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases. 

This role owns quality for the fan-facing mobile experience across Android and iOS. You are the last line of defense before a release reaches fans, and the first person to know when something is not right. 

Key Responsibilities

Own Test Coverage

- Design, write, and execute manual and automated test cases for new and existing Mobile App features
 - Build and maintain automated UI test suites for Android using frameworks such as Espresso or Appium
 - Validate API responses and data integrity across content, identity, personalization, and notification features

Find and Drive Out Defects

- Log, triage, and track defects through resolution, working with Engineering to reproduce and verify fixes
 - Perform regression, exploratory, and smoke testing ahead of App Store and Play Store releases
 - Monitor crash reports, analytics, and post-release quality metrics to catch emerging issues early

Ship as One Team

- Join sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness reviews to define coverage and acceptance criteria
 - Work day to day with Android and iOS Engineering, Product, and Design to clarify expected behavior
 - Document test plans, results, and known issues so the team can act on them quickly

Raise the Bar

- Improve testing practices, tooling, and automation coverage over time rather than repeating manual effort

Reporting Relationships

Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with Android and iOS Engineering, Backend Engineering, and Design, and partners with Product Management on release readiness. 

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
 - 1+ years of experience in manual or automated testing of mobile applications on Android or iOS
 - Experience writing and executing test cases and test plans
 - Familiarity with at least one mobile test automation framework, such as Espresso, Appium, or XCUITest
 - Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries you serve. 
 - Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. 

Preferred

- Experience with API testing tools such as Postman
 - Experience with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira and TestRail
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for mobile app testing
 - Experience testing consumer-facing mobile apps in sports, media, or entertainment

Core Competencies

- Detail-oriented and methodical about reproducing and isolating defects
 - Writes issues engineers can act on immediately
 - Comfortable working across Android and iOS in a fast-moving environment
 - Collaborative with engineering, product, and design
 - Curious about mobile platforms and motivated to improve how testing gets done

Why This Role Matters

A single bad release costs fan trust that takes months to earn back. This role protects that, and it is a direct path into deeper mobile engineering and automation work on a product people use every week. 

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

 - Perform root cause analysis and assist developers in troubleshooting issues. 
 - Validate cloud services, server applications, APIs, and integrated security solutions. 
 - Test integrations between video management systems, access control systems, and third- party platforms. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, test coverage, and automation efficiency. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvements in QA processes and automation coverage. 
 - Take ownership of assigned features and ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

- Create and execute test cases and test scenarios. 
 - Automate repetitive test cases using Python, Robot Framework, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools. 
 - Perform API testing using Postman, Swagger, REST APIs, or similar tools. 
 - Validate logs, databases, and system behavior during issue investigation. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives. 
 - Support both manual and automation testing activities based on project needs. 
 - Collaborate effectively with development, QA, support, and product teams. 
 - Utilize GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Atlassian Rovo, or similar AI tools to accelerate testing and analysis activities. 

What We Look For Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in Software QA, Test Automation, or Software Testing. 
 - Experience performing manual and automation testing. 
 - Experience testing web applications, APIs, and client-server applications. 
 - Knowledge of automation tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, or similar technologies. 
 - Understanding of software testing concepts, SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle. 
 - Experience using Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, or similar test management tools. 
 - Basic knowledge of Linux, Windows, and networking fundamentals. 
 - Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams. 
 - Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts. 
 - Good troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Exacq, Cloudvue, Enterprise Manager, VideoEdge, CCure, Kantech, or similar security platforms. 
 - Experience with Access Control, Video Surveillance, Enterprise Monitoring, or Physical Security products. 
 - Experience with REST APIs and microservices. 
 - Knowledge of SQL and database validation. 
 - Experience testing Android and iOS applications. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, or cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience using GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-assisted engineering tools. 
 - Understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, ports, protocols, and Wireshark. 
 - Exposure to performance, scalability, and reliability testing. 

Desired Characteristics

- Strong ownership and accountability. 
 - Willingness to work on both manual and automation testing. 
 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies. 
 - Self-motivated and proactive problem solver. 
 - Ability to work beyond assigned stories when needed to help the team achieve sprint goals. 
 - Strong collaboration skills and positive attitude. 
 - Interest in AI-assisted engineering and continuous improvement. 

Location

- Hybrid position based in India. 
 - Hyderabad or Gurgaon preferred. 
 - Ability to collaborate with global teams and provide overlap with EST business hours as needed.

data.title: QA Engineer - Core Business Systems
data.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on QA Automation to establish, implement, and drive a comprehensive quality assurance strategy across the CBS platform estate - ServiceNow (ITSM), Salesforce and NetSuite (CRM/ERP), Boomi (integrations), OpenAir, and Anaplan - alongside the enterprise-level integrations connecting them. This role requires a strong focus on test automation, integration testing, and data validation, alongside leadership to define best practices and ensure system reliability across the estate. The ideal candidate will also bring an understanding of cloud-native testing principles and security testing requirements at a high level. 

You will work as a hands-on contributor within CBS, leading by example, building automation frameworks, and driving testing across all six platforms and the workflows that connect them. 

What You Will Do: 

Test Automation Framework Development

Design, Develop, And Maintain Robust Test Automation Frameworks For: 

- UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright - covering ServiceNow, Salesforce, and NetSuite front ends
 - API Testing: Postman, REST Assured - covering Boomi integration endpoints and platform APIs
 - Data Validation: Python scripting with SQL integration - covering cross-platform data flows between Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, OpenAir, and Anaplan
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins or Azure DevOps to ensure seamless testing during deployments across the CBS estate. 
 - Maintain clean, reusable, and well-documented test scripts for consistent results across all platforms. 

Metrics: 

- Achieve 70-80% test automation coverage for critical CBS workflows within 12 months. 
 - Ensure automation stability with <5% failure rates across regression runs. 

Functional, Integration, and Regression Testing

- Conduct functional testing to validate workflows, integrations, and system updates across CBS platforms. 
 - Perform end-to-end integration testing across ServiceNow (ITSM), Salesforce and NetSuite (CRM/ERP), Boomi (integration layer), OpenAir, and Anaplan. 
 - Automate data validation testing to ensure consistency and accuracy across systems, using SQL and Python scripts - with particular attention to Boomi-mediated data flows as integration scripting is rewritten for ongoing platform compliance. 

Metrics: 

- Maintain <10% defect leakage post-production, improving to <5% as automation matures. 

Performance and Load Testing

- Use tools like JMeter or Locust to conduct performance testing to measure response times and system scalability across CBS platforms. 
 - Establish performance benchmarks for critical workflows and collaborate with the Data and Integrations lead and platform owners to address bottlenecks. 

Metrics: 

- Ensure systems meet defined performance SLAs under expected and peak load conditions. 

Cloud-Native Testing and Monitoring (High Level)

- Understand cloud-native testing principles for monitoring system availability, scalability, and resource utilisation across the CBS estate (e. g. , AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor).

5+ Years

Bangalore

Full-Time

Real‐Time Systems Integration

Artificial Intelligence & Sensor Fusion

 - Supports validation of perception and prediction systems against ground truth, field data, and applicable standards or guidelines.

Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Applies multiple vendor‐provided or in‐house SDLC methodologies with testing embedded across all phases. 
 - Converts requirements into robust, reviewable designs with explicit verification and testability considerations.

Software Development

Problem Solving & Technical Troubleshooting

Knowledge of structured problem‐solving methods and advanced troubleshooting techniques across organizational, hardware, software, and system domains; ability to resolve high‐impact issues.

FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA

Now home to 1, 000+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data & Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech & Analytics. 

Our Values define us. They are - Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day. 

They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day. 

Overview Of The Role

Flutter Functions' AI & Automation team is looking for an expert AI Engineering Lead to build and lead a unit of 2-3 AI developers. You will be responsible for the technical vision and execution of Flutter's enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms , using internal data to enhance productivity and decision-making across our global sports betting and gaming operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining AI engineering, architecture, people leadership and cross-functional teamwork . You will shape engineering standards, make key architectural decisions, mentor your team, and help deliver production-grade AI systems serving over 20 million customers across 20+ regulated markets. 

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Set the technical direction for our enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms, making architectural decisions across LLM inference, agentic frameworks, context engineering, guardrails and system design . 
 - Own the selection, deployment and optimisation of LLM inference systems including AWS Bedrock and LiteLLM , with a focus on model routing, cost, latency and operational excellence. 
 - Design production-grade context pipelines, RAG systems and prompt architectures , establishing patterns, standards and evaluation practices for the team. 
 - Guide architectural decisions around token economics, context limits, latency budgets and capability-to-cost trade-offs . 
 - Establish robust guardrails, security and Responsible AI practices , addressing prompt injection, data leakage, authentication, access control and sensitive data handling across regulated markets. 
 - Make informed technology choices across agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands and ADK , and establish scalable orchestration and tool-use patterns. 
 - Own problems end-to-end, from LLM integration and backend services through to user-facing interfaces, APIs and integrations using AWS services, MCP and modern engineering standards . 

People Leadership

- Build, lead and mentor a pod of 2-3 AI developers , supporting their technical and career growth. 
 - Establish engineering standards through code reviews, architectural guidance and continuous technical development . 
 - Lead the team through production incidents, complex technical challenges and post-mortems, driving systemic improvements. 
 - Develop a culture of learning, experimentation, psychological safety and continuous improvement , while encouraging the team to challenge assumptions and take calculated technical risks. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and prioritise high-impact work. 
 - Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into Flutter's existing infrastructure. 
 - Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, present architectural decisions to leadership, and influence technical direction across teams. 

TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED

Core Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI or a related STEM field , with 8-12 years of software development experience, including 2-3+ years focused on AI/ML or agentic systems development. 
 - Experience leading or mentoring technical teams , with the ability to establish technical direction and drive delivery through others. 
 - Advanced Python and backend engineering skills, including production experience with FastAPI, Flask and async patterns . 
 - Hands-on expertise with AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM or similar LLM inference platforms , including model routing, API design, cost optimisation and production deployment. 
 - Strong experience in context engineering, RAG and prompt architecture , and ability to evaluate trade-offs and design production-grade solutions. 
 - Deep experience with 2-3+ agentic frameworks , such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, ADK or CrewAI , including orchestration, tool use and multi-agent patterns. 
 - Experience designing and implementing guardrails, content filtering and Responsible AI practices in production environments. 
 - Strong AI security fundamentals , including prompt injection, data exfiltration, model misuse, OAuth, JWT and least-privilege design. 
 - Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenCode , and ability to validate AI-generated code and guide others in their use. 
 - Expert knowledge of software engineering fundamentals , including SDLC, Git, API design, system architecture and collaborative engineering. 
 - Exceptional communication and influencing skills - ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and build consensus without relying on formal authority. 

Highly Desirable Skills

- Full-stack experience across React, TypeScript, backend services and AI integration . 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating production RAG systems and vector databases , including Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch or Weaviate. 
 - Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its implementation in AI agent systems. 
 - Contributions to AI/ML or agentic open-source frameworks such as LangChain or CrewAI. 
 - Experience in gaming, sports betting, financial services or other heavily regulated environments . 
 - A track record of growing engineers, building high-performing teams or leading technical initiatives that delivered material business impact. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity and thought leadership in AI, with an appetite for emerging technologies and the ability to form and defend informed technology choices. 

Benefits We Offer

- Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling. 
 - Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs. 
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents. 
 - Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year. 
 - Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness. 
 - Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals. 
 - Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance. 
 - Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance. 
 - Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares. 
 - Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections. 
 - Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards. 

WHY CHOOSE US

Flutter is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential. 

We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.

data.title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - DB
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - DB builds and runs Database Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 

Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Related Experience Required

- Overall, 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Strong experience as Database Engineer and/or Architect
 - Deep understanding of Relational Database technologies (MSSQL, PostgreSQL)
 - Understanding of modern database & storage technologies (NoSQL, Caching Services, Time-Series Database, Vector Database, Spatial Database)
 - Experience as a DBA
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. 
 - undefined
 - Familiarity and hands on with Traditional Database Products (Oracle)
 - undefined
 - Knowledge of cloud cost methodology. 
 - Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Administration, Database Architecture, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, NoSQL, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Times Series, Vector Databases, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.

We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We are seeking a skilled Senior IT Applications(Java Full Stack Developer) to join our Open Systems Development & Support -CAT IT Division Bangalore Team. 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer - Java Full Stack Developer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable applications with a focus on Warranty Systems. Experience in Manufacturing or Supply Chain domains is a strong advantage. 

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore PSN Office, KA-India

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and maintain full stack Java applications, including both frontend and backend components. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions. 
 - Ensure the scalability, performance, and reliability of applications. 
 - Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to maintain code quality. 
 - Support and enhance existing applications, particularly within Warranty Systems.

 - Document software designs, processes, and implementation details. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements.

 - Explains phases, activities, dependencies, deliverables, and key decision points.

Software Integration Engineering: Knowledge of software integration processes and functions; ability to design, develop and maintain interfaces and linkage to alternative platforms and software packages.

 - Cites examples of common linkage requirements for software products and vendors. 
 - Works with integrating software into the customer or partner framework and infrastructure. 
 - Participates in the development of technology interfaces and bridges. 

Software Product Design/Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design. 

Level Extensive Experience: 

- Demonstrates experience with the architecture and design of major or multiple products. 
 - Describes major software architecture alternatives and considerations. 
 - Explains design considerations for commercial database systems, operating systems and web. 
 - Displays experience in estimating the cost of a specific design of a proposed product. 
 - Facilitates design reviews and walkthroughs. 
 - Analyzes benefits and drawbacks of specific software designs and architecture. 

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products.

Software Product Testing: Knowledge of software product testing; ability to design, plan, and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure software product quality and adherence to stated requirements.

data.title: Principal ASIC Verification Engineer - DDR/LPDDR
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You understand that verification is not about writing tests, it is about building an environment where the right bugs cannot hide, and you have the scars from finding those bugs at 2am to prove it. 

Leading a team does not mean delegating tasks, it means knowing when to step in, when to let someone struggle productively, and when to rewrite the testbench architecture because the current one will not scale. You have worked with RTL designers who swear their code is clean and architects who change the spec on Thursday, and you have learned to build verification strategies that survive both. 

Memory protocols like DDR or LPDDR do not intimidate you. Serial interfaces, complex checkers, SystemVerilog assertions that actually mean something, these are tools you reach for without thinking. You care about functional coverage because it tells you what you have not tested yet, not because it is a metric someone asked for. At Synopsys, you will work on DesignWare IP that powers real products, with a team that takes verification as seriously as you do. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of verification engineers through full IP verification cycles, from test plan definition through coverage closure and signoff
 - Build and evolve SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments for DesignWare synthesizable IP cores, ensuring they scale across multiple product generations
 - Define test plans that cover corner cases, protocol compliance, and system-level interactions, then review and guide implementation across the team
 - Write and debug complex testbenches, checkers, and assertions for serial interface protocols and memory controllers, including DDR and LPDDR where applicable
 - Extract, analyze, and drive functional coverage and code coverage metrics to closure, identifying gaps and adjusting strategy in real time
 - Collaborate directly with RTL designers, digital architects, and circuit teams to align verification scope with design intent and catch issues early
 - Manage regression infrastructure and work with the infra team to keep verification cycles efficient and reliable

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver verification signoff on IP cores that ship in millions of devices, ensuring they work correctly the first time in silicon
 - Raise the bar for verification quality across the DesignWare team by mentoring engineers and evolving testbench architecture and methodology
 - Catch critical bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months of schedule and customer trust
 - Influence IP architecture decisions by surfacing verification insights early, when design changes are still cheap
 - Help shape how the team adopts AI-assisted verification flows, improving efficiency without sacrificing rigor
 - Contribute to Synopsys' leadership in IP by ensuring that what we deliver is not just feature-complete but robustly verified
 - Build verification environments and strategies that other teams will reuse and learn from, multiplying your impact across the organization

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering with 8+ years of hands-on verification experience
 - Proven track record leading verification teams through IP project delivery, including planning, execution, and signoff
 - Strong experience developing SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches from scratch and evolving them as designs grow
 - Deep expertise writing test plans, implementing checkers, and building assertions that catch real bugs
 - Proficiency extracting and interpreting functional coverage and code coverage, and using those metrics to drive verification closure
 - Experience verifying serial interface protocols and working through IP design and verification processes, knowledge of DDR or LPDDR protocols is a strong plus
 - Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end verification deliverables, including metric closure and formal review signoff, experience with AI-assisted verification tools is a plus

Who You Are

- You can explain a coverage hole to an architect in two sentences and walk out with a plan to close it
 - You debug by hypothesis, not by adding print statements until something makes sense
 - When a testbench is too slow or too brittle, you refactor it instead of working around it
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes the code pass
 - You work across time zones and teams without losing context or creating confusion downstream
 - You know when to push back on a design decision and when to adjust the verification plan to match reality

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join Synopsys' DesignWare IP Verification R&D team in Bangalore, working with a global group of experienced verification engineers who are responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of IP cores that power semiconductors across the industry. This team collaborates closely with RTL designers, architects, and infrastructure engineers to deliver robust, production-ready IP. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Cloud Native builds and runs automation scripts and tools (IaC / Terraform) to streamline provisioning, configuration, and management of Cloud PaaS and Serverless Services, and sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Educational Background

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in Cloud PaaS and Serverless Technologies across Azure, Azure Local and GCP
 - Proficient in writing scripts using Terraform, Python, Ansible, Json and PowerShell
 - Experience with building, configuring and managing Cloud AI Services (e. g. Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Google Document AI, BigQuery AI)
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Strong expertise in Azure/GCP application services (e. g. Logic Apps, Function Apps, App Services, cloud run, pub/sub) for designing and implementing scalable, secure, and cloud-native solutions. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. 
 - Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

#AGTech

Ansible (Software), API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), JSON APIs, Microsoft PowerShell, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Python (Programming Language), Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

We are looking for a strong Quality Engineering candidate who can flex across MTS-2 and MTS-3 expectations depending on depth of experience, ownership, and technical maturity. This role is ideal for someone who brings deep hands-on automation skills with solid manual testing foundations, and who is excited to work on products spanning mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and large-scale data pipelines. 

This person will work across Nielsen Pulse / Streaming+, EMM / panel applications, and adjacent digital measurement platforms. The role requires end-to-end quality ownership across user journeys, platform integrations, data collection flows, and backend validation in a domain where correctness, scale, and platform diversity matter. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable testing not just UI behavior, but also events, telemetry, APIs, databases, data pipelines, and platform-specific edge cases across Android, iOS, web, and TV environments. They should be able to design robust automation, perform deep debugging, and partner closely with engineering, product, data, and operations teams to ship high-quality releases. 

Qualifications

- Own test strategy, planning, execution, and sign-off for features spanning manual and automation coverage
 - Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing
 - Validate complex end-to-end flows across mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and data pipelines
 - Perform deep validation of data correctness across logs, APIs, databases, batch jobs, event streams, and downstream reports
 - Design test cases for large-volume, high-variability, real-world datasets and platform combinations
 - Investigate production issues, reproduce complex defects, and drive root-cause analysis with engineering teams
 - Validate streaming/data donation flows, permissions, onboarding, telemetry, reward logic, and panel-related workflows
 - Partner with developers, product managers, designers, data engineers, and stakeholders to ensure quality from requirements through release
 - Improve CI/CD quality gates, regression coverage, release confidence, and defect prevention practices
 - Contribute to test planning for new devices, OS upgrades, beta releases, and cross-platform compatibility validation

 - Strong understanding of API testing, service validation, and backend workflow testing
 - Experience validating large datasets, event pipelines, reporting outputs, or analytics systems
 - Strong SQL and data validation skills, including comparison of source vs processed outputs
 - Experience debugging issues using logs, network traces, device logs, browser tools, and backend evidence
 - Strong understanding of test design, regression planning, edge-case identification, and defect lifecycle management
 - Experience working in Agile teams with cross-functional collaboration
 - Ability to independently own features, drive clarity in ambiguous situations, and balance speed with quality

- Experience in panel, measurement, attribution, or data donation ecosystems

data.title: Sr Quality Engineer
data.description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. 

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. 

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. 

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. 

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

- Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins. 
 - Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices. 
 - Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team. 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers. 
 - Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production. 
 - Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems - including reconciliation checks - to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions. 
 - Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions. 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions. 
 - Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit. 
 - Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability. 
 - Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction. 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team - identifying dependencies and escalating risks early. 
 - Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes. 
 - Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery. 
 - Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

·                Prepare and maintain procurement schedules and long-lead material requirements in coordination with project programmes and approved technical submittals. 

·                Liaise with Procurement, Stores and Production teams to ensure the correct materials and specifications are available when required, and highlight risks early. 

·                Provide technical support to manufacturing and installation teams, resolving design interfaces, fabrication constraints and site-specific technical problems. 

·                Investigate installation and product performance issues, establish root causes and implement practical corrective measures to prevent recurrence. 

·                Coordinate technical responses and support to customers and project teams on system specifications, installation details and product performance. 

4. Product Engineering, Quality and Improvement

·                Drive value engineering initiatives to improve manufacturability, installation efficiency, product reliability and cost effectiveness without compromising approved performance. 

·                Support new product and system development, component selection, prototyping, testing, certification and performance improvement initiatives. 

·                Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders on suitable alternatives for aluminium profiles, glass, hardware, seals, gaskets and related components. 

·                Maintain controlled records of technical specifications, approved system details, certificates, testing reports and product documentation for use across Kaprel locations. 

·                Analyze recurring technical errors, nonconformities and rework costs; recommend design standardization and preventive improvements. 

5. Reporting and Accountability

·                Provide regular updates to the General Manager on technical submission status, departmental workload, approval delays, unresolved technical risks and improvement initiatives. 

·                Coordinate closely with regional Kaprel teams so requirements and approved technical documentation are consistent, while respecting differences in local project specifications and standards. 

·                Escalate deviations involving unapproved system changes, project cost impact, contractual scope or technical performance before implementation. 

Qualifications and Experience

·                Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline. 

·                Minimum 6 years of relevant construction or subcontracting experience, preferably in the glazing, architectural aluminium, partition or door systems industry. 

·                Prior experience managing technical work and coordinating with main contractors, consultants and clients. 

·                Good knowledge of project specifications, technical documentation, material approvals and subcontract scope management. 

·                Ability to interpret engineering drawings and coordinate fabrication, procurement and installation requirements; proficiency with AutoCAD and relevant technical tools is advantageous. 

·                Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and team management skills; comfortable coordinating technical deliverables across multiple locations.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place. 

About The Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

- AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up. 
 - Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap. 

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

8th Element

📍 Walk-In Interview - Hyderabad

10th Floor, Sri Harsha ICON, Narsingh, Nanakramguda Service Road, Financial District, Telangana - 500032

Date: 24th October, 2026

Build systems that solve hard problems. 

8th Element is an AI-first engineering company focused on turning technology into measurable business outcomes. We build systems for complex enterprise challenges, including healthcare workflows, clinical intelligence, payment integrity and knowledge-intensive operations. 

We're looking for a strong backend engineer who combines technical depth, intellectual curiosity, ownership and the ability to lead through engineering. Someone who can reason through complex problems, make sound architectural decisions, take systems into production and help other engineers grow. 

You don't need to be an AI expert. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies matter more. 

What You'll Work On

Backend systems and architecture: Design and build reliable backend services, APIs, data models, enterprise integrations and distributed workflows. 

Technical exploration: Research unfamiliar technologies, evaluate approaches, develop proofs of concept and validate assumptions before committing to a solution. 

Complex problem-solving: Investigate difficult technical issues, identify root causes and reason through trade-offs involving performance, reliability, scalability and cost. 

End-to-end ownership: Take systems from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, observability and production support. 

Technical leadership: Guide design decisions, mentor engineers, conduct meaningful code reviews and raise the team's engineering standards. 

AI-powered systems: Depending on the project, work on LLM applications, retrieval systems, AI agents and intelligent workflows. 

What We're Looking For

Strong engineering fundamentals-

Strong programming skills in Python or another backend language, with the ability to become productive in Python. 

Experience building production backend services and APIs, with a solid understanding of system design, databases, SQL and data modelling. 

Familiarity with asynchronous programming, concurrency, distributed systems and failure handling. 

Experience with testing, CI/CD, Docker, cloud deployments and production debugging. 

Technical depth and problem-solving-

You understand the reasoning and trade-offs behind your technical decisions, not just how to implement them. 

You can break down ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions and investigate root causes systematically. 

You can navigate unfamiliar codebases and technologies, learn quickly and make progress without needing detailed instructions. 

You care about code quality, simplicity, reliability and long-term maintainability. 

Ownership and technical leadership-

You've taken ownership of a service, subsystem, major feature or significant engineering initiative. 

You've mentored other engineers, guided implementation decisions or helped improve a team's technical capabilities. 

You can make decisions with incomplete information, identify risks early and take responsibility for outcomes. 

You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively and can lead through technical credibility rather than relying on formal authority. 

Good To Have, Not Required

Experience with LLMs, GenAI, AI agents, RAG, vector databases, model evaluation or AI observability is valuable. 

We don't expect expertise across a particular AI technology stack. We'd rather hire a strong systems engineer who can learn AI than someone who knows AI frameworks but lacks engineering depth. 

How We Work

We're a small team where engineers help shape the problem, not just implement a predefined specification. You'll work directly with engineers, product leaders, domain experts and clients, contributing to technical research, architecture, implementation and production operations. 

We use AI extensively in our engineering workflows. We expect you to use these tools effectively while retaining the judgment to evaluate their output, understand the code and own what you ship. 

You'll have the opportunity to influence our engineering practices, build reusable capabilities and help shape the technical direction of a growing AI-first company. 

We're looking for engineers who think deeply, take ownership and make the people around them better.

FlexTrade Systems is a global leader in high-performance multi-asset execution management and order management systems for equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, futures, and options. A pioneer in the field, FlexTrade is internationally recognized for introducing FlexTRADER®, the world's first broker-neutral, execution management trading system, which allows clients to completely control and customize their execution workflows through a comprehensive ability to search/access liquidity while maintaining the confidentiality of their trading strategies. 

At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to an ever-changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to every interaction, and we continue to improve, grow together, and collaborate as one team. All of these, while having Fun, truly make FlexTrade a wonderful place to work. 

About you: 

We are seeking a highly motivated, technically curious engineer who thrives on solving complex challenges in a fast‐paced trading environment. As part of the FX Development & Client Services team, you will architect high‐performance FX trading components, build low‐latency integrations with leading global market participants, and work directly with traders and technologists to shape next‐generation FX workflows. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys breaking down complexity into well‐defined technical solutions and wants to continuously grow as financial products and markets evolve.

 - Produce clear technical designs, architecture documents, and workflow specifications. 
 - Continuously learn and adapt to new products, markets, and trading technologies as financial systems evolve. Job requirements

 - Strong problem‐solving and debugging skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into clear, actionable tasks.

 - Excellent communication skills for working across technical and business teams.

Within the finance transformation business, we work with forward-looking organizations to optimize financial operations, enhance decision-making and align finance with business objectives. Our services span organization structure, technology enablement and process improvement. 

What's in it for you?

An opportunity to lead a combined finance operations team while working closely with clients and international stakeholders. You will gain exposure to global finance processes across Cash Applications and P2P, ERP systems, team management and opportunities to improve and streamline existing processes. 

Role Description Lead the day-to-day delivery of Cash Applications and Procure-to-Pay activities for a global client, ensuring service quality, timely delivery and effective issue resolution. Leadership, stakeholder management, accounting and process knowledge, analytical and problem solving ability, ownership and follow-through, SLA and deadline orientation, escalation management, coaching and team development, continuous improvement mindset.
