We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the Barco CTRL Workflow Innovation team and support the development of a new AI-driven product from the ground up. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities. 

- Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, environment management, configuration, and deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code practices. 
 - Enable deployment and operation of AI/ML workloads, including model serving, inference workflows, RAG-based components, vector search services, and related data/AI services. 
 - Support cloud-to-edge deployment and operational patterns for AI capabilities, including lightweight model packaging, inference deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management for Edge AI scenarios. 
 - Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities. 
 - Support secure handling of product data, secrets, access control, compliance needs, and cloud security best practices. 
 - Work closely with Data & AI engineers and product teams to improve developer experience, release readiness, test automation, and operational reliability. 
 - Guide and mentor fellow colleagues in DevOps, cloud, and AI/MLOps practices while contributing to technical discussions and engineering excellence. 

Qualifications and Experience

Education

We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains: 

B. Tech. /B. E. /M. E. /M. Tech. in Computer Science/AI Engineering

Experience

- 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud platform engineering, SRE, AI/MLOps, or related product engineering roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GCP is required, including relevant cloud-native compute, storage, networking, IAM, observability, and deployment services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications, backend services, data pipelines, and AI/ML workloads. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/MLOps practices, including model deployment, model serving, inference workflows, experiment tracking, model versioning, and release automation for AI-enabled product features. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and environment automation using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Good understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, network security, secure deployment patterns, and least-privilege access. 
 - Experience setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA-oriented reliability practices, and incident response workflows. 
 - Exposure to data and AI platforms or services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI Vector Search, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, vector databases, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience supporting RAG-based applications, GenAI-enabled services, model APIs, or AI inference platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Exposure to Edge AI concepts, hybrid cloud-edge deployments, on-device or near-device inference, model optimization, and operational constraints such as latency, reliability, connectivity, and resource usage is desirable. 
 - Good programming and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or similar languages, with ability to build automation and internal tooling. 
 - Understanding of DevSecOps practices, automated testing, quality gates, vulnerability scanning, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices. 
 - Ability to collaborate with cloud partners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, product owners, and validation teams across geographies. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership, operational discipline, and willingness to explore and adopt new technologies in AI, DevOps, and cloud engineering.

data.title: Principal Enterprise Software Engineer
data.description:
Principal Platform DevOps Engineer

Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in information, software solutions and services for professionals in healthcare; tax and accounting; financial and corporate compliance; legal and regulatory; corporate performance and ESG. 

In this role as Principal Platform DevOps Engineer, you will be working in Global Business Services, where we improve and transform our internal technology infrastructure, including IT operations, workplace technologies, cybersecurity, IT architecture, engineering services, and network and enterprise systems. 

About The Role

The Principal DevOps Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, building, and optimizing enterprise-scale infrastructure, automation and cloud platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership in DevSecOps, platform engineering, and cloud architecture. The Principal DevOps Engineer drives innovation, ensures engineering excellence, and leads cross-functional initiatives to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions. This position also plays a key role in mentoring teams, influencing technical strategy, and integrating emerging technologies such as generative AI into engineering practices. 

You will report to Manager of DevSecOps Engineering and work alongside a team of 18 dedicated colleagues. 

As part of our dynamic DevOps community, you'll join a global network of passionate tech professionals who collaborate, support, and inspire each other across borders. You'll have the opportunity to: 

- Attend flagship events like Wolters Kluwer Technology Summit
 - Participate in industry-leading conferences such as Ignite
 - Compete in exciting challenges like the Code Games

We believe in continuous learning, innovation, and celebrating success together. 

You will

- Lead the design and engineering of scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise infrastructure, automation and cloud platforms. 
 - Define and implement best practices in software development, DevSecOps, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Oversee the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms using SRE principles. 
 - Architect and manage cloud infrastructure (Azure), ensuring performance, cost-efficiency, and compliance. 
 - Lead the development and optimization of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. 
 - Guide the adoption of containerized and serverless architectures (e. g. , AKS, MS Fabric, PaaS DB etc). 
 - Ensure adherence to security standards, conduct risk assessments, and lead compliance initiatives. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and roadmaps. 
 - Mentor and coach engineering teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. 
 - Explore and integrate generative AI technologies to enhance software capabilities and automation. 

You have

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field. 

Experience

- Minimum of 10 years of experience in infrastructure automation, engineering, DevSecOps, or platform engineering. 
 - At least 3 years in a technical leadership role. 
 - Minimum 2 years of experience with AI and generative AI technologies or equivalent exposure. 
 - Proven experience in enterprise-scale application and infrastructure operations. 

Skills

- Advanced proficiency in scripting languages (e. g. , Bash, Python) for automation and infrastructure tasks. 
 - Deep expertise in programming frameworks (. NET, Java) and modern application development. 
 - Extensive experience with Terraform and other IaC tools, including module development and maintenance. 
 - Proficiency with CI/CD tools (e. g. , Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions). 
 - Strong architectural knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure), including service design and deployment. 
 - Familiarity with SRE practices and tools for monitoring, incident management, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and lead teams. 
 - Relevant certifications (Azure, Terraform CKA, Python, SRE) are preferred. 

Working together

- Hybrid: This is a hybrid role, where you will spend at least eight days a month at our Pune office, where you'll enjoy the benefits of connecting and collaborating with your colleagues in person. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Test Lead SME

In this role, you will: (Principal Responsibilities)

- Act as the senior technical lead for integration testing across the Product Control pod and Channels IT programme. 
 - Define and own the end-to-end integration-testing strategy across upstream, downstream, internal and third-party systems. 
 - Establish integration-test scope, environments, test data, dependencies, entry and exit criteria, quality gates and release-readiness measures. 
 - Lead testing across APIs, microservices, messaging platforms, event-driven services, data pipelines, databases and reporting interfaces. 
 - Ensure end-to-end business flows are validated across contact center, Product Control, accounting, regulatory and reconciliation processes. 
 - Coordinate integration testing with global teams across the UK, Hong Kong, Guangzhou, India and Canada. 
 - Identify and manage interface, environment, data, sequencing and dependency risks. 
 - Ensure defects are logged, prioritized, root causes are understood and remediation is tracked through to closure. 
 - Provide clear status reporting on integration coverage, risks, defects, dependencies and release readiness. 

NFR strategy and assurance

- Define and maintain the NFR strategy, ensuring requirements are identified, measurable, testable and traceable to business and technical outcomes. 
 - Work with architects, engineers, infrastructure, security, operations and business stakeholders to establish NFR acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead the planning and execution of NFR testing, including: 
 - Performance, load, stress and endurance testing

 - Resilience, failover and recovery testing

 - Security, access-control and vulnerability validation 
 - Monitoring, alerting, logging and observability testing

 - Deployment, rollback and production-verification testing 
 - Define performance baselines, service-level thresholds, capacity assumptions and production-volume scenarios. 
 - Assess NFR risks and ensure that identified gaps have documented remediation plans and accountable owners. 
 - Challenge designs and implementation approaches where they may create unacceptable performance, resilience, security or operational risks. 
 - Produce NFR evidence and sign-off recommendations for governance forums, architecture reviews and release decisions. 
 - Support audit, regulatory and control requirements through complete and traceable test documentation. 
Technical quality engineering

- Provide hands-on technical leadership for test automation and integration-validation solutions using Java and relevant testing frameworks. 
 - Develop and maintain automation for APIs, services, data flows, messaging, database validation and end-to-end scenarios.

 - Partner with software engineers to improve service testability, observability, error handling and operational supportability. 
 - Review test designs, automation code, test results and technical evidence for quality and completeness. 
 - Support deployment and release activities, including pre-production validation and post-deployment verification. 
 - Contribute to technical delivery plans, estimates, timelines and sprint planning. 

Architecture and stakeholder management

- Work with architecture teams to ensure that integration and NFR considerations are embedded in solution designs and aligned with the target-state architecture. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into clear integration scenarios and measurable NFR acceptance criteria. 
 - Collaborate with upstream and downstream system teams to coordinate interfaces, environments, test data and delivery schedules.

 - Support programme governance, release forums, technical design reviews and production-readiness assessments. 

Leadership and people development

- Lead, coach and mentor integration-test and quality-engineering colleagues.

 - Contribute to recruitment, resource planning and capability development for the testing function.

What You'll Need To Succeed

We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Renesas is hiring a Software QA Engineer with strong software and hardware testing experience to work with hands-on automated and manual testing of customer-facing software/hardware integrations. Develop and execute detailed manual and automated software/UI test cases in Python or other OO language. Experience in electrical engineering, Hardware debugging, hardware/firmware or embedded testing is strongly desired. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate market-leading digital controller solutions powering AI, client, and server applications. Responsibilities include software test planning, execution, reporting, leading testing projects, automation, documentation, and debugging software connected to hardware to determine the root cause of issues, and driving product quality across the development software/hardware lifecycle.

You will work teams across the globe to generate test requirements and define test methodologies. 

- Develop a robust understanding of detailed technical requirements for product software and related hardware and firmware. 
 - Design and execute automated and manual test plans for software, hardware, firmware, and IC solutions. 
 - Debug software and hardware issues, with a focus on IC functionality and root cause analysis. 
 - Analyze test results, report defects, and support issue resolution with development and customer-facing teams. 
 - Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure product quality exceeds expectations. 
 - Drive test automation, validation framework improvements, and QA best practices. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to testing strategy, planning, and process enhancements. 
 - Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while balancing quality, timelines, and feature delivery. 
 - Proactively identify risks, raise issues, and recommend product and process improvements. 

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or similar

Experience: 2-5 years of Software QA experience, including 8+ years testing software integrated with hardware/firmware. 

Technical Proficiency: 

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a keen attention to detail to debug complex HW/SW issues and document detailed test plans and test cases and root cause analysis of software vs hardware/FW bugs through deep analysis of both manual automated test failures. 
 - Experience in electronics, microcontroller programming, and bus communications, ideally in power systems, semiconductors, or ICs. 
 - GUI test automation skills with Python and tools such as Qt Squish, SmartBear Test Complete, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with lab test equipment and measurement tools. 
 - Solid understanding of JIRA, version control, QA best practices, and software/hardware development lifecycles. 
 - Proven ability to mentor teams, hardware/software test development and lab management, improve test coverage, and drive quality initiatives. 
 - Willingness to speak up, raise issues and risks, ask lots of questions, and provide improvement recommendations for products, test cases, test automation, and team processes.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

data.description:
Job Description

About The Core Engineering

The Core Engineering is a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm. 

Our engineers have access to the latest technology and massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, leveraging modern frameworks to build responsive, intuitive front-end and Big Data applications. The firm is making a significant investment to uplift and rebuild the Compliance application portfolio. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Vice President (VP), Full-Stack Engineer to join our Surveillance & Models technology team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. You will be responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications. 

As a VP-level engineer, you will maintain a strong hands-on presence-actively writing code, contributing to system and application design, reviewing implementations, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to build modern platforms that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards, drawing on your architecture and design background to strengthen technical solutions.

- Technical Leadership & Architecture

 - Design Decisions: Bring a strong architecture and design background to modular design, integration patterns, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Hands-on Engineering

 - Database Management: Optimize database schemas, queries, and data pipelines across both on-prem relational (e. g. , DB2, Sybase) and cloud-based (e. g. Snowflake) database platforms. 
 - API Design & Security: Develop and secure RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between internal systems and external partners, ensuring low latency and high availability. 
 - AI & Intelligent Automation: Apply hands-on experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) integrations to build intelligent features, automate workflows, and enhance user and operational outcomes. 
 - Partnering with Stakeholders: Apply knowledge of the financial industry and compliance or risk functions to design and improve compliance surveillance models. 
 - Team Mentorship & Collaboration
 - Mentorship: Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, strong design thinking, continuous learning, and operational discipline. 
 - Code Reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews and technical design discussions to improve quality, maintainability, and consistency across teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to convert requirements into sound technical designs and delivery plans. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience

- Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in full-stack engineering, architecture, or related roles, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and implementing large-scale, enterprise-level data solutions. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field. 

Technical Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with Java or Python, including with Apache Spark and/or Hadoop 
 - API design and micro-services architecture, such as to create interconnected services 
 - Experience with Cloud-based data platforms, such as Snowflake 
 - Exposure to Data Lake or Lakehouse solutions 
 - Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns 
 - Hands-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled application features 
 - Knowledge of the financial industry and compliance or risk functions

Interpersonal Skills

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative working style with experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction. 
 - Commitment to engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery.

data.description:
This role has been designed as ''Onsite' with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

In the HPE Hybrid Cloud, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what's next for you. 

This role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in Linux, hypervisor technologies, automation/scripting, and cloud platforms who wants to grow into private-cloud and clustered-infrastructure specialization. We are looking for a candidate with 7-8 years of experience to work on HPE VM Essentials (VME) clusters and the HPE CloudOps Suite. 

Experience Level ( Specialist and trainable candidates)

7-8 years of hands-on experience in Linux systems, virtualization/hypervisors, automation, and/or cloud platform operations. 

What You'll Do

Role Summary

We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer with 3-4 years of experience to help design, build, automate, and continuously improve our HPE VM Essentials (VME) private cloud platform and HPE CloudOps Suite environment. This is an engineering-focused role - you'll spend your time building automation, hardening infrastructure, improving platform reliability, and engineering solutions to recurring problems. 

What You Need To Bring

Key Responsibilities

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Build and maintain automation for VM lifecycle management, provisioning workflows, patching, and configuration using Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent IaC tooling. 
 - Develop scripts and tools (Python/Bash) to automate health checks, capacity reporting, drift detection, and routine operational tasks. 
 - Own and improve CI/CD-style pipelines for infrastructure changes (version-controlled playbooks/templates, peer-reviewed changes, staged rollouts). 
 - Build self-healing automation and proactive alerting to reduce manual intervention

Linux Systems Administration

- Administer and troubleshoot RHEL/Ubuntu (or similar) Linux servers - services, storage, networking, and log analysis. 
 - Analyze system and kernel logs to support incident diagnosis (storage errors, service failures, resource exhaustion). 

Cloud Platform & CloudOps Suite Engineering

- Support integration tasks between orchestration tooling and underlying infrastructure. 

Documentation & Knowledge Engineering

- Write and maintain infrastructure-as-code documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks as living engineering artifacts . 
 - Contribute to design reviews and engineering retrospectives, driving permanent fixes into automation and standards. 

________________________________________

Required Technical Skills And Good To Have

- Hypervisors: Hands-on experience with KVM/QEMU, VMware, or similar virtualization platforms - VM lifecycle management, snapshots, basic performance troubleshooting. 
 - Linux: Skills on RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu - services, storage (LVM, filesystems), networking basics, log analysis. 
 - Automation: Working knowledge of scripting (Bash and/or Python) and at least one automation/config management tool (Ansible preferred). 
 - Cloud Platforms: Practical exposure to at least one public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) or private cloud orchestration platform (Morpheus, OpenStack, or similar). 

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. 

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. 

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. 

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

 - Creation of reusable and efficient Python-based Playbooks. 
 - Use Splunk SOAR platform to enable automation and orchestration on various tools and technologies by making use of existing or custom integration

 - Should have worked in a security operations center and gained understanding of SIEM solutions like Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel and other log management platforms. Having experience in Splunk content development will be an added advantage
 - Willing to learn new technologies and take up new challenges. Assist in developing high-quality technical content such as automation scripts/tools, reference architectures, and white papers. 
 - Good grasp in conceptualizing and/or implementing automation for business process workflows

 - Experience in Process Development, Process Improvement, Process Architecture, and Training
 - Quick to apprehend and adapt new applications.

data.title: Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE)
data.description:
Job Title: Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - MySQL, PostgreSQL & Oracle

Location: Remote

Work Mode: Fully Remote

Experience: 5+ years

Start Date: Immediate

Job Summary: 

Owision is seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to own the reliability, performance, scalability, and automation of our MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle database fleet across on-premises and multi-cloud platforms (AWS, OCI, Azure). Operating at the intersection of DBA, SRE, and Platform Engineering, you will treat databases as code, eliminate operational toil, and build self-healing, highly available, and observable data platforms that power mission-critical services. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Define, monitor, and enforce SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs for database availability, latency, durability, and error budgets across all production tiers. 
 - Architect, maintain, and continuously validate High Availability (HA) configurations, clustering, replication topologies, and automated failover mechanisms. 
 - Lead database incident management, participate in on-call rotations, and conduct blameless Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to implement permanent preventive engineering solutions. 
 - Design, automate, and regularly test Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity plans to guarantee strict RPO and RTO targets. 
 - Treat databases as code by automating provisioning, scaling, patching, backups, and zero-downtime schema migrations using Python, Bash, Terraform, and Ansible. 
 - Build and maintain internal Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) self-service tools and CI/CD automation pipelines for engineering teams. 
 - Conduct deep query optimization, indexing strategies, capacity planning, and engine-level tuning (InnoDB, PostgreSQL autovacuum, Oracle AWR/ASH). 
 - Build end-to-end monitoring, alerting, and telemetry dashboards using PMM, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, and Zabbix. 
 - Enforce database security by design, including encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access control, auditing, compliance, and data governance policies. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 4-6+ years of hands-on experience as a DBRE, SRE, or Systems DBA managing large-scale, production database environments. 
 - Strong SRE mindset with practical experience managing SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, incident response workflows, and post-mortem practices. 
 - Deep production expertise in MySQL and PostgreSQL internals, alongside solid working knowledge of Oracle Core (RMAN, Data Guard, OEM, RAC basics).

data.title: Field Application Engineer – Robotics
data.description:
Location for this opening: Mumbai Factory

Field Application Engineer - Robotics

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Learning robotics from the inside is a priceless opportunity. 

Commission, program and demo cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree. 

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with customer-site travel

Department: Robotics & Industrial Automation

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1-4 years (immediate joiners preferred)

The Role

You will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites, across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. You will work with customers and our sales, design and project teams to turn applications into running automation. 

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation. 

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications. 

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimize cycle times. 

• Run demos, application trials and customer training. 

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running. 

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation. 

• Coordinate with sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team. 

Must Have

• Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation. 

• 1-4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering. 

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge. 

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills. 

• Willingness to travel to customer sites. 

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus. 

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus. 

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming. 

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR/mobile robot deployment. 

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work alongside the people who build them, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity. 

• Real ownership: take projects from first demo to live operation, with fast decisions and direct access to leadership. 

• Grow as we grow: move into Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Project Engineering or Field Application Manager roles. 

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, certifications, and cutting-edge mobile robotics. 

• Exciting projects in factories, warehouses and new applications. 

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives, travel support and a supportive, growing team. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. , headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners. 

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna. co. in and recruitment1@luna. co. in with the subject "FAE - Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi). 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Who We Are

Job Description

What You Will Do

- Lead the development of next-generation routing and switching hardware platforms, taking complete ownership from concept and design through validation, production release, and product sustaining. 
 - Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) programs as a technical lead, coordinating cross-functional and geographically distributed teams to deliver high-performance, quality-driven, and cost-effective products. 
 - Define hardware design specifications, implement designs, and drive PCB development, including schematic reviews, layout validation, Gerber generation, and Bill of Materials (BoM) release. 
 - Lead high-speed board bring-up, system-level debugging, fault analysis, Design Verification Testing (DVT), and new component qualification using advanced laboratory test and measurement equipment. 
 - Drive hardware design and validation involving CPU and memory architectures, including DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, SPI, XGMII, XFI, and XAUI interfaces. 
 - Collaborate with PCB layout, signal integrity, power, mechanical, thermal, CPLD/FPGA, firmware/BIOS, software, testing, manufacturing, and sustaining teams to resolve complex system-level challenges. 
 - Design and verify CPLD/FPGA logic and support hardware integration, functionality, and platform validation. 
 - Review and approve schematics, BoMs, PCB placement and routing, laboratory results, compliance test reports, and product technical documentation. 
 - Own technical documentation, including product specifications, hardware design specifications, design review records, DVT plans, compliance test plans, diagnostic test plans, and hardware test reports (HTRs). 
 - Ensure compliance with EMI/EMC, safety, environmental, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and Design for Assembly (DFA) requirements, as applicable. 
 - Work closely with external vendors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to manage technical dependencies, resolve issues, and support product quality and cost objectives. 
 - Provide ongoing product sustaining support, identify design improvements, and stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and hardware engineering best practices. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics and Telecommunication, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized university; an M. E. /M. Tech. is preferred. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex, high-end hardware products from concept to volume production, with a strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle. 
 - Strong expertise in high-speed board design, hardware bring-up, debugging, system integration, and advanced laboratory testing and measurement techniques. 
 - In-depth knowledge of CPU and memory architectures, with hands-on experience in DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, SPI, XGMII, XFI, and XAUI interfaces. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of system-level design considerations, including software, PCB design, signal integrity, power conversion, thermal management, mechanical design, DFM, DFA, and cost optimization. 
 - Experience leading NPI programs and influencing design decisions to achieve performance, quality, reliability, and cost targets. 
 - Working knowledge of CPLD/FPGA design and verification, along with hardware integration and validation. 
 - Knowledge of EMI/EMC, safety, and environmental regulatory compliance requirements for telecommunications systems. 
 - Strong technical documentation, design review, problem-solving, and fault-analysis skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, external suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
 - Strong leadership, interpersonal communication, negotiation, and supplier-management skills. 
 - A proactive, self-motivated, and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to organize work, take ownership, and lead by example. 
 - Adaptability to changing business priorities, ambiguous challenges, and assignments beyond immediate areas of expertise, while following established processes, checklists, reporting structures, and company practices. 
 - Awareness of current industry trends, emerging technologies, innovations, and hardware engineering best practices.

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online  marketplaces that match searchers and "research and compare" consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation's largest media networks. 

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven  matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.   They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results. 

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience. 

We believe in: 

- The direct measurability of digital media. 
 - Performance marketing. (We pioneered it. )
 - The advantages of technology. We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world's biggest channel. 

  

Quality Engineer - Backend Automation  

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)
Experience: 4-7 Years |  

About the Role

We are seeking hands-on Quality Engineers to support the modernization of Quest, a high-volume event and workflow-processing platform. This role focuses on backend quality engineering, including API, event-driven, database, integration, performance, and migration testing to ensure reliability and correctness throughout the Quest v2 migration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute test strategies for backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and database interactions. 
 - Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Java, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate Kafka-based event processing, retries, ordering, duplicate handling, replay, and idempotency scenarios. 
 - Perform migration validation between Quest v1 and Quest v2, including reconciliation and data consistency checks. 
 - Develop SQL-based data validation, integration, regression, performance, and resilience tests. 
 - Investigate defects using logs, metrics, traces, databases, and event streams. 
 - Support production deployments, release validation, and incident investigations. Required Skills

- 4-7 years of Quality Engineering, SDET, or software testing experience. 
 - Strong Java programming and test automation skills. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Strong SQL and database validation experience (MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, etc. ). 
 - Experience testing backend services, integrations, and distributed systems. 
 - Good understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, Git, and Linux/Unix environments. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Preferred Skills

- Experience with Kafka, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures. 
 - Knowledge of Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Testcontainers, WireMock, and contract testing. 
 - Experience with JMeter, Gatling, k6, or similar performance testing tools. 
 - Exposure to resilience, concurrency, recovery, and high-volume transaction systems. What We're Looking For

- Engineers who treat automation as production-quality software. 
 - Strong focus on backend, data, event-processing, and system reliability testing. 
 - Ability to independently own test coverage, defect investigation, and quality validation. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with developers, architects, and QA teams. Levels: Candidates may be hired as Quality Engineer (4-6 years) or Senior Quality Engineer (5-7 years) based on experience and capability in automation design, test strategy, performance testing, and technical leadership.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Get to know Okta

  

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth. 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.   

Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

Access Essentials - Core Product

The Access Essentials organization drives Okta's core mission by designing and delivering robust authentication and authorization solutions across all Okta-protected resources. Our goal is to empower organizations with frictionless, highly secure access experiences. By engineering scalable cloud services and advanced client software, we enable seamless device logins and enforce strong authentication standards across enterprise applications. As a key group within Okta R&D Engineering, we push the boundaries of identity security. Discover more about our engineering vision on our blog. 

As an Architect in this group, you will play a pivotal role in shaping next-generation identity and security architectures. You will solve complex, high-impact technical challenges, define long-term product strategy, and elevate our engineering standards while navigating a fast-moving cybersecurity landscape. 

  

Ideal candidate should be : Hands-on expert developer in Java who is deeply technical with a passion for building high-quality, secure, and performant applications and frameworks. Demonstrable experience leading technical projects involving 20+ engineers across multiple workstreams. Excited by the opportunity to work on cutting-edge security and identity management challenges and are a thought leader who can drive technical strategy and mentor other engineers. A collaborative individual with excellent communication skills, capable of working with cross-functional teams to deliver on a shared vision. Not just be a builder; but a force multiplier who can create frameworks and solutions that enable other teams to be more productive. 

  

This role is to build, design solutions, and maintain our platform for scale. The ideal candidate is someone who has experience building software systems to manage and deploy reliable and performant infrastructure and product code at scale on a cloud infrastructure. 

  

Minimum Requirements: 

- Strong hands-on experience designing &  developing enterprise software using Java with Springboot
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented programming principles, design patterns, server-side technologies and distributed system concepts(caching, asynchronous processing, multi-threading)
 - Strong experience working with relational databases, ideally MySQL, PostgreSQL or GraphDB
 - Skilled in debugging and troubleshooting complex java codebase  
 - Passionate about writing clean, maintainable and scalable code with a deep focus on security
 - Solid experience with cloud infrastructure platforms particularly AWS and GCP  
 - Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools

- Strong understanding of IAM protocols(FIDO, WebAuthn, SSO, SAML, OAuth,   SCIM, OpenID Connect) and identity management best practices
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure coding practices, and certifications like CISSP or Security+. 
 - Some experience with javascript frameworks and basic UI development
 - Prior experience building teams from ground-upEducation and Training: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
 - 18+ years of software development experience, with at least 12+ years of experience designing and building enterprise grade software using Java at scale

The Okta Experience

Senior Front-End Developer (React)

We are looking for an experienced Senior Front-End Developer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of modern, scalable web applications. The candidate will work closely with architects, UX designers, backend engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality, maintainable, and responsive applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop scalable, maintainable web applications using React and TypeScript. 
 - Develop reusable UI components and shared frontend libraries using Material UI (MUI), Emotion, and modern UI development practices. 
 - Integrate frontend applications with backend systems through REST APIs, WebSockets, and STOMP-based messaging. 
 - Design and implement Web Components and reusable UI modules that can be leveraged across multiple applications. 
 - Build feature-rich user interfaces including dashboards, data tables, charts, forms, configuration screens, and other enterprise application workflows. 
 - Develop responsive and accessible interfaces while ensuring good application performance and usability.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

We are seeking an experienced and technically influential Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Cloud Tooling and Pipelines team. This pivotal team is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our core Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (leveraging Spinnaker and custom tooling), Infrastructure as Code (IaC) execution engines (primarily Terraform), and a suite of supporting microservices. These systems are critical for enabling and managing our extensive resource footprint across AWS ECS and EKS. 

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be a key contributor, driving the implementation of scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions that automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments. Your deep expertise in software engineering principles and cloud-native development will be essential in building and enhancing our critical tooling for infrastructure provisioning, vulnerability management, and IaC deployments. You will also play a vital role in mentoring other engineers and influencing the team's technical roadmap. If you have a strong passion for building robust software systems that empower operational efficiency at scale, we encourage you to apply. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Design and Develop Core Platform Components: Lead the design and development of scalable and reliable microservices and tools that form the backbone of Okta's Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (including components for Spinnaker, Terraform, and custom tooling). 

- Build Infrastructure as Code Automation: Develop sophisticated software solutions and APIs that empower engineering teams to provision and manage infrastructure, execute production changes, and deploy code with high reliability and efficiency. 

- Architect and Implement Deployment Workflows: Contribute to the architectural design and hands-on implementation of robust CD pipelines and Terraform-based IaC workflows, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security for application deployments. 

- Develop High-Quality Automation Software: Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code (primarily in Java, Python, or Go) for microservices with a strong focus on automation, operational excellence, and self-service capabilities. 

- Collaborate for Operational Efficiency: Partner closely with DevOps, SREs, and Product teams to proactively identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Then lead software development efforts to deliver scalable, reliable automation solutions. 

- Champion Software Engineering Best Practices: Advocate for and implement industry best practices in software design, development, testing, and deployment to ensure the highest quality and maintainability of our tooling. 

- Integrate Security by Design: Apply and promote security best practices throughout the software development lifecycle for our tooling and infrastructure automation to ensure a secure, compliant operational environment. 

- Enable Self-Service Capabilities: Proactively identify opportunities to build self-service automation for infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, and other operational tasks, reducing manual effort and improving developer velocity and onboarding. 

- Provide Technical Guidance and Mentorship: Serve as a technical mentor and role model for other engineers on the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence in software engineering. 

Required Qualifications
 - 7+ years of professional experience in Software Development, with a strong focus on backend systems and distributed applications. 

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java, Go, Python, or similar backend languages, specifically building scalable and reliable applications. 

- Demonstrated experience in developing and maintaining automation tools, platforms, or microservices for cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or similar). 

- Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and practical experience with tools such as Terraform. 

- Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) platform development, including familiarity with tools like Spinnaker or similar. 

- Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and ECS, from a software development perspective. 

- Proficient in using Docker and experienced with building applications that interact with underlying Linux and networking fundamentals. 

- Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, etc. ) in the context of application development and operational management. 

- A strong passion for solving complex operational challenges through innovative software solutions and automation. 

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills within a software development context. 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 

Good to Have: 

- Demonstrated ability to build AI-powered assistants or "copilots" that simplify complex IaC templates (Terraform/Pulumi) for application teams, reducing the cognitive load on developers. 

- Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures to build intelligent platform documentation bots that can diagnose deployment failures or suggest infrastructure optimisations in real-time.

The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst (Java Full Stack) is a senior-level technical leadership role responsible for establishing, designing, and delivering high-quality, scalable application systems and software solutions in coordination with cross-functional technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to drive end-to-end applications systems analysis, architectural alignment, full-stack software engineering, and implementation activities across distributed enterprise environments. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Solution Delivery

- System Integration & Product Delivery: Partner with engineering managers, product owners, and multi-disciplinary teams to establish architectural roadmaps, integrate enterprise services, and deliver core system enhancements and new digital capabilities. 
 - Architecture & Engineering Standards: Ensure software and application designs strictly adhere to enterprise architecture blueprints, security baselines, and industry best practices. 
 - Complex Problem Resolution: Resolve high-impact, critical engineering and architectural challenges through in-depth evaluation of complex business flows, technical bottlenecks, system dependencies, and industry standards. 
 - Coding & Quality Governance: Define, champion, and enforce engineering standards for clean code, design patterns, automated unit/integration testing, debugging, code reviews, and release readiness. 
 - Cross-Functional Domain Alignment: Maintain a comprehensive understanding of how application architecture, infrastructure, data management, and business capabilities integrate to achieve business objectives. 

Innovation, AI-Augmented Engineering & Coaching

- Innovative Problem-Solving: Apply interpretive thinking and structured analysis to identify complex technical problems, proposing modern, scalable, and resilient technical solutions. 
 - AI-First Software Delivery: Actively leverage generative AI and modern developer-productivity tools to accelerate software delivery cycles, streamline automated test creation, refactor legacy code, and elevate code quality. 
 - Mentorship & Team Guidance: Serve as a technical advisor and mentor to mid-level software engineers and analysts, leading technical discussions and delegating engineering tasks effectively.

- Risk & Controls Assessment: Appropriately assess risk when business and technical decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding client assets. 
 - Regulatory & Policy Compliance: Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and enterprise standards; apply sound ethical judgment; and escalate, manage, and report control issues with full transparency. 

Qualifications & Technical Competencies

- Core Backend Software Engineering (Java)
 - Java Mastery: Advanced, hands-on expertise with Java (Java 17 / 21) and the modern enterprise Java ecosystem. 
 - Frameworks: Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, and Hibernate / JPA. 
 - Microservices Architecture: Proven track record of architecting, implementing, and deploying high-throughput, low-latency, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed processing systems. 
 - Messaging & Event-Driven Systems: Hands-on experience with asynchronous messaging and event streaming technologies (Apache Kafka, Solace, or JMS). 
 - API Standards: Expertise designing and developing enterprise-grade RESTful APIs and gRPC services with strong authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS). 
 - Modern Frontend Engineering (React / Angular)
 - Frontend Frameworks: Deep practical experience building modern, responsive web applications using React and/or Angular with TypeScript and modern ECMAScript (ES6+). 
 - State Management & Reactive Programming: Proficiency in state management patterns (Redux / NgRx) and reactive streams using RxJS. 
 - Modern UI & Micro-Frontends: Hands-on experience with Micro-Frontend architectures, standalone components, dynamic routing, and complex enterprise data grids (e. g. , AG Grid Enterprise, Elemental UI / Design System components). 
 - Web Fundamentals & Real-Time Data: Strong mastery of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, DOM manipulation, responsive layouts, and bidirectional communication protocols (WebSockets / Server-Sent Events). 
 - Database & Data Engineering
 - Relational Databases (RDBMS): Deep experience with relational data modeling, schema design, advanced SQL tuning, and query optimization on enterprise databases (Oracle, ). 
 - NoSQL Data Stores: Practical experience designing, indexing, and maintaining document/key-value NoSQL databases (MongoDB/Couchbase). 
 - High Availability & Scalability: Solid understanding of database clustering, indexing strategies, replica sets, connection pooling, and caching strategies . 
 - CI/CD, Containerization & Cloud Operations
 - Containers & Orchestration: Proven experience containerizing applications using Docker and deploying onto container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift). 
 - Enterprise CI/CD Pipelines: Hands-on proficiency configuring automated build, test, and release pipelines using modern enterprise platforms (Harness, Jenkins, Tekton, or GitHub Actions) in Linux environments. 
 - Job Scheduling & Batch Systems: Familiarity with enterprise workload automation and job schedulers (Autosys or equivalent). 
 - Quality & Security Tooling: Experience integrating automated code quality, dependency management, and vulnerability scanning tools (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx). 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent; Master's degree preferred.

AI Solutions, part of Mastercard's AI & Data organization, scales AI across the enterprise, moving use cases beyond pilots into trusted, production-grade capabilities embedded in Mastercard's platforms and products. Centralizing this capability drives speed to scale, operational resilience, consistent delivery standards, and responsible AI by design, in close partnership with the AI Center of Excellence.

PhD/Master's in CS, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related STEM field

data.title: Principal R&D Engineer (3DIC)
data.description:
You Are

You have 15+ years of experience and are already drawn to hard technical problems: algorithms, data structures, and software that has to be correct, fast, and maintainable. You may not yet have shipped a full EDA product, but you write solid C/C++, you debug with discipline, and you want to learn how production design tools actually get built. 

You are curious about how chips are designed and packaged - and you want to grow into that domain by working on real software, not only on theory. At Synopsys, you will contribute to package substrate design automation within 3DIC Compiler, helping enable advanced multi-die systems for AI, high-performance computing, and heterogeneous integration. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Implement and extend package substrate design automation capabilities within the 3DIC Compiler platform. 
 - Write production C/C++ code for features such as HDI substrate auto-routing, design rule checking, power delivery network analysis, and design for manufacturability. 
 - Build, test, and debug software that runs on large, real-world packaging designs, including multi-die chiplets and heterogeneous integration. 
 - Work with senior engineers, product teams, and customers to understand design bottlenecks and turn them into well-scoped software changes. 
 - Participate in design and code reviews; learn how architecture decisions are made across the 3DIC product. 
 - Grow your skills in algorithms, performance, and software quality under the mentorship of experienced R&D engineers. 

The Impact You Will Have

- Contribute features that help customers design next-generation advanced packaging for AI, high-performance computing, and other complex systems. 
 - Help reduce design cycle time for teams working on HDI substrates, chiplets, and multi-die architectures. 
 - Own well-defined pieces of auto-routing, power delivery, checking, and manufacturability software - and see them used by leading semiconductor companies. 
 - Build a foundation in a strategic Synopsys product line at the center of the industry shift toward chiplet-based systems. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of relevant software or R&D experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ skills and a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity. 
 - Ability to write, debug, and test production-quality code; coursework, internships, or projects that show this clearly. 
 - Interest in physical design, EDA, semiconductors, or advanced packaging - prior domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. 
 - Coursework or project experience in at least one related area is helpful: graph algorithms, computational geometry, CAD/EDA tools, VLSI/physical design, or large-scale C++ software. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to learn from design reviews and feedback. 

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the advanced packaging design automation team for 3DIC Compiler. The team focuses on package substrate design and the industry shift toward chiplet architectures and heterogeneous integration. You will be mentored by senior and distinguished engineers, contribute to a strategic Synopsys growth area, and see a clear path to greater ownership as you grow.

It also provides the capabilities for Morgan Stanley B2B stock plan business to manage participants' lifecycle. If you are an exceptional individual who is interested in solving complex problems and building sophisticated solutions in a dynamic team environment, Middle office is the place for you.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Python + AI) - Remote
data.description:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. 

We're Most Proud Of: 

- Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. 
 - Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world's greatest companies. 
 - Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. 
 - Our 4. 1-star rating on GlassDoor. 
 - Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. 

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client's problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production. 

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. 

On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right. 

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don't hold up. 

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: 

- Reframes the request. Treats "we need an agent for X" as a hypothesis, not a spec. 
 - Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints - before choosing technology. 
 - Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent - and defends why. 
 - Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won't deliver value. 

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE's first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. 

- Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it's worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. 
 - Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they're worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. 
 - Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines - the things that kill projects in month two. 
 - Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. 
 - Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with "why, " "how do you know, " and "what happens today when. . . " - without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. 
 - Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. 

What You'll Do

- Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. 
 - Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. 
 - Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture - data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted - plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Build. Ship working systems - agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. 
 - Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases. 
 - Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch - eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client's team run it without you. 
 - Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of professional software development experience with core proficiency in Python (or TypeScript/Node. js). 
 - Has shipped at least one agentic AI solution, LLM workflow, or RAG architecture to a production environment. 
 - Advanced English is required. 
 - Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI developer tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex) in daily workflows. 
 - Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls to translate unstructured business requirements into technical architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience building agentic systems using orchestration frameworks or APIs such as LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or direct LLM APIs. 
 - Proven experience taking full end-to-end technical ownership of features from discovery to deployment. 
 - Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. 
 - Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. 
 - Forensic attention to detail. 
 - A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. 
 - Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. 
 - Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. 
 - Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. 
 - Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. 

Strong Plus

- Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems. 
 - Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases. 
 - Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing). 
 - Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense. 
 - Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background. 
 - Client enablement and training - building the client team's capability, not just the system. 
 - Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts. 

Work Authorization Requirements

- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis. 
 - FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.
