What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

You'll be part of the DevOps and Assurance team within Bain's Next Generation Software Solutions (NGSS) department - a multidisciplinary engineering organization responsible for building, operating, and scaling Bain's next-generation digital products and platforms. 

The DevOps and Assurance team plays a critical role in enabling secure, efficient, and reliable delivery of technology solutions across Bain's global ecosystem. The group focuses on both technical operations and platform assurance, ensuring that every deployment meets the firm's high standards for quality, security, and compliance. 

What You'll Do

We are looking for an accomplished DevOps engineer to drive the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cloud infrastructure and software delivery processes. In this role, you will lead efforts to build and scale CI/CD pipelines, provision and operate Azure infrastructure, and ensure security and reliability across the deployment lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate will work in close partnership with software development, QA, and security teams to foster a culture of automation, performance excellence, and operational resilience. This position requires both strong technical expertise and the ability to guide best practices and mentor engineers across teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Automation - 30%

- Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Terraform Cloud. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security across environments. 
 - Architect and manage Azure networking: VNet/subnet design, private endpoints, DNS resolution, NSG rules, and Front Door Premium configuration. 
 - Provision and maintain Azure platform services: App Services, Azure SQL, Azure OpenAI, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Key Vault, Entra ID, and Storage Accounts (ADLS Gen2). 

Cloud & Platform Management (Azure) - 25%

- Manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pools, scaling, spot instances, and workload connectivity to dependent services (databases, storage, AI services). 
 - Manage identity and access: Entra ID app registrations, managed identities, RBAC, and integration with external IdPs (Okta). 
 - Administer database platforms from an infrastructure perspective: Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Cosmos DB - including connectivity, Entra auth, firewall rules, and private endpoints. 
 - Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability across dev, demo, and production environments. 

CI/CD & Software Delivery - 20%

- Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for container builds, infrastructure deployments, and application releases. 
 - Manage container image lifecycle: build, scan, push to ACR, and deploy to AKS or App Services. 
 - Implement environment promotion workflows with appropriate gating, secrets management (Key Vault), and rollback strategies. 
 - Design and operate GitHub-hosted private runners where required, including network integration with Azure VNets. 

Monitoring, Security & Assurance - 15%

- Implement and operate observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability. 
 - Respond to security findings: triage, containment, IAM scoping, container image CVE remediation, and endpoint hardening. 
 - Handle L2/L3 incident escalations, including root-cause analysis, user journey tracing, and log analysis. 
 - Enforce solution compliance across products: network isolation, least-privilege access, secrets hygiene, and deployment guardrails. 

Leadership & Collaboration - 10%

- Partner with architects, product engineers, and security teams to align on infrastructure standards and platform roadmaps. 
 - Promote DevOps culture, automation-first thinking, and continuous improvement across the NGSS engineering organization. 
 - Contribute to technical discovery, POCs, and innovation work streams to validate new tools, technologies, and architectural patterns. 
 - Support team recruiting activities: resume screening, technical interviews, and candidate evaluation. 

About You

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 4-7 years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or cloud platform engineering roles. 
 - Proven track record of designing and operating cloud infrastructure in production environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional engineering teams in fast-paced product organizations. 

Professional Skills & Mindset

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for diverse stakeholders. 
 - Proactive, analytical, and systematic - strong problem-solving skills with the ability to trace issues across multiple layers (DNS, networking, identity, application). 
 - Results-driven with a bias for automation and continuous improvement. 
 - Familiarity with Agile methodologies and a commitment to team enablement. 

Technical Expertise

- Hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud (or equivalent) - workspace management, state, modules, and remote backends. 
 - Strong proficiency in Azure services, including AKS, Networking (VNets, subnets, private endpoints, NSGs, DNS zones), App Services, Key Vault, Container Registry, and Storage Accounts. 
 - Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and container image lifecycle management. 
 - Expertise in roles, permissions, and IAM - particularly Microsoft Entra ID and Okta. 
 - Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and related DevOps toolchains. 
 - Proficient in Linux administration and automation scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python) for reusable workflows. 
 - Experience with monitoring platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights. 
 - Familiarity with Azure private networking: private endpoints (blob, DFS, SQL, PostgreSQL), Private DNS Zones, and VNet integration for App Services and AKS. 
 - Competent in database deployment and management from an infrastructure perspective - Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, and Cosmos DB. 
 - Foundation in security remediation: container CVE patching, IAM scoping, NSG/firewall tightening, and WAF/Front Door rule management. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Administrator, Terraform Associate, or CKA (or equivalent). 
 - Experience managing multi-environment governance, cost optimization, and compliance frameworks in cloud environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Search, Databricks, and the integration of AI services into enterprise platforms.

data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

The Opportunity

The Monetization Team powers Postman pricing & packaging, and scales its business. 

We Build And Operate Mission-critical Billing Systems That Handle

- Payments & renewals

 - Post Purchase product onboarding

As Postman grows, we are evolving towards a config-driven, highly scalable platform that supports both self-serve and sales-led motions globally. 

We're looking for a Front End Senior Engineer who can lead the development of the user-facing platform, driving technical excellence in UI architecture and product innovation in the monetization experience. 

What You'll Do

- Build & Optimize Monetization Experiences Design, develop, and own the user interfaces for key monetization flows, including checkout, subscription management, and pricing pages.

About You

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. data.title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
data.description:
Description

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon - the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. 

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase - and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. 

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product - we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. 

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build - the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems. 
 - Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide. 
 - Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them. 
 - Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience. 
 - Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. 

A day in the life

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on - and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers - a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

Under minimal direction, the Senior Manager, DCCA leads a DS, DP or FDP team based in India that creates and revises controlled GMP documentation for Amgen sites globally. Hours for this role may vary based on global time zones, which could include hybrid hours, on call requirements, and flexible working hours. 

Role Responsibilities

Global Service Delivery and SLA Management

- Lead the daily operation of the global GMP documentation service for DS, DP, or FDP, ensuring requests are received, clarified, prioritized, assigned, completed, and handed off in accordance with defined service-level agreements. 
 - Establish transparent intake, triage, prioritization, and escalation practices that balance site criticality, compliance risk, business impact, and available capacity. 
 - Develop and maintain capacity plans, workload forecasts, staffing models, and recovery plans that enable the team to meet commitments across supported sites and time zones. 
 - Own performance management routines and dashboards for on-time delivery, right-first-time quality, cycle time, queue aging, rework, customer feedback, and resource utilization. 
 - Identify service risks early, communicate impacts and options clearly, and escalate constraints with proposed mitigation and recovery actions. 

GMP Documentation Quality and Compliance

- Ensure document creation and revision activities comply with applicable global and local GMP requirements, good documentation practices, data-integrity expectations, controlled-document procedures, and approved change-control processes. 
 - Set and maintain standards for document structure, technical writing, accuracy, traceability, version control, formatting, and review readiness to prevent defects before delivery. 
 - Oversee authoring and revision of controlled GMP documents, such as SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing and laboratory records, technical reports, and associated attachments, based on approved site inputs and change requirements. 
 - Oversee the content creation of training materials used in the manufacturing areas including instructional design. 
 - Implement appropriate peer review, quality checks, training, and escalation mechanisms to improve right-first-time acceptance and reduce avoidable rework. 
 - Support inspection and audit readiness; ensure service records, training, and performance evidence are complete, traceable, and review-ready. 
 - Oversee investigational support within the specific manufacturing domain. 

Global Partnership and Governance

- Serve as the senior-manager-level liaison between the India documentation team and global site stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, QC, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and other technical functions. 
 - Create effective governance forums with supported sites to review demand, priorities, service performance, quality trends, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Clarify and maintain accountability between the service team and site owners: the service team provides disciplined document development and revision support; site functions retain ownership of technical content, approvals, local requirements, and implementation decisions. 
 - Resolve complex cross-functional issues that could affect document quality, approval readiness, delivery timing, or compliance, using a risk-based approach. 

People Leadership and Organizational Capability

- Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team of GMP documentation professionals, technical writers, and/or documentation specialists. 
 - Establish role clarity, training curricula, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans that build sustainable technical and leadership capability in India. 
 - Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning while maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and accountable work environment. 
 - Partner with Human Resources and functional leaders to maintain an adaptable organization that can respond to changing global demand and business priorities. 

Operational Excellence and Strategic Improvement

- Standardize and continuously improve documentation workflows, templates, authoring practices, quality controls, and digital ways of working across the service. 
 - Lead cross-site projects and improvement initiatives that increase speed, accuracy, scalability, and customer experience without compromising compliance. 
 - Manage departmental headcount, training, technology, and operating budgets; optimize resources against the long-range demand plan. 
 - Represent the documentation service on global teams, task forces, and quality-system initiatives as needed. 

Service Performance and Quality Measures

The leader establishes goals and management routines that keep customer commitments, documentation quality, and compliance visible and balanced. 

Measure

Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

Experience: 10+ Years 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Work Model: Onsite / Remote
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced 
Staff DevOps Engineer / Cloud Platform Architect with expertise in Azure Cloud, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations (AIOps). 
The ideal candidate will lead enterprise cloud transformation, build scalable cloud-native platforms, modernize CI/CD processes, and implement AI-driven operational capabilities to improve system reliability, observability, incident response, and infrastructure efficiency. 
This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong architecture, automation, cloud governance, and engineering enablement experience. 
Key Responsibilities
1. Azure Cloud Architecture & Transformation
- Design and implement enterprise Azure Landing Zones and cloud governance frameworks. 
- Lead large-scale migrations from on-premises infrastructure to Microsoft Azure. 
- Architect enterprise AKS platforms supporting multiple applications and environments. 
- Implement Azure networking, Key Vault, Container Registry, storage, and security services.

2. Platform Engineering & CI/CD Modernization
- Design enterprise CI/CD platforms using GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Actions. 
- Develop reusable CI/CD frameworks for Java, . NET, Node. js, and Python applications. 
- Establish enterprise SDLC standards, branching strategies, and release governance. 
- Implement automated build, testing, security scanning, artifact management, and deployment workflows. 
- Modernize legacy DevOps platforms and improve developer productivity. 
3. Kubernetes, GitOps & Infrastructure Automation
- Architect and manage multi-cluster Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments. 
- Implement GitOps using ArgoCD, Helm, and Kubernetes. 
- Develop reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code standards. 
- Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and application deployments. 
- Establish platform scalability, reliability, and operational best practices. 
4. AIOps & Intelligent IT Operations
- Design and implement AIOps capabilities to improve cloud operations, observability, and service reliability. 
- Leverage machine learning and AI-driven analytics for anomaly detection, event correlation, and predictive incident identification. 
- Integrate AIOps capabilities with monitoring and observability platforms such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, or Splunk.

- Develop automated incident response and self-healing infrastructure workflows. 
- Apply AI-assisted root-cause analysis to accelerate incident diagnosis and resolution.

- Integrate AIOps solutions with ITSM and incident management platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or PagerDuty. 
- Explore Generative AI and LLM-based operational assistants for incident summarization, troubleshooting, and runbook automation. 
- Establish measurable improvements in Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), availability, and operational efficiency. 
5. DevSecOps & Cloud Security
- Integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Advanced Security, CodeQL, and JFrog Xray. 
- Implement container security, vulnerability management, and software supply chain controls. 
- Establish secure infrastructure deployment and cloud governance practices. 
- Automate compliance validation and security controls within DevOps workflows. 
- Implement IAM, RBAC, secrets management, and secure cloud architecture standards.

data.title: Senior Automation Developer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Developer to streamline, test, and manage our infrastructure and deployment pipelines. The core focus of this role is building robust automation and testing frameworks within a Proxmox virtualization environment, while also bridging our operations to public cloud infrastructure (AWS/OCI). If you are passionate about Infrastructure as Code, relentless about automated testing, and thrive in optimizing virtualized environments, this role is for you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Infrastructure Automation: Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) pipelines using Terraform to provision resources across Proxmox and public clouds (AWS/OCI). 
 - Virtualization Management: Act as the subject matter expert for our Proxmox VE environments, ensuring high availability, optimal resource allocation, and automated cluster management. 
 - Automated Testing: Develop, maintain, and scale comprehensive automated testing suites utilizing the Robot Framework to validate infrastructure deployments and system integrations. 
 - Custom Scripting: Write clean, efficient scripts (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate routine system administration, monitoring, and deployment tasks. 
 - Cloud Integration: Maintain hybrid cloud interoperability, extending on-premise Proxmox capabilities into AWS and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 
 - Team Enablement & Mentorship: Drive continuous improvement within the engineering team by actively hosting and participating in regular Friday knowledge-sharing sessions to showcase new automation techniques and testing strategies. 

Requirements

Technical Skills Matrix

- Virtualization: Deep operational experience in Proxmox VE is a core requirement. Experience with OpenStack deployment and management is an added advantage. 
 - Automation & IaC: Core requirements include proficiency in Terraform and advanced scripting using Python or Bash. 
 - Testing: Solid understanding of Robot Framework and general testing frameworks is required. Familiarity with PyTest and Selenium is a nice-to-have. 
 - Cloud: A solid working knowledge of AWS and/or OCI is essential. Working knowledge of Azure is an added advantage. 
 - DevOps: Core requirements include hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with Jenkins is preferred as a nice-to-have skill. 

The Ideal Candidate Profile

- The Proxmox Expert: You have hands-on, battle-tested experience managing and automating Proxmox clusters-this is non-negotiable for the role. 
 - The Test-Driven Automator: You don't just write automation scripts; you write the tests (via Robot Framework) that prove the infrastructure is resilient before it hits production. 
 - The Hybrid Cloud Thinker: You understand the nuances of balancing on-premise virtualized workloads with public cloud scalability on AWS and OCI.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AWS / DevOps Engineer to design, build, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure supporting our AI/ML initiatives and automated data extraction pipelines. data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

About the role

We are looking for a Salesforce Tester to own quality assurance across our Salesforce implementations and support work. You will test CPQ, Sales Cloud and Service Cloud solutions, including their integrations with other systems, write and run test cases, and work closely with consultants, developers and client stakeholders to make sure releases are correct before they reach production. This is a fully remote, full-time position. 

Responsibilities

- Analyze requirements and user stories, and create test plans, test scenarios and detailed test cases
 - Test end-to-end business processes across Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, accounts, forecasting), Service Cloud (cases, queues, entitlements, Knowledge) and CPQ (products, pricing, quoting, contracts)
 - Validate CPQ configuration such as product bundles, price rules, product rules, discount schedules, approvals and quote document generation
 - Run functional, regression, integration, UAT-support and smoke testing across sandboxes and release cycles
 - Plan and execute integration testing between Salesforce and external systems (e. g. ERP, billing, CRM/marketing tools, middleware such as MuleSoft), covering inbound and outbound data flows, field mappings, data transformations, sync timing and record ownership
 - Test API-based integrations (REST/SOAP, platform events, outbound messages, batch jobs), including positive, negative and edge cases such as failed calls, retries, duplicate records, timeouts and malformed payloads
 - Verify end-to-end data integrity across systems, for example quote to order to invoice, or case and account sync, and reconcile data between Salesforce and the target system
 - Use tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Workbench or similar to trigger and validate integration calls, and review integration logs and error queues to diagnose failures
 - Log, track and retest defects with clear reproduction steps, working with developers and consultants to resolve them
 - Test data setup, and profile and permission set validation
 - Maintain and improve regression packs and test documentation, including integration test scenarios

Required qualifications

- 5+ years of software testing experience (manual testing required; automation is a plus)
 - 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce testing or delivery experience, including at least 1 year with Salesforce CPQ
 - Solid working knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
 - Hands-on experience testing integrations between Salesforce and other systems, including API testing and validating data flows end to end
 - Working understanding of integration concepts: REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML payloads, authentication, and sync patterns (real-time vs. batch)
 - Ability to explain basic CPQ concepts clearly, for example: 
 - Product catalog, bundles, options and features
 - Price books, list vs. net price, and pricing methods
 - Price rules, product rules and discount schedules
 - Quote lines, quote templates and approval flows
 - Contracts, amendments and renewals
 - Experience writing test cases, managing defects (e. g. Jira, Azure DevOps) and working in Agile/Scrum teams
 - Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and clear written and spoken English
 - Ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a remote team

Certifications

- Highly desired: Salesforce Certified Administrator
 - Highly desired: at least one Salesforce consultant certification (e. g. Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or CPQ Specialist)

Nice to have

- Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Provar, Copado Robotic Testing or similar)
 - Experience with integration or middleware platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato or similar) and API automation
 - Familiarity with Flows, Apex triggers and validation rules from a testing perspective
 - Experience with DevOps and release tooling (Copado, Gearset, or similar)
 - Exposure to Revenue Cloud, Experience Cloud or Agentforce

data.description:
Description

Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer acts on - every subscription, rental, purchase, and renewal - is the moment they pay, powered by a set of world-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru. 

We are the Prime Video Payments team: the voice of the customer at the point of purchase and the engine of Prime Video's global growth. We define, design and deliver payment experiences for our customers WW, across devices. We are also at the forefront of AI innovation - reimagining how customers interact with our commerce surfaces, and how intelligence removes friction from payments to acquire, engage, and retain more customers. 

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Software Development Manager on the Prime Video Offers team, you will: 

- Own a major pillar of the commerce platform end-to-end. You'll lead large engineering teams of 10+ engineers each, responsible for critical services and customer journeys that determine what every Prime Video customer can buy, rent, or subscribe to - and at what price. You own the architecture, the delivery, the operations, and the customer experience. 
 - Drive a multi-year architectural transformation. You'll own key pieces of this transformation, making decisions that shape how the system works for years to come. 
 - You will lead and drive conversations across multiple Amazon businesses on driving Prime Video's Payments strategy; and own goals of highest visibility. 
 - Build and scale high-performing engineering teams. You'll hire, develop, and retain senior engineering talent. You'll grow engineering managers into stronger technical leaders, and develop senior engineering leaders toward Principal readiness. You'll create a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and customer obsession. 
 - Set the bar for customer health and operational health. Our services are on the critical path for every PV transaction. You'll own customer-facing reliability first - ensuring customers never see a broken experience - and drive operational excellence through monitorability, availability targets, cost efficiency, and mechanisms that scale. 
 - Partner across organizations to deliver at scale. The work requires deep collaboration across Amazon businesses. You'll represent your pillar in executive leadership forums, negotiate priorities, and drive alignment on shared interfaces and dependencies. 
 - Balance execution with strategic investment. You'll deliver on high-visibility goals while simultaneously investing in the architectural improvements that make future delivery faster. You'll make the trade-offs and communicate them clearly. 

A day in the life

You might start the day reviewing customer health metrics and operational dashboards, then move into a technical design review for a new cross-product capability. After lunch, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and VP+ leadership, making trade-off decisions on what to prioritize. Later, you're coaching an engineering manager through a difficult people situation, then joining a team celebration for a successful launch. You end the day connecting with your teams over activities that build site strength and community locally. 

About The Team

We are the Prime Video Commerce Payments team in Bengaluru - engineers across all levels and managers who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We're proud of what we've built, and we're just getting started. 

We are a worldwide team, and we operate like one. That means working across time zones with genuine empathy - understanding that your counterpart in Seattle or London has a life outside of work, just as you do, and that great collaboration doesn't require anyone to sacrifice their personal time. 

Inclusivity isn't a value we list on a slide - it's how we work. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard, regardless of level, background, or tenure. 

If you are looking to work in a space that directly impacts how your friends and family interact with Prime Video, this role is for you. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
 - 5+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications
 - Experience partnering with product and program management teams
 - Experience establishing metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence

data.title: Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

data.title: Sr. System Software Quality Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Sr. System Software Quality Engineer

The Role

AMD's quality engineering team is looking for an Associate QA Engineer to build, execute, and scale automated test suites for our core memory-tiering agent and central management platform. You will work closely with developers to ensure the stability of low-level Linux systems and high-performance prefetching engines. You will leverage a comprehensive test environment to practice robust test automation daily, using modern AI tools to accelerate development and focus on the core semantics of test behaviors rather than syntax. While automation is central to scaling and regression, some manual testing is also expected. 

The Person

We are looking for a QA Engineer with proven experience in software testing, QA, or systems validation. The candidate will have advanced Linux knowledge and intermediate Python scripting skills, and will bring endless curiosity about how complex, low-level software and hardware systems interact. The engineer will thrive in a fast-moving, high-velocity environment, working independently while managing rapidly changing priorities. 

The engineer will engage as an active team player, communicate with empathy across technical and non-technical audiences, and consistently drive to make things better, faster, and more cost-effective. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write, execute, and maintain automated integration and smoke tests daily using Radish/Cucumber and Python. 
 - Design and conduct systems-level testing and benchmarking of the memory management platform under real-world workloads. 
 - Reproduce, troubleshoot, and document field-reported issues within local testbeds. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants to automate boilerplate, focusing on system semantics, test design, and edge-case validation. 
 - Produce clear technical documentation, bug reports, and testing updates. 
 - Provide operational feedback to the CI/CD team to improve the testing environment. 
 - Deploy ephemeral test environments on demand via Ansible on GCP or AWS. 
 - Create new test cases using adhoc or scheduled tests to discover corner case scenarios

Requirements

- 9+ years in software testing, QA, or system validation in a product development company
 - Advanced Linux knowledge (CLI, system services, core OS concepts). 
 - Played a key role in Software Quality for an Enterprise class software product. 
 - Strong scripting skills in C/C++, python etc. 
 - Implemented process adherence in development environment
 - Familiarity with GitHub, Ansible, Cucumber/Radish, and Jira. 
 - Curiosity about low-level software/hardware interaction. 
 - Ability to work independently amid rapidly changing priorities. 
 - Drive to make things better, faster, and more cost-effective. 
 - Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. 
 - Expertise in one of the domain (Storage, Process, Post Silicon System Validation etc)

Academic Credentials

Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field preferred, or equivalent. 

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. 

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. 

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD's "Responsible AI Policy" is available here. 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

data.title: AI Automation Engineer
data.description:
AI Automation Engineer

Accelerate Performance. 

About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long-term performance partner. 

With 6, 200+ active customers worldwide and a market-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45+ years of industry expertise with modern AI-driven execution - helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15+ industries and 10+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact. 

CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company. 

This role is part of our Discrete Manufacturing business unit, which delivers software solutions for manufacturers that produce components and assemblies that become part of larger products. Serving small through enterprise manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, industrial equipment, and engineered products, Discrete Manufacturing focuses on modern execution-connecting planning, production, traceability, and automation to help manufacturers run more resilient, efficient, and predictable operations. 

CAI India

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust. 

The Role

You will be the engineer who walks into a business problem, sees the application, dashboard or integration that solves it, and builds it end to end - with AI as your first tool and a full stack of skills behind it. As CAI Discrete's single, self-sufficient builder, you will work with the leaders of Support, Professional Services, Sales, Marketing, Product and Engineering to find manual, repetitive or invisible work and replace it with something that runs on its own: an AI-driven workflow on Claude and tools such as Scribe, a purpose-built internal application, a live executive dashboard, or a data pipeline connecting the systems CAI runs on - NetSuite, Salesforce and Service Cloud, Gong, Mosaic, Aha!, Jira/Azure DevOps and GitHub. This is a hands-on build role; success means things you built are in daily use, manual hours are gone and leadership decides from dashboards you created. You start as the only dedicated AI Automation Engineer in the BU; your track record is what grows the team. 

What You Will Build and Do

- AI-driven automations: Claude-based agents and workflows that remove repetitive steps in Support and PS first, then Sales, Marketing, Product and Engineering - prompt and tool design, agentic flows, guardrails and evaluation. 
 - Internal applications: Small, purpose-built web applications where no off-the-shelf tool fits, built end to end - React or Angular front end, Python/C#/Node API, SQL database - secured with CAI's identity platform. 
 - Executive dashboards: Weekly-use dashboards for pipeline to revenue, market signals, customer health, engineering productivity and roadmap to shipped, with consistent KPI definitions and AI-generated narrative. 
 - Data connectivity for enterprise applications: Pipelines and connectors pulling enterprise-application data via APIs into a governed data layer with scheduled refresh and quality checks - internal business-system connectivity for analytics, not product integration. 
 - How you work: Scope the need with functional leaders, propose and align before building, ship with source control, CI/CD, tests and documentation, monitor in production, and quantify impact in hours saved, cycle time and adoption. What We Are Looking For

- 6+ years of software engineering with demonstrated full-stack delivery - applications you personally built across front end, API and database and supported in production. 
 - Hands-on experience building automations or applied AI workflows with Claude, ChatGPT or comparable LLM tooling; demonstrated build experience, not theoretical interest. 
 - Proficiency in a back-end language (Python, C#/. NET or Node. js/TypeScript), a modern front-end framework (React or Angular) and SQL, including data modeling and query tuning. 
 - Dashboards and data pipelines: Power BI, Tableau or a code-based stack; ETL/ELT design; API integration with SaaS business applications (OAuth 2. 0, webhooks, incremental extraction) - ideally two or more of NetSuite, Salesforce/Service Cloud, Gong, Mosaic, Aha!, Jira/ADO, GitHub. 
 - Engineering fundamentals - Git, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins), automated testing, Azure or AWS, secure handling of credentials and data. 
 - Business instinct to pick problems worth solving, clear written and spoken English with non-technical stakeholders, strong self-direction across concurrent projects, and regular overlap with US business hours. Role Parameters and Ownership

- Bangalore, India; minimum two days per week in office; no travel. Priorities and assignments from the GM, CAI Discrete Manufacturing; engineering standards and cross-BU practice with the Director of Engineering, Bangalore. 
 - High-ownership objectives: initial roadmap within 30 days with execution from month two; monthly status and quarterly outcome reports; hours saved as FTE-equivalent capacity is a standing measure. 

How Success Is Measured

• Release testing completed on schedule with a documented go/no-go and no critical escaped defects. 

• Automated regression coverage of agreed critical paths, growing every release. 

• Stable suites: flaky-test rate kept low and results trusted by the team. 

• Shorter regression cycle time through automation. 

• Fast, well-documented defect turnaround. 

CAI Software provides industry-specific software for manufacturers and asset-intensive organizations. Our mission is to Accelerate Performance for our customers. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. 

Why Join CAI

You will build software that runs real factories - the systems that tell operators what to make, capture what happened on the shop floor, and keep supply chains moving. You will be paired with experienced engineers, given ownership of well-scoped features from your first sprint, and exposed to the full product lifecycle: requirements, design, code, test, release and customer feedback. You will learn both modern engineering practices and the manufacturing domain in depth, building a career foundation that is in high demand across the industry. 

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6, 200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like - and we are building the team to lead that work. 

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers - and how we work: 

- Built to Fit - Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
 - Built to Expedite - Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays. 
 - Built to Deliver - AI turns action and insights into measurable performance. 
 - Built to Scale - Sustains and scales performance without disruption. 

CAI Software is an "EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. "

Benefits & Remuneration

- Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package
 - Hybrid work environment
 - Generous holiday allowance and additional employee perks
 - Strong focus on Individual Career Development (IDP)
 - Clear progression plan with opportunities for a long-term career within the business
 - Future opportunity to build and lead your own team as the business grows
 - Exposure to global teams and customers
 - Be part of a leading ERP software vendor serving Manufacturers, Food & Beverage producers, processors, distributors, and the Print Industry
 - Join a collaborative, values-led team committed to growing the business and enabling customers to thrive

Equal Employment Opportunity

CAI Software is an Equal Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law.

CAI Software endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use the online application process and need an alternative method for applying, please contact us at talent. acquisition@caisoft. com or send an e-mail with your specific accommodation request. 

Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination

CAI Software will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1. 35(c).

data.description:
Description

Love building and leading high-performing engineering teams? Want to own the systems that keep billing accurate and trustworthy for millions of advertisers spending billions of dollars worldwide? Excited to lead the shift from manual financial operations to AI-powered and agentic automation? Then, the Iron Mountain platform team wants you!

Amazon Advertising is one of the fastest-growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost product reach and sales through performance and display advertising. The Iron Mountain platform is the singular system that manages all advertiser billing, invoicing, accounting automation, real-time budgeting, promotions, payments, and Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) - processing multi-billion transactions worth 100x in dollar value daily, worldwide, across all ad products displayed On or Off Amazon. 

Billing accuracy is a critical pillar of this platform. This team owns billing corrections (credits and rebills), offline and alternative payment workflows, and the revenue-integrity mechanisms that make advertising billing transparent and auditable end to end - serving thousands of correction requests each year from partners across Ads Sales, Finance, Accounting, and FinOps. The multi-year roadmap transforms this space into self-service and intelligent automation: AI-driven investigation of billing defects, agentic correction workflows, and advertiser-facing self-service experiences. 

The Iron Mountain team is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead this Bengaluru-based team. You will: 

Lead, hire, and develop a team of 8+ engineers, owning their growth, delivery, and engineering excellence

Own the product and technical roadmap for billing corrections and offline payments - from high-volume manual workflows today to automated, self-service, and agentic experiences through 2027

Drive operational excellence for tier-1 billing systems where accuracy and availability directly protect advertiser trust and Amazon revenue

Shape how GenAI and AI agents interact with financial systems safely - automation with auditability, guardrails, and zero tolerance for monetary error

Partner across Finance, Accounting, FinOps, and ad-product teams worldwide to reduce correction volume at the root cause, not just process it faster

Be a player-coach: technically strong enough to hold the bar in design reviews, while spending your energy on people, roadmap, and delivery

To succeed, you will bring a track record of building strong teams and delivering large-scale distributed systems, comfort operating business-critical financial services, and a forward-looking perspective on how AI transforms financial operations - combined with people-first leadership that grows engineers as fast as it ships software. 

Key job responsibilities

People & Team Leadership

- Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of SDEs. 
 - Set technical direction and priorities, balancing short-term deliverables with long-term architectural investments
 - Foster a culture of operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement
 - Drive career development for team members, providing regular coaching and feedback
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with partner teams and stakeholders to align on roadmaps and dependencies. 

A day in the life

As a Software Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in the development of services that keep advertising billing accurate and trustworthy at global scale. You will lead a dynamic group of passionate engineers and collaborate with peer teams across Ads, Finance, and Accounting to identify automation opportunities, design novel solutions that meet customer requirements, and build software that intelligently detects and remediates billing defects across our worldwide advertising platforms. You will be building highly available, scalable, and auditable architecture - increasingly powered by AI and agentic workflows - to execute financial corrections safely and effectively. 

About The Team

The Cashmere team builds software which supports the automated detection, correction, and settlement of advertiser billing, empowering humans to automate key financial operations and take themselves out of the loop as Amazon Advertising scales. We own services that model billing behaviors across ad products and marketplaces, identify and remediate defects before they reach advertisers, capture the financial and compliance constraints of our systems, and execute credits, rebills, and offline payments that serve our customers while preserving accuracy, auditability, and advertiser trust. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - 1+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
 - 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
 - 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience
 - 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using distributed programming experience
 - 5+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

data.title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
data.description:
Company Overview

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best - bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what's next. 

Overview

- Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment. 
 - Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration. 
 - Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform. 

Key Accountabilities

- Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management. 
 - Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management. 
 - Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency. 
 - Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations. 
 - Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks. 
 - Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews. 
 - Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions. 
 - Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications. 
 - Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Full-time bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university. 
 - Experience: 8-12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems. 
 - GCP - primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity. 
 - Terraform - primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale. 
 - Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation. 
 - Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications. 
 - Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation. 
 - ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes. 
 - Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications. 
 - Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role. 
 - Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery. 
 - Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments. 
 - Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable. 
 - Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity. 
 - Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution. 

SUPPORT REQUIREMENT

- The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team's operational support model. 

ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

data.title: Staff Engineer – Observability Platform
data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Observability team. This role is ideal for a highly technical engineer who thrives on uncovering the truth behind complex system behaviors, diagnosing difficult production challenges, and driving platform-wide improvements. 

As a Staff Engineer, you will operate as a force multiplier across engineering teams, helping Postman build world-class observability capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and developer productivity. You will partner closely with Infrastructure, Platform, Product, Security, and Data teams to identify systemic issues, establish operational excellence, and ensure engineering teams have the visibility they need to operate at scale. 

What You'll Do

- Drive the technical vision and architecture for Postman's observability platform. 
 - Design and build scalable solutions for metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and operational analytics. 
 - Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and drive long-term corrective actions. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to improve service reliability, availability, performance, and operational maturity. 
 - Establish observability standards, best practices, and instrumentation frameworks across the company. 
 - Build tooling and automation that enable faster incident detection, diagnosis, and resolution. 
 - Leverage telemetry data to uncover performance bottlenecks, capacity risks, and reliability gaps. 
 - Drive cross-functional initiatives focused on platform health, operational excellence, and engineering productivity. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and help raise the technical bar across the organization. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with significant exposure to distributed systems and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Strong expertise in observability domains including monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, telemetry pipelines, and incident management. 
 - Experience operating large-scale production systems with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and performance. 
 - Deep understanding of system debugging, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, and production operations. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, Node. js, or similar. 
 - Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Honeycomb, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct authority. 
 - Strong communication skills and a data-driven approach to problem-solving. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building internal developer platforms or observability platforms at scale. 
 - Exposure to AIOps, intelligent alerting, anomaly detection, or AI-powered operational tooling. 
 - Experience driving reliability initiatives across multiple engineering organizations. 
 - Background in SRE, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Developer Productivity. 

Why This Role Matters

The Observability team sits at the center of Postman's engineering ecosystem. Success in this role means creating the visibility, insights, and operational intelligence that enable every engineering team at Postman to build and operate reliable products with confidence. 

This is a high-impact Staff Engineer position for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, driving engineering excellence, and uncovering the signals that help teams make better decisions. 

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we're always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team. 

**This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location**

The Senior Software Engineer is a senior-level position on the CES Connections engineering team, utilizing in-depth knowledge and experience to solve complex problems and lead large or high-profile projects that power Syndigo's product data integrations. This role applies creative approaches to improve existing engineering processes, analyzes and resolves escalated technical issues, and serves as a resource for less-experienced colleagues.
