data.title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently. 

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally. 

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship
 - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heartPlease be advised that Jitterbit does not: 

- Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
 - Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
 - Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
 - Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages. 

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées. Influe sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'efficience de sa propre équipe. Contribue significativement à l'élaboration des priorités. Se fonde sur des pratiques et des politiques professionnelles façonnées par le rôle. Le rôle dispose d'une autonomie modérée, nécessitant un haut niveau de discernement opérationnel. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Est conscient des derniers développements techniques dans son propre domaine. Contribue à l'élaboration de stratégies et de politiques, et assure la mise en œuvre dans les limites de son domaine de responsabilités. 
 - Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.

Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision.

Développe les compétences de persuasion nécessaires pour influencer les autres sur des sujets relevant de son domaine.

-

Job Purpose: This role is responsible for driving business excellence and organization transformation through continuous improvement initiatives, while ensuring compliance with IMS, DISHA, ABEM, and other quality frameworks through regular audits, training, and process management. Additionally, this role will also oversee equipment management strategies, optimize resource allocation, and maintain high standards of operational excellence in line with Six Sigma methodologies. 

Responsibilities

Lead Business Excellence and Organization Transformation

Integrated Management Systems (IMS) And Audits

Ensure adherence to the 9 standards as outlined in the IMS framework. 

Facilitate communication for internal audits, collate observations, ensure timely closure of findings and manage the recertification process. 

Organize and lead management review meetings to communicate audit findings and drive continuous improvement. 

Coordinate refresher trainings for new joiners on IMS and provide auditor training as needed. 

Oversee surveillance audits conducted by external auditors, such as TUV NORD, and ensure compliance with observations. 

DISHA Process Management

Ensure processes align with DISHA requirements and oversee adherence across operations and maintenance (O&M) teams. 

Audit DISHA processes as documented in the 18 manuals, track compliance, and report KPI achievements to management. 

Govern the accountability framework for DISHA processes and ensure robust implementation. 

Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) for critical equipment, and as needed for non-critical equipment. 

Perform regular FMEA for defined equipment and RCA at the unit level for UTA. 

ABEM And AWMS Compliance

Ensure strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) within the ABEM framework. 

Lead preparation for audits based on communications from the business excellence team at the head office, monitor and track the sustainment of ABEM practices within the assigned zone. 

Facilitate 5S activities and ensure they are performed consistently. 

Coordinate with the head office team for QC and 5S audits, acting as the SPOC for audit schedules, planning, and tracking. 

Maintenance And Equipment Management

Conduct periodic reviews of equipment classification to ensure accurate categorization. 

Analyse critical inventory to optimize resource allocation and minimize downtime. 

Maintain a clear distinction between critical and non-critical equipment for prioritized maintenance. 

Business Sustainability

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA, and CHETNA guidelines to ensure sustainable business practices. 

Prioritize safety of personnel and equipment by enforcing training and adherence to safety protocols. 

Drive initiatives for environmental sustainability and compliance with relevant regulations. 

Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality management within the department. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to enhance operational efficiency. 

Implement process and system improvements by integrating new technologies and adoption of automation solutions. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of digital initiatives.

Operations & Maintenance

Key Stakeholders - External

Auditors

BE/B. tech or equivalent technical field. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

10+ years of experience in quality management, process improvement, or a related field, with a proven track record in leading transformation initiatives. 

Preferred Industry

data.title: System Development Engineer,, DSP Analytics
data.description:
Description

Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top engineering talent get you charged up?

Looking for a highly motivated System Development Engineer to help build Amazon's business critical delivery systems and build solutions to operate at scale. You will work on critical business functions for our customers around the world while meeting system availability goals and ensuring system performance with growing business needs. You will discover innovative ways to automate and scale our infrastructure as we expand globally. You will work together with multiple teams and departments, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. 

The ideal candidate has a passion for understanding computing systems and for applying that understanding with an obsession for delighting customers. In this role, you will apply your skills of system design, networking, coding/scripting languages, as well as technical communication and project organization to make your impact on improving our business processes. The candidate is expected to contribute work critical initiatives, build products, lead engineers to troubleshoot, debug, evaluate and resolve computer-identified alarms, make feature enhancements, systems management, perform software deployments and migrations, host management and automate the operational tasks. 

They would also be responsible to develop tools and end to end automation to achieve human free operations. 

As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team. 

Key job responsibilities

Design, implement, maintain, and deploy components that solve problems in a complex ecosystem. We work in lots of different languages (not limited to, but most often Python and Java). It is more important to us that you understand coding in the context of working in distributed systems and/or widely scaled web applications. 

- Lead migration projects from planning through execution, including infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation
 - Identify and implement cost optimization strategies to reduce per-offering costs through automation and streamlined operations. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, conducting code reviews, providing technical direction, and fostering a culture of operational excellence within the team. 
 - Lead root cause analysis for high-severity incidents, implement preventive measures, and drive operational improvements across the team's processes and tooling. 
 - Collaborate with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration blockers
 - Participate in on-call rotations to ensure operational support for critical migration activities
 - Building AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operation or make our day to day job easier and faster. 
 - Perform deep dive on services with different compute type to generate recommendations for optimization of resources. 

A day in the life

You will lead the technical direction for complex migration challenges using AWS technologies and modern development practices. You might collaborate on pipeline infrastructure setups, build AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operations, or develop tools in Python and Java to automate critical migration tasks. You'll work closely with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration obstacles, analyze memory efficiency across service fleets. Your work will span infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation, all while supporting operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You'll also mentor team members, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with Seattle-based leadership on strategic priorities. 

About The Team

We are the Amazon DSP Analytics team, supporting all business pillars across the DSP organization horizontally, with the vision to enable data-, insights-, and science-driven decision-making. We are an exceptionally talented and fun-loving team. Here, you'll have the opportunity to dive deep into complex business and data problems, drive large-scale technical solutions, and raise the bar for operational excellence. We love sharing ideas and learning from each other, and we believe in using those ideas to disrupt the status quo. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
 - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
 - Experience with Linux/Unix
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
 - 4+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science
 - Experience in Performance tuning or optimization of compute resources. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale
 - 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)

Your leadership will ensure that AI & ML data collection systems are developed and operationalized at the highest standards of performance, reliability, and security. You will be working closely with individual contributors, ensuring that projects align with broader business goals and AI/ML strategies. 

Job Description

As an Engineering Manager, AI & ML (Data Collection), you will play a vital role in executing the company's AI and machine learning initiatives with a strong focus on data collection technologies. This position will require deep technical expertise in unstructured data processing, data collection pipeline engineering, and a hands-on approach to managing and mentoring engineers. Your leadership will ensure that AI & ML data collection systems are developed and operationalized at the highest standards of performance, reliability, and security. You will be working closely with individual contributors, ensuring that projects align with broader business goals and AI/ML strategies. 

This role requires deep engagement in the design, development, and maintenance of AI & ML models, solutions, architecture, and services. You will need to provide strong technical direction, problem-solve complex technical challenges, and ensure that the team consistently delivers high-quality, scalable solutions. You will leverage your deep knowledge in areas such as advanced natural language processing (NLP), generative AI (GenAI) and large language models (LLMs), ML Operations (MLOps), data architecture, data pipelines, and cloud-managed services. 

Your leadership will ensure that our AI/ML systems align with global business strategies, maintaining seamless integration and high-performance standards. You will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML data systems-from research and development to deployment and operationalization. 

You will be responsible for mentoring team members, resolving technical challenges, and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration while ensuring they have the right tools, frameworks, and guidance to succeed. This role offers a unique opportunity to drive impactful change in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, where your efforts will directly contribute to the success of our AI/ML initiatives globally. Your ability to collaborate with cross-departmental stakeholders, provide leadership across locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You will solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. 

Team Overview

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers and data scientists responsible for building AI & ML solutions and services as part of robust data collection pipelines handling large volumes of unstructured data. Your team will focus on building scalable and reliable systems to process and categorize data that is essential for downstream data collection processing. 

Outline of Duties and Responsibilities

- AI & ML Data Collection Leadership: Drive the execution of AI & ML initiatives related to data collection, ensuring that the team's efforts are aligned with overall business goals and strategies. 
 - Technical Oversight: Provide hands-on technical leadership in the engineering of ML models and services, focusing on unstructured data, NLP, and classifiers. Oversee and contribute to the implementation of scalable solutions that meet high standards of reliability and efficiency. 
 - Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and data scientists, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Ensure effective communication and coordination within your team and across geographically dispersed teams. 
 - NLP Technologies: Contribute to the development and application of NLP techniques, including classifiers, transformers, LLMs, and other methodologies, to efficiently process and categorize unstructured data. Ensure these models are integrated seamlessly into the broader AI/ML infrastructure. 
 - Data Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain advanced data collection pipelines, utilizing orchestration, messaging, database, and data platform technologies. Ensure pipelines are optimized for scalability, performance, and reliability. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with other AI/ML teams, data collection engineering teams, product management, and others to ensure data collection efforts support broader AI/ML goals and product objectives. 
 - Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Continuously explore and implement new technologies and methodologies to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of data collection and processing systems. Stay at the forefront of advancements in NLP and data processing. 
 - System Integrity & Security: Ensure that all data collection systems meet the highest standards of integrity, security, and compliance. Implement best practices for data governance and model transparency. 
 - Talent Acquisition & Retention: Play an active role in recruiting, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Foster an environment where team members are encouraged to innovate, feel valued, and achieve their full potential. 
 - Process Improvement: Apply Agile, Lean, and Fast-Flow principles to improve team efficiency and the delivery of high-quality data collection solutions. 
 - Support Company Vision and Values: Model and promote behaviors that align with the company's vision and values. Participate actively in company-wide initiatives and projects as required. 

Experience, Skills and Qualifications

 - 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on AI & ML technologies, particularly in data collection and unstructured data processing.

 - Strong expertise in NLP and machine learning, with hands-on experience in classifiers, large language models (LLMs), and other NLP techniques. Additionally experience in Gen AI, RAG, Agentic AI is essential
 - Extensive experience with data pipeline and messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Airflow, and cloud data platforms (e. g. , Snowflake).

 - Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and containerization (e. g. , Kubernetes, Docker) with experience in managing these systems globally.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phones on an ongoing basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

data.description:
Job Title

Controls Project Engineer I

Job Description

Controls Project Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time

If you are passionate about industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, and delivering advanced automation solutions for material handling environments, this could be the ideal opportunity for you. 

Your Role

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, integration, and commissioning of Low-Level Controls (LLC) software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems. You will work with Siemens PLC technologies, SCADA, HMI, drives, and safety systems to deliver reliable and high-quality control solutions. 

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary and international project teams, support customer-facing activities, provide technical guidance to junior engineers, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of Vanderlande's controls solutions. 

What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities

Controls Software Development & Engineering

- Design, develop, and test LLC software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems using Siemens TIA Portal. 
 - Develop functional PLC software based on customer requirements, project specifications, and standard controls architecture. 
 - Program and configure Siemens PLC systems using Ladder Logic, FBD, STL, and SCL. 
 - Configure and integrate PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, and safety systems. 
 - Apply reusable software modules, library structures, and standardized controls solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain technical documentation including functional specifications, interface documents, and engineering deliverables. 

Testing, Integration & Commissioning

- Perform engineering, simulation, emulation, FAT, SAT, and site commissioning activities. 
 - Troubleshoot software, communication, PLC, HMI, and controls-related issues during testing and commissioning. 
 - Perform system integration activities with SCADA, Equipment Management, Mechanical, Electrical, and Safety disciplines. 
 - Use Siemens diagnostic tools such as Proneta and online diagnostics for troubleshooting and system validation. 
 - Support backup, version management, and software configuration activities. 
 - Prepare test plans, commissioning documentation, and reports to support successful project delivery. 
 - Support successful project handover and completion of Service Take Over (STO) deliverables. 

Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

- Identify project risks, technical issues, and dependencies and recommend appropriate mitigation actions. 
 - Support customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions when required. 
 - Mentor junior Controls Engineers and provide technical guidance during engineering, testing, and commissioning activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with engineering standards, development processes, and quality guidelines. 
 - Contribute to software standardization and continuous improvement of products, tools, and engineering processes. 
 - Report technical progress, deviations, risks, and issues to the Project Lead Engineer and Group Leader. 
 - Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams across global locations. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation and PLC-based control systems. 
 - Proven experience in engineering, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automated material handling or industrial automation systems. 
 - Experience working on international projects and site commissioning activities is preferred. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal for PLC development, troubleshooting, testing, and commissioning. 
 - Good understanding of SCADA systems and system integration. 
 - Experience with HMI development, screen configuration, alarms, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Strong knowledge of
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram (FBD)
 - Statement List (STL)
 - Structured Control Language (SCL)
 - Hands-on experience with
 - PROFINET
 - PROFIBUS
 - AS-i
 - Familiarity with Siemens engineering and diagnostic tools including Proneta, online diagnostics, backup, and version management. 
 - Working knowledge of Siemens PLC concepts including data blocks, indirect addressing, reusable software modules, and library structures. 
 - Basic to intermediate experience with Safety PLC programming, testing, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk View is an added advantage. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Good communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams. 
 - Willingness to travel internationally for commissioning and customer support, approximately 50-70%. 
About Vanderlande

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey-from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors. 

At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other. 

Website www. vanderlande. com

What We Offer

Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice

 - Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs

 - Opportunity to collaborate globally with engineering teams and international customers

How We Work

We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. 

In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say. 

Ready to apply?

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer – IPsec/VPP/Kubernetes
data.description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Network Platform Software Engineer with 8-12 years of hands-on software/platform development experience in networking, telecom, or high-performance networking domains. 

The role will primarily focus on network platform development, feature implementation, code-level debugging, issue resolution, and system integration across IPsec, VPP, StrongSwan, Linux networking, Docker, and Kubernetes. The engineer will also contribute to AI-assisted engineering initiatives, developing tools to automate log analysis and improve root-cause identification and debugging efficiency. 

What you'll do: 

Design, develop, debug, integrate, and maintain networking/platform software involving IPsec, VPP, StrongSwan, and Linux networking. 

Develop and enhance networking features involving IPsec/IKE, routing, traffic selectors, SPD/SAD, tunnels, and traffic segregation. 

Work with existing codebases to understand implementation flows, modify code, implement fixes, and resolve defects. 

Debug complex networking scenarios across multi-tunnel, multi-network, VLAN, container, and Kubernetes environments. 

Perform end-to-end troubleshooting and RCA across application, container, networking, VPP/DPDK, and Linux kernel layers. 

Develop and enhance AI-assisted tools for automated log analysis and root-cause identification, and collaborate across teams to drive complex issues through resolution. 

What you should have: 

8-13 years of hands-on software/platform development experience, preferably in networking or telecom. 

Strong hands-on experience with IPsec, VPP, and StrongSwan, including implementation, debugging, and integration. 

Strong Linux/Kernel networking expertise, including packet flow, CPU/IRQ, performance, and system-level debugging. 

Hands-on experience with Docker/Kubernetes networking, including CNI/Multus, SR-IOV, pod/service networking, and cluster debugging. 

Experience with VPP/DPDK and high-performance networking is highly desirable. 

Strong C/C++ programming and debugging skills, with Python/scripting skills for automation, analysis, and development of engineering tools. 

AI & Automation - Good to Have: 

Exposure to AI/LLM-based developer tools or coding assistants. 

Interest or experience in applying AI to software development, log analysis, debugging, and RCA automation. 

Experience with automation, log-processing, or internal debugging/analysis tools. 

Nice to Have: 

Experience with VPP/DPDK datapath development and performance optimization. 

Experience with Linux kernel networking internals and system debugging tools. 

Experience with SR-IOV, Multus, CNI, and cloud-native telecom networking. 

Experience with high-performance packet processing and telecom networking products. 

Role Evolution: 

The initial focus will be on understanding the existing networking implementation, codebase, architecture, and failure patterns. Over time, the engineer will take increasing ownership of feature development, code-level debugging, defect resolution, performance optimization, and AI-assisted RCA capabilities. 

The objective is to build strong engineering ownership across the networking stack, from application and container layers through IPsec, VPP/DPDK, Linux networking, and kernel layers, while using AI-assisted automation to improve log analysis, debugging efficiency, and root-cause accuracy.

data.description:
Job Description

The Manager, Internal Controls will be based in India. In this position, you will report to the Head of Internal Controls. Nextpower is seeking a Manager, Internal Control to lead the company's SOX and internal controls work across assigned business processes. This role manages and develops a team of internal controls professionals while partnering with Finance, Accounting, IT, Operations, Legal, and external auditors. The manager sets team priorities, oversees routine operating plans and costs, and guides risk assessments, control design and testing, remediation, and readiness efforts. The role requires sound judgment, strong knowledge of business processes and financial reporting, and the ability to turn control requirements into practical solutions. 

Watch "Culture is our Passion" to learn more about us

We Are Looking For Someone Who Demonstrates

- Passionate drive to innovate and create
 - Integrity to the core
 - Enthusiastic customer focus
 - Consistent interactive teamwork
 - Desire for continuous improvement and top performance. 

Here Is a Glimpse Of What You Will Do

People leadership and team operations

- Manage, coach, and develop a team of internal controls professionals; set clear goals, assign work, review quality and timeliness, provide ongoing feedback, and support performance and career development. 
 - Plan and allocate team capacity against monthly and routine operating plans; monitor milestones, workload, and costs, and raise resource or schedule risks with leadership. 
 - Apply company policies consistently, address routine team matters, and recommend improvements to procedures and practices within the function. 

SOX program and control environment

- Lead and contribute to SOX risk assessments, annual planning and scoping, readiness activities, and the ongoing maturity of the SOX program. 
 - Oversee assigned process areas and ensure the team understands related business activities, risks, controls, company policies, and applicable accounting and reporting requirements. 
 - Guide process walkthroughs, tests of design, and tests of operating effectiveness; review workpapers and documentation for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. 
 - Partner with process owners to evaluate existing processes, identify control gaps and improvement opportunities, and design practical controls that address risk and exposure. 
 - Assess new projects, systems, and process changes for SOX impact; coordinate with cross-functional partners to define and complete readiness actions. 
 - Maintain accurate SOX documentation, including process narratives, flowcharts, risk-control matrices, and evidence of control performance. 

Issues, remediation, and partnership

- Evaluate audit findings and control deficiencies; analyze relevant facts, assess potential impact, and develop and track remediation plans with SOX leadership and accountable stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with internal and external auditors and support requests related to SOX, internal controls, and financial reporting. 
 - Explain control requirements, findings, and recommendations to process owners, peer groups, and leaders; build cooperation and influence timely action across functions. 
 - Monitor progress against commitments, resolve routine execution issues, and escalate significant risks, delays, or resource needs. 

Governance and continuous improvement

- Stay current on relevant SOX, PCAOB, COSO, U. S. GAAP, and public-company reporting requirements and emerging practices. 
 - Recommend updates to team procedures and control practices based on changes in the business, systems, risks, and applicable requirements. 

Here Is Some Of What You Will Need (required)

- Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - (10-12) years of related experience in accounting, external or internal audit, SOX, or internal controls, preferably across public accounting and corporate environments. 
 - Experience directly managing or formally leading employees, including assigning work, coaching, providing feedback, and supporting performance and development. 
 - Working knowledge of SOX 404, internal control frameworks such as COSO, audit requirements including PCAOB standards, and U. S. GAAP. 
 - Experience assessing business process risks, designing or evaluating controls, leading walkthroughs and control testing, documenting results, and driving remediation. 
 - Ability to analyze complex or incomplete information, exercise sound judgment, and interpret requirements to recommend appropriate procedures and actions. 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical control matters and gain cooperation from cross-functional partners. 
 - Demonstrated ability to organize team work, manage multiple timelines, and deliver against recurring plans

Here Are a Few Of Our Preferred Experiences

- CPA, CIA, or other relevant professional certification. 
 - Experience supporting a public company's SOX program through growth, system implementation, acquisition, or process transformation. 
 - Experience with internal controls over financial reporting across finance, accounting, IT, or operational processes.

You will be responsible for taking features from a raw concept to a live environment, ensuring that every deployment delivers high technical excellence and system stability. data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Computer Engineering or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10 years of experience in SoC DFT architecture and design. 
 - 10 years of experience in DFT protocols including Scan Compression, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG (IEEE 1149. 1), and iJTAG (IEEE 1687). 
 - 10 years of experience with industry-standard EDA tools such as Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX/SMS, or Cadence Modus. 
 - 4 years of people management experience developing employees and leading multiple SoC projects from RTL architecture through to post-silicon validation. 
 - Experience in Tcl, Python, or Perl for developing automation flows. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- PhD in Electrical Engineering with a focus on VLSI testing, fault tolerance, or reliability. 
 - Experience with advanced technology nodes (5nm/3nm), 2. 5D/3D-IC packaging, or high-speed I/O (SerDes/DDR) testing methodologies. 
 - Experience managing global technical teams and driving vendor engagement. 
 - Ability to drive cross-functional timing closure, power analysis, and IR-drop mitigation for high-frequency designs. 

About The Job

In this role, you'll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You'll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems. 

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what's possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. 

Responsibilities

- Define and document the comprehensive DFT architecture for multi-core SoCs, including strategies for hierarchical scan compression, Memory BIST (MBIST) for huge memory instances, Functional BISTs, Analog components, Logic BIST, high-speed I/O loopback, and JTAG/IEEE 1149. 1/1500/1687/1838 networks. 
 - Lead the complete DFT lifecycle from RTL planning to pattern handoff, own the schedule, resource allocation, and milestone tracking to ensure zero-defect delivery. 
 - Deploy next-generation DFT methodologies and automation flows to maximize test coverage, while minimizing test time, pattern count, and silicon area overhead. 
 - Collaborate with post silicon team, Physical Design and Power Architects. 
 - Support the post-silicon phase to achieve final Production Release Qualification (PRQ). Mentor senior technical staff, drive vendor EDA tool selection/qualification, and act as the primary technical liaison for DFT matters with stakeholders.

data.title: Migrations Operations Manager
data.description:
Location: Trivandrum

About us

At Arbor, we're on a mission to transform the way schools work for the better.   

We believe in a future of work in schools where being challenged doesn't mean being burnt out and overworked. Where data guides progress without overwhelming staff. And where everyone working in a school is reminded why they got into education every day.   

Our MIS and school management tools are already making a difference in over 12, 000 schools and trusts. Giving time and power back to staff, turning data into clear, actionable insights, and supporting happier working days.   

At the heart of our brand is a recognition that the challenges schools face today aren't just about efficiency, outputs and productivity - but about creating happier working lives for the people who drive education everyday: the staff. We want to make schools more joyful places to work, as well as learn.   

About the role

We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Migration Operations Manager to join our Engineering team and lead the team responsible for the operational health of the migration journey for Arbor products, primarily Arbor MIS, alongside other products such as Arbor Finance. The remit and focus of the role is to line-manage and develop a team of Migration Operations Engineers, ensure smooth day to day operations, and drive lasting improvements across the migration pipeline. You will work closely with Onboarding, Support, and the Migration Product, and Platform teams to ensure migrations are executed at scale with high quality. . It's a broad and exciting role, so we're looking for someone up for a challenge - if you're an effective leader and a good communicator, this is the role for you. 

Core responsibilities

People Management & Leadership

- Line-manage and support the development of Migration Operations Engineers, including conducting 1: 1s, performance reviews, and fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture
 - Recruit, onboard, and retain strong operational engineers, building a team that can scale with migration volume
 - Set the bar for operational quality, defining what "good" looks like for migration operations and holding the team to that standard
 - Mentor and coach team members in migration best practices, triage, root cause analysis, and escalation, delivering constructive feedback that balances recognition of strengths with actionable development areas
 - Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and learning from both successes and failures
 - Champion knowledge sharing across the team and wider organisation through tech talks, playbooks, and structured learning
 - Manage team capacity against migration volume, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across multiple products and countries
 - Oversee project planning for migration operations work, lead estimation and feasibility assessments, and take ownership of resource allocation and execution
Delivery & Execution

- Ensure that migrations complete well within SLA, organising the team and on-call rota to ensure we have coverage during critical migration events
 - Own operational readiness for large-scale and time-sensitive migration windows, including risk assessments, checklists, and go/no-go decisions
 - Lead root cause analysis on failed or delayed migrations, identifying recurring failure patterns and systemic issues. Run post-incident reviews and ensure lessons learned are applied to prevent recurrence
 - Define and maintain triage frameworks, severity classification, prioritisation criteria, and escalation paths
 - Ensure migrations meet defined SLAs and quality benchmarks, contributing to the definition and evolution of those standards
 - Drive automation initiatives to reduce operational toil, improve data integrity checks, and increase migration throughput
 - Maintain and improve migration operational documentation, playbooks, and best practices
 - Adapt plans quickly when circumstances change mid-migration, making sound judgement calls under pressure

Collaboration & Communication

- Provide structured, prioritised operational feedback and requirements to the Migration Product and Migration Platform team, acting as the voice of operations in platform decisions
 - Act as the migration operations function's primary liaison with Onboarding, Support teams, proactively driving communication
 - Proactively flag migration risks, blockers, and timeline impacts to stakeholders, managing expectations and negotiating timelines when needed
 - Build strong working relationships with customer-facing teams to understand the school's perspective, feeding that insight back into how migrations are prioritised and executed
 - Run or contribute to regular cross-team syncs to maintain alignment and surface issues early
 - Communicate migration status, risks, and decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex migration issues into understandable updates tailored to the audience

Requirements

About you

- Demonstrated experience leading technical operations for complex production systems, with a track record of managing risk, improving reliability, and coordinating delivery across multiple workstreams
 - Demonstrated ability in people management, including 1: 1s, performance reviews, hiring, and developing engineers
 - Understanding of SLAs, operational metrics, and service reliability concepts (SLOs/SLIs)
 - Proven ability to deliver through others while maintaining the technical depth required to contribute hands-on when appropriate
 - Significant experience operating or supporting data migration processes in production environments
 - Deep experience with monitoring and observability platforms (e. g. , Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent)
 - Experience with incident management, operational triage, and post-incident review processes
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working directly with customer-facing teams
 - Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritise effectively under pressure, and adapt when circumstances change
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Experience using AI tooling to increase team productivity, or a strong interest in doing so

Desirable

- Experience in SaaS environments, particularly education technology or school MIS systems
 - Experience with data migrations between competing platforms at scale (ETL, cutovers, decommissioning of legacy systems)

Benefits

What we offer

The chance to work alongside a team of hard-working, passionate people in a role where you'll see the impact of your work every day. 

We also offer:

data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI team, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end - from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface - and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows, or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on. 

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1-2 years) building AI-agentified applications - not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI during technical evaluation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own features end to end - database schema, backend services, APIs, and frontend (React/Next. js) user interface - operating as an owner rather than a ticket-taker. 
 - Build full-stack web applications: responsive, production-grade frontends using React/Next. js, backed by well-designed REST APIs and backend services. 
 - Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces. . 
 - Build and productionize AI-agentified features - agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling - grounded in 1-2 years of hands-on experience with these systems. 
 - Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers. 
 - Apply reliability engineering practices - observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews - to keep production systems healthy. 
 - Design and optimize relational database schemas, including joins, indexing, and query performance tuning. 
 - Build clean, well-tested, production-grade frontend and backend code that others can read, test, and extend. 
 - Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked. 
 - Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos. 

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack development (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation). 
 - 1-2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating AI-agentified applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, or LLM-powered features) in production. . 
 - Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery. 

Technical Skills - Applied AI

- 1-2 years of hands-on experience building AI-agentified applications, including agent frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph, ADK, or equivalent), tool/function-calling for LLMs. 
 - Practical understanding of AI-specific considerations: latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude Code or similar). 

Technical Skills - Full Stack

- Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next. js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing/SSR). 
 - Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs. 
 - Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization. 

Technical Skills - Distributed Systems & Reliability

- Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling. 
 - Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks. 
 - Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity. 

Soft Skills

- Proactive communication - shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early. 
 - Asks the right questions - clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation. 
 - Ownership mindset - treats the project as their own rather than just completing tickets. 
 - Transparency - speaks up when something is unclear instead of making assumptions. 
 - Strong analytical mindset to break down complex or ambiguous problems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with agentic frameworks (ADK, LangGraph, or similar) beyond individual projects - production deployment experience preferred. 
 - Familiarity with API documentation standards (Swagger/OpenAPI). 
 - Basic DevOps awareness (Docker, CI/CD) and Git/version-control best practices.

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it's powered by the anime content we all love. 

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

In the role of Staff Software Engineer, Shop (eCommerce), you will report to the Fan Experiences Engineering Organization. 

We are considering applicants for the location of Hyderabad, India. 

Crunchyroll is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our India Engineering Center and help build the next generation of our member-focused eCommerce platform. 

The eCommerce platform is designed to create an exclusive experience for Crunchyroll members, including access to unique products and limited drops. An integral part of the member experience, the platform must be designed to deliver high-quality features, operate reliably at scale, and delight our fans. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across the Shop team, helping define the architecture, engineering strategy, and execution approach for critical eCommerce capabilities. You will remain hands-on while operating with a broad perspective: solving complex technical problems, shaping durable platform investments, raising engineering standards, and enabling other engineers to deliver with confidence. 

You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Product, Program Management, and other Engineering verticals to align on requirements, priorities, technical trade-offs, and dependencies. You will help turn ambiguous problems into clear technical direction and scalable solutions, while ensuring that features are delivered with strong operational ownership. 

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who can connect customer and business outcomes to pragmatic technical decisions, influence across team and organizational boundaries, and establish patterns that improve the quality, reliability, and velocity of the Shop platform.

data.title: DevOps & AIOps Engineer REQ_122
data.description:
Embark on an exciting journey into the realm of AI Product Engineering with 3Pillar!

We invite you to join our elite team as we embark on missions critical to technological advancement and industry revolution. At 3Pillar, our dedication to excellence is unwavering, as we push the boundaries of cutting-edge technologies to transform industries. 

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve the deployment of our AI-powered application modernization platform (NEXUS) into client production environments. This role is a unique hybrid of Platform Engineering and Technical Advisory. You will not only design the underlying multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) but also partner directly with client IT groups to establish SysOps frameworks. You will leverage our AI-driven automation tools to provision infrastructure, integrate AIOps for anomaly detection and remediation, and ensure clients receive seamless product updates via our Helm-based delivery pipeline. This is an individual contributor role that requires a "product mindset"-you are designing for scale, security, and long-term operational sustainability in client environments. 

Responsibilities

Collaboration & SysOps Partnership

- Serve as the primary technical partner to client IT groups, guiding them on best practices for operating bespoke NEXUS implementations. 
 - Work with client-aligned delivery teams to manage the lifecycle of the platform, ensuring timely and reliable product updates via Helm charts. 
 - Collaborate with client stakeholders to tailor infrastructure and operational workflows, ensuring NEXUS integrates seamlessly with their existing enterprise monitoring and ticketing systems. 

AI-Driven Automation & AIOps Integration

- Build & Leverage AI for Provisioning: Architect and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate the provisioning and configuration of infrastructure across multi-cloud environments. 
 - AIOps Implementation: Integrate and adopt 3Pillar's AIOps platform into client ecosystems to enable proactive, automated anomaly detection and incident remediation. 
 - Knowledge Base Evolution: Maintain and refine the AIOps knowledge base, training agents to perform accurate root-cause analysis (RCA) and automate recurring issue resolution. 

Platform & Multi-Cloud Development

- Evolve our Helm-based platform layer and Terraform module libraries to support standardized, secure deployment patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 12 
 - Design for "Delegation": Move our automation from simple execution to self-adapting workflows that handle ambiguity and get smarter over time. 3 
 - Ensure all infrastructure-as-code and automated remediation scripts meet rigorous enterprise security and compliance standards, including PII access logging and least-privilege IAM. 

Required Experience

- Client-Facing Advisory & Enablement: Proven experience in a technical advisory or client-facing engineering role. You are comfortable partnering with client IT teams, guiding them through technical adoption, and translating complex platform requirements into operational success. 
 - DevOps & Infrastructure Expertise: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering. You possess production-grade Terraform experience-architecting modular, multi-cloud IaC frameworks that enable consistent, repeatable deployments across different environments. 
 - AIOps & Observability: Hands-on experience integrating or managing AIOps platforms or automated observability stacks. You understand the lifecycle of incident response, anomaly detection, and automated remediation. 
 - AI-Driven Automation: Demonstrated experience building automation workflows. You don't just write scripts; you build systems that reduce manual operational toil and empower users through self-service provisioning and automated configuration. 
 - Platform Engineering at Scale: Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Helm. You have a track record of deploying and operating complex, multi-service platforms and managing their lifecycle (chart development, values layering, atomic releases). 
 - Foundational Cloud Operations: Proven AWS expertise (EKS, networking, IAM/IRSA) with a strong aptitude for multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP).

 - Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication. You are able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and mentor teams on best practices. 

What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?

At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity

- Imagine a flexible work environment - whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach. 
 - You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams. 
 - We're big on your well-being - as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best. 
 - Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities - across projects, offerings, and industries. 
 - We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity - globally and locally. 

Thank you, 

Kiran Dhanak

data.title: DevOps Engineer (WordPress & Hosting)
data.description:
Brainstorm Force is a product-based software company that builds WordPress products and SaaS applications, while also hosting WordPress production sites for customers. We are looking for a skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer with 2-3 years of experience to help maintain the performance, security, availability, and scalability of our infrastructure. 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing customer hosting environments on cPanel, WordPress/PHP servers running on Nginx and LiteSpeed, and Laravel and Next. js SaaS applications deployed on bare-metal servers and VPS environments. You will also leverage AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day work to troubleshoot issues, build automation, and document solutions more efficiently, while ensuring that every production change is reliable, secure, and well-tested. 

Why You'll Love Working With Us: 

- Remote work
 - Competitive pay
 - Flexible working hours
 - Paid time off
 - Parental leave
 - Allowances for setting up workspace
 - Excellent work-life balance
 - Career growth opportunities

What you'll be doing: 

WordPress/PHP servers: 

- Run and tune Nginx + PHP-FPM and LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed stacks with MySQL/MariaDB and Redis. 
 - Fix slow sites, 5xx errors, memory exhaustion and database bottlenecks. 

SaaS infrastructure: 

- Deploy and maintain Laravel (queues, Horizon/Supervisor, schedulers) and Next. js (Node/PM2) apps on bare metal and VPS. 
 - Run zero-downtime deployments with clear rollback plans. 

Customer hosting (cPanel/WHM): 

- Maintain the servers that host our customers' production WordPress sites. 
 - Handle account setup and migrations, PHP version management, resource limits, malware cleanup and email deliverability. 
 - Diagnose and fix server-level issues on customer sites. 

Edge and networking: 

- Own DNS, Cloudflare (WAF, caching rules, SSL modes), CDN setup and load balancing across our services. 
 - Improve performance through CDN and caching (Cloudflare, server-side caching, Redis object cache). 

Cloud services and reliability: 

- Manage AWS S3 storage, SES email sending and IAM access, following least-privilege practices. 
 - Run monitoring, alerting, backups with tested restores, patching, SSH hardening, firewalls and SSL/TLS certificates. 
 - Respond to incidents and write clear root-cause reports. 
 - Document infrastructure and fixes so the team can work from shared runbooks, and work with development teams to scale applications and improve performance. 

AI-assisted operations: 

- Use Claude to troubleshoot, write scripts and Ansible playbooks, review configs and keep runbooks current. 
 - Automate routine tasks with shell scripting, Ansible and other tools. 
 - Check AI output before running it, and never share customer data or credentials with it. 
You must have these skills: 

- 2-3 years working on Linux production servers over SSH. 
 - Hosted and maintained WordPress/PHP sites at server level: reading logs, fixing 500/502 errors, slow sites, PHP and memory issues. 
 - Working knowledge of DNS, Cloudflare/CDN, SSL, and the basics of how load balancing works. 
 - MySQL/MariaDB basics: backups, restores, finding slow queries. 
 - Redis working knowledge: installing and securing it (no public exposure, password/ACL), WordPress object caching, Laravel cache/queue/session use, and basic memory and eviction settings. 
 - Working knowledge of core AWS services: 
 - S3: buckets, access policies, storing backups and assets, lifecycle rules
 - SES: domain verification, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, handling bounces and complaints, leaving the sandbox
 - IAM: users vs. roles, least-privilege policies, access keys and why to avoid long-lived ones
 - Uses Claude or similar AI tools in daily technical work, and checks the output before running it. 
Good-to-Have skills: 

- cPanel/WHM server administration or shared-hosting infrastructure experience
 - LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed, PHP-FPM tuning
 - Deploying Laravel or Node. js/Next. js apps; PM2/Supervisor
 - Load balancer setup (Nginx, HAProxy, cloud LB)
 - AWS CloudFront and other AWS services (EC2, Route 53, CloudWatch)
 - Bash scripting, Ansible, Docker, CI/CD

Ready for an exciting journey? Apply now and be part of our awesome team! We're excited to hear from you!

data.title: Software Dev Senior Engineer
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

  

  

CSE SRE - DBA Focus

Job Description

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer - setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead on call response and triage - help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
 - Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership. 
 - Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
 - Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms - metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing - to ensure full visibility into production systems. 
 - Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams. 
 - Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers. 
 - Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion. 
 - Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout. 
 - Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists. 
 - Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices. 
 - Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection. Required: 

- 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
 - 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
 - 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management. 
 - 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required. 
 - Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale. 
 - Experience managing other database systems - PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc . 
 - CS Degree or equivalent experience. Preferred: 

- Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
 - Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues. 
 - Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments. 
 - Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure. 
 - Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
 - Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
 - Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language.
