data.title: Software Engineer - Advanced
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Simcenter HyperMesh CFD is a powerful pre- and post-processing solution for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), designed to help engineers efficiently prepare models, generate high-quality meshes, and analyze complex simulation results. 

We are looking for a Software Developer - CFD Post Processing to join our development team and contribute to the continued evolution of the Simcenter HyperMesh CFD (HMCFD) interface. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and enhance GUI-based software capabilities used by engineers working with advanced CFD workflows. You will work closely with software developers, CFD experts, and users to understand technical requirements and translate them into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance software solutions. 

The role provides an opportunity to work across C/C++, Python, Tcl, GUI technologies, CFD, and engineering software, while contributing to a product used in complex engineering workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop core product capabilities: Design, implement, test, and enhance software features for the HMCFD graphical user interface using C/C++ and appropriate software engineering practices. 
 - Build intuitive engineering interfaces: Develop and maintain GUI functionality that enables engineers to efficiently prepare CFD models, interact with simulation data, and perform pre- and post-processing activities. 
 - Solve complex technical problems: Analyze user and product requirements, investigate technical challenges, and develop robust, maintainable solutions for complex engineering workflows. 
 - Develop automation and customization: Use Python and Tcl scripting to automate workflows, customize solutions, and improve productivity for specific CFD applications and user requirements. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with software developers, CFD specialists, product teams, and users to understand requirements and deliver effective product capabilities. 
 - Ensure software quality: Perform development-level testing and QA activities, troubleshoot defects, and contribute to maintaining the reliability and usability of the product. 
 - Support product adoption: Contribute to technical documentation, user tutorials, and other technical content that helps customers and internal users effectively utilize HMCFD capabilities. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience in C/C++, with the ability to develop maintainable and production-quality software. 
 - Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting for automation, customization, and engineering workflows. 
 - Experience developing GUI-based applications, with a good understanding of user interface design and software interaction patterns. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into practical software solutions. 
 - Working knowledge of both Linux and Windows operating systems and experience developing or supporting software in a multiplatform environment. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software developers, engineering experts, and end users. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with Qt and/or OpenGL. 
 - Basic to intermediate knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and common CFD workflows. 
 - Experience with Simcenter HyperWorks or other CAE/engineering software. 
 - Experience with CAD modeling or visualization software. 
 - Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural analysis. 
 - Experience developing software for engineering, scientific, simulation, or visualization applications. 
 - Familiarity with scripting-driven engineering workflows and application customization. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.description:
The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing. 

We are looking for highly capable software engineers with practical experience of programming the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC). The successful candidate will be working with vibrant software and hardware teams across multiple geographies on ground breaking products and will be presented with opportunities to vastly grow their technical understanding. 

If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

We are seeking those who will perform both software development and actively participate in the OpenBMC community. 

- Your day-to-day role will involve develop, enhance, and maintain the OpenBMC firmware stack for Arm-based server platforms, ensuring robust and reliable system management capabilities. 
 - BMC firmware bring-up and platform enablement activities for new Arm-based server boards, including hardware integration, driver configuration, debugging, and validation. 
 - Develop and port BMC functionalities across multiple Arm-based server platforms, promoting software reuse, scalability, and consistency across platforms. 
 - Working closely with colleagues who develop SoC firmware to ensure that the BMC operates correctly within the complete system. 
 - Contribute to the upstream OpenBMC community to ensure that common server manageability features and Arm-specific platform requirements are well supported, maintained, and aligned with industry standards. 

Required Skills and Experience

We need the following experience and skills from our candidates: 

- 4+ years of strong proficiency in C/C++ programming and Linux shell scripting for embedded firmware development, debugging, and automation.

 - Good understanding of OpenBMC architecture, system management services, D-Bus communication, and systemd service management, with experience in developing, integrating, and debugging OpenBMC components. 
 - Good Linux debugging skills. 
 - Familiarity with Git. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills; excellent written and spoken English.

 - Experience contributing to upstream open-source projects, particularly OpenBMC, including patch submission, code reviews, and collaboration with the open-source community. 
 - Hands-on experience with BMC SoCs from vendors such as ASPEED or Nuvoton, including platform bring-up, peripheral integration, and firmware development. 
 - Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics, understand board-level interfaces, and collaborate with hardware teams to debug platform integration issues.

Job Description

The Sr. Director / Vice President, Optical Engineering will be a senior engineering leader responsible for strategy, execution and NPI scale for Nokia's Product and Solutions Engineering organization within the optical networking portfolio. With a strong focus on high-volume pluggable optical and line system products, this leader will enable the business to scale complex technologies from development into reliable, cost-effective, high-quality volume production. 

The role will serve as the senior operational interface between engineering, supply chain, manufacturing partners, and business leadership, ensuring manufacturing readiness, production scalability, yield performance, quality, delivery, and cost competitiveness across a global footprint. The successful candidate will bring deep credibility in optical networking or adjacent high-tech manufacturing environments, combined with the executive presence and influencing capability required to lead through a complex global matrix. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- 
 - Set the global manufacturing and operations strategy for optical networking products, with emphasis on high-volume pluggable solutions and complex optical systems. 
 - 
 - Own strategic engagement with global contract manufacturing partners, including key partners across Southeast Asia, to ensure scalable capacity, quality discipline, cost competitiveness, and supply continuity. 
 - 
 - Lead and coordinate all pre-GA ramp activities across R&D functions, including hardware, PV&T, firmware, and OSG, ensuring seamless manufacturing readiness for successful product launches. 
 - 
 - Drive design for Manufacturing ( DfM ) strategies across hardware, firmware, test, calibration, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to optimize scalability, quality, cost, and speed to volume.

 - Define and influence manufacturing CAPEX investments to maximize operational efficiency, support scalable production capacity, and minimize long-term impact on COGS. 
 - 
 - Establish manufacturing processes, operating mechanisms, test infrastructure, and governance frameworks capable of supporting production volumes in the millions of units annually. 
 - 
 - Own the CP-to-C5 manufacturing lifecycle, leading post-GA manufacturing performance, yield improvement initiatives, FMA activities, workforce training, test-time optimization, QRBs, binning strategies, and continuous process improvement. 
 - 
 - Oversee a global manufacturing ecosystem spanning development, testing, qualification, and production sites across North America, Europe, and Asia. 
 - 
 - Build executive-level relationships with external suppliers, contract manufacturers, and ecosystem partners while maintaining rigorous standards of operational performance and accountability. 
 - 
 - Provide strong leadership and governance across a complex matrix organization, ensuring accountability, driving timely decision-making, and influencing senior stakeholders to achieve critical business outcomes. 
Key Skills And Experience

- Senior manufacturing and operations leader with extensive experience (15+ years) in optical networking, photonics, telecommunications hardware, semiconductor-adjacent technologies, or comparable high-tech manufacturing environments. 
 - Strong industry credibility and technical depth in optical components, pluggable technologies, and complex electro-optical systems
 - Proven record of scaling complex products from new product introduction, engineering validation, and pre-GA ramp through high-volume global production. 
 - Deep expertise across manufacturing engineering, product industrialization, supplier strategy, quality systems, operational excellence, and production governance. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional global programs involving hardware, PV&T, firmware, OSG, supply chain, quality, and contract manufacturing partners. 
 - Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills with the ability to operate effectively in a global matrix environment. 
 - Ability to align senior leaders, create clear governance mechanisms, and hold stakeholders accountable for delivering manufacturing, quality, cost, and launch outcomes. 
 - High levels of resilience, credibility, executive presence, and leadership maturity. 
 - Experience working across geographically distributed teams and manufacturing ecosystems in North America, Europe, and Asia. 

Success Factors

- Deliver scalable manufacturing operations capable of supporting significant growth in optical pluggables volumes, from pre-GA ramp through post-GA sustained production. 
 - Establish trusted partnerships with internal engineering organizations and external manufacturing partners. 
 - Drive operational efficiency, yield performance, test-time optimization, quality, cost, and delivery performance across the entire manufacturing value chain. 
 - Serve as a respected cross-functional leader who can align diverse stakeholders, enforce governance discipline, and execute complex global manufacturing programs with speed and accountability.

data.title: Senior Principal Engineer
data.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work. 

Senior Principal Engineer

Technical Lead / Architect, TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You are the kind of engineer other engineers want to build with. You have spent your career going deep on production systems, and you have reached the point where your judgment shapes architectures, raises teams, and makes hard problems look simple. This is the most senior technical seat in the pod, and it is unapologetically hands-on. 

As Technical Lead and Architect, you own the architecture for an OpCo's modernized applications and set the engineering bar the whole pod builds to. You operate as a player/coach: designing complex systems, writing meaningful code, and running rigorous reviews of work produced by both engineers and AI agents. You treat agentic development as a first-class part of the architecture, not a novelty, and you define how the pod gets the most out of it without ever compromising quality or security. 

If you want your decisions to matter, your code to ship, and your standards to lift an entire team, this is built for you. 

About the PodA TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do
 - Own the architecture: Define and own the end-to-end software architecture for the pod's applications, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native across AWS and Azure. 
 - Own the frontend architecture: Set the frontend architecture: state management, a scalable library of reusable components, design-system integration, and the patterns, standards, and performance budgets the pod builds against. 
 - Lead the technical direction: Serve as the highest technical authority and escalation point in the pod. Set design patterns and standards, and make confident architectural decisions amid ambiguity. 
 - Stay hands-on: Operate as a player/coach. Make significant code contributions, lead complex designs, and deliver thorough code reviews of work from both engineers and AI agents. 
 - Lead AI-native development: Define how the pod uses agentic tooling such as Claude Code across the SDLC, establishing patterns for AI-assisted design, implementation, testing, and review that maximize velocity while protecting quality and security. 
 - Set the quality bar: Define and enforce engineering excellence: clean code, Domain-Driven Design, modern design patterns, Twelve-Factor principles, meaningful test coverage, and application security. 
 - Build secure and reliable systems: Embed secure-by-design principles and cloud-native observability so applications run fast, stay available, and stay safe in production. 
 - Mentor and raise the team: Coach senior engineers, grow the technical capability of the team (human and agentic), and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with the OpCo: Work with the OpCo's technical leadership and existing teams to align architecture with their landscape, integrate with existing systems, and transfer knowledge. What You Bring
 - Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with significant time in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Architect roles leading the architecture of complex, production systems. 
 - Production experience on BOTH AWS and Azure (required): You have personally designed, built, and run production software on both AWS and Azure. This dual-cloud depth is essential: you are the technical authority who sets cloud architecture regardless of which target cloud an OpCo runs on. Hands-on depth includes containers (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless (Lambda and Azure Functions), and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. 
 - Architectural depth: Deep command of modern architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, distributed systems), DDD, and design patterns, with a record of turning business objectives into technical solutions at enterprise or B2B scale. 
 - Hands-on technical depth: Current, real coding ability. A player/coach who contributes code, leads design, and delivers thorough reviews, including of AI-generated work. 
 - AI-native engineering: Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear, practiced approach to architecting and delivering software in an AI-native team. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - Frontend architecture: Deep expertise in modern frontend architecture with React. js and Next. js: state management, scalable and reusable component design, design-system strategy, and frontend performance at scale. 
 - DevSecOps: Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and modern DevSecOps practices. 
 - Communication and leadership: You align technical and business stakeholders, lead under competing priorities, and bring calm and clarity to fast-moving teams. Nice to Have
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - A track record leading application modernization or re-platforming of large enterprise or B2B applications. 
 - GenAI architecture experience: RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, multi-agent frameworks, MCP servers and tools, context engineering, and vector databases. 
 - Experience leading embedded or client-facing engineering teams. 
 - Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS and Azure. What Success Looks Like
 - First 90 days: You understand the OpCo's landscape, have set the architectural direction and engineering standards, and the pod is shipping against them with a clean, AI-native workflow. 
 - First 6 months: The architecture is proven in production, quality and delivery metrics are trending up, and the team's technical capability, human and agentic, has visibly grown under your leadership. Why TechGrove, Why Banyan
 - Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. Should You Apply?We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes. 

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.   

Protect yourself by following these steps: 

- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware. com email address. 
 - Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process. 
 - If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond - instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware. com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

Job Description

Location: Hyderabad

Experience

MS and 3-6 years

Primary Areas: Developer Productivity, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, Reliability Engineering, Test Automation

Primary Stack: Azure, Terraform, Docker, Azure DevOps, Python, Go, Playwright, Angular/TypeScript, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Developer Productivity and Reliability Engineer to build the internal engineering platform, automation, and quality systems that enable teams to deliver software quickly, safely, and reliably. 

The role will own reusable infrastructure patterns, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment provisioning, deployment workflows, observability, and developer self-service capabilities across our Python/Django, Go, and Angular/TypeScript applications running on Azure. 

The engineer will help establish a modern platform-engineering model based on automation, Infrastructure as Code, measurable reliability, reusable golden paths, and fast developer feedback. This role will work closely with engineering, QA, architecture, security, and product teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Developer Productivity and Internal Platforms

- Build and operate reusable developer workflows that simplify build, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and release activities. 
 - Create self-service workflows for project setup, environment provisioning, database initialization, test execution, deployment, and diagnostics. 
 - Develop reusable repository templates, pipeline templates, Terraform modules, container templates, and engineering tooling. 
 - Establish "golden paths" for common application types and deployment scenarios. 
 - Improve local development environments using consistent tooling, containers, service emulators, and documented workflows. 
 - Reduce developer cognitive load by standardizing common infrastructure, deployment, testing, and observability patterns. 
 - Provide clear feedback through pipeline reports, deployment status, test evidence, quality dashboards, and actionable failure diagnostics. 

Infrastructure as Code and Cloud Automation

- Design and maintain Azure infrastructure through Terraform and version-controlled Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Build reusable, composable, and versioned Terraform modules for application, networking, identity, storage, databases, monitoring, and security services. 
 - Automate infrastructure validation, policy checks, drift detection, security scanning, and controlled promotion across environments. 
 - Implement environment provisioning and teardown workflows, including short-lived or ephemeral environments where appropriate. 
 - Automate application deployments using Docker and Azure services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring. 
 - Establish safe deployment patterns, including blue-green or canary releases, health checks, automated rollback, and progressive delivery. 
 - Manage configuration and secrets securely using appropriate Azure services such as Key Vault and managed identities. 
 - Improve infrastructure consistency across development, test, staging, and production environments. 

Reliability Engineering

- Define and implement service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and reliability dashboards for critical applications and delivery systems. 
 - Establish production-readiness standards covering availability, performance, scalability, resilience, observability, backup, recovery, and operational ownership. 
 - Instrument applications, pipelines, infrastructure, and deployment workflows with logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and diagnostic context. 
 - Analyze incidents, recurring failures, deployment problems, flaky tests, and operational toil; drive permanent corrective actions. 
 - Support incident response, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvement plans. 
 - Improve mean time to detect, mean time to recover, deployment success rate, and change failure rate. 
 - Introduce resilience and failure testing for important services and infrastructure. 
 - Automate health checks, smoke tests, rollback decisions, and post-deployment verification. 

CI/CD and Release Engineering

- Design and optimize Azure DevOps pipelines for fast, reliable, repeatable builds and releases. 
 - Implement pipeline stages for validation, compilation, unit testing, API testing, security scanning, container image creation, infrastructure validation, deployment, and post-deployment verification. 
 - Use dependency and build caching, parallel execution, selective test execution, and incremental pipelines to reduce feedback time. 
 - Establish quality gates based on test results, coverage, security findings, code quality, infrastructure validation, and release risk. 
 - Support Git-based development workflows, pull-request validation, branch policies, artifact versioning, and release traceability. 
 - Automate release evidence, test reports, deployment records, and compliance-related documentation. 

Test Automation and Quality Engineering

- Define a layered testing strategy across unit, integration, API, contract, component, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Build and maintain Playwright-based UI and regression suites with traceability, screenshots, videos, logs, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Improve test reliability through deterministic test data, service virtualization, isolation, parallelization, and environment management. 
 - Automate test data creation and cleanup for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and dependent services. 
 - Reduce flaky tests and ensure failures are classified as product defects, test defects, infrastructure issues, or environmental issues. 
 - Partner with engineering and QA teams to make applications easier to test and operate. 
 - Explore AI-assisted test generation, test maintenance, failure triage, and coverage analysis with appropriate human review. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Graduate with 5-8 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, CI/CD, test automation, or developer-productivity engineering. 
 - Strong experience building internal developer platforms, delivery automation, or reusable engineering tooling. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, workspaces or equivalent environment strategies, policy validation, and infrastructure testing. 
 - Strong Azure experience with services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, Key Vault, monitoring, and managed databases. 
 - Strong experience designing Azure DevOps pipelines and Git-based delivery workflows. 
 - Practical experience with Docker, container image lifecycle management, registries, health checks, and deployment automation. 
 - Strong understanding of SRE concepts, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, incident response, resilience, and operational readiness. 
 - Hands-on automated testing experience with Playwright or a comparable framework across API and end-to-end layers. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and/or Go. 
 - Working knowledge of Python/Django, Go services, and Angular/TypeScript applications. 
 - Experience with MySQL/PostgreSQL and Redis for test data, environment setup, integration testing, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Experience implementing quality gates, security scanning, dependency checks, artifact promotion, and release traceability. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex failures across application code, pipelines, infrastructure, networking, and cloud services. 

Preferred Skills

- Kubernetes, Helm, or other container orchestration platforms. 
 - GitOps and declarative deployment tools. 
 - OpenTelemetry and modern observability platforms. 
 - Performance, load, stress, and resilience testing. 
 - Ephemeral environments and preview deployments for pull requests.

 - AI-assisted development, test generation, failure triage, or agent-based engineering workflows.

Soft Skills

data.title: Software QA Engineer - Performance Testing
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

We are looking for a Software QA Engineer - Performance Testing to design, automate, and execute performance testing strategies for cloud-based enterprise applications, APIs, platforms, and distributed services. 

In this role, you will evaluate system performance, identify bottlenecks, analyze scalability and reliability, and establish performance baselines to support release readiness. Working closely with Software Development, Architecture, DevOps, and QA teams, you will help embed performance engineering into the software development lifecycle and explore AI-assisted performance analysis and anomaly detection. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design performance test strategies: Plan and execute load, stress, scalability, endurance, spike, capacity, and benchmark tests using realistic workload models. 
 - Develop performance automation: Build and maintain reusable performance test scripts, frameworks, and workload-generation solutions using tools such as JMeter, k6, Locust, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot performance: Investigate latency, throughput, resource utilization, and system behavior to identify bottlenecks and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Establish performance baselines: Compare results across builds and releases, identify regressions, and provide data-driven recommendations for performance and release readiness. 
 - Test cloud-native and distributed systems: Evaluate APIs, microservices, databases, and enterprise applications across containerized and cloud-based environments. 
 - Leverage monitoring and observability: Use metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards to correlate performance results with system behavior and communicate actionable findings. 
 - Integrate performance engineering into delivery: Embed automated performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate across engineering teams to improve performance standards, test efficiency, and continuous quality. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 4+ years of relevant experience in performance testing or performance engineering, including workload design, execution, analysis, and reporting. 
 - Hands-on experience with performance testing tools such as Apache JMeter, k6, Locust, RPT, or equivalent. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, or Groovy, with the ability to develop and maintain test automation. 
 - Experience testing web applications, APIs, and distributed services, with knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP, databases/SQL, and relevant communication protocols. 
 - Strong understanding of performance metrics, workload modelling, statistical analysis, performance baselining, regression detection, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Experience with cloud-native or enterprise application architectures, CI/CD integration, and monitoring/observability tools, along with strong analytical and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience performance-testing microservices, Kubernetes-based applications, containers, and large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI. 
 - Experience with observability and application performance monitoring tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, Telegraf, Loki, Tempo, Kibana, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics. 
 - Experience with distributed load generation, performance dashboards, and automated performance regression testing. 
 - Knowledge of Git/GitLab, Jira, and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Exposure to desktop application performance testing, WebSockets, GraphQL, CLI-based testing, or other relevant protocols. 
 - Experience with AI/ML-assisted performance analytics, anomaly detection, or automated root-cause analysis. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation. 

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors. 

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development. 

Key Responsibilities

PLC Software Development

- Understand PLC Software Development
 - Develop and maintain PLC software based on IEC 61131-3 standards. 
 - Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems. 
 - Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms. 
 - Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration

- Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I). 
 - Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions. 
 - Integrate PLC, HMI, instruments, motion devices, and network systems. 

System Engineering

- Analyze customer and product requirements and translate them into software and control system architecture. 
 - Define software-hardware interfaces and control philosophies. 
 - Support system design reviews and risk assessments. 

Troubleshooting & RCA

- Investigate field issues and implement corrective actions. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities. 
 - Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Customer Support

- Support manufacturing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities. 
 - Provide technical support during customer escalations. 
 - Develop manufacturing packages and technical documentation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Quality, Project Management, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams on platform standardization and product improvements. 
 - Participate in engineering change management (ECR/ECO) activities. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive software standardization and code modularization. 
 - Contribute to technology roadmaps for next-generation control systems. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and share technical best practices

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of PLC software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Omron / Siemens / LS PLC
 - Experience with HMI development (Pro-face, MXon, M2I or equivalent). 
 - Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, EtherCAT
 - Experience in troubleshooting and debugging industrial automation systems. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively in an international engineering environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor equipment, gas delivery systems, chemical delivery systems, or process equipment. 
 - Experience supporting customer sites, installation, and commissioning activities. 
 - Experience with SCADA or industrial software platforms. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety and industrial cybersecurity. 
 - Experience leading technical projects or system architecture reviews. 
 - Experience collaborating with global engineering organizations.

data.description:

The Manager of Engineering - BenTech Integrations is responsible for leading one cross-functional delivery pod within our India-based BenTech engineering organization. This role is accountable for day-to-day execution, team health, delivery predictability, and support readiness for a pod that builds, enhances, deploys, and supports integration capabilities connecting our carrier systems with the HCM and benefits administration platforms our employer clients and broker partners depend on, including platforms such as Workday, ADP, UKG, Benefitfocus, PlanSource, Businessolver, and others. 

In this role, you will coach and develop a high-performing team while translating roadmap priorities and engineering direction into actionable plans, sprint execution, release outcomes, and operational readiness. You will partner closely with product, architecture, engineering, quality, and operations leaders in India and the United States to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and deliver reliable outcomes within established engineering standards and business priorities. 

This leader brings a strong delivery and customer focus, embraces servant leadership, and helps the team apply sound engineering practices to achieve quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. The role also requires attentiveness to governance, compliance, production readiness, and support for critical business periods such as Annual Enrollment and Open Enrollment. 

- Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, India is a requirement of the role. 

Mode of Working: This role follows a hybrid work model, with a primary base in Bengaluru. While on-site presence is essential for key engagements, flexibility is offered for remote work based on business needs and team alignment. 

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Execution & Predictability

- Lead day-to-day execution for a single BenTech integration delivery pod, ensuring commitments are delivered with predictable throughput, clear dependency management, and transparent communication to stakeholders. 
 - Translate roadmap priorities and engineering direction into actionable team plans, sprint goals, release outcomes, and support readiness activities. 
 - Remove delivery obstacles, escalate risks appropriately, and improve team flow from planning through production support. 
 - Drive strong execution across design, build, test, deployment, and stabilization activities. 

People Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, coach, and develop a cross-functional engineering pod, fostering a culture of accountability, craftsmanship, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Provide ongoing feedback, performance coaching, and career development support to team members. 
 - Build strong team connectedness and engagement while reinforcing healthy agile ways of working. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, and capability development for assigned team members, helping establish and mature pod-level delivery capacity as the SGS BenTech organization grows. 

Engineering Excellence & Quality

- Reinforce established engineering practices within the pod, balancing speed with quality, reliability, and maintainability, including test automation, CI/CD discipline, code quality, observability, and production readiness. 
 - Partner with lead engineers and architects to ensure sound implementation decisions, appropriate non-functional coverage, and alignment to approved engineering standards. 
 - Use delivery, quality, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen team execution over time. 

Operational Readiness & Support

- Ensure the team is prepared to support production health, issue triage, defect resolution, and service recovery when needed. 
 - Drive readiness for critical business periods, including Annual Enrollment and Open Enrollment, through planning, coordination, risk mitigation, and support playbooks. 
 - Promote strong execution in incident follow-up, root cause analysis, and preventive improvements. 

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Partner closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, lead engineers, architects, QA, operations, and US-based stakeholders to align pod plans, delivery priorities, and release readiness. 
 - Coordinate dependencies and issue resolution across teams and partner groups, escalating risks and tradeoffs when broader leadership support is needed. 
 - Maintain clear communication with stakeholders regarding pod status, key risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes. 

Governance, Risk, & Compliance

 - Reinforce disciplined change management, production readiness reviews, and adherence to required controls for delivery and support. 
 - Use delivery and service metrics to improve transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

Skills And Background You'll Need

Experience

- Typically requires 14+ years of experience within IT and 2+ years of experience managing engineering, software delivery, or agile development teams, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

 - Experience delivering customer-facing or business-critical systems with accountability for availability, quality, and performance.

 - Experience working in a globally distributed delivery model with close partnership across India- and US-based teams.

Preferred

 - Experience working with BenTech, HCM, or benefits administration platforms such as Workday, ADP, UKG, Benefitfocus, PlanSource, Businessolver, or similar ecosystems.

 - Experience supporting engineering teams through platform modernization, automation, or transformation efforts. 
 - Exposure to quality engineering, SDET-led practices, or data-intensive delivery teams. 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted development practices or interest in leveraging AI tooling to accelerate integration development and testing.

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar's state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy. 

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep. 

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers. 

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager. 

Job Duties

- The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions. 
 - Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets.

 - Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions. 
 - Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals. 
 - Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development. 
 - Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams. 
 - Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.

 - Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time. 
 - Coordinates walkthroughs and reviews; ensures conformance to standards and adherence to design specifications. 
 - The position is challenged to carefully evaluate problems and provide input into many possible solutions before selecting one option. Problems may be complex and can require developing and monetize new solutions. 
 - The leader follows general policies and guidelines for projects under his/her control to ensure specific, management goals are met and desired results are achieved. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, and Reoccurring Revenue, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc. 
 - S/he should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. S/he would need to also balance technical leadership with savvy business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.

 - Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team.

OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

Senior Managers of Engineering at OneTrust make long-term strategic and technical contributions. They set strategic goals for the team, hire and develop engineers, and prioritize projects that create meaningful customer and business impact. They remain technically engaged-helping develop new products, identify requirements, and execute with excellence. 

As a Senior Manager on the AI Governance Engineering team, you will lead the development of OneTrust's next-generation AI Governance platform. You will help turn complex governance, compliance, security, and responsible AI requirements into scalable products that enable organizations to confidently build, evaluate, deploy, and operate AI models and agents. This is an opportunity to shape a high-impact product area at the intersection of AI, enterprise software, and trust. 

Your Mission

Drive strategic planning and execution while developing key technologies that strengthen OneTrust's long-term, proprietary strategic position in AI Governance. Create new concepts from initial design through market release, establish a strong engineering culture, and lead teams that deliver reliable, secure, and extensible AIG capabilities at enterprise scale. 

You Are

- Experienced overseeing end-to-end development activities while monitoring the reliability, security, and performance of internal systems and recommending improvements when required. 
 - Able to translate AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI needs into clear product requirements, technical strategy, and execution plans. 
 - Able to ensure compliance with security regulations while managing software development projects by setting requirements, goals, and timelines. 
 - Designing strategies for future development projects based on the company's overall objectives and resource availability. 
 - Implementing innovative technologies and architectural patterns for AI model and agent governance. 
 - Coordinating effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Security, Compliance, and customer-facing teams. 
 - Providing technical oversight and hands-on leadership to your team, while staying close enough to the technology to guide critical decisions. 
 - Ensuring projects are delivered according to schedule without compromising quality, reliability, or customer trust. 
 - Good at finding opportunities to improve development processes, engineering productivity, and operational excellence. 
 - Experienced building onboarding and mentoring programs to teach and train other engineers in order to incubate individual and team growth. 
 - Comfortable leading through ambiguity and balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform investments. 

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field. 
 - 12+ years of engineering experience with a strong track record of successful development and delivery of complex, enterprise-class software that results in material market impact. 
 - Recent experience in development, operations, troubleshooting, and managing teams. 
 - Understanding of how to operate in a DevOps model. 
 - Experience with the AI agent ecosystem and deployment platforms such as Agent Core, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Vertex AI. 
 - Proven critical thinking and advanced analytical skills and qualities. 
 - Strong consulting skills and tactful conflict management skills. 
 - Systematic problem-solving approach coupled with a strong sense of ownership and drive. 
 - System design and architecture experience. 
 - Experience designing and architecting large, complex distributed systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of data structures and programming. 
 - Ability to think of various algorithms, given a problem. 
 - Solid understanding of the agile software development lifecycle. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Monetization Platform
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365, all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors, including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling. com addresses. 

About Monetization Platform

The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries. 

The team owns the platform behind the complete monetization lifecycle: 

Quote → Contract → Entitlement → Subscription → Usage → Bill → Revenue

These systems support a $1B+ sales base, manage entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enable localized billing as Rippling launches into new countries. 

As Rippling continues to introduce new products, pricing models, packaging structures, and markets, the Monetization Platform provides the common infrastructure that allows teams to move quickly without rebuilding monetization logic each time. 

Our vision is simple: 

Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code. 

This is a platform for engineers who enjoy solving foundational problems where correctness matters, abstractions need to last, and the impact extends far beyond a single product or team. 

The opportunity

- Rippling's product portfolio is expanding rapidly across HR, IT, Finance, and new product categories. 
 - Every new product introduces monetization complexity: what a customer purchased, what they are entitled to use, how their subscription evolves, how usage should be measured, what they should be charged, how payments are collected, and how that activity is ultimately reflected in financial systems. 
 - We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of Rippling's Monetization Platform. 
 - You will own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters spanning contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - You will work on systems where errors are expensive. Incorrect contract state, entitlement state, usage calculations, invoices, payments, taxes, or revenue records can directly affect customers, financial accuracy, and trust. 
 - This role combines: 
 - 
 - Hands-on backend and platform engineering
 - Org-level architectural leadership
 - Technical leadership and mentorship
 - Cross-functional influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Payments, Security, and Data
 - You will define architecture, make difficult technical tradeoffs, align teams around durable solutions, mentor technical leaders, and help build a platform that allows Rippling to monetize new products and markets faster and with greater confidence. 
 - This is not an architecture-only role. You will stay close to execution through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level technical decisions. 

What You'll Own

- Own major technical charters across CPQ, contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - Define architecture for systems requiring strong guarantees around data integrity, auditability, reliability, recoverability, and clear ownership across service boundaries. 
 - Design durable platform abstractions that allow product teams to introduce new packaging, pricing, entitlement, metered billing, subscription, and contract models without building custom one-off solutions. 
 - Lead multi-team initiatives from problem definition and architecture through technical design, execution, migration, launch, and long-term operational ownership. 
 - Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data models, ownership models, and failure-handling strategies across interconnected monetization systems. 
 - Make high-quality technical tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, performance, cost, compliance, maintainability, and delivery speed. 
 - Stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level decisions. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, Payments, Platform, Security, Data, and product engineering teams. 
 - Identify systemic technical risks early and drive alignment on durable solutions, particularly where customer trust or financial accuracy is at stake. 
 - Establish engineering standards for critical monetization systems, including testing, observability, incident learning, migration safety, rollout mechanisms, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers and help grow technical leadership across the organization. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, thoughtful design reviews, clear technical writing, and operational excellence. 

What Success Looks Like

- Platform leverage: Product teams can launch new products, pricing structures, packaging models, entitlement models, and usage-based offerings without rebuilding core monetization infrastructure. 
 - Correctness and trust: Critical contract, entitlement, subscription, billing, payment, tax, and revenue workflows maintain a high standard of data integrity, auditability, and reliability. 
 - Clear architectural boundaries: Monetization capabilities have well-defined ownership, APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, reducing coupling and one-off implementations. 
 - Faster product and market expansion: New products and country launches can adopt common monetization capabilities rather than creating bespoke billing and entitlement systems. 
 - Operational excellence: Critical monetization systems have strong observability, safe migration patterns, effective incident learning, and clear operational ownership. 
 - Technical leadership: Engineers across teams look to you for architectural guidance, difficult technical decisions, and direction on complex cross-system problems. 
 - Stronger technical leaders: Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers around you develop greater technical judgment, ownership, and ability to lead increasingly complex initiatives. 

What We're Looking For

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, preferably across backend engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, product engineering, or systems engineering. 
 - Proven experience operating at Senior Staff, Principal Engineer, or equivalent Staff+ scope. 
 - Deep hands-on engineering foundation with strong coding, debugging, system design, and production ownership experience. 
 - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems with demanding reliability, observability, and data correctness requirements. 
 - Strong architecture depth across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, event-driven systems, service boundaries, reliability, performance, failure modes, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, cross-functional, multi-team technical initiatives from definition through production ownership. 
 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across product needs, business constraints, engineering quality, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Ability to influence senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. 
 - Strong mentorship record and a track record of raising the technical bar for engineers around you. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments. 
 - Deep backend programming experience in one or more languages. Python and Django experience is a strong plus. 

Bonus points

- Experience building monetization, entitlement, metered or usage-based billing, subscription, pricing, payments, accounting, revenue, tax, or fintech systems. 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product engineering teams. 
 - Experience working in SaaS, enterprise software, HR technology, payroll, compliance, workflow-heavy domains, or high-growth product companies. 
 - Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience with security, permissions, auditability, compliance, or enterprise-grade controls. 
 - A builder-leader mindset: someone who can define direction, align stakeholders, establish durable architecture, and remain close to execution.

data.description:
About Astrobase Space Technologies

Astrobase is a pioneering spacetech startup founded by prominent Senior ISRO scientists and IIT Bombay alumni with over 20 years of experience in designing, manufacturing, testing and flying advanced Cryogenic Launch Vehicles. Driven by a vision to make India a Space tech powerhouse, we are developing innovative launch vehicles that will transform space exploration. At Astrobase, you'll be part of a team creating history in the Indian space industry. Our goal is to become the first private space company from India to land on the moon economically. 

Key Responsibilities

- Perform in-process and final inspections of engine components and assemblies. 
 - Verify compliance with technical drawings, specifications, and standards. 
 - Ensure dimensional checks and quality verification during assembly stages. 
 - Witness functional and mechanical tests. 
 - Supervise engine component assembly and integration activities. 
 - Ensure proper alignment, fitment, and installation of engine subsystems. 
 - Monitor torqueing, fastening, and mechanical integration processes. 
 - Ensure adherence to approved assembly procedures and drawings. 
 - Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists, and quality records. 
 - Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) for deviations and coordinate corrective actions. 
 - Maintain traceability of parts, materials, and inspection records. 

DESIRED QUALIFICATION

- Diploma in Mechanical / Aerospace / Automobile Engineering (minimum requirement for inspection roles). 
 - B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical / Aerospace Engineering (preferred for supervisory or engineer-level positions). 
 - ITI certification in trades such as Fitter / Machinist with additional training in quality inspection (suitable for technician-level inspectors). 
 - Specialized certification in Quality Assurance / NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) / Metrology adds strong value. 

WHY WORK WITH US?

At Astrobase, We Believe In The Power Of Human Ingenuity And Collaboration To Push The Boundaries Of Space Exploration. As a Team Member, You'll Be

- Creating History: Join us in developing cutting-edge launch vehicles, playing a pivotal role in transforming space access and shaping the future of space exploration. 
 - Collaborating with Experts: Work alongside ISRO scientists and industry veterans with decades of experience in designing India's iconic space missions like Chandrayaan 3
 - Growth Opportunities: As Astrobase scales, you'll have the chance to take on leadership roles and be part of an expanding organization driving change in the Indian space sector. 
 - Pioneering Space Technology: Your contributions will not only impact Astrobase but also influence the global space ecosystem. Be part of something larger than yourself

Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!

Who Are We?

For 115 years, L'Oréal, the world's leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world. 

For more than a century, L'Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L'Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty. 

Today, L'Oréal includes more than 2, 000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future. 

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L'Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure. 

A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!

We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH. 

Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC . . . 

You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment. 

Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale. 

In this role, You will. .

As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact. 

You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.

 - Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group's business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization. 
 - As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.

 - Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
