data.title: Associate Manager - Drone Ecosystem
data.description:
About QCI

The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030. 

Role Summary

As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential. 

The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone-as-a-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation's Drone Ecosystem. 

Role & Responsibility-

QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below: 

- Scheme Design & Development: Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS. 
 - Research, Analysis & Knowledge Products: Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components. 
 - Report Writing & Deck Preparation: Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders. 
 - Scheme Operations: Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i. e. , regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination. 
 - Business Development & Marketing of the Scheme: Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation. 

Eligibility Criteria & Requirements-

Educational Qualification: 

- A Bachelor's degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor's degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role. 
 - An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage. 

Experience-

- Minimum 3 years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program. 
 - Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification. 
 - Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required. 
 - Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred. 
 - Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory. 
 - Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired. 
 - Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required. 

Technical Capabilities-

Strong Research Skills: Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e. g. , government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information. 

Structured Thinking & Writing: Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well-written outputs. 

Data Analysis: Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage. 

Visualization & Presentation Skills: Strong data-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well-structured and visually compelling presentations. 

Behavioural Capabilities-

High Degree of Curiosity: Genuine interest in how India's public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks "why. "

Integrity & Accountability: Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions. 

Meticulous Attention to Detail: Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook. 

Proactive & "Get-it-Done" Attitude: Self-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

data.title: Assistant Manager - Testing & Validation
data.description:
Role Summary

The Assistant Manager - Testing & Validation is responsible for leading testing, analytics, quality control, method development and validation, and validation activities for New Product Development (NPD) projects in line with the Aliaxis Innovation Model (AIM), from concept to successful market launch. The role manages laboratory testing, product qualification, benchmarking, plant issue investigations, failure analysis, counterfeit product identification, and Intellectual Property (IP)-related testing while ensuring compliance with ISO/IEC 17025 and NABL requirements. The incumbent oversees day-to-day laboratory operations, resource planning, calibration and validation programs, measurement uncertainty (MU), Green Pathway initiatives, laboratory capability enhancement, and the development, validation, and standardization of new test methods. As an authorized signatory in the absence of the Laboratory Manager, the role is responsible for reviewing and approving test reports and maintaining the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of laboratory data and records. Additionally, the position drives 5S, laboratory housekeeping, safety, and continuous improvement initiatives to maintain an efficient, compliant, and audit-ready laboratory environment. The role provides technical leadership and subject matter expertise to R&D-Innovation, Quality, Manufacturing, and Global Aliaxis teams, with hands-on expertise in advanced polymer characterization techniques including FTIR, DSC, TGA, DMA, SEM-EDX, XRF, Capillary Rheometry, and Weathering Testing, along with strong knowledge of UTM, Charpy and Izod Impact Testing, HDT/VST, MFI, viscosity testing, and other polymer testing and characterization methods. Strong project management, communication, data analysis, Excel, PowerPoint, and presentation skills are essential for delivering high-quality technical outcomes and supporting innovation, product quality, and business growth. 

Roles And Responsibility

- Lead testing, quality control, analytics, and validation activities for New Product Development (NPD) projects in accordance with the Stage & Gate Process, ensuring timely execution from concept through product launch. 
 - Demonstrate strong technical knowledge of polymer materials, processing technologies, and product performance requirements, with expertise in uPVC & CPVC pipes and fittings, solvent cement, water storage tanks, and other polymer-based products. 
 - Independently perform, supervise, and interpret a wide range of polymer testing and characterization activities, including UTM, Charpy & Izod Impact, HDT/VST, MFI, Capillary Rheometer, Weathering (Q-SUN/Xenon), Fusion Study, Viscosity, XRF, DSC, TGA, DMA, SEM-EDX, and other advanced material characterization techniques. 
 - Support plant issue investigations, failure analysis, counterfeit product identification, intellectual property (IP)-related testing, material qualification, benchmarking studies, and root cause analysis to support business and quality objectives. 
 - Provide subject matter expertise for QA/QC analysis, NPD projects, product validation, process improvement initiatives, and technical problem-solving activities. 
 - Collaborate closely with R&D, Innovation, Quality, Manufacturing, Procurement, and external partners to achieve project objectives and deliver high-quality technical outcomes. 
 - Manage annual maintenance, calibration, intermediate checks, performance verification, and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment as per approved schedules. 
 - Review, validate, and maintain test reports, technical records, raw data registers, equipment logbooks, trend charts, and laboratory documentation to ensure data integrity and traceability. 
 - Lead and support implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Quality Management System, including: 
 - Ensuring SOPs are current, available, and consistently followed. 
 - Compliance with latest ASTM, ISO, BIS, and other applicable standards. 
 - New test method development and validation. 
 - Measurement Uncertainty (MU) estimation and maintenance. 
 - Proficiency Testing (PT) and Inter-Laboratory Comparison (ILC) participation. 
 - SRM/IRM testing and control chart monitoring. 
 - Raw data, master register, and report verification. 
 - LMS maintenance and documentation control. 
 - Verification of calibration certificates and quality records. 
 - Repeat/replicate testing and investigation of abnormal results. 
 - Closure of non-conformances arising from internal and external audits. 
 - Lead NABL accreditation activities and support Green Pathway initiatives to strengthen laboratory compliance, sustainability, and operational excellence. 
 - Ensure adequate inventory and availability of laboratory consumables, spare parts, reference materials, and testing resources. 
 - Drive 5S implementation, laboratory housekeeping, safety compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives to maintain an organized, efficient, safe, and audit-ready laboratory environment. 
 - Plan, coordinate, and execute laboratory activities in the absence of the Laboratory Manager and act as authorized signatory for reports and laboratory records as delegated. 
 - Lead assigned laboratory sections to ensure safe, efficient, and quality-compliant operations while achieving testing, project, and business objectives. 

Skills And Competencies

- 6 - 8 Yrs of relevant experience
 - Bachelor's /Master's degree in disciplines related to Polymer Engineering/Science, Plastic Technology, Chemical Engineer
 - Strong knowledge of polymer materials, polymer processing, product performance, and material characterization techniques. 
 - Good understanding of uPVC, CPVC, solvent cement, water storage tanks, and other polymer-based products. 
 - Sound knowledge of ASTM, ISO, BIS, and other relevant testing standards. 
 - Strong understanding of ISO/IEC 17025: 2017, NABL accreditation requirements, laboratory quality systems, and Measurement Uncertainty (MU) principles. 
 - Knowledge of failure analysis, benchmarking, counterfeit product identification, intellectual property (IP)-related testing, root cause analysis, and product validation. 
 - Understanding of statistical analysis, data interpretation, trend analysis, and technical reporting methodologies. 
 - Hands-on expertise in advanced polymer characterization techniques including FTIR, DSC, TGA, DMA, SEM-EDX, XRF, Weathering Tests (Q-SUN-Xenon & UV), Capillary Rheometer. 
 - Knowledge of interpreting results from Universal Testing Machines (UTM), Charpy & Izod Impact Testers, HDT/VST Testers, Melt Flow Index (MFI) Testers, Viscosity Testing Equipment, Fusion Studies and other polymer testing instruments. 
 - Experience in test method development, method validation, troubleshooting, and laboratory investigations. 
 - Proficiency in calibration, intermediate checks, performance verification, and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment. 
 - Experience in proficiency testing (PT), inter-laboratory comparison (ILC) programs, SRM/IRM testing, and laboratory quality assurance activities. 
 - Strong leadership, planning, project management, and execution capabilities. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver results within agreed timelines. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Canva, Laboratory Management Systems (LMS), and other data analysis and presentation tools. 
 - Capability to lead assigned laboratory sections, mentor team members, and drive continuous improvement, 5S, safety, and operational excellence initiatives.

About the role: As a Principal SRE, you will set the technical direction for how Cvent scales, secures and operates its platforms, and you will mentor others while helping Cvent both envision and achieve its DevSecOps goals. 

Strong AI and automation skills are required, and candidates with hands-on WAF and security exposure are especially valued. 

This role is open in Bangalore and Gurgaon. 

We are looking for someone with the drive, ownership and ability to take on challenging problems, both technical and process related, in a dynamic, collaborative and highly distributed, multi-disciplinary team. You will use your background as a generalist to work closely with product development teams, Information Security, Cloud Infrastructure and other SRE teams to keep our platforms secure, and you must be able to see the big picture and solve hard multi-disciplinary problems with others. 

Technical depth in cloud operations, the software development lifecycle and security vulnerability

management will help you, but excellent mentorship, communication and the ability to drive alignment are must-haves. We use SRE principles such as blameless postmortems and a focus on automation to keep improving our knowledge and maintain a good quality of life. 

In this Role, You Will: 

- Enlighten, enable and empower a fast-growing set of multi-disciplinary teams across multiple applications and locations. 
 - Tackle complex development, automation and business process problems, and champion Cvent standards and best practices. 
 - Ensure the scalability, performance and resilience of security-related systems and processes. 
 - Work with product development teams, Information Security, Cloud Automation and other SRE teams to build a holistic understanding of security concerns and resolve them effectively and efficiently. 
 - Identify recurring problems and anti-patterns in development, operational and security processes. 
 - Develop build, test and deployment automation that seamlessly targets multiple on-premises and AWS regions.

Preferred candidate profile

Experience: 10 to 15 years in SRE, DevSecOps or DevOps, with significant time in a lead, staff or principal role.

operational efficiency and developer productivity, for example AI-assisted alert triage, event

grouping and incident response. 

• Deep fluency in AWS across multi-account, multi-region and high-traffic environments, with a strong foundation in distributed systems and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, CDK or Terraform). 

• Demonstrable leadership in scaling SRE practices: CI/CD, observability, incident management, RCAs and blameless postmortems. 

• Incident management experience: able to act as Incident Commander, write clear incident

summaries, drive RCA, and coordinate resolution across teams under pressure. 

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or equivalent), PR-based deployment workflows, and troubleshooting pipeline failures in distributed environments. 

• Change management discipline: communicating changes proactively, documenting rollout strategies, and managing phased production deployments with rollback plans. 

• Fluent in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Ruby or Bash, with solid Linux and networking fundamentals. 

• Experience with APM, monitoring and logging tools (Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus, 

Grafana). 

• Excellent communication skills and a track record of driving alignment across multi-disciplinary

teams, plus a passion for mentoring and making things better for your peers. 

• Experience with SDLC methodologies (preferably Agile). 

WAF and security exposure (strongly preferred; candidates with hands-on experience are prioritized)

• AWS WAF: rule authoring, rate-based rules, Bot Control integration, rule group management, and

multi-product WAF sharing strategies (e. g. , managing rule limits across applications sharing the same WebACL). 

• DDoS protection with AWS Shield Advanced, including moving endpoints from count to block mode and building observability (Lambda + CloudWatch alarms). 

• CDN experience, ideally Amazon CloudFront, as part of a layered security posture with WAF and

Shield. 

• Bot mitigation strategies, including AWS Bot Control, token-based traffic classification, JA4+ASN

fingerprinting, and evaluation of third-party vendors (e. g. , Datadome). 

Good to Have Skills

management.

• Good understanding of containerization concepts: Docker, ECS, EKS, Kubernetes.

• Familiarity with risk assessment and management concepts and practices.

data.description:
Job Title

Controls Project Engineer I

Job Description

Controls Project Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time

If you are passionate about industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, and delivering advanced automation solutions for material handling environments, this could be the ideal opportunity for you. 

Your Role

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, integration, and commissioning of Low-Level Controls (LLC) software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems. You will work with Siemens PLC technologies, SCADA, HMI, drives, and safety systems to deliver reliable and high-quality control solutions. 

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary and international project teams, support customer-facing activities, provide technical guidance to junior engineers, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of Vanderlande's controls solutions. 

What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities

Controls Software Development & Engineering

- Design, develop, and test LLC software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems using Siemens TIA Portal. 
 - Develop functional PLC software based on customer requirements, project specifications, and standard controls architecture. 
 - Program and configure Siemens PLC systems using Ladder Logic, FBD, STL, and SCL. 
 - Configure and integrate PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, and safety systems. 
 - Apply reusable software modules, library structures, and standardized controls solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain technical documentation including functional specifications, interface documents, and engineering deliverables. 

Testing, Integration & Commissioning

- Perform engineering, simulation, emulation, FAT, SAT, and site commissioning activities. 
 - Troubleshoot software, communication, PLC, HMI, and controls-related issues during testing and commissioning. 
 - Perform system integration activities with SCADA, Equipment Management, Mechanical, Electrical, and Safety disciplines. 
 - Use Siemens diagnostic tools such as Proneta and online diagnostics for troubleshooting and system validation. 
 - Support backup, version management, and software configuration activities. 
 - Prepare test plans, commissioning documentation, and reports to support successful project delivery. 
 - Support successful project handover and completion of Service Take Over (STO) deliverables. 

Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

- Identify project risks, technical issues, and dependencies and recommend appropriate mitigation actions. 
 - Support customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions when required. 
 - Mentor junior Controls Engineers and provide technical guidance during engineering, testing, and commissioning activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with engineering standards, development processes, and quality guidelines. 
 - Contribute to software standardization and continuous improvement of products, tools, and engineering processes. 
 - Report technical progress, deviations, risks, and issues to the Project Lead Engineer and Group Leader. 
 - Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams across global locations. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation and PLC-based control systems. 
 - Proven experience in engineering, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automated material handling or industrial automation systems. 
 - Experience working on international projects and site commissioning activities is preferred. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal for PLC development, troubleshooting, testing, and commissioning. 
 - Good understanding of SCADA systems and system integration. 
 - Experience with HMI development, screen configuration, alarms, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Strong knowledge of
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram (FBD)
 - Statement List (STL)
 - Structured Control Language (SCL)
 - Hands-on experience with
 - PROFINET
 - PROFIBUS
 - AS-i
 - Familiarity with Siemens engineering and diagnostic tools including Proneta, online diagnostics, backup, and version management. 
 - Working knowledge of Siemens PLC concepts including data blocks, indirect addressing, reusable software modules, and library structures. 
 - Basic to intermediate experience with Safety PLC programming, testing, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk View is an added advantage. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Good communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams. 
 - Willingness to travel internationally for commissioning and customer support, approximately 50-70%. 
About Vanderlande

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey-from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors. 

At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other. 

Website www. vanderlande. com

What We Offer

Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice

- Competitive Salary Package
 - 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
 - 22 paid leave days
 - 8 sick/casual leave days
 - Applicable government holidays
 - Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance
 - Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs
 - Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
 - Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
 - Opportunity to collaborate globally with engineering teams and international customers
 - Exposure to advanced automation and material handling technologies
How We Work

We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. 

In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say. 

Ready to apply?

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume. 

Diversity & Inclusion

Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets - focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. 

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. 

Corporate Functions Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. 

Responsibilities

Position Purpose : 

We are looking for a hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our NeXus Core backend team. You will own and improve automated testing for distributed services supporting accounts, balances, trades and positions. Working closely with engineers, product and DevOps, you will build reliable component, integration, end-to-end and performance coverage, identify quality risks early, and help the team deliver correct, resilient services. This is a coding-focused role with technical ownership, code review and mentoring responsibilities. 

Primary Responsibilities Include

- Own the backend test strategy, prioritising by business risk and choosing appropriate component, integration and end-to-end coverage. 
 - Extend shared TypeScript automation frameworks and reusable helpers; build maintainable suites, deterministic test data and isolated component environments. 
 - Validate gRPC contracts and behaviour, including authentication, authorisation, errors, deadlines, streaming and backward compatibility. 
 - Test Kafka-driven ingestion and processing, including eventual consistency, duplicate or out-of-order events, retries, recovery and reconciliation with database state. 
 - Develop and maintain k6 performance suites; investigate latency, throughput, error rates and resource behaviour using Datadog. 
 - Integrate functional and performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines; diagnose failures, improve feedback and reduce flaky tests. 
 - Maintain TestRail traceability and automated reporting; communicate meaningful coverage gaps, defects and release risks. 
 - Work with engineers and product on acceptance criteria and testability; drive defect investigation through resolution. 
 - Review automation pull requests, mentor QA engineers and lead practical improvements to shared tooling and testing practices. 

Qualifications

To Land this role

- 5+ years of QA automation experience, with a strong backend/API focus and demonstrated independent ownership of automation frameworks or substantial test suites. 
 - Strong hands-on TypeScript / JavaScript skills: writing reusable test code, reviewing changes and debugging asynchronous behaviour. Experience with Mocha / Chai or comparable frameworks. 
 - Practical experience testing gRPC / Protocol Buffers, including client setup, metadata, status codes and service contracts; a solid understanding of REST API testing. 
 - Experience designing component and integration tests using controlled fixtures, mocks or service simulation, alongside end-to-end coverage. 
 - Experience testing Kafka or comparable event-driven systems, with an understanding of asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency. 
 - Strong SQL skills for validating persisted data and investigating discrepancies; experience with PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database. 
 - Hands-on performance testing experience using k6 or a comparable tool, including workload design, interpreting results and investigating regressions. 
 - Experience running tests in Docker-based environments and integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines; confident use of Git and pull-request workflows. 
 - Ability to diagnose failures across tests, service logs, APIs, messaging and databases, distinguishing product defects from environment or test issues. 
 - Clear communication of quality risks and release confidence, effective collaboration across teams, and experience reviewing test code or mentoring other QA engineers. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with our specific tooling: Azure DevOps, Docker Compose, WireMock, TestRail, Allure and Datadog. 
 - Familiarity with Java / Spring Boot code, Kubernetes deployments, health/readiness checks and service recovery scenarios. 
 - Experience validating schema evolution, API compatibility and authentication/authorisation across distributed services. 
 - Domain knowledge in financial services, trading systems or regulated environments, particularly account, balance, trade or position data. 

Working Environment

4 days from office

The Role: 

We are looking for a deeply technical, hands-on Blue Prism specialist who can work across automation development, production operations, solution architecture, platform engineering, and technical problem-solving. 

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a delivery-management, project-management, or people-management position. The successful candidate will be expected to personally design, build, troubleshoot, deploy, support, and improve enterprise-grade Blue Prism solutions. 

This role is suited to engineers who enjoy working directly with technology, solving complex production issues, understanding systems end to end, and expanding their skills across multiple technologies as the automation landscape evolves. 

What You Will Get To Do: 

- Design, build, test, deploy, and support complex enterprise automation solutions using Blue Prism 
 - Own automation solutions across their complete lifecycle, including discovery, feasibility assessment, design, development, release, production support, optimization, and retirement 
 - Develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable Blue Prism processes and business objects 
 - Work extensively with Process Studio, Object Studio, Control Room, Work Queues, Schedules, Credentials, Environment Variables, Releases, and Runtime Resources 
 - Design robust exception-handling, recovery, retry, logging, alerting, and operational-support frameworks 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation failures across Blue Prism, applications, databases, APIs, virtual machines, credentials, and infrastructure components 
 - Perform root-cause analysis for recurring production issues and implement permanent technical fixes 
 - Monitor live automations, analyse operational performance, and improve stability, resilience, recoverability, and throughput 
 - Design automation architecture for new and existing processes, including component design, integration patterns, deployment models, and support models 
 - Review and refactor poorly designed, unstable, or difficult-to-maintain automation solutions 
 - Integrate Blue Prism with web applications, Windows applications, Java applications, mainframe systems, Citrix environments, APIs, databases, file systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook, and enterprise platforms 
 - Build and consume REST and SOAP services and work with XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, tokens, and secure credentials 
 - Work closely with infrastructure, architecture, information security, database, application-support, and business teams to resolve technical dependencies 
 - Support Blue Prism environment upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, patching, capacity planning, and platform improvements 
 - Participate in technical design reviews and challenge solutions that are not scalable, secure, supportable, or operationally resilient 
 - Create clear technical documentation, including solution designs, operational runbooks, deployment instructions, support procedures, and troubleshooting guides 
 - Conduct technical code reviews and enforce Blue Prism engineering standards and reusable design patterns 
 - Support release, change, incident, and problem-management activities for production automations 
 - Contribute to automation engineering standards, platform governance, reusable frameworks, and Centre of Excellence practices 
 - Evaluate and learn additional technologies that complement Blue Prism and improve automation capability 
 - Work hands-on with adjacent technologies such as APIs, SQL, scripting, cloud services, monitoring, and platform tooling 
 - Take full technical ownership of assigned solutions without relying on separate development, support, or architecture teams to solve core engineering problems 
 - Continuously expand technical capability by learning and applying multiple technologies based on business and platform needs

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years of overall technology experience, with substantial hands-on experience developing enterprise automations using Blue Prism 
 - At least 5 years of recent, continuous, hands-on Blue Prism development experience 
 - Strong practical expertise in Blue Prism Process Studio and Object Studio 
 - Deep understanding of Blue Prism application modelling, spying techniques, dynamic attributes, wait stages, collections, work queues, environment variables, credentials, schedules, sessions, and runtime resources 
 - Demonstrated experience building complex Blue Prism solutions rather than only maintaining, monitoring, or coordinating automation projects 
 - Strong experience supporting Blue Prism automations in production environments 
 - Proven ability to diagnose failures involving Blue Prism, target applications, virtual machines, databases, APIs, access permissions, credentials, certificates, and infrastructure 
 - Strong understanding of exception handling, retry design, recovery stages, logging, auditability, transaction management, and operational resilience 
 - Experience designing reusable Blue Prism components, frameworks, templates, and utility objects 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise automation architecture and the technical dependencies required to run Blue Prism at scale 
 - Experience integrating Blue Prism with REST APIs, SOAP services, XML, JSON, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications 
 - Good working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write queries, analyse data, troubleshoot database-related issues, and support integrations 
 - Experience with at least one programming or scripting technology such as C#, . NET, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or VBA 
 - Ability to read and troubleshoot code, scripts, API payloads, logs, configuration files, and database queries 
 - Experience automating browser-based, desktop, Java, Citrix, virtual desktop, and legacy applications 
 - Understanding of Blue Prism infrastructure, including application servers, interactive clients, runtime resources, databases, virtual machines, connectivity, and environment configuration 
 - Experience with production monitoring, incident management, problem management, change management, and release management 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release controls, security controls, and enterprise development standards 
 - Ability to independently convert business requirements into technically sound automation designs 
 - Ability to assess automation feasibility, identify technical risks, estimate complexity, and recommend practical solutions 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and root-cause-analysis skills 
 - High level of ownership and willingness to remain hands-on throughout the solution lifecycle 
 - Willingness and ability to learn multiple technologies beyond Blue Prism 
 - Ability to adapt to new tools, platforms, programming languages, integration methods, and automation technologies based on business needs 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when explaining technical issues and design decisions 
 - Ability to work effectively with globally distributed technical and business teams

This Role May Not Be Suitable for You If: 

- Your recent experience has primarily been in project management, delivery management, team management, or stakeholder coordination 
 - You have worked mainly as a Blue Prism Control Room operator or production-monitoring analyst 
 - You have limited recent hands-on experience building Blue Prism processes and business objects 
 - You prefer to hand off architecture, development, deployment, or production troubleshooting to separate teams 
 - You are looking only for a narrowly defined Blue Prism development role and are not interested in learning additional technologies 
 - You are not comfortable personally investigating and resolving complex technical and production issues 
 - Your experience is primarily with other RPA platforms and you have only limited exposure to Blue Prism

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Blue Prism Developer, Professional Developer, Technical Architect, or equivalent certification 
 - Experience working in large-scale, regulated enterprise environments 
 - Experience with Blue Prism platform upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery, infrastructure design, or environment administration 
 - Experience with Blue Prism Hub, Interact, Capture, or Process Intelligence 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services 
 - Exposure to CI/CD concepts, automated deployments, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices 
 - Experience working with financial services, healthcare, insurance, banking, or other regulated industries

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, enabling us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking, decisions, and conversations. 

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

Job Opportunity: Automation Engineer

The Automation Engineer (PLC Programmer) will develop and implement PLC-SCADA-HMI programs, support onsite commissioning, troubleshoot automation issues, and ensure reliable plant operation across project sites in India. Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE: RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. 

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration. 

, 

Purpose & Scope -

The Senior Manager, AI Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI solutions that accelerate Ralph Lauren's transformation into an AI-enabled enterprise. This role combines strong technical leadership with hands-on execution to deliver production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and reusable engineering capabilities across the organization. This leader partners closely with AI Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Product, Security, Governance, and Business Technology teams to translate prioritized use cases into secure, scalable, and high-impact AI solutions built on Microsoft Azure and Databricks. 

The Role Is Responsible For

- Enterprise AI and agentic AI solution delivery 
 - Multi-agent orchestration and intelligent workflow automation 
 - LLMOps and MLOps engineering practices 
 - AI integration, observability, and operational excellence 
 - Responsible AI implementation and governance adherence 
 - Engineering team leadership and capability development

This leader is expected to drive engineering excellence while enabling rapid experimentation, innovation, and scalable AI adoption across business functions. 

, 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

AI Solution Delivery

- Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise AI solutions aligned with business priorities. 
 - Translate prioritized AI use cases into scalable, production-ready applications and services. 
 - Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to define solution requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Drive disciplined execution across prototyping, engineering, testing, deployment, and production support. 

Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

- Design and implement agentic AI solutions using Azure AI services, Databricks, vector platforms, orchestration frameworks, and modern LLM ecosystems. 
 - Build and maintain multi-agent workflows, orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation solutions. 
 - Develop reusable patterns for memory management, tool usage, reasoning workflows, human-in-the-loop controls, and enterprise action execution. 
 - Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies based on business value, risk, and engineering fit. 

AI Platform Engineering

- Contribute to enterprise AI platforms, reusable services, SDKs, templates, and engineering accelerators. 
 - Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and shared AI capabilities supporting multiple business use cases. 
 - Partner with Data Engineering to ensure AI-ready data foundations and scalable access patterns in Azure and Databricks. 
 - Support technical decisions related to AI services, inference, model deployment, infrastructure, and integrations. 

Engineering Excellence & Operations

- Establish and promote standards for CI/CD, testing, release management, monitoring, and operational support. 
 - Implement LLMOps and MLOps practices including evaluation, prompt management, experimentation, telemetry, and runtime optimization. 
 - Lead production-readiness reviews for reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency. 
 - Monitor performance and drive continuous improvement through operational analytics. 

Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, compliance, governance, and Responsible AI standards. 
 - Partner with Security and Governance teams to implement guardrails, auditability, policy enforcement, and risk controls. 
 - Support observability frameworks including telemetry, evaluation, performance tracking, and drift detection. 

Team Leadership & Talent Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers and technical specialists. 
 - Provide technical coaching and hands-on guidance throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, engineering rigor, and continuous learning. 
 - Support recruiting, onboarding, performance enablement, and career development. 
 - Drive collaboration across strategy, architecture, data, infrastructure, product, and business teams. 

, 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or data engineering, including technical leadership responsibility. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams that deliver AI or machine learning solutions. 
 - Proven experience developing and deploying production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and intelligent automation solutions. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering skills with the ability to architect, prototype, review, and troubleshoot AI systems. 
 - Deep experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, API Management, and cloud-native engineering patterns. 
 - Strong experience with Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, AI/ML pipelines, vector search, and scalable data processing. 
 - Experience building RAG solutions, vector database integrations, memory architectures, and enterprise knowledge-retrieval systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, MCP-based ecosystems, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of LLMOps and MLOps, including deployment, prompt management, evaluation, observability, experimentation, governance, and runtime optimization. 
 - Experience with API-first architecture, microservices, event-driven systems, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and business teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience delivering agentic AI and multi-agent solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate, and adopt emerging AI technologies and practices. 
 - Experience building reusable engineering frameworks, accelerators, and shared AI services. 
 - Familiarity with AI-native commerce and Agentic Commerce ecosystems, including UCP, ACP, and autonomous transaction orchestration patterns. 
 - Experience in retail, luxury retail, eCommerce, or digital commerce environments. 
 - Relevant Azure, Databricks, cloud engineering, or AI/ML certifications.

data.description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We've learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members-including HR and leadership-via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. 

What To Know

- Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text. 
 - We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day. 
 - Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee. 

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault. com

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks - keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company's unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100, 000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

Senior Engineer- C++

The Opportunity

We have an outstanding career opportunity for Senior Engineer- C++ at Bangalore, Hyderabad and Pune locations. In this role you will build scalable, high-performance enterprise software. 

What You'll Do. . . 

- Design, develop, and maintain core components in a distributed storage platform. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Debug complex production issues and improve system performance. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and conduct code reviews. 
 - Drive innovation while maintaining product quality and reliability. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric solutions. 

Who You Are. . . 

- Bachelor's degree required. 
 - 4 or more years of software development experience
 - Strong experience in C++ Object oriented programming. 
 - Good understanding of Linux and Windows internals, including process, memory, storage, and networking concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience with debugging and troubleshooting tools such as gdb, WinDbg, ProcMon, Wireshark, tcpdump, or similar. 
 - Proven experience with crash dump analysis, memory leaks, handle leaks, deadlocks, race conditions, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong experience working with systems involving micro-services & service architecture, client-server architecture, and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, and Design Patterns. 
 - Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and software development best practices. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a strong sense of ownership. 
 - Security and SaaS experience strongly preferred. 

You'll Love Working Here Because

- Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
 - Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
 - Annual health check-ups, Car lease Program, and Tuition Reimbursement
 - An inclusive company culture, an opportunity to join our Community Guilds
 - Personal accident cover and Term life cover

Ready to #makeyourmark at Commvault? Apply now!

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work. 

Commvault's goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault. com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault. com.

data.title: QA Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) - The AI Factory Platform Company - we're building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide. 

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale. 

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision. 

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact. 

Job Overview

We are seeking a Manager, Quality Engineering to lead quality engineering for ClusterWareAI, a critical component of the Penguin Solutions AI Factory Platform. 

ClusterWareAI enables automated provisioning, orchestration, monitoring, and lifecycle management of large-scale AI infrastructure. In this role, you will define and drive the quality strategy for a complex distributed platform spanning GPU infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, Kubernetes, workload orchestration, and AI-enabled operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead and develop a Quality Engineering team while partnering closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Support, and Systems Integration teams to build quality into every stage of the product lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate brings a strong product-engineering mindset, deep experience with test automation and distributed systems, and a passion for delivering reliable cloud and infrastructure software at scale. 

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI across functional, integration, system, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and resilience testing. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing QE team while establishing strong technical, automation, and execution practices. 
 - Drive a shift-left, automation-first quality culture, partnering with Engineering, Product, Platform, DevOps, Support, and Systems Integration throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Design scalable test automation frameworks across APIs, UI, CLI, control-plane services, infrastructure integrations, and end-to-end workflows, integrated with CI/CD quality gates. 
 - Define test strategies for GPU infrastructure, bare metal, Kubernetes, networking, storage, workload orchestration, and distributed systems at scale. 
 - Validate infrastructure lifecycle workflows including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, rollback, deprovisioning, monitoring, health management, and automated remediation. 
 - Drive performance, scalability, HA, fault-injection, longevity, and failure/recovery testing across large-scale distributed environments. 
 - Define validation for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, security, access controls, resource governance, and workload separation. 
 - Establish quality and release-readiness metrics covering automation, escaped defects, test reliability, performance, scalability, and product risk. 
 - Partner with Support and Engineering on customer issues, root-cause analysis, and converting field failures into automated regression coverage. 
 - Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted quality engineering approaches to improve test generation, failure analysis, defect triage, and engineering productivity. 

AI / Agentic Quality Engineering

- Own the AI Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI's AI Platform capabilities. 
 - Build automated AI evaluation frameworks and benchmark suites covering accuracy, groundedness, consistency, reliability, latency, cost, and task success. 
 - Establish LLM and agent evaluation methodologies using golden datasets, scenario-based testing, synthetic data, LLM-as-a-Judge, rubric-based evaluation, and human evaluation. 
 - Test RAG, tool calling, multi-step agents, planning/execution, agent collaboration, memory, and infrastructure-aware reasoning. 
 - Develop AI regression pipelines to detect degradation caused by changes to models, prompts, agents, tools, knowledge sources, and orchestration logic. 
 - Drive AI safety and adversarial testing, including hallucination, prompt injection, unauthorized tool use, policy violations, data leakage, and unsafe infrastructure actions. 
 - Validate agent guardrails, policy enforcement, approvals, authorization boundaries, tenant isolation, auditability, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Establish production AI quality metrics including task success rate, hallucination rate, tool-call accuracy, agent failure rate, escalation rate, latency, and cost efficiency. 
 - Develop scenario-based autonomous infrastructure testing to validate that agents correctly observe, reason, plan, obtain approval, execute authorized actions, verify outcomes, and recover safely from failures. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years in Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, Test Automation, or related engineering roles, with 3+ years leading QE teams. 
 - Proven experience owning quality for a commercial software, cloud, infrastructure, or distributed systems platform. 
 - Strong programming and automation skills, preferably Python, with experience building scalable automation frameworks. 
 - Strong experience testing APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, infrastructure software, and complex enterprise applications. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, performance, scalability, reliability, HA, security, and failure/recovery testing. 
 - Strong Linux, debugging, observability, log analysis, and distributed-systems troubleshooting skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, coaching, and team development. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/LLM quality engineering, AI evaluation, or testing AI-powered applications. 
 - Experience testing LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, multi-agent systems, or agentic workflows. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation methodologies including golden datasets, benchmark testing, LLM-as-a-Judge, RAG evaluation, adversarial testing, and red teaming. 
 - Experience with frameworks such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, LangSmith/LangChain evaluation, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, or equivalent. 
 - Understanding of AI failure modes including hallucination, prompt injection, non-determinism, tool-use errors, context failures, model regression, and unsafe agent behavior. 
 - Experience integrating AI evaluation and regression testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU cloud/neocloud platforms, or large-scale cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and multi-tenant cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with GPU infrastructure, including GPU lifecycle, drivers, firmware, health monitoring, and heterogeneous accelerator environments. 
 - Experience with high-performance networking technologies such as InfiniBand, RDMA/RoCE, high-speed Ethernet, and distributed storage. 
 - Experience with bare-metal provisioning, infrastructure lifecycle management, and fleet-scale automation. 
 - Experience with workload orchestration and scheduling technologies such as Kubernetes and Slurm. 
 - Experience with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Ansible. 
 - Experience with cloud platform security, tenant isolation, identity/access controls, and resource governance. 
 - Experience with observability, SRE practices, service-level objectives, high availability, fault tolerance, and automated remediation. 
 - Experience testing AI/LLM-powered capabilities and developing repeatable AI evaluation frameworks. 
 - Background in enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, systems management software, or High Performance Computing environments. 

Location

Hybrid - Bangalore, India

Travel

As needed

data.title: Software Development Engineer II - Frontend
data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts . 

About Commerce & Payments Team: 

The Commerce & Payments team is a newly formed organization to add HighLevel's evolving capabilities and make it both a Commerce Platform and a surface where our customers can perform their sales motions for their products. Building Catalogs, subscriptions, fulfillment , payment processing engines, inventory mgmt, pricing, documents/contracts and more to enable our SMBs to increase their revenue will be the core focus of the org. Hardly any tech debt, mostly green field work working closely with product folks to build, ship and refine our Commerce offerings makes this an exciting place to learn, engage and thrive. 

About the Role: 

We're building a global commerce platform to power $1T+ in annual transactions for millions of SMEs. As an SDE II on the frontend, you'll build the surfaces that customers and their buyers touch: storefronts, checkout, catalog, subscription management, invoices and contracts. 

These surfaces carry money. They get embedded inside other people's experiences. They run on slow phones and flaky networks in 150+ countries. A layout shift shows up in someone's conversion rate, and a 300ms regression shows up in someone's revenue. 

This role is for engineers who obsess over frontend craft and have the depth to back it up. If you already know why your bundle is that size, where your hydration cost goes, and what your service worker does on a cache miss, we want to talk to you. 

Responsibilities: 

- Build and ship the commerce surfaces: storefronts, checkout, catalog, subscription management, invoices and documents
 - Embed our experiences inside other experiences - module federation, iframes and white-label hosts that stay isolated, load fast and degrade gracefully
 - Own performance budgets end to end: Core Web Vitals, bundle size, render cost, hydration, main-thread work. Measure them in CI and defend them
 - Build installable, offline-tolerant PWAs with service workers, considered caching strategies and background sync
 - Deliver WCAG 2. 2 AA accessibility and full localisation across languages, currencies, tax and address formats, and RTL layouts
 - Instrument the client with real-user monitoring and OpenTelemetry so regressions surface before customers report them
 - Collaborate with PM/Design and mentor junior engineers

Requirements: 

- 2+ years building and operating production frontend applications
 - Deep Vue. js knowledge: the reactivity model, component composition, rendering behaviour, and the runtime cost of each choice
 - A visible performance habit. You live in Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools and the performance profiler, and you can walk us through a regression you found, measured and fixed
 - Service workers and caching strategy: precaching, runtime caching, versioning, invalidation, and offline behaviour that stays correct
 - Client state management and local caching at scale (TanStack Query or equivalent): cache keys, staleness, invalidation, optimistic updates
 - Accessibility as a build-time discipline: semantics, focus management, keyboard paths, screen reader behaviour, WCAG 2. 2 AA
 - Internationalisation and localisation: message extraction, plurals, locale-aware currency and date formatting, RTL
 - Modern frontend tooling and module federation (Rspack, Vite), plus bundle analysis and code splitting
 - An eye for craft. You notice the four-pixel misalignment, the janky scroll, and the layout shift that only appears on a throttled connection, and you fix all three
 - Comfortable consuming typed backend contracts (ConnectRPC/protobuf) and reasoning about API contracts and error states
 - Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills

Tech Stack: 

Frontend: Vue. js, Rspack, Module Federation, TanStack Query

Client platform: Service workers/PWA, OpenTelemetry, Vite, ESLint

Backend contracts: Go, ConnectRPC, Buf

Cloud: GCP (GKE), Pub/Sub

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision. 

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Strong skills in C, C++ programming

Experience in Algorithms, Data Structures/File Structures

Strong skills in Unix/Linux internals - Hands-on in multi-threading, synchronization & Kernel programming etc. 

- Enterprise Cloud / Hybrid Cloud / Clustering development, Storage Systems, C & C++ Programing, Unix Internals, Perl / Python scripting Knowledge of TCP/IP and network protocols, network analysis, IP filters etc.

Preferred Qualification & Experience

- Industry: Experience in high-volume consumer goods (CPG/FMCG), oral care, or precision plastics manufacturing. 
 - Audit Expertise: Familiarity with international subsidiary benchmarking, cGMP, and EOHS site standards.

 - Commercial Mindset: Understanding of plant financials, product commercialization bundles, and target cost delivery.

data.title: Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.

data.description:
Title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Cost & Engineering Efficiency

Location: Noida/ Bangalore (Hybrid)

Summary Of Role

Sumo Logic's microservices architecture, hosted on AWS, ingests petabytes of data daily across many geographic regions in support of our planet-scale observability and security products, serving hundreds of millions of queries a day against thousands of petabytes of data. At that scale, every inefficiency - in code, architecture, or infrastructure - compounds into real cost. 

This role sits within the Product SRE organization, working alongside your global SRE team on your product area's reliability roadmap - with a mandate that leads with code as much as operations. You'll find where Sumo's systems are spending more compute, storage, or engineering time than necessary, and fix it in the code and architecture, not just the infra config, while also carrying the fuller SRE mandate - reliability, security posture, and improving the day-to-day experience of the engineers within your product area. You'll be part of a team that blends SRE and backend software engineering skillsets, partnering closely with product engineering teams across your product area. 

This is an engineering role - the work is about shipping code, architecture, and system-level changes that improve unit economics, not managing cost dashboards, tagging, or reserved-instance/savings-plan purchasing. 

What You'll Do

- Continuously discover cost and efficiency opportunities through production profiling, telemetry, cost data, capacity trends, and system-level analysis - across algorithmic inefficiencies, resource-heavy code paths, and architectural decisions - and turn ambiguous problems into prioritized engineering initiatives. 
 - Apply performance and capacity engineering techniques to understand CPU, memory, storage, network, and I/O behavior under real production workloads, and optimize the resulting resource footprint. 
 - Write production-grade code to implement the optimizations you identify - JVM/GC tuning, algorithmic and resource-efficiency improvements, re-architecting inefficient services - in systems that process petabytes of data daily. 
 - Define and track engineering efficiency metrics such as cost per GB ingested, cost per query, cost per event, resource utilization, or cost per customer workload, and translate the work into measurable impact for engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and measurement - influencing teams where you don't have direct ownership - and help establish engineering patterns and practices that make cost and efficiency a continuous part of the development lifecycle. 
 - Partner with engineering teams in your product area to prioritize changes, and with developer infrastructure and Global SRE to align with the broader reliability roadmap. 
 - Participate in the SRE responsibilities for different product areas - SLOs, on-call, incident response, and blameless RCA - using those experiences to identify systemic reliability, performance, and efficiency improvements. 

What You'll Have

- B. Tech, M. Tech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience with a demonstrated track record of ownership. 
 - Strong CS fundamentals - comfortable with algorithmic complexity, data-structure performance characteristics, and system design at scale. 
 - Ability to author production-ready code in at least one OO/systems language (Java, Scala, Go, C++, or similar) - depth of engineering ability matters more than which language. 
 - Experience with distributed systems and microservice architectures in production. 
 - Demonstrated track record of independently identifying ambiguous performance, scalability, or cost problems and driving engineering changes that produced measurable improvements in production. 
 - Strong ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior, capacity, performance, and cost, and use production data to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes. 
 - Working fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS compute, storage, networking) - enough to reason about cost and architectural tradeoffs. 
 - Comfort moving across the stack, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on, to find root causes of inefficiency. 

Nice to have

- JVM tuning and GC optimization experience at scale. 
 - Exposure to cost-attribution/FinOps practices or tooling. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or modern CI/CD tooling. 
 - Prior SRE experience - on-call, SLOs, incident response. 
 - Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kafka Streams) or observability/security platforms. 

Why this role

- Visibility - Cost/efficiency work maps directly to metrics the business already tracks. 
 - Scope you define - you identify where the opportunities are rather than executing a fixed backlog. 
 - Real scale - systems ingesting petabytes of data daily and serving hundreds of millions of queries. 

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www. sumologic. com. 

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.
