data.description:
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta' s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values. 

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission and Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation is at the heart of everything we do. This job requires daily onsite work at our office in Hyderabad, India. 

This Opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center (IDC) and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the initial members, you'll help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is a unique opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. This highly visible position will report to our Director of Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation team directly and will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and ML teams across geographies. 

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex healthcare domain data and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

We are seeking Full Stack Engineers to help build our critical internal annotation and administrative platforms to enable high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks across the company. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex full stack, i. e. , both UX and backend data problems and want to build tools used daily by internal clinical domain and technical experts.

data.title: Head – Mechanical Engineering (Defence & Aerospace)
data.description:
Experience: 10+ Years

Location: Gurugram  

Department: Engineering / R&D  

Reporting To: CEO / Head of R&D

  

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Head - Mechanical Engineering to lead mechanical design, structural development, packaging, integration and qualification of complex systems for defence and aerospace programmes. 

The candidate will lead the mechanical engineering team, own key design decisions, coordinate manufacturing and outsourced engineering vendors, and take mechanical systems from concept through detailed design, prototype, qualification and production. 

Projects include Tethered aerostat and radar platforms, Underwater Communication Systems, AUV systems, UAV/avionics platforms and surveillance systems. 

Previous hands-on experience in defence, aerospace or military-grade engineering programmes is mandatory. 

  

Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Team Management

  

●        Lead and mentor mechanical design, structural and manufacturing engineers across multiple projects. 

●          Define system mechanical architecture, structural concepts, packaging philosophy and interface requirements. 

●          Allocate engineering activities and ensure project milestones, technical reviews and deliverables are achieved. 

●        Conduct concept, PDR/CDR, manufacturing and test-readiness reviews. 

●        Coordinate closely with electronics, RF, firmware, systems and manufacturing teams. 

●        Identify mechanical risks and drive technical decisions and corrective actions. 

  

Mechanical Design & Analysis

  

●        Lead/review 3D modelling, detailed drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-up and engineering calculations. 

●          Design/review structural frames, payload enclosures, LRUs, equipment racks, brackets, housings, mounts and mechanisms. 

●        Perform/review structural, static, dynamic, vibration, shock and thermal analyses. 

●        Apply FEA for structural integrity, deformation, modal response, fatigue and optimisation. 

●          Ensure appropriate material selection considering strength, weight, corrosion, environment and manufacturability. 

●          Design ruggedised solutions suitable for airborne, naval, underwater and field-deployed environments. 

●          Ensure mechanical designs consider thermal management, ingress protection, sealing, vibration isolation and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Vendor Management

  

●          Coordinate with external vendors for machining, sheet-metal fabrication, composites, welding, casting, surface treatment and specialised manufacturing. 

●        Prepare technical drawings, manufacturing specifications, SOWs and acceptance criteria. 

●        Evaluate and review vendor designs, manufacturing processes, tooling and first-article components. 

●        Monitor vendor quality, timelines, manufacturing tolerances and delivery. 

●        Lead DFM/DFA activities and optimise designs for production, cost and repeatability. 

●        Support development of fixtures, jigs, assembly tooling and production documentation. 

  

Qualification & Reliability

  

●        Lead structural, environmental, vibration, shock, temperature and mechanical qualification activities. 

●          Experience with applicable defence/aerospace standards such as MIL-STD-810, JSS 55555, RTCA DO-160 or equivalent environmental requirements. 

●        Prepare/review qualification plans, test procedures, compliance matrices and test reports. 

●          Coordinate with certification, inspection and customer quality teams during qualification and acceptance. 

●        Conduct design FMEA, failure analysis and corrective-action activities. 

  

System Integration & Field Trials

  

●          Lead mechanical integration of electronics, sensors, antennas, payloads, power systems and other subsystems. 

●        Ensure interface compliance between mechanical, electrical and system-level assemblies. 

●        Support prototype assembly, system integration, field trials and qualification testing. 

●        Resolve mechanical issues identified during trials and customer acceptance. 

●        Maintain drawings, BOMs, interface documents, design calculations and configuration records. 

  

Mandatory Qualification & Experience

●        B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent discipline. M. Tech preferred. 

●          10+ years of mechanical product/system development experience, preferably in defence or aerospace. 

●        Minimum 3 years leading a mechanical engineering/design team. 

●        Prior experience working on defence/aerospace projects is mandatory. 

●        Strong hands-on mechanical design and engineering analysis capability. 

●        Expertise in 3D CAD and engineering drawings using SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX or equivalent. 

●          Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerance analysis, materials, manufacturing processes and assembly design. 

●        Experience with structural/thermal FEA using ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran or equivalent tools. 

●        Experience taking products from concept through prototype, qualification and production. 

●          Prior involvement in environmental/structural qualification or certification of defence/aerospace equipment. 

●        Experience coordinating outsourced design and manufacturing vendors. 

Technical Knowledge

Candidate should have strong knowledge of: 

  

●        Structural design and load calculations. 

●        Static, dynamic, modal, vibration and shock analysis. 

●        Fatigue and structural reliability. 

●        Thermal management and heat-transfer fundamentals. 

●        Sheet metal, CNC machining, welding, composites, casting and additive manufacturing. 

●        Material selection including aluminium alloys, steels, composites and engineering polymers. 

●        Corrosion protection, coatings and surface-treatment processes. 

●        Environmental sealing, IP-rated enclosure design and ruggedisation. 

●        Lightweight design and structural optimisation. 

●        Mechanical packaging of electronics and avionics equipment. 

  

Preferred Experience

●        Experience with DRDO, HAL, BEL, DPSUs, Indian Armed Forces or defence OEMs. 

●          Mechanical development of UAVs, aerostats, radar systems, underwater platforms, surveillance systems or similar equipment. 

●        Experience with airborne structures, payload mounting systems and ruggedised equipment. 

●        Exposure to underwater pressure housings, watertight enclosures and corrosion-resistant design. 

●        Experience with composite structures and lightweight aerospace design. 

●        Knowledge of configuration management, defence documentation and production quality processes. 

  

Leadership Competencies

●        Strong engineering judgement and design-review capability. 

●        Ability to lead and grow a multidisciplinary mechanical team. 

●        Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability. 

●        Effective vendor management and manufacturing coordination. 

●        Ability to manage multiple programmes and aggressive development schedules. 

●        Strong communication with engineering teams, customers and external partners. 

●        Willingness to travel for manufacturing reviews, integration and field trials. 

  

Critical Selection Criteria: Defence/aerospace project experience, strong mechanical design and analysis capability, team leadership, vendor management and prior qualification/testing experience are mandatory.

data.title: Product Builder
data.description:
Branch Overview

Branch is a leading AI-powered lending fintech with 50M+ downloads across India and Africa. We use alternative data and machine learning to expand financial access for millions of people traditionally excluded from the formal financial system. Founded by the former CEO of Kiva. org and backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, and the IFC, Branch combines mission-driven impact with world-class technology and scale. 

In India, Branch operates as a regulated digital lending institution and Middle Layer NBFC, building trusted and accessible financial products for millions of customers across the country. Our 250+ member India team is growing rapidly and works across technology, data science, risk, product, and operations to solve high-impact problems at scale. 

Certified as a Great Place to Work in 2025, Branch offers the opportunity to build meaningful careers while shaping the future of inclusive fintech in one of the world's fastest-growing digital economies. 

About Lending Lab

Lending Lab is Branch's internal experimentation engine for new lending products. We are a

small, focused team with a single mandate: find the lending products that will catapult Branch to

the next orbit. We run fast experiments, set explicit kill metrics before we start, and shut down what doesn't work without optimism bias. When something works, it gets rebuilt at scale across Branch's full customer base. This is not a place for roadmap management or stakeholder alignment theatre. It is a place to build, learn, and move. 

The Role

This is a 0→1 product role that requires genuine technical depth. You will take lending ideas

from "what if" to the first disbursed loan - and you will build most of it yourself. 

You'll write the spec and the first version of the code. 

There are no handoffs, no backlogs to inherit, and no engineers to delegate to. You are the

engineer, the builder. You will own the full stack of decisions: define the problem, design the

experience, build the prototype, integrate the APIs, run the experiment, and recommend

whether to scale or kill. 

We are not looking for a PM who can dabble in code. We are looking for someone who is

technically strong enough to ship independently - and product-minded enough to know the

experience they want to create. As part of a small focused team, you will help shape the product

ideas and then implement the same. You can assume you will have an army of AI agents if

desired. 

Responsibilities

• Evaluate new lending product ideas: research the market, score the opportunity, and

recommend whether to experiment

• Design borrower experiences end-to-end - flows, screens, edge cases, communication

• Build functional prototypes and MVPs using code, AI-assisted tools, or a combination

• Set success metrics and kill metrics before each experiment starts - and honour them

• Run small-cohort experiments, collect data, and write crisp recommendations

• Own the tooling and integrations needed to disburse, track, and collect for each product

• Work with the Lending Lab Head on experiment prioritisation and portfolio decisions

What We're Looking For

• 1-4 years of experience with a strong technical foundation - you have written

production code and are comfortable owning a full-stack implementation independently

• You have independently built and shipped something - a product, app, tool, or side

project with real users. We will ask to see it. 

• Strong with modern development tools and AI-assisted coding (Cursor, Lovable, or

similar) - you use these to move faster, not as a substitute for engineering depth

• Product instincts to match the technical ability - you can identify a real user problem, 

design the solution, and know when to stop building

• Comfortable integrating third-party APIs, setting up backend logic, and owning the full

borrower journey from frontend to data store

• Comfortable with ambiguity and kill decisions - when data says stop, you stop

• Startup experience strongly preferred - especially if you've been an early engineer, a

founding engineer, or built your own product

• Experience in fintech or lending is a plus, not a requirement

• Based in Bangalore (remote-first, with occasional in-person when needed)

Benefits of Joining

- Competitive salary and equity package
 - Fast-paced, collaborative, and high-autonomy work culture
 - Hybrid work setup designed for flexibility and work-life balance
 - Fully paid group medical insurance and personal accident insurance
 - Generous paid time off, plus company-declared public holidays
 - Fully paid parental leave for fathers and non-birthing parents (12 weeks), in addition to 26 weeks of statutory maternity leave
 - Monthly WFH stipend, along with a one-time home office setup budget
 - $500 annual professional development budget
 - Quarterly social meet-ups and sponsored monthly team lunches

We're looking for more than just qualifications -- if you're unsure that you meet the criteria but identify with our vision of providing equal opportunity to everyone to access financial services, please do not hesitate to apply!

Branch International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company does not and will not discriminate in employment on any basis prohibited by applicable law.

data.title: Lead Engineer II, Surface Product Improvement
data.description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration - and we want you to be part of it. You'll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21, 000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. 

Job Purpose

The Product Improvement Lead is responsible for leading product design improvement activities arising from feedback on field performance, ease of manufacturing, assembly & testing and ease of installation & retrieval of the product. Improvement Lead acts as the focal point in RCA investigations and initiates the necessary corrective & prevention actions. This role is a transformational position with responsibilities to support implementation of new processes, new tools and support improvement activities associated with information flow, risk management, value stream mapping, LPPD behaviors and thinking. In addition to this, the Improvement Lead is expected to drive one or more transformational projects. 

Job Description

- Leads complex problem-solving situations. Defines what problem-solving frameworks, techniques and tools to apply, and when to drive and influence investigations. 
 - Leads and supports product improvement and product standardization and product qualification projects depending upon the assigned group. 
 - Using LPPD and transformational thinking, defines a simplified future state Operating System for Engineering Management and optimum operating processes and tools for engineering staff (GD3, Readiness Levels etc. ) 
 - Uses analytical and risk evaluation tools to expose root causes and defines countermeasures. 
 - Operates with a continuous improvement mindset, remains isolated from firefighting. 
 - Responsible for listening to learn, consults experts where appropriate. 
 - Challenges the norm, rejects the status quo, while educating and inspiring the team to support continuous improvement. 

Additional Description

- Serves as a technical point of contact for assigned work package scope and may serve as a focal point for all communications related to scope. 
 - Develops product design, geometry standards documentation and product qualification requirements. 
 - Creates, reviews/approves part reports, drawings, engineering specifications and standards. 
 - Defines product quality, material, welding, and NDE requirements. 
 - Supports and manage project schedule and deliverables. 
 - Provides Management with technical assistance and work progress updates as requested. 
 - Mentors and provides technical guidance to Product Improvement Engineers and Designers/Drafters. Works collaboratively to accomplish project tasks. Provides independent review and approval of work packages. 
 - Provides vendors technical assistance and builds strong working relationships. 
 - Works to the requirements of industry code related to surface production systems, TechnipFMC standards and client specifications. 
 - Adheres to all relevant work instructions and design guidelines, clearly demonstrates creativity and innovation in finding solutions and alternatives. 
 - Develops unique solutions for complex technical problems that may include the design of new products/systems or the development of solutions having few or no precedents. 
 - This is an individual contributor position. The role is responsible for executing activities assigned by the manager and execute it with the assigned team. 

You Are Meant For This Job If

- Degreed Mechanical Engineer with at least 8-years of Product Design Engineering experience preferably in upstream Oil & Gas industry. 
 - Demonstrated experience in supporting engineering for Oil & Gas projects constrained by safety, quality, delivery, and cost requirements. 
 - Product engineering experience in design of Surface Oil & Gas products like Wellheads, Christmas Trees (XT) Gate Valves, Actuators, Chokes, Ball Valves etc. will be added benefit. 
 - Alternate industry background that are relevant for this position: Heavy Engineering, Power Plant Engineering, Boilers & Pressure Vessels, Large Bore Valve Engineering etc. 
 - Experience in reviewing & approving engineering designs, documents, layouts, calculations and interpreting FEA/ structural analysis results. 
 - Strong knowledge of engineering discipline and physical modeling techniques (solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer) is required. Experience conducting design analysis - hoop stress, flexibility, buckling, burst, fatigue, etc. 
 - Work experience must include experience with various ASME, API and NACE Codes and Standards as it relates to surface equipment design and manufacturing. 
 - Exposure to various manufacturing processes - forging, hot and cold extrusion, cladding, HIP, induction bending etc. 
 - Exposure to welding codes and practices - ASME IX and API 1104. 
 - Exposure to NDE codes and practices - UT, PAUT, PT, RT, MPI per ASME V. 
 - Confidence to work globally, to escalate and to communicate directly with Senior leadership. 
 - Ability to manage the engineering projects within specified schedule and budget. Demonstrated organization and project planning skills. 
 - Accuracy, dependability, ability to manage schedule and prioritize work for self and others in team. 
 - Ability to design complex engineering plans and review design work for systems and products. 

Skills

Problem-solving Tools and Continuous Improvement Techniques

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture. 

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

Master Data Quality Manager
data.description:
Company Description DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide. 

Role Description

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation. The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained. 

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose. 

Key responsibilities

1. Data quality monitoring

- Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data. 
 - Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards. 
 - Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions. 
 - Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records. 
 - Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes. 
 - Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement. 

2. Data Cleansing and Remediation

- Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets. 
 - Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies. 
 - Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information. 
 - Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures. 
 - Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status. 
 - Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner. 

3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding

- Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data. 
 - Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment. 
 - Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data. 
 - Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements. 
 - Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions. 
 - Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information. 

4. Data governance and standardization

- Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data. 
 - Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained. 
 - Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality. 
 - Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures. 
 - Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams. 
 - Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation. 

5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support

- Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information. 
 - Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues. 
 - Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records. 
 - Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices. 

6. Reporting and continuous improvement

- Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress. 
 - Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action. 
 - Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes. 
 - Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation. 

Qualifications

- Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline. 
 - Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment. 
 - Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented. 
 - Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records. 
 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically. 
 - Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues. 
 - Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. 
 - Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions. 
 - A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products. 
 - Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases.

This is a senior technical lead role that pairs deep platform engineering expertise with the thought leadership needed to bring AI into production operations. The person owns the build, hardening, patching, and lifecycle of the operating system and platform estate, and serves as the top escalation point for complex incidents - while simultaneously identifying where AI and automation can replace manual toil, reduce incident volume, and shorten recovery times. Success depends as much on change leadership as on engineering: shaping standards, winning stakeholder buy-in, and guiding 1st line operations through new AI-enabled ways of working without disrupting service levels. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform engineering depth - packaging and hardening approved OS builds, management agent stacks, patch currency, and configuration standards across the estate
 - AI-driven operations innovation - identifying, piloting, and scaling AI/automation use cases for incident triage, root cause analysis, runbook execution, and predictive monitoring
 - Thought leadership and evangelism - articulating an AI-for-operations vision, authoring white papers and R&D positions, staying ahead of emerging tooling
 - Change management and adoption - driving organizational uptake of new practices, coaching 1st line teams, managing risk and resistance while protecting SLAs
 - Incident, problem, and change discipline - major incident leadership, RCA, and rigorous change control in a regulated production environment
 - Service improvement measurement - instrumenting and evidencing reductions in incident volume and MTTR from process redesign and automation
 - Solution design and implementation planning - translating requirements into physical builds, costed designs, and multi-workstream delivery plans
 - Automation and infrastructure-as-code fluency - scripting, configuration management, and pipeline-driven platform delivery
 - Standards, compliance, and documentation - run books, technical policies, and AI governance/guardrails to document-control standards
 - Cross-functional influence - partnering with architecture, security, development, vendors, and the business to land change. 

Required Qualifications

- Provides a high level of technical and subject matter expertise in one or more technologies and serves as a point of escalation for technical issues related to specialty. 
 - Produces, delivers, and maintains appropriate documentation for systems in accordance document control standards and procedures.

 - Contributes to the definition and implementation of improved operability on new and current systems.

 - Reviews and coordinates the implementation of proposed modifications, and changes to the production environment. 
 - Provides direction into standards and procedures for monitoring, capacity planning, tuning, maintenance, performance optimization, backups and recovery; ensures infrastructure will meet capacity requirements to deliver projects on time. 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Participates in the technical design process as it relates to database implementations, reviews technical documents, and communicates any risks or issues using the appropriate escalation procedures.

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

Role Description

Information Security Engineer Role

Overview

We are seeking a talented and experienced Security Engineer with a strong focus on Python and security automation to join our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be adept at developing and implementing automated security solutions to protect our systems and data, as well as reviewing, validating, and hardening code and workflows produced by AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) and agentic systems. This role requires a proactive individual who can work independently and collaboratively to enhance our security posture in an environment where both humans and AI agents write and operate code. In addition, proficiency and experience using a SOAR for automation and security incident response is required. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain security automation scripts and tools using Python to a high standard of reliability and efficiency, including reviewing and hardening code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Integrate security tools and solutions, including developing and managing APIs, to automate security processes and workflows. 

Conduct security assessments and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential threats. 

Monitor security systems and respond to incidents with automated solutions, implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Tines, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect) to streamline response activities. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement security controls, and write clear technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for tools and processes. 

Govern enterprise use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including tenant restrictions, access scoping, and compliance/audit logging. 

Design and enforce security controls for agentic AI systems, including tool-permission boundaries, prompt injection defenses, and agent identity/access governance. 

Utilise Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for threat detection and Kusto Query Language (KQL) to analyse security data. 

Implement CI/CD pipeline automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) to ensure secure code deployment and infrastructure provisioning. 

Skills And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field. 

Proven experience as a Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on Python and security automation. 

Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing automation scripts and tools, as well as reviewing and validating code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability scanners. 

Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes). 

Experience with API development and integration, including RESTful APIs. 

Proficiency in implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect). 

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for endpoint security. 

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication, including writing technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience securing AI/LLM-based agentic systems, including prompt injection defense, tool-permission boundaries, and agent identity governance. 

Experience governing enterprise AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), including compliance/audit logging, tenant restrictions, and CI/CD supply-chain hardening against AI-related risks. 

Desirable

Proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) for querying and analysing security data. 

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, or GIAC. 

Experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). 

Understanding of network protocols and security architecture. 

Familiarity with the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e. g. , tool misuse, agentic supply-chain risk, unexpected code execution, human-agent trust exploitation). 

Experience with AI red-teaming and evaluation methodologies for agentic and LLM-based systems. 

Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) security and other agent-tool integration risks. 

Skills

AI Security, Python, Cloud Security, IDS/IPS, LLMs, Vulnerability Assessment, SOAR, Container Security, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

data.title: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation
data.description:
Company: Upstox

Location: Bengaluru

Work arrangement: 5 days in the office

Function: Insurance - B2B Sales (SDR / Lead Generation team)

About Upstox

At Upstox, we're building the future of investing - simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We're not just moving fast - we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you're in the right place. 

The Role: Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you'll own the top of this funnel - building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month. 

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you'll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you. 

What You'll Own

Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management

- Lead management framework: Design and own the end-to-end framework - sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads. 
 - Ideal customer profile: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data. 
 - Outreach playbooks: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events. 
 - Renewal-cycle planning: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates. 

Target Account List Building

- Target list: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership. 
 - Research & data tools: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data. 
 - Data hygiene & prioritisation: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert. 

Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team

- Qualified pipeline: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month. 
 - Monthly targets: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals. 
 - Feedback loop: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly. 

Team Leadership & Motivation

- Hiring & training: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e. g. , Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life). 
 - Targets & reviews: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards. 
 - Coaching & culture: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture. 

Individual Contribution

- Personal target: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - CXO outreach: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team. 
 - Lead from the front: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate. 

Tools, Reporting & Analytics

- Lead management stack: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team. 
 - Dashboards & MIS: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement. 
 - Data-led allocation: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaboration: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering. 

How Success Is Measured

- Qualified leads delivered: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target. 
 - Meetings held: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker. 
 - Funnel conversion: Lead → meeting → proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel. 
 - Team productivity: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week. 
 - Self-outreach target: The Manager's personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - Data quality: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records. 

Who You Are

- 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets. 
 - Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover. 
 - Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools - CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms. 
 - Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly. 
 - Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team. 
 - Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS. 
 - Excellent communication skills. 
 - Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru. 

Good to have

- Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e. g. , HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS). 
 - Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment. 
 - Graduate degree; MBA preferred. 

Why This Role Rocks

- You'll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms. 
 - You'll have high ownership and visibility - your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business. 
 - You'll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs. 
 - You'll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product. 
 - Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families. 

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice. 

Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

data.title: Manager Account Analytics
data.description:
Overview

About Business Unit: 

Powerful predictors of the future - our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive. 

How You'll Make An Impact

The Manager, Account Analytics Development is a hands-on technical leader. You will personally design and build the most technically demanding parts of our AI capability, and you will hire and develop the engineer who works alongside you. This is a small, senior team - today a VP and a Lead. You will be the third member, and the first person you hire will report to you. 

We already run AI agents in production that generate analyst-grade SQL against our analytics environment. That foundation works. What comes next is harder, and it is the reason this role exists. 

What You'll Build

Interpretation. Systems that take the output of an analysis and produce business-relevant interpretation - what the numbers mean for this client, in this category, given what we know about their objectives. This is the distance between a query result and an insight, and closing it requires reasoning, not summarization. 

Client knowledge. A knowledge system that accumulates and organizes what the organization understands about each client: their business, their category, their measurement history, and Epsilon's relationship with them. It has to serve both people and agents, and it has to compound with use rather than decay into a stale wiki. 

Media investment planning. Analytical tooling that supports budget allocation and media investment planning - putting scenario and optimization capability directly in the hands of client teams. 

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 

Responsibilities

Architecture and Systems Design

- Own the architecture of our AI capability: how agents are scoped, how they compose, and where the boundaries sit between tools, context, and model reasoning. 
 - Design evaluation before you design the solution. Define how we will know an agent is correct, how we detect regression in a non-deterministic system, and where human review belongs in the loop. 
 - Establish the engineering standards - source control, testing, documentation, deployment - that let a three-person team ship reliably today and a larger team ship reliably later. 

Hands-On Delivery

- Write production code. 
 - Prototype quickly to resolve technical uncertainty, then make the explicit call about what graduates into a supported system and what gets discarded. 
 - Take personal ownership of the components carrying the highest technical risk rather than delegating them. 

Team Leadership

- Hire, onboard, and develop your first direct report at senior engineer level. 
 - Set technical direction and raise the quality bar through design review and code review. 
 - Absorb technical scope currently carried by the VP and become a person the wider analytics organization brings its hardest problems to. 
 - Promote engineering discipline, documentation, code quality, and knowledge sharing across the team. 

Business Partnership

- Work directly with analytics leads and client teams, most of whom are US-based, to find where automation and AI create real leverage - and where they do not. 
 - Translate loosely specified business problems into system designs, and explain those designs credibly to non-technical partners. 
 - Balance experimentation against the reality that these tools enter client-facing workflows and have to keep working. 
 - Your work will be evaluated by the level of usage and adoption by the rest of the Analytics team and the ability of the tools you and the team develop to drive greater efficiency and insights

Qualifications

- 8+ years building software or data products, including leading technical design on complex, ambiguous projects. 
 - Strong Python and advanced SQL. You are comfortable both in a substantial codebase and in an analytical data warehouse. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping LLM-based systems in production - agents, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs - not prototypes or prompt experimentation alone. 
 - Systems thinking. You can take an ambiguous capability such as "interpret this analysis" and decompose it into components, interfaces, and failure modes, then explain why you drew the boundaries where you did. 
 - A considered point of view on evaluating non-deterministic systems, and practical experience applying it. 
 - Working familiarity with marketing measurement - attribution, incrementality, media mix modeling, campaign performance - sufficient to judge whether an automated interpretation is analytically sound. You will not be building measurement models; you will be building systems that reason about their output. 
 - Experience mentoring or leading engineers, whether or not you have held a formal management title. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. 

Additional Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Preferred Technical Experience

- Agentic development environments - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar - used as a daily working tool rather than tried once. 
 - Databricks, Greenplum or PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or comparable analytical platforms. 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined code review practice. 
 - Building knowledge management or retrieval systems that stay accurate as they grow. 
 - Integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Marketing analytics, media, or adtech background. 
 - Working with data under client confidentiality and governance constraints. 

How You Work

- You are opinionated about design and you change your mind when the evidence says to. 
 - You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and equally comfortable being wrong in it. 
 - You would rather ship something useful and imperfect than design something elegant that never lands.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. data.description:
Role: Engineering Manager

Function: Engineering / Technology Leadership

Location: Bangalore, India (Embassy TechVillage)

Type: Full-time

Industry: Market Research, Data & Insights, Technology

About Company

The company is a data-driven marketing research firm with over 25 years of experience. It operates one of the world's largest consumer research networks, with 130 million+ global panelists. 

The company serves approximately 2, 500 domestic and 1, 500 overseas clients across Asia-Pacific. It integrates survey, digital behavioral, and daily purchase data to deliver comprehensive insights. 

Backed by ~$848M in funding, it is currently in a merger stage. The culture is built on deep thinking, transparency, swift collective action, and ownership. 

Position Overview

This role leads a product engineering team within the company's Global Technology Department. The Engineering Manager is responsible for technical direction, delivery quality, and production reliability across a modern cloud-native stack. The role bridges deep technical engagement with people leadership - setting engineering standards, driving architectural decisions, and building a team that independently owns and delivers outcomes. Close collaboration with product, design, and Japan-based stakeholders is required to align engineering execution with business priorities across geographies. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Own the team's technical direction and delivery outcomes, ensuring engineering decisions support product goals, maintainability, scalability, and reliability
 - Lead architecture and system design discussions, evaluate technical trade-offs, and guide implementation decisions for complex or ambiguous problems
 - Stay technically engaged through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, and hands-on contribution when necessary to resolve critical issues or unblock the team
 - Take end-to-end accountability for delivery, engineering quality, production reliability, and technical risks - establish clear priorities, address blockers, and ensure commitments are managed transparently
 - Partner with product managers, designers, platform teams, and Japan-based stakeholders to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, and align on scope, priorities, and trade-offs
 - Build a team of engineers who can independently own problems and deliver solutions through effective delegation, technical guidance, mentoring, and constructive feedback
 - Establish high engineering standards across testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and production operations, driving continuous improvement in quality and reliability
 - Drive effective adoption of AI-assisted development tools and workflows, improving engineering productivity while maintaining accountability for code quality, security, and production outcomes
 - Support hiring, performance management, and engineer development to build a strong, accountable, and high-performing engineering team

Must Have Criteria

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams as an Engineering Manager or equivalent technical leadership role
 - Strong technical foundation in software development, architecture, and system design, with the ability to evaluate implementation details and challenge technical decisions
 - Demonstrated experience owning technical direction and making sound engineering decisions for production systems
 - Proven ability to take end-to-end accountability for delivery, balancing scope, speed, engineering quality, reliability, and long-term technical health
 - Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, production operations, and incident management
 - Experience identifying technical risks, resolving complex problems, and removing blockers to enable independent and effective team delivery
 - Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills: partnering with product and design, challenging assumptions constructively, and aligning geographically distributed teams including Japan-based stakeholders
 - Proven ability to mentor engineers, delegate effectively, and develop technical ownership and decision-making capabilities within the team

Nice to Have

- Experience with cloud-native systems, microservices, and distributed systems

- Define the enterprise roadmap for autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and intelligent workflow orchestration.

- Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows.

 - Write clean, readable and testable code that follows SOLID principles and team coding standards. Refactor older code when needed and keep technical debt under control. 
 - Implement business logic for multi-step calculations such as rates, slabs, percentages, fees, rebates and penalties. Make sure every result is accurate, repeatable and easy to trace. 
 - Implement double-entry postings, map each transaction to the correct finance/account codes, and handle reversals, refunds and adjustments without breaking ledger balances. 
 - Write and optimise complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and reports. Design tables and indexes that keep data consistent and queries fast as volume grows. 
 - Write unit and integration tests for all business logic, with extra focus on calculation edge cases and boundary values. Keep test coverage high so changes can be released with confidence. 
 - Investigate and fix production issues, including calculation or data mismatches. Do root-cause analysis and put permanent fixes in place, not just workarounds. 
 - Take part in code reviews, sprint planning and technical discussions. Work closely with QA, business analysts and finance teams to clarify rules and confirm expected results. Required skills and experience

- 4-8 years of hands-on Java development (Java 11 or later; Java 17 preferred), with at least 2 years on enterprise or transaction-heavy applications. 
 - Strong command of OOP concepts, Collections, Generics, Multithreading and concurrency utilities, Exception Handling, Streams and Lambdas. Able to explain why one approach is better than another, not just use it. 
 - Solid experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and Spring Security. Understands dependency injection, bean lifecycle, profiles and configuration management. 
 - Has built and consumed RESTful services, including authentication (JWT/OAuth2), validation, pagination and global exception handling. Has integrated with third-party APIs such as payment gateways or banks. 
 - Strong SQL on PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL - complex joins, subqueries, window functions, indexing, stored procedures and query tuning using execution plans. 
 - Clear understanding of ACID, isolation levels, optimistic and pessimistic locking, and idempotency. Knows how to prevent duplicate entries and race conditions in multi-user systems. 
 - Uses BigDecimal correctly for money, with defined scale and rounding modes. Knows why double/float must not be used for financial values. 
 - Understands ledgers, journal entries, debits and credits, chart of accounts and finance code structures. Can translate a finance rule into correct and testable code. 
 - Writes unit tests with JUnit 5 and Mockito, and integration tests for APIs and database layers. Comfortable with test-driven thinking for logic-heavy code. 
 - Comfortable with Git branching, Maven or Gradle, Jenkins or other CI/CD tools, and basic Linux commands for deployment and log checks.

data.title: SENIOR/ STAFF / PRINCIPAL ENGINEER — NAND SILICON DESIGN VALIDATION (SDV)
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

ROLE

Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration. 

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams. 

Responsibilities

- Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent. 
 - Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions. 
 - Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features. 
 - Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions.

Required Qualifications

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level.

 - Mixed-signal verification
 - Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
 - Post-silicon validation and characterization
 - Memory validation
 - Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations. 
 - Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments. 
 - Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results. 
 - Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with 12+ years of Salesforce experience to own the overall Salesforce solution architecture and technical direction for an enterprise client. The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, high-performing Salesforce solutions aligned with business objectives while providing technical leadership to development, integration, and delivery teams. 

The ideal candidate will combine hands-on Salesforce development expertise with enterprise architecture, solution design, and stakeholder management capabilities. Strong experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, enterprise integrations, Salesforce AI capabilities, and large-scale implementations is essential. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Salesforce Solution Architecture

 - Lead solution design and architecture for complex Salesforce implementations, enhancements, integrations, and transformation initiatives. 
 - Make architectural decisions related to Salesforce data models, integrations, security, automation, custom development, APIs, and platform capabilities. 
 - Identify technical risks, scalability concerns, architectural gaps, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Ensure architecture decisions follow Salesforce best practices and enterprise architecture standards. 

2. Salesforce Development & Technical Leadership

- Maintain hands-on involvement in Salesforce development using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Flows, Salesforce APIs, and integrations. 
 - Provide technical direction to developers, technical leads, integration teams, and Salesforce professionals. 
 - Review technical designs, code, integrations, and implementation approaches. 
 - Guide teams in developing scalable, secure, maintainable, and high-performing Salesforce solutions. 
 - Resolve complex technical challenges and recommend appropriate architectural solutions. 

3. Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture

- Design and oversee integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications, middleware, external systems, and third-party platforms. 
 - Define integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, middleware, and other enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Establish appropriate data architecture, data flows, synchronization mechanisms, and integration standards. 
 - Ensure secure and reliable data exchange across enterprise applications. 
 - Address Salesforce governor limits, data volumes, performance bottlenecks, and integration scalability. 

4. Salesforce Platform & Cloud Solutions

- Lead solution design across Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. 
 - Evaluate and apply Revenue Cloud, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Experience Cloud, and Data Cloud where relevant to business requirements. 
 - Drive adoption of modern Salesforce capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein AI, and other emerging Salesforce technologies. 
 - Assess platform capabilities and recommend appropriate standard, declarative, or custom development approaches. 
 - Ensure solutions leverage Salesforce capabilities effectively while minimizing unnecessary complexity. 

5. Security, Performance & Governance

- Define Salesforce security architecture, sharing models, access controls, and data protection practices. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise security, governance, and architecture standards. 
 - Review system performance, scalability, governor limits, and technical debt. 
 - Establish architectural guidelines and technical standards for development and integrations. 
 - Promote maintainable solutions that support future enhancements and enterprise growth. 

6. Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

- Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and senior leadership to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Lead architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, solutioning discussions, and estimation activities. 
 - Support solution proposals and communicate architectural recommendations to enterprise clients. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders. 
 - Explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

7. Delivery Governance & Team Collaboration

- Collaborate with delivery and program leadership to ensure architecture decisions support project objectives and successful delivery. 
 - Work with development, integration, QA, DevOps, and business teams throughout the implementation lifecycle. 
 - Support technical planning, design reviews, code reviews, release planning, and implementation governance. 
 - Promote engineering excellence, Salesforce best practices, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure technical decisions align with enterprise delivery standards and long-term business goals. 

Required Technical Skills & Competencies

- 12+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, with significant experience in Salesforce architecture and enterprise implementations.

 - Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. 
 - Hands-on development knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Flows, Salesforce APIs, and integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce security, sharing models, data architecture, integration architecture, governor limits, scalability, and performance optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agentforce and Salesforce AI capabilities. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, event-driven architecture, and external system integrations. 
 - Experience making architectural decisions and translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Strong solution design, technical problem-solving, and architectural decision-making capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to lead architecture discussions with senior business and technology stakeholders. 
 - Salesforce Architect-level certification(s) required. 

Must-Have Skills

 - Apex

 - Salesforce APIs and Integrations 
 - Salesforce Administration Fundamentals

 - Scalability & Performance Optimization

Good to Have Skills

Desired Attributes
