The company provides end-to-end civil, mechanical, and electrical EPC solutions, covering land acquisition, wind resource assessment, foundations, logistics, turbine erection, electrical integration, and commissioning. With a proven track record of 20 GW+ wind turbine installations, extensive electrical transmission line execution, and strong infrastructure support from Sanghvi Movers' crane and trailer fleet, Sangreen ensures safe, high-quality, and timely project delivery. The organization is certified in ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001: 2015, and ISO 45001: 2018, and maintains a robust QHSE culture focused on zero accidents. Sangreen's vision is to delight the world through sustainable, scalable engineering solutions that foster innovation, empower communities, and positively impact the environment. 

1. JOB DETAILS

Job Title:   Manager - Process Excellence

Department / Business Unit:   Process Excellence / Business Excellence

Location:   Head Office / Project Sites, as required

Employment Type:   Full-time, Permanent

Experience Required:   5 to 7 years of relevant experience

Industry:   EPC / Infrastructure

Travel Requirement:   Travel to project sites and operating locations, as required

2. JOB PURPOSE

The Manager - Process Excellence is responsible for identifying operational problem areas, conducting structured root cause analysis and designing practical solutions that improve process effectiveness across the  organisation. The role facilitates development and implementation of operational processes at the Head Office and project sites, secures stakeholder alignment, monitors compliance, conducts regular audits and supports long-term process sustenance. 

3. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Problem Identification & Root Cause Analysis

•  Identify operational problem areas and opportunities for process improvement across functions and project locations. 

•  Conduct structured root cause analysis and define clear problem statements. 

•  Evaluate process gaps, recurring issues and barriers affecting operational flow and execution. 

Solution Design & Stakeholder Alignment

•  Design practical process solutions based on the identified problem statement and root causes. 

•  Develop detailed solution elements, operating requirements and implementation actions. 

•  Obtain buy-in from key stakeholders and align affected teams on the proposed solution. 

•  Coordinate with operational teams to incorporate functional and site-level inputs into process design. 

Process Development & Implementation

•  Facilitate the development of operational processes with inputs from relevant operational teams. 

•  Guide the establishment and implementation of processes at the Head Office and project sites. 

•  Define appropriate issue-escalation mechanisms to support timely resolution at the required  organisational  level. 

•  Support the transition of approved solutions into regular operating practices. 

Governance & Leadership Reviews

•  Conduct fortnightly and monthly steering committee meetings with leadership. 

•  Present initiative status, key issues, risks, decisions required and implementation progress. 

•  Align  organisational  efforts and stakeholder actions towards approved process-excellence initiatives. 

•  Track agreed actions and facilitate timely follow-up and closure. 

Process Compliance & Sustenance

•  Ensure compliance with agreed processes by relevant stakeholders.

data.title: QA/QC ENGINEER LECTRONICS
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India's first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. 

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don't just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you'll be fuelling the future of space exploration. 

JOB SUMMARY: 

We are looking for a passionate QA/QC Engineer - Electronics to drive engineering excellence and maintain uncompromising quality standards across the entire satellite lifecycle. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Production, and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) teams, owning quality assurance, reliability analysis, and compliance protocols for advanced satellite electronics and hardware. 

You will own the verification of space-grade components, lead root cause analyses, and ensure our systems perform reliably in the harshest orbital environments. If you are driven by precision, technical rigor, and the thrill of space exploration, this is your opportunity to put your stamp on history. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Quality Assurance Leadership: Develop and implement robust QA plans, procedures, and inspection standards aligned with ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD, and industry best practices. 
 - Design Phase Integration: Partner with cross-functional teams during System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR) to bake quality into every phase of design. 
 - Reliability & Circuit Analysis: Perform network analysis, derating analysis, worst-case analysis, FMEA, FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) studies to identify and mitigate design vulnerabilities. 
 - AIT & Environmental Compliance: Review and validate environmental qualification test results-including Thermal, Vibration, EMI/EMC, and Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing-and verify compliance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP). 
 - Audit & Configuration Control: Conduct internal and supplier quality audits while maintaining end-to-end component traceability, configuration management, and documentation control. 
 - Non-Conformance Management: Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and drive continuous quality improvement across electronic manufacturing. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent. 
 - Experience: 2+ years of hands-on Quality Assurance (QA/QC) experience within Aerospace, Space, Satellite, Defence, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Reliability Systems. 
 - Standards & Compliance: Strong knowledge of ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD-883, IPC-A-610, and quality management principles. 
 - Technical Expertise: Practical background in supporting satellite electronics, avionics, power electronics, on-board computers, RF systems, or payloads, alongside circuit derating and worst-case analysis skills. 
 - Methodologies: Familiarity with FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCA, CAPA, and reliability engineering frameworks. 
 - Core Competencies: Exceptional analytical thinking, rigorous documentation discipline, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on experience in Satellite Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT) quality processes. 
 - Familiarity with cleanroom operations, contamination control, and ESD-safe handling practices. 
 - Experience with satellite subsystems such as Reaction Wheels, Battery Systems, EPS, CDH, PCU, and RF Payloads. 
 - Certifications or working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt). 

WHY JOIN US?

- Pioneering Impact: Work at the vanguard of India's private space revolution, contributing directly to hardware that reaches orbit. 
 - End-to-End Exposure: Gain comprehensive visibility across the entire satellite lifecycle, from initial design reviews to final environmental testing and launch readiness. 
 - Innovation Culture: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of brilliant aerospace engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth, mission-driven environment. 
 - Career Growth: Scale your expertise alongside state-of-the-art satellite mass-production infrastructure and global projects.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Automation Engineer - Python based in India. 

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of Python-based applications and services. You will design, develop, and execute automated and manual testing strategies to identify defects early and deliver dependable software solutions. Working closely with developers, product teams, and other stakeholders, you will validate application functionality, test APIs and web applications, and strengthen overall test coverage. You will use Python and Pytest to build and maintain automated test suites while applying your knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, and software development lifecycles. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to continuous quality improvement within a collaborative, technology-driven environment. You will also help optimize testing processes, communicate quality risks, and ensure that software releases meet established functional and technical standards. 

Accountabilities

- Test Planning and Strategy: Analyze business and technical requirements to define test scenarios, prepare test plans, establish testing strategies, and determine appropriate testing coverage. 
 - Test Automation: Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Python and Pytest to validate application functionality, reliability, and expected behavior. 
 - Manual and Functional Testing: Perform manual, functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing to identify defects and verify that applications meet specified requirements. 
 - API Testing: Test REST APIs and backend services to validate endpoints, request and response structures, data integrity, error handling, and integration behavior. 
 - Web Application Testing: Validate web application workflows, user interactions, business logic, and cross-component functionality to ensure a consistent and reliable user experience. 
 - Database Validation: Write and execute SQL queries to verify database records, validate data consistency, and investigate discrepancies between expected and actual results. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects with clear steps, supporting evidence, and expected versus actual outcomes; collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolution. 
 - Regression Testing: Build and maintain reusable regression test suites, verify bug fixes, and ensure that new features and code changes do not negatively affect existing functionality. 
 - QA Documentation and Reporting: Maintain comprehensive test cases, test plans, test strategies, execution reports, defect logs, and quality documentation. 
 - SDLC/STLC Compliance: Apply established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) practices throughout the development and release process. 
 - Version Control and Collaboration: Use Git and related development workflows to manage test automation code and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. 
 - Quality Reviews: Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and requirement reviews from a quality assurance perspective, identifying potential risks and recommending improvements. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance automation coverage, testing efficiency, defect prevention, and QA processes through best practices and appropriate tools. 
 - Stakeholder Communication: Communicate test results, defect trends, release readiness, quality risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Cross-Functional Delivery: Work closely with developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to support timely releases and ensure that software meets quality expectations. 

Requirements

- At least 4 years of professional experience in quality assurance and test automation, preferably involving Python-based applications and services. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, with mandatory hands-on experience using Pytest for automated testing. 
 - Solid understanding of manual testing, automation testing, functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and test execution methodologies. 
 - Experience preparing and maintaining test cases, test plans, test strategies, test reports, and other QA documentation. 
 - Practical experience testing REST APIs and web applications, including validating API requests, responses, data flows, and error scenarios. 
 - Good understanding of REST API principles, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication mechanisms, and API validation techniques. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge, including the ability to write queries and validate database records, data integrity, and application outputs. 
 - Understanding of SDLC and STLC processes, software testing methodologies, defect life cycles, and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Familiarity with Git or other version control systems for managing automation scripts and collaborating with development teams. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and the capacity to identify complex defects and edge cases. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document defects clearly and communicate testing outcomes to stakeholders. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, manage priorities, and contribute to quality-focused software delivery. 
 - A proactive mindset and willingness to continuously improve automation frameworks, testing coverage, and development processes. 

Good-to-have Qualifications

- Familiarity with AWS services and cloud-based application environments. 
 - Experience using Jira or similar tools for issue tracking, test management, and project collaboration. 
 - Previous experience in the healthcare or pharmaceutical domain, including an understanding of relevant application workflows and quality expectations. 
 - Exposure to applications powered by large language models (LLMs), including experience validating AI-generated outputs, response consistency, reliability, and edge cases. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into continuous integration and deployment workflows. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. 

Must have skills : Salesforce Lightning Web Components

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves creating tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. The role requires working with contemporary development frameworks and following agile methodologies to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient software that meets unique business requirements. Collaboration with team members and adapting to evolving project needs are integral parts of the daily workflow, fostering continuous improvement and innovation in software development. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Expected to perform independently and become an SME. 
 - Required active participation/contribution in team discussions. 
 - Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Maintain and enhance existing software components to improve performance and user experience. 
 - Document development processes and code changes to ensure knowledge sharing and maintainability. 
 - Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support to foster their professional growth.

- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Salesforce Lightning Web Components. 
 - Experience with JavaScript frameworks and component-based architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of front-end development principles and responsive design. 
 - Familiarity with version control systems and collaborative development workflows. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug complex software issues efficiently. 
 - Knowledge of integrating APIs and working with backend services. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Salesforce Lightning Web Components. 
 - This position is based at our INDC1A - NON-STPI location. 
 - A 15 years full time education is required.

data.title: SMTS (Backend Engineer)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an SMTS (Backend Engineer) based in India. 

As an SMTS (Backend Engineer), you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of cloud-native software products that power modern private cloud infrastructure. You will work on innovative technologies that help enterprises simplify IT operations and transform existing hardware into scalable, reliable, and future-ready cloud environments. Collaborating with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams, you will help shape product roadmaps, develop robust backend services, and solve complex infrastructure challenges. You will play an important role in improving system performance, scalability, and reliability while supporting deployments and troubleshooting production issues. This position offers the opportunity to work with cloud-native architectures, virtualization technologies, and modern infrastructure platforms in a dynamic, data-driven environment. If you enjoy solving challenging engineering problems, taking ownership of your work, and continuously learning new technologies, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful technical impact. 

Accountabilities

- Contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of cloud-native products, backend services, and infrastructure software. 
 - Collaborate with engineering team members and relevant stakeholders to define technical solutions and implement product roadmap initiatives. 
 - Develop reliable, efficient, and maintainable software using programming languages such as Python or Golang. 
 - Support cloud infrastructure deployments using private cloud products, diagnosing technical issues and implementing effective solutions. 
 - Monitor and continuously improve product performance, scalability, availability, and overall system reliability. 
 - Investigate complex backend and infrastructure problems, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement long-term corrective measures. 
 - Work with Linux/Unix systems, networking technologies, storage infrastructure, and virtualization environments to develop and optimize cloud-native solutions. 
 - Contribute to engineering best practices, code quality, technical documentation, and collaborative problem-solving. 
 - Explore and adopt emerging technologies and engineering approaches to improve product capabilities and operational efficiency. 
 - Take ownership of assigned projects and technical deliverables, ensuring solutions align with product requirements, quality standards, and business objectives. 

Requirements

- A bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5-8 years of professional experience in software development, backend engineering, or a related engineering role. 
 - Proficiency in Python or Golang, with the ability to develop, debug, and maintain production-quality software. 
 - Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems, including system-level troubleshooting and performance analysis. 
 - Experience or solid technical exposure to networking protocols, networking infrastructure, or storage systems. 
 - Understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, virtualization technologies, and infrastructure software. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to investigate and resolve complex technical challenges. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams. 
 - A proactive, self-motivated approach, adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies. 
 - A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality software in a data-driven organization. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes, or cloud platforms and development environments such as OpenStack and DevStack, is an advantage. 
 - Experience with the Linux networking stack, identity and access management (IAM), kernel modules, or device drivers is a plus. 

Benefits

- Remote work opportunity, with preferred locations including Bengaluru, Pune, Noida, and Hyderabad, India. 
 - Full-time employment offering the opportunity to contribute to impactful cloud infrastructure products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native technologies, private cloud platforms, virtualization, networking, and distributed systems. 
 - Opportunities to tackle challenging backend engineering problems and contribute to the evolution of enterprise infrastructure solutions. 
 - Collaboration with experienced engineering professionals in a technically driven and innovative environment. 
 - Opportunities for continuous learning, technical development, and exposure to emerging technologies. 
 - The opportunity to take ownership of engineering initiatives and influence product performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Salary and additional benefits: Specific compensation, healthcare coverage, paid leave, and other benefits were not specified in the provided job description and can be clarified during the recruitment process. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Enterprise Technology Team as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. 

Job Responsibilities

- Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
 - Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
 - Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e. g. , code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 
 - Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
 - Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
 - Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
 - Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
 - Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
 - Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e. g. , for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. 
 - Proficiency in Java and Python, with experience building microservices-based applications; willingness to learn and adopt new technologies as needed. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure), distributed systems, and web technologies including RESTful APIs, web services, WebSockets, and JSON. 
 - Working knowledge of OAuth 2. 0 / OpenID Connect concepts and secure API access patterns, including token lifecycle and validation
 - Develop and operate microservices and APIs (REST/Web services, WebSockets, JSON) with strong SDLC discipline (testing, code reviews, automation, observability). 
 - Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
 - Exposure to cloud technologies

data.title: Quality and System Engineer
data.description:
Are you a talent looking to build business skills, gain experience, and take on exciting challenges? Grow your career with Trelleborg and start shaping the industry from the inside. 

Who are we?

Trelleborg Industrial Solutions (TIS) is a global leader in innovative polymer-based solutions for key industries and critical infrastructure. We are one of three Business Areas within the Trelleborg Group, with a total of about 6 200 employees around the world. 

Trelleborg Marine & Infrastructure are committed to advancing operational performance in marine, port and built infrastructure, empowering our clients to succeed at the highest level. 

About the Role: 

About the role: 

The Quality & BMS Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining and continuously improving Trelleborg Marine System's Business Management System (BMS) or Integrated Management System (IMS) and QMS (Quality Management Systems). The role ensures compliance with ISO 9001, stakeholder requirements, legal obligations, and Group standards through effective governance, audits, risk management, document control, and continuous improvement initiatives. The position is primarily focused on management systems and documentation rather than operational quality control activities. 

Roles and responsibilities: 

BMS or IMS Management

- Implementation of BMS/IMS as per internal stakeholder requirements
 - Maintain and improve the BMS/IMS in line with project management requirements. 
 - Manage policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, and records. 
 - Ensure effective document control, version management, and record retention. 
 - Drive process standardization and system compliance across the business. QMS Management

- Implementation of QMS as per business needs and ISO 9001 guidelines. 
 - Maintain and continuously improve the QMS in line with project and business requirements. 
 - Manage policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, and records. 
 - Ensure effective document control, version management, and record retention. 
 - Drive process standardization, compliance, and continual improvement across the business  Governance & Performance

- Coordinate Management Review meetings and track actions. 
 - Monitor quality objectives, KPIs, and process performance. 
 - Prepare management reports on quality, compliance, audits, risks, and improvements. Audits, Compliance & Risk

- Develop and manage the internal audit program. 
 - Coordinate external certification, customer, and supplier audits. 
 - Track corrective actions and verify effective closure. 
 - Maintain risk, compliance, and legal obligation registers. Documentation & Continuous Improvement

- Act as custodian of the company's management system documentation. 
 - Support departments in developing and updating procedures and work instructions. 
 - Facilitate root cause analysis, CAPA, and continuous improvement initiatives. Training & Awareness

- Deliver BMS/IMS training and promote compliance awareness. 
 - Support competency management and training record maintenance. Education and Qualifications

- Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in, Business Management Systems (BMS)/Integrated Management Systems (IMS), Quality Management Systems and Compliance and Governance
 - Demonstrated experience managing and improving ISO 9001 compliant management systems. 
 - Experience with third-party project management tools such as Monday. com, Jira, or other globally recognized platforms
 - Proven experience coordinating internal (multidisciplinary) and external audits. 
 - Strong experience in document control, risk management, corrective actions, and compliance programs. 
 - Experience supporting project quality documentation within engineering, manufacturing, or project delivery organizations. 
 - Experience leading process improvement and organizational change initiatives. Competence

- ISO 9001 knowledge and practical application. 
 - Internal auditing and corrective action management. 
 - Risk assessment and continuous improvement. 
 - Process mapping and document management. 
 - Data analysis and reporting skills. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management. 
 - Ability to work independently and manage priorities. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office and project management tools. Trelleborg is an equal opportunity employer! We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

"Are you the one we're looking for? Apply now by clicking the Apply button, or email me for more information"

At Trelleborg our people are #shapingindustryfromtheinside

Trelleborg is a world leader in engineered polymer solutions for almost every industry on the planet. And we are where we are because our talents brought us here. By specializing in the polymer engineering that makes innovation and application possible, Trelleborg works closely with leading industry brands to accelerate their performance, drive their business forward-and along the way, shape the industry and progress that will benefit humankind in the exciting years ahead. Our people are Shaping Industry from the Inside. Why don ́t you join us?

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world's largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo's automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700, 000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust. 

Simplicity at Scale. 

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you'd like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we'd like to talk to you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo. 

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions. 

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: 

- Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai. 
 - Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
 - Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far. 
 - Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team. 
 - Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
 - Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams. 
 - Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
 - Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on. 
 - Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans. 
 - Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration. 
 - Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
 - Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you. 
 - Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering. 
 - Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions. 
 - Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners. 
 - Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs. More information about this role: 

- This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week. 
 - This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence. 
 - The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 55, 00, 000 LPA and INR 75, 00, 000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e. g. , ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended. Experience: 

- Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required. 
 - Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team. 
 - Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required. 
 - Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them. 
 - Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams. 
 - AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction. 
 - ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation. 
 - Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e. g. , SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain. 
 - Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction. 
 - Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e. g. , available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs). 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels. Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications: 

- An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting. 
 - Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture. 
 - PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business. 
 - Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India. 
 - Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market. 
 - Broader background in cybersecurity or certificate/identity infrastructure. 

Additional Information

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate. 

Our "One Sectigo" culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo: 

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage. 

Global team. Global reach. Global impact. 

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work - and our team members - reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

data.description:
Provides expert level IT technical lead services, including the direction, evaluation, selection, configuration, implementation, and integration of new and existing technologies and tools. 

About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

This role provides expert-level IT technical lead services, including the integration and implementation of technologies, while applying deep backend expertise to optimize performance, ensure secure architecture, and enhance system scalability. 

Responsibilites

- Provides expert-level technical leadership for critical software, middleware, or hardware projects across multiple platforms, ensuring successful architecture, development, and implementation. Evaluates and approves development options and technical deliverables. Oversees comprehensive testing for functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Approves technical solutions proposed by team members, resolves complex technical problems, and anticipates issues to enable preventive action. 
 - Acts as a key technical liaison with stakeholders, effectively communicating technical implications, project risks, and solution strategies.

 - Leads or contributes to special projects and cross-functional initiatives as assigned. 
 - Applies deep server-side development skills, focusing on performance optimization, secure architecture, and database efficiency. 
 - Troubleshoots complex system performance issues and recommends improvements to optimize data flow across services and APIs. 
 - Ensures scalable and resilient backend functionality, with proactive measures for increased system demands. 

Qualifications and Skills: 

- Minimum 8 years of experience in software development, architecture, and system integration. 
 - Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor's in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master's in Computer Applications (MCA). 
 - Expert level programming skills in Java, SpringBoot, Python
 - Expert level understanding of AWS Services (DynamoDB, S3, ECS, Route 53, Athena, Lambda, Step Function, SNS/SQS, Cloud Formation, API Security/IAM, Bedrock), GitHub, Bitbucket, CI/CD

 - Experience in mentoring teams, establishing technical standards, and driving continuous process improvement. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agile, Confluence, JIRA, and monitoring and refining dashboards
 - Expertise in software architecture, system design, and technical leadership for enterprise applications. 
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agile, Confluence, JIRA, and monitoring and refining dashboards; knowledge of continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, conduct root cause analysis, and optimize system performance. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to influence technical decisions. 
 - Desired Certifications: AWS Cloud Practitioner, AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Solution Consultant. 
 - Experience in mentoring teams, establishing technical standards, and driving continuous process improvement. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

data.title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
data.description:
Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)

About The Role

What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress-test AI-powered applications and infrastructure - identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Conduct penetration tests against AI-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
 - Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
 - Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry-standard tools and methodologies
 - Simulate real-world attack scenarios - from reconnaissance through exploitation and post-exploitation
 - Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
 - Evaluate AI-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
 - Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
 - Work independently on task-based engagements on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK)
 - Proficient with industry-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
 - Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
 - Able to think like an attacker - creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
 - Strong written communication skills - you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
 - Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments

Nice to Have

- Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
 - Experience with AI/ML security testing - adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red-teaming
 - Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
 - Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
 - Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
 - Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
 - Experience conducting security assessments in compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc. )

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - work when and where it suits you
 - Freelance autonomy with access to high-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
 - Be at the forefront of AI security - a rapidly growing field with massive demand
 - Sharpen your skills against novel AI-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
 - Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

data.title: Software Dev Engineer I,  University Talent Acquisition
data.description:
Description

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands - customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon. 

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. For an update on your status, or to confirm your application was submitted successfully, please login to your candidate portal. NOTE: Amazon works with a high volume of applicants, so we appreciate your patience as we review applications

Key job responsibilities

- Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market. 
 - Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry. 
 - Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed. 
 - Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use. 
 - Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems. 
 - Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
 - Knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, algorithm design, data structures, problem solving, and complexity analysis. 
 - Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous technical internship(s). 
 - Experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases. 
 - Experience in optimization mathematics such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization. 
 - Effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions. 
 - Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly. 

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.description:
Job Description

Role title: Staff Engineer, Data Platform

Salary range: $130, 000 - $180, 000 USD

Location: Chicago-based Hub or fully r emote

The opportunity

Applied engineers the platforms, data, and intelligent systems moving insurance forward. The work runs in production across agencies and carriers, where quality, speed, reliability, and sound technical judgment matter. In this role, you will lead architecture and technical decision-making across Applied's customer-facing data platform. 

This newly created individual contributor role reports directly to the leader of Data and Analytics and serves as the senior engineering lead across Data Lake, Data Engineering, Analytics & Visualization, and Data Science. You will help modernize the platform supporting internal products and customers, raise engineering standards, and remain hands-on when the work calls for it. You will influence how data moves from its source through ingestion, preparation, visualization, and consumption by Applied products, AI solutions, and customers. 

What You'll Own

- Lead architecture and technical decision-making across the end-to-end data lifecycle, from source ingestion and streaming through preparation, visualization, and consumption by products, AI solutions, and customers 
 - Drive modern engineering approaches through proofs of concept, technology evaluation, and reimagining existing solutions when a more scalable or efficient path is available 
 - Improve the scalability, reliability, accuracy, completeness, and observability of data flowing into and through the Data Lake 
 - Guide and contribute to major initiatives, including reducing streaming latency, strengthening observability across more than 4, 000 agency GCP projects, and modernizing database architecture away from SQL Server 
 - Partner with Software Engineering, Data Engineering, BI Engineering, Data Science, product teams, and senior leadership to resolve difficult technical problems and align teams around sound platform decisions 
 - Remain hands-on by designing, prototyping, troubleshooting, reviewing code, and contributing directly to implementation when needed 
 - Mentor engineers and build a culture of strong software engineering practices, experimentation, platform thinking, AI-enabled work, and shared technical ownership

What You'll Bring

- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of strong technical impact 
 - Deep data-focused software engineering experience, with the ability to reason across ingestion, streaming, storage, transformation, visualization, and consumption 
 - Strong cloud data platform experience in Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure, including architecture and production problem-solving at scale 
 - Experience designing or operating data lake and streaming systems, with practical knowledge of data accuracy, stability, availability, and performance 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the software development lifecycle, source control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and production operations 
 - Hands-on programming experience with Python, Go, or comparable languages, plus strong SQL and data architecture fundamentals 
 - A track record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams without direct reporting authority while balancing strategic guidance with direct technical contribution 
 - Experience leading complex platform design or migration decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly to technical and business stakeholders, or equivalent practical experience

What Could Set You Apart

- Production experience with GCP technologies such as BigQuery , Dataflow or Apache Beam, Pub/Sub, AlloyDB or Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, and Redis 
 - Experience with change data capture tooling such as Debezium or an equivalent technology 
 - Experience applying AI or machine learning within data platforms or using AI and automation to accelerate engineering work 
 - Experience with large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS data platforms, particularly in insurance or another regulated industry 
 - A record of modernizing legacy systems, leading low-disruption migrations, and creating engineering standards that teams adopt 
 - An entrepreneurial approach that includes testing ideas, building proofs of concept, questioning existing assumptions, and starting fresh when the outcome justifies it

Your background may bring strengths we have not listed here. If the role and its impact interest you, we encourage you to apply. 

Build a career that moves an industry

Applied is the connective intelligence transforming how insurance works. We build the platforms , data, and intelligent systems that connect agencies and carriers across the insurance lifecycle. 

Here, careers move with the work . You can own meaningful decisions, build what reaches the market, expand your scope as the business evolves, and work alongside people who bring expertise , curiosity, and care to what they create. 

What You Can Expect

- Work with reach: Build products, services, or programs that support agencies, carriers, and teammates across the insurance lifecycle . 
 - Ownership with context: Make decisions with a clear view of customer needs, business priorities, and the teammates who bring the work to market . 
 - Growth through scope: Expand your impact through meaningful projects, cross-functional exposure, learning opportunities, and stretch work as the business evolves . 
 - Built by people: Work with people who bring expertise , curiosity, and care to what they build, and who share accountability for moving the work forward . 

Benefits And Support

Our benefits support your health, time, and life beyond work. 

NORTH AMERICA

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
 - Holiday and vacation time 
 - Health and wellness days 
 - A day off for your birthday

Compensation Transparency

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $130, 000 - $180, 000 USD. Starting pay reflects the role's scope and the successful candidate's relevant experience, skills, and location. 

Candidate security

Applied communicates with candidates through an @appliedsystems. com email address or our official careers portal. Our recruiters will never request payment or ask for bank account details, government identification numbers, or other sensitive financial information during initial recruiting conversations.

data.title: Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems) based in India. 

We are seeking a technically minded specialist to support, test, and improve a radio communications application used in a professional telecommunications environment. In this role, you will combine application support, system and integration testing, JavaScript scripting, and defect management to ensure reliable application performance. You will help users resolve technical issues, maintain system rules and models, and contribute to continuous product improvement. Working within a small, established Agile team, you will collaborate with colleagues to identify issues, enhance functionality, and strengthen software quality. This remote contract opportunity is well suited to someone who enjoys troubleshooting, communicating with users, and developing their technical skills in radio systems and cloud-based testing. 

Accountabilities

- Application Support: Provide timely technical assistance to users, investigate application issues, guide users through troubleshooting steps, and deliver application training when needed. 
 - Integration and System Testing: Plan and execute comprehensive integration and system tests in cloud environments to validate application functionality, reliability, and performance. 
 - Defect Tracking and Resolution: Identify, document, track, and manage software defects using Jira, collaborating with the team to investigate issues and verify fixes. 
 - JavaScript Scripting and System Configuration: Develop and maintain Radio Online (ROL) system rules and models using JavaScript, including variables, loops, functions, and related scripting techniques. 
 - Agile Team Collaboration: Work closely with team members in an established Agile environment to refine application functionality, prioritize issues, and support iterative improvements. 
 - Application Quality and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to testing practices, troubleshoot recurring issues, and recommend improvements to application stability, usability, and support processes. 
 - Technical Learning and Development: Participate in advanced JavaScript training and specialized workshops covering ROL testing methods, continuous integration, and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - User Communication: Explain technical concepts and troubleshooting procedures clearly, helping users understand solutions and use the application effectively. 

Requirements

- Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in engineering or a technical discipline, together with at least three years of engineering, IT, or technical experience; alternatively, five or more years of relevant engineering, IT, or technical experience. 
 - Application Support: Experience or demonstrated capability in technical troubleshooting, application support, and helping users resolve software-related issues. 
 - Testing and Quality Assurance: Understanding of integration testing and system testing, ideally with experience validating applications in cloud-based environments. 
 - JavaScript Fundamentals: Familiarity with JavaScript or the ability to develop scripting skills involving variables, loops, functions, and system logic. 
 - Defect Management Tools: Ability to document and track defects systematically; experience with Jira is valuable. 
 - Agile Collaboration: Willingness to work within an Agile team, collaborate on application improvements, and contribute to structured development and testing workflows. 
 - Communication Skills: Strong verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical steps in straightforward language and support users with patience, empathy, and professionalism. 
 - Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: A methodical approach to investigating issues, identifying root causes, validating fixes, and improving application reliability. 
 - Preferred Radio Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with digital or analog radio technologies, radio communications systems, or dispatch consoles is an advantage. 
 - Learning Mindset: Motivation to develop expertise in JavaScript, specialized radio application testing, and CI/CD practices. 

Benefits

- Health Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance coverage. 
 - Employee Wellbeing: A wellness program with a focus on mental health. 
 - Recognition and Rewards: Employee recognition initiatives and company incentive programs. 
 - Paid Leave and Time Off: A range of leave options, including holiday, maternity, paternity, birthday, bereavement, and paid personal leave. 
 - Remote Work: Remote working opportunities for greater flexibility. 
 - Work-Life Balance: A focus on supporting a healthy balance between professional and personal commitments. 
 - Learning and Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development, technical training, and continued learning. 
 - Immigration Support: An immigration program that may support relocation to Canada for eligible employees. 
 - Contract Opportunity: A remote contract position based in India. Specific compensation details and contract duration were not provided in the original job description.

data.title: T24 Senior Test Analyst (Perm)
data.description:
As a T24 Senior Test Analyst, you will manage testing deliverables for Temenos Core Banking systems. You will lead test planning, create functional and non‐functional test cases, define automation strategies, and ensure quality delivery across SIT, UAT, and BAU support. 

What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed

Test Planning & Execution

- Manage T24 testing team deliverables and track schedules to meet project timelines. 
 - Create functional and non‐functional test cases based on designs from analysts and developers. 
 - Prepare test data, execute test cases, and report progress with recovery planning if delays occur. 
 - Identify, log, track, and report defects, clarifying issues with analysts and developers. 
 - Define automation and performance test strategies. 
 - Support user acceptance testing (UAT). 
 - Provide BAU support for branches including troubleshooting and QA. 

Collaboration & Governance

- Liaise with IT and business partners to ensure test coverage. 
 - Collaborate across teams to align testing with project objectives. 
 - Ensure timely communication of progress, risks, and issues. 

We'd Love to Hear From You If. . . 

Experience

- You have 4-6+ years of experience testing Temenos Core Banking (T24). 
 - You have knowledge of T24 retail/corporate banking modules including Accounts, Funds Transfer, Teller, FX, Money Market, Loans and Deposits, SWIFT, reporting, Letters of Credit, General Ledger, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Miscellaneous Deals, and Non‐Stop modules. 
 - You have team management experience. 
 - You have experience in full SDLC (advantageous). 
 - You have experience testing in MUFG or other financial institutions (advantageous). 

Technical Expertise

- You have a bachelor's degree in Computing or a relevant field (e. g. , B. Tech, B. E, MCA). 
 - You have proven skills in developing automation strategies, frameworks, and scripts using Selenium or Playwright. 
 - You have experience with DevOps and defect management tools such as JIRA and Azure DevOps. 
 - You have experience using AI technologies (e. g. , Copilot). 
 - You have Unix/Linux knowledge. 

Ways of Working

- You are proactive, motivated, and results‐driven with strong accountability. 
 - You work effectively under pressure and meet challenging deadlines. 
 - You have strong logic, math, algorithmic, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - You demonstrate independence, teamwork, and urgency in prioritising work. 
 - You have excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. 
 - You have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and accuracy. 
 - You understand controls in a banking environment. 

---

Who We Are

Thakral One is a consulting and technology services company headquartered in Singapore, with a pan-Asian presence. We focus primarily around technology-driven consulting, adoption of value-added bespoke solutions, enabling enhanced decision support through data analytics, and embracing possibilities in the cloud. We are heavily inclined towards building capabilities collaboratively with clients and believe strongly in improving grounded and practical outcomes. 

This approach is possible through our partnership with leading global technology providers and internal R&D teams. Our clients come from Financial Services, Banking, Telco, Government, Healthcare, and Consumer-oriented organisations.

data.title: Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer based in India. 

Join an innovative cloud security engineering environment where you will help validate and strengthen the security of modern cloud infrastructure and runtime environments. In this role, you will design automated testing frameworks and ensure that advanced security features perform reliably across major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will work with Python, eBPF, Linux kernel technologies, containers, and Kubernetes to test security capabilities and identify complex technical issues. Collaborating closely with software and kernel engineers, you will investigate runtime behaviour, reproduce challenging issues, and improve the quality and reliability of security solutions. You will also contribute to continuous integration pipelines that enable faster, more consistent validation of new features. This opportunity is ideal for a technically curious engineer who enjoys automation, cloud-native technologies, and solving complex security challenges in a fast-evolving engineering environment. 

Accountabilities

- Cloud security validation: Design, implement, and maintain automated validation strategies for cloud security features and runtime protection capabilities. Ensure that security functionality performs as expected across different cloud environments and deployment configurations. 
 - Python test automation: Develop and maintain Python-based testing frameworks using tools such as pytest. Create reusable test cases, validate REST APIs, process JSON and YAML configurations, and automate repetitive validation tasks to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - eBPF and runtime observability testing: Build and maintain test hooks and validation frameworks for eBPF-based capabilities. Work with kernel-level observability mechanisms to verify runtime security functionality and help ensure accurate detection of relevant system and application behaviour. 
 - Multi-cloud environment management: Configure, deploy, and test security sensors and agents across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Validate feature behaviour under different infrastructure configurations and investigate platform-specific issues. 
 - Linux kernel investigation: Collaborate with kernel engineers to reproduce, investigate, and debug runtime security issues. Analyse relevant Linux kernel behaviour, system calls, namespaces, and control groups to identify root causes and support effective fixes. 
 - Continuous integration and automated pipelines: Integrate automated security validation into CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Improve test execution reliability, provide timely feedback on code changes, and help detect regressions early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Container and Kubernetes testing: Validate security functionality across Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, pods, and related cloud-native environments. Investigate issues involving container isolation, runtime behaviour, and infrastructure configuration. 
 - Infrastructure automation and observability: Use tools such as Terraform to provision and manage test environments. Leverage monitoring and visualisation tools such as Grafana to support troubleshooting, test analysis, and performance investigation. 
 - Serverless container validation: Test security capabilities in serverless container environments, including AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run, ensuring consistent behaviour across different deployment models. 
 - Cross-functional engineering collaboration: Work closely with security, platform, and kernel engineering teams to understand technical requirements, improve test coverage, investigate defects, and strengthen the quality and reliability of cloud security features. 
 - Continuous improvement: Identify gaps in existing validation processes, improve test frameworks and automation practices, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of cloud security testing methodologies and engineering standards. 

Requirements

- Cloud engineering experience: Hands-on experience configuring and working with at least one major cloud platform, with practical familiarity across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The ability to deploy infrastructure, configure cloud services, and troubleshoot cloud-based environments is important. 
 - Python automation expertise: Strong Python programming and test automation skills, including experience with pytest, REST API testing, and structured data formats such as JSON and YAML. You should be able to develop maintainable automation frameworks and reusable validation components. 
 - Linux internals: Familiarity with Linux kernel concepts, including system calls, namespaces, control groups (cgroups), and kernel modules. The ability to investigate low-level system behaviour and troubleshoot runtime issues is highly valuable. 
 - eBPF knowledge: Experience with eBPF technologies and kernel-level observability is highly desirable. An understanding of how eBPF-based instrumentation operates and how to validate its behaviour will be a strong advantage. 
 - Containerisation and orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, and pods. You should understand containerised application environments and be comfortable testing security functionality across cloud-native deployments. 
 - Infrastructure as code and monitoring: Practical familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and Grafana for monitoring and visualisation. Experience creating repeatable test environments and analysing system behaviour is beneficial. 
 - CI/CD and test integration: Experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration and delivery pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable tools. Understanding test automation, regression detection, and pipeline reliability is important. 
 - Serverless technologies: Exposure to serverless container platforms such as AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run is an advantage, particularly when validating security behaviour across different execution environments. 
 - Analytical and debugging skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a structured approach to investigating complex technical issues. You should be able to reproduce failures, identify potential root causes, and collaborate with engineers to validate fixes. 
 - Communication and teamwork: Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams, explain technical findings clearly, document test results, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Engineering mindset: A proactive, quality-focused approach to software validation, with an interest in cloud security, runtime protection, automation, and emerging infrastructure technologies. 

Benefits

- Full-time employment opportunity based in India. 
 - Opportunity to work on advanced cloud security and runtime protection technologies. 
 - Exposure to major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern technologies such as Python, eBPF, Linux kernel internals, Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Opportunity to collaborate with experienced security, platform, and kernel engineers on complex technical challenges. 
 - Scope to influence automated testing frameworks, validation strategies, and the reliability of security products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native, containerised, and serverless infrastructure environments. 
 - Opportunities to deepen technical expertise in cloud security engineering, runtime observability, and test automation. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
