data.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Operator
data.description:
HiveWatch is a tech-forward, inclusive organization fostering the evolution of the physical security industry. We are a diverse team of forward thinkers who empower each other to find creative and collaborative solutions in an industry ripe for modernization. We are passionate about the problems we're solving for our customers and equally passionate about the company we're building. 

HiveWatch is here to help security teams pivot from chasing threats to preventing them. We protect organizations, people, and property through the intelligent orchestration of physical security programs. With better communication, more insights, and less "noise", we are modernizing what it means for businesses and their employees to truly feel safe. 

The Role

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our App Experience team. You'll design, build, and ship AI-powered features in the intelligence layer of our platform: the agents that triage alarms, assess incidents, and recommend or take action the way an experienced security operator would. That means composing frontier models (language, vision, audio) with our own data, tooling, and retrieval into production-grade agent workflows, and working across the full stack to do it, from model orchestration in our Kotlin / Spring Boot / Python services to the React/TypeScript surfaces where operators see and act on the results. 

You'll own the evaluation loop for what you build. You'll define what "correct" means for an agent decision, build the eval sets and harnesses to measure it, and use those results to drive changes to prompts, tools, and architecture. To get there, you'll dig into real customer data, including alarm streams, video, access control events, and operator actions, to form and test hypotheses about where agents get things right, where they drift from human judgment, and why. You'll build the guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and observability that let us trust agents with higher-stakes decisions over time, and that let customers understand why an agent did what it did. 

You'll prototype quickly to learn what works, then harden the winners into reliable, cost-aware features. You'll partner closely with our product team and in-house security operations experts to turn operator intuition into something an agent can act on and to find the next problem worth automating. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build agentic product features that assess security scenarios and make decisions human security operators make today, such as whether to triage, escalate, dismiss, or dispatch. 
 - Form hypotheses about our data, then validate them: query production datasets, analyze results, and turn findings into product and model decisions
 - Orchestrate calls to both self-hosted inference models and frontier models, including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, routing across models, and cost/latency tradeoffs
 - Ship end-to-end features: Python for LLM/inference orchestration and analysis, and our Kotlin / Spring Boot / GraphQL backend to integrate agent capabilities into the platform
 - Work with product, customers, and security operations experts to encode operator judgment into agent behavior
 - Reliably deliver features and services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and modern service delivery practices
 - Mentor junior engineers and drive technical decisions that influence the team's architecture and development practices
 - Support production systems through incident response, troubleshooting, and break-fix activities to maintain service reliability and customer trust
 - Participate in a 24/7 on call rotation approximately 1 week per month as needed. 

Our Tech Stack

- Languages: Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, and Rust
 - Deployments: GitHub Actions, Terraform, Terragrunt, and Helm
 - Infrastructure: AWS (Kinesis, Serverless, RDS, EKS), Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3 years in senior roles
 - Strong experience with at least one compiled, object oriented programming language such as Rust, Kotlin, Java, C#, or C++
 - Strong proficiency with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query tuning
 - Experience building full-stack applications in microservice architectures
 - Demonstrated ability to work hypothesis-first with data: framing questions, writing the SQL or analysis code to answer them, and drawing sound conclusions
 - Experience with modern cloud services and cloud-native development
 - Experience with containerization using Docker and deploying applications to Kubernetes
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows
 - Experience using monitoring tools to measure and alert on performance and reliability issues
 - Experience with and enthusiasm for AI native software development practices
 - Strong system design skills and experience with distributed, high-scale applications
 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work in agile environments
 - Data-driven individual who will use metrics to influence decision making

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong experience with AWS
 - Experience designing evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic systems: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing for agent behavior
 - Experience with real-time or event-driven data (Kinesis, Kafka, or similar)
 - Hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code
 - Background in security technology or enterprise software
 - Experience with observability tools and performance optimization
 - Startup experience and/or early-stage SaaS experience

Additional Info

- Salary range for this position: $160, 000 - $200, 000 per year
 - Eligible to participate in HiveWatch Equity Incentive Plan
 - Final offer will be at the company's sole discretion and determined by multiple factors, including years and depth of relevant experience and expertise, location, and other business considerations. 

Benefits & Culture

At HiveWatch, we're passionate about taking care of our people - and it shows in the benefits we offer. Our team enjoys: 

- Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
 - Cutting-edge work in an emerging field with huge growth potential
 - Competitive compensation packages designed to reward top talent
 - A modern, newly renovated HQ right on Main Street in El Segundo, CA
 - 401(k) with a 4% company match to help you invest in your future
 - Flexible paid time off so you can recharge when you need it
 - A family-friendly, compassionate culture that values balance and belonging

We encourage you to challenge the status quo, share your perspective, and leave fear at the (access-controlled) door. 

Our EEO Statement

HiveWatch is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to cultivating a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. We execute our hiring practices so that they are merit-based and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, national origin, ancestry, military or veteran status, or other protected characteristic.

Description

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon. com. 

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to 'making zero happen' to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill "the 3 Zeros". We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. 

Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus. 

As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements. 

We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence. 

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth. 

Amazon is earth's most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar. 
 - Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization). 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

data.title: Technical Delivery Director – Salesforce
data.description:
Technical Delivery Director - Salesforce

About MirketaMirketa is a U. S. -headquartered digital transformation, technology consulting, and product engineering company with a delivery center in Noida, India. We specialize in Salesforce consulting and implementation, AI/GenAI, cloud platforms, data engineering, enterprise integration, and custom applications. We also build enterprise products for healthcare, AI-powered case resolution, revenue management, and nonprofit organizations. 

Position OverviewWe seek a technically accomplished Technical Delivery Director - Salesforce to own end-to-end Salesforce solutioning and technical execution across an assigned portfolio of enterprise engagements. The Director will lead Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams; own pre-sales technical proposals and estimates; and ensure solution quality, predictable delivery, and strong talent development. This is an engineering-led role, not merely project coordination. 

1. End-to-End Technical Solutioning, RFPs & Estimation·            Lead end-to-end technical solutioning from discovery through technical approval and project initiation, including requirements analysis, architecture, technology selection, integration design, build-versus-buy decisions, sizing, and implementation planning. 

·            Own technical responses to RFPs/RFIs, proposal architecture, solution diagrams, assumptions, resource and staffing plans, effort estimates, and implementation timelines. 

·            Lead business and technical discovery with clients, U. S. sales teams, Business Analysts, and solution architects; translate requirements into feasible Salesforce solution designs. 

·            Validate platform constraints, data architecture, security, integration complexity, nonfunctional requirements, risks, and delivery feasibility before commitments are made. 

·            Act as technical solution owner through pre-sales handover; ensure proposed solutions are scalable, commercially viable, and executable by the engineering team. 

·            Participate in technical workshops, client solution presentations, and proposal defenses; refine estimates using actual delivery benchmarks. 

2. End-to-End Salesforce Technical Delivery·            Own Salesforce technical execution across concurrent implementation, modernization, integration, and enhancement projects, from design and build through testing, deployment, and stabilization. 

·            Manage Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams, ensuring delivery against approved scope, effort budgets, timelines, and quality standards. 

·            Identify technical blockers and delivery risks early; lead recovery of troubled projects, complex integrations, and critical platform issues. 

·            Coordinate with Program Delivery, PM/BA, QA, DevOps, and U. S. client stakeholders on dependencies, releases, and acceptance. 

3. Portfolio Governance & Project Reviews·            Run weekly technical portfolio reviews covering milestone status, estimate-to-actual variance, remaining effort, staffing, defects, dependencies, and risks. 

·            Own technical forecasts and corrective actions; ensure Technology Managers maintain credible engineering plans and proactively escalate threats to delivery. 

·            Provide clear portfolio reporting to the VP Engineering & Technical Delivery and collaborate with Program Delivery on project controls and change management. 

4. Salesforce Architecture & Quality·            Own architecture quality and standards, reviewing data models, security/sharing, scalability, governor limits, integrations, platform performance, and design tradeoffs. 

·            Guide appropriate choices between configuration and customization; ensure Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, event-driven and asynchronous patterns are fit for purpose. 

·            Enforce peer reviews, unit and regression testing, CI/CD, source control, environment management, and release quality gates. 

·            Lead defect root-cause reviews, reduce rework and technical debt, and promote reusable architecture patterns and engineering accelerators. 

·            Provide technical judgment on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and, where relevant, Health Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce. 

5. Delivery Economics & Resource Planning·            Own engineering effort budgets, estimates, delivery efficiency, utilization, capacity plans, and staffing for assigned projects. 

·            Work with Finance and Program Delivery to monitor margin performance, effort variance, productivity, and corrective measures. 

·            Forecast demand for Salesforce skills and align technical staffing to pipeline and delivery commitments. 

6. Hiring, Leadership & Culture·            Own technical hiring requirements and assessments across junior, mid-level, senior, and leadership positions; personally interview Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and senior Salesforce engineers. 

·            Partner with HR on sourcing, competency models, technical assessments, onboarding, career paths, development plans, and employee retention. 

·            Mentor technical managers and leads; establish regular coaching, meaningful 1: 1s, performance feedback, succession plans, and collaborative engineering practices. 

·            Build a high-performing, accountable culture with strong technical ownership, merit-based recognition, continuous learning, and innovation. 

7. Salesforce Capability Development & Innovation·            Establish domain-specific architecture patterns, reference solutions, internal training, certification priorities, and reusable implementation assets. 

·            Develop capabilities in Agentforce and Salesforce AI, AI-assisted development and testing, and integrations with Python, AI services, cloud, and data platforms. 

·            Collaborate with AI/Data and Cloud Technical Delivery Directors on cross-technology solutions. 

8. Client Engagement & Escalations·            Serve as senior technical counterpart for Salesforce clients, clearly presenting architecture tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recovery plans. 

·            Own critical technical escalations and contribute to client trust, delivery acceptance, and account growth. 

Required Qualifications·            12-16+ years in enterprise software engineering and technical delivery, including significant hands-on Salesforce development and solution architecture. 

·            5+ years in Salesforce architecture or senior technical leadership; 4-6+ years managing Engineering Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, or sizeable engineering teams. 

·            Demonstrated experience leading multiple enterprise Salesforce projects and organizations of approximately 30-60 technical professionals. 

·            Deep knowledge of Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, Salesforce security/sharing, integration patterns, governor limits, and DevOps/CI-CD. 

·            Proven personal ownership of technical solutioning, enterprise RFPs, architecture selection, estimates, staffing plans, implementation feasibility, and delivery handover. 

·            Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud; strong ability to challenge designs, engineering estimates, and technical decisions. 

·            Accountability for technical effort budgets, quality metrics, engineering capacity, client escalations, and manager development. 

·            Excellent communication with U. S. enterprise stakeholders; ability to work on-site in Noida every working day during core business hours. 

·            Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Technical Architect (CTA), or related advanced credentials

Preferred / Nice-to-Have·            Health Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, and/or Agentforce experience. 

·            Salesforce-native ISV packaging, managed packages, and OEM product architecture. 

·            Complex integration, data migration, AI/GenAI, Python, Azure/AWS, or cloud data-platform experience. 

·            Track record of rescuing troubled projects, building engineering practices, and attracting mid- and senior-level Salesforce talent. 

Key Performance Indicators

Area/ Measures

Technical solutioning / Solution quality, architecture feasibility, technical win support, post-kickoff design changes, estimation accuracy

Delivery predictability / On-time milestones, forecast and schedule variance, delivery acceptance

Engineering quality / Escaped defects, rework, test automation, architecture compliance, technical debt

Economics/ Engineering effort variance, project margin, utilization, capacity accuracy

Leadership and hiring/ Manager effectiveness, critical hiring, coaching, capability growth and retention

Client outcomes/ Escalation trends, recovery effectiveness, satisfaction and acceptance

First 180 DaysDays 1-30 | Assess & Baseline·            Assess assigned Salesforce portfolio, solution architecture, technical skills, current estimates, delivery health, and quality problems. 

·            Establish KPI baselines and identify critical manager, staffing, and technical risks. 

Days 31-90 | Establish Governance·            Implement weekly technical portfolio reviews, solutioning approval and pre-sales handover checks, architecture reviews, estimation standards, and quality gates. 

·            Begin coaching managers, correcting high-risk projects, and recruiting critical roles. 

Days 91-180 | Demonstrate Results·            Improve estimation accuracy, solution quality, milestone reliability, engineering productivity, and defect prevention. 

·            Strengthen managerial ownership, fill approved critical technical roles, and present a Salesforce engineering capability roadmap. 

Ideal CandidateA hands-on Salesforce engineering and architecture leader who has progressed into portfolio delivery leadership, can own solutions from initial client discovery through successful production delivery, can challenge estimates and architecture, and can build a self-sufficient technical management organization.

data.title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
data.description:
Description

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?

DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions - interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that. 

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights. 

This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
 - You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
 - You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
 - Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
 - Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
 - Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
 - Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
 - Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
 - Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
 - Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
 - Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

A day in the life

You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries. 

About The Team

DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely. 

We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. data.title: Senior/Staff Deep Learning Compiler Engineer
data.description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. 

Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21. 

The Opportunity

Quadric is building the world's first General-Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU) architecture, bringing high-performance AI, DSP, and ML compute to edge devices. As a Deep Learning Compiler Engineer, you will design and optimize the compiler stack (MLIR, TVM, LLVM) that bridges state-of-the-art neural network frameworks directly to our proprietary hardware architecture. You'll play a critical role in unlocking peak hardware performance, low latency, and memory efficiency for edge AI workloads. 

What You'll Do

Deep Learning Compiler Infrastructure & Optimization

- Design, implement, and maintain compiler optimization passes targeting Quadric's processor architecture using frameworks like MLIR, Apache TVM, or LLVM. 
 - Develop lowering pathways from high-level machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) down to optimized low-level kernel code. 
 - Optimize neural network performance for memory throughput, latency, compute unit utilization, and power consumption. 

Neural Network Model Parsing & Graph Transformation

- Implement graph-level optimizations, including operator fusion, layout transformation, quantization (INT8/FP16), and memory allocation strategies. 
 - Analyze novel deep learning model topologies (Transformers, CNNs, Vision-Language Models) and extend compiler support for new operators and primitives. 
 - Benchmark and profile end-to-end model performance to identify and resolve compiler bottlenecks. 

Hardware-Software Co-Design

- Collaborate closely with hardware and micro-architecture teams to define instruction set extensions, hardware acceleration features, and compiler requirements. 
 - Develop software simulators, functional models, and test benches to validate compiler correctness and generated binary performance. 
 - Participate in hardware bring-up and validation efforts on FPGA and ASIC platforms. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months, you'll: 

- Successfully integrate support for key deep learning models (e. g. , modern Transformer architectures or Vision models) into Quadric's compiler pipeline. 
 - Implement custom graph and codegen optimization passes that deliver measurable performance improvements on target benchmarks. 
 - Partner with the architecture team to influence the next-generation micro-architecture definition through data-driven workload analysis. 

Required

What We're Looking For

- 8 years+ experience alongwith BS, MS, or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Hands-on experience developing deep learning compilers or compiler infrastructures (e. g. , MLIR, Apache TVM, LLVM, XLA, TensorRT, or Glow). 
 - Strong proficiency in C++ (14/17/20) and Python, with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. 
 - Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) and deep learning operator representations. 
 - Solid understanding of computer systems, memory hierarchies, parallel processing, and CPU/GPU/NPU instruction execution. 

Preferred

- Experience with low-level kernel optimization, SIMD/vector programming, and memory allocation strategy development. 
 - Knowledge of model quantization methodologies (INT8, FP8, mixed-precision) and post-training/QAT optimization techniques. 
 - Prior experience working on software stacks for custom AI accelerators, DSPs, or embedded architectures. 
 - Experience with FPGA bring-up, hardware emulation, or cycle-accurate simulator development. 

Quadric also offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our India-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: 

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 - Equity with the business
 - Paid Parental Leave
 - PF Retirement Plan
 - Flexible PTO
 - Winter holiday shutdown
 - Catered lunch each day in our office
 - Downtown Pune office location, close to shops, cafes, and local amenities
 - Collaborative, low-ego culture with significant ownership and impact
 - A work culture focused on innovative disruption

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Quadric is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law

data.title: Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer
data.description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. 

Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21. 

The Opportunity

Quadric is building a revolutionary new processor-based SoC architecture. As a Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer, you will join the ground floor of our chip design team, taking technical leadership in architecting and building our SoC-level verification environment from scratch. You will collaborate closely with architects, hardware engineers, and software teams to ensure high quality and complete verification coverage for our next-generation GPNPU-based SoCs. 

What You'll Do

Testbench Architecture & Test Plan Development

- Architect and build novel, scratch-built testbenches for SoC-level verification of our GPNPU-based SoCs. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with architects, HW designers, and SW teams to document comprehensive verification test plans. 
 - Implement scalable testbenches using commercial Verification IP (VIP) and/or internal software utilities. 

Test Execution & Verification Coverage

- Develop directed and random drivers, as well as assembly or C++ programs, to efficiently stress-test SoC subsystems and integration. 
 - Verify complex SoC subsystems, including 3rd-party IP (e. g. , NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR). 
 - Leverage VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation environments alongside assembly programming and Python scripting to execute test suites. 
 - Track, analyze, and communicate verification progress across teams using functional and code coverage metrics. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months, you'll: 

- Build out and deploy a fully functional, scratch-built SoC-level UVM verification environment. 
 - Achieve target coverage metrics across all critical SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP blocks. 
 - Establish robust co-simulation pipelines that validate HW/SW execution before tapeout. 

Required

What We're Looking For

- Minimum 5+ years of dedicated design verification experience on complex SoC/ASIC designs. 
 - Deep expertise in UVM methodology and leading SoC-level verification practices. 
 - Proficiency in SystemVerilog or Verilog, assembly programming, and scripting languages like Python. 
 - Hands-on experience verifying SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP (e. g. , NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR). 
 - Strong computer architecture background with experience in VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation. 

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our India-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: 

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 - Equity with the business
 - Paid Parental Leave
 - PF Retirement Plan
 - Flexible PTO
 - Winter holiday shutdown
 - Catered lunch each day in our office
 - Downtown Pune office location, close to shops, cafes, and local amenities
 - Collaborative, low-ego culture with significant ownership and impact
 - A work culture focused on innovative disruption

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Quadric is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law

E-Verify and Right to Work Notices

Quadric participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility for U. S. -based roles. As part of this process, applicants may review the following notices, which explain your rights and our participation in E-Verify. These notices are provided in English and Spanish. 

- E-Verify Participation Notice (English | Spanish)
 - Right to Work Notice (English | Spanish)

No action is required from candidates during the application process. These notices are provided for informational purposes only. 

Privacy

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that Quadric will collect and process your personal information as part of the hiring process. Please review our Privacy Policy to understand how we handle your data

data.title: AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )
data.description:
Role Title : AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect

Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery. 

As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges-delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams. 
 - Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams. 
 - Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis). 
 - Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium). 
 - Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams. 
 - Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges. 
 - Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases. 
 - Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage. 
 - Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
 - Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication. 
 - System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective. 
 - Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience designing and building GenAI platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure. 
 - Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees). 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering. 

Work Timings 2: 00PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

For Internal Applicants

- Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
 - Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
 - Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
 - Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal )
 - L09+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible. 
 - L09+ Employees can apply

Level / Grade : 11

As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner's product. 

This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements. 

Learn more about here!

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

What you'll do at MongoDB

- Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
 - Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
 - Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
 - Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
 - Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
 - Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
 - Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have

- 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
 - Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
 - Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
 - Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
 - Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
 - The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
 - Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

- Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
 - Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
 - MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB's broader product portfolio

What you will learn

- Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
 - Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
 - Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. data.title: Supervisor, Accounts Receivable
data.description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities. 

Come Join Our Team!

- As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

Help Us Grow Our Dream Team - Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!

Job Summary

- We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management. 

Essential Functions And Tasks

- Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity. 
 - Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow. 
 - Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets. 
 - Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved. 
 - Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances. 
 - Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery. 
 - Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows. 
 - Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization. 
 - Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members. 
 - Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters. 
 - Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success. 

Education And Experience Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in any related field. 
 - Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting. 
 - In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives. 
 - Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems. 
 - Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus. 
 - Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities. 

Compensation

- Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons . 
 - This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies . 

Ventra Health

Equal Employment Opportunity (Applicable only in the US)

Ventra Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culturally diverse organization. We strive for inclusiveness and a workplace where mutual respect is paramount. We encourage applications from a diverse pool of candidates, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, or veteran status. We will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, as needed, to assist them in performing essential job functions. 

Recruitment Agencies

Ventra Health does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Ventra Health is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Solicitation of Payment

Ventra Health does not solicit payment from our applicants and candidates for consideration or placement. 

Attention Candidates

Please be aware that there have been reports of individuals falsely claiming to represent Ventra Health or one of our affiliated entities Ventra Health Private Limited and Ventra Health Global Services. These scammers may attempt to conduct fake interviews, solicit personal information, and, in some cases, have sent fraudulent offer letters. 

To protect yourself, verify any communication you receive by contacting us directly through our official channels. If you have any doubts, please contact us at Careers@VentraHealth. com to confirm the legitimacy of the offer and the person who contacted you. All legitimate roles are posted on https: //ventrahealth. com/careers/. 

Statement of Accessibility

Ventra Health is committed to making our digital experiences accessible to all users, regardless of ability or assistive technology preferences. We continually work to enhance the user experience through ongoing improvements and adherence to accessibility standards. Please review at https: //ventrahealth. com/statement-of-accessibility/.

data.title: Plant Head (PSP Hydro- O&M)
data.description:
Responsibilities

- Ensure reliable, safe, and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems. 
 - Develops and maintains safe system of work (SSOW) procedures, including HIRA, PTW, LOTO, JSA etc. 
 - Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i. e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB, Cybersecurity etc. compliances). 
 - To provide oversight of all operational & maintenance activities, management of the operational and maintenance teams, financial control, contract management, environmental compliance, regulatory compliance, technical compliance, risk evaluations and relationship management. 
 - Achieve generation targets, pumping schedules, and meet SLDC / RLDC instructions. Liaison with SLDC/RLDC, DISCOMs, OEMs, regulatory bodies and government agencies, as and when required. 
 - Strategic oversight of reliability centered maintenance (RCM), including preventive, predictive, condition based and corrective maintenance approach. 
 - Maintaining and sharing complete plant operation & maintenance records, including daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting needed to corporate office management team. 
 - Prepare and manage plant O&M budget and P&Ls, work to optimize the costs and maximize production. This includes developing and tracking the monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and keeping them within approved limits. 
 - Responsible for overseeing end‐to‐end O&M contract management, including contractor performance monitoring, compliance, service delivery, budgeting, and risk mitigation. 
 - Responsible for local co-ordination with Government authorities / clients / Vendors and local community representees. Effective Coordination and dispute settlements with O&M contractor, local community and other stakeholders, as and when required. 
 - Ensure availability of critical spares inventory to meet the exigencies, in co-ordination with plant maintenance heads. 
 - Support billing, PPA compliance, DSM management, and settlements, as and when required. 
 - Define and monitor O&M Plans to achieve yearly Generation targets (including minimization of APC) and yearly agreed of Plant/Machines Availability targets. 
 - Delegates and assigns work tasks to Plant O&M team to maintain optimum plant operations. 
 - Assess plant operational procedures to identify areas of inefficiency and formulate action plan for continuous improvements. 
 - Lead plant improvement projects, modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and automation upgrades. 
 - Lead, train and develop a multi-disciplinary team at Plant level: i. e. for operations, mechanical, electrical, C&I, safety, civil and other support functions. 
 - Develop and execute risk management strategies to mitigate O&M risks and ensure compliance with internal audits. 
 - Ensure implementation on approved CSR plan at plant level. 
 - IMS implementation at Plant and coordination with central IMS team. 

Qualifications

- B. E/B. Tech in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 20+ years of experience in operations and maintenance within the hydro power generation sector. 
 - Strong knowledge of Statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to Hydro and PSS Plants. 
 - Must have O&M experience in large-scale hydropower plants/ pump storage plants. 
 - Experience leading a team of managers, engineers and technicians for large scale hydro/pump storage power Plants operations and maintenance works. 
 - Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant Operations and Maintenance works. 
 - Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment. 
 - Advanced certifications in operations management or power generation technologies are preferred

data.title: Lead - Field Instrumentation (Boiler)
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to maintain and enhance the operational excellence and reliability of all Control & Instrumentation systems associated with Boiler systems. This role is pivotal for conducting on-field maintenance activities including routine maintenance, timely overhauls, and calibration of equipment to prevent failures and ensure continuous operation. 

Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Boiler)

Operational Excellence And Equipment Reliability

Monitor the availability and functionality of all C&I systems related to Boiler area including firing systems, Mill fan, ASLD, CAMS, and MOV. 

Conduct routine maintenance of MOV, Boiler, and Auxiliaries to prevent equipment failures. 

Execute timely overhauls of the Boiler systems to maintain operational integrity. 

Troubleshoot and rectify breakdowns of equipment to ensure continuous operation. 

Coordinate with other departments to minimize maintenance delays and optimize equipment availability. 

Execute calibrations as per schedule and prepare detailed reports on findings and adjustments. 

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Technical And Process Improvement

Perform periodic backups of Boiler PLC and auxiliary systems to secure operational data. 

Provide resources and guidance to contractor technicians for routine maintenance tasks. 

Follow the established checklist for equipment maintenance to ensure thoroughness and accuracy.

data.title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect-SENIOR MANAGER
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Service line - Position Title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

Your Key Responsibilities

- 10+ years of experience in respective domain. 
 - Solution Architecture
 - Lead end-to-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
 - Lead end-to-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross-workstream integration points. 
 - Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit-to-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations. 
 - Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope. 
 - Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non-SAP systems. 
 - Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices. 

Delivery Governance & Program Leadership

- Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization. 
 - Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision-making discussions. 
 - Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates. 
 - Identify cross-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams. 
 - Prepare leadership-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs. 

Integration, Data & Technical Oversight

- Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event-driven patterns, middleware, and third-party platforms. 
 - Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution. 
 - Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean-core alignment. 
 - Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies. 

Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

- Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit-to-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates. 
 - Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post-go-live stabilization reviews. 
 - Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team. 
 - Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Core SAP & Transformation Expertise

- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models. 
 - Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas. 
 - Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications. 
 - Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches. 

Technical Architecture Skills

- Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles. 
 - Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness. 
 - Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction. 
 - Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution. 

Leadership & Consulting Skills

- Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams. 
 - Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams. 
 - Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk management skills. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

data.description:
Location - Hybrid

This is a hybrid role based out of our Gurugram, India office, 3 days in the office, 2 days remote. 

About Us

Sauce Labs is the world's largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world's top ten largest financial institutions and over 300, 000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8. 7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI-driven code generation and enterprise-grade software quality. Learn more at http: //saucelabs. com. 

Release Assurance at the Speed of AI | Meet the new Sauce Labs

As a Software Engineer in the Platform team, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving core architecture for applications developed in the company. Feature teams implement new ideas and improve existing ones based on the vision of the Product Team and feedback from our customers. Web Platform has high visibility and importance within the company as it's job is to provide common foundations for those teams to build on, merge and deployment strategy, monitoring, and give technological guidance to developers throughout the company.

Observability

- OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing - Advanced
 - Prometheus and PromQL - Advanced - diagnosing from metrics, not only reading dashboards
 - Grafana - Advanced
 - Log querying at scale - Advanced
