data.title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
data.description:
Job Description

The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities. 

The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally. 
 - Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements. 
 - Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems. 
 - Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria. 
 - Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs. 
 - Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long-term sustainability objectives. 
 - Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems. 
 - Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment. 
 - Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles. 
 - Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors. 
 - Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials. 
 - Support decision-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development. 
 - Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4. 0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance. 
 - Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. 
 - Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end-to-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments. 
 - Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies. 
 - Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles. 
 - Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups. 
 - Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. 
 - Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred. 
 - Experience supporting global or multi-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable. 
 - Exposure to Industry 4. 0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous. 
 - Experience within engineer-to-order, project-based, high-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred. 
 - Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams. 
 - Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required. 

About Us

Every day, the oil and gas industry's best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success. 

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success-now and in the future. 

Global Family

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work. 

Purposeful Innovation

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better. 

Service Above All

This drives us to anticipate our customers' needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated CAD & Methodology Engineer to drive the development, deployment, and support of scalable design automation infrastructure for Backend Physical Design teams. The role focuses on enabling efficient, repeatable, and high-quality RTL-to-GDSII implementation and signoff by maintaining robust reference flows, developing automation solutions, and driving methodology standardization across projects.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and release reference flows for Synthesis, STA, Place & Route, and Signoff. 
 - Build automation to improve productivity, including setup generation, QoR checks, report parsing, ECO automation, and deliverable packaging. 
 - Define and enforce methodology standards, flow validation, and QoR compliance checks. 
 - Qualify and deploy EDA tools, PDKs, libraries, and signoff runsets across compute environments. 
 - Provide technical support and root-cause analysis for flow, tool, and infrastructure issues through tapeout. 
 - Collaborate with Physical Design teams, IT, EDA vendors, and Foundry partners to drive flow improvements and issue resolution. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in Physical Design CAD, Design Methodology, or Backend Design Automation. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering. 
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII implementation and signoff methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard EDA tools from Synopsys, Cadence, and/or Siemens. 
 - Proficiency in Tcl, Python, Shell, or Perl scripting. 
 - Experience developing CAD automation and methodology solutions for backend design teams. Preferred Skills

- Experience with advanced technology nodes (7nm and below). 
 - Knowledge of PDK, library, and runset enablement. 
 - Familiarity with compute farms, Linux environments, Git, and CI/CD frameworks. 
 - Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills. Join us to drive design automation, methodology innovation, and successful tapeouts across cutting-edge semiconductor products. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

We are looking for an experienced RF Performance Engineer to support a US-based telecom network optimization project. This is a remote contract opportunity for candidates based in India who can work US business hours. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Nokia NetAct, 5G/LTE network performance, RF optimization, KPI analysis, and command-line operations, supporting network integration and post-launch performance improvements. 

Are you passionate about solving complex wireless network challenges and optimizing next-generation 5G networks? This is your opportunity to work on high-impact LTE and 5G optimization initiatives, including NR600, NR2500, L2100, L600, and multi-layer network performance projects. You will play a key role in improving network quality, troubleshooting performance issues, and ensuring seamless connectivity across newly integrated network layers. 

Location: 100% Remote - India

Work Schedule: US Business Hours (Mandatory)

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong hands-on experience with Nokia NetAct and command-line operations (Mandatory). 
 - Experience in 5G NR and LTE RF performance optimization, including post-integration performance checks. 
 - Strong understanding of 5G/LTE parameters, baseline configurations, and LMS parameters. 
 - Experience optimizing newly integrated network layers, including NR41, NR600, NR2500, L2100, and L600. 
 - Experience with ENDC (E-UTRA NR Dual Connectivity) configuration and optimization. 
 - Strong expertise in LTE/VoLTE KPI monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and optimization. 
 - Experience identifying and resolving network performance issues, including handover failures, throughput degradation, dropped calls, and RACH/access failures.

Principal Scientist: Firefly Enterprise India

The Opportunity

Firefly Enterprise brings Adobe's generative AI and creative technology into the heart of enterprise content production by helping large organizations create, adapt, and deliver on-brand content at production scale, inside the tools their teams already use. 

Our charter spans two areas: 

- Audio/Video Solutions: The media-processing backbone for enterprise-scale content production: ingesting, transforming, generating, and delivering audio and video reliably at production volume. 
 - Extensibility: Enterprise agentic workflows and plug-ins that surface Firefly's enterprise capabilities directly inside Figma and other Adobe creative applications. 

We're looking for a Principal Scientist to be the technical anchor of a small, fast-growing team; a player-coach who is as comfortable in the architecture and the codebase as in a design review or a customer conversation. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You won't carry direct reports or own headcount, but you will set the technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and mentor a team of software and machine-learning engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering managers on people leadership, and you'll be instrumental in interviewing and holding the hiring bar high. 

Impact You'll Make

- Set the long-term technical architecture and vision across both charter areas. 
 - Make enterprise-scale reliability and resiliency a first-class property of everything the team ships. 
 - Bring AI capabilities into the product and into how the team builds, raising both customer value and engineering velocity. 
 - Grow a scaling team of software and machine-learning engineers through hands-on work and mentorship, i. e. , lifting the technical bar by example. 
 - Turn customer and field insight into a credible, deliverable roadmap in partnership with adjacent teams. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture for enterprise-scale audio/video media-processing pipelines by designing for throughput, latency, cost, and operational resilience at production volume. 
 - Architect the extensibility platform: agentic enterprise workflows and plug-ins that expose Firefly's enterprise capabilities inside Figma and other Adobe creative apps. 
 - Stay hands-on by writing code, leading design and architecture reviews, and setting the engineering standards the team builds to. 
 - Mentor developers and specialists in machine learning alike, growing their technical judgment through the work. 
 - Play an instrumental role in hiring: interview, calibrate, and keep the bar high. 
 - Interface directly with customers and field/sales teams to identify real problems and collaborate across adjacent teams to shape the roadmap and deliver solutions. 
 - Manage collaborators and expectations across engineering, product, and the field; with clarity and follow-through. 
 - Leverage AI capabilities to improve both what customers get and how the team develops software. 

What You'll Bring

- 15+ years building large-scale distributed software systems. 
 - Proven experience operating at enterprise scale with a deep focus on reliability and resiliency. 
 - Strong backend engineering in Java, Python, or comparable technologies, with a solid command of distributed systems and cloud-native platforms.

 - Strong collaborator management with the ability to set expectations and align across engineering, product, and the field.

 - Contributions to open-source software or widely adopted developer platforms. 

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Our 30, 000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We're on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 

Let's Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

data.title: VP of Engineering | Healthcare Insurance | AI-Enabled SaaS
data.description:
About Rialtic

Rialtic is a healthcare technology company focused on improving payment accuracy and reducing unnecessary healthcare spending. Its platform combines an expert-curated policy library with cloud-native technology to automate claims editing and help healthcare payers make more accurate payment decisions. Following its strategic merger with Exponential AI, Rialtic is bringing together healthcare payment accuracy, enterprise technology, and AI capabilities to advance its platform and product offerings. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional  Vice President of Engineering  to lead engineering strategy, architecture, execution, and team development for a mission-critical healthcare technology platform. This role is for a proven engineering leader who has built and scaled complex software products, understands the realities of healthcare insurance technology, and can translate business priorities into secure, scalable, high-quality products. 

You will partner closely with executive leadership and Product to shape the technology roadmap, strengthen engineering execution, and embed AI into how software is designed, developed, tested, and delivered. 

Healthcare insurance experience is mandatory.   We are specifically seeking candidates who understand the technical and operational complexities of healthcare payer systems-not candidates whose experience is limited to general-purpose SaaS, fintech, or AI products. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Engineering Strategy and Architecture

- Own the engineering strategy, technical architecture, and execution roadmap in alignment with business and product priorities. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of scalable, cloud-native, enterprise-grade software platforms. 
 - Drive sound architectural decisions across application design, APIs, data systems, integrations, security, performance, and reliability. 
 - Balance technical innovation with maintainability, delivery speed, and long-term platform health. 2. AI-Enabled Engineering

- Establish practical, measurable adoption of AI-assisted software development across engineering teams. 
 - Evaluate and implement AI-enabled workflows for coding, testing, code review, documentation, debugging, and developer productivity. 
 - Identify opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities into products where they deliver meaningful customer and business value. 
 - Maintain strong standards for software quality, security, privacy, and human oversight in AI-enabled workflows. 3. Healthcare Insurance Technology

- Apply a strong understanding of healthcare payer operations and the technology underpinning claims and payment workflows. 
 - Lead engineering solutions that address healthcare payment accuracy, claims editing, policy application, and related payer technology challenges. 
 - Ensure systems can support complex business rules, evolving healthcare policies, large-scale data processing, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Partner with Product and domain experts to translate healthcare requirements into robust technical solutions. 4. Engineering Execution and Operational Excellence

- Improve delivery predictability, release quality, engineering throughput, and production reliability. 
 - Establish clear engineering metrics, operating rhythms, technical standards, and accountability. 
 - Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident management, and continuous improvement. 
 - Make informed build-versus-buy, modernization, and technology investment decisions. 5. Leadership and Team Development

- Build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams and leadership capabilities. 
 - Establish a culture of technical ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Partner with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and business leadership to deliver shared outcomes. 
 - Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, priorities, and progress effectively to executive stakeholders. 

Required QualificationsCandidates must meet  all core requirements  below. 

- 20+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience leading engineering organizations and delivering complex production software. 
 - Mandatory healthcare insurance experience:   Direct experience building or leading technology for health insurers, healthcare payers, health plans, or healthcare insurance technology platforms. 
 - Demonstrated technical depth across full-stack engineering, including frontend and backend systems, APIs, databases, integrations, and distributed applications. 
 - Proven experience owning architecture and engineering delivery for scalable, cloud-based enterprise products. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering managers and senior technical teams, with accountability for delivery, quality, and operational outcomes. 
 - Practical experience adopting AI-assisted software engineering tools or AI-enabled development workflows, with the ability to demonstrate measurable impact or concrete implementation outcomes. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, production monitoring, security, and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience partnering with Product and executive stakeholders to establish roadmaps, prioritize investments, and deliver business outcomes. 
 - Excellent communication, strategic judgment, and the ability to remain technically credible while operating at an executive level. 
 - Ability to work from Hyderabad, India. 

Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience with payment integrity, claims editing, claims adjudication, medical policy rules, clinical coding, or healthcare cost-containment platforms. 
 - Experience in healthcare enterprise SaaS or mission-critical systems processing large volumes of sensitive data. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations through rapid growth, platform modernization, or significant product transformation. 
 - Familiarity with applicable healthcare data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Experience establishing measurable engineering productivity and AI adoption programs. What Success Looks Like
 - A clear, business-aligned engineering roadmap and scalable technical architecture. 
 - Faster, more predictable software delivery without compromising quality or reliability. 
 - Measurable improvements in engineering productivity through effective AI adoption. 
 - Robust, secure, and maintainable products that address complex healthcare payer requirements. 
 - Strong engineering leadership, clear accountability, and effective cross-functional execution. Who Should Apply?This role is best suited to an experienced engineering executive who combines  deep software engineering fundamentals, proven organizational leadership, practical AI adoption, and substantial healthcare insurance domain experience. 

Candidates without direct healthcare insurance or healthcare payer technology experience will not be considered. 

- Please highlight the healthcare insurance platforms you have worked on, the engineering organizations you have led, the scale and complexity of systems you have delivered, and measurable outcomes from your engineering and AI initiatives.

data.title: Manager, Clinical Operations
data.description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22, 000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere. 

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose. We move with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart. 

About The Role

We are seeking a Manager, Clinical Operations to join our team in Bengaluru in a onsite capacity. As a Manager, Clinical Operations, you will oversee a team and support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in study execution, regulatory compliance, and the delivery of high-quality project deliverables on time. You will resource client projects with suitably developed professionals, develop and retain your team, and provide clinical consultation to project teams, working independently under the supervision of a Senior Manager, Associate Director, or Director. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout. 

Responsibilities include overseeing project delivery and team performance, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence study outcomes. Your leadership shapes how efficiently and effectively new therapies move from study planning to the patients who need them. 

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through project delivery excellence, talent development, and client partnership. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Manager, Clinical Operations can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research. 

Key Responsibilities

- Monitor performance through close interaction with project and functional leadership, ensuring project documentation and correspondence are accurate and complete, and serve as an ongoing liaison with project teams, sponsors, and management regarding the performance of direct reports. 
 - Manage and oversee team activities, including appropriate resourcing of staff, staff assignments, quality control, and the efficiency of project deliverables. 
 - Produce accurate resourcing plans with appropriate project team members, and monitor resource needs throughout the project. 
 - Develop action plans with management and project leadership to keep projects on time and within budget, and facilitate metrics collection. 
 - Recruit, retain, and develop a skilled, experienced, and motivated team through training, mentoring, and allocation of staff according to their ability. 
 - Conduct quality checks of deliverables and take appropriate remedial action to ensure departmental and project productivity and quality metrics are met. 
 - Provide technical support and clinical consultation to project teams, ensuring staff have the knowledge required to fulfill their duties. 
 - Support staff in improving their efficiency and effectiveness at prioritizing work, and participate in formal staff review processes, including performance and salary reviews. 
 - Serve as a senior-level contributor on project teams, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of your own deliverables and generating study-specific status reports for study teams, sponsors, and management. 
 - Maintain working knowledge of, and ensure compliance with, ICH Guidelines, Good Clinical Practice, regulatory agency requirements, and Parexel and sponsor SOPs. 
 - Where appropriate, contribute to project bids, client presentations, and business lead generation. 

Candidate Profile

You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring

- Strengths in managing and motivating direct reports, developing talent, and resourcing projects effectively
 - Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
 - The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
 - A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
 - Comfort working with resourcing plans, project metrics, and quality control processes

Required Qualifications

- Educated to degree level, or an equivalent nursing qualification or relevant clinical or other equivalent experience
 - Substantial monitoring or data management experience, or equivalent experience in clinical research, with a strong understanding of the clinical trials environment
 - Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
 - Experience with study documentation and quality control processes, including Central File documentation
 - Competency in the local language and written English
 - Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Degree in a biological science, pharmacy, or other health-related discipline
 - Oral English competency

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research. 

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

data.title: Assistant Manager - FQA (Mechanical)
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to uphold and enhance the quality and integrity of mechanical components and systems through rigorous inspection and testing procedures. This includes coordinating for site inspections, conducting tests, overseeing boiler and pressure part surveys, and managing welder qualifications. The role also involves preparing and reviewing quality assurance plans and field quality plans, as well as leading quality training sessions to ensure high standards of workmanship and engineering practices. 

Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Inspection: 

- Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards. 
 - Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares. 
 - Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries. 
 - Identify and inspect Boiler Tube Leakage rectification works with NDT testing and other quality procedures. 
 - Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity. 
 - Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc. 
 - Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification). 
 - Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment. 

Quality Control And Testing

- Conduct welder qualification tests (for both IBR and non-IBR) and maintain welder performance records. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve materials, QAPs, and FQPs of various site packages. 
 - Prepare and review WPS, PQR, and WPQ documents. 
 - Operational Excellence and Compliance: 
 - Raise NFA (Note for Approval) for deviations and modifications and obtain approval through the system. 
 - Provide budget inputs and ensure the sustainability of resources and processes. 

Resource Management, Training, And Innovation

- Provide TNI inputs and drive feedback sessions for continuous learning. 
 - Provide innovative ideas and recommendations. 
 - Support quality awareness training sessions for maintenance engineers and agency engineers/supervisors to foster a culture of quality and excellence at the site. 
 - Manage relationships with external agencies to ensure the timely submission of bills, closure of accounts, and resolution of financial matters related to mechanical works. 

Business Sustainability

- Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 
 - Maintain the safety of business associates/other contractors and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols. 
 - Ensure compliance with technical audits, safety audits, and business excellence assessments. 
 - Implement CHETNA Safety standards in the department to achieve zero harm. 
 - Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards. 
 - Ensure compliance with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and company policies. 

Digitization And Automation

- Execute integration of advanced technology and comprehensive digitization strategies in mechanical quality assurance processes to optimize operational efficiency. 
 - Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy. 
 - Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 
 - Monitor and analyse data from digital systems to inform decision-making and improve quality outcomes. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

- Maintenance Mechanical
 - Operations & Maintenance
 - Techno Commercial

Key Stakeholders - External

- Agencies and contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

6+ years of experience in quality assurance/control, with a significant portion in a leadership role within the power sector or related heavy industries. 

Preferred Industry

Candidates with experience in the power generation, energy, or related heavy industrial sectors are preferred, with a strong background in operational excellence and quality management systems.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing , Chiller
data.description:
Role: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing , Chiller

Location: Sricity

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate. carrier. com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier. 

About The Role

The General Manager - HVAC Chillers will lead end-to-end manufacturing operations for a comprehensive range of HVAC chiller products, including air-cooled chillers, water-cooled chillers, centrifugal chillers, scroll chillers, and data center cooling chillers. 

The role is responsible for production execution, manufacturing planning, quality control, engineering collaboration, laboratory testing, customer witness testing, and material availability. The position requires close coordination with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing while meeting customer delivery commitments and product performance requirements. 

Job Responsibility

- Manufacturing and Production Operations
 - Lead daily manufacturing operations for air-cooled, water-cooled, centrifugal, scroll, and data center chillers. 
 - Ensure production targets, customer delivery schedules, productivity, and capacity utilization are achieved. 
 - Establish standardized work processes, manufacturing procedures, and shop-floor operating discipline. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce manufacturing costs, minimize waste, and optimize resource utilization. 
 - Ensure compliance with EHS requirements, operational standards, and applicable manufacturing procedures. 
 - Production Planning and Execution
 - Develop and execute production plans aligned with customer demand, sales forecasts, and delivery commitments. 
 - Coordinate with Planning, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Sourcing teams to ensure timely availability of critical components and materials. 
 - Monitor production schedules, work-in-progress, capacity constraints, and material shortages to minimize line stoppages. 
 - Identify production risks and implement recovery plans to protect customer deliveries. 
 - Optimize production sequencing, manpower deployment, equipment utilization, and manufacturing lead times. 
 - Quality Control and Process Excellence
 - Ensure process quality throughout all stages of chiller manufacturing, assembly, testing, and dispatch. 
 - Work closely with Quality teams to establish and maintain process controls, inspection standards, and corrective-action systems. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions for manufacturing defects, rework, and customer complaints. 
 - Ensure adherence to engineering specifications, product standards, approved processes, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Promote a culture of first-time-right manufacturing and continuous quality improvement. 
 - Engineering and New Product Development
 - Collaborate with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Design Engineering teams on new product introductions, engineering changes, and product improvements. 
 - Support first-of-a-kind (FoAK) builds, prototype builds, pilot production, and transition to serial or mass production. 
 - Ensure manufacturing readiness through process validation, tooling readiness, work instructions, operator training, and capacity planning. 
 - Provide manufacturing feedback to Engineering on design-for-manufacturability, assembly processes, serviceability, and cost optimization. 
 - Support the resolution of technical issues encountered during product development, production, and performance testing. 
 - Laboratory Testing and Customer Witness Testing
 - Ensure readiness and effective utilization of chiller testing laboratories and associated test infrastructure. 
 - Possess a strong understanding of chiller performance testing, functional testing, test procedures, instrumentation, and test data interpretation. 
 - Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, and Laboratory teams to ensure products meet specified performance and reliability requirements. 
 - Plan and manage customer witness testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and other customer inspection requirements. 
 - Ensure test documentation, results, traceability, and customer approvals are completed on schedule. 
 - Coordinate the resolution of test failures, technical deviations, and customer observations before product release. 
 - Procurement, Sourcing, and Material Availability
 - Work closely with Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, and Supplier Quality teams to ensure uninterrupted availability of production materials. 
 - Review critical material shortages, supplier delivery performance, long-lead-time components, and supply constraints. 
 - Participate in supplier recovery planning and escalation to resolve material availability issues affecting production. 
 - Support supplier development, localization initiatives, alternate-source qualification, and cost-reduction programs. 
 - Align material procurement plans with the production schedule, product mix, and customer delivery priorities. 
 - People Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Lead and develop production, planning, and manufacturing teams, building a strong culture of accountability and ownership. 
 - Establish clear performance objectives, operational reviews, and capability-development plans for the team. 
 - Work collaboratively with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, and Customer Service to resolve business challenges. 
 - Drive structured daily management, performance reviews, escalation processes, and cross-functional problem-solving. 
 - Develop technical capabilities within the organization through training, standardization, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Operational Performance and Business Excellence
 - Monitor and improve key operational metrics, including safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, inventory, and manufacturing lead time. 
 - Drive lean manufacturing, waste elimination, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop and manage operational budgets, manufacturing cost targets, and resource requirements. 
 - Identify capacity expansion and process improvement opportunities to support business growth, particularly in data center cooling applications. 
 - Provide regular operational performance updates, risk assessments, and improvement plans to senior management. 
 - Qualifications and Experience
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - A postgraduate qualification in Operations Management or Business Administration is desirable. 
 - Typically 15+ years of experience in HVAC, industrial refrigeration, chiller manufacturing, or related engineering and manufacturing operations, including significant leadership experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing production operations and planning for complex HVAC equipment or industrial cooling systems. 
 - Strong technical knowledge of air-cooled chillers, water-cooled chillers, centrifugal chillers, scroll chillers, and data center cooling solutions. 
 - Practical understanding of chiller assembly processes, performance testing, quality systems, and factory acceptance or customer witness testing. 
 - Experience in new product introduction, first-unit builds, manufacturing scale-up, and mass-production readiness. 
 - Proven experience in cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Sourcing, and Supply Chain teams. 
 - Technical and Leadership Competencies
 - Strong knowledge of HVAC chiller systems, manufacturing processes, and product performance requirements. 
 - Understanding of chiller testing, laboratory operations, performance validation, and customer acceptance requirements. 
 - Expertise in production planning, capacity management, material planning, and delivery execution. 
 - Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams and driving cross-functional accountability. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, decision-making, and customer-facing skills. 
 - Ability to balance customer commitments, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and cost objectives. 
 - Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance Will Be Measured Against The Following Key Indicators

- Safety: EHS compliance, incident reduction, and adherence to safe operating practices. 
 - Delivery: On-time production completion and on-time customer delivery performance. 
 - Quality: First-pass yield, defect rate, rework, warranty issues, and customer complaints. 
 - Productivity: Production output, labor productivity, capacity utilization, and manufacturing lead time. 
 - Material Availability: Production line stoppages due to material shortages and supplier delivery performance. 
 - Testing and Customer Satisfaction: On-time completion of laboratory testing, customer witness tests, and factory acceptance testing. 
 - New Product Introduction: Timely completion of FoAK builds, production readiness, and mass-production ramp-up. 
 - Cost and Inventory: Manufacturing cost improvement, scrap reduction, inventory control, and working capital optimization. 
 - People Development: Team capability, technical competency, employee engagement, and leadership development. 
 - Expected Outcome

The General Manager - HVAC Chillers will ensure a safe, reliable, quality-driven, and customer-focused manufacturing operation capable of delivering the full chiller portfolio on time. The role will strengthen cross-functional execution, improve material availability and production efficiency, support product development and industrialization, and build the manufacturing capabilities required to support future business growth, particularly in data center cooling and high-performance chiller applications. 

Benefits

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and wellbeing programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees' health, security, and success. 

- Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave 
 - Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities 
 - Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Apply Now!

data.title: Principal Architect
data.description:
At S&W, we help our clients thrive by simplifying the complex, illuminating new paths, and shaping solutions that make a difference. As one of the UK's top 10 fastest-growing accountancy firms, we have been a trusted partner since 1881-helping businesses and individuals meet challenges and seize opportunities across generations. 

Built on expertise and driven by ambition, we provide a comprehensive range of services, including tax and accountancy, advisory and assurance, corporate finance, and restructuring. We are defined by our purpose-to help navigate challenges, unlock potential, and achieve the extraordinary. 

S&W acquired ClearViewIP in September 2025 to complement the existing advisory services that S&W currently offers its clients including corporate finance, valuations, transaction services and forensic services, along with business tax, audit, consulting and business outsourcing services. 

The ClearViewIP team comprises experienced IP professionals, with decades of experience in managing, protecting and commercialising innovation and ensuring best practice IP approaches are deployed to help clients win in the market. 

Job Description

Principal Architect - AI-First IP Intelligence Platform

We are transforming a global IP intelligence organization from expert-driven workflows into an AI-first, scalable platform architecture. Our mission is to convert complex, knowledge-intensive IP workflows-prior art search, patent landscape analysis, FTO, competitive intelligence-into modular, explainable, enterprise-grade AI systems. 

- Location: Gurugram, India
 - Working format: 5 days per week in the office

The Role

You will work closely with the Director and Head of the Workbench Program in the UK, and partner with the India operations team to understand how the work is done today and translate that into the platform. This is an architecture role with long-term platform ownership and significant technical influence. It is not about maintaining existing systems. The foundations are being laid now, and you will be shaping them hands-on: 

- AI-native workflows that reason over long technical documents and cite evidence
 - Backend services that orchestrate large analytical workloads across a data platform, and the APIs around them. 
 - Modern frontend experiences built for reviewing output at scale (React/NodeJS or equivalent) - a near-term critical path for this hire
 - Secure, enterprise-grade Azure-based deployments, with Databricks as the current leading platform for the data/AI layer. 
 - Robust DevOps and MLOps foundations, including model evaluationYou will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels-designing long-term architectural blueprints while actively shaping core systems in their earliest stages. This role is not about maintaining existing systems. It is about laying the foundations for a platform that will define the next decade of the company's growth. 

Qualifications

Technical Strengths

- 12-15+ years in software engineering, with significant architectural ownership
 - Experience building large-scale, distributed, enterprise-grade systems
 - Proven, hands-on track record designing and building modern backend AND frontend architectures - frontend/UI depth is essential, not a nice-to-have, for this role
 - Strong experience in Azure cloud deployments; hands-on Databricks experience (PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow) strongly preferred

Technical Depth

- Polyglot capability (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Node. js or similar)
 - Data storage and query design: SQL, Delta / Lakehouse patterns, search indexes
 - Structured extraction from long documents; structured-output contracts with LLMs
 - Batch inference at scale, and the failure modes of long-context model calls
 - Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline design
 - APIs and service design
 - Desirable: vector databases, semantic search, RAG architectures - though our work leans more on verified structured extraction than on retrieval alone
 - Vector databases, Semantic search systems, RAG architectures, Knowledge graphs

Domain Advantage (Preferred)

- Experience in IP analytics, patent intelligence, legal tech, or other knowledge-intensive domains
 - Exposure to patent data formats, citation networks, IPC/CPC classifications
 - Experience building explainable systems in regulated or high-trust environments

data.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
Level AI is a Mountain View-based conversational intelligence company building the AI platform that powers modern contact centers. Our systems analyze millions of customer interactions to surface insights, automate quality assurance, and drive real-time agent guidance. We work at the frontier of applied speech and language AI, and our research directly shapes products used by enterprise customers every day. 

We are looking for a Principal AI Research Engineer to set the technical direction for our most ambitious AI initiatives. You will lead research on large language models, speech understanding, and retrieval systems-then translate that research into production capabilities at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world deployment, and who can raise the technical bar across the entire AI organization. 

What You'll Do

- Define and drive the research roadmap for core AI capabilities spanning LLMs, ASR/speech understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic systems.

data.title: Principal AI/ML Engineer Lead
data.description:
Description

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- LLM Engineering Standards Across Agent Pods
 - Define and own LLM engineering standards across all Agent Stream pods - agent framework conventions, prompt lifecycle standards, eval harness design patterns, guardrail implementation, and confidence threshold calibration methodology that all Senior AI/ML Engineers follow. 
 - Own the Langfuse observability framework at platform level - instrumentation standards, trace validation patterns, eval pipeline design, prompt regression testing, and model version regression detection. Pod-level Langfuse usage is consistent because this role defines how it is done. 
 - Standardise RAG pipeline architecture across pods - embedding strategy, vector database selection and management, retrieval strategy, reranking, and structured output design for financial document reasoning. Shared RAG infrastructure is your design. 
 - Review and challenge agent design proposals from pod AI/ML engineers - raise the bar on prompt design, memory architecture, evaluation rigour, and production reliability across the stream. 
 - Contribute to AI/ML hiring - define the technical bar for AI/ML engineers across the stream, participate in interviews, and ensure hiring standards are consistent across pods. 
 - Memory Architecture Ownership
 - Own the memory architecture strategy for the AI Platform - designing the personalised, complex memory layer that agents depend on for continuity, context, and adaptive behaviour across sessions and users. 
 - Design and implement the tiered memory architecture for agent workflows - working memory (in-context), episodic memory (past interactions), semantic memory (extracted facts and preferences), and procedural memory (agent instruction updates). Select and implement the right memory framework for each tier: LangMem for LangGraph-native flows, Mem0 for managed personalisation, Zep/Graphiti for temporal and knowledge-graph reasoning, or Letta for explicit OS-style memory management. 
 - Define memory hygiene standards - extraction policies, deduplication, contradiction resolution, and forgetting policies for agents that write aggressively to memory at scale. 
 - Own context window management strategy - how long-running agent workflows handle context pressure, when to compress, when to retrieve from memory, and how to maintain coherence across multi-step financial close workflows. 
 - Platform AI/ML Contribution
 - Contribute hands-on to Platform Team AI capabilities - working with the Platform Architect on how RAG, memory, and eval infrastructure is exposed as shared platform services that agent pods consume. 
 - Stay current on the LLM and agent engineering landscape - evaluate new frameworks, protocols, and tooling (MCP, A2A, new memory systems, emerging eval approaches) and bring informed recommendations to the Director of Engineering on what to adopt and when. 
 - Identify and address systemic AI/ML quality gaps across pods - inconsistent eval practices, weak guardrail implementations, or memory architectures that will not scale.

 - Strong communication, collaboration, technical leadership, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with Ragas or equivalent RAG evaluation frameworks preferred. 
 - Experience with model fine-tuning or RLHF preferred. 
 - Experience with financial close, Record-to-Report, accounting, or enterprise finance software preferred.

data.title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
data.description:
Description

UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization - establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act - protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet. 

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale. 

This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch. 
 - Improve the static stability of authentication - ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery. 
 - Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet. 
 - Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events. 
 - Own pipeline and release health for SDK components - keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy. 
 - Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews. 
 - Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

data.title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU and SOC
data.description:
NVIDIA is searching for a highly motivated, creative engineer to join the GPU Software team. As a GPU/SOC system software engineer, you will work with a team of very dedicated software and hardware engineers involving a wide variety of technologies. As someone who is hardworking and passionate about their work, you will craft and debug key aspects of our production GPU and SOC kernel drivers and embedded SW, focusing on platform performance, power savings, and robustness. You should demonstrate the ability to excel in an environment with intricate system level interactions. 

What Your Role Entails

- Design, implement and debug changes in the NVIDIA SW stack to take next-gen HW from design / development stage to production, with focus on kernel-mode SW
 - You will follow the devices all the way through the development process to datacenter systems, customer desktops, notebooks, workstations, and gaming console products that are used throughout the world
 - Be heavily involved in emulation, bringup, and product hardening required to build our groundbreaking products
 - Multiple opportunities to collaborate and communicate effectively with teams from all around the globe

What We Need To See

- BS or MS degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
 - 5+ years of relevant software development experience
 - Background in solving problems that apply to sophisticated systems deployed at scale
 - Strong C/C++ programming skills as well as having shown initiative in pursuing independent coding projects
 - Familiarity with computer system architecture, microprocessor, and microcontroller fundamentals (caches, buses, memory controllers, DMA, etc. )
 - Strong Operating systems fundamentals with Kernel experience on Linux or Windows systems

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Background and strength with system-level (SW and HW) debugging is invaluable
 - Windows Driver Models, with WDDM or MCDM a strong plus. 
 - Familiarity with system level security concepts
 - Experience with system software concepts

data.title: Lead Engineer - Process & Operability Engineering
data.description:
Overall target of the position : The Process & Controls Engineer has the responsibility of the on-time delivery of the Project Process engineering documentation according to the valid Work Instructions and Technical Rules, with respect to the Project and contractual requirements, and Company Plant EHS Policy, with technical support from the Process Lead Engineer and Experts. 

Delivering Steam Turbine & Generator Auxiliaries systems in compliance with the Company Rules and Policy, Project, Regulations, Codes and Standards, Contract and Country requirements. 

Tasks & Responsibilities

- Reviews the technical contractual requirements and analyze the rules, codes and standards applicable to Process & Controls engineering. 
 - Identifies the contractual Risks and Opportunities and propose technical deviations and clarifications. 
 - Determines applicability of the project contractual requirements on process & controls engineering scope and ensures the allocation of requirements to document for his/her scope of work in the documents management tool, 
 - Executes (with the other Process & Control engineers of his/her project team and supported by the Lead Engineer Process & controls and by experts) the following Process & Controls engineering activities: 
 - 
 - The Process (mechanical) systems design including: 
 - Process Flow Diagrams, 
 - The P&IDs, 
 - The System Design Manuals including the controls logic diagrams, Electrical and I&C interfaces, 
 - The process electrical load list (list of electrical consumers with process engineering data only), 
 - 
 - The piping interfaces list,

 - Identification of Nuclear Safety Classified Items/Components and Activities in line with Equipment qualification team and supported by the Nuclear Safety Process Engineer,

 - The Reliability Availability and Maintainability (RAM) studies.

 - Is responsible for Design control and Design freeze process for his/her scope, complying with applicable configuration management procedures, 
 - Analyses Customer comments and Technical Queries and prepare related answers, 
 - Ensures technical check for process engineering deliverables done by other process engineer(s) to maximize the quality level, 
 - Contributes to the Plant Operation and Control Concept, 
 - Prepares and manage mechanical and functional interfaces with internal participants (product lines, mechanical packages) and external parties (customer, general designer, partner, supplier) and take actions if necessary (MCL), 
 - Supplies and reviews of Process Operating and Design Data for circuits in EDB, 
 - Participates in design and/or technical reviews (internal/external) and prepares the associated reports, 
 - Participates in various coordination meetings (liaison, conciliation, workshops, etc. . . ) with customer/general designer/partner. 
 - Ensures that the arrangement and the piping routing correspond to the process requirements, 
 - Coordinates and provides the Process & Controls documentations "as built" revisions and collect the REX from site. 
 - Participates in control system FAT (test preparation, tests and subsequent actions after tests). 
 - Ensures timely responses on Process & Controls issues raised internally by other engineering disciplines. 
 - Supports the site Construction and Commissioning staff through troubleshooting, claim management supporting, Close-Out punch lists to obtain PAC and FAC with the Customers, review major software and mechanical modifications (eg FSI preparation). 
 - Contributes Operating Instructions, 
 - Prepares reply of Non Conformance Reports (NCR) and take the necessary actions, 
 - Ensures the feedback of experience from the project via the Lead Engineer, 
 - Provides information to prepare the engineering progress upon request by Lead Engineer, 
 - Reports to the Lead Engineer Process the status of the assigned tasks. 

Qualification Profile

Education and Experience: 

- Bachelor degree in Mechanical or Instrumentation and control engineering or equivalent degree, 
 - At least 10 years professional experience in Process & Control Engineering within Power Plant Engineering, 
 - Site experience (3 months preferable), 

Specific Knowledge And Skills

- Engineering in his/her technical field and with interface clarification beyond his/her field, 
 - Good knowledge in other disciplines (i. e. products specifications, layout & arrangement, electrical design) involved in Power Plant engineering, 
 - Detailed knowledge of power plant water/steam cycles and/or ST auxiliary systems and/or generator auxiliary systems and, 
 - Basic knowledge of Company's products: Steam Turbine, Generator, Heat exchangers and Pumps, 
 - Computer familiarity (Word, Excel, Outlook, Pdf editor, . . . . . ), 
 - Knowledge about CAD tools: Autocad, Visio, Naviswork, etc. . . 
 - Fluent in English (good standard in reading, written and spoken is mandatory), 
 - Strong technical and scientific know-how and willingness to continuously extend and develop it, 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills, enjoys personal contact

data.title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
As a Principal Data Platform Engineer at RWS, you will be the most senior technical authority on our data platform. You will architect and implement a scalable Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data platform, setting the engineering standards, patterns and guardrails that the wider Data Engineering team builds on. This is a hands-on role: you will write the Terraform, the pipelines and the automation that make the platform repeatable, secure and cost-effective at scale. 

You'll own the platform end to end - from infrastructure as code and CI/CD through to the data pipelines running on top of it - and you'll push the boundaries of how we deliver, including leveraging AI agents to scale up pipeline delivery. Your work will directly enable our Analytics and AI teams to build the future of global language services. If you enjoy designing systems that other engineers depend on, you'll find a home here. 

About Product & Technology

Product & Technology plays a pivotal role in aligning the organization with its strategic objectives and enhancing shareholder value. Product & Technology is responsible for establishing unified standards and governance practices throughout the company. Additionally, we oversee the development and maintenance of core applications essential for the seamless operation of various functions across the organization. We are committed to driving and executing future roadmaps that are in line with the overall strategic direction of RWS. 

With a global reach, Product & Technology provides support services to over 7500 end users worldwide. We take pride in managing the information security operation and safeguarding all our assets. Our core functions encompass Enterprise & Technical Architecture, Network & Voice, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Service Operations, Data & Analytics, Security & Quality Compliance, Transformation, Application Development, Enterprise Platforms, With a dedicated team of over 500 staff, Product & Technology ensures a strong presence across all regions, enabling efficient and effective support to our global operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Job Overview

- Architect the GCP Data Platform: You'll design and implement a scalable, secure GCP data platform that serves as the foundation for analytics and AI across RWS. 
 - Build Infrastructure as Code: You'll create a reusable, modular Terraform codebase so that provisioning new environments and data products is fast and repeatable. 
 - Automate Delivery: You'll implement CI/CD pipelines that give us automated, controlled and auditable deployments of both infrastructure and data code. 
 - Engineer Data Pipelines: You'll design and build pipelines using native GCP services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform, Cloud Composer and Knowledge Catalog. 
 - Scale Delivery with AI: You'll leverage AI agents and automation to accelerate pipeline delivery and raise the throughput of the wider engineering team.

 - Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design

Commercial

 - Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements

 - The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services. 
 - Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - The applicant should ideally have obtained British Chartered Engineer status or equivalent, possess a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and possess membership to an accredited engineering body.

data.title: Senior Manager, Data & Integrations
data.description:
Job Description

Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations

Summary/Objective

The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U. S. -based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization. 

Core Job Duties

- Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines. 
 - Conduct 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team. 
 - Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization. 
 - Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively. 
 - Partner with U. S. -based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones. 
 - Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U. S. data and integrations teams. 
 - Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems. 
 - Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards. 
 - Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution. 
 - Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch. 
 - Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect. 
 - Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e. g. , Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards. 
 - Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e. g. , Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers. 
 - Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns. 
 - Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions. 
 - Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work. 
 - Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U. S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones. 
 - Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U. S. counterparts as needed. 
 - Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U. S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity. 

Job Complexity

Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities. 

Interaction

Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U. S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U. S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones. 

Supervision

Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently. 

Experience

Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work. 
 - 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 
 - Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U. S. -based counterparts across time zones. 
 - Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e. g. , Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato). 
 - Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work. 
 - Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e. g. , Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e. g. , Great Expectations, dbt tests). 
 - Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration. 
 - Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e. g. , Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require. 
 - Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization. 
 - Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution. 
 - Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations. 
 - Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic. 
 - Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently address complex, cross-regional challenges. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across geographies, time zones, and cultures. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate global priorities and standards into local execution plans. 
 - Preferred Qualifications: 
 - Direct hands-on experience with Workato
 - Experience with Parabola. io or comparable low-code automation tools
 - Familiarity with streaming/real-time data technologies (e. g. , Kafka, Event Hubs) as a complement to batch pipeline experience
 - Hands-on experience with big data ecosystem services such as Hadoop, Hive, HBase, YARN, and Spark
 - Professional services or customer-facing implementation experience
 - Experience operating in a follow-the-sun or globally distributed delivery model
Position Details

Physical Demands: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 

Travel Required: Yes, up to 15% travel may be required, including periodic travel to the U. S. for team and stakeholder alignment. 

Work Authorization: Employee must be legally authorized to work in India. 

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Location: India (Hybrid/Remote)

Required Qualifications
