data.title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished Application Dev Lead to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL), have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions. 

This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Leadership & People Management

- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms. 
 - Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization. 
 - Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs). 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals. 
 - SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery. 

Technical & Domain Responsibilities

- Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern). 
 - Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments. 
 - High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption. 
 - Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices. 
 - Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers. 
 - Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards. 
 - High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing. 

Recommended Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

- Java & Microservices: 
 - Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC). 
 - Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch). 
 - Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing). 
 - Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
 - Database & Data Persistence: 
 - Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering. 
 - Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE). 
 - Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks). 
 - Enterprise Middleware & Messaging: 
 - Subject Matter Expertise in TIBCO technologies: TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW 5. x / 6. x), TIBCO Enterprise Message Service (EMS), TIBCO Administrator/TEA. 
 - In-depth experience with enterprise queuing and streaming: IBM MQ and Apache Kafka (Topic design, Partitioning, Consumer Groups, Schema Registry). 
 - APIs & Protocols: 
 - Contract-first API development: RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger, SOAP Web Services, gRPC. 
 - Data formatting & transformation: JSON, XML, XSD, WSDL, XPath, XSLT, and Canonical Data Modeling. 
 - Security & Cryptography: 
 - Solid foundation in transport and application security: SSL/TLS 1. 3, Mutual TLS (mTLS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Keystores/Truststores, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, and API Key/Token management. 
 - DevOps, CI/CD & Observability: 
 - Build & CI/CD toolchains: Git, Maven, Gradle, Harness, TeamCity, Jenkins, uDeploy. 
 - Comprehensive monitoring & logging: Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Micrometer, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin). 
Good To Have Skills

 - Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD). 
 - Familiarity with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and Spring Boot Test. 
 - Experience with API contract testing tools (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract) and performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling). 
 - Knowledge of automated code quality gates and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkstyle). 
Banking Domain Expertise

- Deep expertise in banking and financial services integration architecture and enterprise application patterns. 
 - Proven experience with real-time fraud detection pipelines, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, NACHA/ACH, RTP), core ledger accounting, and trade/transaction processing systems. 
 - In-depth knowledge of real-time transactional flows, straight-through processing (STP), guaranteed exactly-once delivery, idempotency key patterns, and high-volume messaging resilience.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management, technical communication, and presentation skills across technical teams and executive business sponsors.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Expert - AI/ML for Industry AI
data.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging - but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 

In this role, you design, build, and operate AI native enterprise applications that combine cloud native software engineering with production grade machine learning and agentic AI capabilities being embedded directly within customer environments and fast-moving delivery teams. You work closely with customers to translate ambiguous business and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions, to solve complex real world business problems at speed owning technical delivery from discovery and prototyping through deployment, stabilization, and successful handover to platform or operations teams. You are accountable for the technical quality, reliability, and impact of application solutions within your scope. Working closely with product, data, ML, and customer teams, you apply modern AI assisted engineering practices and architectural guardrails aligned with SAP standards to enable responsible and scalable AI adoption. 

What You Bring

- Extensive hands-on experience in software and application engineering (14+ years) for cloud-native, enterprise, and SaaS environments, with strong knowledge of architectural principles such as scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Proven ability to design and deliver AI-native applications, utilizing large language models, RAG architectures, vector databases, and agentic systems to innovate enterprise workflows. 
 - Strong proficiency in widely used AI/ML Python libraries and frameworks
 - Exposure to data pipelines and MLOps practices
 - Skilled in integrating Agentic AI into complex business processes, ensuring responsible and effective use of AI agents within enterprise operations. 
 - Solid architectural foundation across cloud platforms, distributed systems, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Experience owning solutions across the full application lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and production operations. 
 - Ability to work effectively with cross functional teams and customer stakeholders, communicating complex technical topics clearly. 
 - Learning mindset, technical leadership, and accountability in high impact, ambiguous environments
 - You demonstrate a proactive approach to leveraging AI in everyday workflows, ensuring high‐quality outputs through thoughtful context design and system integration

What You Build

In this role, you will: 

- Design, develop, and operate production‐grade, cloud‐native enterprise applications integrating AI capabilities such as large language models, retrieval‐augmented generation, and agent‐based workflows. 
 - Embed directly into customer projects and fast moving cross functional teams to rapidly understand business processes, technical landscapes, and operational challenges. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into robust application architectures, balancing speed, quality, security, and long‐term maintainability. 
 - Rapidly prototype, iterate, and productionize solutions in customer environments, adapting reference architectures and reusable assets to real world enterprise constraints. 
 - Own application delivery end‐to‐end, from problem framing and prototyping through deployment, observability, and production operations. 
 - Apply AI‐assisted engineering practices, evaluation frameworks, and architectural guardrails to ensure compliant, trustworthy, and high‐quality solutions. 
 - Ensure delivery milestones, quality standards, and technical objectives are met, proactively managing risks and technical escalations within scope. 
 - Act as a key technical interface to customers and internal stakeholders, clearly communicating solution approaches, trade‐offs, and progress. 
 - Contribute to engineering standards, best practices, and reusable components to improve efficiency and consistency across solutions

Where you Belong

You will be part of a growing AI and industry expert team dedicated to serving customers across the region (Americas, Europe, Asia). We are building a collaborative, high-impact environment that brings together deep AI expertise, strong industry knowledge, and regional understanding to help customers innovate, transform, and lead in their markets. 

This team thrives on working together to turn complex business challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You will find an environment that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning, where new ideas are encouraged and real-world impact matters. This is a place for people who enjoy building something new. You will thrive here if you are customer-centric, motivated by meaningful outcomes, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-evolving AI landscape. 

We work closely with decision-makers, challenge assumptions with data, and give data scientists room to influence strategy-not just produce analysis. We value sharp thinking, business curiosity, and clear communication. 

#SAPIndustryAICareers

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. 

We win with inclusion

SAP's culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone - regardless of background - feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. 

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap. com. 

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. 

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements. 

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

data.description:
Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI

Role Overview

Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren't a traditional gatekeeper-you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale. 

This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity. 

As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly. 

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization

- Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems. 
 - Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling. 
 - Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance. 
 - Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e. g. , self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting). 
 - Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources. 
 - Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities. 

Data & AI Infrastructure

- Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads. 
 - Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost. 
 - Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases. 
 - Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems. 

Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture

- Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution. 
 - Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns. 
 - Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions. 

GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy

- You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle. 
 - You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization. 
 - Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability. 

Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership

- Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape. 
 - Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams. 
 - Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence. 
 - Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health. 
 - Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes. 

Who You Are

- Strategic Visionary-you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps. 
 - Ultra-technical-you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach. 
 - System-First Thinker-you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision. 
 - Cloud-Native Expert-you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance. 
 - Pragmatic Decision Maker-your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed. 
 - Builder's Mentality-you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption. 
 - Growth-Oriented Mentor-you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy. 

Must-Have Skills & Experience

- 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms. 
 - Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e. g. , EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus. 
 - Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution-understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies. 
 - Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems. 
 - Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker). 
 - Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin). 
 - Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards. 
 - Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team - the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1. 5 billion risk calculations every day. 

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core - providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale. 

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability. 

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform. 

Responsibilities

Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: 

Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards. 

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: 

Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning. 

Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250, 000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.

 - Exposure to NoSQL databases (e. g. , MongoDB, Cassandra) is a plus.

Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering

Location: Pune (Hybrid)

Line of Business: Compliance Technology / Enterprise Technology

About The Role

Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?

At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the Head of Product and Engineering, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms. 

In this dual-hatted role, you will: 

Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms: Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms. 

Serve as the India Site Lead: Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site. 

This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Strategy , Platform Unification and Product Management
 - Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform. 
 - Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency. 
 - AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine. 
 - Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability. 
 - Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders

 - Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes. 
 - India Site Leadership
 - Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs. 
 - Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies. 
 - Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies. 

Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture

We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack: 

- Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
 - Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e. g. , Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
 - Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
 - AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

What We're Looking For (Qualifications)

Basic Qualifications: 

- Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
 - Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications. 
 - Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale. 
 - Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects. 
 - Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience. 
 - Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e. g. , Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Why Join Citi?

- Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk. 
 - True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals. 
 - Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery. 

And many more reasons. . .

data.title: Technical Expert - Agentic Systems
data.description:
Location: Bangalore. 

Function: Software Engineering

Reports to: Manager, Esko AI

About The Role

The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions - and invoke expert human judgement when required. This is a complex engineering problem that goes beyond the boundaries of standard agentic scenarios. 

We're looking for a Technical Expert to take technical ownership of core agentic capabilities within Esko's AI Platform, from experimentation and design through production implementation. be a senior authority and author on agentic AI across Esko's AI Platform. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management one: you'll set direction and raise the bar through writing code, leading experiments, writing documentation, and mentorship of team members for a platform that spans multiple agentic capabilities (knowledge & reasoning, tool use and orchestration, evaluation, and safety/guardrails) and which is used by many product teams across the business. 

You should bring experience from multiple agentic AI projects with a similar order of complexity in terms of the technical challenges you have successfully tackled, together with a 'sixth sense' for agentic AI operation to predict the approaches which are likely yield successful results as the platform grows into new domains. 

What You Will Do

- Go deep on the hardest technical problems inside the agentic AI platform - the ones where progress depends on specialist expertise, not just engineering effort: data discovery & consolidation, agent planning and tool-use, retrieval and grounding, validation-before-action, conflict/ambiguity handling, and similar hard sub-problems. 
 - Personally design, build, and harden the platform's most technically demanding components - the pieces where correctness, edge cases, and failure modes are subtle enough to need deep, hands-on ownership rather than delegation. 
 - Act as the team's go-to technical expert on agentic AI and LLM systems: the person others bring their hardest "how do we actually make this work" problems to, providing depth on specific technical questions rather than setting overall team direction.

 - Evaluate emerging techniques, frameworks, and tools in agentic AI and LLM tooling, and give the team pragmatic, evidence-based recommendations on what's worth adopting. 
 - Write technical deep-dives and documentation that make complex mechanisms legible to the rest of the team, so your expertise compounds rather than staying tacit. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language.

 - Excellent technical communication - able to write RFCs and architectural documents that align diverse stakeholders, and to move fluently between deeply technical and business audiences.

Preferred Experience

In this role, you will be instrumental in building high-scale, low-latency AI solutions applied to Fraud Mitigation, Risk Scoring, and Loss Prevention across US Retail Banking products

- Key Responsibilities

AI/ML & Generative AI Architecture

data.title: Generative AI Quality Engineer - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering - from Agentic AI flow testing and RAG pipeline validation to AI safety, test automation, and performance & reliability engineering. 

You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines. 

Responsibilities

Agentic AI Testing

- Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e. g. , ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion). 
 - Test tool-use correctness - ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time. 
 - Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions. 
 - Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e. g. , AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph). 
 - Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops. 

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing

- Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines - covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages. 
 - Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance - ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query. 
 - Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora. 
 - Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval. 
 - Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality. 
 - Validate context window management - ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality. 
 - Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes. 
 - Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns. 

Test Automation

- Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation. 
 - Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation. 
 - Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data. 
 - Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes. 
 - Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions. 
 - Automate vector database validation - index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks. 

AI Safety & Security Testing

- Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems. 
 - Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior. 
 - Validate privilege escalation controls - ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources. 
 - Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness. 
 - Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas. 
 - Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies. 
 - Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including: 
 - Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
 - Insecure Output Handling
 - Training Data Poisoning
 - Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
 - Sensitive Information Disclosure
 - Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity. 
 - Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management. 
 - Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations. 
Performance & Reliability Testing

- Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services. 
 - Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines - from query to final response. 
 - Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure. 
 - Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions. 
 - Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation. 
 - Test vector database performance - query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency. 
 - Conduct cost efficiency analysis - measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task. 
 - Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates. 
 - Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems. 
 - Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures. 

Domain Knowledge

- Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns - naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG. 
 - Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers). 
 - Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization. 
 - Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards. 
 - Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents). 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements. 
 - Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos). 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Master's degree is a plus. 

Experience

- 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI. 
 - Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems. 
 - Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

 - Work in a multi functional team passionate about Silicon characterization and correlation to pre-Silicon Performance and Power models. 
 - Responsible for generating ATPG patterns for Silicon speed path debug. 
 - RTL and gate level verification for ATPG, non-ATPG patterns. 
 - Correlating diagnosis result to map to real design failures. Root cause the same feed learnings to pre-silicon design sign off parameters.

Description

Join our Retail Business Services team and help shape the shopping experience for millions of Amazon customers worldwide. You'll work on solving complex, high-impact problems across catalog management, supply chain optimization, and retail operations-using your technical expertise to build scalable solutions that drive real business results. 

Key job responsibilities

- Evaluate emerging technologies and cloud infrastructure solutions to enhance our operational capabilities and system performance
 - Lead incident management activities, including on-call responsibilities, and conduct thorough root cause analysis to prevent future issues
 - Develop and implement automation solutions that improve stability, reliability, and scalability across our systems
 - Collaborate with peers across teams to identify opportunities for solving problems that enhance customer experience
 - Contribute to operational excellence initiatives by designing robust processes and systems that support our retail operations at scale

A day in the life

As a Support Engineer on our team, you'll divide your time between multiple impactful areas. You might start your morning reviewing incident reports and collaborating with operations teams to identify root causes of system issues. Later, you could be designing automation solutions that leverage machine learning to streamline catalog enrichment or supply chain defect resolution. You'll participate in on-call rotations, working through complex technical challenges alongside your teammates. Throughout the day, you'll engage with different parts of the organization-from retail operations to engineering teams-to understand their needs and translate them into technical solutions. Your work directly influences how customers discover and purchase products on Amazon. 

About The Team

We're a collaborative group of engineers, operations specialists, and technical leaders united by a shared mission: ensuring Amazon's catalog is complete, accurate, and comprehensive so customers have a seamless shopping experience. Our team values deep expertise and continuous learning. Whether you prefer mastering a specific domain, coordinating across multiple initiatives during critical moments, or focusing on methodical process improvement, there's a place for you here. We celebrate knowledge sharing through mentorship, code reviews, and technical conversations with senior engineers. We're committed to supporting your growth while maintaining a healthy work-life balance-we believe the right flow between your professional and personal life is essential to long-term success and happiness. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of software development, or 4+ years of technical support experience
 - Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
 - Experience scripting in modern program languages

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed applications/enterprise applications

 - Experience operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Arm is redefining what is possible in cloud and data center computing. Our Neoverse platforms are helping power a new era of infrastructure - combining advanced silicon with the system software required to turn ambitious technology into production-ready solutions. 

Are you excited by solving complex system-level problems, leading engineers and ensuring sophisticated SoC platforms are ready for production?

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in the infrastructure solutions software team in our CE-SW group. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for leading and developing a local engineering team. The focus will be on driving the validation and productisation of our infrastructure platforms, with strong collaboration across software engineering, quality, test and release functions. 

Come and make an impact at scale!

Responsibilities

You will: 

- Lead and develop a team of software engineers at your site, providing technical direction, coaching and career development while remaining hands-on in solving complex engineering challenges. 
 - Drive system validation and productisation for Infrastructure System Solutions, establishing effective validation plans, quality criteria and approaches to product readiness. 
 - Advance scalable test infrastructure, CI, regression capabilities and quality metrics to improve coverage, efficiency and confidence throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate across Arm locations and engineering teams to manage dependencies, resolve complex system-level issues and drive effective execution across pre-silicon and silicon environments. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Strong experience in testing complex system software, with a technical background in SoC, firmware, platform software or system-level validation across pre-silicon and/or silicon environments. 
 - Proven experience leading and developing software engineers, combining line management with strong hands-on technical leadership. 
 - Strong knowledge of software quality, validation methodologies, automated testing, CI and product readiness for complex systems. 
 - Excellent technical judgement, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams and geographical locations. 

"Nice To Have" Skills And Experience

- Knowledge of server-class SoCs, including RAS, power management, PCI Express (PCIe), Compute Express Link (CXL), memory and virtualization. 
 - Familiarity with the Linux kernel, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), UEFI EDK II, OpenBMC or Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM). 
 - Experience with automated system validation, hardware test environments, server farms or continuous integration infrastructure. 

In Return

At Arm, we're shaping the future of infrastructure computing and turning advanced technology into production-ready solutions. This role offers the scope to influence our products, engineering practices and teams while contributing to some of our most sophisticated platforms. 

Join us and help shape world-class infrastructure technology at Arm!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you.

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

About The Role

At ThoughtSpot, we're building the future of analytics with AI at the core. As a Member of Technical Staff, you'll join a team of world-class engineers working on technologies that power our next-generation analytics platform. From distributed systems and high-performance backend services to AI-powered search and natural language understanding, you'll work on challenging engineering problems at scale while learning from experienced mentors. This is an opportunity to build products that are used by some of the world's leading enterprises and make an impact from day one. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems that process large volumes of data with high performance and reliability.

 - Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of core platform components.

 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices. 
 - Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, debugging, and problem-solving with experienced engineers.

What You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.

 - Good understanding of core Computer Science fundamentals, including Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Databases, and Distributed Systems.

 - Curiosity to learn, ownership, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative engineering environment. 
 - Internship, academic projects, or hands-on experience in backend systems, distributed systems, cloud technologies, or AI/ML is a plus. 

In-Office at ThoughtSpot

Spotters are expected in-office 3+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed. 

About ThoughtSpot

The world's most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot's AI-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision-making into a truly data-driven culture. 

At ThoughtSpot, we're a curious, data-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That's why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation. 

Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles

Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to: 

- Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality. 
 - Hands-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality. 
 - Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions. 
 - Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools. 

Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset: 

- Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
 - Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
 - Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary

This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it's required for every role at ThoughtSpot. 

AI Mindset for All Spotters

At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work. 

All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot's AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI. 

ThoughtSpot for All

At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you're a strong match, we encourage you to apply. 

What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?

ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives - this balance-for-the-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world-class products. If you're excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that's right for you.

Citi is looking for an experienced e-Trading Technology Quality Assurance (QA) Senior Analyst to play a pivotal role in safeguarding the integrity of electronic trading platforms within a high-velocity, globally connected Capital Markets technology environment. In this role, you will own quality assurance across the full testing lifecycle - from UAT strategy through to production rollout - directly influencing the reliability and regulatory compliance of trading systems used at scale. You will operate as a senior quality leader, mentoring colleagues, shaping testing standards, and coordinating across global technology and business teams to drive consistent, measurable quality outcomes. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end quality assurance across UAT and production rollout cycles for electronic trading platforms, including validation of Futures and Options products, algorithmic Trading and Execution Platform, and electronic order management workflows. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain automated test suites using Java and Cucumber within a Behavior-Driven Development framework, ensuring test coverage aligns with system and regulatory requirements. 
 - Define and enforce quality standards and testing procedures across the software development lifecycle, conducting annual reviews and recommending improvements to keep practices current and effective. 
 - Monitor products and processes for conformance to established standards, identify quality risks, perform root cause analysis, and deliver clearly documented remediation recommendations. 
 - Validate system behavior against FIX protocol specifications and electronic trading regulatory obligations, ensuring trading platform outputs meet both technical and compliance benchmarks. 
 - Act as a quality advisor and mentor to junior team members, providing guidance on testing approaches, standards adherence, and professional development within IT Quality. 
 - Assess quality-related risks in business and technology decisions, escalating control issues transparently and ensuring all corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and resolved to completion. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- 9-13 years experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle from test strategy through to production validation. 
 - Must - Hands-on experience testing electronic trading platforms, including a solid working knowledge of Futures and Options products, Capital Markets and Derivatives domains, order types, and electronic trading processes. 
 - Must - Demonstrated experience testing e-Trading lifecycles and workflows as well experience of trading algorithms such as TWAP, VWAP, Iceberg etc. with the ability to validate algorithmic behavior against defined specifications. 
 - Proficiency in test automation using Java and Cucumber within a BDD Behavior-Driven Development framework, including the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts independently. 
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments such as ECS, and version control using GitHub, enabling effective integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows. 
 - Good understanding of the FIX protocol and regulatory obligations for electronic trading, with the ability to validate system behavior against these standards in a structured and auditable way. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication and coordination skills, with the ability to align project teams, vendors, and global counterparts on quality outcomes across complex, multi-geography programs. 

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

- Project management experience in a fast-paced, time-to-market driven technology environment, with the ability to manage quality workstreams across concurrent deliverables. 
 - Experience contributing to the development of new testing standards and procedures in collaboration with cross-functional technology teams. 
 - Familiarity with process audit methodologies and the ability to conduct structured product evaluation and conformance assessments.

data.title: Quality Engineering Lead – Data & Reporting Platforms
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced VP, Quality Engineering Lead to define, build, and drive our automated data and report testing strategy. In this role, you will lead the Quality Engineering (QE) initiatives for our next-generation, AI-powered data and reporting ecosystem. 

As a hands-on leader, you will design robust automated test suites to validate complex data architectures-specifically focusing on data virtualization, massive data federation, data contract testing, and the verification of emerging natural language/conversational AI query interfaces. You will manage a talented team of quality engineers, establish testing standards, and collaborate closely with engineering, and product teams to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant data and report delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
 - Data & Reporting Test Strategy: Architect and execute a comprehensive, end-to-end automated testing strategy covering data virtualization, federated queries, BI/reporting, and AI-enabled analytical interfaces. 
 - Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and functionally manage a specialized team of Data & Report Quality Engineers, fostering a culture of modern Quality Engineering (QE) and continuous improvement. 
 - Governance & Compliance: Define operating standards, automated quality gates, and data verification protocols across the analytics and reporting delivery lifecycle. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Own the reporting of quality metrics, pipeline coverage, and test automation maturity to senior global technology and engineering leaders. 
 - Data Virtualization & Federation Testing
 - Federated Query & Virtualization Validation: Develop automated testing frameworks to validate query execution, latency, and data integrity across massive federated query engines and data virtualization platforms (e. g. , Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill) connecting dozens of heterogeneous catalogs without physical data movement. 
 - Data Contract & Schema Validation: Implement automated schema validation and data contract testing to ensure curated, virtualized data products strictly adhere to published business definitions and system requirements. 
 - Access Control & Security Testing: Design data-driven security tests to verify that centralized data access governance (e. g. , Apache Ranger, role/attribute-based access controls) and data masking are flawlessly applied. 
 - AI & Conversational Intelligence Testing
 - Natural Language Query Testing: Establish frameworks to test conversational AI interfaces that allow users to query data using natural language. Validate natural language processing (NLP) models, intent recognition, NLP-to-SQL translation logic, and the accuracy of the underlying datasets returned. 
 - Autonomous Agent Verification: Design testing patterns for non-deterministic AI agents (e. g. , automated alerting systems and contextual research assistants), validating logical outputs, threshold actions, and boundary limits. 
 - Big Data & Reporting Platform Testing
 - Report & Dashboard Verification: Devise automated strategies to test visual correctness, performance, and backend data reconciliation for BI platforms (e. g. , Tableau, custom web-based dashboards) during large-scale migration phases of legacy systems (comprising hundreds of reports). 
 - Data Lakehouse & Pipeline Testing: Lead automation efforts validating complex data pipelines across hybrid databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and modern analytical lakehouses. 
 - Data Reconciliation: Design and automate source-to-target data reconciliation, schema drift detection, and data lineage validation to ensure reports match underlying source systems perfectly. 
 - CI/CD & Test Automation Engineering
 - Continuous Quality Pipelines: Seamlessly integrate data and report automation suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab, etc. ) to trigger continuous verification with each deployment code path. 
 - Triage & Defect Management: Champion structured defect triage, prioritizations, and root cause analysis across complex, multi-tiered data and reporting infrastructure environments. 

Technology Skills

Required Technical Skillsets

- Data Virtualization & Federation: Hands-on experience with enterprise data virtualization or query federation platforms, such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill. 
 - BI & Reporting Platforms: Deep expertise in testing BI and reporting platforms (e. g. , Tableau, custom web-based dashboards, Aspose, or similar reporting engines). 
 - Database Querying & Testing: Advanced SQL expertise with hands-on experience testing relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases. 
 - Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python or Java to build, maintain, and scale custom test automation frameworks. 
 - API Testing: Strong experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and data contract validation using tools like Postman, RestAssured, or custom scripts. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Experience integrating automated data test suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing. 
 - Test Methodologies: Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, functional, integration, regression, and parallel-run testing for large-scale migrations. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skillsets

- Modern Lakehouse & Warehouse Platforms: Familiarity with cloud-native data platforms, such as Databricks or Snowflake (experience with Google BigQuery is also valued). 
 - Distributed Data Processing Engines: Familiarity with distributed compute engines, specifically Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink for large-scale data processing. 
 - Data Quality Automation: Experience implementing automated data quality frameworks using industry-standard tools such as Great Expectations, dbt test, Soda / SodaCL, or Deequ / PyDeequ. 
 - AI/ML & NLP Testing: Experience testing LLM-backed applications, validating Natural Language-to-SQL engines (e. g. , conversational query interfaces), prompt validation, and autonomous agent testing. 

Leadership & Methodology

- Agile QE Leadership: Strong experience running QA cycles within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, managing sprint closures, and collaborating with cross-functional Dev/Product leads. 
 - Test Strategy Design: Proven track record of designing multi-layered testing strategies (unit, integration, regression, system, and regression parallel runs for migrations). 

Experience & Qualifications

- Total Testing Experience: Minimum 10-12 years of relevant experience in software testing, quality engineering, or data engineering. 
 - Data Automation Experience: Minimum 5-8 years of hands-on experience in automated data testing, ETL testing, or data pipeline quality engineering. 
 - BI & Analytics Verification: Minimum 5-8 years of experience in report/BI testing, data reconciliation, and source-to-target data validation. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent engineering field.

data.title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering - from Agentic AI flow testing and RAG pipeline validation to AI safety, test automation, and performance & reliability engineering. 

You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines. 

Responsibilities

Agentic AI Testing

- Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e. g. , ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion). 
 - Test tool-use correctness - ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time. 
 - Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions. 
 - Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e. g. , AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph). 
 - Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops. 

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing

- Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines - covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages. 
 - Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance - ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query. 
 - Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora. 
 - Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval. 
 - Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality. 
 - Validate context window management - ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality. 
 - Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes. 
 - Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns. 

Test Automation

- Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation. 
 - Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation. 
 - Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data. 
 - Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes. 
 - Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions. 
 - Automate vector database validation - index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks. 

AI Safety & Security Testing

- Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems. 
 - Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior. 
 - Validate privilege escalation controls - ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources. 
 - Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness. 
 - Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas. 
 - Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies. 
 - Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including: 
 - Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
 - Insecure Output Handling
 - Training Data Poisoning
 - Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
 - Sensitive Information Disclosure
 - Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity. 
 - Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management. 
 - Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations. 
Performance & Reliability Testing

- Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services. 
 - Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines - from query to final response. 
 - Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure. 
 - Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions. 
 - Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation. 
 - Test vector database performance - query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency. 
 - Conduct cost efficiency analysis - measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task. 
 - Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates. 
 - Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems. 
 - Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures. 

Domain Knowledge

- Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns - naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG. 
 - Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers). 
 - Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization. 
 - Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards. 
 - Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents). 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements. 
 - Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos). 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Master's degree is a plus. 

Experience

- 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI. 
 - Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems. 
 - Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.
