data.title: Guidewire Technical Architect – Jutro / JDP
data.description:
Summary

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI-enabled delivery. We work as one global team, combining deep product expertise, implementation excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement to help customers realize value faster. Our environment is collaborative, customer-obsessed, and innovation-driven, centered on Guidewire InsuranceSuite and the Guidewire Cloud Platform. 

As a Guidewire Architect focused on ClaimCenter / Jutro, you will define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for complex Guidewire implementations, modernization programs, and digital transformation initiatives across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will provide architectural leadership for ClaimCenter implementations, claims transformation programs, and digital experience solutions built using Jutro, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions that accelerate customer value. 

This role is ideal for a hands-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers' path to value while contributing to Professional Services' mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation. 

Job Description

What you'll do

- Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro-based digital solutions across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring alignment with customer enterprise architecture and Guidewire best practices. 
 - Lead solution design and implementation, including ClaimCenter configuration and customization (Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, integrations, and plugins) and/or Jutro digital experience architecture, UI design, and portal development, delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Architect and oversee complex integrations between Guidewire applications and enterprise systems such as policy administration, billing, CRM, document management, data platforms, and third-party services using APIs, web services, messaging, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Provide technical leadership to cross-functional delivery teams through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering governance, driving quality, reusability, automation, and best-in-class delivery practices. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, architects, and customer teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions that address performance, availability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence. 
 - Champion cloud adoption, AI-enabled delivery, and automation initiatives to accelerate implementation timelines, improve productivity, and establish repeatable delivery patterns across programs. 
 - Contribute to organizational assets including accelerators, reference architectures, technical standards, and thought leadership while promoting knowledge sharing across Guidewire, customer, and partner teams globally. 
 - At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI-empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes. 

Required

What you'll bring

- Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, automation, and data-driven insights to improve delivery efficiency, solution quality, and customer outcomes. 
 - 10-18 years of software engineering and architecture experience, including significant hands-on expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro, with experience leading at least two large-scale implementation, modernization, or cloud transformation programs. 
 - Deep expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter configuration and architecture, including Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, activities, integrations, plugins, and Guidewire development best practices; or strong expertise in Jutro architecture and development, including digital portals, UI frameworks, component design, and customer-facing insurance applications. 
 - Guidewire ClaimCenter ACE Certification, Jutro certification, or equivalent Guidewire implementation credentials preferred. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering complex integrations using REST APIs, web services, messaging frameworks, and event-driven architectures across Guidewire and enterprise ecosystems. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, cloud-native architecture, performance optimization, security best practices, scalability, resiliency, and non-functional requirements for mission-critical applications. 
 - Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences in Agile delivery environments. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams, customers, and time zones. 

Preferred

- Experience with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP), including cloud-native implementation patterns, observability, DevOps, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Proven success leading ClaimCenter Cloud, Jutro digital transformation, or Guidewire modernization programs leveraging automation and AI-enabled delivery approaches. 
 - Familiarity with other Guidewire products such as PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, Data Platform, and Analytics. 
 - Experience with modern microservices, API-first architectures, event-driven systems, and digital experience platforms. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Your Impact

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - IPv6 Networking exp is a must**
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

About the Role

SonicWall is seeking a Senior Software Engineer  with deep IPv6 expertise to lead the design, implementation, and hardening of IPv6 capabilities across the Sonicwall firewall firmware stack. As a Principal Engineer, you will be the technical authority for IPv6 feature parity, protocol correctness, and interoperability across SonicWall Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms. This role is ideal for engineers with hands-on experience delivering IPv6 in high-performance router, switch, or carrier-grade networking products who are looking to apply that expertise in the embedded network security domain. 

Responsibilities

- Lead IPv6 Architecture & Feature Delivery - Own end-to-end design and implementation of IPv6 features across the Sonicwall frewall networking stack, including IPv6 routing, interface addressing, DHCPv6, NDP, MLDv2, and IPv6 Policy-Based Routing (PBR). 
 - Drive IPv6 Feature Parity - Identify and close gaps between IPv4 and IPv6 feature sets across subsystems - including VPN Tunnel Interfaces, IPsec/IKEv2, SSL-VPN, Syslog, SNMP, and NAT64 - ensuring consistent dual-stack and IPv6-only operation. 
 - Design High-Performance IPv6 Packet Processing Paths - Architect and optimize the IPv6 dataplane for packet forwarding, classification, ACL matching, and session lookup within the sonicwall high-performance packet-processing pipeline. 
 - Resolve Complex IPv6 Protocol Issues - Diagnose and resolve deep-rooted interoperability, conformance, and performance issues involving IPv6 neighbor discovery, prefix delegation, ICMPv6 error handling, and fragmentation edge cases. 
 - Establish IPv6 Protocol Conformance Standards - Define and drive compliance with IETF IPv6 RFCs (RFC 2460, RFC 4291, RFC 4861, RFC 4862, RFC 6724, RFC 8200, and related extensions) within the Sonicwall frewall codebase. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Platform, Security, Data Platform, and QA teams to integrate IPv6 changes safely across subsystems and validate correctness at scale. 
 - Prototype and Evaluate IPv6 Technologies - Evaluate emerging IPv6 transition mechanisms (464XLAT, MAP-T, CLAT, SRv6) and contribute to next-generation NGFW networking capabilities. 
 - Influence Technical Direction - Drive architectural decisions, IPv6 scalability strategies, and long-term technical roadmap for protocol parity and government/federal compliance (USGv6, IPv6-ready certification, DoD IPv6 mandates). 
 - Mentorship & Technical Leadership - Serve as the IPv6 subject-matter expert (SME) for the Sonicwall frewall engineering org; mentor senior and mid-level engineers and lead cross-team IPv6 technical design reviews. Requirements

- 7- 9+ years of hands-on C/C++ systems-level development for networking platforms - with a strong emphasis on routers, Layer-3 switches, carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT) devices, or network security appliances. 
 - Deep IPv6 Protocol Expertise - Proven, production-level implementation experience with: 
 - IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and prefix delegation (DHCPv6-PD)
 - Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP), Router Advertisements (RA), and MLDv2
 - IPv6 routing protocols (OSPFv3, BGP with IPv6 AFI/SAFI, RIPng)
 - IPsec/IKEv2 over IPv6 transport
 - IPv6 ACLs, PBR, and traffic classification at line rate
 - IPv6 transition and coexistence mechanisms (Dual-Stack, 6in4, 6rd, NAT64/DNS64, 464XLAT)
 - L2/L3/L4 Networking Depth - Solid understanding of Ethernet, VLANs, 802. 1Q, bridging, routing (static and dynamic), NAT, firewall state tables, and VPN tunneling in the context of both IPv4 and IPv6. 
 - High-Performance Packet Processing - Experience with DPDK, ODP, OFP, XDP/eBPF, or comparable frameworks for low-latency, high-throughput packet forwarding is a strong advantage. 
 - Protocol Conformance & Testing - Experience validating IPv6 implementations against IETF RFC requirements and government IPv6-ready test suites (USGv6, IPv6-Ready Logo Phase-2) is highly desirable. 
 - Strong Debugging & Diagnostic Skills - Proficient with tcpdump, Wireshark (IPv6 dissectors), GDB, kernel trace tools, and network emulation environments (GNS3, EVE-NG, or equivalent) for root-cause analysis of IPv6 issues. 
 - Communication & Leadership - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to lead cross-functional IPv6 design discussions, write technical specifications, and represent engineering in product and architecture reviews. Nice to Have

- Experience with government / federal IPv6 compliance requirements (DoD IPv6 mandate, NIST SP 500-267, USGv6 Profile). 
 - Exposure to SRv6 (Segment Routing over IPv6) or MPLS over IPv6 architectures. 
 - Familiarity with Sonicwall frewall, SonicWall NGFWs, or similar embedded network security firmware. 
 - Working knowledge of WireGuard over IPv6 transport. 
 - Experience with automated IPv6 test frameworks (RFC 2544, IXIA, Spirent, or similar). 

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.     

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries.

data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran's test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques. 

As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran's testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results. 

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. 

Technologies You'll Use

- Java11, JUnit5, 
 - Docker and Kubernetes
 - AWS, GCP
 - Terraform, WireMock, RestAssured
 - Bazel, BuildKite

What You'll Do

- Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback. 
 - Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness. 
 - Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments. 
 - Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions. 
 - Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to: 
 - Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
 - Generate high-quality test scenarios
 - Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
 - Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
 - Enhance developer and QA productivity
 - Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines. 
 - Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes. 
 - Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking. 

Skills We're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence. 
 - Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, Buildkite. 
 - Experience working with backend automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of database testing and ETL/data pipeline validation is a strong plus. 

AI & Productivity Engineering

- Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities. 
 - Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines. 
 - Ability to design prompt strategies, validate LLM outputs rigorously and implement safeguards to prevent hallucinations or unsafe automation. 
 - Experience streamlining workflows using AI to improve measurable engineering productivity. 
 - Comfortable feeding, tuning and orchestrating AI agents to solve real engineering problems. 
 - Strong outcome orientation, measures success through impact, reliability gains and velocity improvements rather than output volume. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

- Leading project technically and responsible for project
 - Regular Interaction with end customer (internal / external) and managing queries technically. 
 - Develop and maintain RTL for digital blocks taking full ownership of self and team code
 - Write and run simulations to verify design functionality
 - Debug functional issues and support integration
 - Collaborate with verification and physical design teams
 - Support synthesis, lint, and timing checks
 - Document design behavior, assumptions, and interfaces

Your Skills & Experiences

- 4 -12 years of RTL Design using Verilog / System Verilog experience
 - Digital electronics fundamentals
 - Simulation and debug using testbenches and waveform analysis
 - Synthesis awareness and basic knowledge of constraint-driven design along with timing closure
 - ASIC design flow
 - Protocol understanding (if applicable: ACI, UART, SPI, I3C, etc. )
 - EDA tools such as Lint, CDC, RDC - SpyGlass VC, Simulation - xcelium Synthesis, Power - Genus, Joules RTL coding - VS code SuperLint - Jasper Gold
 - Version control using GIT
 - Good problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills
 - Extensive knowledge of excel, office suite. . 
 - English business proficiency

Soft Skills Required

Engage and collaborate with cross-functional teams

Good level of autonomy, methodology and rigor

Good team player with positive attitude

Self-motivated to find the solution on its own

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
data.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Role Summary

As a Lead software development engineer, you will join a team of highly adaptable engineers responsible for rapidly learning new business domains, understanding complex technology ecosystems, and delivering high-priority business outcomes. Engineers in this organization are expected to engage across multiple domains, become productive quickly, execute prioritized initiatives, and transition seamlessly to new opportunities as business priorities evolve. 

Success in this role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, business curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments with numerous upstream and downstream dependencies. Candidates must be comfortable working across modern cloud-native platforms, enterprise integrations, legacy systems, APIs, and emerging AI-enabled solutions. 

Role Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services. 
 - Establish trusted partnerships with domain engineering teams and deliver solutions that align with existing engineering standards, delivery processes, and operational models. 
 - Drive a consistent experience between Delta only and mixed metal itineraries through understanding the end-to-end ecosystem and nuances of Alliances partner travel. 
 - Forge a new way of working through building trust, collaboration and quality of development that seamlessly integrates with other pipeline deliverables. 
 - Build a deep and broad understanding of interdependencies between internal & external systems to architect efficient and scalable solutions. Must be able to conduct root cause analysis to generate creative solutions enabling velocity of delivery. 
 - Implement best practices for cloud architecture, security, and performance. 
 - Automate deployment, monitoring, and management of cloud applications. 
 - Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code and contribute to both front-end and back-end development as a full-stack engineer. 
 - Build and integrate AI/ML-powered features and agents into applications using AWS AI services. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure and applications. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related technical field is preferred 
 - 7- 12years of experience in software development with Java 11+/J2EE in Spring boot backend and Python. 
 - Angular in front end, with a focus on cloud technologies. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related technical field is preferred. 
 - Proficiency in AWS services such as S3, Lambda, RDS, and CloudFormation. 
 - Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or AWS Code Pipeline. 
 - Proficiency in AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and Agent Core. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and building distributed systems. 
 - Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications (e. g. , personalization, NLP, recommendations). 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated output. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns. 
 - Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities. 
 - Analyze system dependencies, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities that accelerate delivery. 
 - Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Lead initiatives with high accountability, create a collaborative environment with a solution-based approach. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor and mentor for the team offering technical advice. 
 - Ability to communicate with precision, engaging team and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships across cross-functional teams and geographies enabling organizational alignment. 
 - Ability to set priorities with the team by understanding interdependence, inspiring team members with consistent focus, quality output, and timelines. 
 - Constantly keep oneself updated on current technology & trends to drive innovative decisions through piloting forward-thinking approaches to complex problems in one's own area of work. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer priorities and business challenges while creating value for technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to break down complex problems into concise impact statements. 
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. 
 - Experience with a modern front-end framework is a plus
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. 
 - Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities. 
 - Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams. 
 - Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives. 
 - Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight. 
 - Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. 

For more information, please visit www. deltatechhub. com

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
 - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
 - Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
 - Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
 - Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

data.title: AWS SRE Lead
data.description:
Technology->Cloud Platform->Amazon Webservices DevOps, Technology->DevOps->Site Reliability Engineering(SRE)

Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain highly available and scalable AWS cloud infrastructure. Monitor applications, servers, and cloud resources to ensure system reliability and performance. Automate operational tasks using Python, Shell scripting, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis (RCA). Implement and support CI/CD pipelines for seamless application deployments. Manage incident, problem, and change management activities. Configure and maintain monitoring and alerting tools. Work closely with development and DevOps teams to improve system stability. Ensure security, compliance, backup, and disaster recovery standards are met. Participate in on-call support and production support activities. Minimum Qualifications 5 to 9 years of experience in AWS Cloud and SRE/Production Support. Strong knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, and Route 53. Experience with Linux/Unix administration. Proficiency in Python or Shell Scripting. Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, or Prometheus. Experience with incident management and troubleshooting production environments. Knowledge of networking concepts including DNS, Load Balancers, TCP/IP, and VPN. Experience with Git and CI/CD tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with Terraform or CloudFormation. Knowledge of Jenkins and DevOps practices. Experience with ELK, Splunk, Datadog, or New Relic. Familiarity with ServiceNow and ITIL processes. Experience in High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) environments. AWS Certification is an added advantage. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platforms
data.description:
We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer for Arm's AI Platforms team in Bangalore. You will help shape technical direction, build production software, and establish the engineering practices of a growing team. Working with the Director of Engineering and technical leaders across Arm, you will take responsibility for significant platform capabilities and remain closely involved in their implementation. 

We are looking for an exemplary practitioner whose code, technical decisions, and approach to difficult problems set the standard for the team. You will combine systems engineering depth with hands-on expertise in agentic AI across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), helping engineers embrace new methods and assess their effect on delivery and quality. 

Responsibilities

- Define technical direction with engineering leadership. Assess platform needs, explore design options, and turn decisions into software the team can deliver and operate. 
 - Design and implement distributed platform services. Write critical code, review implementations, and rapid prototyping to test uncertain assumptions before committing to a design. 
 - Shape the engineering culture through daily practice. Help the team deliver frequent changes with clear ownership, useful design and code reviews, and verification appropriate to the software being built. 
 - Build and use agentic AI workflows across the SDLC. Give agents useful project context, connect them to development tools, and establish feedback through tests and code review. Measure their effect on delivery speed and software quality. 
 - Keep current with developments in software engineering, AI development tools, and cloud systems. Evaluate promising approaches through hands-on experiments and adopt them when the results justify the change. 
 - Resolve difficult design and production problems involving concurrency, data consistency, performance, and failure recovery. Use what you learn to improve the architecture and the team's engineering practices. 
 - Help recruit staff and senior engineers, and develop their judgment through shared technical work. Support engineers in taking ownership of complete capabilities and working through unfamiliar problems. 
 - Partner with Arm teams in the US and UK on architecture and shared interfaces. Make technical decisions understandable and establish clear ownership across teams. 

Required skills and experience

- 12+ years building distributed software, cloud platforms, or production infrastructure, or equivalent experience demonstrated through the scope and impact of your work. 
 - Strong programming skills in Go, C++, Rust, Python, or a comparable language. Experience designing service interfaces, working with concurrency and persistent data, and debugging complex failures. 
 - Experience building and operating software on Kubernetes and Linux, with an understanding of workload lifecycle, networking, resource management, and failure recovery. 
 - Hands-on expertise with agentic AI tools and harnesses for the SDLC. Experience configuring and extending workflows, assessing generated code, and verifying changes through automated checks and engineering review. 
 - A record of technical leadership grounded in your own engineering work, including mentoring experienced engineers, explaining design choices, and improving how a team develops software. 

Preferred skills and experience

- Experience with AI inference infrastructure or model serving, including how workload and hardware choices affect latency, throughput, and resource use. Knowledge of inference performance and resource-efficiency considerations.

data.title: Sub System Test Engineer – IXL - Railway Infrastructure
data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make an extraordinary addition to our vibrant international team. 

We are looking for a Sub System Test Engineer: IXL - Railway Infrastructure

Work assignments: 

Responsibility for the test execution/management of mass transit or main line rollouts of Interlocking (IxL) projects for CBTC/ Non-CBTC signaling Systems as part of large-scale railway infrastructure projects. Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for IxL domain in CBTC/ Non-CBTC application projects Carrying responsibility for the lab data testing scope. Representation of the Test Team within a project when communicating to internal stakeholders, whilst reporting to the line management (test manager/group lead). Ensuring compliance with defined procedures/processes. 

Exploration of further business opportunities: 

Identification and exploitation of additional business opportunities during project implementation, e. g. identifying Change Requests or extending the scope towards project needs. 

You'll make a difference by: 

- Preparation of test checklist specific to project and Develop test specification / test cases as per IXL design requirement specifications. 
 - Responsible for data lab testing of IxL Sub-systems in Test lab using real and simulated test environments. 
 - Review / verification of all documents related to Lab data testing. 
 - Evaluation of project, customer, rolling stock and internal requirements towards implementing suitable project specific test cases and test documentation. 
 - Detailed knowhow on functional aspects of IxL and its interface with other subsystems like ATC and ATS with CBTC/non-CBTC. 
 - Knowledge about testing and commissioning process and Strategy. 
 - Work with development team to identify and capture test cases, ensure version management
 - Knowledge of test automation for IxL testing
 - Setting up test environments, writing test scripts and implementing test cases/scenarios. 
 - Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned people. 
 - Reviewing test logs and results to identify failures, raising CFXs in the change and defect management tool, participating in CCB meetings, and providing test inputs. 
 - Interfacing/Clarification with senior test engineer, test manager, System Manager/Sub PM, Validation, RAMS and project teams. 
 - Interfacing with HQ teams towards tooling requirements, developing/adapting templates/schematics, and parameterization. 
 - Able to support installation and tests activities/teams onsite if required. 
 - Understanding other subsystems like ATS, ATC, Communication and Diagnostic Systems. 
 - Knowledge of Projects Support functions (RM/DM/CM) and Quality Management. 

Essential Soft and Hard skills for IXL Functional Tester: 

- Basic Knowledge of Linux. 
 - Experience with VMware. 
 - Networking knowledge. 
 - Troubleshooting skills for the Test Environment. 
 - Ability to understand and implement IP addressing, subnetting, interface configuration, routing principles, and gateway setup. 
 - Fundamental understanding of server environments, including ESXi and Windows. 
 - Practical experience with Siemens products, particularly WKII, R9k, TGMT, and TG200, will be an added advantage. 

You'll win us over by: 

- Degree in electrical or electronics engineering. 
 - Professional experience of minimum 5 years in railway transportation systems (Main line / Mass Transit) with the focus on testing in IXL sub-system (CBTC / Non CBTC). 
 - Performed hands on testing activities for IXL subsystem besides understanding of operational scenarios, requirements, and interfaces. 
 - Experience with Functional testing, lab testing, test setups. Experience with Integration tests and SAT would be an added advantage. 
 - Proficient English essential both written and oral, knowledge of German/Spanish is an asset
 - Independent and structured approach to work. 

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 

This role is based in Pune, where you'll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come. 

We're Siemens. A collection of over 312, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow. 

Find out more about Siemens careers at: www. siemens. com/careers & more about mobility at https: //new. siemens. com/global/en/products/mobility. html

data.title: Specialist, Quality Engineer
data.description:
If you're passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide's Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, "on your side" goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we're looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. 

Role Summary

Specialist QA Engineer - Job Requirements

We are seeking a Specialist QA Engineer to strengthen quality across web applications, APIs, and integrated services. The role requires hands-on API and performance testing, alongside test automation, observability practices, and CI/CD integration to help teams deliver reliable software at pace. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience in software quality engineering, including designing test strategies and translating requirements into clear, risk-based test coverage. 
 - Strong programming experience in at least one of: Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain automated test code. 
 - Practical experience developing browser automation with Playwright and/or Selenium; able to create maintainable, reusable tests and troubleshoot failures. 
 - Experience applying the Page Object Model (POM) or an equivalent page/component abstraction to organize UI automation. 
 - Experience with BDD-style testing and Cucumber, including writing or maintaining readable feature scenarios and step definitions. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and tools such as Harness; familiarity with Rancher-based environments is an advantage. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and executing API tests for REST and SOAP services and validating integrations, including systems built with Mule or MuleSoft; able to verify functional behavior, error handling, and end-to-end flows across dependent services. 
 - Hands-on experience planning and executing performance and load tests using JMeter, analyzing results, identifying bottlenecks, and communicating performance risks and findings. 
 - Experience with database testing, including data validation and verification of application-to-database behavior; familiarity with Oracle Database and relational and non-relational database concepts. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, New Relic, and Splunk (or equivalent platforms) to investigate test and production issues. 
 - Experience using AI prompting to support QA work, such as generating or refining test scenarios, test data ideas, and defect-analysis summaries; able to validate AI-generated output for accuracy, security, and suitability before use. 
 - Familiarity with Jira for managing test-related work, tracking defects, and communicating status within a delivery team. 
 - Experience working within Agile methodologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams through planning, refinement, execution, and retrospectives. 
 - Strong defect investigation, root-cause analysis, test reporting, and communication skills; able to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and operations teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building AI agents is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting test automation in containerized or Kubernetes environments, including deployments managed with Rancher. 
 - Experience combining UI, API, integration, and performance testing in a cohesive quality strategy. 
 - Familiarity with test data management, mocking/stubbing, parallel test execution, and reducing flaky tests. 
 - Experience contributing to continuous-delivery quality gates and release-readiness decisions. 

What Success Looks Like

- Automated tests are maintainable, useful, and integrated into delivery pipelines. 
 - Test results provide actionable feedback, and defects are identified early with clear evidence and reproducible steps. 
 - Performance and observability signals are used to help teams diagnose risk and improve service reliability. 

Job Description Summary

If you're enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!

As a Quality Engineer you will plan and conduct a wide range of software quality tests and analyses to ensure all application products and services meet organizational standards aligned to their quality management approach, as well as, end-user requirements. All Quality Engineers perform quality planning, quality design and execution. 

You will focus on a blend of skills enabling efficient execution of risk-based testing, test automation, performance testing, test data management, test environment management, continuous integration and continuous deployment all improving speed to delivery for our business partners. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Carries out procedures to ensure all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements. 
 - Analyses and reviews moderate requirements, user stories and technical work products to create the automation needed. 
 - Applies secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities. 
 - Plans for the proper mix of manual, automated, and exploratory testing methods. 
 - Uses the appropriate quality engineering tools to define test data management, test automation, security/vulnerability, performance, and regression testing needs. 
 - Validates test results, records and researches defects. 
 - Coordinates test runs and test environment calendars for all impacted applications. 
 - Traces requirements to tests and test results. 
 - Prioritizes, defines, and manages defect reporting and resolution. 
 - Manages defects including identifying, tracking, and providing critical thinking for resolution. 
 - Identifies means to be more effective and efficient in testing, without compromising quality. 
 - Plans for continuous integration to enable a continuous deployment pipeline. 
 - Executes moderate release testing and has a plan for back-out testing. 
 - Validates that release components are installed in the appropriate testing environment. 
 - Aligns with the Nationwide automated testing reference architecture. 
 - Complies with release management process governance and timelines throughout the release. 
 - Additional responsibilities may include collaboration across teams and adherence to company standards.

Job Description: 

The Senior Controls Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle management of software for industrial automation and control systems. This role involves developing PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, and industrial communication solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams throughout the complete project lifecycle-from concept and design through commissioning and customer support. 

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, industrial networking, and machine automation using Siemens, Beckhoff, Bosch Rexroth, B&R automation platforms or a combination of these automation platforms. 

Essential duties and responsibilities: 

- Design and develop machine control software for custom automation systems from concept through commissioning. 
 - Develop PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, safety, and industrial communication software. 
 - Configure and integrate servo drives, VFDs, robotics, vision systems, and field devices. 
 - Prepare Functional Design Specifications (FDS), I/O lists, software architecture, and technical documentation. 
 - Perform software testing, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and customer support. 
 - Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Project Engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Participate in the review of electrical designs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards. 
 - Troubleshoot control systems and optimize machine performance. 
 - Participate in software code reviews and maintain software quality standards. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives, software standardization, and engineering best practices. 
 - Maintain project schedules and communicate technical progress to project stakeholders. 

Requirements & Experience

- Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning. 
 - Experience designing and implementing control systems for custom automation projects. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, and motion control. 
 - Experience integrating servo systems, drives, motors, robotics, sensors, and vision systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols including: 
 - Profinet
 - EtherCAT
 - Ethernet/IP
 - Modbus TCP
 - OPC UA
 - Experience with Safety PLCs and machine safety devices. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and commissioning skills. 
 - Experience with software version control and software lifecycle management. 
 - Ability to prepare technical documentation including: 
 - Functional Design Specifications
 - Software Architecture
 - I/O Lists
 - User Manuals
 - Electrical Documentation
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams). 

Education

- Bachelor's Degree in one of the following disciplines: 
 - Electronics & Communication Engineering
 - Instrumentation & Control Engineering
 - Mechatronics Engineering
 - Electrical Engineering
 - Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning. 

Key Result Areas: 

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI applications for custom machine automation. 
 - Deliver reliable, maintainable, and scalable control software. 
 - Follow software change management procedures and maintain version control. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine commissioning, and production startup. 
 - Provide technical support during installation and post-deployment activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with engineering standards and customer requirements. 
 - Deliver assigned projects on time while maintaining quality and customer satisfaction. 

Travel: 

- Domestic and international travel may be required, up to 20%, depending on project requirements.

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage.

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA

Instrumentation & Control Components

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects.

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage.

data.title: Manager/Sr. Manager, Engineering - AI Platform
data.description:
We are looking for a Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering for our AI Platform team. Someone who can take ownership of a fast-growing, high-visibility team building the agentic foundation for SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how AI agents get built, governed, and shipped across the company. 

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will partner closely with the Product Manager for AI Platform to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Team leadership and development

- Lead and grow the AI Platform team, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
 - Develop individual engineers through regular 1: 1s, coaching, and honest feedback
 - Hire and onboard new engineers into an already fast-moving workstream as scope grows

Delivery and operations

- Own delivery of the AI Platform roadmap: production readiness for Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo, the Agent Development Stack, evaluation/trust/safety/guardrails, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP for SCD APIs
 - Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health, keeping delivery and engagement strong
 - Remove blockers before they slow the team down, and hold a high bar on security, compliance, and operational readiness

Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration

- Partner with the Product Manager to translate product strategy into an executable engineering plan
 - Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks
 - Collaborate across Product Development, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders

Strategy and growth

- Help shape SimCorp's agentic platform strategy as scope expands beyond today's capabilities
 - Anticipate where the team needs to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
 - Bring an informed point of view on responsible, safe, and governed AI agent development

What We Value

Ownership and independence You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through. 

Management experience You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement. 

Technical grounding in AI and platform engineering You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with agent orchestration, LLM-based systems, APIs, and the trust/safety layer around them. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off. 

Communication clarity You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums. 

Result orientation and a growth mindset You focus on outcomes, not just activity, and drive your own growth and your team's. 

Distributed team experience and empathy Leading a distributed team takes clear communication, inclusive practices, and genuine attention to people's wellbeing. Experience with Scandinavian or European teams, and comfort with remote work, is a plus. 

Structured thinking in ambiguous situations AI technology and the team's scope are still evolving. You create clarity, manage capacity with discipline, and align with stakeholders without escalating every decision. 

Collaborative by default You know when to align, when to decide, and when to push back - and do all three constructively, fitting naturally with how we work

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India's Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group's Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it's a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet "Blue Darter" with honour. 

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India's supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 

Position Overview: 

The Service Centre Incharge - Operations (Non Metro / BDO) is responsible for managing end-to-end operational activities across one or more assigned Non Metro Branches, Business Development Offices (BDOs) or Service Centres. The role oversees inbound and outbound shipment processing, pickup and delivery coordination, customer service support, manpower deployment and operational governance to ensure seamless day-to-day operations. 

Reporting to the Assistant Manager - Operations (Area Operations), the incumbent provides frontline leadership to operational teams, ensuring adherence to service commitments, operational productivity, safety, compliance and Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures while delivering consistent customer experience and supporting business continuity across the assigned locations. 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage end-to-end shift operations across assigned Non Metro Branches and BDO locations by ensuring efficient shipment processing, timely pickups and dispatches, optimal workforce utilisation, operational discipline and consistent service delivery while maintaining safety, compliance and customer satisfaction. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

End-to-End Shift Operations

- Lead and supervise all inbound, outbound, pickup and dispatch activities during the assigned shift. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, processing, sorting, scanning, loading and dispatch of shipments in line with operational timelines. 
 - Monitor operational workflow across assigned BDOs and Service Centres to ensure seamless shipment movement. 
 - Ensure operational readiness to manage daily volumes, peak periods and contingency situations. 

Shipment Processing & Service Quality

- Ensure accurate scanning, sorting, bagging, routing and reconciliation of all shipments. 
 - Minimise shipment exceptions, operational delays and service failures through proactive monitoring. 
 - Ensure adherence to network cut-off timelines and service commitments. 
 - Escalate damaged, short, discrepant or delayed shipments promptly and ensure timely resolution. 

Pickup & Delivery Operations

- Coordinate daily pickup and delivery activities to achieve defined service levels. 
 - Monitor route readiness and shipment movement to ensure timely customer service. 
 - Support resolution of operational issues impacting deliveries and pickups. 
 - Coordinate with transport, network and customer service teams to ensure smooth operational execution. 

People Leadership & Shift Management

- Plan and deploy manpower effectively across operational activities and assigned locations. 
 - Lead, coach and guide Ops Staff, Senior Ops Staff and Territory Service Representatives during the shift. 
 - Conduct daily shift briefings covering operational priorities, safety and productivity expectations. 
 - Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline and workforce productivity while promoting teamwork and accountability. 

Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline

- Ensure adherence to Blue Dart Standard Operating Procedures, operational guidelines and statutory requirements. 
 - Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with safety standards and security procedures. 
 - Ensure prescribed uniform, identity card and personal protective equipment are used wherever applicable. 
 - Maintain high standards of housekeeping, operational discipline and ethical conduct across all assigned locations. 

Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement

- Monitor daily operational performance and productivity against defined targets. 
 - Ensure timely completion of operational documentation, system updates and shift reports. 
 - Conduct effective shift handovers and escalate operational risks or service issues promptly. 
 - Support implementation of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet, Security, Network Operations and Area Operations teams to ensure seamless service delivery. 
 - Build effective working relationships across internal teams and operational partners. 
 - Support implementation of new operational initiatives, business priorities and process improvements. 
 - Act as the primary operational contact for assigned locations during the shift. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

Education: 

- Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university. 

Experience: 

- 2-5 years of relevant experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, warehousing, distribution or supply chain operations. 
 - Experience in managing end-to-end Service Centre operations, including inbound, outbound, pickup and delivery activities. 
 - Proven experience in leading frontline operational teams and coordinating shift operations. 
 - Exposure to shipment processing, scanning, sorting, reconciliation, dispatch and customer service operations. 
 - Experience working with operational systems, handheld scanners and operational reporting will be an advantage. 

Skills & Capabilities: 

Technical Skills: 

- End-to-End Shift Operations Management 
 - Service Centre Operations 
 - Shipment Processing & Dispatch Management 
 - Pickup & Delivery Coordination 
 - Workforce Planning & Shift Management 
 - Productivity & Resource Utilization 
 - Operational Reporting & MIS 
 - Operational Systems & Scanner Usage 
 - Safety & Regulatory Compliance 
 - Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Key Competencies: 

- Operational Leadership 
 - Planning & Organising 
 - Decision Making 
 - Customer Focus 
 - Team Leadership & Coaching 
 - Problem Solving 
 - Accountability & Ownership 
 - Communication & Collaboration 
 - Integrity & Ethical Conduct 
 - Operational Discipline 
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset

Key Performance Indicators: 

KRAs

KPIs

Operational Performance

Inbound & Outbound SLA adherence; On-time shipment processing; Dispatch timeliness

Service Quality

Shipment accuracy; Scanning compliance; Reduction in shipment exceptions and operational errors

Pickup & Delivery Performance

Pickup & Delivery SLA adherence; Timely vehicle turnaround; Customer service support

Productivity

Shift productivity; Manpower utilization; Resource optimization

Safety & Compliance

SOP adherence; Audit compliance; Safety & security compliance; Housekeeping standards

Operational Governance

Shift reporting accuracy; Timely documentation; Effective shift handover; Timely escalation of operational issues

People Leadership

Team productivity; Coaching & capability development; Attendance & workforce discipline

Continuous Improvement

Participation in process improvement initiatives; Productivity and service enhancement

Why join DHL Blue Dart?

When you join us, you're not just taking a job-you're becoming part of a purpose-led movement that's reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don't just deliver parcels-we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day. 

Here's what makes us stand out: 

- Great Place to Work® Certified-a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that's not just a logistics leader-but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.
