data.title: Lead - Digital Construction [T500-28816]
data.description:
About Suffolk: 

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment through Suffolk Technologies. 

With more than $10 billion in annual revenue and projects across healthcare, life sciences, higher education, mission critical, aviation, transportation, commercial, and other complex sectors, Suffolk is redefining how America builds through innovation, technology, and operational excellence. 

About Suffolk Global: 

Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds. 

By partnering closely with teams across the United States, Suffolk Global will help drive quality, scalability, and innovation while creating new opportunities for technical professionals to contribute to some of the most complex construction projects in North America. 

About Digital Delivery: 

Suffolk is building the next generation of Digital Delivery capabilities to transform how buildings are designed, coordinated, and constructed. By combining Building Information Modeling (BIM), data-driven workflows, automation, and emerging technologies, our goal is to create a more connected, efficient, and predictable project delivery process. 

As part of this vision, Suffolk Global is establishing a high-performing Digital Delivery team in Bangalore that will partner directly with project teams across the United States. Together, we will develop scalable modeling standards, improve coordination workflows, enhance quality through digital reviews, and create innovative solutions that support some of the most complex construction projects in North America. 

This is an opportunity to help build a new capability from the ground up and play a leadership role in defining how Digital Delivery services are delivered globally. 

Lead - Digital Construction

Title: Digital Delivery Lead

Location: Bangalore, India (Onsite)

Role Summary; 

The Digital Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the day-to-day execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple projects and teams. This role provides technical oversight, resource coordination, quality management, and team leadership to ensure the successful delivery of BIM models, coordination services, constructability reviews, and digital project deliverables. 

The Digital Delivery Lead serves as the primary connection between project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and production staff, ensuring that work is delivered efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with Suffolk standards. This role is responsible for developing team capability, driving accountability, and establishing a culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Delivery Leadership: 

- Lead execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple concurrent projects. 
 - Coordinate project assignments, priorities, and workloads across Digital Delivery Engineers and Senior Digital Delivery Engineers. 
 - Monitor project schedules, deliverables, and resource requirements to ensure successful execution. 
 - Identify delivery risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for technical and project delivery challenges. 

Team Leadership & Development: 

- Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentoring for Digital Delivery team members. 
 - Support onboarding and development of new staff. 
 - Conduct regular reviews of work quality and performance. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Support career development planning and technical skill growth across the team. 

Quality & Standards Management: 

- Ensure compliance with Suffolk Digital Delivery standards, workflows, and governance processes. 
 - Oversee QA/QC reviews across assigned projects. 
 - Monitor model quality, coordination performance, and deliverable consistency. 
 - Drive adoption of standards, templates, content libraries, and best practices. 
 - Review lessons learned and implement corrective actions where needed. 

Technical Oversight: 

- Provide technical guidance related to BIM modeling, coordination, constructability analysis, and content development. 
 - Support resolution of complex technical issues and project challenges. 
 - Collaborate with Senior Digital Delivery Engineers to maintain standards and technical consistency. 
 - Ensure proper application of modeling workflows and coordination processes. 

Stakeholder Management: 

- Collaborate with U. S. -based project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and project stakeholders. 
 - Support project planning and workload forecasting activities. 
 - Communicate project status, risks, resource needs, and delivery performance. 
 - Build strong working relationships across project and operational teams. 

Operational Excellence: 

- Monitor team utilization and workload balancing. 
 - Support staffing and resource planning activities. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and delivery performance. 
 - Drive implementation of process improvements and operational best practices. 
 - Contribute to the growth and scalability of Suffolk Global's Digital Delivery organization. 

Required Qualifications: 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline. 

Experience: 

- 8-12 years of experience in BIM, Digital Delivery, VDC, architecture, engineering, or construction technology. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading BIM delivery teams or coordination teams on complex building projects. 
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities. 

Technical Skills: 

- Expert-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit. 
 - Strong experience with BIM coordination and clash detection workflows. 
 - Deep understanding of BIM standards, model governance, QA/QC processes, and digital delivery best practices. 
 - Experience with BIM content development, template management, and standards implementation. 
 - Strong understanding of architectural, structural, and MEP systems. 

Leadership Skills: 

- Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams. 
 - Strong organizational and planning skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
 - Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance technical quality with delivery commitments. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience with Navisworks Manage. 
 - Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360. 
 - Experience with point cloud and Scan-to-BIM workflows. 
 - Experience developing BIM standards and enterprise delivery processes. 
 - Experience supporting global or distributed project teams. 

Success Measures: 

A successful Digital Delivery Lead will: 

- Deliver projects on schedule and in accordance with quality expectations. 
 - Maintain high levels of team productivity and utilization. 
 - Improve model quality, QA/QC performance, and coordination outcomes across projects. 
 - Successfully develop and mentor Digital Delivery team members. 
 - Ensure consistent adoption of Digital Delivery standards and workflows. 
 - Build strong partnerships with project teams and stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the growth, scalability, and operational maturity of the Digital Delivery organization.

data.title: Systems Engineering Technical Coordination Lead
data.description:
About Acron Aviation (Avionics - Surveillance)

Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle. 

Job Title

Systems Engineering Technical Coordination Lead India

Position Summary

Acron Aviation is seeking a Systems Engineering Functional Lead & HCL Coordinator to lead independent systems development and verification and validation (IV&V) activities for safety-critical avionics products. This role serves as the primary offshore focal point between Acron Aviation engineering teams and HCL delivery teams, ensuring execution quality, technical rigor, schedule alignment, and certification readiness. 

The successful candidate will combine hands-on technical development and verification expertise with team leadership, partner coordination, and day-to-day execution management. This individual will provide technical direction, oversee work assignments, review deliverables, drive issue resolution, and maintain alignment across software, systems, hardware, certification, and program stakeholders. 

This is a highly visible role requiring strong ownership, technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision across globally distributed teams. This role may require occasional international travel to Acron Aviation sites, customer locations, certification events, and engineering integration activities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & Coordination
 - Act as the primary interface between Acron Aviation U. S. engineering teams, Acron India engineering teams, and HCL delivery teams, ensuring alignment of priorities, resources, deliverables, and schedules. 
 - Lead daily execution of systems activities for avionics products
 - Plan, assign, review, and monitor Development and V&V work packages while ensuring quality, schedule, and technical objectives are achieved
 - Identify and escalate technical risks, resource constraints, dependencies, and schedule impacts proactively
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including process optimization, automation, AI-enabled tools, and verification efficiency enhancements
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance to offshore Development and V&V team members
 - Support onboarding of new team members, including tool access, process training, and development environment setup
 - Systems and Software Verification
 - Define, review, and execute verification activities for system requirements, interface requirements, and integration requirements
 - Develop and execute requirements and requirements-based testing, analysis, inspections, and reviews in accordance with certification objectives
 - Author and maintain systems requirements, test procedures, test cases, automated test assets, test reports, and verification artifacts
 - Partner with systems development teams to investigate coverage gaps, resolve anomalies, and close certification findings
 - Certification and Compliance Support
 - Support certification activities in accordance with FAA and EASA expectations
 - Participate in Systems Reviews (SR) and Stage of Involvement (SOI) audits and certification reviews
 - Prepare and review certification evidence packages and compliance documentation
 - Author or review requirements, verification plans, procedures, test reports, traceability data, coverage reports, and certification support documentation
 - Ensure requirements and design evidence is complete, traceable, and audit-ready
 - Requirements Traceability and Defect Management
 - Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements, design artifacts, source code, tests, verification results, and problem reports
 - Utilize approved requirements, configuration management, and defect tracking tools
 - Lead defect triage activities for software and integrated system anomalies
 - Support root cause investigations, corrective action verification, and objective evidence collection
 - Cross-Functional Leadership
 - Coordinate across systems, software, hardware, quality, configuration management, certification, and program teams
 - Lead technical reviews, readiness reviews, and status meetings
 - Create clear work instructions and tasking packages that enable consistent execution across distributed teams
 - Provide regular status reporting, metrics, risk visibility, and closure plans to program and engineering leadership

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline
 - 8-12 years of experience in avionics systems verification, software verification, IV&V, or embedded systems validation within regulated environments

General Summary

The Flex Solution Principal Engineer serves as the technical owner and primary engineering contact for assigned OEM customer programs, working directly with OEM engineering leaders and Qualcomm's senior technical stakeholders. The role drives customer-specific Flex Platform development and leads cross-functional teams spanning platform, ADAS software, validation, and build engineering. The role also models and assesses system performance for digital cockpit and ADAS workloads by comparing projections with real-world implementations. 

The principal engineer shall enable successful, scalable adoption of Qualcomm Digital Cockpit Platform and ADAS solutions across OEM programs by orchestrating multi-party alignment, ensuring robust integration, and driving safety, performance, and time-to-market outcomes. 

What You'll Do

 - Act as a senior hands‐on technical leader, directly involved in system design decisions, integration trade‐offs, issue triage, and root‐cause analysis across Digital Cockpit and ADAS domains. 
 - Manage multiple OEM Flex and ADAS program solution teams, supported by technical leads reporting to this role. 
 - Provide senior technical leadership across Qualcomm Automotive engineering teams to shape and deliver customer-specific features. 
 - Define the Flex Solutions team's technical roadmap to anticipate evolving customer needs for automotive middleware across Flex and ADAS systems. 
 - Perform Flex‐based Digital Cockpit system integration using QNX RTOS, AUTOSAR Classic and Adaptive stacks and Android including configuration, integration, and validation. 
 - Integrate ADAS software stacks (Perception and Drive Policy), analyse end‐to‐end data flows and latency, and actively profile, assess, and tune system performance to meet Flex platform characterization and workload targets. 
 - Lead BSP and driver bring-up on customer hardware, troubleshoot low-level boot and runtime issues, and configure Qualcomm software products on customer hardware. 
 - Develop deep, practical expertise in Qualcomm Digital Cockpit and ADAS platforms at the SoC, system, and software stack levels.

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Flex Solution integration on Reference and Customer Hardware

Program Execution & Delivery

Customer Technical Leadership

- Act as the chief technical counterpart to the OEM's engineering leadership for all ADAS and related programs.

 - Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with the customer's engineering executives, architects, and program leads.

 - E/E and compute architecture (in-vehicle and backend/cloud)

Required Qualifications

- 18+ years of experience in senior engineering roles in the Digital Cockpit/ADAS / AD domain at an OEM, Tier-1, semiconductor, or relevant technology supplier. 
 - Experience working directly with major global OEMs on large-scale mixed critical Digital Cockpit/ADAS programs. 
 - Strong background in Tier 1 automotive systems engineering with focus on: 
 - BSP Integration, Performance analysis, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) management (multi virtual machine)
 - Compute platform architecture (SoC, GPU/DSP, accelerators) - Hypervisor /Virtual Machine
 - Embedded SW stacks (OS such as QNX/Linux/Android, middleware, frameworks, toolchains, AUTOSAR (Classic/Adaptive))

 - Strong problem-solving skills, data-driven and structured, with ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: Leadership Role - DFT
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we're looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don't shy away from humanity's challenges but are determined to help solve them. 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. 

Leadership Role - DFT

The Role

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) in the IODC SoC DFT organization, you will lead end-to-end ATPG strategy, implementation, and pattern validation for complex, multi-million gate SoCs powering next-generation SOCs. You will be responsible for driving all ATPG execution activities from DFT architecture definition through pre-silicon verification, production test enablement, silicon bring-up, and manufacturing ramp. 

This role requires close collaboration with RTL, DFT RTL, DFT Verification, Physical Design, Product Engineering Operations (PEO), ATE, and Silicon Validation teams to ensure high-quality test content, optimal coverage, tester readiness, and successful silicon deployment. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in ATPG, scan methodologies, and pattern validation with proven experience delivering production-quality test solutions for large-scale SoCs. 

The Person

You are a highly motivated technical leader with extensive experience in SoC DFT and ATPG execution. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex debug challenges, and possess a strong track record of driving cross-functional execution from design conception through manufacturing. 

You are comfortable working across multiple organizations, influencing technical direction, mentoring engineers, and serving as the key technical expert for ATPG signoff and silicon test readiness. 

IMPACT

This role serves as the technical owner for ATPG execution across critical SoC programs and directly influences product quality, manufacturing yield, test cost, and time-to-market. The successful candidate will play a key role in enabling first-silicon success and scaling robust DFT methodologies across future AMD SoC generations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end ATPG execution for large-scale SoCs from architecture phase through silicon production. 
 - Define and drive ATPG methodologies, test strategies, coverage closure plans, and pattern signoff criteria. 
 - Generate and validate scan, transition fault, cell-aware, bridge, chain diagnosis, and compression-based ATPG patterns. 
 - Drive pattern quality improvements, tester efficiency optimization, and test cost reduction initiatives. 
 - Partner closely with DFT RTL, DFT Verification, RTL, Physical Design, and Timing teams to ensure robust DFT implementation and testability. 
 - Collaborate with PEO and ATE teams to enable tester bring-up, pattern correlation, tester debug, and manufacturing deployment. 
 - Lead pattern validation activities across simulation, emulation, ATE, and platform environments. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of ATPG, tester, silicon, and yield-related issues. 
 - Ensure high-quality pattern delivery meeting schedule, coverage, power, and manufacturing requirements. 
 - Support silicon bring-up, diagnosis, yield learning, and production ramp activities. 
 - Develop automation flows and AI-enabled solutions to improve ATPG productivity and debug turnaround time. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and drive ATPG best practices across the organization. 

Preferred Experience

- 16+ years of experience in SoC DFT with strong expertise in ATPG and manufacturing test. 
 - Proven ownership of ATPG execution for multiple successful high-volume SoC products. 
 - Extensive experience with multi-million gate SoCs and hierarchical ATPG methodologies. 
 - Deep understanding of Scan, EDT/Compression, LBIST, MBIST, Boundary Scan, and DFT architecture. 
 - Strong experience with pattern validation, tester correlation, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Hands-on experience working with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, and ATE teams. 
 - Experience debugging silicon failures and supporting yield improvement initiatives. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, Shell, or similar languages. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across geographically distributed teams. 

Preferred Technical Skills

- ATPG tools such as Tessent, Modus, TestMAX, TetraMAX, or equivalent. 
 - Scan architecture, compression techniques, and diagnosis methodologies. 
 - STIL, WGL, tester pattern formats, and pattern conversion flows. 
 - Power-aware ATPG and test coverage optimization. 
 - Pattern validation on simulation, emulation, ATE, and platform environments. 
 - Silicon diagnosis, yield analysis, and failure characterization. 
 - DFT timing, physical-aware ATPG, and implementation debug. 
 - Strong knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing test flows and production test deployment. 

Academic Credentials

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in related discipline preferred

The ideal candidate should have a strong architectural understanding, be capable of identifying potential issues independently, and proactively guide the design team towards delivering accurate, coordinated, and professionally documented projects.

data.title: Motion Control Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

Who we are: 

At UST, we help the world's best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30, 000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact-touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at . 

Summary

UST is looking for core Motion Control Engineer

Job Description

About the Role

We are seeking a Motion Control Engineer to own the design, configuration, and optimization of multi-axis motion systems built on ACS Motion Control platforms. You will select the right motor, encoder, drive, and controller architecture for each application, then bring those systems to life - wiring, commissioning, programming, and tuning them to meet demanding accuracy, throughput, and reliability targets. 

This role sits at the intersection of electrical design and controls software. You should be equally comfortable reading a schematic, pulling a scope trace on a servo loop, and writing ACSPL+ code. 

What You'll Do

Motion system architecture and selection

- Size and select servo/stepper motors, linear and rotary, based on load, duty cycle, inertia ratio, and thermal budget
 - Specify feedback devices - incremental and absolute encoders, resolvers, linear scales - matching resolution, interface (EnDat, BiSS, Sin/Cos, A/B), and accuracy to the application
 - Define the controller and drive architecture: ACS controller family, EtherCAT network topology, drive sizing, power supply and regen requirements
 - Perform trade studies on cost, performance, and lead time; produce bills of material and vendor comparisons

Configuration, programming, and tuning

- Configure ACS controllers and drives using MotionBoot, SPiiPlus MMI Application Studio, and related toolchains
 - Develop motion applications in ACSPL+ - multi-axis coordinated motion, gantry and master/slave configurations, gearing, camming, PVT and spline trajectories, registration and triggered motion
 - Tune servo loops - current, velocity, and position - using frequency response analysis, notch and low-pass filters, feedforward terms, and disturbance rejection techniques
 - Characterize and correct settling time, following error, resonance, backlash, and cogging; validate against spec with data
 - Implement safety and fault handling: limits, E-stop chains, STO, homing strategies, error recovery

Electrical integration

- Produce and review motion control schematics, panel layouts, cable and harness drawings, and I/O maps
 - Debug wiring, grounding, shielding, and EMI issues on the bench and on the machine floor
 - Support panel build, wiring checkout, and power-on of new systems

PLC and machine integration

- Program and integrate PLCs (Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT, or equivalent) that supervise or coordinate with the motion controller
 - Implement fieldbus communication - EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP - between PLC, motion controller, HMI, and upper-level software
 - Work with mechanical, software, and manufacturing engineering through design reviews, integration, and production ramp
 - Document designs, tuning parameters, and commissioning procedures; support transfer to manufacturing and field service

Required

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline
 - 7-8 years of hands-on experience in industrial motion control and automation
 - Demonstrated experience with ACS Motion Control hardware and software - SPiiPlus controllers/drives, ACSPL+ programming, MMI Application Studio
 - Strong working knowledge of servo control theory: control loop structure, gain tuning, frequency response, stability margins, feedforward
 - Proven ability to size and select motors, drives, and feedback devices from first principles rather than by catalog matching
 - Solid electrical fundamentals: ability to create and interpret schematics and wiring diagrams, and to troubleshoot with a multimeter, oscilloscope, and controller trace tools
 - PLC programming experience in at least one major platform, including ladder and structured text
 - Familiarity with industrial networks, especially EtherCAT, and with machine safety concepts and standards
 - Comfortable working hands-on in a lab or machine floor environment, including bring-up and debug of prototype hardware

Preferred

- Experience with multi-axis gantry systems, dual-loop feedback, or direct-drive linear and torque motors
 - Experience with other motion platforms (Beckhoff, Aerotech, Delta Tau/Power PMAC, Siemens, Rockwell) for comparison and migration work
 - Knowledge of vibration analysis, mechanical resonance, and structural dynamics as they affect closed-loop performance
 - Exposure to machine vision or sensor-triggered motion
 - Experience supporting equipment through design-to-production transition

What We Believe

We're proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we've been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone, to champion diversity and inclusion and to place people at the centre of everything we do. 

Humility

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone. 

Humanity

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves. 

Integrity

We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships. 

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation. 

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. 

UST reserves the right to periodically redefine your roles and responsibilities based on the requirements of the organization and/or your performance. 

- To support and promote the values of UST.

data.title: Platform Architect & Backend Lead
data.description:
About The Role

We are building a multi-tenant, hardware-agnostic IoT platform from the ground up. We need a senior engineer who can design the system architecture in the morning and write production backend code in the afternoon. This is not an architecture-only role and not a coding-only role - it is both, simultaneously, in a fast-moving early-stage environment. You will also own cloud infrastructure as interim DevOps until we scale. 

The Ideal Candidate

You have built IoT backend platforms before - not just used them. You understand the hard problems: device auth at scale, MQTT broker design, time-series ingestion performance, multi-tenant data isolation, and real-time delivery to web clients. You are comfortable making architectural decisions autonomously, documenting them clearly, and standing by them. You work remotely with discipline - you flag risks before they become problems. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture

- Design the full end-to-end IoT platform architecture: device connectivity layer → MQTT/protocol ingestion → stream processing → time-series storage → REST/GraphQL API layer → real-time WebSocket delivery
 - Define the multi-tenant data model: strict data isolation between customers, tenant-scoped API tokens, row-level security
 - Design the device lifecycle system: provisioning, X. 509/JWT authentication, device registry, status tracking, decommissioning
 - Architect the protocol abstraction layer so MQTT, Modbus, OPC-UA, CoAP, and HTTP devices all normalise to the same internal data model
 - Design a configurable rule engine: event-condition-action rules for alerts, automations, and integrations - no code required from customers
 - Plan OTA firmware update management: secure delivery, versioning, rollback, fleet orchestration
 - Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for every major technical choice - nothing undocumented
 - Design the scaling path from 100 devices (pilot) to 500, 000+ (production) without structural rework

Backend Development

- Build core platform services from scratch: device management, telemetry ingestion, rule engine, notification/alerting, OTA update, multi-tenant API gateway
 - Develop REST and GraphQL APIs with full OpenAPI specification - version-controlled from Day 1
 - Implement WebSocket and SSE endpoints for real-time telemetry delivery to web and mobile clients
 - Build device command-and-control with acknowledgement, retry logic, and timeout handling
 - Implement device shadow service: last-known state of every device accessible even when offline
 - Write unit, integration, and load tests - no service reaches staging without test coverage
 - Own service reliability: SLO definitions, alerting runbooks, on-call incident response

Cloud Infrastructure (Interim)

- Provision and manage all AWS environments (dev, staging, production) using Terraform - no click-ops
 - Configure AWS IoT Core: MQTT endpoint, topic namespace, rules engine, certificate management
 - Set up CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions for all backend services
 - Configure CloudWatch monitoring, log aggregation, and automated health alerts
 - Manage IAM for all team members - least-privilege access, no shared credentials
 - Hand off infrastructure fully documented when a DevOps engineer joins in Phase 2

Requirements

- 7-12 years software or systems engineering; minimum 4 years specifically building IoT platform backends or connected product infrastructure
 - Expert-level, hands-on experience with AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub - production deployments, not tutorials ⚑ NON-NEGOTIABLE
 - Expert MQTT knowledge: v3. 1 and v5. 0, topic hierarchy design, QoS levels, retained messages, Last Will & Testament, broker sizing and clustering ⚑ NON-NEGOTIABLE
 - Proficiency in Python and Node. js/TypeScript for production backend services - Go is a strong advantage
 - Hands-on experience with a time-series database: InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, or AWS Timestream
 - Terraform or AWS CloudFormation - you provision cloud infrastructure programmatically, not through the console
 - Multi-tenant SaaS backend architecture: data isolation patterns, tenant-scoped access control, shared infrastructure design
 - Security fundamentals applied in practice: TLS/mTLS, X. 509 certificates, OAuth 2. 0, JWT, secrets management (Vault or AWS Secrets Manager)
 - Message broker or streaming experience: Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS Kinesis, or AWS IoT Rules Engine
 - Proven ability to work autonomously at a senior level - makes decisions, documents rationale, flags risks without needing to be prompted ⚑ REMOTE DISCIPLINE

Nice to Have

- Industrial protocol knowledge: Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC-UA, BACnet - even as a consumer or integrator
 - EMQX, HiveMQ, or VerneMQ broker deployment and production operation
 - Edge computing runtimes: AWS Greengrass v2, Azure IoT Edge, or Balena
 - Digital twin frameworks: AWS IoT TwinMaker, Azure Digital Twins
 - Container orchestration: Kubernetes, ECS, or equivalent for future Phase 2 migration
 - Open-source IoT contributions or published technical writing on platform architecture

Skills At a Glance

Architecture: IoT platform end-to-end design

- Multi-tenant SaaS patterns
 - Device lifecycle management
 - Protocol abstraction
 - Rule engine design
 - Horizontal scaling strategy

Backend: Python / Node. js / TypeScript / Go

- REST + GraphQL API design
 - WebSocket / SSE real-time delivery
 - MQTT broker configuration
 - Time-series DB (InfluxDB / Timestream)
 - PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS

Cloud & DevOps: AWS IoT Core / Azure IoT Hub

- Terraform / CloudFormation
 - GitHub Actions CI/CD
 - Docker containers
 - CloudWatch monitoring
 - IAM and security policy management

Security: TLS / mTLS configuration

- X. 509 certificate management
 - OAuth 2. 0 / JWT implementation
 - Secrets management
 - Device authentication at scale

data.title: Lead Full-chip STA and timing signoff Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Full Chip SoC Timing Lead in ASIC/SoC design implementation and timing closure. The ideal candidate will lead full-chip timing activities from synthesis through place-and-route, signoff, and tapeout for complex SoCs in advanced technology nodes. This role requires deep expertise in STA, timing constraints, MMMC flows, SI/crosstalk analysis, ECO closure, and cross-functional collaboration with RTL, PD, CTS, DFT, power, and signoff teams. 

The Person

You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead full-chip timing closure for complex SoC/ASIC designs across all modes and corners. 
 - Own and drive timing signoff from synthesis to final tapeout. 
 - Develop, validate, and maintain timing constraints including SDC for full-chip and block-level integration. 
 - Perform and review static timing analysis (STA) for setup, hold, recovery, removal, clock gating, and async paths. 
 - Drive MMMC timing methodology and ensure robust timing convergence across PVT corners. 
 - Work closely with physical design teams on floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and post-route timing optimization. 
 - Analyze and resolve timing violations related to datapath, clock path, cross-talk, noise, OCV/AOCV/POCV, derates, and variation effects. 
 - Lead timing ECO strategies and execute closure with minimal impact to power, area, and performance. 
 - Collaborate with RTL/design teams to identify architectural or logic changes required for timing improvement. 
 - Coordinate with IP/block owners for timing budgeting, interface timing closure, and hierarchical timing signoff. 
 - Ensure signoff quality using industry-standard tools and methodologies. 
 - Drive correlation between implementation timing and signoff timing. 
 - Lead tapeout readiness reviews and provide timing risk assessment to program leadership. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and define best practices for timing methodology and closure. 

Preferred Experience

- 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics / Electrical Engineering / VLSI / Microelectronics / Computer Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC/SoC timing analysis and timing closure. 
 - Strong expertise in full-chip STA and timing signoff for large-scale SoCs. 
 - Proven experience in advanced technology nodes (such as 7nm, 5nm, 3nm or similar). 
 - Strong knowledge of synthesis, place-and-route, extraction, and signoff flows. 
 - Experience with timing budgeting and hierarchical/full-chip integration. 
 - Solid understanding of clocking architecture, CDC implications, and timing exception handling. 
 - Ability to debug complex timing issues and drive closure under aggressive schedule targets. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

data.description:
Job Title: SAP TP4 Solution Architect / Technical Engineering Lead

Location : Remote

Experience: 10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience, including 5+ years in SAP S/4HANA projects and 5+ years in frontend development. 

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP TP4 Solution Architect / Technical Engineering Lead to own end-to-end technical architecture and lead engineering execution from solution design through deployment and production support. 

The role combines architecture ownership, hands-on development, technical governance, and team leadership. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in SAP ABAP, SAPUI5/Fiori, data architecture, enterprise integration, and security, with experience supporting high-volume production systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture and Design

• Define the end-to-end TP4 technical architecture, solution boundaries, dependencies, and integration approach. 

• Translate approved functional designs into detailed technical designs aligned with enterprise standards. 

• Conduct technical impact assessments, evaluate architecture options, and identify risks. 

• Create architecture diagrams, Technical Design Documents, interface mappings, and security review documentation. 

• Collaborate with Master Data, OTC, Security, Basis, Demand Planning, Integration, and other technical teams. 

Technical Development and Leadership

• Lead engineering across ABAP, SAPUI5/Fiori, OData, CDS, workflows, integrations, reporting, and batch processing. 

• Develop complex solutions and provide hands-on guidance to technical teams. 

• Review technical designs, source code, unit-test evidence, transports, and deployment packages. 

• Ensure implementation aligns with approved architecture, coding standards, security requirements, and performance expectations. 

• Track technical debt and drive improvements in code quality and maintainability. 

. 

Mandatory Skills and Experience

SAP Implementation and Core Technical Expertise

• 10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation project experience. 

• 5+ years of SAP S/4HANA project experience. 

• 5+ years of frontend development experience. 

• Strong knowledge of data architecture, modern web technologies, and enterprise integration methods. 

• Experience supporting high-volume production environments. 

• Expertise in customizing and configuration tables, number ranges, numbering sequences, enqueue and locking mechanisms, RFC integration, authorization objects, SAP workflows, and change and transport management. 

ABAP Development

• Object-Oriented ABAP and complex data structures. 

• Open SQL, functional programming concepts, and dynamic programming. 

• Numbering, locking, debugging, and performance optimization. 

• RFC communication, BAPIs, and web services. 

• ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP). 

• Advanced CDS views. 

• OData V2 and V4 services. 

SAPUI5 and Fiori

• SAPUI5 and OpenUI5. 

• SAPUI5 freestyle application development. 

• Fiori Elements. 

• SAP Fiori Launchpad. 

JavaScript and TypeScript

• JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. 

• Asynchronous and reactive programming. 

• AJAX and request handling. 

• DOM manipulation. 

Development Tools

• Eclipse. 

• SAP Business Application Studio. 

• GitHub. 

Functional Knowledge

Working knowledge of one or more of the following is mandatory: 

• SAP MM. 

• SAP SD. 

• SAP FI/CO. 

• SAP Business Partner (BP). 

• SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM). 

Preferred Experience

• Functional or technical experience with SAP Trade Promotion Management or another TPM solution. 

Key Deliverables

• Technical impact assessments, dependency maps, initial risk assessments, and architecture options. 

• Architecture diagrams, Technical Design Documents, interface mappings, and security reviews. 

• Completed builds, code-review records, unit-test evidence, build-to-design reviews, and technical debt updates.

Description

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. Department Overview

The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows. 

Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation-not experimentation without operational accountability. 

Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator

We are seeking a Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node. js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software. 

Core Responsibilities

- Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule. 
 - Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications. 
 - App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node. js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS). 
 - Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs. 
 - Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance. 
 - Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces. 

Technical Profile

- Core Data Engineering Foundations: 
 - Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms. 
 - Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting). 
 - Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts. 
 - Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge: 
 - Practical experience with Node. js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO). 
 - AI & Agentic Engineering: 
 - Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain. 
 - Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms. 
 - Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e. g. , Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code. 
 - Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure: 
 - Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 

Qualifications

- Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth). 
 - Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation. 
 - Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node. js/APIs). 
 - Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Hyperconverged Infrastructure Data Path
data.description:
Quantum Corp. leads the world in helping organizations build modern, software-defined infrastructure that simplifies IT operations and accelerates digital transformation. Whether its delivering unified compute, storage, and networking for enterprise workloads, enabling seamless hybrid cloud deployments, powering mission-critical virtualized environments, or driving AI-ready hyperconverged infrastructure at scale, Quantum has the tools and technology to help you engineer the solution that works now - and scales for decades to come. You are applying to an exceptional team that contributes to enhancing our position as a proven global leader in hyperconverged and software-defined infrastructure. 

We are seeking a high-caliber Senior HCI Software Engineer to join our Hyperconverged Infrastructure Team. In this role, you will be responsible for the core software stack that unifies compute, storage, and networking into a single, seamlessly managed platform: the HCI Software Stack. You will design, implement, and optimize the software layers that converge compute, storage, and networking resources into a unified, policy-driven infrastructure platform. This is a full-stack infrastructure role requiring a passion for systems software, distributed resource management, and building platforms that make complex infrastructure simple to operate at scale. 

Specific Duties Include But Are Not Limited To

- HCI Platform Architecture: Design and maintain the core HCI software stack including the distributed resource scheduler, software-defined storage engine, and virtual networking fabric that underpin Quantum's hyperconverged appliances. 
 - Performance & Resource Efficiency: Profile and optimize resource contention across compute, storage, and network layers. Work with technologies like iSCSI, NVMe-oF, SR-IOV, and DPDK to minimize overhead and maximize workload density on shared HCI nodes. 
 - Fault Tolerance & Self-Healing: Implement and maintain features such as automatic node failure detection, live VM migration, distributed snapshot management, and self-healing storage policies to ensure continuous availability of HCI workloads. 
 - Virtualization & Workload Management: Develop and extend integrations with hypervisors (KVM, VMware, Hyper-V) and container runtimes (Kubernetes, Docker) to enable seamless workload placement, live migration, and QoS enforcement across the HCI cluster. 
 - Scale-Out & Lifecycle Management: Ensure the HCI platform scales linearly as nodes are added, automating data rebalancing, capacity expansion, and rolling software upgrades without disrupting running workloads. 

Job Requirements

- Minimum 8 years of experience in systems or infrastructure software development using C/C++, Python, or equivalent languages. 
 - Leverage modern development tools and AI-assisted workflows (e. g. , Claude code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLMs) to accelerate prototyping, code generation, and test automation. 
 - Experience developing or optimizing the datapath in a software-defined storage layer, including I/O path, caching, replication, erasure coding, and low-latency data services. 
 - Experience with hypervisors (KVM, VMware vSphere, Hyper-V) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift) is a plus. 
 - Experience with software-defined networking (OVS, VXLAN, BGP) and Linux networking stack is a plus. 
 - Experience with HCI platforms such as Nutanix AOS, VMware vSAN, or Azure Stack HCI is a plus. 
 - Experience with AI/ML infrastructure workloads and GPU resource management is a plus. 
 - Ability to work in a team environment. 
 - Strong communication skills. 
 - Ability to work with a globally distributed team. 
 - Self-motivated, able to identify and solve problems on their own. 
 - Ability to collaborate cross functionally and integrate other components into the solution. 
 - Approach problems creatively and not just repeat the same mistakes made before them. 
 - Effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Desired Skills

- Experience with Linux OS administration including kernel tuning, performance profiling (perf, eBPF), and HCI node lifecycle management
 - Experience using GIT. 
 - Experience using JIRA. 

Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is passionate about simplifying infrastructure complexity, thrives at the intersection of hardware and software, and has hands-on experience designing or operating hyperconverged or software defined infrastructure environments.

data.title: Senior Staff, Emulation Engineer
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

The Connectivity Business Unit at Marvell is at the forefront of delivering high-performance silicon for the world's most demanding data infrastructure, spanning Optical DSPs, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices. Within the BU, the Pre-Silicon Emulation team plays a critical role in program execution-bridging RTL design and real-world system behavior before a single chip is taped out. Our team owns emulation model development, test execution, and system-level debug across Marvell's emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), enabling early firmware bring-up, hardware/software co-validation, and risk reduction on the path to silicon. We work closely with design, verification, firmware, software, and post-silicon teams to ensure emulation is a productive, schedule-driving resource-not a bottleneck. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems at the intersection of hardware and software, and want your work to directly impact the success of next-generation connectivity silicon, we'd love to hear from you. 

What You Can Expect

Execute emulation model bring-up, test development, and debug for connectivity silicon programs, including ODSP, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices, on platforms such as Palladium, Veloce, and Zebu. 

Work with design, validation, and firmware teams to understand emulation hardware and software requirements, and implement platform configurations, transactors, speed bridges, protocol adapters, and firmware/software stacks. 

Engage with EDA and emulation hardware vendors to resolve platform, tooling, and model issues and maintain a productive emulation environment. 

Develop and maintain HW/SW enablement flows and scripts to support RTL validation and improve emulation model usability for firmware, driver, and system software development. 

Collaborate with pre-silicon validation, design, firmware, and post-silicon teams to identify and resolve emulation bottlenecks and improve validation coverage. 

Build and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure to improve emulation environment productivity, reliability, and utilization within assigned programs. 

Minimum Requirements

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's/PhD with 3+ years of experience. 

Hands-on experience with one or more SoC emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), including building and maintaining emulation models for SoC designs. 

Background in test planning, simulation, and debug in Verilog/SystemVerilog environments. 

Experience with SoC development flows, emulation-based debug, and system-level validation. 

Scripting and automation skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, and/or UNIX shell. 

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including design, validation, firmware, and vendor partners. 

Good to Have

Experience with emulation of networking devices or mixed-signal designs, including systems containing PHY or Layer-2/Layer-3 functionality. 

Exposure To Connectivity-focused Silicon, Such As

Optical DSPs (ODSP)

High-speed Ethernet PHYs

AEC/AOC enablement devices

Familiarity with firmware or software bring-up using emulation platforms. 

Experience contributing to or improving emulation infrastructure within a project or product line. 

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. 

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. 

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

data.description:
Job Details

Job Title: Head - Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)

Job Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Work Model: Work from Office

Job Level: Head / Senior Leadership

Employment Type: Full-time

Candidate Expectations

Total Experience: 15+ years preferred. 

Relevant Experience: Significant experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, academic administration, quality frameworks, and institutional ranking processes within higher education. 

Candidate Location: Chennai preferred; candidates willing to relocate may be considered. 

Mandatory Skills

Leadership of IQAC or institutional quality assurance functions. 

NAAC accreditation processes, assessment, and documentation. 

Institutional ranking frameworks and data management. 

Academic and administrative quality audits. 

Outcome-based education, academic quality metrics, and continuous improvement. 

Preparation of institutional reports, evidence repositories, and performance dashboards. 

Stakeholder coordination and team leadership. 

Preferred Industry: Universities, higher education institutions, medical colleges, engineering institutions, and multidisciplinary educational institutions. 

Leadership Expectations: Ability to lead institution-wide quality initiatives, coordinate accreditation and ranking activities, and establish robust quality assurance and governance mechanisms. 

Education & Certification

Mandatory: Ph. D. or postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline, as appropriate to the institution's requirements. 

Preferred: Ph. D. with substantial experience in higher education administration, academic quality assurance, or institutional governance. 

Good to Have: Training or certifications related to NAAC accreditation, NBA accreditation, quality management systems, academic auditing, outcome-based education, or institutional assessment frameworks. 

Additional Preference: Experience in multidisciplinary institutions covering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education. 

Detailed Job Description

Role Overview

The Head of IQAC will be responsible for establishing, leading, and strengthening the institution's internal quality assurance framework. The role will oversee institutional quality processes, accreditation readiness, NAAC-related data and documentation, institutional ranking submissions, academic and administrative audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

The position will work closely with senior management, academic leaders, department heads, faculty, and administrative teams to ensure institutional performance is measured, documented, evaluated, and improved in line with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

Institutional Quality Assurance & Governance

Develop and implement institution-wide quality assurance policies, frameworks, procedures, and annual quality plans. 

Lead the functioning of the Internal Quality Assurance Cell and establish mechanisms for continuous academic and administrative improvement. 

Define quality indicators, monitoring systems, review mechanisms, and accountability structures across departments. 

Ensure quality initiatives are aligned with institutional objectives and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

NAAC Accreditation & Assessment

Lead institutional preparedness for NAAC accreditation, assessment, and applicable quality assurance processes. 

Coordinate the collection, verification, consolidation, and presentation of data and supporting evidence required for accreditation. 

Oversee preparation and review of relevant institutional submissions, including the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR), Self-Study Report (SSR), and other applicable documentation. 

Track accreditation criteria, performance indicators, evidence gaps, and improvement requirements. 

Coordinate with academic and administrative departments to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines. 

Institutional Rankings & Performance Data

Lead institutional ranking-related data collection, validation, analysis, and submission activities for relevant national and other applicable ranking frameworks. 

Coordinate with departments to compile verified information relating to academics, research, faculty, student outcomes, infrastructure, outreach, and institutional performance. 

Establish centralised data repositories and evidence-tracking mechanisms to improve data accuracy, consistency, and auditability. 

Analyse ranking performance, identify gaps, and recommend initiatives to strengthen institutional outcomes. 

Monitor ranking criteria, submission timelines, and applicable framework updates. 

Academic Quality & Continuous Improvement

Monitor academic quality indicators, teaching-learning processes, curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and student outcomes. 

Promote outcome-based education, programme outcome mapping, feedback mechanisms, and academic quality enhancement initiatives, where applicable. 

Facilitate internal academic audits, administrative audits, and periodic departmental reviews. 

Identify performance gaps and coordinate corrective and preventive action plans. 

Encourage evidence-based decision-making and a culture of continuous quality improvement. 

Data Management, Documentation & Reporting

Establish standardised processes for data collection, validation, documentation, and record maintenance. 

Develop dashboards and institutional reports to track quality indicators, accreditation readiness, ranking performance, and improvement initiatives. 

Ensure the availability of reliable supporting evidence for audits, assessments, accreditation reviews, and ranking submissions. 

Implement document control, version management, and evidence verification practices. 

Present periodic quality performance reports and improvement recommendations to institutional leadership. 

Stakeholder Coordination & Capacity Building

Work closely with senior management, academic leadership, faculty, department coordinators, and administrative teams on quality-related initiatives. 

Establish departmental quality coordinators and define clear responsibilities for data submission, verification, and compliance. 

Conduct awareness sessions and capacity-building programmes on accreditation criteria, documentation standards, quality metrics, and institutional ranking requirements. 

Facilitate internal quality review meetings and monitor the closure of agreed action items. 

Build institution-wide ownership of quality assurance and accreditation readiness. 

Regulatory Compliance & Quality Audits

Monitor applicable quality assurance and accreditation requirements relevant to the institution and its academic programmes. 

Coordinate internal reviews to assess compliance with prescribed academic, administrative, and documentation standards. 

Ensure timely identification, escalation, and closure of quality-related gaps. 

Maintain readiness for external assessments, inspections, audits, and accreditation visits. 

Coordinate with relevant institutional departments to ensure consistency between submitted data, supporting evidence, and official records. 

Strategic Planning & Institutional Improvement

Translate accreditation and ranking findings into measurable institutional improvement plans. 

Benchmark institutional performance against relevant peer institutions and applicable quality frameworks. 

Recommend process improvements, governance mechanisms, and digital tools to strengthen quality management. 

Track implementation of improvement initiatives and report progress to institutional leadership. 

Contribute to long-term institutional planning through quality analytics and performance insights. 

Key Skills

Mandatory Skills

IQAC leadership and institutional quality assurance. 

NAAC accreditation and related documentation. 

Institutional rankings and performance data management. 

Academic and administrative quality audits. 

Data validation, evidence management, and institutional reporting. 

Quality indicators, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

Stakeholder coordination and institutional governance. 

Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration. 

Good-to-Have Skills

Exposure to NBA accreditation and other applicable programme-level accreditation frameworks. 

Experience in multidisciplinary universities offering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering programmes. 

Knowledge of outcome-based education, programme outcome assessment, and academic quality frameworks. 

Experience with institutional dashboards, data analytics, and digital documentation systems. 

Exposure to national ranking frameworks, benchmarking, and institutional performance improvement. 

Research, academic administration, and university-level governance experience. 

Other Specific Remarks

Candidates should have substantial experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, and ranking-related activities, rather than general academic administration alone. 

Demonstrated ownership of NAAC-related data, documentation, assessment readiness, and institutional quality processes is preferred. 

Strong expertise in data accuracy, evidence validation, reporting, and coordination across academic and administrative departments is essential. 

Candidates should be capable of leading institution-wide quality initiatives and presenting performance insights to senior leadership. 

Experience in a university or large multidisciplinary higher education institution will be an advantage. 

Candidates with exposure to both Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education are preferred. 

The role requires a detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong analytical, documentation, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities.

data.title: Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence
data.description:
Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence

- The OpportunityAliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand-we're building the world's most admired tattoo company. 

With 16+ premium studios, a team of 160+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders. 

We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations. 

We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners. 

If you thrive in high-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you. 

As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region. 

- The MandateYou will own quality across the entire studio network end to end - compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself - what gets checked, how often, through what method - and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on. 

- What you'll be doingChecking every studio against its own standard - how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run - through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported. 

Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all - you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change. 

Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it - real visits and unannounced ones - so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to. 

Owning the physical readiness of every studio - hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on - and catching what's broken before a customer does. 

Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted - and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it. 

Building the entire audit system from nothing - the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask - designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day. 

Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale - holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something. 

- What we're looking forYou've done this before - run quality or audit work across multiple locations. 

You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all. 

Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past - the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later. 

You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen. 

You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone - a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior - you report what you found, not what's comfortable. 

Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both - the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once. 

Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline - what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before. 

- What success looks likeevery studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses.
