data.title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
data.description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets - safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights. 

Overview

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities. 
Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation. 

  
Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities
Strategic Focus

- Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities. 
 - Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features. 
 - Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management. 
 - Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare. 
 - Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation. 
 - Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns. 
 - Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms. 
 - Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance. 
 - Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose. 
 - Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues. 
 - Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues. 
 - Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases. 
 - Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption. 
Operational Management

- Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues. 
 - Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions. 
 - Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk. 
 - Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation. 
 - Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria. 

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership  
   

- Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners. 
 - Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors. 
 - Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits. 
 - Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams. 
Governance, Security and Risk

- Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements. 
 - Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners. 
 - Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance. 
 - Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options. 
 - Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer. 
The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs. 

  
Experience & Personal Attributes

- Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation. 
 - Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous. 
 - Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI. 
 - Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support. 
 - Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes. 
 - Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous. 
 - Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation. 
 - Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review. 
 - Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including structured diagnosis of complex integration, data, security and configuration issues. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical options, trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong planning, prioritisation and delivery discipline, with the ability to manage concurrent initiatives and production priorities. 
 - High standards of integrity, discretion and care when handling employee and organisational data. 
 - Practical, collaborative and outcomes-focused, with the confidence to work with limited supervision, manage multiple priorities, challenge weak assumptions and escalate material risks.

data.description:
About the team

The Platform & Infrastructure Engineering team owns the foundational estate that everything else runs on. The team designs, builds, automates, and operates scalable cloud-native systems across networks, security, data & storage, and compute. It carries significant regulatory and operational responsibility, with its platforms directly underpinning critical customer-facing systems such as payments and banking, so security and availability are not optional. 

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Infrastructure Security at slice. You will own charters like cloud security, network security, and software supply chain security and build a team that makes the secure path the default path for every engineer. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the architecture, hire and grow the team, and be accountable for measurable, auditable security outcomes across our cloud and hybrid estate. 

What You will do

- Lead, hire and scale the Infrastructure Security team, setting goals, mentoring engineers, and developing technical leaders. 
 - Own the cloud and hybrid network security architecture and roadmap, balancing security, reliability, scalability, velocity and cost. 
 - Establish secure-by-design principles, guardrails and baseline configurations across AWS accounts, organizations and future cloud regions. 
 - Drive Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform automation to ensure security controls are version-controlled, tested, repeatable and consistently enforced. 
 - Own IAM, SSO/Identity Center, PAM, least-privilege access, just-in-time access and secrets management. 
 - Enforce encryption, KMS/HSM key management, certificate lifecycle management and data protection standards. 
 - Secure Kubernetes (EKS), compute workloads and container images through hardening, runtime protection and automated patching. 
 - Design secure network architecture, including VPC segmentation, hybrid connectivity, egress controls, firewalls, DNS security, IDS/IPS, and zero-trust access. 
 - Protect internet-facing services and APIs using DDoS mitigation, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and API security controls. 
 - Harden CI/CD pipelines and implement DevSecOps practices, including short-lived credentials (OIDC), SCA, image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and provenance. 
 - Implement policy-as-code and admission controls to prevent misconfigured infrastructure and untrusted or vulnerable artifacts from reaching production. 
 - Govern open-source and third-party dependencies through vulnerability management, license compliance, and remediation of SLAs. 
 - Establish security metrics for control coverage, policy violations, exposure and remediation timelines; continuously detect and remediate misconfigurations and security drifts. 
 - Partner with Cybersecurity, AppSec, GRC and SOC teams to address security and compliance gaps and support audits. 
 - Lead infrastructure security incident responses, including DDoS attacks and cloud misconfigurations, and drive blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Strengthen resilience through availability planning, disaster recovery, capacity management, incident readiness, and recovery exercises for critical infrastructure. 

What You will need

- 9+ years in infrastructure, cloud or security engineering, including 2+ years managing and building high-performing teams. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise in AWS/GCP/Azure security (IAM, Organizations/SCPs, KMS, Security Hub, Guard Duty or equivalents) and cloud security architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of IAM, SSO, PAM, secrets management, encryption and key management. 
 - Deep expertise in cloud and data-center networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection and IDS/IPS. 
 - Practical experience with CI/CD hardening, SCA and image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and policy enforcement. 
 - Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (e. g. , Terraform) and experience building guardrails at scale. 
 - Solid grounding in observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux, networking, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience designing infrastructure for high-scale, highly available environments. 
 - Experience in fintech, banking, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments. 
 - Experience with RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, CERT-In guidelines, PCI DSS or NPCI audits. 
 - Depth in admission controllers, policy engines and runtime security tools. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CCSP, CISSP or CKS. 
 - Contributions to security tooling, open source or the wider security community. 

Life at slice

Life so good, you'd think we're kidding: 

- Competitive salaries. Period. 
 - An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We'll love you and take care of you, our promise. 
 - Flexible working hours. Just don't call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. 
 - Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. 
 - A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. 
 - Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. 
 - Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you'll forget the term "colleagues can't be your friends".

data.description:
Location: Mangalore - India

Summary

We are looking for a Manager - Software Engineering (Data Extraction) to lead and scale UniCourt's core data extraction and processing systems in the Legal Tech domain. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with strong expertise in Python-based backend systems, data pipelines, and automation frameworks. You will be responsible for driving innovation in large-scale data ingestion, transformation, and standardization while maintaining the highest levels of accuracy, reliability, and performance. This role requires close collaboration with Product, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure timely delivery, process consistency, and adherence to UniCourt's values of innovation, transparency, and excellence in data quality. 

About the Job

Our company creates some of the world's most cutting-edge software solutions in the legal industry. We solve difficult problems, work on innovative technology, and build world-class platforms for people and enterprises to interact with court records and other public data sets. With some of the best minds in the industry, we're one of the most sought-after learning and career destinations in the world of legal tech. If you're looking to work at a company with opportunities to forge your career path in technology, UniCourt is the right place for you. Our customers range from individuals who interact with court records a few hours in a month to enterprise clients who spend several hours every day on our SaaS platform. 

About Us

UniCourt is a leader in making court data more accessible and useful with our Legal Data as a Service (LDaaS). We provide real-time access to court data through our APIs and online app for business development and intelligence, litigation analytics, litigation tracking, case research, investigations, background checks, due diligence, compliance, underwriting, machine learning models, and process automation. 

We provide access to court data from state and federal courts to a diverse list of clients, including Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw firms and industries such as legal, insurance, finance, investigations, government, education, nonprofits, and consumers. 

UniCourt is a legal technology company focused on using technology to unlock the potential of legal data. We are based in both California and Mangalore, India and our team includes legal professionals, data scientists, physicists, computer engineers, and sales and marketing, professionals. 

Role & Responsibilities

1. Sprint & Resource Management

a) Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and re-planning with Product and QA leadership. 

b) Ensure equitable resource allocation and optimize team productivity. 

c) Track sprint progress, manage interdependencies, and ensure timely delivery of data extraction milestones. 

2. Requirements & Functional Design Ownership

a) Own and finalize High-Level Requirements Documents (HLRs) in collaboration with Product Managers, CTO, and data stakeholders. 

b) Create and manage Jira Epics, User Stories, and Tasks for data-related projects. 

c) Lead the creation of Functional Design Documents (FDDs) for data workflows, defining success metrics for extraction accuracy, coverage, and timeliness. 

d) Review Interface Design Documents (IDDs) related to API integrations and provide improvement feedback. 

3. Data Quality & Testing Collaboration

a) Review and approve QA test plans for data extraction, validation, and transformation workflows. 

b) Define CI/CD pipeline requirements ensuring that regression, integration, and data consistency tests block faulty deployments. 

c) Partner with QA and data engineering teams to identify recurring data issues, optimize extraction logic, and improve validation frameworks. 

d) Oversee release management processes, ensuring smooth rollouts and detailed release documentation. 

4. Delivery Excellence

a) Ensure that all data extraction projects are delivered on time, meeting quality and scalability standards. 

b) Communicate deviations in requirements or timelines proactively to stakeholders. 

c) Oversee hotfix and quick sprints to resolve critical data or pipeline issues efficiently. 

5. Incident & Production Management

a) Escalate and report critical data incidents with detailed root cause analysis and corrective actions. 

b) Maintain dashboards for tracking extraction performance, job failures, latency, and data freshness. 

c) Share periodic reports on system health, coverage, and performance with leadership. 

6. Process Management & Governance

a) Define and enforce development and release processes tailored for data extraction pipelines. 

b) Establish checklists for requirements approval, design reviews, coding standards, testing, documentation, and release readiness. 

c) Keep data extraction architecture and process documentation up-to-date in Confluence or similar tools. 

7. Cost & Tool Optimization

a) Monitor cloud (AWS) costs related to crawling, storage, and data pipeline execution. 

b) Evaluate and implement new Python libraries, frameworks, or tools to improve data extraction accuracy and efficiency. 

c) Lead POCs to test and adopt scalable approaches using technologies like Scrapy, FastAPI, Airflow, or AWS Lambda. 

d) Track and prioritize initiatives impacting data quality and client deliverables. 

8. Team Building & Hiring

a) Build and structure the team with focus on scalability, performance, and automation. 

b) Collaborate with HR to drive recruitment for Python developers, data engineers, and automation specialists. 

c) Design level-specific technical assessments for Python and data pipeline skills and ensure structured feedback documentation. 

9. Coaching, Mentoring & Performance Development

a) Conduct regular 1: 1s to guide team members on career growth, technical development, and performance improvements. 

b) Mentor engineers on advanced Python coding practices, data engineering standards, and architectural best practices. 

c) Identify and nurture high-potential employees and build succession plans for key roles. 

10. Strategic & Analytical Thinking

a) Apply strong analytical thinking to improve data accuracy, reduce processing time, and enhance maintainability. 

b) Drive initiatives that align with organizational KPIs and client impact metrics. 

c) Anticipate data-related risks and implement proactive solutions at scale. 

11. Leadership & Communication

a) Lead with empathy, integrity, and transparency. 

b) Encourage innovation and collaboration across cross-functional teams. 

c) Communicate clearly with stakeholders on goals, challenges, and project updates, maintaining alignment at all levels. 

Qualifications

1. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science

Required Skills

1. 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 2-3 years in a leadership or management role. 

2. Strong expertise in Python, with experience in frameworks like FastAPI, Django, Flask, or Scrapy. 

3. Strong experience in containerising application with Docker to deploy on Kubernetes K8S

4. Hands-on experience with data extraction, web scraping, ETL pipelines, and data processing frameworks. 

5. Proficiency with AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, CloudWatch) and CI/CD tools. 

6. Familiarity with Airflow, Kafka, or Celery for workflow orchestration and automation. 

7. Strong understanding of Agile, SDLC, and DevOps principles. 

8. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills. 

9. Experience in Legal Tech, Data Analytics, or SaaS environments is a strong plus.

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. data.title: Web Developer - Webflow, Marketo
data.description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions-creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels. 

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth-turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection. 

Job Summary

Role Purpose

Candescent is seeking a skilled Web Developer to build, maintain, and continuously improve our website from one of our India office locations. You will work closely with marketing, design, and strategy stakeholders to bring pages and campaigns to life quickly and cleanly, with a strong focus on hands-on Webflow development and integrating web experiences with Marketo for lead capture and marketing automation. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys turning designs into polished, performant, well-structured pages and is comfortable owning the technical execution of a marketing website. You will work under the direction of the senior web developer in India, who will set priorities, review your work, and provide technical coaching. 

Key Responsibilities And Deliverables

What you will be responsible for and what you will do

Build & Maintain

- Build, update, and maintain website pages, templates, and components in Webflow, following design specifications and brand guidelines. 
 - Maintain clean, scalable Webflow CMS structures including collections, fields, and dynamic content that non-technical teammates can manage. 
 - Implement responsive, accessible, cross-browser designs from Figma or similar design files. 
 - Perform regular site maintenance including fixing broken links, resolving bugs, managing redirects, and monitoring uptime. 

Marketing Systems & Tracking

- Integrate and troubleshoot Marketo forms, tracking scripts, and landing pages within the website, ensuring accurate lead capture and data flow into marketing automation. 
 - Implement and maintain tracking and analytics tags such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Marketo Munchkin in coordination with marketing stakeholders. 
 - Support A/B testing initiatives by implementing test variants and experiment code on landing pages. 

Performance & Quality

- Optimise pages for site speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance. 
 - Ensure SEO best practices are followed in markup, including meta tags, structured data, semantic HTML, URL structure, and redirects. 
 - Translate designs accurately, with strong attention to spacing, typography, and visual detail. 

Collaboration & Ways of Working

- Collaborate with designers, marketers, and project managers to scope, estimate, and deliver web requests on time. 
 - Work closely with the senior web developer in India, who will set priorities, review work, and provide technical direction and coaching. 
 - Maintain basic documentation of site structure, components, and workflows. 
 - Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs. 

Experience

Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience

- 3-5 years of experience building and maintaining websites, including hands-on Webflow development across Designer and CMS. 
 - Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
 - Experience integrating and troubleshooting Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform for forms and tracking on a website. 
 - Familiarity with responsive design principles and cross-browser and device testing. 
 - Basic understanding of SEO fundamentals as they relate to site markup and structure. 
 - Strong attention to detail and the ability to translate designs accurately. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and projects at once. 
 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced marketing environment with shifting priorities. 

Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions

Additional accomplishments

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a portfolio of live sites will be considered. 
 - Experience implementing tracking and analytics tags such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager is preferred. 
 - Experience with other no-code or low-code website platforms and content management systems is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with version control such as Git for custom code embeds is a plus. 
 - Basic experience with A/B testing tools is a plus. 
 - Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Jira is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred. 
 - Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful. 

What Success Looks Like

- Web pages and campaigns are built accurately, on time, and match design intent. 
 - Forms and tracking reliably capture and pass lead data into Marketo without errors. 
 - The site stays fast, functional, and free of recurring bugs. 
 - Webflow CMS is organised and maintainable by both developers and marketers. 
 - Requests are delivered predictably, with clear communication on status and blockers. 

What Will Make You Successful

- Care for the small details that separate a good build from a sloppy one. 
 - Willingness to ask questions early rather than guessing at requirements. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum. 
 - Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones. 
 - A collaborative, low-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback. 
 - Strong organisation, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment. 

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

data.title: STAFF, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve Walmart's next-generation International Pricing platforms. 

The International Pricing team enables Walmart's mission of Every Day Low Price (EDLP). At its core, the team is responsible for the systems that help set, manage, approve, and execute prices for first-party items across Walmart's international markets. 

The platforms you build will support multiple countries, each representing a multi-billion-dollar business. You will solve complex engineering and business problems involving large-scale data processing, pricing recommendations, rules and workflows, downstream price execution, resiliency, auditability, and market-specific requirements. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write production-quality code, lead architecture and design, review critical technical decisions, and mentor engineers across the team. 

About The Team

Walmart International Technology enables our stores, eCommerce operations, associates, and customers across markets outside the United States. 

The International Pricing Engineering team builds and operates platforms that support the end-to-end price-setting lifecycle for first-party merchandise. These capabilities include pricing strategy and recommendations, business-rule evaluation, simulations, approval workflows, manual and automated price setting, markdown optimization, competitive pricing intelligence, and price execution through downstream systems. 

Our goal is to build a scalable, resilient, multi-market pricing platform that supports common global capabilities while accommodating the regulatory, operational, currency, hierarchy, and business-process requirements of individual markets. 

What You'll Do

Remain hands-on and contribute production-quality code for critical platform capabilities, complex integrations, and technically challenging initiatives. 

Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for International Pricing platforms. 

Write high-quality design documents, including HLDs, LLDs, Architecture Decision Records, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams, and operational readiness plans. 

Review architecture and technical designs produced by engineering teams and ensure alignment with platform standards, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. 

Design and build scalable, high-throughput, and low-latency Java- or Kotlin-based microservices deployed on cloud infrastructure. 

Build extensible pricing capabilities using domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, Kafka, API-first principles, and well-defined service boundaries. 

Design solutions for pricing recommendations, rule evaluation, approvals, simulations, publishing, execution, auditability, and downstream-system integration. 

Own data-modelling and persistence strategies across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data stores, with a strong focus on data accuracy, lineage, consistency, and traceability. 

Design resilient distributed workflows using appropriate patterns such as orchestration, outbox, retries, circuit breaking, idempotency, and dead-letter processing. 

Define REST and gRPC APIs with clear contracts, backward-compatibility guarantees, versioning strategies, and consumer-driven contract testing. 

Design for multi-market and multi-tenant use cases while balancing global platform consistency with market-specific business requirements. 

Identify and proactively address systemic risks, including scaling bottlenecks, single points of failure, data-integrity gaps, operational dependencies, and technical-debt accumulation. 

Drive architecture and integration alignment with shared platforms and downstream systems responsible for price calculation, price publishing, execution, catalogue, analytics, and store operations. 

Represent International Pricing in cross-organizational architecture and engineering forums. 

Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security validation, canary deployment, rollback, and production verification. 

Drive observability-first engineering through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, actionable alerts, and business-flow monitoring. 

Ensure that services comply with enterprise security, privacy, infrastructure, and software-development standards. 

Lead production-readiness reviews, incident investigations, root-cause analyses, and reliability-improvement initiatives. 

Mentor junior, mid-level, and senior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, pairing, and structured feedback. 

Establish engineering standards for design quality, code quality, automated testing, performance, security, release readiness, and operational excellence. 

Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Business, Program, Quality Engineering, and other platform teams to translate complex pricing requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

Promote a platform-first mindset by creating reusable and configurable capabilities that enable multiple markets and engineering teams without duplicating solutions. 

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, automate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and deliver measurable business value. 

Make sound technical decisions and solve complex problems efficiently in a high-impact, fast-moving environment. 

What You'll Bring

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

12+ years of relevant software-engineering experience, including experience building highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems. 

Strong hands-on programming experience with Java 17/21, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. 

Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed-system fundamentals, design patterns, and software-engineering principles. 

Strong experience with Kafka or similar messaging platforms and asynchronous processing patterns. 

Experience designing and operating systems using relational and NoSQL databases. 

Advanced experience with cloud infrastructure such as Azure, GCP, or AWS. 

Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, service-to-service communication, autoscaling, resource management, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 

Experience designing systems that process large data volumes while maintaining strong consistency, traceability, performance, and availability. 

Demonstrated ability to author clear technical designs and influence architecture across multiple teams. 

Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, messaging, and data layers. 

Experience driving engineering excellence through automated testing, performance optimization, reliability improvements, operational readiness, and incident prevention. 

Experience integrating machine-learning inference APIs or model endpoints into production services. 

Familiarity with GenAI-assisted engineering tools and their responsible use across software-development workflows. 

Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and consensus-building skills. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and raise the technical capabilities of the broader team. 

Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform architecture and sustainability. 

Experience building or operating large-scale retail, eCommerce, pricing, promotion, markdown, or revenue-management platforms. 

Understanding of retail pricing concepts such as EDLP, competitive pricing, price rules, simulations, approvals, price execution, regional pricing, and markdown optimization. 

Experience building multi-tenant or multi-market platforms with shared global capabilities and configurable market-specific behaviour. 

Experience integrating with complex upstream and downstream enterprise systems. 

A continuous drive to simplify, automate, improve, and optimize platforms, tools, development workflows, and operational processes. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Job Description

We are looking for a Staff SDE - IBM OMS Sterling who will serve as a technical leader, driving architectural direction, multi-team initiatives, and the development of highly scalable distributed systems. You will partner with Product, Architecture, DevOps and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful technology solutions across a complex digital ecosystem. 

You will independently define and deliver large-scale, multi-phase projects, mentor engineers, and shape technical strategy. The role also includes leveraging LLMs and GenAI-driven tools to enhance engineering productivity, reduce cycle time, and build the next generation of internal developer experience tools. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

 - Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact, multi-team engineering initiatives.

 - Define technical roadmaps, sequence projects into phases, and ensure timely execution across teams. Software Engineering & System Design

- Architect, develop, and optimize microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud.

 - Solve complex cross-system issues through deep debugging, performance tuning, and root cause analysis.

- Champion adoption of AI-assisted development practices and LLM/GenAI tools across engineering teams to enhance workflows, improve cycle time, and automate routine tasks. 
 - Define clear guidelines, training, and standards for effective and secure use of AI tools, including prompt engineering, code generation, and review expectations. 
 - Integrate AI-driven capabilities such as code generation, unit test creation, log analysis, documentation summarization, and code review assistance into the development workflow. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices for AI-generated code, including human-in-the-loop reviews, coding standards, test automation, secure coding, and design-first development. 
 - Measure and optimize engineering productivity using AI-related metrics (cycle time, PR throughput, AI-code adoption, defect escape rate, developer satisfaction) and continuously identify opportunities to reduce bottlenecks with AI. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Impact

- Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, QE, DevOps, and peer engineering teams. 
 - Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate across teams to resolve dependencies and align on architectural standards. 
 - Influence technical direction beyond your immediate team. Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Mentor engineers across multiple teams, guiding them in design, coding, debugging, and best practices. 
 - Participate actively in hiring and talent development. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design critiques, and technical leadership. 
 - Help define and uphold engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural principles. Ownership & Operational Excellence

- Take full ownership of systems from development to deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
 - Ensure engineering deliverables meet performance, reliability, and security criteria. 
 - Proactively identify areas for improvement and propose scalable, maintainable solutions. 
 - Lead incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Skills and Qualifications

Must-Have - IBM Sterling OMS

- 10+ years of professional experience in IBM OMS Sterling Development. 
 - Hands-on experience with IBM Sterling OMS on-premises - order lifecycle management, distributed order management (DOM), and fulfilment workflows. 
 - Proficiency in Sterling customization: Java extensions via YFS/SMCFS APIs, pipeline configuration (condition trees, transaction pipelines), agent framework, and service framework. 
 - Deep understanding of Sterling Agent Server architecture: master/child agent processes, agent criteria, job thresholds, and concurrency impact on database performance. 
 - Ability to diagnose Sterling on-premises JVM issues: heap sizing, GC tuning (G1/ZGC), root cause analysis, and thread dump/heap dump interpretation. 
 - Experience with IBM Sterling Configuration Deployment Tool (CDT) and environment promotion governance across dev, QA, staging, and production. 
 - Experience with IBM Inventory Visibility (IV): supply, demand class modelling, net availability calculation, and OMS-IV integration. 
 - Understanding of inventory supply and demand mapping: how WMS feeds populate IV supply and how OMS order reservations reduce net availability. 
 - Experience implementing REST-based inventory reservation flows from e-commerce platforms through OMS into IBM IV - including idempotency, retry, rollback, and reservation release on cancellation. 
 - Ability to articulate the end-to-end customer order journey and every OMS/IV touch point - from PDP availability check through order creation, fulfilment, and returns. Assessed in interview. 
 - Delivered at least two IBM Sterling OMS implementations or major platform transformations; able to articulate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and lessons learned from each. 
 - Proven experience shipping scalable, high-availability, high-performance systems, including load handling, horizontal scaling, observability, and fault-tolerant design. 
 - Experience with WAS Application, JMS, distributed system patterns, caching, asynchronous processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of working with databases: Oracle
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, debugging capabilities, and system-level thinking. 
 - Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. 
 - Ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive technical initiatives. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience applying LLMs/GenAI to improve engineering productivity and developer workflows.

Personal Attributes

data.description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world's leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit  www. saviynt. com. 

This is a Principal position within the  Platform Engineering organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated Platform Engineering hat, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience. 

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. Crucially, you will act as a partner across engineering-working closely with developers, Embedded SREs (E-SREs), and Central SRE teams-while actively evangelizing platform products to accelerate adoption throughout the organization. 

WHAT YOU BRING

- 
12+ Years of experience across the Software Development lifecycle with a focus on platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure. 

- 
Proven IDP build experience: you have shipped or significantly contributed to a Backstage or Port portal (or equivalent) used in production. 

- 
Deep Kubernetes expertise across EKS and AKS, including multi-tenant cluster design, Helm, Kustomize, and Crossplane. 

- 
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS fleet management, cell-based architectures, and ring/canary deployment strategies. 

- 
Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or Python for building production-grade CLIs, custom operators, or platform backends. 

- 
GitLab CI + ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts pipeline implementation experience-building CI/CD-as-a-service for engineering teams. 

- 
Terraform / OpenTofu module authoring at scale-module registry design, state management, and refactoring large IaC codebases. 

- 
Background in developing Backstage plugins or contributing to open-source developer platform ecosystems. 

- 
Practical application of workload identity, SPIFFE/IRSA, and cloud-native zero-trust network architectures. 

- 
Implementation of OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno for policy-as-code within production-grade Kubernetes clusters. 

- 
Proficiency in FinOps methodologies and tools such as Kubecost or cloud cost exposure APIs. 

- 
Experience managing Kafka or AWS MSK as a multi-tenant platform capability. 

- 
Proven platform-first mindset with a history of centralizing scattered tooling into core foundation layers, evangelizing platform adoption, and collaborating effectively across developers, Embedded SREs, and Central SREs. 

- 
Professional exposure to identity security frameworks, SaaS delivery, and high-compliance operational environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP). 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOINGInternal Developer Platform (IDP) & Developer Portal

- Take ownership of key aspects of the IDP architectural lifecycle, from service catalog creation to automated, self-service environment provisioning. 

- Construct and manage a centralized developer hub featuring TechDocs, software catalogs, and seamless integrations with GitLab, Jira, and cloud management consoles. 

- Develop and implement "golden-path" templates to rapidly deploy new microservices equipped with Kubernetes configurations, observability tools, and automated security guardrails. 

- Champion and evangelize the adoption of platform products across engineering units using developer feedback, usage analytics, and active outreach. 

Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Fleet Operations

- Design and support cell-based deployment patterns and progressive ring-deployment strategies across multi-tenant and single-tenant customer fleets to isolate tenant workloads and limit blast radiuses. 

- Automate continuous zero-downtime release deployments globally while providing platform abstractions that support multi-region SaaS deployments. 

Platform-as-a-Service on Kubernetes

- Design and supervise multi-tenant Kubernetes environments on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, ensuring a unified cluster management experience for internal users. 

- Produce modular Helm libraries and infrastructure compositions that mask underlying cloud complexities for product development teams. 

- Enforce robust isolation and access control policies that reflect our multi-tenancy security framework at the namespace level. 

- Maintain high availability through automated cluster lifecycle operations, including seamless scaling and blue/green deployment rotations. 

GitOps, CI/CD, and Delivery Infrastructure

- Drive the evolution of CI/CD-as-a-service by providing standardized pipeline templates via GitLab CI and ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts for effortless team consumption. 

- Deploy GitOps methodologies to establish default rollback capabilities, continuous drift detection, and transparent audit trails across environment workflows. 

- Incorporate supply-chain security measures, such as container signing and SBOM creation, directly into our core delivery infrastructure. 

API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure

- Manage edge, ingress, and service-to-service communication infrastructure (API gateways, service mesh), incorporating built-in mTLS, rate limiting, distributed tracing context propagation, and circuit breaking as platform primitives. 

- Configure global load balancing and edge protection (CDN/WAF) as standardized defaults across developer paths. 

Infrastructure Automation & IaC

- Curate a centralized Terraform / OpenTofu registry for multi-cloud resources that adheres to stringent FinOps and security standards by default. 

- Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane). 

- Engineer custom Go-based CLI tools and operators to automate critical platform tasks, including cost tracking and credential rotation. 

Platform Observability, FinOps & Resilience

- Launch a unified observability suite using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to provide teams with essential self-service performance metrics. 

- Establish logging and distributed tracing as foundational platform primitives, integrated automatically through standard developer paths. 

- Create detailed FinOps reporting mechanisms and real-time cost anomaly guardrails to enable precise cloud expenditure attribution for teams and tenants. 

- Integrate chaos testing and automated disaster recovery (DR) failover verification to meet strict enterprise SaaS uptime requirements. 

Platform Security & Compliance Guardrails by Default

- Integrate zero-trust principles and workload identity into the platform fabric using short-lived credentials and cloud-native network policies. 

- Utilize policy-as-code (OPA, Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and admission controllers to enforce security standards at the cluster level without impeding development velocity. 

- Streamline secrets management by providing a secure, automated, self-service platform capability. 

- Build compliance-as-code into CI/CD pipelines to automatically generate audit trails and SBOM documentation required for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP certifications. 

Event-Driven & Messaging Infrastructure

- Manage shared messaging infrastructure systems like Kafka and AWS MSK, delivering topic provisioning and schema management as a robust platform service. 

- Construct reusable patterns and scaffold templates that allow product teams to easily implement event-driven architectures from within the IDP. 

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

Security & Compliance
This role requires adherence to Saviynt's information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training. 

Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team.   All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Full Stack Engineer based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced Principal Full Stack Engineer to shape the technical direction of a global SaaS platform serving millions of volunteers across multiple countries. In this senior individual contributor role, you will combine hands-on software development with architectural leadership to build scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems. You will work across multiple product teams, solving complex engineering challenges and driving critical initiatives from technical discovery through delivery. With a strong focus on Laravel, Next. js, and cloud infrastructure, you will help evolve a modern platform toward event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, and AI-augmented capabilities. You will influence engineering standards, strengthen software quality, and mentor developers through collaboration and technical excellence. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to make a lasting impact on product strategy, platform architecture, and engineering practices within a collaborative, product-focused environment. 

Accountabilities

- Technical Architecture and Direction: Own the architecture and technical direction of core platform domains, establishing scalable modular boundaries, event-driven workflows, and foundations for AI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Hands-on Engineering: Dedicate approximately 60-80% of your time to designing, coding, reviewing, debugging, and pairing on complex technical challenges across Laravel, PHP, Next. js, and cloud environments. 
 - Cross-Team Technical Leadership: Work across multiple product squads to resolve complex engineering problems, lead technical discovery, and deliver high-impact initiatives that span teams and systems. 
 - Engineering Standards: Define, document, and promote architectural principles, coding standards, and development patterns that improve system reliability, maintainability, security, and observability. 
 - Quality Engineering and Delivery: Champion shift-left testing, robust test strategies, CI/CD improvements, regression control, and production monitoring to ensure consistent software quality and reliable releases. 
 - Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Guide senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing sessions, and constructive feedback, empowering them to take ownership of systems and technical decisions. 
 - Innovation and AI Integration: Evaluate and prototype emerging technologies, including generative AI workflows, AI agents, data pipelines, and tools such as Vertex AI, helping teams adopt practical solutions that enhance product capabilities. 
 - Strategic Collaboration: Partner with engineering leadership and technical leads on long-term architecture, roadmap planning, estimation, prioritization, and technical trade-offs while ensuring engineering health remains aligned with business objectives. 
 - Platform Evolution: Support architectural improvements involving event-driven systems, distributed workflows, cloud infrastructure, and future platform capabilities, including AI readiness and multi-cloud development.

- Professional Experience: At least 8 years of software engineering experience, including experience in a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Software Architect role within a SaaS environment.

 - Additional Technical Strengths: Knowledge of analytics platforms such as Looker or BigQuery, data pipelines, machine learning workflows, message queues such as AWS SQS or Kafka, and distributed-system performance tuning is beneficial. 
 - Leadership and Communication: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence technical decisions without relying on formal management authority.

data.title: Senior Backend and DevOps Engineer
data.company: Mogi I/O   OTT/Podcast/Short Video Apps for you
data.description:
About Mogi I/OWe build video infrastructure - live streaming, video-on-demand, transcoding and protected delivery - for media companies, creators and government projects. Our platform runs on Kubernetes across AWS and GCP, and our engineers own their systems end to end, from code to production. 

What You'll DoYou will design, build and run the Go services and infrastructure that keep our streams fast, secure and available under heavy load. 

Backend & Distributed Systems
 - Design and build high-throughput, concurrent Go services (goroutines, channels, context) that serve tens of millions of requests per day. 
 - Plan capacity and optimise services as traffic grows by an order of magnitude. 
 - Build safeguards against cascading failures - timeouts, retries, circuit breaking, rate limiting - so the platform holds up during traffic spikes. 
 - Build stateless, horizontally scalable APIs backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and RabbitMQ. 
Streaming & Media
 - Own live-streaming pipelines over RTMP/RTMPS, HLS and WebRTC, and push end-to-end latency down to a few seconds. 
 - Build and maintain transcoding and packaging pipelines with FFmpeg and Shaka Packager (CMAF, fMP4), tuned for low-bandwidth devices and fast startup. 
 - Build HLS encryption, URL signing and protected delivery through AWS CloudFront. 
 - Run re-streaming to third-party platforms such as YouTube and Instagram. 
Cloud, Kubernetes & DevOps
 - Operate multi-region, multi-cluster Kubernetes on AWS (EKS) and GCP (GKE), including cross-cluster ingress and load balancing. 
 - Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform across production and test environments. 
 - Ship through GitOps with Argo CD and CI/CD pipelines on Jenkins and Docker. 
 - Build serverless components on AWS Lambda where they fit, such as scheduling and EPG jobs. 
Reliability & Performance
 - Run distributed load tests (Locust) to validate performance and failure behaviour before launches. 
 - Instrument services with Prometheus and Grafana, and own their alerts and dashboards. 
 - Review code, mentor engineers and set backend standards for the team. 
What We're Looking ForYou have 4+ years building backend systems and running the cloud infrastructure they deploy on, with Go services in production at scale. 

- Strong Go: concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, context, profiling and memory tuning. 
 - Proven work on distributed systems that handle millions of requests per day, with measurable gains in latency, throughput or reliability. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one of FFmpeg, HLS, RTMP/RTMPS or WebRTC. 
 - Production Kubernetes and Docker on AWS or GCP. 
 - Infrastructure as code with Terraform, plus CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar). 
 - PostgreSQL or MongoDB, Redis, and a message broker such as RabbitMQ. 
 - Comfort with networking fundamentals: TCP, WebSockets, load balancing, CDNs. 
 - Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, and experience debugging live incidents. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
Nice to Have
 - GitOps with Argo CD. 
 - Packaging with Shaka Packager, CMAF and fMP4; DRM or HLS AES encryption. 
 - AWS Lambda, CloudFront and signed-URL delivery. 
 - Multi-region or multi-cluster Kubernetes with cross-cluster traffic management. 
 - Load testing at scale with Locust, k6 or similar. 
 - Working knowledge of Python or Node. js. 
 - Open-source work or side projects in high-concurrency networking - for example WebSocket servers, TCP servers or P2P systems. 
Why Join Mogi I/O
 - Work on real scale: live and on-demand video serving tens of millions of requests a day. 
 - Own systems end to end - design, infrastructure, deployment and on-call. 
 - Ship work with visible impact, from sub-5-second live latency to national-scale government projects. 
 - A small, senior team where your decisions shape the platform. 
 - Competitive salary, based on experience. 
Compensation & Salary PackageAnnual Compensation: ₹12, 00, 000 (₹12 LPA)

We offer a competitive annual compensation package of ₹12 LPA for this position, providing an opportunity to work on large-scale video infrastructure and high-impact engineering projects. 

How to ApplySend your resume and GitHub profile to hr@mogiio. com with the subject line "Senior Backend and DevOps Engineer". 

Tell us about one system you scaled or one latency problem you solved, with the numbers. 

Learn more about us at mogiio. com.

Company Description TOYOTA TSUSHO Nexty Electronics India Private Limited is the India arm of NEXTY Electronics, a 100% subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho, a major general trading company in Japan. Established in April 2000 in India, the company specializes in local distribution of electrical components and delivers stable production support through a robust supply chain. Building on decades of expertise in electronics, NEXTY Electronics provides comprehensive one-stop solutions, including system solutions, bespoke software development, and connected solutions for logistics and fleet management. The company collaborates with partner EMS providers for production services and is committed to quality service and innovative, customer-focused solutions. 

Role Description A Senior Embedded Software Manager -PMSM Motor Control leads the design, development, and team execution of firmware, control algorithms, and software architectures for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) & it's related peripherals, communications etc. This role spans automotive traction/Motor drives, industrial automation systems, and high-volume consumer appliances. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define end-to-end embedded software and system architectures for 3-phase PMSM motor control Electronic Control Units (ECUs), industrial drives, and appliance control boards. 
 - Algorithm & Control Design: Oversee implementation of Field-Oriented Control (FOC), maximum torque per ampere (MTPA), field-weakening, sensorless/sensored commutation, and advanced observers. 
 - Application Scope Strategy: Drive software engineering for diverse applications including EV traction drives, automotive thermal management (electronic water pumps, cooling fans), industrial servo drives, and consumer motor control applications like air conditioning compressor controls. 
 - People & Program Management: Lead, mentor, and scale cross-functional embedded software and motor-control engineering teams. Handle sprint planning, milestone tracking, and cross-department collaboration. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to industry safety and quality standards, managing software lifecycles compliant as per industry needs e. g. ISO 26262 (Automotive ASIL), IEC 61508 (Industrial), IEC 60730 (Consumer Safety), ASPICE, and MISRA C guidelines. 
 - Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with power electronics, inverter hardware, and systems engineering for debugging, HIL/SIL/MIL validation, and motor dynamometer testing.

data.title: Team Lead - Security Engineering
data.description:
Are you ready to lead and encourage a team of top-tier security engineers? As a Security Engineer Team Lead at Aristocrat, you will play a crucial role in crafting and implementing our global security strategy. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play. Security is fundamental to keeping our innovative products and services safe for millions of users worldwide. This position offers an outstanding opportunity to work with a world-class team and deliver impactful security initiatives across a dynamic and growing company. 

What You'll Do
 - Lead the selection, testing, implementation, and oversight of Aristocrat security controls. 
 - Lead and mentor the Security Engineers to successfully implement objectives and key results. 
 - Apply cyber security engineering expertise in support of programs, proposals, and corporate objectives. 
 - Partner with cybersecurity operations for continuous control improvement activities. 
 - Maintain timely, accurate, and effective reporting on the status and application of security controls for critical assets intended for executive-level management. 
 - Develop conceptual and logical solutions that support the implementation of security controls throughout Aristocrat environments. 
 - Consult and collaborate with collaborators, asset owners, and IT teams to advance security initiatives. 
 - Define and apply configurations of security controls for endpoints, cloud environments, DevSecOps, product security, and identity platforms. 
 - Provide domain expertise on cybersecurity strategies and find opportunities to optimize security controls. 
 - Stay informed about emerging security trends, technologies, and threats, and recommend improvements to improve Aristocrat's security posture. 
 - Perform as a lead solution architect across all technologies, mentoring less experienced engineers. 
 - Other duties as assigned. 

What We're Looking For
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field and over 10 years of pertinent experience. Additional years of relevant experience may be accepted instead of a degree. 
 - Minimum of 13+ years of experience in cybersecurity, focusing on building, implementation, and management of security solutions. 
 - Demonstrated experience in working with a geographically dispersed team. 
 - Solid understanding and demonstrated experience with SIEM platforms, data streaming platforms, network security, EDR systems, Cloud Security, and IAM principles. 
 - Expert knowledge of information security technologies, networking, cloud, and infrastructure architecture in a global capacity. 
 - Capacity to handle complex troubleshooting issues. 
 - Proven ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under pressure. 
 - Ability to contribute to organizational critical thinking beyond the area of responsibility. 
 - CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, or other relevant certifications preferred. 
 - Excellent collaboration skills - must be eager to work as part of a cohesive team and partner with other teams within Aristocrat, both locally and globally. 
 - Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present relevant data and information, actively listen, dialogue freely, verbalize ideas effectively, and resolve communication issues. 

Join us at Aristocrat and lead our security engineering team to new heights of excellence!

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat. 

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. 

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits. 

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

As an experienced software engineer utilizing test instrumentation with a broad scope for implementing Viasat's test and measurement strategies, you will provide technical insights and skill to the product test engineering organization. You will drive long-term improvement of the organization's testing processes and growth in a multi-customer/multi-vendor/multi-configuration environment. 

You will need to think long-term and lay out scalable and maintainable solutions solving issues impacting customer test systems, with effective test measurement tools. You will work together with test engineers of different groups to improve their teams test strategies and make sure test coverage is complete among different teams and areas.
