data.title: Software Engineer | GO Programming, Cloud-Native, PPPOE/IPOE, Microservices, DHCPV4/DHCPV6 | 8-14 Years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Cisco's cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the world's largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead sophisticated investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability. 

- Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. 
 - Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. 
 - Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. 
 - Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. 
 - Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. 
 - Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. 
 - Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. 
 - Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. 
 - Troubleshoot sophisticated, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. 
 - Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. 
 - Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 
 - Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. 
 - Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. 
 - Experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. 
 - Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. 
 - Knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. 
 - Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. 
 - Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). 
 - Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. 
 - Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. 
 - Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. 
 - Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). 
 - Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. 
 - Telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

 - Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers. 
 - Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines. 
 - Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate. 
 - Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows. 
 - Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders. 
 - Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon. 
 - Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation. 
 - Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams. 

Core Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools. 
 - Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management. 
 - Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies. 
 - Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms. 
 - Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams. 
 - Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage. 
 - Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access. 

AI Testing Expertise

- Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates. 
 - Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone. 
 - Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge. 
 - Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage. 
 - Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse. 
 - Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery. 
 - Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies. 
 - Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release. 
 - Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems. 
 - Experience with cloud-native testing on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and with ephemeral test environments managed through Kubernetes and Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with MLOps practices, model registries, feature stores, data validation, experiment tracking, dataset or artifact versioning, and quality-engineering enablement or open-source tooling.

data.title: Senior Engineer - Controls
data.description:
About Us: 

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12, 000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 

Job Description: 

Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business. 

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we've grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city's Top 150 Privately Held Companies. 

What truly sets us apart is our culture-rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results. 

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services-providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide. 

Our culture is built on: 

- Ownership - Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment. 
 - Flexibility - A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time. 
 - Empowerment - Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact. 
 - Learning and Growth - Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development. 

Career Development and Global Exposure

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You'll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you'll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive. 

If you're ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment-where long-term stability meets start-up agility-and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Engineer - Controls with 8+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff automation platforms. Experience in printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries is highly preferred. 

The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment. 

The role will be responsible for the interface between electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine-level automation. 

Technical Skills

PLC & HMI Platforms

Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms: 

- Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs
 - Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs
 - ControlLogix
 - CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff PLC / IPC-based control systems
 - TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT
 - Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms. 

PLC & HMI Development

- Hands-on experience developing PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards. 
 - Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using: 
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram
 - Structured Text
 - Sequential Function Chart
 - Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems. 
 - Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs. 
 - Experience with machine-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications. 
 - HMI scripting/programming experience using JavaScript, C#, or similar technologies is an added advantage. 

Siemens Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with Siemens S7-1500 PLCs. 
 - Experience with TIA Portal V15. 1 or above. 
 - TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred. 
 - Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development. 
 - PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging. 
 - Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred. 

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

- Hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs. 
 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage. 

Industrial Communication & Networking

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including: 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA
 - Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks. 

Drives, Motors & Motion Control

- Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion-control systems. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Motor horsepower
 - Torque
 - Speed range
 - Gear ratios
 - Reduction ratios
 - Acceleration/deceleration
 - Experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred. 
 - Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion-control applications. 

Instrumentation & Control Components

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including: 

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects. 

FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
 - Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams. 
 - Hands-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start-up. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues. 
 - Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools. 
 - Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support. 

Standards & Compliance

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as: 

- ANSI
 - ISA
 - NEC
 - NEMA
 - NFPA
 - OSHA
 - UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage. 

Tool Skills

Mandatory / Core

- Siemens TIA Portal - V15. 1 or above
 - Siemens S7-1500 PLC
 - Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000
 - ControlLogix / CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT

Preferred

- TIA Portal V17+
 - FactoryTalk View
 - Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
 - OPC UA
 - Industrial Ethernet networking
 - HMI scripting / C# / JavaScript
 - EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in PLC and HMI programming. 
 - Experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs from scratch. 
 - Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred. 
 - Experience in printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries is an advantage. 
 - Experience in machine commissioning and customer-site support is preferred. 

Key Result Areas

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements. 
 - Integrate Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems. 
 - Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues. 
 - Follow software development, change-management, and version-control procedures. 
 - Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes. 
 - Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope. 
 - Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine start-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance. 
 - Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required. 

Soft Skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Logical and systematic approach to problem-solving. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Strong customer-facing and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements. 
 - Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms. 

Travel

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to 15%, for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

Job Summary

As a Principal Engineer in our Identity Security division, you will be the ultimate technical authority and go-to expert for our core Single Sign-On (SSO) and Federation capabilities. You will own the architectural integrity, security posture, and scalability of our SAML 2. 0, OAuth 2. 0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) implementations. In this role, you will balance deep technical execution with organizational leadership-driving best practices across microservices, mentoring engineering teams, representing our identity expertise externally, and pioneering the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance our identity security capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures. 
 - Architect resilient, low-latency microservices capable of handling millions of token validations, federation requests, and authentication flows globally. 
 - Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles. 
 - Partner with data science teams to integrate AI/ML models into authentication flows for real-time risk scoring and anomalous token behavior detection. 
 - Advocate for and embed generative AI development tools into the team's daily workflows to safely accelerate delivery and improve code quality. 
 - Lead large-scale features, protocol refactors, and microservice optimizations, ensuring alignment with the company's Tech Radar and security baselines. 
 - Identify architectural gaps in SSO services, advocate for improvements, and implement robust solutions. 
 - Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards. 
 - Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration. 
 - Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness. 
 - Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role. 
 - The candidate should have experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#/. NET OR Java OR Python . The candidate should be willing to work with the C#/. NET technology stack. 
 - Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts. 
 - Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities. 
 - Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value. 
 - Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders
 - Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2. 0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2. 0/OIDC Authorization Servers. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Role Overview: 

We are looking for an experienced Security Automation & SOAR Engineer with strong hands-on expertise across Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR and Microsoft Sentinel. The role will be responsible for the design, development, integration, migration, optimization, and operational support of security orchestration and automation capabilities supporting Security Operations. 

The engineer will work closely with SOC, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Vulnerability Management, IAM, and engineering teams to automate security processes, integrate security technologies, improve analyst efficiency, and support the migration and modernization of SOAR capabilities. 

The successful candidate must demonstrate strong software engineering, troubleshooting, and automation skills and be capable of independently developing and supporting complex playbooks, scripts, APIs, and integrations. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

SOAR Engineering & Automation: 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain security automation workflows across Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR and Microsoft Sentinel. 
 - Develop and troubleshoot Cortex XSOAR playbooks, automations, scripts, integrations, and incident workflows. 
 - Develop Microsoft Sentinel automation rules, Logic Apps, and security response playbooks. 
 - Build reusable automation components using Python, Java, PowerShell, REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks. 
 - Automate security use cases including: 
 - Phishing investigation and response
 - Compromised account response
 - Malware and endpoint investigation
 - Threat intelligence enrichment
 - Indicator enrichment and blocking
 - Identity-related investigations
 - Incident enrichment and prioritization
 - Automated containment and remediation
 - Implement appropriate error handling, logging, exception management, and human approval points within automated workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot failed playbooks, integrations, APIs, scripts, and automation dependencies. 
 - Establish disciplined development, testing, version control, and deployment practices for security automation. 

Integration Engineering: 

- Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Cortex XSOAR, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security platforms. 
 - Integrate SOAR platforms with technologies including Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, CyberArk, Entra ID, Active Directory, ServiceNow, email security, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management platforms. 
 - Develop custom integrations where native capabilities do not meet operational requirements. 
 - Build and troubleshoot REST API-based integrations, including authentication, authorization, certificates, secrets, data mapping, and error handling. 
 - Establish reusable and supportable integration patterns across Security Operations. 
 - Monitor integration health, dependencies, failures, and performance. 
 - Maintain integration inventories, technical documentation, and architecture diagrams. 

SOAR Migration & Modernization: 

- Support the migration, consolidation, and modernization of security automation capabilities between SOAR platforms, including Cortex XSOAR and Microsoft Sentinel. 
 - Assess existing playbooks, integrations, scripts, workflows, and platform dependencies. 
 - Map source-platform workflows, data structures, APIs, integrations, incident models, and automation logic to target-platform capabilities. 
 - Re-engineer and optimize automation where appropriate rather than simply replicating legacy workflows. 
 - Identify redundant, duplicate, or obsolete playbooks and integrations during migration. 
 - Support migration activities across: 
 - Discovery and dependency analysis
 - Use-case and playbook mapping
 - Architecture and design
 - Development and integration
 - Functional and regression testing
 - Parallel validation
 - Production cutover
 - Stabilization and operational handover
 - Maintain traceability between existing and migrated automation to identify functional or coverage gaps. 
 - Support migration cutover and rollback planning to minimize disruption to Security Operations. 
 - Develop migration documentation, dependency maps, test evidence, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks. 

Microsoft Sentinel & Detection Engineering: 

- Support Microsoft Sentinel engineering, including data connectors, telemetry ingestion, normalization, platform health, and optimization. 
 - Develop and tune KQL queries, analytics rules, correlation logic, and hunting queries. 
 - Connect security detections with appropriate automated investigation and response workflows. 
 - Support telemetry integration across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, email, and enterprise applications. 
 - Partner with detection engineering teams to align relevant detections and response workflows with MITRE ATT&CK. 

Engineering Governance & Operational Support: 

- Implement Git/source control, code review, testing, CI/CD, and controlled release practices for security automation. 
 - Maintain playbook catalogs, integration inventories, technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks. 
 - Monitor automation reliability and effectiveness and identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual activity. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues affecting SOAR platforms, playbooks, APIs, and integrations. 
 - Partner with SOC and Incident Response teams to translate manual processes into scalable automation. 
 - Provide technical knowledge transfer and support to SOC analysts and security engineering teams. 
 - Participate in production support and major incident activities for critical automation and platform issues as required. 

Required Experience & Technical Skills: 

- 8+ years of cybersecurity or Security Operations engineering experience, with significant experience in SIEM/SOAR and security automation. 
 - Strong hands-on Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR engineering experience, including playbook development, custom automation, integrations, scripts, and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong hands-on Microsoft Sentinel automation experience, including automation rules, Azure Logic Apps, playbooks, and security orchestration. 
 - Strong software development and scripting capability with hands-on experience in Python and Java. 
 - Strong experience developing and troubleshooting REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and API-based integrations. 
 - Experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms used in enterprise integrations, including OAuth, API keys, certificates, and secrets. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating SOAR platforms with EDR, IAM/PAM, ITSM, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, email security, and other security technologies. 
 - Experience migrating, re-engineering, or modernizing SOAR playbooks, scripts, integrations, and workflows between platforms. 
 - Strong KQL capability for Microsoft Sentinel detection, investigation, and hunting use cases. 
 - Experience with PowerShell and Microsoft security automation. 
 - Experience with Git/source control, testing, code review, CI/CD, and structured change-management practices. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across APIs, authentication, networking, automation workflows, and security platforms. 
 - Ability to translate Security Operations processes into scalable, maintainable, and supportable automation. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills: 

- Experience with JavaScript and other scripting languages. 
 - Experience developing Cortex XSOAR custom integrations and Content Packs. 
 - Familiarity with Demisto SDK and XSOAR content-development practices. 
 - Experience with Cortex XSIAM. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Defender XDR and the wider Microsoft security ecosystem. 
 - Experience developing ServiceNow integrations and automated security workflows. 
 - Experience with Terraform and/or Ansible. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD and automated testing for security automation content. 
 - Experience with cloud environments, including Azure, AWS, and GCP.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Requirements

Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

Work Experience

2-5Years

You are a proactive problem solver with a strong focus on reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

data.title: Senior Oracle Functional Consultant / Test Lead
data.description:
Company Description

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services. 

We're an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do: 

- UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner 
 - 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business 
 - 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK 
 - Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW 
 - Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We're a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it's deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we'll invest in you!. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Oracle Functional Consultant / Test Lead to provide functional consultancy and testing leadership across Oracle E-Business Suite implementations, enhancements and international rollout programmes. 

The successful candidate will have strong hands-on Oracle EBS R12 Financials expertise and experience across the full implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support. 

This is a dual functional and testing role. The consultant will design and configure Oracle solutions while using their functional expertise to develop test scenarios, validate end-to-end business processes, support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), manage defects and provide assurance that solutions meet agreed business and statutory requirements. 

Experience of international rollouts and new-market implementations is particularly important, including the establishment of new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units and integration with third-party systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Oracle Functional Consultancy

- Lead requirements gathering and analysis with business, Finance and technical stakeholders, translating requirements into effective Oracle EBS solutions. 
 - Design and configure Oracle Financials solutions, particularly General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, E-Business Tax, Fixed Assets, AGIS and related financial processes. 
 - Configure and support new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units for international and new-market implementations. 
 - Ensure solutions meet country-specific business and statutory requirements while remaining aligned with the organisation's wider Oracle template and financial architecture. 
 - Produce and maintain functional design and configuration documentation, including MC050 configuration documents and implementation artefacts. 
 - Develop configuration migration plans and support controlled promotion through development, SIT, UAT and production environments, using tools such as ConfigSnapshot where appropriate. 
 - Provide functional input into integrations with third-party applications, including procurement, payroll, foreign exchange/rate providers and retail systems. 
 - Work closely with technical consultants, developers and integration teams to define and validate integrations and customisations. 
 - Provide functional support throughout deployment, cutover, go-live and hypercare. 

Testing and Quality Assurance

- Translate business and functional requirements into structured test scenarios, test cases and expected results. 
 - Define and execute functional test coverage for Oracle configurations, customisations, integrations and end-to-end business processes. 
 - Lead or provide senior functional support for SIT, UAT and regression testing, including country-specific and statutory requirements. 
 - Test both standard business processing and exception/error scenarios across Oracle and connected applications. 
 - Analyse defects to identify root causes across configuration, application functionality, customisation, integration, test data and business processes. 
 - Work with business and technical teams to reproduce, resolve and retest defects. 
 - Maintain traceability between requirements, functional designs, configuration and test coverage. 
 - Support business users during UAT, resolving functional queries and distinguishing genuine application defects from process or data issues. 
 - Provide functional assurance to support implementation readiness and go-live decisions. 
 - Validate critical configuration and business processes following deployment and continue defect investigation during hypercare. 

Qualifications

Functional and Technical Skills

Essential

- Significant experience as a Senior Oracle E-Business Suite Functional Consultant, with strong Oracle EBS R12 Financials knowledge. 
 - Detailed functional experience across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Advanced Global Intercompany System (AGIS) and E-Business Tax. 
 - Experience configuring ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units. 
 - Proven delivery experience across multi-country, new-market or legal-entity implementations. 
 - Strong requirements gathering, functional solution design, configuration and documentation skills. 
 - Strong understanding of the relationship between Oracle configuration, business processes and downstream testing. 
 - Hands-on experience of SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management and resolution. 
 - Ability to create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases from business requirements and functional designs. 
 - Experience testing interfaces between Oracle EBS and third-party applications. 
 - Experience supporting deployment, cutover, go-live and post-production hypercare. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across Finance, business, functional, technical, integration and programme teams. 

Highly Desirable

- Experience using ConfigSnapshot for configuration definition, comparison, migration or assurance. 
 - Experience producing and maintaining MC050 configuration documentation. 
 - Experience implementing statutory ledgers. 
 - Experience within a large international retail environment. 
 - Experience supporting multiple concurrent country implementations. 

Testing Competencies

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong quality and testing mindset, with the ability to understand how Oracle configuration decisions translate into testing requirements. 

They should be capable of assessing how a business process will operate in Oracle, what configuration and integrations support it, how the solution will be validated, how exceptions and failures should be handled, and what regression testing is required when the solution changes. 

The ability to combine deep Oracle functional expertise with structured end-to-end testing is a core requirement of the role. 

Seniority and Leadership

As a senior member of the delivery team, the consultant will take ownership of assigned functional areas and provide guidance to business users, consultants and testers. Responsibilities may include coordinating functional workstreams, reviewing functional and testing deliverables, supporting planning and issue resolution, providing input into implementation readiness and go-live decisions, and supporting junior team members through knowledge transfer and solution guidance. 

Personal Attributes

The Ideal Candidate Will Be

- Analytical, methodical and detail-oriented. 
 - Comfortable owning delivery from initial requirement through to production. 
 - Able to challenge requirements constructively and identify gaps and risks. 
 - Strong at troubleshooting complex functional, configuration and integration issues. 
 - Confident communicating with both business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Comfortable operating within high-profile, business-critical programmes. 
 - Able to balance delivery deadlines with appropriate testing and quality controls. 
 - Capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a wider programme team.

Job Requirements

Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering).

 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. The world is how we shape it. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications leveraging LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and modern AI engineering tools. The ideal candidate should have practical experience building AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based solutions that solve real business problems and create measurable value. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop AI agents, copilots, and autonomous workflows. 
 - Build solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Google ADK. 
 - Develop RAG solutions, semantic search capabilities, and enterprise knowledge assistants. 
 - Integrate AI solutions with business applications, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. 
 - Package, deploy, and monitor AI applications in cloud environments. 
 - Contribute reusable frameworks, accelerators, and AI engineering best practices. 

Required Technical Skills

Programming & Engineering

- Strong proficiency in Python. 
 - Experience with REST APIs and integrations. 
 - FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals. 

Agentic AI & LLMs

- Hands-on experience with one or more: 
 - LangChain
 - LangGraph
 - CrewAI
 - AutoGen
 - Google ADK
 - Prompt Engineering
 - Function/Tool Calling
 - Agent Workflows and Memory Concepts
 - Building LLM-powered applications

RAG & Knowledge Systems

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, Milvus, etc. )
 - Semantic Search and Embeddings

Cloud & Deployment

- Docker
 - Azure, AWS, or GCP
 - CI/CD fundamentals

Preferred Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
 - Multi-Agent Systems
 - GraphRAG
 - Semantic Kernel
 - OpenAI Agents SDK
 - PydanticAI
 - AI Evaluation Frameworks (Promptfoo, RAGAS)
 - Knowledge Graphs
 - React or Streamlit-based AI applications

Professional Attributes (Mandatory)

- Strong collaborator capable of working effectively across engineering, product, business, and leadership teams. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Confident, proactive, and self-driven individual who takes ownership and delivers results. 
 - Strong networking and relationship-building abilities, with the capability to engage stakeholders across teams and geographies. 
 - Comfortable conducting demos, presentations, workshops, and technical discussions. 
 - Passionate about continuous learning and staying current with emerging AI technologies. 

Experience Requirements

- 3-8 years of overall software engineering experience. 
 - Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based application development. 
 - Experience building and delivering AI-powered applications, agents, copilots, or automation solutions in enterprise or production environments. 

Qualifications

Bachelor of Technology

Additional Information

Ideal Candidate Summary

A hands-on AI Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals and at least 2 years of experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI. The ideal candidate has experience building AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based solutions using modern agent frameworks and LLM technologies. Beyond technical expertise, they are a confident communicator, strong collaborator, and relationship builder who can effectively influence stakeholders, drive cross-functional collaboration, and help accelerate AI innovation across the organization.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer- Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Golang/Python
data.description:
About The Job

The Red Hat Engineering team is looking for a talented and versatile Senior Software Engineer. 

Our mission is to deliver a next generation platform for building, testing and releasing artifacts to deliver Red Hat products and services using open hybrid cloud technologies while focusing on innovation and security. 

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing the next-gen productization pipeline, optimizing our systems, and ensuring a seamless user experience in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 

This position requires a proactive problem solver who is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions and continuously improving our systems. 

You will work with Red Hat's latest open source technologies, such as Kubernetes, Tekton, ArgoCD, Terraform and OpenShift. You will also work closely with Red Hat's leading product development teams, QE, SRE, product management, and other stakeholders worldwide, working with a stable team in an agile environment to deliver services for Red Hat teams and customers. 

What you will do?

- Design, develop, and implement new features based on evolving business requirements. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software defects. 
 - Ensure that all code changes maintain or improve system stability and performance. 
 - Assist users by troubleshooting issues and providing technical support when needed. 
 - Gather user feedback and suggest improvements to enhance user experience. 
 - Monitor system performance and implement optimizations to improve efficiency and scalability. 
 - Conduct code reviews and refactor existing code to maintain code quality and performance. 
 - Deploy changes to staging and production environments following established processes and best practices. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps to ensure smooth and reliable operation of software in production. 
 - Stay updated with industry trends and technologies to bring innovative ideas to the team. 
 - Contribute to the improvement of internal processes, tools, and standards. 
 - Work with open source communities such as Tekton and Kubernetes and submitting code in these upstream communities for review
 - Work in a global team, including teams in EMEA, NA, and APAC
 - Work with developers, quality engineers, PMs, SRE and customers
 - Learn about the latest AI tools and how to apply them to solve existing problems

What you will bring?

- Ability to work with new and fast-changing technologies with a high level of uncertainty, reacting to changes in requirements quickly
 - Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for learning and adapting to new challenges. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer science or equivalent working experience
 - At least 5 years of experience writing code in Golang, JAVA, or Python
 - Experience working on shared codebases using source control management (SCM) systems like GitHub or GitLab
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment. 
 - Experience working with Linux as a developer
 - Experience with building & debugging applications on Kubernetes clusters
 - Experience building and running containerized applications and controllers
 - Experience with cloud-based infrastructure (e. g. , AWS) and microservices architecture

The Following Is Considered a Plus

- Experience with IBM cloud
 - Experience in Terraform
 - Experience in Tekton or ArgoCD
 - Experience building CICD pipelines
 - Experience in Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk
 - Experience in Open Source development
 - Experience defining requirements between application components
 - Experience in DevSecOps or Product Security 
 - Experience with Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM)

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world's leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. 

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat's culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. 

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. 

Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee. 

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat. com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

Your impact begins here

As PEMS (Production Environment Monitoring System) developer you will design, develop and support solutions on the LabVantage LIMS platform for QC laboratory operations and the PEMS system. You will build features and interfaces, resolve complex application issues and contribute to reliable releases in a regulated GxP environment. By combining strong technical delivery with close business collaboration, you will help improve system functionality, data integrity and the day-to-day experience of laboratory users. 

What You'll Bring

You are a hands-on developer who takes ownership, learns independently and works effectively across technical and business teams. You will bring: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or an equivalent discipline. 
 - 4-6 years of software development experience using Java and database technologies, including application development, configuration and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong development skills in Core Java, JavaScript, JSP, REST APIs, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL. 
 - Experience debugging application issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes. 
 - Experience authoring and reviewing FDS, TDS, API documents, risk assessments and test documentation. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, verbal and written communication, analytical and decision-making skills. 
 - A proactive, self-driven approach with ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing and the ability to work within defined processes and deadlines. 

Useful, But Not Essential

- Experience with hands on PEMS development in the Lab Vantage ecosystem is a plus
 - Experience operating and maintaining a GxP or business-critical IT system is a plus

What You'll Do

- Design and development: Develop LabVantage LIMS features, interfaces, configurations and proofs of concept for the PEMS system. 
 - Technical troubleshooting: Perform root cause analysis, resolve application issues, deliver bug fixes and patch sets, and address support tickets requiring technical analysis.

data.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world. 

SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations. 

What You Will Do

- Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems. 
 - Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers. 
 - Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data. 
 - Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues. 
 - Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions. 
 - Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes. 
 - Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas. 
 - Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses. 
 - Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations. 
 - Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes. 
 - Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks. 
 - Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas. 
 - Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior. 
 - Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions. 
 - Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems. 
 - Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared. 
 - Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions. 
 - Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation. 
 - Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis. 

Must-have Qualifications

- Technical
 - 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company. 
 - Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc. 
 - Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code. 
 - Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems. 
 - Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
 - Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
 - Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components. 
 - Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products. 
 - Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues. 
 - Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes. 
 - Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence. 
 - Behavioral
 - Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work. 
 - Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information. 
 - Willingness to challenge assumptions. 
 - Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

This position is part of the R&D Validation and Verification (V&V) team. The R&D team is responsible for designing, implementing, and testing embedded software for protection and control applications, primarily in the electrical distribution and transmission industry. 

The role also includes the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, and Agentic AI to enhance R&D V&V activities, including intelligent test automation, automated test-case generation, test-result analysis, anomaly detection, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of verification and validation processes. 

Job Description

- Define and implement comprehensive Verification & Validation (V&V) strategies, test plans, and frameworks for power-system, protection, control, embedded software, and industrial communication products. 
 - Review system requirements, communication specifications, use cases, interfaces, and architecture to establish complete test coverage, traceability, and validation criteria. 
 - Design and execute system-level, integration, communication, functional, regression, interoperability, performance, robustness, and negative testing. 
 - Develop and maintain Python-based automated test frameworks, communication simulators, protocol test tools, and test infrastructure. 
 - Plan and execute validation of industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870-5-104 (T104), T103, T101, TCP/IP, Ethernet, and Serial communication. 
 - Perform communication interoperability and integration testing between IEDs, protection relays, RTUs, SCADA systems, gateways, PLCs, control systems, and substation automation systems. 
 - Validate communication functions including data exchange, command/control, time synchronization, event reporting, configuration, fault handling, timeout, recovery, redundancy, and performance. 
 - Develop Python-based tools for protocol message generation, packet analysis, device simulation, communication monitoring, automated validation, and fault injection. 
 - Analyze communication traces, network packets, relay event records, system logs, and test results to identify communication and system-level issues. 
 - Troubleshoot complex communication, embedded software, firmware, and system-integration issues and perform structured root-cause analysis. 
 - Work closely with Power Systems, Protection, Hardware, Firmware, Software, Systems Engineering, and Continuous Engineering teams to resolve defects and improve product reliability. 
 - Validate Protection & Control systems for generators, transmission lines, transformers, motors, busbars, substations, and digital control applications. 
 - Test protection schemes including Overcurrent/Earth Fault, Differential, Distance, Generator, Motor, Transformer, and Busbar protection. 
 - Validate protection relays, IEDs, RTUs, SCADA interfaces, digital control systems, gateways, and embedded software/firmware. 
 - Apply AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI to communication and V&V activities. 
 - Develop AI Agents that can analyze communication requirements, generate test scenarios, orchestrate approved test workflows, analyze protocol logs, detect anomalies, classify failures, and assist with root-cause analysis. 
 - Develop Agentic AI-based communication testing solutions capable of interacting with approved testing tools, simulators, protocol analyzers, and V&V infrastructure. 
 - Apply AI-assisted analysis to IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, T104, TCP/IP, Ethernet, and serial communication logs and traces to accelerate troubleshooting and defect identification. 
 - Implement intelligent workflows for automated test-case generation, regression-test optimization, communication anomaly detection, test-result analysis, and automated V&V reporting. 
 - Ensure AI/Agentic AI-based testing remains traceable, explainable, repeatable, deterministic where required, and subject to engineering validation and human approval. 
 - Establish and maintain CI/CT-based automated V&V pipelines for continuous communication and system testing. 
 - Use JIRA, Xray, Confluence, Git, and other engineering tools for requirements traceability, test management, defect tracking, documentation, and configuration management. 
 - Continuously improve communication testing methodologies, automation frameworks, AI-assisted V&V capabilities, test coverage, and product reliability. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Communication Engineering, Instrumentation, or Power Systems Engineering. 
 - Minimum 3+ years of experience in communication testing, system V&V, embedded software/firmware testing, automation, or R&D engineering. 
 - Strong Python programming skills for automation, scripting, protocol testing, data analysis, and tool integration. 
 - Strong understanding of industrial communication, power-system automation, protection, control, and embedded systems. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of: 
 - IEC 61850
 - DNP3
 - Modbus
 - IEC 60870-5-104 (T104)
 - T103
 - T101
 - TCP/IP
 - Ethernet
 - Serial communication
 - Experience with communication troubleshooting, protocol analysis, packet capture, message decoding, interoperability testing, and network diagnostics. 
 - Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI applied to testing, automation, communication analysis, or engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of AI Agent architecture, tool/function calling, RAG, APIs, Python-based AI automation, and intelligent workflow orchestration is desirable. 
Power System & Protection Knowledge

- Understanding of electrical distribution and transmission systems. 
 - Knowledge of Protection & Control systems for generators, transmission lines, transformers, motors, busbars, and substations. 
 - Knowledge of IEC and ANSI standards related to protection, control, automation, and communication. 
 - Understanding of CT/VT calculations and protection relay settings is advantageous. 
 - Experience with ABB, Siemens, SEL, and other major relay manufacturers is an advantage. 

AI & Agentic Communication Engineering

- Develop intelligent communication-testing agents capable of: 
 - Analyzing communication requirements
 - Generating protocol test scenarios
 - Creating test data
 - Executing approved test workflows
 - Monitoring communication traffic
 - Analyzing protocol logs
 - Detecting communication anomalies
 - Identifying failure patterns
 - Supporting root-cause analysis
 - Generating automated test reports
 - Combine Agentic AI + Python + industrial protocols + power-system domain knowledge to create next-generation automated communication V&V solutions. 
 - Apply human-in-the-loop controls and engineering validation for AI-driven decisions in safety- and reliability-critical power-system applications. 
Tools & Processes

- Python, Git, JIRA, Xray, Confluence
 - Protocol analyzers and network diagnostic tools
 - Automated test frameworks and simulators
 - CI/CD and Continuous Testing
 - SDLC, STLC, V-Model, Agile/SAFe
 - White-box, black-box, system, integration, regression, interoperability, and performance testing

Desired Characteristics

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills in industrial communication and embedded systems. 
 - Ability to bridge communication engineering, power systems, protection & control, software automation, and Agentic AI. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently. 
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills across multidisciplinary R&D teams. 
 - Strong interest in applying AI Agents and intelligent automation to next-generation power-system communication and V&V. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
