data.title: Full-Stack AI Compute Architect
data.description:
Full-Stack AI Compute Architect

Hyderabad, India | On-site

Experience: 12 + Years

About OXMIQ

OXMIQ provides complete hardware and software GPU IP that lets our customers build their own AI silicon. Founded by Raja Koduri, we recently closed a $35M Series A (co-led by Samsung Catalyst Fund and Fundomo, with MediaTek, Intel Capital, and others), bringing total funding to $60M, with Jim Keller joining our board. 

Our OxCore architecture combines scalar, tensor, SIMT, and orchestration engines on one platform - delivering CUDA compatibility alongside a fully programmable architecture. On top of it runs OxPython, our software stack that runs existing CUDA and PyTorch code unmodified with day-zero support for new AI models. We have an established team and a working stack, and we're now shifting from development to production - hardening the platform and scaling it for inference at real customer scale. 

You'll join the OXMIQ architecture team, which sets the direction of our software, silicon, and systems. You'll help refine our software strategy and deliver the highest-performance solutions by optimizing the whole stack - from AI models and frameworks at the top down to kernel and hardware-level code generation. 

The Scope of This Role

This role spans the AI software stack from models on down - the full vertical path a workload travels: from a model authored in frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or ONNX, through graph capture and the compiler, into the runtime and scheduler, down to individual kernels and the instructions that execute on OxCore. 

We're looking for an architect who is fluent across that whole range - someone who can reason about how a transformer or diffusion model is structured and about warp divergence and register allocation, and who can make the choices that connect those layers into one coherent, high-performance platform. You won't be the deepest specialist at every layer, but you should be able to hold the whole range in your head and drive decisions end to end. 

Key Responsibilities

- Refine the technical direction of OxPython, the OXMIQ software stack - from framework front-ends (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and model ingestion, through graph capture, the compiler, runtime, and driver layers, down to kernels - in close partnership with the existing software team. 
 - Own how AI models map onto the platform: understand how modern workloads (LLMs, diffusion, vision, agentic inference, and beyond) are structured and expressed at the framework level, and shape how they are captured, partitioned, and lowered so they run unmodified with day-zero support and scale efficiently for inference. 
 - Own whole-stack performance: drive optimization end to end, identify and remove bottlenecks at every layer - from graph-level and framework-level inefficiencies down through compiler, runtime, driver, and kernels - and close the gap to peak hardware utilization. 
 - Guide the graph and compiler strategy: MLIR dialect and IR design, lowering pipelines, operator representation, and LLVM backend code generation targeting Oxmiq hardware IP. 
 - Architect work orchestration across OxCore's scalar, tensor, and SIMT engines, and shape the compiler/runtime approach that runs CUDA-optimized models unmodified - preserving day-zero support for new AI models without sacrificing programmability. 
 - Advance the SIMT execution and parallel compute strategy: thread/warp scheduling, divergence handling, occupancy, and the memory hierarchy, and how parallel workloads are expressed, lowered, and mapped onto the hardware. 
 - Refine and optimize the strategy for kernel programming models (including Triton-based and custom op lowering), kernel fusion, and tiling, in collaboration with kernel engineers. 
 - Design for scale and production: ensure solutions grow cleanly with customer workloads, deployment sizes, and model complexity, and harden them for real-world delivery. 
 - Work with architecture and hardware teams to translate performance requirements into efficient code generation and runtime strategies, and feed software needs back into hardware definition. 
 - Drive the software/hardware validation strategy - evolving how the stack and silicon are co-verified as we scale from bring-up through production. 
 - Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and architecture discussions, and mentor engineers across the frameworks, compiler, runtime, and kernel teams. 
 - Guide performance profiling, benchmarking, and root cause analysis for compiler- and runtime-generated code. 

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years building systems and/or AI-infrastructure software, with a track record of owning architecture for a major component or a full stack that spans multiple layers. 
 - Breadth across the AI software stack - you can reason about the problem from the model and framework level down to the kernel and instruction level, and understand how choices at one layer constrain the others. 
 - Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and a solid understanding of how deep learning models are structured, expressed, captured, and optimized - not just at the operator level but as whole graphs and workloads. 
 - Strong expertise in C++ and compiler infrastructure, including LLVM (IR, pass infrastructure, backend code generation) and MLIR (dialect design, conversion passes, progressive lowering). 
 - Deep expertise in SIMT and parallel compute architectures - thread/warp execution models, divergence, synchronization, occupancy constraints, and memory hierarchies. 
 - Proven experience with GPU programming models, including CUDA, and an understanding of what it takes to deliver CUDA compatibility on non-NVIDIA hardware. 
 - Solid command of code generation concepts - instruction selection, scheduling, register allocation, vectorization, and memory hierarchy optimization. 
 - Experience co-designing software alongside silicon or shaping a hardware-software interface. 
 - Strong debugging and performance analysis skills, and a bias toward shipping: you prototype, measure, and make decisions with incomplete information. 
 - Hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development workflows. 

Note: we expect exceptional depth in some of these areas and working fluency across the rest. The essential requirement is the ability to operate across the whole stack, not mastery of every layer. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience architecting compiler backends or runtimes for custom AI accelerators, NPUs, or GPU IP. 
 - Experience with graph-level model optimization, framework integration internals (e. g. , PyTorch compile/inductor, XLA), or serving/inference infrastructure for large models. 
 - Experience with Triton or similar high-level GPU kernel frameworks, and with kernel fusion, operator tiling, and auto-tuning. 
 - Exposure to quantization, mixed-precision, or sparsity-aware compilation techniques. 
 - Experience with performance modeling and roofline analysis for GPU workloads. 
 - Background in deep learning, computer vision, image processing, or video - the workloads our customers run. 
 - Experience bringing up and scaling a software stack on new or pre-silicon hardware into production. 
 - Contributions to open-source compiler, runtime, or ML-framework projects such as LLVM, MLIR, PyTorch, or Triton. 

Education

B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech/MS/Ph. D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Why OXMIQ

You'll join a well-funded company - fresh off a $35M Series A backed by Samsung, MediaTek, Intel Capital, and others, with Jim Keller on our board - with an established team and a proven stack, at the point where we're scaling it into a production platform in customers' hands. You'll work directly with the people designing the hardware it runs on. 

This is a role for an architect who wants to refine and optimize the AI software stack end to end - from models and frameworks down to kernels and silicon - rather than just one layer of it, and measure success in shipped, high-performance solutions. 

Compensation & Benefits

OXMIQ offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, equity participation, comprehensive medical coverage, and the opportunity to contribute to foundational silicon and software technology. 

OXMIQ is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

 - Demonstrate end-to-end ownership of technical solutions from design through production support, delivering with minimal supervision. 
 - Proactively identify risks and dependencies, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and mentor developers through code reviews and pair programming. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 4+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and modern frontend development patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and building distributed systems, including the ability to draft architecture based on approved patterns. 
 - Experience deploying and managing applications using ROSA, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Solid working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e. g. , GitLab CI, ROSA pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, Nexus, SonarQube, Veracode). 
 - Strong programming skills in Java; working knowledge of Python is a plus. 
 - Experience optimizing SQL/NoSQL databases, writing efficient queries, and contributing to data modeling. 
 - Demonstrated experience using Delta-approved AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated outputs. 
 - Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt design, and common AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technical solutions independently with occasional guidance. 
 - Experience mentoring or guiding junior developers and reviewing peers' pull requests. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect certification. 
 - Experience with microservices architecture and serverless computing. 
 - Understanding of networking and security principles in cloud environments. 
 - Exposure to modern AI technologies and frameworks, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP, is a plus. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.

Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future of Aviation. data.title: Security Validation Lead
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time. 

In this context, you will be responsible for Camera Image Sensor SoC validation, focusing on Security, Secure Streaming, Cryptographic Validation, and System-Level Functional validation. 

The candidate will be responsible for validating security features across the Camera Image Sensor SoC, ensuring robust implementation of security architectures including Secure Boot, Root of Trust, Authentication, Encryption, Hashing, Secure Firmware Update, Secure Streaming, and Anti-Tamper mechanisms. The role requires deep understanding of imaging pipelines, embedded systems, security protocols, and automation using Python. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate end-to-end security architecture of Camera Image Sensor SoCs. 
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans for hybrid cryptographic schemes combining classical and PQC algorithms: 
 - Secure Boot
 - Chain of Trust
 - Secure Firmware Loading
 - Secure Debug Access
 - Secure Key Provisioning
 - Anti-Tamper Mechanisms
 - Secure Manufacturing Flows
 - Secure video streaming
 - Verify authentication and authorization mechanisms. 
 - Validate OTP -based security configurations. 
 - Perform negative testing and security robustness testing. 
Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)
 - Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities. 
 - Knowledge: 
 - Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

Value Proposition

As part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at First Citizens Bank, the Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM (Quality Assurance) will serve as the technical leader responsible for defining and driving the quality engineering strategy for enterprise IAM platforms and services. 

This role requires deep expertise in IAM technologies, quality engineering, test automation, and cybersecurity practices. The successful candidate will provide leadership across multiple IAM initiatives, establish testing standards and frameworks, drive automation maturity, and ensure the security, scalability, reliability, and compliance of IAM solutions. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to engineering, architecture, product, and cyber security teams while influencing strategic technology decisions across the IAM ecosystem. 

Job Details

Job Title : Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM

Career Level: P4

Job Category: Assistant Vice President

Role Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Bangalore

About The Team

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program supports end-to-end identity governance, access lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, and privileged access management capabilities for employees, contractors, partners, and enterprise applications across the organization. 

Impact

This position resides within the Cyber Security organization and is responsible for establishing the quality engineering vision and testing strategy across IAM platforms. The role will drive test automation, security validation, performance engineering, and quality governance for critical IAM capabilities. 

The Principal Engineer will lead complex testing initiatives, influence architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and ensure enterprise IAM solutions meet security, operational, regulatory, and business requirements. This individual contributor role partners closely with IAM Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Operations, and Information Security leadership teams. 

Key Deliverables (Duties And Responsibilities)

- Define and drive the enterprise IAM Quality Engineering and Test Automation strategy. 
 - Hands-on experience on Selenium, building test strategy for large scale platforms like SailPoint, Automation using Python or other scripting languages. 
 - Establish testing standards, frameworks, tools, governance models, and best practices across IAM programs. 
 - Lead quality assurance efforts for Identity Governance, Access Management, SSO, Federation, MFA, PAM, and Directory Services initiatives. 
 - Design and build scalable automated test frameworks leveraging modern programming languages and enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Drive continuous testing practices integrated with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps methodologies. 
 - Define quality gates, release readiness criteria, risk assessments, and production validation processes. 
 - Provide technical leadership for end-to-end testing across IAM platforms, APIs, workflows, integrations, and cloud services. 
 - Partner with architecture teams to review solution designs and ensure testability, scalability, resilience, and security requirements are met. 
 - Lead security testing initiatives including authentication, authorization, privilege escalation, API security, and identity lifecycle validation. 
 - Establish performance, load, stress, and resilience testing strategies for IAM platforms. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers on quality engineering, automation practices, and testing methodologies. 
 - Drive adoption of shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles across IAM delivery teams. 
 - Collaborate with product, engineering, cyber security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with regulatory and internal security standards. 
 - Evaluate emerging testing technologies, AI-driven automation capabilities, and industry best practices to improve effectiveness and efficiency. 
 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, and strategic technology planning. 
 - Develop and report quality metrics, automation coverage, defect trends, and risk indicators to senior leadership. 
 - Serve as the escalation point for complex testing, integration, and production quality challenges. 

Functional Skills

Skills and Qualifications (Functional and Technical Skills)

- Strong leadership and influencing skills with the ability to drive enterprise-wide quality initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to define testing strategies and quality engineering roadmaps for large-scale IAM programs. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, security, architecture, and operations. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 
 - Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution when required.

data.title: Functional Validation Engineer
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Lab validation and characterization

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time. 

The role requires strong expertise in Camera Image Sensors, Imaging Pipelines, Sensor Characterization, High-Speed Interface Validation, Embedded Systems, and Python-based Automation. The candidate will work closely with architecture, design, firmware, and application teams to ensure complete coverage of sensor functionality and system-level performance. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute comprehensive validation plans based on product specifications and architecture requirements. Verify sensor features including: 

- Exposure Control
 - Gain Control
 - HDR Operation
 - Global Shutter and Rolling Shutter Functionality
 - Region of Interest (ROI)
 - Binning and Sub-Sampling Modes
 - Defect Pixel Correction
 - Embedded Data Functions
 - Synchronization and Trigger Mechanisms
 - Multi-Camera Operation
 - Cybersecurity

Validate sensor configuration registers and firmware interactions. 

Perform feature, integration, system-level, regression, stress, and corner-case testing. 

Analyze failures and drive root-cause investigations with design and firmware teams. 

Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)
 - Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities. 
 - Knowledge: 
 - Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: Technology Delivery Lead (Markets Technology) (Prime Services, Equity Swaps & Secured Financing) - Managing Director
data.description:
State Street is seeking an accomplished senior technology leader to lead technology delivery for the Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing businesses within State Street Markets Technology. This will provide strategic leadership, delivery oversight, and engineering excellence across globally distributed teams, with a significant delivery footprint in India. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving execution across complex technology portfolios, enabling business growth, modernizing platforms, strengthening operational resilience, and building high-performing engineering organizations. As the India-based senior technology leader, will oversee both employee and vendor delivery teams, partnering closely with business, operations, risk, and technology leaders globally to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative solutions. The role requires a strong blend of business acumen, engineering leadership, transformation experience, and execution rigor within highly regulated financial services environments. 

Role Overview

The Managing Director will serve as the senior technology delivery leader for Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing Technology. The role owns end-to-end technology execution across the software delivery lifecycle and is accountable for delivery predictability, platform stability, modernization, workforce strategy, and engineering excellence. 

This leader will play a critical role in supporting State Street Markets' strategic growth objectives, including scaling newly launched business capabilities, expanding product offerings, modernizing technology platforms, and advancing automation across front-to-back operational processes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Delivery Leadership & Business Execution-
 - Own end-to-end technology delivery across Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing, including architecture, engineering, testing, release management, and production support. 
 - Deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes aligned with business priorities, regulatory requirements, and client commitments. 
 - Scale technology capabilities supporting the growth of the Equity Swaps business across global markets. 
 - Lead strategic modernization initiatives, including platform transformation, application rationalization, and legacy technology retirement. 
 - Drive front-to-back automation across Prime Services workflows, including corporate actions, claims, recalls, and billing processes. 
 - Enhance platform resilience, security, and operational stability through cloud adoption, application modernization, technology controls, and remediation programs. 
 - Expand technology capabilities supporting Secured Financing products, including intraday repo, agency repo, and unsecured bond borrow offerings. 
 - Global Delivery & India Leadership-
 - Serve as the senior delivery executive for India-based engineering teams supporting Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing. 
 - Drive organizational scale, productivity, and delivery excellence across globally distributed teams. 
 - Establish and evolve a high-performance operating model with clear accountability, governance, execution discipline, and workforce optimization. 
 - Lead effective collaboration across global technology, business, and operations organizations to ensure successful delivery outcomes. 
 - Engineering Modernization & Transformation-
 - Define and execute the technology modernization roadmap aligned to business growth and strategic priorities. 
 - Accelerate adoption of cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, event-driven platforms, and engineering best practices. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through automation, DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, and site reliability practices. 
 - Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities to improve productivity, quality, and delivery velocity. 
 - Risk, Controls & Operational Excellence-
 - Establish robust governance frameworks covering delivery health, operational performance, risk management, and service quality. 
 - Ensure proactive identification and mitigation of execution, technology, cyber, and operational risks. 
 - Strengthen controls and resiliency aligned with enterprise risk management and regulatory expectations. 
 - Drive operational excellence through disciplined metrics, transparency, and continuous improvement. 
 - Executive Stakeholder Management-
 - Act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to senior leaders across business, operations, technology, and risk functions. 
 - Lead executive governance forums and delivery reviews. 
 - Provide transparent, data-driven reporting on portfolio performance, investment priorities, risks, and strategic outcomes. 
 - Influence key technology and business decisions through strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement. 
 - Talent & Organizational Leadership-
 - Build and develop high-performing engineering teams capable of delivering strategic business outcomes. 
 - Lead workforce planning, succession management, leadership development, and capability-building initiatives. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous learning. 
 - Optimize the workforce model across employees and strategic vendor partners to support long-term business growth. 
 - Enterprise Leadership-
 - Contribute to broader State Street technology priorities, including engineering excellence, talent strategy, AI adoption, delivery governance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Collaborate across technology organizations to drive consistency in standards, practices, and execution methodologies. 
 - Support enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that enhance scalability, resiliency, and business agility. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 20+ years of progressive experience leading technology delivery and large-scale engineering organizations within financial services or complex global enterprises. 
 - Proven track record of delivering large transformation programs and managing complex technology portfolios. 
 - Deep knowledge of Capital Markets, Prime Brokerage, Securities Finance, or related Markets businesses. 
 - Strong engineering background with experience in modern technology architectures, including cloud platforms, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Demonstrated success leading global teams across multiple locations, including employee and vendor organizations. 
 - Strong execution discipline with expertise in delivery management, software engineering, production stability, and operational excellence. 
 - Deep understanding of risk management, technology controls, cyber security, resilience, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Exceptional communication, collaboration, and executive leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders globally. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading technology organizations supporting Prime Brokerage, Securities Finance, Secured Financing, Equity Swaps, or broader Markets businesses. 
 - Experience driving cloud transformation, platform modernization, and enterprise-scale engineering transformations. 
 - Knowledge of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation, and emerging productivity technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in Agile, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and engineering maturity models. 
 - Architecture-level understanding of enterprise data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and front-to-back financial services technology architectures. 

Are you the right candidate? Yes!

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don't necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit. 

Why This Role Is Important To Us

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We're driving the company's digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation. 

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We're looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company. 

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. 

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
data.description:
Company Description

Logward, a Shippeo company, is a pioneer in AI-powered supply chain execution workflows. As part of Shippeo - the global leader in real-time transportation visibility - Logward brings together trusted, SLA-backed visibility data with intelligent workflows and automation, helping global supply chain teams respond faster, reduce manual effort, and run more connected operations. 

*Please note: this role is locally employed by and contracted directly through Logward India Private Limited. *

Founded in 2014, Shippeo is a leading European SaaS company transforming supply chain visibility. With a global presence and multicultural team of 27 nationalities operating across Europe, North America, and Asia, we offer real-time multimodal transportation visibility to top industry leaders across various sectors. 

Our ambition is to become the world's leading supply chain data platform, using predictive AI, high-quality real-time data, and a robust partner network to enhance customer experience and operational excellence. 

Learn more about our mission and values on our website: https: //www. shippeo. com/en/company/about-us

___

About the role

Logward, a Shippeo company, is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Data to join its core product development team in Bengaluru. You will help build Logward's No-Code Data Platform, creating reusable product capabilities that enable users to ingest, model, transform, validate, monitor, and operationalize data workflows without writing code. 

This is a backend product engineering role, not a customer implementation or data integration delivery role. You will work with product managers, architects, frontend engineers, and QA engineers to build reliable, configurable, observable, and enterprise-ready platform capabilities. 

Location & Work Model: 

- Location: Bengaluru
 - Work Model: Hybrid (4 days per week in-office)

Application Requirement: 

As we operate internationally, we kindly request all candidates to submit their CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages cannot be considered. 

- Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent - Individual Contributor
 - Function: Engineering, Data Platform

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop the core data backbone for Logward's No-Code Data Platform. 
 - Build reusable capabilities for ingestion, parsing, schema management, mapping, transformation, validation, orchestration, monitoring, and operational workflows. 
 - Develop scalable backend services, APIs, workers, and execution engines using Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar technologies. 
 - Build configuration-driven and metadata-driven frameworks that allow users to define pipelines, mappings, validations, and business rules without writing code. 
 - Use distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or similar technologies. 
 - Support ingestion of structured, semi-structured, and flat-file data, including JSON, XML, CSV, fixed-width files, EDI, APIs, and database sources. 
 - Implement transformations such as lookups, joins, enrichments, calculations, conditional logic, aggregations, normalization, and format conversions. 
 - Build observability capabilities including execution logs, audit trails, lineage, error tracking, retry handling, SLA monitoring, and data quality checks. 
 - Contribute to AI-assisted capabilities such as schema inference, mapping suggestions, transformation recommendations, anomaly detection, error explanation, and pipeline troubleshooting. 
 - Design safe AI-agent workflows with tool orchestration, structured outputs, validation layers, guardrails, audit logs, and human review. 
 - Convert product requirements into architecture, technical designs, and production-ready code, while contributing to design reviews, testing, debugging, and production readiness. 
 - Collaborate with product, engineering, and design teams to build robust, user-friendly, extensible, and scalable platform features. 

What We're Looking For

 - Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.

data.title: Pre-Validation, CSV & AI Quality
data.description:
Quality Engineer - Pre-Validation, CSV & AI Quality

Bangalore

5+ years

Role Overview

We are seeking a Pre-Validation and Computerized System Validation (CSV) Expert with 2 to 5 years of experience in GxP validation, quality assurance, and regulated software environments to contribute to the quality engineering and validation of enterprise-grade SaaS and AI-powered products. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in risk-based validation, pre-validation activities, requirements assessment, validation strategy, test planning, traceability, IQ/OQ/PQ, data integrity, audit trail assessment, electronic records/signatures, and validation documentation for cloud-based and integrated systems. 

The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product, Testing, Implementation, Quality, Security, and Customer teams to assess requirements and risks early, identify validation gaps, define appropriate verification and testing approaches, review configuration and implementation evidence, and ensure systems are fit for intended use in regulated manufacturing and life-sciences environments. 

AI/GenAI - Must have: Hands-on use of AI for requirements analysis, risk assessment, test/OQ script generation, traceability analysis, validation document review, defect investigation, gap identification, and AI-assisted CSV workflows. Strong understanding of the need to independently verify AI-generated outputs and maintain GxP compliance, data integrity, confidentiality, and auditability. 

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Validation & Validation Strategy

- Lead and execute risk-based pre-validation activities for product releases, customer implementations, configuration changes, integrations, and new functionalities in regulated environments. 
 - Review business, user, functional, and configuration requirements to identify validation impact, GxP relevance, critical functionality, data integrity risks, and test coverage needs. 
 - Define validation approaches, scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and verification strategies based on intended use, system risk, complexity, and regulatory impact. 
 - Review and challenge Configuration Specifications, functional specifications, design/configuration documentation, and implementation details to confirm that the configured system aligns with approved requirements. 
 - Perform validation readiness assessments before formal OQ/PQ and identify gaps in requirements, configuration, test data, environments, traceability, documentation, and evidence. 
 - Support dry runs and pre-validation testing to identify defects, ambiguous requirements, usability gaps, missing scenarios, and OQ script/data-sheet issues before formal execution. 
 - Review release and customer-specific changes for validation impact and provide risk-based recommendations on regression testing, revalidation, or additional verification. 

Computerized System Validation (CSV) & GxP

- Apply CSV lifecycle principles to SaaS, web applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and enterprise platforms used in GxP-regulated processes. 
 - Develop and review validation deliverables including validation plans/strategies, risk assessments, URS/FRS or equivalent requirements, configuration specifications, traceability matrices, test scripts, test evidence, summary reports, and validation closure documentation. 
 - Strong understanding of IQ, OQ, PQ and risk-based testing principles, including appropriate separation of verification activities from formal qualification execution. 
 - Review and assess system functionality related to audit trails, user roles and access control, electronic records, electronic signatures, data retention, data export, data integrity, and system-generated reports. 
 - Apply principles of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GxP, ALCOA+ data integrity, and applicable computerized-system controls when reviewing validation scope and evidence. 
 - Review deviations, defects, test failures, change controls, CAPA actions, and validation impacts; assess whether issues affect intended use, data integrity, or validation status. 
 - Support periodic review, change impact assessment, release certification, and revalidation activities for validated systems. 

Pre-Validation Testing, OQ Readiness & Quality Engineering

- Review and challenge test scenarios, OQ scripts, datasheets, expected results, and evidence requirements for completeness, accuracy, traceability, and risk coverage. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, configuration, and end-to-end testing as part of pre-validation and validation readiness activities. 
 - Validate critical business workflows, configuration rules, calculations, data flows, integrations, reports, exports, audit trails, and role-based behavior against approved requirements. 
 - Identify edge cases, negative scenarios, boundary conditions, dependencies, data inconsistencies, and usability gaps that may not be adequately covered in formal test scripts. 
 - Ensure test evidence is objective, reproducible, attributable, contemporaneous, complete, and suitable for regulated validation records. 
 - Partner with Engineering and Testing teams to perform root-cause analysis and confirm defect fixes through appropriate regression and impact-based testing. 

AI/GenAI Validation & AI-Assisted CSV

- Use AI/GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent tools to accelerate requirements analysis, risk identification, test scenario generation, OQ script drafting, traceability mapping, document review, and defect analysis. 
 - Design AI-assisted workflows that convert requirements and test cases into structured validation scenarios, OQ steps, expected results, traceability mappings, and validation documentation while retaining human review and approval. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated test cases and validation content for correctness, completeness, hallucinations, unsupported assumptions, regulatory suitability, and alignment with approved requirements. 
 - Apply AI to analyze large volumes of requirements, test results, defects, logs, audit-trail data, and validation evidence to identify trends, gaps, inconsistencies, and potential quality risks. 
 - Understand validation considerations for AI-enabled and AI/ML functionality, including intended use, risk classification, model/output reliability, data quality, explainability, human oversight, change management, and ongoing monitoring where applicable. 
 - Establish appropriate controls for the use of AI with GxP and customer data, including confidentiality, privacy, data minimization, secure prompting, output verification, and prevention of uncontrolled use of production or sensitive data. 
 - Contribute to AI-enabled Quality Engineering initiatives and reusable tools that improve validation efficiency, traceability, test coverage, and quality without compromising compliance. 

Domain Knowledge - Manufacturing, Life Sciences & Enterprise Systems

- Strong understanding of GxP-regulated manufacturing or life-sciences processes and the role of computerized systems in supporting critical business and quality processes. 
 - Understand common enterprise systems and data flows such as ERP, MES, LIMS, QMS, WMS, supply chain, batch/material processes, genealogy, master data, reporting, and analytics platforms. 
 - Ability to understand manufacturing workflows, material and batch relationships, process hierarchies, genealogy/traceability, data lineage, and business-critical configuration rules. 
 - Assess the impact of system configuration and software changes on business processes, data integrity, downstream integrations, reporting, and validated state. 
 - Translate business and domain knowledge into practical validation scenarios, risk assessments, traceability, and meaningful test coverage. 

Documentation, Compliance & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Review validation and quality documentation for consistency, completeness, traceability, clarity, and alignment with approved procedures and regulatory expectations. 
 - Maintain strong traceability between requirements, risks, configuration, test cases, OQ/PQ evidence, defects, and final validation conclusions. 
 - Prepare clear validation observations, risk assessments, review comments, certification recommendations, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Work closely with Engineering, Product, Testing, Implementation, CSV, Security, and Customer teams to resolve validation gaps and ensure timely delivery. 
 - Support customer audits, internal quality reviews, inspection readiness, and responses to validation-related questions when required. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 2 to 5 years of experience in CSV, Computer System Validation, Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Validation, or a closely related regulated environment. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GxP validation and risk-based testing for SaaS, web applications, APIs, databases, integrations, or enterprise systems. 
 - Strong understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GxP principles, ALCOA+ data integrity, audit trails, electronic records, and electronic signatures. 
 - Hands-on experience with validation documentation, requirements, risk assessments, traceability matrices, IQ/OQ/PQ, test evidence, deviations, change controls, and validation reports. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum software development and working with Engineering, Product, Testing, DevOps, Implementation, and Quality teams. 
 - Experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools for requirements, defects, documentation, and traceability. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI tools for quality and validation activities, with strong ability to critically review and validate AI-generated outputs. 
 - Experience in manufacturing, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred. 

Skills & Attributes

- Strong understanding of CSV lifecycle, risk-based validation, GxP controls, and data integrity principles. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess validation risk and determine appropriate testing depth. 
 - Ability to understand complex business workflows, system configurations, integrations, data models, and downstream impacts. 
 - Strong requirement-to-test traceability and validation documentation skills. 
 - Ability to identify functional gaps, edge cases, configuration risks, data integrity risks, and compliance gaps. 
 - Strong understanding of audit trails, role-based access, electronic records/signatures, data retention, and controlled changes. 
 - Ability to independently review OQ scripts and datasheets and identify missing coverage, ambiguous steps, incorrect expected results, and evidence gaps. 
 - Strong AI literacy with the ability to use AI as a productivity and quality-engineering accelerator while maintaining human oversight and regulatory accountability. 
 - Ability to assess AI-generated content for accuracy, hallucination, completeness, bias, confidentiality, and suitability for regulated use. 
 - Good understanding of manufacturing processes, enterprise data models, and GxP business workflows. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset. 
 - Good communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment and manage multiple validation priorities. 

What you will get to work on: 

- Opportunity to work with AI-powered enterprise platforms and regulated digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Opportunity to work at the intersection of CSV, Quality Engineering, AI, Manufacturing, and Life Sciences. 
 - Culture focused on innovation, learning, quality, compliance, and technical excellence. 
 - Regular workshops, training programs, and tech talks. 

About Mareana

Mareana builds cutting-edge enterprise digital AI products focused on Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Sustainability. Our AI-driven platforms solve complex data challenges and deliver real-time insights, enabling businesses to accelerate digital transformation. 

We have delivered more than $1B+ in business value to global clients, including leading firms in life sciences, consumer goods, chemicals, food & beverage, and manufacturing. We are recognized by Gartner as a "Cool Vendor in AI" and have been featured in Silicon Review and Manufacturing Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead delivery of the group's digital commerce applications, owning sprint and Program Increment execution from planning through release. Keep commitments realistic against available capacity, and manage risks, dependencies, and release readiness across the digital release cycle. 

- Lead delivery for digital commerce capability within the Omnichannel domain, managing the squad that delivers these capabilities for the group's brands.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world's most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty. 

About The Team And What We Will Build Together

The Manager of Software Engineering leads one or more Agile development squads within the Software Engineering group at Kobie. As part of our strategic roadmap and client implementations, this role focuses on delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions while supporting the growth and development of the engineering team. 

As a key leader within the team, you will work closely with Product Owners, QA, Architects, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-designed technical solutions. You will guide a team of skilled engineers in building and delivering reliable software, while fostering strong engineering practices and a collaborative team environment. 

You will play an active role in day-to-day delivery, sprint execution, and team enablement ensuring predictable outcomes, high-quality releases, and continuous improvement. This includes supporting resource planning, mentoring engineers, and helping the team grow both technically and professionally. 

In this role, you will build strong partnerships with product and cross-functional teams, gaining a deep understanding of business needs and contributing to solutions that leverage modern technologies within a scalable platform ecosystem. 

The Manager of Software Engineering is responsible for driving team momentum, maintaining high standards of execution, and ensuring alignment between engineering efforts and product goals. You will also help communicate technical approaches and decisions effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, building strong working relationships across the organization. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Lead one or more Agile development squads within the Software Engineering group, delivering scalable and high-quality platform capabilities and client solutions

 - Drive end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, ensuring predictable execution, high quality, and alignment with product and client implementation goals
 - Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, coaching, and performance feedback, helping them grow their skills and careers
 - Contribute to the design and development of modern distributed systems and microservices architectures
 - Champion strong engineering practices, including code quality, automated testing, documentation, and operational readiness
 - Work with QA and SDET teams to improve test automation coverage and quality engineering practices across Agile squads
 - Demonstrated ability to define and evolve CI/CD strategies and infrastructure, enabling automated, secure, and efficient deployments
 - Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment that drives team momentum, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement

What You Need To Be Successful

- 8-10 years of software development experience, with 2+ years of engineering leadership or team management
 - Proven experience leading Agile development teams delivering production-grade software systems
 - Hands-on expertise in modern backend and frontend technologies (e. g. , Java, Spring, Angular) and testing methodologies
 - Strong understanding of modern Java architecture including event-driven design, Kafka, pub/sub messaging patterns, and scalable microservices
 - Familiarity with event-driven design and messaging platforms such as Kafka or similar pub/sub systems
 - Experience running production workloads in cloud-based, containerized environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
 - Demonstrated ability to define and evolve CI/CD strategies and infrastructure, enabling automated, secure, and efficient deployments
 - Knowledge of test automation strategy and frameworks, including test coverage analysis, parallel test execution, and integration into CI pipelines
 - Experience with testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Rest Assured, Postman, SoapUI, or similar frameworks and test-first development approaches, preferably BDD
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization
 - Ability to mentor engineers, drive team accountability, and maintain focus on delivering high-quality outcomes

About Kobie

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We're always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. 

As a trusted partner to some of the world's most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special. 

We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard. 

Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie, through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities. 

To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays, offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance. 

As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U. S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection. 

Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Own the hardest engineering outcomes in X3 and turn architecture direction into working, supportable product capabilities. Set the technical bar across squads while remaining close enough to the code, evidence and customer impact to make sound decisions. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Expert understanding of distributed systems architecture, including domain-driven design, service decomposition, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, scalability, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, consistency models, disaster recovery, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Extensive experience defining and governing API-first and event-driven platforms, including REST, GraphQL, messaging architectures, service contracts, versioning strategies, backward compatibility, integration governance, and ecosystem extensibility. 
 - Strong engineering and architecture expertise across relational databases and document databases, including platform-scale data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, replication, migration strategies, data lifecycle management, and operational resilience. 
 - Deep experience leading cloud-native engineering initiatives encompassing containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, secure software supply chains, observability, reliability engineering, security architecture, upgrade strategies, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex modernization initiatives, balancing legacy constraints, customer continuity, platform evolution, technical debt reduction, and long-term architectural sustainability. 
 - Proven ability to evaluate and govern AI-assisted engineering practices, ensuring appropriate human review, traceability, security controls, testing strategies, and operational safeguards. 
 - Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to align engineers, architects, product leaders, operational teams, and executives around complex technical decisions, risks, investments, and trade-offs. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Shape platform capabilities as strategic products that enable engineering velocity, operational excellence, ecosystem extensibility, and long-term scalability across multiple squads and domains. 
 - Define and govern service boundaries, domain ownership models, API contracts, event architectures, distributed systems patterns, and platform standards that remain sustainable as the organization scales. 
 - Establish organization-wide engineering expectations for secure software delivery, supply-chain security, identity and access management, secrets management, policy enforcement, infrastructure automation, observability, reliability, and operational readiness. 
 - Drive adoption of OpenTelemetry-compatible observability, reliability engineering practices, SLOs, performance management, capacity planning, resilience testing, incident learning, and recovery strategies across engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical leadership for platform engineering capabilities, including containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, developer experience improvements, automation, self-service engineering capabilities, and FinOps optimization where appropriate. 
 - Define and govern compatibility, upgrade, migration, deprecation, recovery, and rollback strategies that protect customer continuity, partner investments, operational stability, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders, establish engineering standards, review architectural direction, and influence cross-functional technical decision-making across the portfolio. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing large-scale ERP, enterprise business applications, batch-processing platforms, reporting platforms, or complex legacy systems. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are valuable context but are not required. 
 - Deep understanding of ERP, manufacturing, distribution, finance, supply-chain, commerce, or operational workflow domains, including platform modernization, migration, reconciliation, and business continuity. 
 - Experience leading platform engineering, SaaS infrastructure, cloud platform transformations, developer-experience initiatives, or internal platform product development. 
 - Experience designing extensible ecosystems, marketplace architectures, partner enablement platforms, metadata-driven platforms, migration factories, or highly configurable enterprise applications. 
 - Experience delivering regulated, highly available, enterprise-scale SaaS platforms with strong requirements for reliability, security, compliance, privacy, auditability, and operational governance. 
 - Experience influencing engineering organizations through architecture governance, technical strategy, technology roadmap definition, engineering excellence programs, and senior technical mentorship. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant ownership of architecture, platform strategy, distributed systems design, and cross-team technical leadership for large-scale cloud-native products. 
 - Demonstrated success leading major modernization, transformation, platform, or SaaS initiatives that span multiple teams, business domains, and technology stacks. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Recognized as a trusted technical leader capable of balancing customer outcomes, business priorities, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability. 

Provide your feedback on BizChat

Expected outcomes / success measures

- A small number of agreed architecture decisions and transition states guide delivery without blocking squads. 
 - Modern components and contracts reduce coupling, runtime dependency and support effort while preserving customer behaviour. 
 - Critical releases and migration waves have repeatable quality, observability and rollback evidence. 
 - Engineers make more decisions locally because standards, examples and mentoring are clear. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Managers, Principal and Senior Engineers, Automation, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services, partners and Europe/North America domain experts. India delivery is a first-class ownership centre with planned Europe/North America overlap and clear hand-offs across time zones. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Acts as a calm technical role model, makes uncertainty visible, develops talent and chooses the simplest safe path that improves customer and business outcomes. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Own cross-squad technical strategy for a significant modernisation outcome, from current-state discovery through a viable transition state and measurable exit criteria. 
 - Make and record decisions on domain boundaries, GraphQL contracts, componentisation, data-path simplification and legacy-runtime reduction. 
 - Lead difficult implementation, incident, performance and migration problems; decide when to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire a capability. 
 - Set engineering standards for secure coding, testing, observability, deployment, upgrades and rollback, and ensure they are adopted rather than merely documented. 
 - Coach senior and developing engineers, grow technical leadership in India and across the distributed squad network, and challenge designs constructively. 

Decision ownership: 

Technical direction within the assigned portfolio, cross-squad trade-offs, exception escalation, transition-state design and acceptance of engineering evidence. Escalates product, legal, security or commercial policy decisions with a clear recommendation. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.
