JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Process Manager - Operational Risk & Audit Quality

Location - Mumbai / Pune

Function: Operational Risk & Quality Assurance | Reporting: Audit Quality Head

Role Summary

Own the end-to-end delivery and quality of assigned Class 1 audits across BFSI client engagements. Lead risk-based scoping, control testing, evidence review, finding articulation, stakeholder readouts, and remediation tracking while strengthening audit discipline, preventive controls, and team capability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan and execute risk-based audits covering process governance, transaction accuracy, SOP/SLA adherence, regulatory and client requirements, and key operational controls. 
 - Lead walkthroughs, risk and control assessments, sample testing, data analysis, and evidence validation; maintain complete, traceable, and defensible working papers. 
 - Review audit files and deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, evidence sufficiency, and appropriate application of audit methodology and risk ratings. 
 - Draft clear findings covering condition, criteria, root cause, risk/impact, recommendation, owner, timeline, and closure evidence; identify repeat or systemic issues. 
 - Conduct insightful readout sessions with Operations, Risk/Compliance, and client stakeholders; manage challenge constructively while preserving audit independence. 
 - Facilitate RCA using 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, Pareto, or control mapping: challenge corrective and preventive actions for sustainability and proportionality. 
 - Track findings to closure, validate implementation evidence and effectiveness, and escalate overdue, high-risk, repeated, or inadequately remediated actions. 
 - Maintain audit dashboards and governance reporting covering plan versus completion, ratings, themes, action aging, repeat findings, and decisions required. 
 - Calibrate review quality, and improve checklists, test scripts, sampling, analytics, and audit automation. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business, Economics, Risk, or a related field; master's preferred. 
 - 8-12 years' BFSI, investment banking operations, or financial-services KPO experience across operations, audit, risk, controls, quality assurance, incidents, or remediation. 
 - Experience leading process or audit reviews, control assessments, RCA, corrective-action tracking, reporting, and senior stakeholder management preferred. 
 - CA, CPA, CIA, CISA, FRM, Lean Six Sigma, or relevant domain certification preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of TQM, process standardization, defect prevention, quality measurement, and continuous improvement. 

Core Skills and Knowledge

Audit and risk: Risk-based auditing, control design/operating-effectiveness testing, sampling, evidence assessment, finding writing, rating calibration, RCA/CAPA, and closure validation. 

Leadership and communication: Analytical judgment, attention to detail, professional skepticism, ethical conduct, concise writing, confident readouts, stakeholder management, coaching, and execution under tight deadlines. 

Tools and improvement: Advanced Excel; exposure to Power BI/Tableau, SQL/Alteryx, GRC tools, VBA/RPA, continuous monitoring, and governed AI use is advantageous.

data.description:
Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer

About L4B Software

L4B Software specializes in embedded software engineering, platform development and product cybersecurity. We work with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, board support packages (BSPs) and real-time embedded systems to develop reliable, secure and maintainable software platforms. 

Our engineering work supports industries including medical devices, consumer electronics and other connected embedded products where security must be integrated throughout the product lifecycle. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer with strong hands-on experience securing embedded devices and connected products, particularly in consumer electronics or medical-device environments. 

This is a hands-on engineering position, not a general IT cybersecurity, SOC, network security or compliance-only role. 

You will work directly with embedded software, platform and product-engineering teams to design, implement, test and maintain security mechanisms across device hardware, bootloaders, operating systems, firmware and software-update infrastructure. 

We are particularly interested in engineers who have contributed to security architectures and controls in real products, from development and integration through production release and ongoing maintenance. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Embedded Product Security Architecture

- Design and implement security architectures for Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP and other embedded platforms. 
 - Perform device-level threat modeling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments. 
 - Identify threats involving physical device access, debug interfaces, firmware extraction, communication interfaces and software vulnerabilities. 
 - Translate security requirements into practical technical controls and engineering tasks. 
 - Collaborate with hardware, BSP, platform and application engineers to implement security by design. 2. Secure Boot, Device Identity and Cryptography

- Implement and validate Secure Boot, Verified Boot and chain-of-trust mechanisms. 
 - Work with hardware-backed security technologies such as TPM, HSM, secure elements, ARM TrustZone and OP-TEE, as applicable. 
 - Design secure device identity, key provisioning, key storage and key lifecycle mechanisms. 
 - Implement cryptographic signing, integrity verification and secure firmware authentication. 
 - Support secure manufacturing provisioning and device lifecycle security. 3. Embedded Linux and Android Platform Hardening

- Implement security controls within Embedded Linux and, where applicable, Android/AOSP platforms. 
 - Harden bootloaders, Linux kernels, operating-system configurations and device services. 
 - Work with Linux security mechanisms such as SELinux, AppArmor, dm-verity, dm-crypt and filesystem protection. 
 - Reduce attack surfaces by securing services, ports, permissions, interfaces and debug capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with Yocto/BSP engineers to integrate security controls into production firmware images. 4. Secure Firmware Updates and Product Lifecycle Security

- Design and implement secure firmware and OTA update mechanisms. 
 - Ensure firmware authenticity, integrity, rollback protection and secure recovery. 
 - Support secure update architectures for connected and field-deployed products. 
 - Investigate product vulnerabilities and contribute to remediation across supported software versions. 
 - Help establish security maintenance practices for products throughout their operational lifecycle. 5. Vulnerability Management and Security Verification

- Perform vulnerability analysis across embedded firmware, operating systems, libraries and third-party components. 
 - Work with CVE databases, software composition analysis and SBOM generation. 
 - Assess vulnerability exploitability and product-specific security impact. 
 - Support static analysis, dynamic analysis, firmware analysis and penetration-testing activities. 
 - Develop or integrate security verification into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Document security findings, remediation actions and verification evidence. 6. Product Security and Engineering Collaboration

- Work closely with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, BSP, hardware, DevSecOps, QA and product-engineering teams. 
 - Participate in security design reviews and technical risk assessments. 
 - Support security requirements, verification and traceability for regulated or security-sensitive products. 
 - Contribute to product-security documentation and technical security decisions. 
 - Independently investigate and resolve complex embedded security issues. Required Qualifications and Experience

- Strong professional experience in embedded software engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for embedded product cybersecurity. 
 - Professional experience securing consumer electronics, medical devices or comparable connected embedded products. 
 - Strong understanding of embedded hardware, firmware, bootloaders, operating systems and device security boundaries. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing security controls in Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP or comparable embedded platforms. 
 - Demonstrated practical experience in several of the following: 
 - Secure Boot, Verified Boot or hardware root of trust. 
 - Secure key storage, provisioning and cryptographic integration. 
 - Embedded Linux security hardening. 
 - Secure firmware updates and rollback protection. 
 - Device-level threat modeling and attack-surface reduction. 
 - Embedded vulnerability analysis and remediation. 
 - Strong Linux debugging and embedded systems troubleshooting skills. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting with Python or Bash.

Job Title: 

Principal Engineer-High Speed Interface Pre-Silicon Validation/Verification

We Are: 

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. 

You Are: 

You are a driven and insightful Emulation Expert, passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in ASIC digital design. With a deep understanding of IP interfaces--especially PCIe and DDR--you are skilled in leveraging advanced emulation platforms like Zebu to accelerate verification and product development. Your career is marked by a proven ability to deliver robust, production-ready IP through rigorous emulation and verification cycles. You thrive in highly collaborative, matrixed, and international environments, bringing together diverse teams and perspectives to solve complex challenges. 

Your hands-on approach and proactive attitude make you a go-to resource for bridging gaps between Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring seamless integration and verification of both Controller and PHY components. You have a keen eye for detail and are committed to right-first-time development, always ensuring traceability and completeness across verification requirements. You stay ahead of industry trends, standards, and evolving technologies, and are adept at translating these into actionable insights for your teams. As an excellent communicator and natural collaborator, you are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and driving change within the organization. Your adaptability, resilience, and commitment to continuous learning set you apart as a leader in your field. 

What You'll Be Doing: 

- Bridging and closing gaps between the available or required Emulation IP feature set and the Design IP verification for all functions, spanning both Controller and PHY domains. 
 - Reporting key metrics and driving continuous improvement initiatives in Emulation IP quality and performance. 
 - Providing technical leadership and expertise to define requirements for Emulation IP, ensuring its correct implementation and deployment within verification strategies. 
 - Staying ahead of evolving industry standards, interpreting future changes, ECNs, and specification errata, and integrating this knowledge into Emulation and Design IP teams. 
 - Reviewing and validating test plans for both Emulation IP and Design IP, guaranteeing best-in-class function, feature coverage, and product quality. 
 - Collaborating cross-functionally to optimize workflows, standardize methodologies, and ensure compliance with organizational goals. 
 - Mentoring and guiding junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. 

The Impact You Will Have: 

- Enhancing cross-functional collaboration to elevate product quality and end-customer satisfaction. 
 - Transforming the approach to Emulation IP usage in validating cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures. 
 - Driving innovation by defining and refining requirements for IP product development, particularly in emulation contexts. 
 - Championing the adoption of best-in-class verification methodologies across the organization. 
 - Standardizing and optimizing verification workflows to boost efficiency, traceability, and compliance. 
 - Influencing the next generation of emulation and verification solutions, positioning Synopsys as an industry leader. 
 - Accelerating time-to-market for high-performance silicon solutions through advanced emulation strategies. 

What You'll Need: 

- 15+ years of relevant experience in emulation, verification, or IP product development. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe/ DDR / Ethernet interfaces, including protocol and verification strategies. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, particularly for IP verification. 
 - Demonstrated track record in leading IP product development initiatives with a focus on emulation. 
 - Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, with an ability to drive consensus and deliver results. 
 - Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire change across diverse teams. 
 - Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and international environment. 

Who You Are: 

- A proactive and collaborative problem-solver with a passion for excellence. 
 - Innovative thinker who embraces change and seeks out opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Strong communicator, able to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Resilient and adaptable, thriving in dynamic environments and embracing new challenges. 
 - Committed to mentoring others and fostering an inclusive, team-oriented culture. 

The Team You'll Be a Part Of: 

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits: 

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process

data.description:
Job Description - QA/QC Engineer

Reports to:                   Senior QA/QC Engineer            

Job Description: 

The QA/QC Engineer is responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities to ensure compliance with applicable quality, safety, regulatory, and contractual requirements while supporting the organization's strategic objectives and vision. The role is responsible for maintaining and continually improving the Quality Management System (QMS), monitoring compliance with established quality standards and procedures, supporting quality assurance and control activities across projects and operations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives under the guidance of the Senior QA/QC Engineer. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Plan, implement, and monitor Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities throughout project execution to ensure compliance with client contractual requirements, approved quality documentation, applicable codes, standards, and the Company's Integrated Management System (IMS). 
 - Ensure per IMS, QA Document creation work flow fully understood and implemented all the time. 
 - Participate in Internal Kick-Off Meetings (KOM) with relevant stakeholders to gain a comprehensive understanding of project scope, technical requirements, contractual obligations, technical clarifications, and lessons learned from previous projects. 
 - Preparation of Master Quality Specification Extracts-Quality for key international clients (e. g. , Saudi Aramco, PDO, Shell DEP, ADNOC, and others) for review and approval by the Line Managers prior to inclusion in the quality database. Ensure client-specific technical quality requirements are accurately captured to minimize technical risks, standardize quality documentation, and provide a reliable reference for future projects, thereby improving efficiency in the preparation and review of project quality documents. 
 - Preparation of Project Specific Specification Extracts-Quality by identifying and consolidating project-specific quality requirements from client specifications, applicable codes, and standards to support the accurate and efficient preparation of quality documentation, minimize technical errors, and ensure compliance throughout project execution. 
 - Preparation of quality documentation, including Material Purchase Specifications (MPS), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) / Manufacturing Process Plan (MPP), and quality procedures, in accordance with client project specifications, and applicable international codes and standards to ensure technical requirements and compliance throughout project execution. 
 - Review of vendor quality documentation, including Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), manufacturing and testing procedures, welding documentation, and Non-Destructive Examination (NDE) procedures, to confirm compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable codes and standards. 
 - Participate in internal audits within the organization and second-party audits at supplier facilities, as directed by the Head quality to assess compliance with the Quality Management System (QMS). 
 - Execute Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities throughout project execution in accordance with approved quality documents, project requirements, and company procedures, utilizing established quality management systems such as the Event Note System, Inspection Database, and Job Hub to ensure effective quality monitoring, traceability, and compliance. 
 - Maintain and update the QA planning database dynamically to ensure project quality deliverable. 
 - Collaborate with Project Managers during the early stages of project execution to support contract reviews, identify and resolve quality-related conflicts, review technical deliverables, and address project-specific quality requirements to ensure compliance with contractual obligations, applicable standards, and successful project delivery. 
 - Manage technical queries (TQs) related to materials, welding, inspection, and other quality-related matters, ensuring timely review, resolution, and issuance of technical clarifications prior to project commencement to support smooth project execution and minimize potential quality risks. 
 - Participate in project kick-off meetings, pre-inspection meetings, and other quality-related meetings for critical items and packages. Coordinate Quality Control (QC) activities at supplier facilities and liaise with Jord Inspection Engineers /Third-party inspection agencies and client inspectors as and when required to ensure compliance with approved quality requirements, inspection plans, and project specifications. 
 - Identify and document quality non-conformances, raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), monitor and verify the implementation of corrective and preventive actions, ensure effective close-out of NCRs, and recommend improvement opportunities to enhance quality performance and prevent recurrence. 
 - Perform inspection and verification activities in accordance with the latest approved drawings, project specifications, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), quality procedures, and other applicable project quality documents to ensure compliance with contractual requirements. 
 - Ensure full compliance with all company policies, procedures, and Integrated Management System (IMS) requirements while executing QA/QC activities, maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence. 
 - During inspections stop working when: 
 - People's health and safety are at risk, i. e. , due to non-usage of PPE, lack of safety equipment, poor quality equipment and machinery. 
 - Quality related processes and relevant approved documentation are not strictly followed. 
 - The above duties and responsibilities are at a minimum, however, based on job needs there may be additional work required to ensure quality needs are met. 
 - Adhere to all Jord company policies and IMS requirements. 

Skills and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Minimum 5 years of hands-on shop/fabrication experience in the manufacturing of pressure vessels and heat exchangers in accordance with ASME Section II, Section V, Section VIII, and Section IX requirements. Experience with API 661, Air-Cooled Heat Exchangers (ACHE), and Air-Cooled Condensers (ACC) is highly preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge and practical experience in Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities within manufacturing and project execution environments. 
 - Sound understanding of manufacturing processes and product characteristics, including foundry operations, fabrication, machining, welding, Non-Destructive Examination (NDE), heat treatment, surface preparation, painting, and coating activities. 
 - Knowledge and experience in inspection methods, testing techniques, measuring instruments, and quality verification processes. 
 - Ability to interpret, understand, and effectively apply on international codes, standards, procedures, client specifications, and project quality requirements during project execution to ensure compliance and successful project delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, with experience in supporting, coordinating, and managing skilled technical professionals. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, suppliers, clients, and other stakeholders. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to prepare technical documentation, reports, and professional correspondence.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) - Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) -Senior

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 5-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

Nice to Have Skills:

Job Requirements

Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

data.title: Assistant Manager-Coding and Process Excellence
data.description:
- We are a reputable software company specializing in the healthcare industry. Since 1988 we have been servicing the healthcare industry by providing various products to laboratories, hospitals and doctors. As a member of our organization you will be joining a smart and driven team that shares your passion for exploration and discovery in the Healthcare Software vertical. Our significant investment in people, processes, and technology equips our employees with the resources and opportunities to drive substantial value for all our client partners. 

Job Description

Assistant Manager will oversee a team of medical coders, ensuring accurate and timely coding of medical diagnoses, procedures, and services for healthcare facilities. The role involves managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e. g. , ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding), and acting as the primary point of contact between the coding team and other departments. This person will also mentor and train coding staff, monitor performance metrics, and ensure the department meets organizational goals and regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Team Management: 

- Supervise a team of medical coders, ensuring workload distribution and deadlines are met. 
 - Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide feedback to team members. 
 - Serve as the primary point of escalation for coding-related issues or complex cases. 
 - Foster a collaborative and productive team environment by providing guidance, support, and training opportunities. 2. Quality Assurance: 

- Ensure coding accuracy and compliance with industry standards such as ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes. 
 - Perform random audits of coded claims to ensure accuracy and adherence to organizational and regulatory guidelines. 
 - Implement corrective actions and training plans when discrepancies are identified during audits. 3. Training and Development: 

- Organize and conduct regular training sessions on updates to coding standards, regulations, and software tools. 
 - Mentor junior coders and help develop their skills to improve performance. 
 - Keep the team updated on regulatory changes and best practices in medical coding. 4. Operational Oversight: 

- Manage day-to-day operations of the coding team, ensuring tasks are completed on time and meet quality standards. 
 - Track and report team performance metrics, including coding accuracy, productivity, and turnaround times. 
 - Collaborate with other departments such as billing, compliance, and healthcare providers to resolve coding and reimbursement issues. 5. Compliance and Documentation: 

- Ensure that coding practices are in compliance with HIPAA regulations, organizational policies, and state/federal guidelines. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation of all coding processes and updates for auditing purposes. 
 - Assist in preparing the department for internal and external audits. 6. Process Improvement: 

- Identify areas of inefficiency in the coding process and recommend improvements. 
 - Implement new processes, tools, or systems to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of medical coding operations. 7. Client/Stakeholder Relations: 

- Act as a liaison between the coding team and other internal and external stakeholders, including physicians, administrative staff, and external auditors. 
 - Address and resolve any queries related to coding from insurance companies, providers, or billing departments. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Health Information Management, Medical Coding, or a related field preferred. 
 - Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), or similar certification required. Experience: 

- 6+ years of experience in medical coding, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role. 
 - Extensive knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems with E&M coding. 
 - Experience with healthcare billing processes and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Skills: 

- Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. 
 - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in coding and documentation. 
 - Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. 
 - Proficiency in coding software and MS Office tools (Excel, Word, etc. ). 

Additional Information

- Transportation Faciity
 - Health Insurance and Other Benefits

data.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About Us

We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. 

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. 

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. 

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. 

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. 

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. 

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. 

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. 
 - Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. 
 - Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. 
 - Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. 
 - Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. 
 - Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. 
 - Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. 
 - Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. 
 - Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. 
 - Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. 
 - Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. 
 - Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. 
 - Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. 
 - Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. 
 - Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. 
 - Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. 
 - Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. 
 - A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. 
 - Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. 
 - Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. 
 - Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. 
 - Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. 
 - Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. 
 - The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. 
 - Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. 

Especially Valuable Experience

- Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. 
 - Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. 
 - Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. 
 - Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. 
 - Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. 
 - Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. 

Growth, Responsibility And Compensation

Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. 

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. 

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. 

What We Offer

- A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. 
 - Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. 
 - The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. 
 - Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. 
 - Close collaboration with startup leadership. 
 - The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. 

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. 

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. 

How To Apply

We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. 

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: 

- A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. 
 - An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. 
 - Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. 
 - A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. 
 - Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. 
 - Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. 

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Java/Golang

Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. 

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer to help build a new cloud-based SaaS identity analytics product.   We are looking for well-rounded backend or full stack engineers who are passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable microservices and infrastructure for SaaS products. 

As one of the first members on the team, you will be integral in building this product and will be part of an agile team that is in startup mode. This is a unique opportunity to build something from scratch but have the backing of an organization that has the muscle to take it to market quickly, with a very satisfied customer base.

- Deliver efficient, maintainable, robust Java based microservices. 
 - Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements. 
 - Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing. 
 - Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features.

- 9-14 yearss of experience in Java / GO -based backend development. 
 - Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
 - Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture. 
 - Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers. 
 - Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application. 
 - Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis
 - Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana
 - Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude. 
 - Experience working with remote teams
 - Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills  

Desired

- Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture. 
 - Experience writing software applications in Go
What success looks like in the role

Within the first 30 days you will: 

- Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment. 
 - Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it. By 90 days: 

- Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes  many) stakeholders, architects and members of your team. 
 - Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team-there's no room for ivory towers here. 
 - Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day. By 6 months: 

- Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently. 
 - Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity. 
 - Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner. 
 - Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements.

Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.   
  
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:   

- Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.   
 - Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents  
 - Annual performance bonus  
 - 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays  
 - Flexible Work hours

data.title: Principal Engineer - Design Verification
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

We are seeking a diligent SoC/MCU Verification engineer to join our team at Renesas. The Verification engineer will be responsible for performing various verification tasks including Test Plan creation, Testcase creation, Coverage closure, Requirements traceability and Gate Level Simulation. They will also review system requirements and track quality assurance metrics. Ultimately, the role of the Verification Engineer is to ensure that our products, applications, and systems work correctly, safely & securely. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Drive Verification R&D team driving technical execution and best in class methodologies used in the design of advanced microcontrollers and microprocessors. 
 - Work closely with system architects to understand high level specifications to be able to verify them. 
 - Work with various EDA vendors to deploy next generation tools 
 - Build strong collaboration with other R&D teams such as RTL, DFT, digital IP, PD, Design Enablement, Emulation, and Validation to achieve project milestones 
 - Promote continuous improvement to design techniques to ensure 'Zero Defect' chips 
 - Collaborate with SME's and key leaders in architecture, systems, emulation, SoC design, software, physical design, and IP teams developing key technical networks to influence overall design improvements and verification methodologies 
 - Responsible for developing detailed Technical SoC verification execution plans, progress reports and tracking milestones, managing technical risks, and providing mitigations to meet schedule quality and costs commitments. Communicate across technical teas as well as provide executive level presentations 
 - Complete ownership for SoC verification quality sign-offs ensuring all deliverables for team hand-offs. 
 - Drive best in class verification methodologies collaborating with global internal and external SME's and developing adoption and compliance processes. Including, driving key innovation strategies which significantly impact efficiency and quality for overall R&D and ROI

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in electronics engineering. 
 - 14+ years of experience in SoC Verification domains and have working knowledge of industry standard EDA toolkits. 
 - Experience in Microcontroller and Microprocessor architecture & Interconnect
 - Experience in protocols like AHB/AXI, Memory (ROM, RAM, Flash, MRAM) and memory controllers. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, C/C++, Shell. 
 - Good knowledge in scripting like Perl, TCL or Python is a plus 
 - Proven experience in testbench design and development using UVM methodology for IP/Subsystem and SOC. 
 - High proficiency in Metric Driven Verification concepts, functional and code coverage. 
 - Expertise in directed and constrained random methodologies. 
 - Good knowledge of formal verification methodologies and assertions. 
 - Experience with debugging of designs pre- and post-silicon, in simulation and on the bench. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skill. 
 - Must have worked on complex, multi-core SoC's with extensive interconnects and a large range of peripherals. 
 - Fair domain knowledge of clocking, system modes, power management, debug, security and other architectures is a must. Preferred/Plus Qualifications

- Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal‐simulation flows
 - Experience with low‐power verification
 - Familiarity with Medium‐speed or communication IPs, such as: 
 - CANXL, CANFD, LINFLEX, UART, FLEXRAY
 - Interconnect fabrics
 - Security, debug, or safety‐critical IPs
 - Experience delivering reusable, production‐quality VIPs used across multiple SoCs

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

data.title: Senior Microsoft AI Engineer - Copilot, Foundry & Power Automate
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About Us

We are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives. 

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results. 

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team. 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. 

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products. 

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve. 

Ownership of Our Microsoft Environment

You will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control. 

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry. 
 - Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively. 
 - Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries. 
 - Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery. 
 - Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems. 
 - Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them. 
 - Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs. 
 - Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions. 
 - Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections. 
 - Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows. 
 - Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures. 
 - Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions. 
 - Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria. 
 - Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership. 
 - Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer. 
 - Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. 
 - Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows. 
 - Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs. 
 - Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output. 
 - Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms. 
 - Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling. 
 - Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell. 
 - Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement. 
 - Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub. 
 - Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration. 
 - Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication. 
 - Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors. 
 - The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result. 
 - Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget. 

Especially Valuable Experience

- Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment. 
 - Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access. 
 - Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control. 
 - Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search. 
 - Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security. 
 - Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions. 
 - Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain. 
 - Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership. 
 - Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity. 

Growth, Leadership And Compensation

This is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice. 

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years. 

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment. 

What We Offer

- A fully remote role with a long-term perspective. 
 - Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery. 
 - The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team. 
 - Close collaboration with startup leadership. 
 - Varied projects with practical business impact. 
 - Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops. 

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment. 

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. 

How To Apply

We are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work. 

Please submit your CV and a short overview of: 

- A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results. 
 - A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures. 
 - A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed. 
 - A project you managed or a team you led or mentored. 
 - Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors. 
 - Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. 

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

data.description:
ABOUT US: 

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India's first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. 

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don't just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you'll be fuelling the future of space exploration. 

JOB SUMMARY: 

Azista Space is seeking a visionary and rigorous Head of System Reliability and Quality to lead our entire quality division across satellite design, development, assembly, integration, and testing (AIT). Operating as a vertically integrated leader in the global aerospace sector, we bridge the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. In this critical executive role, you will own reliability, product, and mission assurance for every space programme, driving our commitment to zero-defect manufacturing from concept through launch readiness. 

You will set the overarching quality strategy, build and scale a world-class QA/QC team, and act as the definitive quality authority across electrical, mechanical, and software domains. Your leadership will directly govern compliance with aerospace standards-including AS9100D, DO-178C, and DO-254, while embedding a culture of "first-time-right" process discipline. By spearheading Material Review Boards, Failure Review Boards, and robust supplier quality frameworks, you will safeguard our orbital missions, protect mission-critical hardware, and cement Azista Space's reputation as a trusted global provider of high-performance space technology. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Executive Quality Leadership: Lead the entire QA/QC division across hiring, organizational structure, performance management, and succession planning, setting clear product assurance objectives for all satellite programmes. 
 - Final Quality Authority: Serve as the ultimate sign-off authority for design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), test readiness, material review boards (MRB), failure review boards (FRB), and final shipment/launch clearances. 
 - QMS & Regulatory Governance: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve a QMS fully compliant with AS9100D and ISO 9001, successfully hosting customer, certification, and regulatory audits. 
 - Full Lifecycle Mission Assurance: Oversee quality gates and verification matrices across the complete satellite lifecycle, including environmental testing (thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, and EMI/EMC). 
 - Software & Hardware Compliance: Govern complex electronic hardware assurance to DO-254 and flight/ground software quality assurance to DO-178C alongside ECSS/NASA standards where required. 
 - Workmanship & EEE Parts Control: Enforce strict adherence to IPC J-STD-001 (Space Addendum), IPC-A-610, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards, alongside rigorous EEE parts screening and counterfeit-part prevention. 
 - Supplier Quality & Risk Management: Qualify and monitor subcontractors, flow down stringent quality requirements, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions (CAPA, 8D, FMEA) to eliminate quality escapes. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

- Education: Minimum B. Tech / B. E. in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Experience: 12+ years of progressive QA/QC experience within aerospace systems. 
 - Space Systems Expertise: Hands-on quality assurance experience on satellites, spacecraft subsystems, or launch vehicle systems (non-negotiable). 
 - Lifecycle Ownership: Proven track record of owning quality through design, development, integration, and testing of space hardware. 
 - Multi-Disciplinary Mastery: Demonstrated capability managing QA/QC for both electrical/electronic and mechanical systems. 
 - Standards Familiarity: Practical working knowledge of software and complex hardware assurance standards (DO-178C and DO-254). 
 - Leadership Track Record: Experience leading a multi-tiered QA/QC function, including managing subordinate managers and leads. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

- M. Tech / M. E. or MBA in Quality or Operations Management. 
 - Prior experience with ISRO, global space agencies, or leading commercial satellite manufacturers. 
 - Deep knowledge of ECSS-Q product assurance standards and NASA workmanship standards. 
 - Professional certifications: AS9100D Lead Auditor, ASQ CQE / CQM, Six Sigma Black Belt, or IPC Certified Trainer/Specialist. 
 - Direct experience setting up a certified QMS or QA/QC function completely from scratch. 
 - Exposure to clean-room operations and space-qualified EEE parts programmes. 

WHY JOIN US / BENEFITS: 

- Pioneering Impact: Play a pivotal role in shaping India's private space ecosystem, contributing directly to state-of-the-art satellite constellations and orbital missions. 
 - Unmatched Scale: Work at the forefront of indigenous innovation inside India's premier private satellite mass-production facility, bridging high-volume manufacturing with rigorous aerospace engineering. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Collaborate with passionate aerospace visionaries, engineers, and technologists dedicated to democratizing access to space. 
 - Professional Growth: Enjoy executive-level ownership, autonomous decision-making authority, and the opportunity to build and mentor a high-performing engineering culture from the ground up.

data.title: Optical Engineer – Payload Integration & Test
data.description:
About EON Space Labs

EON Space Labs is a Hyderabad-based defence-technology company building indigenous EO/IR optical payloads for space, aerial and ground platforms - from miniaturised telescopes and star trackers for satellites, to EO/IR gimbals for UAVs, to long-range ground surveillance systems. 

Objective

Own the optical bench. You will take our payloads from loose optics to aligned, characterised, flight- and field-ready hardware - setting up the test methods, running them, and writing the procedures that make the results repeatable. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Optical Alignment & Assembly

·            Align and integrate reflective, refractive and catadioptric optical systems (e. g. , Cassegrain / Ritchey-Chrétien telescopes, multi-element VIS and LWIR lenses) to specified wavefront and focus tolerances. 

·            Focus and boresight detectors to optics; set and verify back-focal distance, tilt and decentre; align EO and IR channels to a common line of sight. 

·            Work with mechanical engineers on mounts, shims, adhesives and bonding processes that hold alignment through vibration and temperature change. 

B. Test & Characterisation

·            Measure MTF (slanted-edge, knife-edge or bar targets on a collimator), effective focal length, distortion, field of view, stray light and relative illumination. 

·            For IR cameras: measure NETD, MTF and MRTD using blackbody sources; perform non-uniformity correction (NUC) checks. 

·            Support environmental and qualification testing - thermal cycling, thermal-vacuum, vibration - including pre/post optical performance checks. 

C. Lab Ownership

·            Set up and maintain the optical lab: collimators, autocollimators, interferometer, optical tables, blackbodies, laser sources and measurement instruments. 

·            Maintain cleanroom (ISO-classified area) and ESD discipline, optics handling and cleaning practice, and laser safety per IEC 60825-1. 

·            Automate repetitive measurements and data reduction in Python or MATLAB. 

D. Documentation & Cross-Functional Work

·            Write test procedures, SOPs, test reports and alignment travellers; maintain traceability between design tolerances and measured results. 

·            Feed measured data back to optical design (Zemax OpticStudio / CODE V) to close the loop on tolerancing. 

·            Work with mechanical, electronics, firmware and AI/ML teams; support customer acceptance tests and trials; assist with patent drafting. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education

B. Tech / M. Tech / M. Sc. in Optics, Photonics, Applied Physics, Optoelectronics, or Electronics/Instrumentation with a strong optics specialisation. 

Must-have

·            Hands-on optical alignment and testing on a real optical bench (not only simulation). 

·            Practical use of at least two of: collimator, autocollimator, interferometer, MTF bench, theodolite. 

·            Solid grounding in geometrical and physical optics - aberrations, diffraction limit, MTF, sampling (Nyquist), radiometry basics. 

·            Ability to read and work to optical drawings and tolerances (ISO 10110 or equivalent). 

·            Python or MATLAB for data analysis. 

Good to have

·            Optical design or tolerancing in Zemax OpticStudio, CODE V or similar. 

·            MWIR/LWIR camera testing (NETD, MRTD, blackbody calibration). 

·            Experience with space or defence hardware - cleanroom work, contamination control, thermal-vacuum or vibration testing. 

·            Familiarity with image sensors (CMOS/microbolometer), focusing and boresighting cameras. 

Core Competencies

·            Careful, methodical bench practice - you write down what you did and the result is reproducible. 

·            Comfort with ownership in a small team: you will set up processes, not only follow them. 

·            Clear technical writing. 

Deliverables (first 6 months)

·            Documented, repeatable alignment procedure for at least one EON payload telescope. 

·            Working MTF and wavefront test setups with written SOPs and calibrated reference measurements. 

·            Test reports for payload units delivered to customers during the period. 

What We Offer

·            Work on real flight and field hardware across space, UAV and ground platforms - from bare optics to delivered payload. 

·            Direct exposure to optical design, manufacturing and testing

·            A founding-stage role with visible ownership of the optical lab. 

To Apply

Apply via LinkedIn, or send your CV and a short note on optical systems you have personally aligned or tested to career@eonspacelabs. com with subject line: "Application - Optical Engineer"
