data.title: Engineering Manager, Automation Intelligence
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager, Automation Intelligence based in India. 

Lead the development of an innovative intelligence platform designed to distinguish legitimate AI agents and automated traffic from malicious bots and other online threats. In this role, you will manage a high-impact engineering team responsible for delivering advanced detection capabilities, classification systems, and APIs that help enterprises navigate an increasingly automated internet. You will guide the product from beta through general availability and commercial launch, ensuring exceptional detection accuracy, reliability, and scalability. Combining strategic leadership with strong technical judgment, you will establish quality-driven engineering practices and champion an AI-native development model powered by coding agents and automated reviews. You will also build a high-performing team with the autonomy to innovate, deliver independently, and continuously improve. This fully remote opportunity offers direct collaboration with engineering leadership and the chance to shape both a strategically important product and the future of software engineering practices. 

Accountabilities

- Product Delivery & Launch Readiness: Own the engineering roadmap from beta through general availability and standalone commercial launch, partnering with product management on requirements, estimates, prioritization, delivery sequencing, and launch-readiness criteria. 
 - Service Reliability & Performance: Define and validate the service's operational limits, including throughput, latency, rate limiting, availability targets, and service-level objectives (SLOs), ensuring the platform meets production requirements. 
 - Detection Quality & Accuracy: Establish a continuous detection quality framework using representative test datasets, automated false-positive and false-negative testing, regression suites, and monitoring to maintain and improve detection performance. 
 - Automation Coverage & Classification: Guide detection capabilities for AI agents, assistants, stealth automation, headless browsers, and other emerging frameworks. Evolve classification systems to provide detailed context, confidence levels, identity verification status, and reason codes. 
 - Safe Deployment & Continuous Improvement: Manage staged rollouts of detection updates using feature flags, rollback procedures, and measurable release criteria. Incorporate customer feedback and reported detection errors into prioritized engineering improvements. 
 - Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop a small team of senior engineers, manage recruitment as the team grows, and establish clear ownership, accountability, and opportunities for professional growth. 
 - Engineering Standards & Operational Excellence: Introduce effective engineering practices, including technical specifications, code review standards, repository ownership, and performance benchmarks covering delivery speed, throughput, predictability, failure rates, and recovery time. 
 - Cross-Team Collaboration: Establish effective working agreements with adjacent engineering teams, clarify shared responsibilities, and progressively reduce dependencies that prevent independent development and deployment. 
 - AI-Native Engineering Leadership: Lead an agent-first development workflow in which AI tools support specification, coding, review, and security checks, with appropriate human oversight for critical changes. Maintain and improve the tools, instructions, and review frameworks that enable this approach. 
 - Measurement & Knowledge Sharing: Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-assisted development against established engineering baselines, conduct regular performance reviews, and document lessons learned to inform broader engineering practices. 
 - API Design & Integration Standards: Ensure all product interfaces follow a contract-first approach, with OpenAPI specifications, automated breaking-change detection, generated documentation and SDKs, and APIs that are accessible to both developers and AI agents. 
 - Observability & Executive Communication: Own service observability through logs, metrics, traces, and SLOs. Communicate engineering progress, technical trade-offs, detection quality, and launch readiness clearly to leadership, product partners, and customer-facing teams. 

Requirements

- Engineering Management Experience: At least three years of experience managing software engineers, ideally including senior and staff-level individual contributors, with a proven track record of delivering complete products through launch. 
 - Strong Technical Foundation: At least eight years of software engineering experience before or alongside management. Ability to critically assess technical designs and pull requests, engage in architectural discussions, and make sound technical decisions when trade-offs arise. 
 - Relevant Domain Expertise: Strong experience in at least one of the following areas: bot detection or management, fraud and abuse prevention, web security, browser or client-side engineering, or high-volume API services. Understanding of adversarial environments, where automated threats continually evolve, is particularly valuable. 
 - Quality-Driven Engineering: Experience building or operating measurement-driven engineering processes, including test datasets, precision and recall metrics, false-positive and false-negative tracking, regression testing, monitoring, and service-level objectives. 
 - Hands-On AI Coding Experience: Regular use of AI coding agents and a practical understanding of their strengths, limitations, and appropriate application in software development workflows. 
 - Product & Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with product managers, researchers, and customer-facing teams, making dependencies, priorities, and technical trade-offs explicit. 
 - Communication & Decision-Making: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document decisions and their rationale and explain technical performance, detection quality, and release readiness to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
 - Team Building & Autonomy: Ability to develop high-performing engineering teams, establish clear ownership structures, recruit effectively, and create an environment where experienced engineers can work independently and deliver consistently. 
 - Preferred Bot Detection & Security Experience: Direct experience with bot detection, bot management, anti-automation products, content delivery networks (CDNs), web application firewalls (WAFs), fraud prevention, or security platforms. 
 - Preferred AI Agent Knowledge: Familiarity with AI agent ecosystems, agent frameworks, verified-agent protocols, and how autonomous agents interact with websites and APIs. 
 - Preferred Browser & Automation Expertise: Understanding of browser internals, headless browsers, automation frameworks, and techniques used to detect or evade automated activity. 
 - Preferred API & Platform Experience: Experience operating API-first products with public OpenAPI specifications, software development kits (SDKs), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-facing interfaces. 
 - Preferred Organizational Experience: Experience establishing a new engineering team from an existing organization, separating codebases, defining ownership boundaries, and maintaining productive relationships between teams. 
 - Preferred Business Environment: Background in a high-growth SaaS company serving enterprise customers. 

Benefits

- Fully Remote Work: Join a globally distributed, remote-first organization, subject to country eligibility and local employment requirements. 
 - Strategic Leadership Opportunity: Report directly to the VP of Engineering and lead a strategically important product initiative with clear objectives and significant decision-making autonomy. 
 - Product Ownership & Impact: Guide an emerging product from beta to commercial launch, with dedicated product management support and a clear path to market. 
 - Experienced Engineering Team: Lead an established group of senior engineers, with plans to expand the team and recruit additional specialized talent. 
 - Innovation & Technical Leadership: Help establish an AI-native engineering model, with the opportunity to influence development standards and practices across the wider engineering organization. 
 - Professional Growth: Develop expertise in AI agent detection, online fraud prevention, high-volume services, and advanced engineering management. 
 - Inclusive Work Environment: Join a workplace that values diverse perspectives, professional respect, and equal opportunity. 
 - Important Employment Considerations: The original posting states that certain countries are excluded for regulatory and security reasons and that visa sponsorship is not available. India-based eligibility, compensation, and contractual arrangements should be confirmed during recruitment.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

- May propose changes in design or formulation to improve system and/or process reliability.

Reliability Modeling & Prediction

 - Product Useful Life

System-Level Reliability Analysis

 - Sensors

 - Displays

Product Lifetime & Wear-Out Analysis

 - Electrolytic capacitors
 - Relays
 - Power semiconductors
 - Fans
 - Connectors
 - Batteries
 - Displays
 - Electromechanical parts
 - Apply appropriate models such as Arrhenius, Weibull, Coffin-Manson, thermal acceleration, voltage derating, and duty-cycle-based life models. 
 - Evaluate environmental impact including temperature, humidity, vibration, cycling, load profile, and power-on hours. 
 - Recommend design margins, derating guidelines, and component selection improvements
Field Data Analytics

- Analyze warranty claims, field returns, service records, and customer failure data. 
 - Develop reliability dashboards and reliability KPIs. 
 - Identify dominant failure modes and reliability trends. 
 - Establish failure-rate distributions and reliability growth plans. 
 - Generate actionable recommendations to improve product robustness.

- Define reliability validation plans for new product development and sustaining programs. 
 - Support HALT, HASS, accelerated life testing, temperature cycling, humidity testing, vibration testing, power cycling, and environmental stress testing.

 - Support design verification and product qualification from a reliability perspective

Failure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation

 - Field failures
 - Manufacturing defects
 - Component failures
 - Early-life failures
 - Perform statistical analysis of failures. 
 - Work with hardware, firmware, component engineering, quality, manufacturing, and suppliers to implement corrective actions.

- Utilize reliability prediction software and databases for analysis and reporting. Expertise in Relex, Reliasoft, Minitab, ITEM tool suite
 - Maintain reliability calculation models, assumptions, and documentation. 
 - Develop automated reliability reporting tools and dashboards. 
 - Support design reviews with quantitative reliability assessments

data.title: Business Development Manager
Solution Test Engineer
data.description:
Join our Team

About the Opportunity: 

At Ericsson, we're shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge 5G and cloud-native technologies. We're looking for a Solution Test Engineer to lead end-to-end testing, system integration, automation, and validation of Ericsson Private 5G solutions ( BEWS - Private Networks). In this role, you'll work across 5G Core, RAN, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms, drive quality through automation and CI/CD, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with global teams to deliver world-class telecom solutions. 

What You Will Do

- Test Design & Execution: Design and execute detailed E2E system test plans for Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G) solutions, ensuring full coverage of 3GPP features and customer use cases. 
 - System Integration: Integrate and validate 5G components, including Cloud-Native Core (cn5GC), RAN, and Management/Orchestration platforms, ensuring seamless interoperability. 
 - Advanced Validation: Own the E2E validation for specific feature sets across performance, scaling, and stability, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated regression. 
 - Protocol Debugging: Perform deep-dive troubleshooting of complex call flows using tools like Wireshark/QXDM to analyze NAS/AS signaling and interfaces (N1, N2, N3, etc. ). 
 - Automation Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts within a Python/Robot Framework environment to increase test velocity and reliability. 
 - Stability & Performance Testing: Design and run soak tests, stress tests, and load models to identify memory leaks and system bottlenecks before deployment. 
 - Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, conduct peer reviews of test cases, and contribute to the team's internal knowledge base. 

Skills You Bring

Bachelor's/Master's in CS, EE, or related field with 6-8 years of experience in Telecom/Network testing. 

5G/4G Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of 3GPP architectures and protocols (NGAP, S1AP, RRC, HTTP/2). Ability to analyze multi-interface traces to isolate faults. 

Cloud-Native Skills: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm. Understanding of K8s networking (Services, Load Balancers, and CNI basics) is essential. 

Networking Foundations: Solid knowledge of L2/L3 networking, including IPV4/V6, VLANs, Routing, and familiarity with OSPF/BGP. 

Automation Proficiency: Strong Python scripting skills and experience with Robot Framework (or similar) to automate complex system-level scenarios. 

System Validation Expertise: Proven ability to design test cases for performance (throughput/latency), scaling, and stability (soak/reliability). 

Infrastructure & Tools: Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments. Experience with industry tools such as Spirent (Landslide), Keysight, or Viavi. 

"All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification. "

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to lead the integration backbone that connects systems, data, and business processes across the enterprise?

As Tech Lead for our API & Integration team, you'll drive the technical direction of a critical integration landscape built on the Azure integration stack. You'll shape integration architectures, set engineering standards, and lead by example in code-balancing new integration development with the stabilization and evolution of existing interfaces to ensure reliability, scalability, and security. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys designing clean APIs, building resilient event and message-driven integrations, and guiding teams through complex system landscapes-turning connectivity challenges into robust, well-governed Azure solutions. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

 - Own production readiness (incl. non-functional requirements). 

Quality, Governance & Security

Incident Response

- Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortems. 

Mentorship & Team Growth

- Mentoring team members. 
 - Documenting key design decisions. 
 - Participate in interviews and hiring decisions. 
 - Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement. 

Collaboration & Communication

- Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams. 
 - Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - Minimum of 10+ years of experience in software development, with at least 5 years focused on integration solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of integration patterns and practices. 
 - Experience with microservices and hybrid integration (On‐Prem/Cloud). 
 - Strong proficiency and hands-on experience in Azure Integration Services (including Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Data Factory). 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design, development and lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with programming languages such as C#, PowerShell, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET framework. 
 - Designing integrations with security-by-design principles. 
 - Experience with: Entra ID, Network security (Private Endpoints, VNET integration), Role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Awareness of compliance and data protection requirements (e. g. , GDPR). 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience with BizTalk Server. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft. 
 - Domain experience in large enterprises (finance, manufacturing, engineering). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.description:

Working Days: 5 Days a Week - We Chose Balance Over the Industry Norm

Location: Marol, Mumbai

Job description

About IIDE

IIDE is India's leading digital business school, offering industry-relevant programs in digital marketing, AI, and business. With a strong focus on experiential learning, we equip students, graduates, and working professionals with the skills required to thrive in today's digital-first world. 

Backed by a community of 500, 000+ learners and 250+ industry experts, IIDE delivers hands-on training, real-world projects, and robust placement support. With campuses in Mumbai and Delhi, we continue to expand our presence across India and globally. 

About the Role

As the Team Lead Data Engineering & Analytics at IIDE, Mumbai, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and managing the organisation's data infrastructure, application databases, and business intelligence ecosystem. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role that involves leading a team of data engineers and analysts while actively contributing to database architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, business system integrations, and reporting solutions. 

You will be responsible for establishing a reliable, centralised source of truth across the organisation, ensuring data accuracy, scalability, and accessibility. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will translate business requirements into robust technical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making and operational efficiency. 

You will also explore opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics to enhance business intelligence and automation. 

What You'll Do

- Database Architecture & Application Development: Design and develop scalable relational database architectures and schemas from scratch for business applications, including LMS, CRM, ERP, and student management systems. 

Define database entities, relationships, constraints, indexing strategies, and data models using PostgreSQL. 

Ensure transactional integrity, data consistency, security, and optimal performance across application databases. 

Collaborate with backend development teams to align database structures with application logic, APIs, and evolving business requirements. 

Plan and execute database migrations, schema versioning, performance optimisation, and scalability improvements. 

- Data Engineering & System Integration: Design, develop, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate data from CRM, websites, LMS, marketing platforms, and other business systems. 

Build automated data ingestion, transformation, and processing workflows using SQL, APIs, Python, and relevant integration tools. 

Implement incremental data loading, data validation, deduplication, error handling, retry mechanisms, and pipeline monitoring. 

Establish a centralised analytical data architecture with standardised data definitions and reliable historical records. 

Optimise data pipeline performance, processing efficiency, system reliability, and infrastructure costs. 

- Reporting & Business Intelligence: Consolidate existing reporting systems and establish standardised business metrics across departments. 

Develop reliable reporting datasets, analytical data models, and dashboards using BI platforms such as Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau. 

Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into accurate, actionable, and scalable reporting solutions. 

Identify and resolve reporting discrepancies, eliminate manual reporting processes, and improve data accessibility. 

Enable leadership and business teams to make informed decisions using consistent, trustworthy, and timely data. 

- Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead, mentor, and guide data engineers and analysts while ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and timely project delivery. 

Conduct technical reviews of SQL queries, database designs, data pipelines, and engineering implementations. 

Establish development standards, documentation practices, quality assurance processes, and technical best practices. 

Collaborate with technology, marketing, sales, finance, and academic teams to understand requirements and prioritise data initiatives. 

Remain actively involved in complex technical implementations, troubleshooting, and solution design while managing team responsibilities. 

- AI & Advanced Analytics: Identify opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve business operations. 

Contribute to AI-enabled data solutions, automated insights, and intelligent reporting systems. 

Support predictive analytics initiatives, including lead conversion prediction, forecasting, customer segmentation, and trend analysis. 

Evaluate and implement relevant AI-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency and business decision-making. 

- Additional Duties: Establish and maintain a reliable, centralised data platform that supports seamless integration across business applications. 

Continuously improve data accuracy, database performance, reporting efficiency, and overall system reliability. 

Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual dependencies and enhance data engineering productivity. 

Ensure the team delivers maintainable, scalable, well-documented technical solutions aligned with organisational objectives. 

Perform any other reasonable duties as requested by management, aligned with the broad scope of the position. 

RequirementsWho You Are

- Must-Have: 4 - 8 years of relevant experience in data engineering, database development, analytics engineering, or related technical roles. 

Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and PostgreSQL, including query optimisation and database performance management. 

Proven experience designing relational database architectures for production applications, including ER modelling, normalisation, constraints, indexing, and transaction management. 

Strong understanding of OLTP databases, data integrity, transactional consistency, and backend application integration. 

Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating multiple data sources. 

Proficiency in data modelling, data warehousing concepts, data transformation, and data quality management. 

Experience developing reporting datasets, consolidating business information, and standardising organisational metrics. 

Previous experience leading or mentoring data engineers, analysts, or other technical team members. 

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and the capability to independently own complex technical implementations. 

Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders while translating business requirements into scalable data solutions. 

- Should Have: Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, scripting, and pipeline development. 

Experience working with cloud-based data warehouse platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Amazon Redshift. 

Familiarity with data orchestration and transformation tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, or Dagster. 

Experience developing dashboards and business intelligence solutions using Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau. 

Working knowledge of REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, database deployments, and system integration practices. 

Experience implementing automated data validation, monitoring, and performance optimisation processes. 

- Nice to Have: Exposure to AI/ML initiatives, LLM integrations, predictive modelling, or business forecasting solutions. 

Familiarity with Spring Boot, Java, or other backend application development frameworks. 

Experience supporting predictive analytics use cases such as lead scoring, customer segmentation, or conversion forecasting. 

Relevant certifications or professional training in cloud platforms, database engineering, data analytics, or AI/ML technologies. 

Prior experience working with education technology platforms, LMS, CRM, ERP, or student management systems. 

BenefitsWhy Join IIDE?

- Work with one of India's fastest-growing digital education brands. 
 - Gain exposure to end-to-end data engineering, database architecture, and business intelligence initiatives. 
 - Take ownership of building and scaling the organisation's data infrastructure and centralised analytics ecosystem. 
 - Lead a technically driven team while remaining hands-on with architecture, engineering, and implementation. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute directly to business-critical decisions and technology initiatives. 
 - Explore opportunities to implement AI-enabled solutions, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation. 
 - Work in a collaborative, high-growth environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Enjoy a five-day workweek that supports work-life balance and sustainable professional growth. 

Who You'll Thrive As

You're someone who: 

- Is a hands-on technical leader who enjoys designing and building scalable data solutions as much as guiding a team. 
 - Has a strong foundation in SQL, PostgreSQL, database architecture, and data engineering, with a passion for solving complex technical challenges. 
 - Thinks beyond individual reports and pipelines, focusing on building reliable, integrated, and future-ready data ecosystems. 
 - Takes complete ownership of technical initiatives, from understanding business requirements to architecture, implementation, and ongoing optimisation. 
 - Is passionate about data accuracy, consistency, automation, and establishing a single source of truth across the organisation. 
 - Can translate complex business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions that create measurable impact. 
 - Enjoys mentoring team members, establishing engineering best practices, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Communicates effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and understands how technology supports broader business objectives. 
 - Is curious about emerging technologies, AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics, and actively explores opportunities to apply them.

data.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra's transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Clinical Governance & Quality Assurance
 - Framework Implementation: Lead the implementation and ongoing adherence to Lyra's global clinical governance framework and quality standards within the Indian context. 
 - Policy Development: Develop, review, and update local clinical policies and protocols to ensure full compliance with Indian mental health regulations (e. g. , Mental Healthcare Act 2017), ethical guidelines, and best practices. 
 - Quality Oversight: Design and oversee robust quality assurance activities, including systematic clinical audits, in-depth case reviews, and continuous outcome monitoring (CORE-10/Work Impact). 
 - Incident Management: Lead investigations into serious clinical incidents and formal complaints, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure corrective actions and systemic learning. 
 - Senior Escalation: Act as the final clinical escalation point for complex queries, ethical dilemmas, and high-risk situations, providing expert guidance and resolution. 
 - Clinical Delivery Oversight & Team Management

 - Fidelity & Pathways: Ensure consistent application of Lyra's clinical pathways, standardized assessment tools, and evidence-based intervention protocols across all delivery teams. 
 - Capacity Planning: Contribute to strategic planning regarding clinical team capacity and resource allocation to align with service demand and operational efficiency. 
 - Professional Development: Oversee onboarding and continuous professional development programs, focusing on clinical fidelity and the sophisticated use of Lyra's methodologies. 
 - Mentorship: Foster a high-performance environment by providing direct mentorship and supervision to Clinical Team Leaders. 
 - Case Management Excellence
 - Clinical Integrity: Maintain overall responsibility for the clinical integrity and effectiveness of the case management function. 
 - Data-Driven Optimization: Analyze aggregate case management data and trends to identify areas for process refinement and improved client outcomes. 
 - High-Acuity Consultation: Provide direct clinical guidance on high-acuity or highly sensitive cases requiring senior-level review and intervention. 
 - Care Coordination: Ensure rigorous adherence to best practices in care coordination, inter-provider collaboration, and referral pathways across the service spectrum. 
 - Interdepartmental Collaboration & Strategic Input
 - Network Partnership: Partner with the Network Operations Manager to ensure the provider network aligns with Lyra's standards, providing clinical input on recruitment criteria and performance expectations. 
 - Strategic Advisory: Provide essential clinical expertise to Product Development, Commercial, and Client Success teams to inform service evolution and market strategy. 
 - Thought Leadership: Represent Lyra's clinical approach and quality standards in external forums, conferences, and industry discussions. 

Requirements And Qualifications

- Master's degree in a clinical field (e. g. , Clinical Psychology, Counseling, Social Work). 
 - Optional: Valid and current professional registration/licensure to practice independently in India (e. g. , RCI registration for Clinical Psychologists or equivalent recognized national bodies). 

Experience

- Several years of extensive post-qualification clinical experience in mental health, including direct assessment, diagnosis, and evidence-based interventions. 
 - Several years of progressive experience in a clinical leadership, supervisory, or programmatic oversight role within India. 
 - Deep understanding of the Indian mental healthcare landscape and regulatory compliance. 
 - Fluency in English and Hindi is essential; knowledge of other major regional languages is a significant advantage. 

About You

- Clinical Acumen: Exceptional clinical understanding and the advanced ability to identify, assess, and manage high-level clinical risk and complex psychological presentations. 
 - Problem Solver: Highly analytical with superior problem-solving skills, capable of navigating intricate clinical and operational challenges independently. 
 - Autonomous & Accountable: Able to work independently without close supervision, while ensuring all key issues are escalated appropriately and critical decisions are clinically sound. 
 - Detail-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy of data, maintaining strict confidentiality, and adhering to complex clinical procedures. 
 - Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex clinical concepts clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders internationally. 
 - Proactive & Adaptive: Strong continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to innovate and refine clinical processes. Flexible, adaptable, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Organized: Highly organized with exceptional ability to plan, prioritize, and manage a high-volume, complex clinical function effectively. 
 - Collaborative: A strong team player who readily accepts change and collaborates effectively with internal and external partners. 

Miscellaneous

- Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra's core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy. 
 - Task Ownership: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs). 
 - Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and care outcomes. 
 - Workshop & Content: Lead the delivery of onsite or online workshops and contribute to the development of training manuals and affiliate-facing materials. 
 - Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events and webinars to promote Lyra's transformative care model and clinical research.

data.title: Senior Technical Specialist
data.description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOneTM platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions. 

We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions. 

In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions. 

What will you do in this role?

- Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis
 - Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions. 
 - Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations. 
 - Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows. 
 - Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations. 
 - System Configuration and Customization
 - Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOneTM platform. 
 - Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements. 
 - Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices. 
 - Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization. 
 - SQL Development and Database Management
 - Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic. 
 - Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting. 
 - Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). 
 - Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval. 
 - Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects. 
 - Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
 - Design and develop interactive forms and data-driven document generation solutions. 
 - Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production. 
 - Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools. 
 - Technical Subject Matter Expert & Implementation Support
 - Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects. 
 - Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions. 
 - Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership. 
 - Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions. 
 - Quality Assurance & Testing
 - Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work. 
 - Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery. 
 - Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements. 
 - Documentation & Knowledge Management
 - Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards. 
 - Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements. 
 - Facilitate end-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions. 

What do you need to succeed in this role?

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field. 
 - 7+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting. 
 - Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain. 
 - Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems. 
 - Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations. 
 - Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models. 
 - Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools. 
 - Experience with configuration and customization. 
 - Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Experience supporting data integrations or API-based systems. 
 - Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems. 
 - Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations. 
 - AINS Certifications or other insurance industry certifications. 
 - CBAP (Certified Business Analyst Professional) or similar business analysis certification. 
 - Web Services/APIs and ACORD standards experience. 

We offer: 

- Family Health Insurance including parents
 - Life & Accident Insurance
 - Maternity/paternity leave
 - Performance-based incentives
 - Referral Bonus program
 - Exam Fee Reimbursement Policy
 - Indian festival holidays
 - 5 days working week

Requisition Id: 1753738

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and 'It's yours to build' which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self. 

The opportunity : Senior Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - RISK - DIGITAL RISK - Bangalore

TMT : 

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now. 

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future - building a better working world for all. 

CNS - RISK - DIGITAL RISK : 

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. 

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are : 

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses. 

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management. 

Your Key Responsibilities

data.description:
About Peak3

Peak3 is an award-winning vertical SaaS provider, enabling more relevant, convenient, and affordable insurance protection for everyone through our technology and ingenuity. Together with our clients, we create a more resilient and innovative future. 

We combine insurance core, distribution, and AI solutions to deliver a step change in performance for insurers, MGAs, and insurance intermediaries. From greenfield embedded insurance ventures to multi-country core modernization programs, our SaaS solutions power top customers across life, health, and P&C insurance. 

Our 500+ colleagues are based across over 15 countries in Europe, Asia and the Middle East - with an ambitious roadmap to scale further. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior System Architect to design and evolve scalable, secure and maintainable systems for our insurance clients, with a focus on the Indian market. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, engineering teams and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions across insurance platforms, applications and integrations. 

Insurance domain experience is not mandatory, but experience in Life Insurance is a strong advantage. 

Role and Responsibilities

- Define system and solution architecture for complex enterprise applications and platforms. 
 - Translate business and functional requirements into scalable technical solutions and architecture designs. 
 - Design APIs, integrations, data flows and system interfaces across internal and external platforms. 
 - Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and review solution and technical designs. 
 - Ensure solutions meet security, performance, scalability, availability and maintainability requirements. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies and architectural gaps, and drive appropriate solutions. 
 - Support system modernisation, migration and platform transformation initiatives. 
 - Contribute to technical discovery, RFI/RFP responses and client workshops. 

What You Bring

- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, system design or solution architecture. 
 - Strong experience designing enterprise-scale, distributed and highly integrated systems. 
 - Solid understanding of architecture patterns, APIs, microservices, databases, messaging and system integration. 
 - Experience with modern cloud platforms and cloud-native architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of security, scalability, performance, resilience and observability. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving and technical communication skills. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience working with Agile, DevOps and distributed engineering teams, as well as latest AI tooling/AI-DLC. 

Nice to Have

- Understanding of Policy Administration, Underwriting, Claims, Billing, Product Configuration or Policy Servicing systems. 
 - Experience with insurance platform integrations, including CRM, payments, distribution, actuarial or finance systems. 
 - Experience with Life Insurance platforms such as TCS BaNCS, ALIP, LifePRO, INSIS, FAST or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with IRDAI requirements and Indian insurance processes.

Job Title: Assistant Manager- Java Back End

Department: RISK IT

About Business line/Function: The mission of RISK function is to provide Senior Management of the Group and of the Operating Divisions with full transparency and dynamic analysis of the risks and clients managed by the various operating divisions: Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB), Retail Banking, Investment & Protection Services (IPS). 

Position Purpose: We are looking for a candidate with an excellent level of experience on Java and enthusiastic to develop distributed applications with a focus on high throughput and high performance. 

The role is for a position within the Risk Systems - Counterparty Measures tribe in Mumbai. The tribe is split into multidisciplinary squads implementing Scrum inside an agile at scale methodology. It works on three-month Program Increments and two-week sprints, following all the ceremonies typical of Scrum and Agile at Scale. 

The team has as well completed the re-engineering of the counterparty risk system into a highly distributed architecture using a technology stack composed of big data solutions, data grids, compute grids, REST based architectures and a pricing and simulation engine that uses Graphics Processing Units. The team also uses development practices such as Continuous Delivery to reduce time taken from development to delivery into production. 

The successful candidate will work in a fast paced, agile environment in a multi-disciplinary team. The role is technical with elements of programming and design. It is primarily focused on the Java side of the counterparty risk calculation system. The developer will be working on implementing requirements coming from different sources: Technical, Regulatory and Business

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

Design and development

- Help to clarify and qualify needs
 - Help to carry out studies before project launch
 - Help to design software solutions
 - Develop software that meets development and security standards, while incorporating data and security objectives
 - Help to optimise existing code and improve its maintainability
 - Help to integrate software packages and in the definition of settings
 - Enforce agile development practices such as automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery. 
 - Review code and ensure that it is compliant with the principles and practices of the development teams while ensuring that the needs of the quantitative developers are met. 
 - Hands on development of any tools/framework changes to meet requirements. 

Testing, acceptance and release

- Implement and/or create a test strategy
 - Install the product deployment tools in the different environments
 - Upgrade and/or help to upgrade the documentation

Contributing Responsibilities

- Help in implementing improvements to their activity and maintaining technical know-how
 - Participate in internal and external developer networks to communicate and share best practices
 - Engage in continuous training in new information technologies

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

Computing Skills

- Excellent software design, coding, documentation and analysis skills. 
 - Excellent Java knowledge including hands on experience with Spring, REST and multithreading. 
 - Excellent computer science fundamentals. 
 - Knowledge of distributed Systems and technologies (e. g. Oracle Coherence, Apache Cassandra, Spectrum Symphony, Kafka, Tomcat, etc. ). 
 - Experience on testing, from Unit Testing to Acceptance Testing. 
 - Experience on Continuous Integration and Delivery techniques and tooling. 
 - An appreciation of distributed systems programming patterns. 
 - An appreciation of parallelisation techniques

Behavioural Skills

- Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
 - Creativity & Innovation / Problem Solving
 - Adaptability
 - Ability to Deliver / Results Driven

Transversal Skills

- Analytical Ability
 - Ability to develop and leverage networks

Tools - Methodologies

- AI-assisted Development
 - Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Claude Code
 - IT Programs Conception
 - Testing
 - Agile methodologies

Specific Qualifications

6 to 10 Years of Hands-on Experience

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

- 
 - Java - Core, Multithreading, Collection framework, JDBC
 - Knowledge of distributed systems programming patterns & parallelisation techniques
 - Spring Framework, REST APIs

 - Software design patterns 
 - CI/CD, Testing (Junit & System Testing), Kafka, Tomcat 
 - Development Tools (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Claude Code) 
 - AI Assisted development 
 - Agile methodologies
Behavioral Skills

- 
 - Ability to Collaborate / Teamwork
 - Analytical Ability
 - Strong Communication
 - Results Driven
Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. 

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. - Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers

NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products.

 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

data.title: Senior Software Engineer — AI Evaluation & Benchmarks
data.description:
About The Role

What if the code you write could determine how smart the next generation of AI truly is? We're looking for experienced Software Engineers to design and build the coding benchmarks and data pipelines used to evaluate frontier AI models - the systems that decide whether an AI can actually reason, debug, and write production-quality software. 

This is high-impact, technically demanding work at the intersection of software engineering and AI research. You'll work with large codebases, multiple programming languages, and scalable infrastructure to create evaluation systems that push the boundaries of what AI can do. 

This is a fully remote contract role. If you thrive in fast-paced engineering environments and want your work to directly shape the trajectory of AI - this is the role. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Contract Length: 3 Months
 - Commitment: Full-time availability preferred

What You'll Do

- Design and implement coding benchmarks used to evaluate frontier AI models across real-world programming tasks
 - Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for AI evaluation workflows
 - Analyze AI-generated code for correctness, reliability, and edge-case failures
 - Create structured evaluation scenarios that rigorously test reasoning, debugging, and code quality
 - Work with large code repositories and multi-language environments
 - Collaborate on systems that improve how AI models understand and generate software
 - Provide detailed technical feedback on model performance and failure patterns
 - Contribute to the design of evaluation frameworks that set industry standards

Who You Are

- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience - this is non-negotiable
 - Experience working at a high-growth tech company or top-tier software organization
 - Expert proficiency in Python - you write clean, performant, well-tested Python code
 - Hands-on experience with code repositories and working in large, complex codebases
 - Proven experience designing and implementing LLM coding benchmarks and data pipelines
 - Track record of working in high-performance engineering environments with large-scale products or platforms
 - Strong command of version control systems (Git) and modern development workflows
 - Bilingual or native English speaker with strong written communication skills
 - Self-directed, technically rigorous, and comfortable operating with autonomy

What Makes a Perfect Match

Candidates with these additional qualifications have the highest chance of success: 

- Senior or Lead-level engineering profiles with a history of technical ownership
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience
 - Proficiency in one or more additional languages: JavaScript, Go, C++, or other relevant languages
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and writing robust unit tests (pytest, Mocha, JUnit)
 - Background in security engineering or significant open-source contributions
 - Familiarity with AI/ML evaluation methodologies or model benchmarking

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI evaluation projects alongside world-class research teams
 - Fully remote - work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection
 - Your benchmarks directly influence how the most advanced AI systems in the world are measured and improved
 - Freelance autonomy with meaningful, high-stakes engineering work
 - Collaborate with a global community of elite engineers and researchers
 - Potential for contract extension and ongoing engagement as new evaluation challenges emerge

data.title: Senior Engineering Operations Manager
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering Operations Manager based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on professional to lead the evolution of product development processes within a global, remote-first technology environment. In this role, you will own the end-to-end Product Development Process (PDP), ensuring strong alignment between product strategy, engineering execution, and business priorities. You will also design, build, and maintain automated workflows using an enterprise orchestration platform to improve operational efficiency and streamline product delivery. By applying practical experience with AI agents and agentic workflows, you will help transform how product teams collaborate and execute their work. This role combines engineering expertise, process design, and product thinking to drive measurable improvements across multiple teams. It offers an opportunity to influence organizational practices and contribute directly to an AI-first approach to software development. 

Accountabilities

- Own and continuously improve the end-to-end Product Development Process across Core and Experience product tracks, including process design, workflow stages, board management, and epic definitions and tracking. 
 - Align product development processes with product strategy, ensuring clear connections between strategic objectives, initiatives, and engineering epics. 
 - Establish consistent working practices across product divisions, fostering alignment and trust among Product, Engineering, and leadership teams. 
 - Build, maintain, and operate process automation using Camunda 8, ensuring a reliable and scalable foundation for both product development tracks. 
 - Manage the automation lifecycle, including source control, testing, test environments, monitoring, integration maintenance, and ongoing improvements. 
 - Design and implement agentic workflows that use the organization's own orchestration platform to support internal product development activities. 
 - Apply lessons learned from internal workflow implementations to identify opportunities for product improvements and share actionable feedback with product teams. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally to improve engineering operations, simplify workflows, and increase the effectiveness of product development. 
 - Combine hands-on technical execution with strategic process ownership, ensuring that solutions are practical, user-focused, maintainable, and aligned with organizational objectives. 

Requirements

- Demonstrated experience combining product thinking, process design, and technical implementation, with the ability to assess workflow usability and build effective solutions directly. 
 - Hands-on engineering experience, including writing code and scripts, working with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and debugging integrations. 
 - Proven experience designing, owning, and improving product or engineering processes within a software organization of 100 or more engineers. 
 - Practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows that perform meaningful tasks in real-world environments, beyond experimentation or proof-of-concept projects. 
 - Strong understanding of product development workflows, operational processes, and the relationship between product strategy and engineering execution. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, and leadership teams toward shared processes and objectives. 
 - A proactive, hands-on mindset, with strong problem-solving abilities, ownership, and the capacity to balance strategic thinking with implementation details. 
 - Willingness and ability to use the organization's own orchestration platform to design and implement workflows and improve internal operations. 
 - Familiarity with BPMN, Camunda, or other workflow automation engines is an advantage. 
 - Previous experience in product operations, developer experience, or platform engineering is considered a plus. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation: Location-based salary packages designed to reflect local market conditions. Compensation is determined by experience, skills, and location. For India-based employees, personalized total rewards information is provided during the recruitment process. 
 - Equity opportunities: Access to a Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP), where applicable. 
 - Fully remote work: Work from anywhere, with flexibility to create a productive working environment. 
 - Home office support: Budget for home office equipment and support for coworking spaces. 
 - Flexible time off: Time away from work to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

data.title: DEVELOPER L4
data.description:
Job description: 

Job Description Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏ Do

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

- Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
 - Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
 - Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
 - Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
 - Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
 - Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
 - Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities͏ 2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

- Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
 - Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
 - Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces. 
 - Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
 - Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
 - Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
 - Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
 - Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
 - Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
 - Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders͏ 3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

- Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
 - Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
 - Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members. 
 - Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
 - Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
 - Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation 
 - Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w. r. t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
 - Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally͏ Deliver

MIS & Reporting100% on time MIS & report generation

.
