Engineering Operations Lead
data.description:
Engineering Operations Lead

Location: Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) | Team: Engineering | Reporting to: CTO

OVERVIEW

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome. 

We're backed by MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. 

We're looking for an Engineering Operations Lead to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers. 

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working. 

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO. 

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations

- Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem: take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance. 
 - Standardise engineering workflows: establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs. 
 - Build automation and integrations: connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency. 
 - Maintain secure, reliable platforms: oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment. 
 - Drive platform adoption and improvement: troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities. 

Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office

- Strengthen delivery governance: establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams. 
 - Improve engineering performance visibility: develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends. 
 - Support release readiness: coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment. 
 - Drive cross-functional delivery: track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution. 
 - Improve incident and problem management: strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions. 
 - Partner with the CTO: translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart. 
 - Champion delivery effectiveness: identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution. 

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Build intelligent automation: develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development. 
 - Develop practical AI solutions: explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness. 
 - Improve technology knowledge management: strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms. 
 - Connect and optimise our technology stack: reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems. 
 - Champion responsible innovation: evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value. 

ABOUT YOU

- Strong experience in technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role within a software engineering environment. 
 - Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving Jira, including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations. 
 - Good understanding of Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance. 
 - Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with engineering performance metrics, including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability. 
 - Practical experience with AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting to build solutions and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Comfortable working with Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations. 
 - Confident partnering with CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders, constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements. 
 - A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams. 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working within a CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management function. 
 - Atlassian certifications or experience with Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo. 
 - Experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools. 
 - Experience developing AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows. 
 - Experience with engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management. 
 - Experience in a FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment, ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001. 

HOW WE HIRE

Three conversations: 

- a talent screen, 
 - a conversation with the hiring manager, and
 - a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion. 

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems. 

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions. 

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation: that recognises your skills, experience and impact. 
 - Generous time off: annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work. 
 - Work From Anywhere: up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance: for you and your loved ones. 
 - Personal accident insurance: for when it's needed most. 
 - Enhanced family leave: enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies. 
 - Learning & growth: opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX. 

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers. We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2. 

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. 

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

People Management

Safety, Health & Environment (EHS)

Continuous Improvement

data.title: CPU Verification Infrastructure Tools Architect
data.description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team. 

What You Will Be Doing

- The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon. 
 - You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features. 
 - The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team. 
 - You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 5+ years of experience
 - Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python. 
 - Understanding of SOC and System Architecture. 
 - Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function. 
 - Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i. e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC. 
 - A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software. 
 - Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle. 

Way To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks. 
 - Exposure to Testbench architectures (C++ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches). 
 - Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus. 

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team. 

What You Will Be Doing

- The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon. 
 - You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features. 
 - The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team. 
 - You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 5+ years of experience
 - Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python. 
 - Understanding of SOC and System Architecture. 
 - Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function. 
 - Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i. e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC. 
 - A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software. 
 - Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle. 

Way To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks. 
 - Exposure to Testbench architectures (C++ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches). 
 - Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

Role Title: AVP - Cloud Database Automation Engineer

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Our Platform Engineering organization comprises of Database experts and automation engineers who focus on enabling strategies to enhance customer and partner experience and optimize business performance through database platform development and management cutting edge automation technologies such as Terraform, Jenkins and Ansible.

Cloud Database Automation Engineer role will be responsible for projects to design, enhance or add new functionality to Synchrony Data platforms (Databases), as well as all operational support activities. - Implement infrastructure as code for various database platforms

 - Implement Database automation in AWS from build to day-to-day support. 

Required Skills & Knowledge

- Experience working on or leading teams performing systems automation and integration (ideally leveraging an agile methodology / lean techniques)
 - Competence in using scripting + programming languages to automate frequently executed activities
 - 3+ years Public Cloud (AWS RDS) experience to instant and configure up databases for mission critical, highly available and high throughput application
 - 3+ years Expert knowledge of Linux / Unix / Windows systems
 - 5+ years' experience as a Senior DBA or Database automation Engineer; Expertise in designing/configuring mission critical, highly available and high throughput Databases
 - Experience with production systems and dealing with production issues
 - A clear understanding of cloud service and deployment model

Desired Skills & Knowledge

- Database experience with RDS, PostgreSQL, Cassandra. MySQL, Oracle, DynamoDB or DocumentDB
 - Experience in streaming service such as Kinesis
 - Scripting Proficiency in Terraform, Python and Shell
 - Experience in migrating Database from on-prem to public cloud
 - Responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining automation tools to reduce time and complexity of operations and development tasks
 - Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve escalated production issues
 - Establish and consult on best practices and standard operating procedures for development, deployment, support, break-fix, and systems management
 - Deploy and support automation systems and tooling in a 24x7 production environment

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 8+ years of experience performing systems automation (ideally leveraging an agile methodology) on Database platforms. Deep expertise in at least one database technology. 

Work Timings

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details. We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs - Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Test Strategy & Implementation

Non-Functional Testing

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

data.description:
About dunnhumby

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3, 000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers. 

Tesco Media

Tesco Media is the ultimate media partner to brands. Built on unrivalled customer insight, it's a media owner with soul, scale, and storytelling power. Tesco Media helps brands and agencies connect meaningfully with customers, drive creative effectiveness, and grow at the point of purchase. 

About the Role

We are looking for an Technical Architect to join our engineering organization and help shape the future of our SaaS platform. Our platform powers retail media solutions for global retailers and CPGs, enabling end-to-end advertisement campaigns across e-commerce sites, in-store channels, and social media platforms. 

This role is pivotal in defining architectural guardrails, frameworks, and patterns that enable multiple squads to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure solutions. You will combine hands-on technical depth with the ability to influence and align engineering managers, lead engineers, and product leaders. This is not an ivory-tower role - you will actively partner with teams, ensuring architecture decisions are practical, business-aligned, and execution ready. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Architectural Leadership: Define and evolve application architecture in line with business and product strategy for a global retail media SaaS platform. 
 - Set Guardrails: Establish repeatable patterns for microservices, APIs, identity/auth, observability, and data flows. 
 - NFR Ownership: Ensure non-functional requirements (scalability, reliability, resiliency, observability, security, maintainability) are embedded into design decision. 
 - Cross-Squad Influence: Collaborate with multiple squads (frontend, backend, BFF, platform services) to align on architectural choices. 
 - Tech Evaluations: Lead structured assessments of new tools and frameworks (e. g. , OPA, SpiceDB, caching, API gateways) and guide adoption. 
 - Decision Frameworks: Move teams away from ad-hoc debates by creating clear frameworks for architectural decision-making. 
 - Mentorship: Partner with engineering managers and lead engineers to strengthen design-level thinking and technical maturity. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong hands-on expertise across modern application architecture
 - . NET Core, C#, REST APIs, microservices. 
 - Event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar). 
 - Databases (Postgres, SQL Server, caching strategies with Redis or Couchbase). 
 - Identity & authorization frameworks (Auth0, OPA, SpiceDB, OpenFGA). 
 - Observability platforms (New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana). 
 - Cloud-native experience (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable). 
 - An understanding of AI-enabled application patterns and workflow orchestration frameworks. 
 - Awareness of emerging AI and agentic workflow technologies and their application across retail media, advertising, analytics, and SaaS platforms, with the ability to assess their architectural implications and business value
 - Strong track record of embedding NFRs into platform and product design. 
 - Excellent communicators can simplify trade-offs for both engineers and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience influencing without authority and driving closure across multiple teams. 
You'll Thrive If You. . . 

- Enjoy solving complex technical and organisational challenges. 
 - Can balance long-term architectural vision with practical delivery needs. 
 - Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, and business teams. 
 - Take ownership and drive continual improvement in technology standards and practices. 

India Benefits

- Comprehensive medical insurance of INR 500, 000 covering employees and eligible dependents, with dental and vision benefits included. 
 - Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover, with coverage levels linked to employee grade. 
 - Retirement benefits including Provident Fund, Gratuity, and voluntary National Pension Scheme (NPS). 
 - Employee Assistance Programme, Indian Health Organisation (IHO) membership, and wellbeing resources through the Wellness Hub. 
 - Internet allowance, office commute support, work-from-home kit, subsidised meals, and Early Friday each month. 
 - 25 days annual leave plus 10 public holidays, birthday leave, maternity, paternity and adoption leave provisions. 

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work. We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process. data.title: General Manager – Plant Operations (PVC & WPC Extrusion)
data.description:
General Manager - Plant Operations

Wallikon Industries Private Limited

Location: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh

Website: wallikon. com

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Department: Manufacturing / Plant Operations

Experience: 12-18 years

Salary: ₹10, 00, 000-₹15, 00, 000 per annum (negotiable for the right candidate)

About Wallikon Industries Private Limited

Wallikon Industries Private Limited is a manufacturer of PVC wall panels, ceiling panels, WPC louvers, fluted panels, and related interior building products. 

We are looking for an experienced General Manager - Plant Operations to take complete responsibility for the day-to-day management and performance of our manufacturing facility in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. 

Our plant operates 25 production lines across two shifts, with approximately 250 employees. 

We require a highly capable manufacturing professional who can independently manage the factory, establish effective management systems, improve productivity, control costs, and ensure smooth operations without requiring daily intervention from the company directors. 

Job Purpose

The General Manager will be responsible for the overall functioning of the manufacturing plant, including production, maintenance, quality, manpower, inventory, safety, and operational cost control. 

The successful candidate must be capable of managing a large workforce, leading departmental managers, establishing standard operating procedures, and creating a disciplined, performance-driven manufacturing environment. 

The primary objective is to ensure that the factory operates efficiently and independently under professional management. 

Key Responsibilities1. Overall Plant Management

- Take complete ownership of daily factory operations. 
 - Manage 25 production lines operating across two shifts. 
 - Establish clear reporting structures, responsibilities, and accountability. 
 - Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all departments. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted production and effective coordination between departments. 
 - Resolve operational issues independently and escalate only major matters to company directors. 2. Production Planning and Control

- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production plans. 
 - Monitor line-wise production targets and actual output. 
 - Improve machine utilisation, labour productivity, and overall operational efficiency. 
 - Minimise production downtime, bottlenecks, and material wastage. 
 - Coordinate production planning with sales forecasts, raw-material availability, and dispatch schedules. 
 - Ensure timely completion of production orders. 3. Manpower and Workforce Management

- Manage approximately 250 employees across two shifts. 
 - Lead production managers, shift in-charges, supervisors, operators, technicians, and support staff. 
 - Establish clear duties and performance targets for all employees. 
 - Manage shift allocation, attendance, overtime, discipline, and workforce productivity. 
 - Train and develop supervisors and departmental managers. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement. 4. Maintenance and Equipment Management

- Implement preventive and predictive maintenance programmes. 
 - Reduce machine breakdowns and unplanned downtime. 
 - Coordinate mechanical, electrical, and utility maintenance. 
 - Maintain maintenance schedules, breakdown histories, and spare-parts inventories. 
 - Ensure proper functioning of extrusion lines, hot and cold mixers, vacuum systems, cooling systems, motors, and associated equipment. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis of recurring breakdowns. 5. Quality Control

- Maintain consistent quality across all production lines and shifts. 
 - Monitor product dimensions, thickness, weight, colour, surface finish, and other applicable specifications. 
 - Reduce rejection, rework, and customer complaints. 
 - Establish quality inspection procedures and batch traceability. 
 - Coordinate corrective actions with production teams. 6. Raw Materials and Inventory Control

- Control raw-material consumption against approved production standards. 
 - Monitor wastage, scrap, and material variances. 
 - Coordinate with procurement and stores to ensure uninterrupted material availability. 
 - Maintain accurate records of raw materials, finished goods, consumables, and spare parts. 
 - Prevent inventory discrepancies and unauthorised material usage. 7. Cost Control and Productivity Improvement

- Monitor manufacturing costs, energy consumption, labour productivity, and material utilisation. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and profitability. 
 - Establish measurable cost-reduction initiatives. 
 - Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and take corrective action when targets are missed. 8. Safety and Compliance

- Ensure compliance with applicable factory, labour, environmental, and industrial safety requirements. 
 - Maintain safe working practices and machine-safety procedures. 
 - Conduct regular safety inspections and employee training. 
 - Ensure proper documentation and coordination for applicable statutory requirements. 9. Reporting and Management Systems

- Implement daily production reporting and weekly and monthly performance reviews. 
 - Monitor production, downtime, quality, inventory, manpower, and maintenance KPIs. 
 - Use Excel, ERP, or manufacturing information systems to improve operational visibility. 
 - Provide accurate reports to company directors. 
 - Develop systems that allow management to monitor factory performance remotely. Required Qualifications and Experience

- Diploma or bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Plastics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 12-18 years of experience in manufacturing operations. 
 - At least 5 years in a senior plant management or factory operations leadership position. 
 - Proven experience managing a workforce of approximately 200-400 employees. 
 - Experience managing multiple production lines and two-shift operations. 
 - Strong knowledge of production planning, maintenance, quality management, inventory control, and cost optimisation. 
 - Proficiency in Excel, production reporting, and ERP/MIS systems. 
 - Excellent leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and team-management skills. Preferred Industry Experience

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in: 

- PVC extrusion manufacturing. 
 - WPC extrusion manufacturing. 
 - PVC wall panels and ceiling panels. 
 - WPC profiles, louvers, and fluted panels. 
 - Plastic profiles, building materials, and related manufacturing industries. Candidates with direct experience managing multiple PVC/WPC extrusion lines will be strongly preferred. 

Key Performance Indicators

The selected candidate will be responsible for measurable improvements in: 

- Production target achievement. 
 - Machine utilisation and downtime reduction. 
 - Material consumption and wastage control. 
 - Product quality and rejection rates. 
 - Labour productivity. 
 - Preventive maintenance compliance. 
 - Inventory accuracy. 
 - On-time production and dispatch. 
 - Workplace safety and statutory compliance. Compensation

- Annual CTC: ₹10-15 lakh, depending on experience and suitability. 
 - Performance-linked incentives may be offered against agreed operational targets. 
 - Direct reporting to company directors. 
 - Opportunity to lead a large, established manufacturing facility. How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting: 

- Total manufacturing experience. 
 - Previous plant management experience. 
 - Number of production lines and employees managed. 
 - Experience in PVC/WPC extrusion or related industries. 
 - Production capacity handled. 
 - Achievements in reducing downtime, wastage, and rejection. 
 - Current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to manage a large manufacturing operation independently and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and cost efficiency.

Company Description

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems. 

To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You'll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way. 

We are looking for a Platform Architect for our production team. The role involves: 

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Lead the architectural design of Vialto's unified enterprise product platform supporting multiple product lines (B2B and B2C). 
 - Define platform capabilities, service boundaries, and technical patterns and principles. 
 - Develop frameworks and reusable components to accelerate product development across teams. 
 - Establish architectural standards for microservices, API design, event-driven communication, workflow orchestration, and data integration. 

Transformation & Migration

- Assess existing tools, systems, and products to define a migration roadmap into the enterprise platform. 
 - Identify opportunities to modernize legacy components, consolidate redundant functionality, and align services to the new platform vision. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to guide phased migration, ensuring minimal disruption and technical consistency. 

Cloud & Technical Architecture

- Architect scalable, secure, cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure using services such as: 
 - Azure API Management 
 - App Services / Functions 
 - Event Grid / Service Bus 
 - Azure SQL MI / Cosmos DB 
 - AKS (preferred) 
 - Azure DevOps / GitHub 
 - Drive adoption of best practices in microservices, distributed systems, observability, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Establish standards for performance, resiliency, multi-tenancy, and security posture. 

AI, Automation & Experience Layer

- Partner with teams to define platform-level capabilities using: 
 - Azure OpenAI 
 - Agentic AI with Microsoft Agent Framework 
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP) 
 - AI-augmented capabilities for enabling product team to build features for client-facing and operational tools 
 - Collaborate on the architecture of user experience layers built in Next. js and React. 
 - Enable intelligent services and automation to enhance global mobility operations and client outcomes. 

Patterns We Expect You to Use

- Event-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate) 
 - Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure-mode design, consistency tradeoffs) 
 - Domain-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti-corruption layers) 
 - Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks. 

Collaboration & Leadership

- Act as a trusted architectural advisor to product engineering teams and business stakeholders.

 - Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.

Required

 - Excellent communication, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred

Education

Additional Information

data.title: Manager - Cloud Container Services
data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Position Overview

The Manager, Cloud Container Services is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes Service (CAKS) platform. The role leads a team of Kubernetes platform engineers and operations specialists responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated container platform that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads efficiently across the enterprise. 

This position serves as the operational owner of the centralized AKS platform, driving platform adoption, service reliability, operational excellence, security compliance, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable insights on platform performance, adoption, operational risks, capacity utilization, cost optimization, and service health. The role aligns closely with the enterprise Cloud Foundation strategy and centralized, multi-tenant AKS operating model. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations & Service Ownership

- Own and manage the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes (CAKS) platform. 
 - Ensure platform availability, stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes. 
 - Establish operational standards, support models, runbooks, and platform governance controls. 
 - Drive Kubernetes platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end-of-life planning. 
 - Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements. 

Kubernetes Platform Management

- Oversee centralized multi-tenant AKS environments supporting mission-critical and non-mission-critical workloads. 
 - Manage cluster operations, node pool lifecycle, networking, and platform integrations. 
 - Ensure secure workload onboarding and platform standardization across business units. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to implement scalable and reusable Kubernetes platform capabilities. 
 - Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation, and self-service capabilities. 

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence

- Define and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs. 
 - Lead major incident management and root cause analysis activities. 
 - Drive reliability engineering practices and resilience improvements. 
 - Implement automation-first operational processes leveraging GitHub and Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity readiness for critical Kubernetes workloads. 
 - Reduce operational overhead through standardization and automated remediation. 

Executive Reporting & Operational Metrics

- Develop executive dashboards and leadership reporting focused on: 
 - Platform Availability & Uptime
 - Cluster Health Metrics
 - MTTR & Incident Trends
 - SLA/SLO Compliance
 - Kubernetes Resource Utilization
 - Capacity Planning & Forecasting
 - Node Pool Utilization
 - Security & Compliance Posture
 - Platform Adoption Metrics
 - Cost Optimization & FinOps Insights
 - Support Backlog & Service Request Metrics
 - Present operational reviews, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership
Security & Governance

- Maintain enterprise Kubernetes governance standards. 
 - Oversee RBAC, Azure AD integration, Managed Identities, and secrets management. 
 - Ensure enforcement of Azure Policy, security guardrails, and compliance controls. 
 - Partner with Cybersecurity teams to ensure secure platform operations. 
 - Lead audit and regulatory compliance activities related to container platforms

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

- Serve as the primary operational contact for application teams consuming AKS services. 
 - Build relationships with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate with Microsoft and strategic partners to optimize platform capabilities. 
 - Drive customer experience and service improvement initiatives across the Kubernetes ecosystem. 

People Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Kubernetes platform operations team. 
 - Establish operational goals and performance expectations. 
 - Drive talent development, succession planning, and technical capability growth. 
 - Promote a culture of automation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master's preferred). 
 - 10+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, container engineering or platform engineering with 15+ years of total work experience, including Azure and/or AWS environments. 
 - 5+ years of people management experience managing Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Operations Teams. 
 - Proven experience managing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, specifically: 
 - Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 
 - Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD. 
 - DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, Hub and Spoke Architecture, 
 - RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault etc. . 
 - Strong experience leading ITIL service management functions, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management. 
 - Experience building and presenting executive operational dashboards and service reviews. 
 - Proven track record of driving platform reliability, operational transformation, and automation initiatives. 
 - Experience managing globally distributed teams and complex enterprise environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and Cloud Kubernetes Services. 
Skills & Competencies

- Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, container orchestration, and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Expertise in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) administration and operations. 
 - Experience managing enterprise-scale multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms. 
 - Strong knowledge of container technologies including Docker and container registries. 
 - Experience with GitOps practices using ArgoCD and modern CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Bicep). 
 - Strong understanding of cloud networking, including Hub-Spoke architecture, Private Link, Azure Firewall, ingress, and service networking. 
 - Experience implementing Kubernetes security controls, RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, and Secrets Management. 
 - Expertise in observability, monitoring, logging, and performance management using enterprise monitoring platforms. 
 - Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning
 - Vendor and Managed Service Provider Governance. 

Key Success Metrics

- Enterprise CAKS platform consistently achieves availability, performance, and security objectives. 
 - Increased adoption of centralized AKS services across business units. 
 - High levels of automation, self-service, and operational maturity. 
 - Reduced operational overhead and improved platform reliability. 
 - Leadership receives timely, actionable operational insights and recommendations. 
 - High-performing teams delivering secure, scalable, and resilient Kubernetes platform services. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

data.title: Technical Architect - AWS
data.description:
About Us

At Rhythm, our values form the foundation of our business. We are passionate about customer success, innovation, and our employees. They guide our actions, decisions, and interactions, ensuring that we consistently make a positive impact on the world around us. 

Job Description

Position Overview

We are seeking a rare, highly skilled hybrid AWS Solutions Architect & Software Developer to join our core product engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level cloud architecture and hands-on backend development. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and code-authoring the robust cloud infrastructure that powers our data core. 

The primary focus of this position is architecting and developing the high-throughput pipelines that process raw "fleet exhaust data" (noise) in AWS and funnel actionable summaries (signals) into our enterprise presentation layer. You will heavily focus on complex data orchestrations and integrations across AWS, Salesforce Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and critical third-party fleet compliance ecosystems. 

Key Responsibilities

As a hybrid Architect and Developer, your responsibilities will span architectural design, core systems programming, and cross-platform ecosystem integration: 

Cloud Architecture & Strategy

- Design & Scale: Architect and optimize secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructures capable of ingesting massive, high-velocity streaming data environments. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and maintain production-ready CloudFormation or Terraform templates to ensure fully automated, repeatable environment deployments. 
 - CI/CD Leadership: Establish and govern standardized CI/CD pipelines that continuously decrease time-to-production for new backend features while enforcing rigorous quality and testing gates. 
 - Security & Trust: Design and implement a robust Cloud Trust Architecture ensuring compliance with stringent data protection best practices and role-based access control. 

Backend Software Engineering

- Write Robust Backend Code: Write clean, highly performant, and scalable code (primarily utilizing Python or Node. js) to build core AWS backend services, APIs, and microservices. 
 - Data Processing & AI: Program state-of-the-art serverless workflows utilizing AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and Amazon Bedrock to compute derived risk indicators (e. g. , speeding minutes per 100 miles, trend slope tracking). 
 - Database & Knowledge Lake Management: Optimize structured and unstructured data persistence strategies across Amazon S3, RDS instances, and managed Vector Databases. 
 - Testing & Quality Assurance: Author and run extensive unit and integration tests for AWS-based applications, lead code reviews, and aggressively improve core data processing algorithms. 

Multi-Platform Ecosystem Integration

- Ecosystem Orchestration: Architect the ingestion paths for high-velocity telematics and IoT data, isolating massive volume processing in AWS before translating relevant indicators to executive CRM workflows. 
 - Telematics & Compliance Integration: Build and maintain direct API data pipelines integrating heavy enterprise platforms and third-party systems including: 
 - Telematics Infrastructure: Deep integration with providers like Verizon Connect (VZC) to ingest real-time engine diagnostics, GPS, and harsh event data. 
 - Regulatory Compliance: Integrations with FMCSA API systems (including SAFER, SMS, A&I, and DataQs datasets). 
 - Risk & Personnel Platforms: Synchronized identity management pipelines with Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Samba Safety, Sentix, or related Risk Cloud environments. 
 - Salesforce & MuleSoft Collaboration: Partner closely with application teams to orchestrate end-to-end event-driven flows using MuleSoft for bidirectional Roster CRUD logic, linking the AWS Knowledge Lake cleanly with Salesforce Data Cloud and AgentForce. 
Requirements

What We're Looking For

- Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Experience: 
 - Minimum of 5-7 years of proven hands-on software development experience writing clean production code. 
 - Minimum of 2 years of dedicated experience acting as an AWS Solutions Architect designing complex, multi-system integration topographies. 
 - AWS Certifications: Valid AWS Certifications are strongly preferred (e. g. , AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified Developer - Associate). 
 - Technical Proficiency: 
 - Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or Node. js. 
 - AWS Infrastructure: Deep knowledge of AWS S3, Lambda, EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Lex, Connect, SES, and native database layers (RDS, DynamoDB, or Vector DBs). 
 - Integration Tech: Exceptional familiarity with building and consuming web services across API, REST, and RPC architectures. 
 - Containers: Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments for containerized compute deployment. 
 - Domain Context: Prior experience writing applications that parse telematics data, cellular/IoT streams, geographic spatial boundaries, or government/compliance API interfaces is a significant advantage. 
 - Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a dedicated approach to data-driven technical execution and clear, transparent team communication.

We're looking for a Testing Engineer to own end-to-end quality for assigned products and features. The ideal candidate will move beyond execution into defining test strategies, setting quality standards, improving automation coverage, and driving cross-team quality advocacy. 

Core Responsibilities

- Analyze functional and non-functional requirements and clarify ambiguities early.

 - Set up pipelines/tasks for scalability and benchmarking to review different environments/conditions. 
 - Execute tests: manual (exploratory, UX, edge) and automated (API, UI, integration). 
 - Log clear, reproducible defects (steps, environment, evidence, impact). 
 - Verify fixes, manage defect lifecycle, and prevent reopens via root cause analysis.

 - Track and report quality metrics (defect density, pass rate, automation %, MTTR).

Key Outcomes (Success Indicators)

- Defects caught pre-release increase; post-production escapes trend down.

Professional Experience

data.title: Principal Cybersecurity Architect
data.description:
Providence is seeking an exceptional Principal Cybersecurity Architect to lead the research, development, and deployment of Small Language Models (SLMs) specialized for healthcare and cybersecurity applications. This role combines cutting-edge machine learning research with practical implementation, requiring deep expertise in model architecture design, advanced fine-tuning techniques, graph-based knowledge systems, and vector-based retrieval augmentation. 

The ideal candidate will architect and train efficient, domain-specialized language models using state-of-the-art techniques including LoRA/QLoRA, graph neural networks, vector embeddings, and hybrid retrieval systems. This position requires both depth in machine learning and hands-on implementation skills to deliver high-impact solutions for healthcare operations, clinical workflows, and security applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and optimize Small Language Models for healthcare and cybersecurity domains using advanced architectures (efficient transformers, MoE, sparse attention), compression techniques (quantization: INT8/INT4/GPTQ/AWQ, pruning, knowledge distillation), and emerging SLM architectures (Phi-3, Gemma, Mistral 7B variants) with rigorous ablation studies balancing model size, inference speed, accuracy, and resource requirements 
 - Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques including LoRA, QLoRA, prefix tuning, prompt tuning, and adapter layers; design instruction tuning pipelines aligning SLMs with clinical terminology and security protocols; develop multi-task learning frameworks; and deploy continuous learning strategies using DPO, RLHF, and active learning while optimizing hyperparameters to prevent overfitting on limited healthcare datasets 
 - Implement knowledge graphs capturing domain relationships and build graph-augmented language models integrating Neo4j/Cosmos DB with unstructured text processing, leveraging GNN components (PyTorch Geometric, DGL, GraphSAGE) for entity relationship modeling and complex graph traversal reasoning 
 - Create entity extraction and relation classification pipelines that automatically populate and maintain knowledge graphs from clinical documents, security logs, and operational data to enable graph-based reasoning across patient journeys, care coordination workflows, and security incident chains 
 - Optimize model inference using vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, llama. cpp, GGML, and Optimum for maximum throughput/minimum latency; implement scalable model serving architectures (Triton, TorchServe, FastAPI) with batching, caching, and load balancing; design A/B testing frameworks and champion-challenger patterns for safe production model updates 
 - Design and implement vector database architectures for semantic search and RAG applications using specialized embeddings optimized for cyber text, with hybrid search combining dense vector retrieval, sparse BM25 matching, and graph-based context expansion 
 - Build advanced RAG architectures implementing multi-vector retrieval, reranking strategies (Cohere, Cross-Encoders), context compression, and query decomposition; optimize vector indexing (HNSW, IVF, Product Quantization) balancing accuracy, latency, and memory footprint; and develop chunking pipelines for diverse cyber data formats 
 - Experience in end-to-end data pipelines for cyber text corpora processing, implementing data quality frameworks through de-identification and synthetic data generation (Synthea), bias detection, and representativeness metrics while building experiment tracking systems (MLflow) for versioning and reproducibility 
 - Develop distributed training workflows using DeepSpeed, FSDP, or Megatron-LM for efficient multi-GPU/multi-node training on Azure ML; create automated data augmentation pipelines (back-translation, paraphrasing, entity substitution, synthetic generation) to expand limited healthcare training datasets while maintaining clinical validity 
 - Design comprehensive evaluation frameworks measuring healthcare-specific task performance (NER, relation extraction, summarization, QA, reasoning) with custom benchmark datasets aligned to clinical accuracy requirements, regulatory compliance, and operational impact; implement automated robustness testing for adversarial attacks, edge cases, OOD detection, and hallucination detection 
 - Conduct comparative analysis of SLM variants across accuracy, latency, throughput, memory, and cost metrics; build interpretability tools using attention visualization, SHAP values, and integrated gradients to ensure clinical safety and explainability for healthcare stakeholders and regulatory requirements 
 - Understand on monitoring and observability dashboards tracking model performance drift, data distribution shifts, embedding quality degradation, and retrieval accuracy in production; collaborate with MLOps teams on containerization (Docker), Kubernetes/AKS deployment, and CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment workflows 
 - Build security-focused SLMs for threat detection, log analysis, vulnerability assessment, incident response automation, and policy compliance checking 
 - Partner with clinical stakeholders, security teams, and product managers to identify high-impact use cases and translate domain requirements into technical specifications; mentor junior data scientists on SLM development, fine-tuning techniques, and healthcare AI; contribute to knowledge sharing through documentation, tech talks, and research communities; stay current with emerging research through literature review, conference participation, and experimentation

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- 7-10 years of experience in data science, machine learning research, or AI engineering with demonstrated track record of developing and deploying language models 
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with transformer architectures, fine-tuning methodologies, and production NLP system development 
 - Proven experience applying machine learning in healthcare, life sciences, or highly regulated industries with understanding of domain-specific challenges

Core Technical Skills

- Expert-level proficiency in Python and core ML libraries including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning), and BitsAndBytes 
 - Deep hands-on experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, AdaLoRA, prefix tuning, prompt tuning, P-Tuning, IA3, and adapter methods 
 - Strong knowledge of model quantization techniques and tools: GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF/GGML, bitsandbytes (4-bit/8-bit quantization), and post-training quantization strategies 
 - Expertise in transformer architectures including attention mechanisms (multi-head, grouped-query, sliding window), positional encodings (RoPE, ALiBi), and architectural variants (encoder-only, decoder-only, encoder-decoder) 
 - Practical experience optimizing model training: mixed precision (FP16, BF16), gradient checkpointing, gradient accumulation, distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed ZeRO), and memory-efficient techniques 
 - Strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals including optimization algorithms, regularization techniques, loss functions, evaluation metrics, and experimental design

Graph & Vector Technologies

- Hands-on experience with graph databases: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin API), or TigerGraph including Cypher/Gremlin query languages and graph data modelling 
 - Proficiency in graph neural networks using PyTorch Geometric, DGL (Deep Graph Library), Spektral, or GraphSAGE for node classification, link prediction, and graph classification tasks 
 - Deep experience with vector databases and similarity search: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma, FAISS, or Annoy including index optimization and hybrid search implementations 
 - Expertise in embedding models and techniques: sentence transformers, bi-encoders, cross-encoders, domain-adapted embeddings, and multi-modal embeddings 
 - Strong knowledge of RAG architectures: naive RAG, advanced RAG (with reranking, query transformation), modular RAG, and evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens) 
 - Understanding of knowledge graph construction techniques including entity extraction, relation extraction, entity linking, and ontology alignment

Data & Infrastructure Skills

- Proficiency with cloud ML platforms, preferably Azure ML, Azure Databricks, or equivalent (AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI) for model training and deployment 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (Snowflake preferred) and data lakes (Azure Data Lake, Delta Lake) for working with healthcare datasets 
 - Experience with experiment tracking and model management: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Comet. ml, Neptune. ai, or similar platforms 
 - Familiarity with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and version control (Git) for reproducible ML workflows 
 - Knowledge of data processing frameworks: Pandas, Polars, Dask, Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data manipulation and feature engineering

Domain Knowledge

- Understanding of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR), clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm), and EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Oracle Health) 
 - Knowledge of healthcare privacy regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) and data security requirements including de-identification standards (Safe Harbor, Expert Determination) 
 - Familiarity with clinical workflows, medical documentation practices, and healthcare operational challenges that AI systems must address 
 - Understanding of responsible AI principles including bias detection, fairness metrics, model interpretability, and ethical considerations for healthcare AI

Professional Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to formulate complex business problems as machine learning tasks 
 - Excellent communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to clinical, business, and executive stakeholders 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage end-to-end data science projects from problem definition through production deployment 
 - Strong collaboration skills with experience working across data engineering, ML engineering, product, and clinical teams 
 - Self-directed learner who stays current with rapidly evolving AI/ML research and proactively experiments with emerging techniques

Preferred Qualifications

- PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Science, or related field with publications in top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, ICLR) 
 - Research contributions to efficient language models, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, knowledge graphs, or retrieval-augmented generation domains 
 - Experience with instruction tuning datasets and methodologies including self-instruct, Alpaca-style datasets, FLAN, and human preference alignment (DPO, PPO) 
 - Hands-on experience with inference optimization frameworks: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, text-generation-inference, CTranslate2, or ONNX Runtime for production deployment 
 - Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel for building multi-step AI workflows 
 - Experience with prompt engineering techniques, prompt optimization frameworks (DSPy, PromptSource), and evaluation of prompt effectiveness 
 - Knowledge of clinical NLP benchmarks and datasets: i2b2, MIMIC, n2c2, BioASQ, PubMedQA, and clinical outcome prediction tasks 
 - Familiarity with multi-modal models combining text with clinical imaging, genomics, or time-series physiological data 
 - Experience with federated learning or privacy-preserving ML techniques (differential privacy, secure multi-party computation) for sensitive healthcare data 
 - Contributions to open-source ML/AI projects (Hugging Face, PyTorch, LangChain ecosystem) or active participation in ML research communities 
 - Prior experience in healthcare technology organizations, clinical research institutions, or regulated industries with complex compliance requirements

Success Metrics & Objectives

Role

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on the following key metrics aligned with Providence's AI Data Science and Engineering OKR framework: 

Model Performance & Quality

- Achieve target accuracy, F1 scores, and domain-specific metrics for SLMs on healthcare tasks (e. g. , >85% F1 for clinical NER, >90% accuracy for classification tasks) Deliver inference latency meeting real-time requirements (target: <100ms p95 latency) while maintaining model quality through optimization techniques 
 - Reduce model size by 50%+ through quantization and compression while retaining 95%+ of original model performance

Technical Innovation

- Successfully implement and deploy 3+ novel fine-tuning or optimization techniques advancing Providence's SLM capabilities within first year 
 - Build production-grade graph-augmented RAG system improving retrieval accuracy by 30%+ over baseline vector-only approaches
