data.title: Lead Research Engineer - LLM Optimization & Agentic Systems
data.description:
Company: CraftifAI

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from office

Role focus: 70% hands-on research and engineering; 30% technical leadership and ownership

Preferred joining timeline: Candidates who can join in fewer than 45 days are preferred. 

About CraftifAI

CraftifAI is building Orbit, a platform that automates engineering workflows across embedded software, Edge AI, and FPGA development. Our work connects requirements, domain knowledge, code generation, testing, validation, and deployment to help engineering teams build working products. 

We are looking for a research-driven engineer who can strengthen the LLMs and agentic systems behind these workflows, with a particular focus on efficient on-premises deployment and reliable code generation. 

About the Role

You will lead the research and implementation of domain-specific LLM solutions and agentic systems for engineering applications. This includes fine-tuning models, reducing their deployment footprint while preserving measured task quality, designing knowledge architectures, building agent harnesses, and establishing rigorous product benchmarks. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. Approximately 70% of your time will involve coding, experiments, model optimization, evaluation, and product integration. The remaining 30% will involve architecture decisions, research direction, mentoring, and ownership of technical outcomes. 

You should be comfortable moving from a research hypothesis to an implementation, measuring its impact, understanding its failures, and improving it until it works reliably within the product. 

What You Will Own

1. LLM Fine-Tuning and Efficient On-Premises Deployment

- Adapt LLMs for engineering tasks, including code generation, tool use, debugging, and reasoning over domain-specific information. 
 - Build data preparation and fine-tuning workflows using suitable approaches such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference optimization. 
 - Apply and evaluate compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to reduce model size and memory requirements. 
 - Measure trade-offs between task quality, model footprint, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost on target deployment hardware. 

2. Agentic Systems for Code Generation

- Design and implement agent harnesses for task planning, repository exploration, context management, code generation, tool execution, debugging, and iterative correction. 
 - Build reliable execution flows with clear state management, failure recovery, stopping conditions, and observable results. 
 - Improve the ability of agents to complete engineering tasks across multiple files, dependencies, tools, and execution environments. 
 - Own the integration of these capabilities into CraftifAI's product workflows. 

3. Domain Knowledge and Context Architecture

- Design knowledge systems that connect source code, requirements, architecture documents, hardware documentation, SDKs, APIs, and previous engineering outcomes. 
 - Develop effective retrieval and context construction using approaches such as hybrid search, reranking, structured knowledge, and repository-aware retrieval. 
 - Decide when information belongs in model training, retrieval, structured tools, or persistent agent memory. 
 - Keep retrieved information traceable to its source, version, and applicable hardware or software configuration. 

4. Code Quality and Automated Verification

- Build and integrate static analysis tools, compiler diagnostics, linters, code structure checks, and security checks into agent workflows. 
 - Combine these checks with automated builds, unit tests, and controlled execution to evaluate generated code. 
 - Convert tool findings into actionable feedback that agents can use to diagnose and correct their outputs. 
 - Establish quality gates and regression checks that provide objective evidence of improvement. 

5. Low-Latency System Design

- Profile and optimize the complete workflow, including retrieval, context preparation, model inference, tool calls, and correction cycles. 
 - Improve serving, caching, batching, context efficiency, and execution routing where they produce measurable benefits. 
 - Design for practical on-premises constraints, including available compute, GPU memory, concurrency, and restricted external connectivity. 
 - Optimize time to a verified result alongside model response time. 

6. Reasoning and Learning from Field Use

- Improve agent planning, tool selection, debugging, and recovery through systematic failure analysis and controlled experiments. 
 - Turn field failures and user feedback into curated datasets, evaluation cases, improved knowledge, and better agent behavior. 
 - Evaluate suitable methods for improving reasoning and tool use, including fine-tuning, preference learning, and reinforcement learning where appropriate. 
 - Validate improvements against regression benchmarks before release, within customer data and deployment constraints. 

7. Product Benchmarking and Technical Leadership

- Own reproducible benchmarks at both model and complete product workflow levels. 
 - Measure task completion, functional correctness, static analysis findings, test results, human intervention, latency, memory use, and compute cost. 
 - Use held-out tasks, baseline comparisons, ablation studies, and error analysis to explain which changes improve the product and why. 
 - Define research priorities, lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and take ownership from experimentation through product integration. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- Minimum qualification: MS by Research from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad, in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a closely related field. A PhD is preferred. 
 - Strong practical experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them on private or on-premises infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated experience reducing model size or inference memory requirements, supported by measured quality and performance results. 
 - Deep hands-on experience building agentic systems for code generation, including tool integration, execution feedback, and iterative repair. 
 - Strong understanding of domain knowledge architecture, retrieval systems, context management, and their interaction with model behavior. 
 - Strong Python and software engineering skills, with practical experience using frameworks such as PyTorch, Transformers, PEFT, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience integrating static analysis, build systems, automated testing, or other programmatic checks into code-generation workflows. 
 - Strong research discipline: clear hypotheses, controlled experiments, reproducible results, and careful interpretation of failures. 
 - Ability to make architecture decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and personally implement critical parts of the solution. 

Additional Experience We Value

- Research publications or open-source contributions in efficient LLMs, code models, reasoning, agentic systems, or program analysis. 
 - Experience with C/C++, embedded software, compilers, firmware, or hardware-aware code generation. 
 - Experience with model serving, inference profiling, distributed training, or resource-constrained deployments. 
 - Experience turning research prototypes into maintained production capabilities. 

What to Include in Your Application

Please share your CV and relevant publications, repositories, or project examples. Where possible, include: 

- An LLM fine-tuning or compression project with measured quality, memory, and latency results. 
 - An agentic code-generation system you personally built, including its tool integrations and evaluation approach. 
 - A brief explanation of your individual contribution and the most significant technical problem you solved. 
 - Your current notice period and availability to work from the office.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer C++ | Low Latency Trading Systems
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub, working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You will be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science. 

What You'll Love: 

- Zero bureaucracy, zero silos-engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the management team
 - Direct ownership of subsystems
 - Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
 - A high-trust environment, where performance speaks louder than hierarchy. 
 - Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
 - Ability to transition between various teams and projects, whether related to trading systems, algorithmic trading or system tooling
 - 5-week structured training program: 
 - Market microstructure and trading mechanics
 - Algorithmic execution and strategy design
 - Exchange simulators and performance testing
 - Market data systems and real-time analytics
 - Hands-on exercises using production research data
 - Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
 - Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U. S. , Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets. 

What You'll Work On

Designing and developing system architecture: 

- Core trading systems and algorithmic trading frameworks
 - High-performance execution algorithms for global markets
 - Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
 - Market data adaptors and exchange connectivity adaptors

Building from scratch: 

- Trading systems for new asset classes and execution algorithms
 - Performance optimizations for low-latency, high-throughput systems

Enhancing existing systems: 

- Add support for new features and improve scalability and reliability

Collaborating closely with: 

- A global team of quants, traders, and senior engineers to design cutting-edge solutions

Analyzing and optimizing system performance: 

- Across application, OS, and hardware layers to achieve industry-leading performance
 - Work primarily with C++17 in a high-impact, low-bureaucracy environment

Requirements

You Should Have: 

- Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
 - At least 5+ years software development experience with C++
 - Expert-level knowledge of C++ and excellent software design skills
 - Expert-level knowledge of TCP/IP and multithreading
 - Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to articulate ideas
 - An attitude of constant curiosity and growth, as well as the ability and desire to mentor others
 - While domain experience is a plus, we welcome strong engineers from other industries

Bonus Points For

- Database optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
 - Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
 - Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools, ability to work with large datasets
 - Prior experience developing trading systems or execution algorithms
 - Knowledge of relational databases, database optimizations, and SQL
 - Experience with Python/R

data.title: PMTS - DFT Architect
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

PMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

The Role

As a member of Circuit Technologies (CT) Team, you will architect, develop, and lead the DFT Design and Integration of cutting edge DFT structures including SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, BSCAN. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC/chiplet and IP architects to define future DFx architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production. 

THE PERSON: 

In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues, and SOC/chiplet and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop next-generation SoC/chiplet and IP debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Partner with architecture and SoC/chiplet and IP design teams to define and execute a comprehensive Design-for-Excellence (DFX) strategy spanning debug, test, validation, reliability, and manufacturability. 
 - Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements. 
 - Drive cross-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end-to-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations. 
 - Evaluate and deploy AI-driven methodologies to streamline DFX planning, insertion, verification, coverage analysis, and implementation, improving quality, consistency, and scalability while reducing manual effort and time-to-deployment. 
 - Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations. 

Preferred Experience

- 10+ years of experience in SoC/chiplet and IP design, DFX architecture, or related silicon development disciplines. 
 - Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large-scale SoC/chiplet architectures. 
 - Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG 1149. x/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features. 
 - Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low-power design architectures. 
 - Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions from both architectural and implementation perspectives. 
 - Experience applying AI and data-driven techniques to improve engineering productivity, including DFX requirement analysis, insertion planning, verification, coverage assessment, validation, and design quality optimization. 
 - Ability to leverage modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools to accelerate debug, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and enable earlier identification of design and DFX risks. 

Academic Credentials

data.title: Sr. System Integration Engineer
data.description:
At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) - The AI Factory Platform Company - we're building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide. 

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale. 

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision. 

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact. 

Job Overview

The Integration Engineering team develops and validates the software solutions that power next-generation AI infrastructure. We work at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, AI platforms, and enterprise software to help customers deploy, operate, and scale AI environments with confidence. 

As a Sr. Systems Integration Engineer, you'll work across Penguin's AI Factory Platform and a broad ecosystem of technologies including Linux, Kubernetes, HPC, networking, storage, GPUs, AI frameworks, and cloud-native infrastructure to build, validate, and operationalize integrated solutions. 

The team works collaboratively with Product Management, Software and Hardware Engineering, Solution Architects, and technology partners to evaluate new technologies, develop automation, solve complex integration challenges, and transform innovative ideas into production-ready capabilities. 

Whether you're an experienced engineer or an early-career technologist with a strong systems background and a passion for learning, this role offers an opportunity to work on some of the most advanced AI infrastructure environments in the industry. 

Responsibilities

Build and Validate AI Infrastructure Solutions

- Develop, integrate, and validate software solutions that enable enterprise AI infrastructure. 
 - Evaluate interoperability across Penguin software and partner technologies. 
 - Design and execute proof-of-concepts and technical evaluations. 
 - Help define best practices for deploying and operating AI infrastructure at scale. 

Automate Everything

- Build automation using tools such as Ansible, Python, GitLab CI/CD, Helm, and Kubernetes. 
 - Improve deployment, validation, and operational workflows. 
 - Create reusable tooling that increases reliability and repeatability. 

Solve Complex Systems Problems

- Troubleshoot issues that span software, infrastructure, networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI platforms. 
 - Work alongside engineering teams to identify root causes and drive technical solutions. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of Penguin's AI Factory Platform. 

Learn, Experiment, and Innovate

- Explore emerging technologies across the AI infrastructure ecosystem. 
 - Evaluate new open-source and commercial technologies. 
 - Contribute ideas that influence future products and solution architectures. 
 - Continuously expand your technical expertise across infrastructure and AI technologies. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience administering and supporting Linux-based production environments. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes in production environments. 
 - Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Ansible preferred). 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT) to improve engineering productivity. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with one or more of the following: 
 - DevOps or Platform Engineering 
 - AI or machine learning infrastructure 
 - GPU computing 
 - Slurm or HPC environments 
 - Enterprise storage 
 - Networking 
 - Containers and cloud-native technologies 
 - Observability platforms 
 - CI/CD pipelines 
 Location

Hybrid - Bangalore, India

data.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent Health has a bold mission to change the health of the nation by changing the way health care is delivered. Our pursuit of this mission is the driving force that brings us to work each day. We believe in embracing new ideas, challenging ourselves and failing forward. We respect and celebrate individual talents and team wins. We have fun while working hard and Evolenteers often make a difference working in everything from scrubs to jeans. 

Are we growing? Absolutely and Globally. In 2021 we grew our teams by almost 50% and continue to grow even more in 2022. Are we recognized as a company you are supported by for your career and growth, and a great place to work? Definitely. Evolent Health International (Pune, India) has been certified as "Great Places to Work" in 2021. In 2020 and 2021 Evolent in the U. S. was both named Best Company for Women to Advance list by Parity. org and earned a perfect score on the Human Rights Campaign (HRC) Foundation's Corporate Equality Index (CEI). This index is the nation's foremost benchmarking survey and report measuring corporate policies and practices related to LGBTQ+ workplace equality. 

We recognize employees that live our values, give back to our communities each year, and are champions for bringing our whole selves to work each day. If you're looking for a place where your work can be personally and professionally rewarding, don't just join a company with a mission. Join a mission with a company behind it. 

What You'll Be Doing: 

The Lead HRIS Analyst will support the maintenance and enhancement of the Workday HCM system. This role will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to improve efficiencies and automate processes using the Workday platform. The Lead HRIS Analyst will optimize system functionality through continuous process improvements and enhancements to provide an excellent end-user experience. You are required to have very deep knowledge of the skills necessary to perform your role, and the structure of the technology for which you are responsible. You will guide others through problem solving whether it is a technical issue, project impediment, or conflict. 

Essential Functions

- Support system administration, including business process configuration and design of Workday HR. 
 - Collaborate with HR and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deploy high-quality solutions in an Agile framework. 
 - Understand system pain points, determine root causes, and develop solutions in Workday to address short-term and long-term requirements. 
 - Identify and manage dependencies and downstream impacts of projects to minimize adverse effects on the system and business processes. 
 - Design and develop custom reports to meet business requirements. 
 - Configure and administer security in compliance with policies and procedures. 
 - Deliver end-user support by conducting root cause analysis and resolving issues through the ticketing system. 
 - Create and maintain detailed documentation for the design, configuration, and testing of requested changes and enhancements. 
 - Manage the design and development of deliverables independently. 
 - Support Workday release activities. 
 - Train, coach, and mentor team members. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree. 
 - 8+ years experience with an HR ERP system development role (Oracle, PeopleSoft, SAP, etc. ) troubleshooting and resolving environment issues for enterprise software applications. 
 - At least 5 years of experience in Workday HCM with expertise in multiple modules. 
 - Proficient in Workday report writing (custom, advanced, matrix, and composite), dashboards, and hubs. 
 - Strong understanding of Workday functional modules and their associated business processes. 
 - Proven proficiency in configuring and maintaining Workday functional modules. 
 - Strong knowledge of Workday Business Process frameworks, workflows, and security implications. 
 - Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Workday configurations and solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience supporting and configuring at least three Workday modules, such as HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Time Tracking, Absence Management, Compensation, Benefits, or Talent Management. 
 - Exposure to scripting/programming with a foundational understanding of AI-assisted automation. Ability to leverage emerging AI technologies to enhance HR technology solutions and operational efficiency is a plus. 
 - Experience serving as a Functional Lead on a large-scale, end-to-end Workday implementation, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-production support. 
 - Demonstrated ability to partner with cross-functional stakeholders and drive successful delivery of Workday initiatives in complex organizational environments. 
 - Willingness to work until 2 pm EST /11: 30 pm IST

Preferred Education

- Bachelor's degree in IT or related field. 

Preferred Certifications

- Workday Certifications

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. 

Mandatory Requirements: 

Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business. 

Evolent Health is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

data.title: Gujarati Linguistic QA Specialist (Remote)
data.description:
About This Role

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Gujarati Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Gujarati AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Gujarati content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and help ensure that all contributors follow the expected standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Gujarati and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Gujarati quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Gujarati training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Your profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Gujarati, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Gujarati proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Gujarati writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Gujarati grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Gujarati content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus. 

Key responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Gujarati items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Gujarati wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Gujarati project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Gujarati-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Gujarati language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Gujarati-language projects.

NET, web, API, data, and cloud technologies.  - Deep understanding of multi-tier web application architecture, distributed systems, SaaS, PaaS, cloud-native architecture, and high-scale enterprise application design. 
 - Proficiency with Java/J2EE technologies such as Servlets, JSP, JMS, Spring, Hibernate, SOA, and web services. 
 - Experience with . NET technologies and ability to operate in a multi-technology product environment. 
 - Experience with middleware technologies such as messaging, caching, service orchestration, API gateways, and integration frameworks. 
 - Solid understanding of relational database concepts and hands-on experience with SQL Server, Oracle, or similar enterprise databases. 
 - Experience with application servers such as JBoss or Tomcat. 
 - Experience with REST, SOAP, API security, SSL, web services security, authentication, authorization, and secure integration patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with private, hybrid, or public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Developer or architect certification is preferred. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience architecting financial, accounting, reconciliation, compliance, or other enterprise workflow platforms. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, reliability testing, and production incident analysis. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development workflows and ability to guide teams in responsible adoption of LLM-based tools.

Cultural Fit

data.title: Odia (Oriya) Team Lead (Remote)
data.description:
About This Role

Interview language: English

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as an Odia (Oriya) Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Odia AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Odia content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and help ensure that all contributors follow the expected standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Odia and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Odia quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Odia training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Your profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Odia, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Odia proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Odia writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Odia grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Odia content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus. 

Key responsibilities

- Task Description: Review and quality-check existing translations of English science benchmark questions (ARC) in your target language. For each item, you'll compare the original translation and an AI-proposed correction against the English source, focusing strictly on accuracy and faithfulness rather than stylistic improvement . 
 - You'll review the question and answer choices only , select the appropriate outcome (accept the original, accept the AI correction, edit the final translation, or escalate), and provide a brief review comment. The goal is to preserve the source exactly - including its meaning, difficulty, answer structure, scientific terminology, and protected elements - while following the provided core and language-specific guidelines.

Avanade India's Business Applications practice is seeking a Power Apps Tech Lead to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions across Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse. Key Responsibilities

 - Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues. 
 - Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client's environment strategy. 
 - Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities. 
 - Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 7-12 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive - component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long-running or high-volume patterns. 
 - Proven Dataverse implementation experience: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules. 
 - Practical command of the Dataverse security model - security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security - and the ability to design it for a real organizational structure. 
 - Working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities with canvas apps and Power Platform solutions (Copilot Studio, AI Builder or equivalent). 
 - Experience integrating with external systems and Microsoft 365 services through standard and custom connectors and APIs. 
 - Understanding of Power Platform ALM - solutions, environment variables, connection references and automated deployment. 
 - Awareness of Power Platform governance, licensing implications and DLP policies.

Key responsibilities

data.title: HR Systems Assurance Specialist
data.description:
HR Systems Assurance SpecialistSAP Payroll and SuccessFactorsChennai | India

We are seeking an HR Systems Assurance Specialist to provide independent assurance that HR data, payroll and time are accurate, compliant and appropriately controlled across SAP ECC Payroll and SuccessFactors. The role involves independently extracting and reconciling data across systems, investigating discrepancies, testing controls and clearly reporting findings. This is an assurance and reporting role; it does not involve building or configuring the systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Perform recurring data quality checks across SuccessFactors Employee Central and SAP ECC Payroll to assess completeness, accuracy, validity and consistency of HR master data. 

Reconcile payroll results across periods, including headcount, gross pay, deductions, general ledger (GL) and bank postings, and check compliance with statutory and company policy requirements. 

Verify that SuccessFactors Time Tracking data aligns with rosters and time rules and flows correctly into SAP ECC Payroll wage types. 

Monitor Employee Central to ECC replication and investigate errors, missing records and data mismatches. 

Design, perform and document control tests, maintaining clear, audit-ready evidence and supporting audit trails. 

Log findings, follow up with control and process owners on remediation, and report recurring issues and trends. 

Explain findings and potential impacts clearly to HR Technology, payroll teams and HR business stakeholders. 

Key Competencies & Skills

Strong hands-on reporting skills in SAP ECC HCM/Payroll and SuccessFactors, including Story reports and Table reports. 

Good understanding of SAP HCM and SuccessFactors data models, including Employee Central, Time Tracking and the payroll cluster. 

Working knowledge of payroll processes, including gross-to-net calculations, retroactive and off-cycle payroll, and payroll reconciliation. 

Understanding of time management processes, including rosters, overtime, shift and night allowances, public holidays and absence accruals. 

Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, PivotTables and XLOOKUP; working knowledge of SQL. 

Ability to use Power BI for reporting is preferred; Python or similar scripting experience for automating checks is an advantage. 

Understanding of control design and testing, maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, audit trails and data privacy. 

Strong analytical thinking, professional scepticism, clear written communication and accurate documentation. 

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

SAP ECC HCM / Payroll

Knowledge of key info types: 0000/0001, 0007, 0008, 0014/0015, 2001/2002 and 2010. 

Understanding of payroll cluster PCL2, including RT, CRT and WPBP, and how retroactive calculations appear. 

Experience with or understanding of Wage Type Reporter (PC00_M99_CWTR), payroll journal, PC_PAYRESULT, Ad Hoc Query, SQVI and SE16N. 

Ability to read a payroll schema or PCR and explain a result; configuration or development is not required. 

SuccessFactors Employee Central

Understanding of corporate, succession and country-specific data models, MDF objects, picklists and effective-dated records. 

Experience creating or using Story reports (People Analytics) and Table reports. 

Ability to use the Data Replication Monitor to investigate Employee Central to ECC replication issues. 

SuccessFactors Time Tracking

Understanding of time profiles, time types, time recording profiles, work schedules and holiday calendars. 

Knowledge of time valuation and time collectors, including how approved timesheets flow into ECC Payroll wage types. 

Payroll, Data and Assurance

Understanding of gross-to-net payroll, retroactive and off-cycle runs, and statutory deductions. 

Ability to reconcile headcount, gross pay, GL postings and bank postings period on period. 

Ability to assess roster patterns such as 4x4, 7x7, 14x14 and FIFO, including overtime, shift and night allowances, public holidays and absence accruals. 

Understanding of data quality dimensions: completeness, accuracy, validity, timeliness and consistency. 

Knowledge of GDPR and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the importance of protecting employee data. 

Experience & Education Requirements

6-10 years of total professional experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience with SAP HCM/Payroll and SuccessFactors data. 

Experience working with multicultural, multi-country teams. 

A degree in Commerce, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline. 

Payroll and Time Management experience is an advantage. 

Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain findings to payroll and HR managers without unnecessary technical jargon. 

Self-motivated, analytical and process-oriented, with a collaborative approach to issue resolution and documentation. 

Additional / Preferred Skills

SAP certifications in SuccessFactors Employee Central, SuccessFactors Time Tracking or SAP HCM Payroll. 

Exposure to Employee Central Payroll. 

Interest or experience in automated or AI-assisted assurance checks. 

PRACTICAL SCREENING EXERCISE

As part of the selection process, candidates may be given an anonymised Employee Central extract, timesheet extract and payroll wage-type extract. In approximately 45 minutes, candidates will be asked to: 

Identify employees with approved time but no matching wage type in payroll. 

Identify Employee Central pay changes that have not replicated to ECC. 

Flag overtime that exceeds roster rules. 

Name the control that could have prevented each issue. 

LOCATION & WORKING HOURS

Location: Chennai, India. 

Flexible working hours to overlap with operating sites in the Americas, Africa and Australia. India Standard Time is approximately 8. 5-10. 5 hours ahead of the Americas, depending on location and daylight-saving time. 

Who We Are

Glencore is one of the world's largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life. 

With over 140, 000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices. 

Glencore's customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

Job Title/Role: Director - Enterprise Data Platform

Mode of hire: Full-Time

Base Location: Guindy, Chennai

Mode of work: Hybrid/ Roster Model

Shift Timing: General Shift + Overlapping US time zone

Experience: 10 to 15 Years

Department: Engineering

About The Role

The Data Platform Leader is responsible for defining, building, and operating the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), a centralized, governed, and scalable data foundation that enables enterprise analytics and accelerates insight delivery. This role owns the end-to-end data platform capability as a strategic enterprise asset, including vision, investment direction. 

The role leads the design and execution of a modern AWS Native Lakehouse platform, ensuring secure, high performance, and self-service access to trusted data across the organization. It requires a balance of deep technical expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate within a federated data model that supports domain ownership while maintaining centralized governance. 

Roles And Responsibilities

Platform Strategy

- Define and execute the enterprise data platform strategy and roadmap
 - Design and evolve a modern AWS native lakehouse architecture
 - Establish scalable, reusable data platform patterns and standards
 - Drive migration from legacy Microsoft based data platforms
 - Define and evolve the federated data operating model, including domain responsibilities and data product standards

Platform Delivery & Operations

- Own delivery and ongoing operation of the data platform
 - Oversee development of data ingestion pipelines and transformation frameworks
 - Ensure platform reliability, performance, and scalability
 - Implement monitoring, observability, and operational controls
 - Optimize platform cost efficiency across storage, compute, and data processing workloads

Data Governance & Security

- Define and enforce data governance standards, policies, and controls
 - Implement fine-grained access control using AWS Lake Formation
 - Enable enterprise data cataloging, metadata management, and discovery (e. g. , AWS DataZone)
 - Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and audit requirements

Technology Leadership

- Lead tooling and technology decisions across the platform ecosystem
 - Define reference architectures for batch, streaming, and real-time processing
 - Standardize orchestration and data processing patterns
 - Own integration strategy and interoperability with analytics and BI tools such as Power BI, SQL based platforms, Agentic AI capabilities (e. g. , model context protocol, data access patterns for AI workloads)

Team Leadership & Development

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers and analysts
 - Establish engineering standards, best practices, and quality frameworks
 - Build capabilities in modern data engineering, governance, and platform operations
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement

Stakeholder Engagement

- Drive alignment with business domains to onboard and scale data products
 - Enable self-service data access and consumption
 - Drive alignment with architecture, security, and analytics teams
 - Act as the primary escalation point for platform related decisions

Qualifications & Experience

Required Skills & Experience

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related fields 
 - 3+ years of experience leading data engineering or platform teams 
 - Strong hands on experience with AWS data ecosystem: 
 - S3, Glue, Lake Formation, DataZone, IAM 
 - Athena, Redshift, or similar query engines 
 - Experience designing and implementing Lakehouse or modern data platform architectures 
 - Expertise in data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, and orchestration frameworks 
 - Strong understanding of data governance, security, and access control models 
 - Experience with enterprise data cataloging and metadata management

Preferred Skills

- Experience migrating from Microsoft centric data platforms (e. g. , SQL Server, SSIS, Azure) 
 - Familiarity with domain oriented or data mesh operating models 
 - Experience supporting analytics tools such as Power BI 
 - Knowledge of data sharing and cross domain data product models 
 - Exposure to agentic AI capabilities and data access patterns for AI workloads

Work Environment & Operating Model

- Operates within a federated data model balancing centralized governance and domain ownership 
 - Supports a self service data ecosystem with governed access and discovery 
 - Enables cross domain data sharing with secure, fine grained controls 
 - Partners closely with domain teams, analytics users, and enterprise architecture

About The Platform

The Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) provides a centralized, governed, high performance data foundation built on an AWS native lakehouse architecture. It enables scalable data ingestion, secure data sharing, enterprise-wide data discovery, and flexible analytics consumption across tools and domains. 

Competencies

- Strategic thinking and platform mindset 
 - Strong technical leadership and decision making 
 - Ability to operate in a federated, cross functional environment 
 - Communication and stakeholder management skills 
 - Delivery ownership and execution focus 
 - Continuous improvement and innovation mindset

data.description:
Senior Power Platform Developer - Canvas Apps, Power Automate & Dataverse

Location

Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)

Experience

6-10 years in application development, with strong hands-on experience building intuitive Power Apps canvas apps, designing scalable Power Automate workflows, and implementing Dataverse solutions including the security model - plus working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities into Power Platform solutions

Role Summary

Avanade India's Business Applications practice is looking for a Senior Power Platform Developer to build the apps our clients' users work in every day. This is a hands-on build role for someone who takes a business process and turns it into a canvas app people find easy and fast to use, backed by a properly designed Dataverse model and automation that holds up in production. 

You will own features end to end - data model, app, automation, integration and security - on delivery teams alongside architects, business analysts and client stakeholders. We also expect you to bring AI into the solution where it earns its place: embedding Copilot and agent capabilities in canvas apps and the wider Power Platform estate, rather than treating AI as a separate project. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build intuitive, user-friendly Power Apps canvas apps - screen and navigation design, responsive layouts, reusable components, delegation-aware data access and performance tuning. 
 - Turn business requirements and user journeys into working applications, taking ownership of usability and of how the app performs with real data volumes. 
 - Design and implement scalable Power Automate workflows - cloud flows, child flows, error handling and retry patterns, approvals, scheduled and event-driven processing, and concurrency and throughput considerations. 
 - Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules. 
 - Design and implement the Dataverse security model - security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security - and validate that users see only what they should. 
 - Integrate AI agents and Copilot capabilities into canvas apps and related Power Platform solutions, including Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder models and prompt-based actions, with attention to grounding, accuracy and appropriate use. 
 - Integrate solutions with external systems and Microsoft 365 services using standard and custom connectors, Power Automate and APIs. 
 - Apply Power Platform ALM properly - solutions, managed and unmanaged layers, environment variables, connection references, and deployment through pipelines or Azure DevOps. 
 - Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues. 
 - Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client's environment strategy. 
 - Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities. 
 - Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-10 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive - component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long-running or high-volume patterns. 
 - Proven Dataverse implementation experience: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules. 
 - Practical command of the Dataverse security model - security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security - and the ability to design it for a real organisational structure. 
 - Working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities with canvas apps and Power Platform solutions (Copilot Studio, AI Builder or equivalent). 
 - Experience integrating with external systems and Microsoft 365 services through standard and custom connectors and APIs. 
 - Understanding of Power Platform ALM - solutions, environment variables, connection references and automated deployment. 
 - Awareness of Power Platform governance, licensing implications and DLP policies. 
 - Ability to debug and performance-tune apps and flows, and to resolve defects through to closure. 
 - Good client-facing communication - running requirement discussions and demos, and explaining design decisions clearly. 

Qualifications

Preferred / Good to Have

- Experience with model-driven apps, Power Pages or Power BI alongside canvas apps. 
 - Experience building Copilot Studio agents in depth - topics, actions, knowledge sources and channel deployment. 
 - Custom code extension skills: PCF components, JavaScript, C# plug-ins or Azure Functions. 
 - Azure integration experience - Logic Apps, API Management, Key Vault or Service Bus. 
 - Microsoft certifications: PL-400, PL-200, PL-600 or AI-102. 
 - Experience with Dataverse data migration and integration tooling (dataflows, Azure Data Factory, Data Migration Utility). 
 - Experience with Dynamics 365 applications on the same Dataverse platform. 
 - Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar), including presales or demo support. 
 - Prior contribution to reusable components, accelerators or practice IP.

data.title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle. 

The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities. 
 - Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans. 
 - Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI. 
 - Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting. 
 - Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers' physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows. 
 - Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record. 
 - Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption. 
 - Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity. 
 - Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact. 
 - Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness. 
 - Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes. 
 - Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness. 
 - Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture. 
 - Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required. 
 - Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices. 

First 6-12 Months

The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan. 

Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Job Summary

The Construction Quality Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the overall Quality Management System (QMS) for large-scale construction projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, engineering standards, statutory regulations, client requirements, and international quality practices. The role oversees quality assurance and quality control activities across all phases of construction including civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), process utilities, cleanroom systems, and high-tech industrial facility installations. data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Staff Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have built verification environments that catch bugs before they become customer issues. Whether you have been doing this for three years or closer to ten, you have learned that verification is not about running tests; it is about thinking through what could go wrong and building the infrastructure to prove it won't. You understand that a well-written testbench is half the battle, and the remaining is knowing which corner cases matter, and which ones are just noise. 

You are comfortable working in System Verilog and UVM, writing test cases that exercise real scenarios, not just the ones in the specification. You have debugged enough simulations to recognize patterns in waveforms, and you know when to dig deeper versus when to loop in the design team. Protocols like MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet or USB are not just acronyms to you; you have worked with at least one of them closely enough to understand how transactions flow and where things typically break. 

Working on a verification team means asking questions when the test plan does not make sense, writing assertions that catch issues, and tracking coverage in a way that tells you what you have validated and what you have not. At Synopsys, you will work on IP cores that go into AI systems, automotive platforms, and data centers. The verification work you do will determine whether that IP works when it ships. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and maintain UVM-based testbench for RTL IP cores, including agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, and coverage collectors
 - Write System Verilog test cases and constrained random stimulus to verify functional correctness across different operating modes and protocol scenarios
 - Develop and execute verification plans based on design specifications, identifying test scenarios, corner cases, and coverage goals
 - Debug RTL and testbench issues by analyzing simulation logs, waveforms, and coverage reports to isolate root causes and verify fixes
 - Implement assertion-based checks and functional coverage models to track verification progress and ensure thorough validation
 - Collaborate with design engineers to understand IP functionality, clarify requirements, and provide feedback on design-for-verification considerations
 - Run regressions, analyze results, and work toward coverage closure, documenting verification status and outstanding issues

The Impact You Will Have

- Ensure Synopsys IP cores are thoroughly validated before they reach customers building AI accelerators, automotive systems, and cloud infrastructure
 - Reduce post-silicon bugs and customer escalations by catching design issues early through systematic verification and coverage analysis
 - Contribute to faster IP release cycles by building reusable verification components and efficient test strategies
 - Help maintain high-quality standards across Synopsys IP products, directly impacting customer success and product reliability
 - Support the development of verification best practices and methodologies within the Bangalore team
 - Enable design teams to iterate faster by providing clear, actionable feedback on functional correctness and edge case behavior
 - Build verification infrastructure that can scale across multiple IP variants and protocol configurations

What You'll Need

- 4-8 years of hands-on experience in ASIC or RTL verification for IP cores or digital designs
 - Understanding of verification planning, test case development, and coverage-driven verification concepts
 - Working knowledge of UVM or similar verification methodologies, with experience building testbench components and writing test cases
 - Solid System Verilog skills, including understanding of constrained random verification, coverage, and assertions
 - Familiarity with at least one industry-standard protocol such as MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB or similar
 - Experience debugging RTL simulations using waveform viewers and analyzing coverage reports to guide verification progress
 - Experience with Perforce or similar revision control environment
 - Basic scripting ability in Python, Perl, TCL, or shell scripting to support automation and regression management
 - Ability to use AI tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot for analysis, development, debugs and maximizing productivity. 
 - Have good communication skills, will be a team player, and will have good problem-solving skills. 

Who You Are

- You can look at a design spec and start listing the test scenarios that need to be covered without waiting for someone to hand you a complete test plan
 - You are methodical about debugging, when a test fails, you do not guess, you trace through the waveform and log until you understand exactly what happened
 - You ask questions when requirements are unclear or when a design decision seems like it will be hard to verify, and you do it early enough to matter
 - You are comfortable working with design engineers who may be in different locations, coordinating on bug fixes, clarifications, and verification scope
 - You track your own coverage and verification progress, knowing what has been tested, what has not, and what the gaps mean for overall quality
 - You are motivated by the moment when your testbench catches a real bug, the kind that would have caused problems downstream if it had slipped through

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the IPG and SSG Group at the Bangalore Design Center, working alongside verification and design engineers who develop IP cores for a range of applications including AI, automotive, and cloud infrastructure. The team collaborates across Synopsys' global sites, and you will have the opportunity to work on IP that goes into high-performance systems used by customers worldwide. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
