And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

AI Business Solutions -AI Engineer Senior Manager: 

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager - AI Engineer to lead strategic AI initiatives and drive the design, development, and adoption of agent-based solutions using Microsoft AI technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership to scale AI-driven transformation across enterprise functions. . 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks. 
 - Drive enterprise-wide adoption of intelligent agents built using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#). 
 - Define architecture standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Mentor team members and ensure high-quality delivery across AI initiatives. 
 - Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution. 
 - Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong expertise in Copilot Studio and enterprise-grade AI agent development. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#). 
 - Extensive experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML ecosystem. 
 - Deep understanding of agent-based architectures, orchestration patterns, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Proven ability to define architecture and lead large-scale AI programs. 
 - Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows. 
 - Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components. 
 - Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards. 
 - Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore-offshore delivery models. 

Ideally, you'll also

The following skills are preferred and add value to the role: 

- Experience with Power Platform. 
 - Experience with Azure Integration Services. 
 - Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
 - Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
 - Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

What We Look For

- Total Experience: [12+ Years]
 - Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
 - Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements. 
 - Degree in BE / B. Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience. 
 - Microsoft AI certification is preferred. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Director, Full-Stack Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees' growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world's investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. 

Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance - and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. 

We're seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Full-stack Engineer in our Custody Enterprise platform. The role is based in Pune. 

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways: 

- Lead the vision, architecture, and delivery of BNY's next-generation Corporate Actions Processing Engine, a strategic greenfield platform critical to the firm's future operations. 
 - Drive the end-to-end design and development of a scalable, resilient, and high-performance processing engine that transforms Corporate Actions capabilities across the enterprise. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership while establishing architectural standards, engineering best practices, and modern development frameworks. 
 - Influence the long-term technology strategy and roadmap for a mission-critical platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise architecture. 
 - Partner with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and operational excellence. 
 - Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Accelerate modernization efforts by leveraging emerging technologies and engineering patterns to enhance platform capabilities and future readiness. 

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following: 

Technical Skills

- 15+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years in leadership roles (e. g. Head of Engineering, Technical Lead) 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Java and frameworks like Spring Boot for building microservices

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you. 

, , JR2024865

data.title: Lead Software Engineer, Real Time Index Engineering(Java)
data.description:
FTSE Russell is a leading global provider of financial services, specialising in the creation and management of indexes, data, and analytic solutions. As part of the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), we support investors worldwide in making informed decisions across asset classes, investment strategies, and market segments. Our products are trusted by institutional and retail investors, asset managers, and pension funds to benchmark performance, build investment portfolios, and manage risk. 

Job Summary

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Real Time Framework (RTF), our low-latency, cloud-native platform for calculating, managing and distributing FTSE Russell's real-time indices at global scale, spanning Equity, Fixed Income and Multi-Asset coverage. Reliability, security, and data quality are non-negotiable as we modernise the platform that underpins our entire real-time franchise. 

The ideal candidate is a self-sufficient, technically excellent engineer who can lead through architectural clarity, thorough code review, and hands-on delivery. You combine strong expertise in low-latency, event-driven system design, data modelling, and debugging with genuine passion for how AI tooling is redefining software engineering. This is an individual contributor role where you will lead through the quality of your thinking and your engineering standards. 

AI-First Engineering This team operates with an AI-first approach. We expect hands-on experience with AI development tooling: terminal-based agents, AI-augmented IDEs, and automated workflows. You are ultimately accountable for production quality, security, and correctness. This means owning infrastructure review, security validation, system observability, and operational guardrails. 

What You'll Do

- Build low-latency, event-driven calculation engines that price indices accurately through market events. 
 - Operate a cloud-native, horizontally scalable, always-on platform, built as resilient and managed through infrastructure as code. 
 - Own data foundations for real-time market and reference data, with strong modelling, quality and auditability. 
 - Deliver secure APIs and streaming, event-driven distribution that make real-time index data easy to consume. 
 - Help bring advanced and multi-asset methodologies to market (e. g. volatility-controlled, options/futures-based, long-short). 
 - Modernise the operations experience: replace manual workflows with intuitive tooling and observability. 
 - Lead through architecture, code review and test strategy, partnering across product, operations and client-facing teams. 

Tech Stack

- Development: Java, C#, , Python, SQL, OpenAPI
 - Cloud: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora, and others as required)
 - Databases: Sybase ASE, Sybase IQ, Aurora Postgres
 - IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab
 - AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

Experience We Value

- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong expertise in system design, distributed and event-driven systems, and relational data modelling. 
 - Solid experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS. 
 - Ability to write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent). 
 - Experience designing test strategies at multiple levels of the testing pyramid. 
 - Proficiency with AI development tooling and a clear understanding of how to use AI to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality. 
 - Strong debugging skills across distributed systems. 
 - Basic understanding of financial services or capital markets. 
 - Effective collaboration and the ability to communicate technical decisions to non-technical audiences. 

How We Work

The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, solving real-world problems with purpose and ambition. We're looking for skilled and passionate engineers to drive the future of modern solutions working with leading AI development tools. 

- Build with purpose. Start with why. Define the problem before reaching for a solution.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Manager
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior, hands-on mechanical engineering leader to manage the engineering team and own final technical quality control across our engineering workstreams. These include CAD and engineering design data, simulation load cases, and reviews of FEA and CFD work used in AI development. 

You will assess whether deliverables are technically sound, supported by evidence, and ready for client delivery. The role combines broad engineering judgment with detailed technical review, guidance for engineers and external partners, and ownership of consistent quality standards as delivery scales. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own final technical review and sign-off across workstreams; identify critical issues, request corrections, and verify their resolution before delivery. 

• Review CAD models, assemblies, drawings, design changes, and engineering rationale for functional validity, consistency, and manufacturability. 

• Evaluate FEA and CFD simulation assumptions, material properties, loads, boundary conditions, mesh quality, results, and relevant modelling choices; assess convergence, physical plausibility, and whether conclusions are supported. 

• Review load-case definitions and engineering workflows for realistic use scenarios, clear documentation, and traceability between requirements, models, and outputs. 

• Define acceptance criteria and review checklists, resolve technical disagreements, and involve specialist reviewers where deeper domain expertise is needed. 

• Manage and mentor engineers, assess vendor and freelancer capability, and improve review processes to increase throughput while maintaining quality. 

• Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical requirements, discuss review findings, and explain risks and limitations; align with project leads on delivery readiness. 

REQUIREMENTS

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with 6+ years of relevant industry experience and demonstrated technical leadership at lead or head of engineering level. 

• Experience working with international teams and coordinating quality across multiple projects and external partners. 

• Strong foundations in design, engineering and manufacturing, supported by experience solving real industrial engineering problems. 

• Hands-on expertise in CAD and FEA, with sufficient breadth to evaluate CFD work alongside specialists and recognise the limits of an analysis. 

• Experience reviewing and approving other engineers' work, challenging assumptions, and making defensible technical decisions. 

• Proficiency in relevant CAD and simulation tools, such as SolidWorks, Ansys, Abaqus, Fluent, or Simcenter.

data.description:
CPU Random Tools Engineer - Grade 4

Introduction to Arm

You know us. With 125 Arm-powered products shipped every second, we'll be in over a trillion smart devices by 2035. Your smartphone, award-winning VR gaming, the world's fastest supercomputer - our engineers are crafting the sophisticated core processors leading the race towards a connected, autonomous, hyper-performance future. 

ARM designs the technology that is at the heart of sophisticated digital products, from wireless, networking and consumer entertainment solutions to imaging, automotive, security and storage devices. ARM improves people's lives by enabling the intelligence in affordable, easy-to-use electronic products that transform the way we live and work. We work in partnership with a global network of leading technology companies which are using our smart low-power technology. Together we are enabling the future of a better world. 

ARM is well recognized as the market leader in the CPU and System IP industry and this has been achieved by consistently delivering reliable and high quality IP products. The cost of design and manufacturing is high and that warrants "right first time" approach for all IP and System products. Time-to-market is essential for our partners to take care of steadfast competition in the marketplace, being first would enable them to get premium value from the end products. In this context, Design Verification of CPU IPs is an exciting challenge requiring an engineering abilities that is both broad and deep. 

So, we promise you endless exciting opportunities to experiment and go even further in CPU IP design!

Job Description: Role and Responsibilities

As an Engineer responsible for CPU Random Tools for stress verification, you will work on a sophisticated Random Instruction Sequences (RIS) tool. With a combination of techniques, the tool verifies the functionality of our CPU cores, being designed in Austin (US), Cambridge (UK) or Sophia Antipolis (FR). The existing team ensures addition of new architecture features, its customization to specific CPU cores, and provides support. 

You will be based in Arm's Bangalore design centre in India. 

As Senior Verification Engineer, your role will cover the development of the tool from development to deployment, and accountable for: 

- Understanding the intricacies of the CPU micro-architecture and defining how to push the test boundaries; 
 - Architect and develop solutions to improve the generation of stimuli to produce programs to stress our next generation CPUs; 
 - Implementing and supporting the tool, from the early stages of CPU development to product maturity. 

Job Requirements

- Problem Ownership and ability to work from abstract requirements 
 - Good communication and presentation skills 
 - Self-motivated and willing to take up additional responsibilities 
 - Quick learner with a strong desire to learn and develop new skills

Qualification And Experience

- B. Tech/B. S. or MTech/M. S. in Computer/Electronics Engineering or Computer Science from a reputed institute 
 - 5-10 years of stable proven experience with significant project contributions

Crucial Skills

- You hold experience in software design, and should be comfortable working with low-level hardware 
 - You have good solid understanding of programming languages, such as C and Python 
 - You are knowledgeable about CPU architecture and micro-architecture concepts 
 - You are able to understand assembly language (ASM) 
 - You have strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well as part of a team with the willingness to tackle varied technical challenges. 

Desirable Skills

- Fundamentals of Processor Architecture. 
 - Basics of ARM Architecture. 
 - Familiarity with EDA tools and Hardware Design Verification. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

data.description:
Job Description

The Core Engineering

Responsibilities

The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e. g. , Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm's compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm's liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc. ; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering's 2, 000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units: 

- Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm's risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions 
 - The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics 
 - Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm's financials and a wide range of reporting functions 
 - Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes 
 - Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement 
 - Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

YOUR IMPACT

Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to solve complex, mission-critical problems in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to safeguarding a leading global financial institution?

OUR IMPACT

We are The Core Engineering, a global team of engineers and scientists dedicated to preventing, detecting, and mitigating regulatory and reputational risks across Goldman Sachs. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that protect the firm and its clients. 

We Offer

- Access to petabyte scale of structured and unstructured data to fuel your AI/ML models, including textual data suitable for LLM applications. 
 - The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art LLM models and agentic framework. 
 - A collaborative environment where you can learn from and contribute to a team of experienced engineers and scientists. 
 - The chance to make a tangible impact on the firm's ability to manage risk and maintain its reputation. 

Within Compliance Engineering, we are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer to join our Engineering team. This role will focus on solving highly complex business problems using AI/ML techniques, incorporating latest emerging trends om building out vertical AI agents to run on data at massive scale. 

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential

As a member of our team, you will: 

- Design and architect scalable and reliable end-to-end AI/ML solutions specifically tailored for compliance applications, ensuring adherence to relevant regulatory requirements. This encompasses the development and implementation of GenAI-driven solutions, including agentic frameworks for automating compliance processes, RAG pipelines, and the creation and utilization of embeddings for compliance knowledge bases. 
 - Explore diverse AI/ML problems, such as model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and experimentation with different algorithmic approaches to address novel business challenges. 
 - Develop, test, and maintain high-quality, production-ready code. 
 - Lead technical projects from inception to completion, providing guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. 
 - Collaborate effectively with compliance officers, legal counsel, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards. Promote best practices for AI/ML development, including version control, testing, and documentation. 
 - Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML platforms, tools, and techniques to solve business problems. 

Qualifications

A successful candidate will possess the following attributes: 

- A Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a similar field of study. 
 - Preferably 7+ years AI/ML industry experience for Bachelor's/Masters, 4+ years for PhD with a focus on Language Models. 
 - Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, including deep learning architectures (e. g. , transformers, RNNs, CNNs) 
 - Proficiency in Python and relevant libraries/frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in GenAI techniques, including but not limited to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, AI agents, and evaluation techniques. 
 - Experience working with embedding models and vector databases. 
 - Experience with MLOps practices, including model deployment, containerization (Docker, kubernetes), CI/CD, and model monitoring. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Curiosity, ownership and willingness to work in a collaborative environment. 
 - Proven ability to mentor and guide junior engineers. 

Experience in some of the following is desired and can set you apart from other candidates: 

- Experience with Agentic Frameworks (e. g. , Langchain, AutoGen) and their application to real-world problems. 
 - Understanding of scalability and performance optimization techniques for real-time inference such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation. 
 - Experience with model interpretability techniques. 
 - Prior experience in code reviews/ architecture design for distributed systems. 
 - Experience with data governance and data quality principles. 
 - Familiarity with financial regulations and compliance requirements. 

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit to our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. We are seeking an experienced and dynamic UK Highways Design Leaders to lead the delivery of complex highway infrastructure projects for our UK business. This role combines strong technical expertise, project leadership, stakeholder management, and people leadership to drive successful project outcomes while contributing to the strategic growth and capability development of the Highways discipline. 

Responsibilities

Project & Technical Leadership

Lead the end-to-end delivery of UK highway design projects, ensuring compliance with programme, budget, quality, and client expectations. 

Serve as a technical authority for highway engineering, applying advanced engineering principles to solve complex design challenges. 

Drive technical excellence, innovation, and the adoption of industry best practices, digital delivery solutions, and emerging technologies. 

Review and approve technical designs, reports, specifications, and engineering documentation. 

Ensure designs comply with relevant UK standards, regulations, and client requirements. 

Project Management & Delivery

Monitor project performance, delivery milestones, financial targets, and quality metrics. 

Identify and manage technical, commercial, and delivery risks, implementing mitigation strategies where required. 

Ensure adherence to Quality Assurance (QA), CDM Regulations, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), and Sustainability requirements. 

Support the successful delivery of projects within agreed budgets and programme constraints.

Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing technical insight and delivery solutions. 

Support business development activities, including proposal preparation, resource planning, fee estimation, and client presentations. 

Collaborate effectively with global teams to ensure seamless project execution and knowledge sharing. 

People Leadership & Team Development

Drive capability development and career progression for early-career professionals and emerging leaders. 

Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture focused on excellence and continuous improvement. 

Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention initiatives to strengthen team capability. 

Operational & Strategic Contribution

Support discipline leadership with workforce planning, utilisation forecasting, and performance management. 

Contribute to strategic growth initiatives and the expansion of UK Highways capabilities within the GCC. 

Drive Lean and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, productivity, and operational excellence. 

Support the implementation of innovative tools, processes, and delivery methodologies. 

Qualifications

Minimum 5+ years of experience in UK Highways Design with demonstrable expertise in: 

Highway Geometry Design

Pavement Design

Road Restraint Systems

Traffic Signs and Road Markings

Site Clearance and Highway Infrastructure Design

Strong working knowledge of industry-standard software, including: 

Civil 3D

OpenRoads Designer

AutoCAD

Leading and developing technical teams

Project and resource management

UK Highways design standards and regulations

Industry trends, innovation, and digital engineering practices

This is a Permanent Role with one of Product client of TidyHire. 

Looking to hire Engineering Manager with 70% hands on and 30% people management - Should have worked on TypeScript and Python or Node. JS. 

Technical Leadership (70%)

- Lead end-to-end architecture of scalable full stack web applications - from requirements gathering to production deployment on Cloudflare edge + AWS

 - Architect and govern REST APIs, WebSocket services, and MCP server integrations across distributed systems built on NestJS/Node. js
 - Design, develop, and integrate AI-powered features using Cloudflare Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI agent frameworks
 - Deploy and manage applications on AWS (S3, Athena, k8s/EKS) - edge-first architecture
 - Drive performance optimization, scalability planning, and production reliability across multiple web apps serving internal and external users
 - Lead technical discovery and solutioning for new features, integrations, AI tooling, and platform migrations
 - Own CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in collaboration with the DevOps team - GitLab CI, conventional commits, and deployment automation
 - Conduct deep-dive code reviews and architectural walkthroughs ensuring correctness, maintainability, and TypeScript-first quality
 - Champion automated testing strategy - unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage using Jest, Vitest, and Playwright
 - Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Antigravity) to accelerate development and model best practices for the team. 

People & Delivery Management (30%)

- Lead and grow a team of 6-12 engineers - manage hiring, onboarding, and career development
 - Set clear goals, expectations, and performance benchmarks - conduct regular 1: 1s and structured performance reviews
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers toward technical leadership; build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning
 - Partner with Product Management to translate business requirements into engineering roadmaps and delivery plans
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (QA, DevOps, Design, Product) to ensure smooth delivery and consistent quality
 - Manage project timelines, dependencies, and technical risk - communicate status and blockers to leadership proactively
 - Stay current with emerging technologies - AI agents, edge computing, WebSockets, MCP - and drive continuous adoption of better engineering practices. 

Technology Skills In Order Of Priority

- TypeScript - 10+ years; deep expertise in strong typing, generics, and TypeScript-first

architecture on both frontend and backend. TypeScript is the primary language - not Python. 

- AI Agents - hands-on experience with Cloudflare Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, Flue, or similar; prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and AI-powered feature integration
 - Cloud Providers - AWS (S3, Athena, k8s/EKS) and/or Azure; hands-on infrastructure and deployment experience
 - REST APIs, WebSockets & MCP Servers - designing, governing, and consuming APIs; real-time services and Model Context Protocol server integration
 - Node. js / NestJS - backend service development, TypeScript-based REST and WebSocket APIs
 - SQL / PostgreSQL & Prisma ORM - query optimization, data modeling, schema design, and ORM-based data access
 - Git & CI/CD - GitLab CI pipelines, conventional commits, branching strategies, and release automation
 - Python - working familiarity for scripting and data tasks (deprioritized; TypeScript preferred for all APIs and services)
 - UX Engineering mindset - deep appreciation for design systems, accessibility, and UI quality; UX engineering background is a strong plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 10 - 20 years of hands-on experience in full stack development (TypeScript+Node). 
 - At least 2 years as an Engineering Manager. 
 - Proven track record of delivering large-scale, distributed, cloud-hosted applications
 - Demonstrated ability to grow and retain high-performing engineering teams
 - Strong problem-solving, system design, and architectural decision-making skills
 - Excellent communication skills - ability to translate complex technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
 - Passion for AI-powered engineering - especially agent frameworks, edge computing, and modern frontend architecture

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Switching Software Engineer to lead innovation and development of cutting-edge managed switching solutions for small and medium enterprise (SME) markets. This role requires deep technical expertise in switching software architecture and product-level understanding to drive breakthrough innovations in cost-effective, feature-rich managed switches from 10GB to 400GB targeting SME deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Product Innovation Leadership: Drive breakthrough innovations in SME-focused switching features including zero-touch provisioning, cloud-based management integration, and AI-powered network optimization
 - SME Feature Development: Lead development of enterprise-grade features optimized for SME deployments: simplified network segmentation, automated VLAN provisioning, intelligent traffic prioritization, and plug-and-play enterprise security
 - Cost-Performance Optimization: Innovate cost-effective solutions that deliver enterprise functionality at SME price points while maintaining performance
 - Customer-Driven Innovation: Lead research into SME networking pain points and develop innovative software solutions for simplified network management
 - Platform Differentiation: Drive technical differentiation through innovative features like ML-based network anomaly detection, automated capacity planning, and predictive maintenance for SME environments

 - Competitive Analysis: Lead technical competitive analysis and drive innovation to maintain market leadership in SME managed switching

SME Market Product Knowledge

- SME Network Challenges: Deep understanding of SME networking constraints including limited IT staff, budget sensitivity, and simplified management requirements
 - Market Positioning: Knowledge of SME switching market dynamics, competitive landscape, and differentiation opportunities
 - Enterprise Feature Adaptation: Expertise in adapting complex enterprise features for simplified SME deployment and management

Advanced Switching Features for SME Market

- Intelligent Auto-Configuration: Zero-touch VLAN setup, automated QoS policies, and self-configuring network segmentation
 - Cloud Integration: Seamless integration with cloud management platforms and hybrid cloud networking
 - Security Automation: Automated threat detection, network access control, and security policy enforcement optimized for SME environments
 - Performance Intelligence: ML-driven bandwidth optimization, traffic analytics, and capacity planning for growing SME networks
 - Simplified Network Virtualization: Easy-to-deploy network segmentation and micro-segmentation for SME security requirements
 - Branch Office Connectivity: Advanced SD-WAN integration, site-to-site VPN automation, and centralized branch management
 - Guest Network Management: Sophisticated guest access control with time-based policies, bandwidth limiting, and secure isolation
 - IoT Device Management: Automated IoT device discovery, classification, and policy enforcement for SME environments
 - Voice/Video Optimization: Advanced QoS for unified communications, video conferencing optimization, and real-time application prioritization
 - Network Analytics: Comprehensive network visibility, user behavior analytics, and automated reporting for SME IT teams

Innovation & Technical Leadership

- Emerging Technology Integration: Drive adoption of AI/ML, edge computing, and IoT integration in SME switching solutions
 - Patent Development: Lead development of patentable innovations in SME networking and switching technology
 - Industry Standards: Contribute to industry standards development with focus on SME networking requirements
 - Technical Thought Leadership: Represent company technical innovation at industry conferences and technical forums

Expert Technical Requirements

- Switching Architecture Mastery: Deep expertise in switching ASIC architectures optimized for SME market requirements
 - Advanced Broadcom SDK: Expert-level knowledge of Broadcom SDK optimization for cost-effective, high-performance SME solutions
 - Product-Level Systems: Advanced experience with complete product development from conception to market delivery
 - Innovation Methodologies: Experience with design thinking, rapid prototyping, and customer-driven innovation processes

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering
 - 10 to 12 years of embedded switching software development with focus on product delivery
 - 5+ years of experience developing SME networking products or similar market-focused solutions
 - Proven track record of delivering innovative networking products to market with measurable business impact
 - Experience with customer-driven innovation and market-focused product development

And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.

If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. Connected with this is an exciting career path that leads you to ever new projects and solutions in the field of IT for Siemens Mobility. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer - Java Full stack (Java + Angular + OracleDB)

You'll Make a Difference By

We are looking for a Software Developer to support Siemens Mobility's commercial tools, helping build and improve solutions that make project planning, forecasting, and financial insights more transparent and reliable. This role adds business value by enabling better decisions and clearer cost visibility, while also contributing to SMO IT's broader digital transformation. It's an important role as the need for real-time commercial insights continues to grow. Being in this position feels impactful and rewarding; you work closely with business and IT, solve real problems, and see the direct difference your work makes in global projects. 

- Development:

 - Create responsive UIs using Angular and TypeScript.

Join us and be yourself!

data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

Qualifications & Skills

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

Diversity & Inclusion

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office. 

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9. com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. 

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https: //www. five9. com/pt-pt/legal. 

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

data.title: Avionics Hardware Lead
data.description:
Company Overview

At Cosmoserve Space, we are pioneering a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through innovative technology focused on active debris removal. Our mission is to safeguard the orbital environment by developing high-tech, cost-effective solutions that lead the market in addressing the growing challenge of space debris. With a passionate team of engineers and a commitment to cutting-edge engineering, Cosmoserve is driving the next generation of responsible space activities, ensuring that the space remains accessible for future missions. 

Position: Avionics Hardware Lead

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: CEO

Location: Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Summary

We are looking for an Avionics Hardware Lead to own the onboard electronics of our spacecraft, from system specification to tested flight hardware. The role covers defining avionics requirements from mission goals and designing microcontroller-based circuits, power electronics and subsystem interfaces. The Lead will drive circuit simulation, PCB layout, component selection and testing, and ensure every board meets space-grade quality and reliability standards. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Lead will head a team of engineers, set design and documentation standards, and work closely with the GNC, AIT and QA teams to deliver reliable hardware on schedule. 

Key Responsibilities

•  Translate mission and system goals into clear avionics system specifications. 

•  Lead design and development of electronic circuits built around microcontrollers. 

•  Run circuit simulations and review PCB layouts before fabrication. 

•  Select, design and test low-power DC-DC converters and power distribution circuits. 

•  Define and implement interfaces between avionics units over serial and parallel buses, with signal conditioning using op-amps and current-to-voltage converters. 

•  Select components suitable for space applications, including qualified use of industrial-grade parts. 

•  Apply QA practices in line with MIL-STD-883, ISO and AS9100 requirements. 

•  Prepare and maintain design documents, test procedures and reports. 

•  Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of avionics engineers. 

Qualifications

Education: BE / B. Tech or M. Tech in ECE or EEE with specialisation in Electronics / Instrumentation. 

Work Experience: 8 to 10 years

Required Skill Set (Major)

•        Experience in design and development of electronic circuits with microcontrollers. 

•        Experience in preparing system specifications for system goals and functions. 

•        Good knowledge of circuit simulation in KiCad, PSpice or similar tools. 

•        Knowledge of PCB layout. 

•        Knowledge of power electronics such as low-power DC-DC converters, including selection and testing. 

•        Good knowledge of interfacing various avionics systems using serial or parallel buses, op-amps, current-to-voltage converters, etc. 

•        Knowledge of QA aspects related to MIL 1553 STD, ISO and AS standards. 

•        Good knowledge of component selection for space applications. 

•        Knowledge of building systems for space using industrial-grade components. 

•        Experience in leading a team of engineers. 

•        Good documentation aptitude. 

•          Added Advantage

1.       General knowledge of space systems for satellite building. 

2.       Firmware knowledge

Required Soft Skills

•          Ability to lead, guide and motivate a team of engineers. 

•          Strong sense of ownership from design through to testing. 

•          Clear communication with engineers, management and vendors. 

•          Works well with GNC, mechanical, AIT and QA teams. 

•          Methodical approach to debugging and root cause analysis. 

•          High attention to detail and discipline in following quality processes. 

•          Good planning and prioritisation in a fast-paced startup. 

•          Adaptable to changing requirements and limited resources. 

•          Willing to mentor juniors and give constructive design reviews.

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. 

At Tenstorrent, we build open, state of the art compute for real workloads and real developers. You will own CPU core‐level verification, shaping how our out‐of‐order RISC‐V CPUs behave in silicon. 

This role is hybrid, based out of Bangalore, India. 

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

- You bring 8+ years in CPU verification or closely related digital design.

- Plan and drive functional verification for CPU core features and complex microarchitectural scenarios.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Financial Integrity
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Team

Financial Integrity team at Rippling is on a mission to safeguard the integrity of every financial transaction across Rippling products. We operate at the intersection of finance and engineering, ensuring that all money movements across Rippling are accurate, compliant and reliable. 

The team is structured into four key focus areas: 

- Financial Crime Compliance - Ensure all Rippling financial products meet regulatory requirements across jurisdictions, maintaining strict adherence to government regulations. 
 - Credit Risk - Actively identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to fraud activities, credit exposure and financial anomalies across critical products like Payroll , EOR, COR and Spend, etc. 
 - KYC & Onboarding - Deliver a secure and seamless onboarding experience through strong KYC (Know Your Customer/Business) compliance and automation, ensuring only verified and trustworthy entities enter our ecosystem. 
 - Financial Integration Platform - Build and scale a robust integration platform that connects financial systems, internal products and external partners, enabling secure data exchange, streamlined operations and faster product expansion. 

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity for an exceptional engineering leader to build, scale and lead a high-performing team at the heart of Finance, Risk, Compliance and KYC. You will set the technical vision, drive execution and take ownership of mission-critical systems that demand uncompromising reliability, scalability and accuracy. Beyond delivering features, you will shape strategy, develop strong engineers, influence product direction and solve complex problems with measurable business impact. 

About The Role

Join Rippling as the Engineering Manager for the Financial Integrity team and shape the future of our financial platform architecture. In this high-visibility, high-impact leadership role, you will bring a founder's mindset to build and scale a world-class engineering team responsible for the mission-critical systems that power Rippling's growth. 

You will operate at the intersection of complex distributed systems and core financial strategy-balancing big-picture vision with hands-on execution. If you thrive on deep ownership, technical rigor, and developing high-performing engineers, this is your opportunity to define the foundation of financial integrity at scale. 

What You'll Do

- Lead & Empower: Build, mentor, and inspire a team of passionate engineers known for taking ownership and driving end-to-end impact. 
 - Architect & Execute: Stay hands-on with technical design, code reviews, and system architecture to ensure the delivery of resilient, complex distributed systems. 
 - Act Like an Owner: Bring a founder's mindset to challenge conventional approaches, identify growth opportunities, and define the technical roadmap across Risk and Compliance in close partnership with Product and Business leadership. 
 - Raise the Engineering Bar: Enforce engineering best practices, foster a high-performance culture of accountability, and champion automated solutions that boost operational efficiency. 
 - Scale for Growth: Build scalable systems and team structures that enable the organization to grow smoothly alongside expanding business demands. 

What you will need

We're looking for an Engineering Manager who has a strong technical-foundation, thrives in high-ownership environments and . Key expectations from the role include: 

- Technical Foundation: Candidate should have deep technical hands-on experience and sound understanding of tech and be able to guide and review effectively. 
 - Team development skills: Ability to set a roadmap and goals for a team and every one of its members, delegate intelligently, offer engineering advice, deliver frequent and transparent feedback, work with team members to grow in their careers and ensure everyone delivers quality results
 - Product Development Experience: Hands-on experience building scalable products end-to-end. Should have been closely involved in defining and delivering both small and large-scale projects. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, both within India and globally. Strong collaboration and coordination skills are essential. 
 - Execution-Driven: Should be execution-oriented with a clear understanding of how to set up roadmaps, define milestones, and drive outcomes. 
 - Experience Range: Minimum of 2-3 years in a managerial role and prior experience of 7-8 years as an Individual Contributor. Must have experience leading engineering teams and mentoring engineering with total experience of 8-12 years.

data.title: Systems Engineering Manager, CT

Job Description Summary

Managers of people from multiple families within the function. Impacts the team's ability to achieve service, quality and timeliness of objectives. The role is subject to operating policy objectives. Join a global engineering team utilizing advanced design tools and techniques to develop state-of-the-art Computed Tomography systems. Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation. 

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - RnD Enablement.
data.description:
The Opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer on Hinge Health's Service Enablement team, you will build the platforms, services, and engineering practices that other teams at Hinge Health rely on to ship software safely and quickly. 

Service Enablement treats Hinge Health engineers as its customers. The team builds paved roads, automation, and platform capabilities in developer experience, cloud and service platforms, reliability, observability, security, CI/CD, and AI/ML enablement. The goal is to remove friction, improve operational maturity, and make the default path the easiest one for product and infrastructure teams. 

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership. Expect to turn broad engineering needs into technical strategy, lead initiatives that span several teams, and set standards that get adopted beyond your own pod. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Data, ML, and Infrastructure to balance delivery speed against reliability, security, cost, and maintainability. As Hinge Health expands its use of AI across the software development lifecycle and the care platform, you will also help make those AI and ML workloads reliable, cost efficient, and responsibly run. 

The problems in this role are foundational. Fixing them makes every engineering team at Hinge Health more effective, and the software they ship helps make healthcare more accessible and affordable. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Own a multi-quarter technical roadmap for one or more Service Enablement domains, based on what internal engineering teams actually need. 
 - Lead architecture and design for highly available, secure, and maintainable platforms and services that cross pod boundaries. 
 - Build and maintain paved roads for service development, deployment, observability, reliability, and operational ownership. 
 - Improve developer productivity with automation, reusable frameworks, self-service workflows, and documentation that people can follow. 
 - Set practical standards for SLOs, alerting, incident response, capacity management, service ownership, and production readiness. 
 - Work with product and engineering teams to run AI and ML workloads reliably and cost efficiently, including inference systems where they make sense. 
 - De-risk ambiguous problems with prototypes, spikes, and experiments that produce measurable results. 
 - Write and lead RFCs, design reviews, and technical decision records. Explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Take part in production operations and eliminate recurring failure modes with systemic fixes. 
 - Deliver large initiatives from strategy through production adoption, and measure the result: platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, cost, or reduced operational toil. 
 - Mentor engineers, coach senior engineers into broader technical leadership, help with hiring, and raise the bar for engineering practice across the organization. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8: 30 pm - 10: 30pm IST). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
 - 10+ years of professional software development, or equivalent depth building and operating production systems. 
 - 4+ years with at least one modern programming language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python. 
 - 4+ years across the full software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations. 
 - 4+years of experience in cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads such as AWS, Kubernetes, or EKS. 
 - Experience in software design and distributed systems fundamentals: reliability, scalability, performance, failure modes, and API or platform contracts. 
 - Experience operating production systems, including observability, incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement. 
 - Experience treating internal platforms and developer experience as products, with attention to usability, adoption, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, Claude etc

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building internal developer platforms, service templates, golden paths, CI/CD systems, or self-service infrastructure. 
 - Experience with platform security, identity and access management, compliance controls, or secure-by-default engineering. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML teams with inference infrastructure, model serving platforms, evaluation workflows, or cost and performance optimization. 
 - Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems, workflow orchestration, service networking, or large-scale data and messaging infrastructure. 
 - Experience defining platform metrics such as adoption, deployment lead time, change failure rate, availability, developer satisfaction, or operational toil. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers or acting as technical lead for a platform migration, modernization effort, or organization-wide launch. 
 - Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare - starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care - from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation - through personalized, evidence-based care. 

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2, 550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http: //www. hingehealth. com/

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
 - Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
 - Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. 

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy. 

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth. com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth. com.
