data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Lead Software Engineer, Foundational APIs

Location: Noida, India

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, and collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue meaningful outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values: Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we are saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is establishing a Foundational APIs capability to make core business data and functionality easier to access securely, consistently, and reliably across our products and solutions. 

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will help turn this ambition into working software. You will design and build API capabilities that support product experiences, integrations, workflows, clients, and approved AI solutions without requiring consumers to understand the complexity of SimCorp's underlying systems. 

You will be a senior, hands-on member of a newly established engineering team in India. You will help the team deliver its first production capabilities, establish effective engineering practices, and make sound implementation decisions across API design, distributed systems, security, reliability, testing, and cloud engineering. 

The role requires strong technical depth and practical delivery experience. You will contribute directly to the codebase while guiding other engineers through design discussions, reviews, problem solving, and continuous improvement. 

You will collaborate with architects, Product Management, domain experts, Platform teams, and engineers across SimCorp to build capabilities that are valuable today and sustainable as the wider platform evolves. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate secure and reliable Foundational API services using C#/. NET and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Translate business and consumer requirements into clear API contracts, technical designs, and incremental implementation plans. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership through coding, design discussions, code reviews, pairing, testing, and production problem resolution. 
 - Build API capabilities around clear business use cases rather than exposing the complexity of underlying systems and legacy implementations. 
 - Work with domain experts to understand the business meaning of concepts such as portfolios, positions, transactions, cash, instruments, and settlement information. 
 - Address distributed-system concerns including latency, partial failure, retries, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, and source-system availability. 
 - Build scalable and maintainable backend services with appropriate performance, security, and reliability characteristics. 
 - Assess and reuse existing API frameworks, gateways, integration solutions, domain services, and supported interfaces before introducing new abstractions. 
 - Create adapters and service components that separate stable consumer contracts from legacy or changing underlying implementations. 
 - Support the incremental modernization of existing systems without disrupting current consumers and business processes. 
 - Establish and promote effective engineering practices covering clean code, automated testing, contract testing, secure development, observability, CI/CD, and operational readiness. 
 - Build comprehensive automated tests across unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end levels where appropriate. 
 - Help define quality controls for API changes, including compatibility, versioning, documentation, security, and production readiness. 
 - Diagnose performance bottlenecks, production issues, integration failures, and complex defects, and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Break complex engineering problems into focused, testable, and releasable increments. 
 - Collaborate with the Principal Software Engineer and architects on significant technical decisions and convert agreed direction into practical implementation. 
 - Mentor engineers through technical planning, code reviews, pairing, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. 
 - Promote shared technical ownership and help the team avoid dependency on individual specialists. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Platform, Architecture, Security, Data, and domain engineering teams to deliver integrated capabilities. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Continuously improve yourself, the team, our engineering practices, and the Foundational APIs capability. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing to and thriving in this role. We expect you to have strong expertise in several of the areas below, together with the willingness and curiosity to develop in the others. 

- More than five years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong programming experience in C# and . NET, with a good understanding of clean, maintainable, and testable code. 
 - Practical experience designing and developing REST APIs, backend services, and system integrations. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and production deployment. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated quality controls. 
 - Strong understanding of API design principles, including contracts, resource modelling, versioning, backward compatibility, pagination, filtering, and error handling. 
 - Experience designing secure backend systems using authentication, authorization, identity, access control, and secrets management. 
 - Understanding of distributed-system concerns such as latency, resilience, concurrency, partial failure, consistency, idempotency, and safe retries. 
 - Strong automated-testing skills, including unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with observability practices including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Experience with relational databases and SQL. 
 - Familiarity with messaging, event-driven architecture, service bus patterns, or streaming technologies is valuable. 
 - Experience with Domain-Driven Design or similar approaches to defining business capabilities and service boundaries is valuable. 
 - Experience working with legacy systems, modernization initiatives, adapters, or incremental migration is valuable. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to simplify complex technical problems and create maintainable solutions without introducing unnecessary abstraction. 
 - Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with security, reliability, maintainability, and long-term contract stability. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence through practical guidance and collaboration. 
 - A continuous-improvement mindset and experience working in an agile engineering environment. 
 - Experience collaborating in an international product-development organization. 
 - Strong communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken. 
 - A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field is valuable, but practical engineering experience and demonstrated capability are equally important. 
 - Interest in learning the investment-management domain and understanding the business meaning behind the capabilities being developed. 
 - Readiness to learn relevant SimCorp technologies, frameworks, and legacy environments where required. 

AI-ENABLED DEVELOPMENT

- Use approved AI tools as part of everyday engineering, development, testing, documentation, and technical-discovery workflows. 
 - Critically evaluate AI-generated code, tests, designs, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit. 
 - Help engineers understand when AI can accelerate delivery and when deeper engineering judgment and review are required. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI-assisted development can accelerate prototyping, reduce repetitive work, strengthen testing, and improve developer productivity. 
 - Ensure that AI-generated artifacts meet the same engineering, security, testing, and review standards as other contributions. 

FURTHERMORE, WE VALUE THAT YOU

- Take ownership from technical discovery through implementation, deployment, and production operation. 
 - Are curious about complex business and technical problems and seek to understand the context before proposing solutions. 
 - Can work effectively when business knowledge, implementation ownership, and technical dependencies are distributed across different teams. 
 - Are comfortable challenging assumptions constructively and changing direction when evidence supports a better approach. 
 - Lead through practical engineering contribution rather than relying on title or authority. 
 - Create a collaborative environment where engineers can raise concerns, explore alternatives, and learn from successes and failures. 
 - Identify technical debt and architectural risks and help the team address them deliberately. 
 - Focus on delivering the smallest useful capability that can be validated with a real consumer. 
 - Combine strong technical judgment with humility, openness, and respect for the expertise of others. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy: We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days, or work from the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture: An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued. 
 - Work-life balance: We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best. 
 - Empowerment: We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working. 
 - Career and growth: SimCorp offers opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations. 
 - Innovation: You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess incoming applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed. 

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non-professional details from your application. 

If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities. 

We continuously seek to improve our talent-acquisition process and make every candidate's experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. 

We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer – File System
data.description:
Role Overview

Nasuni is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to help define and build the next generation of our distributed file data platform. This role sits within the File System team, responsible for the core storage architecture powering Nasuni's cloud-native file platform. 

You will provide technical leadership across distributed file system architecture, storage protocols, metadata services, data protection, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure. You will influence long-term platform direction while remaining close enough to the technology to solve some of the most complex systems challenges in enterprise storage. 

This role is ideal for engineers who thrive at the intersection of distributed systems, performance engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and large-scale storage platforms. 

This role is not intended for engineers focused primarily on application development, front-end technologies, or isolated feature delivery. 

This role is located at Nasuni's Hyderabad Office - Hybrid 3 Days Onsite per week. 

Level & Scope Definition

You Will

- Own architectural decisions spanning multiple subsystems
 - Lead technical strategy for distributed storage and file services
 - Drive platform scalability, resilience, and operational excellence
 - Influence engineering standards across multiple teams
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders
 - Balance long-term architecture investments with near-term delivery goals

Responsibilities

- Define architecture and technical direction for Nasuni's distributed file system platform
 - Lead design and implementation of core storage services including metadata, snapshots, caching, replication, and recovery
 - Drive evolution of NFS, SMB, and S3 access services
 - Establish scalability, performance, and reliability standards across the platform
 - Partner with Platform, Control Plane, Security, and Infrastructure teams on system-wide initiatives
 - Guide architectural reviews and technical decision-making
 - Lead resolution of complex production and performance challenges
 - Improve engineering productivity through automation, observability, and modern development practices
 - Utilize AI-assisted engineering workflows where appropriate to accelerate development, troubleshooting, analysis, documentation, and testing while maintaining accountability for quality and security
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to technical talent development

Expected Outcomes & Impact

- Improve platform scalability and resilience for enterprise workloads
 - Influence multi-year architecture decisions across the storage platform
 - Reduce operational complexity through automation and platform improvements
 - Accelerate engineering velocity while maintaining reliability standards
 - Raise technical excellence across the File System organization

Qualifications

Must Have

- 12+ years of software engineering experience focused on systems programming
 - Deep expertise in C and C++
 - Significant experience designing distributed systems at scale
 - Strong understanding of file system internals, POSIX semantics, VFS, metadata services, and storage architectures
 - Experience with Kubernetes-based distributed platforms
 - Experience leading architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams
 - Experience with NFS, SMB, S3, or related storage protocols
 - Proven ownership of large-scale technical initiatives from design through production

Preferred

- Experience with cloud-native storage platforms
 - Linux kernel, FUSE, or eBPF experience
 - Consensus systems and distributed coordination
 - High availability architectures
 - Performance engineering and storage benchmarking
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and technical leads

Ideal

- Experience building enterprise-scale file systems

 - AI workflow optimization experience for software development and platform engineering

Experience Guidelines

- 10-15+ years total software engineering experience

 - 3+ years leading architecture or technical direction across multiple teams

AI at Nasuni

AI at Nasuni is used to improve efficiency, decision-making, and engineering outcomes. In this role, you will be expected to leverage AI tools for code generation, debugging, architecture analysis, documentation, testing, and workflow automation while applying strong engineering judgment, validation, security awareness, and ownership. AI is a productivity multiplier, not a substitute for technical expertise. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform-turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why Work at Nasuni - Hyderabad / India

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders-cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a fast-growing company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. You'll innovate at the intersection of cloud, AI, and enterprise data infrastructure, collaborate with talented teams, and build modern platforms trusted by enterprises worldwide. Join us in Hyderabad and help shape the future of intelligent, AI-ready data management. 

Benefits

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career: 

- Competitive compensation programs

 - Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
 - Hybrid and flexible work arrangements

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

data.description:
Principal Software Engineer, Foundational APIs

Location: Noida, India

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, and collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue meaningful outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values: Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we are saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is establishing a Foundational APIs capability to make core business data and functionality easier to access securely, consistently, and reliably across our products and solutions. 

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a central role in shaping this capability. You will help define and build stable, reusable API contracts that enable product experiences, integrations, workflows, clients, and approved AI solutions to interact with SimCorp's business capabilities without needing to understand the complexity of the underlying systems. 

This is not a role focused only on defining standards or producing architecture. You will work hands-on with engineers, architects, product leaders, domain experts, and existing platform teams to turn technical direction into production-quality software. You will help the team reuse existing API infrastructure and domain capabilities where appropriate, progressively abstract legacy implementations, and avoid creating unnecessary layers or duplication. 

You will join a newly established team in India and help deliver its first production capabilities. The role provides an opportunity to influence architecture, engineering practices, technical direction, and the way API capabilities are developed and adopted across SimCorp. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Lead the technical design and implementation of SimCorp's Foundational APIs. 
 - Work hands-on with engineering teams to build secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable services using C#/. NET and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Translate real consumer and business needs into focused API capabilities with clear outcomes and measurable release criteria. 
 - Design stable and reusable API contracts that represent meaningful business capabilities rather than exposing the complexity of underlying systems. 
 - Collaborate with domain experts to establish clear and consistent meaning for shared concepts such as portfolios, positions, transactions, cash, instruments, and settlement information. 
 - Evaluate and make pragmatic decisions across REST, GraphQL, messaging, and other integration approaches based on the needs of each capability. 
 - Make API behavior explicit across business dates, data freshness, pagination, filtering, precision, missing information, partial results, and error handling. 
 - Design for distributed-system concerns including latency, partial failures, retries, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, and source-system availability. 
 - Help separate stable consumer contracts from underlying implementations so that systems can evolve or be progressively replaced without unnecessary consumer impact. 
 - Assess and reuse existing API frameworks, gateways, services, integration solutions, and domain capabilities before introducing new abstractions or infrastructure. 
 - Work with legacy systems and supported interfaces, using adapters and incremental modernization patterns where appropriate. 
 - Contribute directly to critical implementation areas, technical spikes, reference implementations, automated tests, deployment pipelines, and complex problem resolution. 
 - Establish and promote engineering practices covering clean code, automated testing, contract testing, compatibility validation, security, observability, CI/CD, and production readiness. 
 - Review architecture, technical designs, and code, providing constructive feedback that raises the engineering quality of the team. 
 - Lead by example, helping engineers decompose complex problems into incremental, testable, and releasable capabilities. 
 - Create reusable implementation patterns, templates, documentation, and examples that make it easier for other teams to contribute consistently. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Platform, Security, Data, and domain engineering teams across SimCorp. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, dependencies, limitations, and risks clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers and strengthen technical leadership within the team through design discussions, pairing, code reviews, and practical engineering guidance. 
 - Continuously learn and develop yourself, the team, and the Foundational APIs capability. 

What We Value

- Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed is less important. We expect you to be strong in several of the following areas and interested in learning the rest: 
 - Extensive experience designing and building production software using C# and . NET. 
 - Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, and Azure DevOps. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and developing REST APIs and distributed services. 
 - Experience with GraphQL, messaging, or event-driven architecture is valuable, but not mandatory. 
 - Strong understanding of API design principles, including contract design, versioning, backward compatibility, pagination, filtering, error handling, and documentation. 
 - Experience building observable and supportable services using logs, metrics, tracing, health monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed-system challenges such as latency, resilience, partial failure, concurrency, idempotency, consistency, and safe retry behavior. 
 - Experience creating and managing CI/CD pipelines and automated quality controls. 
 - Strong automated-testing skills, including unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with relational databases and SQL. 
 - Experience applying Domain-Driven Design or similar techniques to define clear business capabilities and service boundaries. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy systems through adapters, incremental refactoring, progressive migration, or cloud adoption. 
 - Ability to simplify complex architectures and create maintainable solutions without introducing unnecessary abstraction. 
 - Ability to evaluate existing systems and frameworks critically before deciding to build something new. 
 - Strong architectural judgment combined with the willingness and ability to contribute hands-on to implementation. 
 - Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term maintainability, reliability, and contract stability. 
 - Ability to mentor and guide engineers toward technical excellence and effective delivery without becoming a bottleneck for decisions. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across product, business, architecture, and engineering domains. 
 - Experience working in a multinational product-development organization. 
 - Interest in learning the investment-management domain and understanding the business meaning behind the APIs being developed. 
 - Readiness to learn relevant SimCorp technologies, frameworks, and legacy environments where required. 
 - An M. Sc. or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field is valuable but not essential. 
 - Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. 

AI-ENABLED DEVELOPMENT

- Use approved AI tools fluently as part of everyday engineering, discovery, development, testing, and documentation workflows. 
 - Critically evaluate AI-generated code, designs, tests, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit. 
 - Help the team use AI responsibly, including understanding when AI-generated output can accelerate delivery and when deeper engineering review is required. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI can reduce low-value work, improve developer productivity, and accelerate prototyping and technical discovery. 
 - Help ensure that APIs intended for approved AI consumers apply the same identity, authorization, business rules, auditability, and operational controls as other consumers. 

FURTHERMORE, WE VALUE THAT YOU

- Are curious about complex business and technical problems and willing to examine assumptions before proposing a solution. 
 - Are comfortable working in an evolving area where business meaning, source-system ownership, implementation, and priorities may be distributed across multiple teams. 
 - Can influence technical direction across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority. 
 - Take ownership of outcomes and remain engaged from discovery through implementation and production operation. 
 - Challenge unnecessary complexity and help teams focus on the smallest useful capability that can be validated with a real consumer. 
 - Learn through experimentation and use insights from both successes and failures to improve future decisions. 
 - Can identify technical debt, architectural risk, and operational weaknesses and help the team address them deliberately. 
 - Value collaboration and knowledge sharing and actively help other engineers grow. 
 - Combine strong technical opinions with openness to evidence, alternative perspectives, and changing circumstances. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy: We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days or work from the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture: An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued. 
 - Work-life balance: We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best. 
 - Empowerment: We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working. 
 - Career and growth: SimCorp provides opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations. 
 - Innovation: You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, technical modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed. 

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non-professional details from your application. 

If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities. 

We continuously seek to improve our talent-acquisition process and make every candidate's experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. 

We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
The Foundry platform is a federation of six squads - Sizer, DES, GCM, Emulator, Layout Designer and Applied AI - each owning their mission autonomously. The Platform / Integration Principal is the technical authority that holds this federation together: you own the cross-squad contracts, define the API boundaries that allow squads to evolve independently, and set the architecture that will scale the platform from an internal tool to a customer-facing product used by System Integrators. You operate at the highest individual-contributor level in Foundry - no engineering management, pure technical leadership - and your decisions have multi-year consequences. You are the go-to authority on platform architecture, will represent Foundry in external technical discussions with SI partners, and will set the engineering standard the rest of the organisation aspires to. 

What You'll Do

- Own the cross-squad integration contracts - Define and maintain the interface contracts between squads: the DES↔Sizer reverse-flow (cycle times back into sizing), the DES→Emulator handoff (simulation state to virtual commissioning), and the SI-partner API platform; ensure contracts are versioned, tested and backward-compatible. 
 - Architect the Layout Service - Design and own the Layout Service: the shared representation of a warehouse design that the Layout Designer, DES and Emulator all read from and write to; define its schema, versioning model and access patterns. 
 - Define the SI-partner API platform - Design the external REST/gRPC API that System Integrators (Dematic, Sistemo, Envista) use to submit solutioning requests, receive results and embed Foundry capabilities in their own tools. Set the technical-debt and scalability strategy - Identify the current architectural constraints that will limit growth; propose and sequence remediation with minimal disruption to squad delivery. 
 - Lead architecture review - Chair the cross-squad architecture review process; approve or challenge architectural decisions that cross squad boundaries; author and maintain the Architecture Decision Record (ADR) library. 
 - Represent Foundry in external technical discussions - Participate in technical discovery sessions with SI partners; understand their integration needs and translate them into platform requirements. 
 - Mentor Principal/Staff and Staff engineers - Raise the technical ceiling of the organisation through code review, design critique, pairing and written guidance; be the person engineers go to for the hardest problems. 
 - Drive hiring quality - Participate in technical interviews; define what 'principal-level' means in Foundry; help calibrate the bar. 

Minimum (required) Qualifications

- 15+ years professional software engineering. 
 - Deep experience designing platform APIs at scale: REST and gRPC; multi-tenant, versioned, backward-compatible. 
 - Experience architecting distributed systems used by multiple consuming teams. 
 - Track record of cross-team architectural leadership: ADRs, design reviews, technical standards. 
 - Experience with B2B SaaS, partner/SI API platforms or developer-facing products. 
 - Strong written communication: can produce an ADR that a squad understands and can implement from. 
 - Mentoring experience at Staff and Principal level. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with warehouse automation, robotics, industrial IoT or AMR fleet management platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Rust + Erlang interoperability - the Foundry simulation and control stacks. 
 - Experience designing event-driven integration architectures (event sourcing, CQRS, saga patterns). 
 - Background in building integration platforms consumed by enterprise SI / ISV partners. 
 - Experience with developer experience (DX) design: SDKs, API documentation, sandbox environments. 
 - Familiarity with multi-agent AI architectures interacting with backend platform APIs. 
 - Prior Principal Engineer or Distinguished Engineer scope at a technology company. 

Technical Qualifications

- We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge. 
 - Platform API: REST (OpenAPI 3. x) and gRPC (Protobuf) at scale; API versioning strategies (URL, header, content-type); backward-compatibility guarantees and sunset policies. 
 - Integration patterns: event-driven architecture (Kafka / Pub/Sub); saga pattern for multi-squad transactions; outbox pattern for reliable event publishing; circuit breakers and bulkheads. 
 - Data architecture: schema evolution (Avro / Protobuf compatibility rules); distributed schema registry; the Layout Service data model (graph-based warehouse representation). 
 - Languages: Java or Go (primary for platform services); Rust reading ability; Python for tooling. 
 - Infrastructure: GCP (GKE, Cloud Spanner for global consistency, Pub/Sub, IAM); Terraform; Backstage as the service catalog and API portal. 
 - Security: OAuth 2. 0 / OIDC for partner authentication; fine-grained RBAC for multi-tenant access; API key lifecycle management; secrets management via GCP Secret Manager. 
 - Observability: distributed tracing across squad boundaries (OpenTelemetry); SLO definition and error-budget tracking; Grafana dashboards for the integration layer; OneUptime for on-call. 
 - Developer experience: OpenAPI-generated SDKs; Postman / API sandbox; developer-portal integration via Backstage. 
 - Testing: contract tests (Pact or custom); chaos engineering (fault injection in the integration layer); load testing for SI partner API endpoints. 

How We Work

- You report to the Senior Director and operate across all squads. 
 - You do not manage people - you lead through technical authority and the quality of your written and spoken reasoning. You are the primary decision-maker for decisions that cross squad boundaries (one-way-door calls in our decision framework) and you chair the architecture review process. 
 - You are expected to be available for cross-squad unblocking quickly and to produce written ADRs for every significant architectural decision.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontier Security Team
data.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. 

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Frontier Security AI team. Snowflake's Frontier Security AI teams develop production-grade LLM applications, intelligent agents, AI infrastructure, and evaluation systems for enterprise customers - products that must meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and efficiency while operating over sensitive data at large scale. In this role, you will lead the design and development of our Agentic Harness and agent evaluation platform, working across product, infrastructure, applied AI, security, and modeling teams to take new capabilities from prototype to dependable customer value. 

AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: 

- Architect and build the Agentic Harness that executes complex, multi-step AI workflows across models, tools, data, and services. 
 - Design stable interfaces for tool execution, context construction, state management, memory, permissions, retries, fallbacks, and human review. 
 - Own agent quality end to end by building evaluation harnesses, representative datasets, automated graders, experiment pipelines, and release gates. 
 - Convert ambiguous reports such as "the agent feels worse" into measurable failure modes, reproducible tests, and durable fixes. 
 - Analyze production agent trajectories to identify failures in reasoning, retrieval, tool use, context, orchestration, and application code. 
 - Close the loop between production incidents, root-cause analysis, evaluation coverage, and regression prevention. 
 - Develop offline and online measurements for task completion, correctness, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Build simulation and replay infrastructure for golden-set tests, adversarial scenarios, model comparisons, and large-scale experiments. 
 - Improve agent efficiency through model routing, prompt and semantic caching, context compaction, tool-result management, and token optimization. 
 - Productionize new model capabilities as secure, observable, multi-tenant services with clear operational controls. 
 - Establish standards for evaluation design, including sampling, ground-truth quality, grader calibration, leakage prevention, and statistical significance. 
 - Define technical direction across multiple teams and lead projects whose scope extends beyond a single service. 
 - Mentor engineers, raise the quality of architecture reviews, and remain directly involved in implementation and debugging. 

OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE: 

- 9+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex production systems. 
 - Direct experience shipping and operating LLM applications, AI agents, or model-backed workflows in production. 
 - Strong background in distributed systems, service architecture, high-throughput APIs, concurrency, and failure handling. 
 - Experience building an agent runtime, workflow engine, developer platform, evaluation system, or similar infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate nondeterministic systems without relying on a single aggregate score. 
 - Fluency in Python and strong proficiency in at least one systems or application language such as Java, Go, Rust, or TypeScript. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, structured generation, retrieval, context engineering, prompt management, and model APIs. 
 - Experience with production observability, including structured traces, replay, metrics, logs, and incident diagnosis. 
 - Ability to balance agent quality with latency, reliability, security, and inference cost. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction and delivering results across organizational boundaries. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, product, and leadership audiences. 

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING: 

- Building evaluation or observability infrastructure for agentic coding, data engineering, or analytics systems. 
 - Designing human-evaluation programs, scoring rubrics, annotation workflows, or grader-calibration methods. 
 - Working with multi-agent orchestration, long-running agents, asynchronous workflows, or durable execution. 
 - Developing synthetic tasks, simulations, adversarial tests, red-team exercises, or safety guardrails. 
 - Building retrieval systems that use vector search, hybrid search, semantic indexing, ranking, or caching. 
 - Operating multi-tenant systems that process sensitive enterprise data. 
 - Working with model training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or feedback-driven optimization. 
 - Evaluating and onboarding frontier models based on measured product outcomes. 
 - Experience with databases, SQL engines, data platforms, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure. 

YOU MAY BE A PARTICULARLY GOOD FIT IF YOU: 

- Treat evaluation as part of product engineering rather than a final validation step. 
 - Can move between agent behavior, distributed infrastructure, data analysis, and production debugging. 
 - Question metrics that do not reconcile and design tests that can expose misleading results. 
 - Take ownership from early architecture through deployment, operations, and measurable customer outcomes. 
 - Prefer evidence from representative tasks and production behavior over isolated benchmark results. 
 - Work effectively in fast-moving environments where requirements develop through experimentation. 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. 

How do you want to make your impact?

Role : Backend and Algorithm Engineer. 

Level: Mid-level, Individual Contributor

-

Experience: 4+ years

-

About The Role

We build a data-driven platform that optimizes compressed air systems - compressors - under real-world operating constraints, including stability, safety, and performance. The algorithms this team develops translate live sensor data into operating decisions that reduce energy consumption, lower emissions, and generate cost savings for customers. 

This role carries end-to-end ownership of algorithms: from the mathematical and control logic that determines how a compressor should behave, through to the production service that executes that decision continuously and safely in the field. For this hire, we are prioritizing engineering strength. We are seeking a candidate whose existing practices already reflect a rigorous, test-first, strongly typed approach to software, so that onboarding time is spent on domain context rather than on foundational engineering habits. 

Responsibilities

- Build and maintain production-grade Python services and automated pipelines to a consistently high standard of testing, type safety, and reliability. 
 - Design and implement optimization and control logic that translates physical and operational constraints into decisions executed by real compressors. 
 - Fit and calibrate models against noisy, real-world sensor data, exercising sound judgment about when a given fit or result cannot be trusted, such as in the presence of outliers, edge cases, or boundary behavior. 
 - Write tests prior to implementation as standard practice, using shared, reusable test fixtures rather than ad hoc, hardcoded test data. 
 - Carry projects from design through automated verification to production deployment, in close collaboration with a distributed core engineering team. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience building and shipping production Python systems, with demonstrated proficiency in type-hinted code and schema-first data models, as opposed to unstructured data passed between functions. 
 - Strong testing discipline, including test-first development, well-structured and reusable test fixtures, and a consistently high standard of test coverage as an established practice rather than an aspirational goal. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own a service across its full lifecycle: containerized, deployed through an automated pipeline, and operated within an orchestrated, multi-service infrastructure. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases and at least one caching or eventing layer in a production environment. 
 - Familiarity with modern, reproducible dependency management practices for Python, in contrast to less structured approaches to package installation. 
 - Strong applied problem-solving ability in optimization or control logic, with demonstrated capacity to translate physical or operational constraints, such as stability, safety, or performance limits, into functioning algorithms rather than relying solely on off-the-shelf models. 
 - Experience fitting or calibrating models against real-world, noisy data, with sound judgment regarding the reliability of results. 
 - A disciplined approach to data and experimentation, including reproducible results, appropriate training and validation practices for time-ordered data, and awareness of data leakage risks. 
 - Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with a distributed team across time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with more than one cloud provider, or genuine interest in cloud migration work. 
 - Experience with workflow or pipeline orchestration systems, beyond request-response APIs. 
 - Academic or professional background in a physical or engineering discipline relevant to rotating or reciprocating machinery - thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, or mechanical/industrial systems - compressors being one example. 
 - Hands-on machine learning experience, which is valuable but secondary to the optimization and control skill set described above. 
 - An advanced degree in a quantitative or engineering field.

Full Chip Timing Closure

STA Signoff

Timing Constraints (SDC)

Timing ECO Methodologies

Advanced Node Timing Signoff

Clock Architecture and Clock Implementation

MCMM Timing Analysis

DFT Timing and MBIST Timing Verification

Hands-on experience with Synopsys PrimeTime (PT) and GCA. 

Experience with Fusion Compiler and/or ICC2 is highly desirable. 

Strong understanding of floorplanning, placement, CTS and routing interactions with timing.

data.title: Senior Devops Engineer-AWS & AI tool
data.description:
Role Description

Architecture & Builder Mode

- AWS solution architecture. Translate workloads and non-functional requirements into AWS architectures covering accounts, networking, compute, storage, data services, identity, security, observability, resilience, and cost. Maintain clear conceptual, logical, and physical deployment designs. 
 - Infrastructure as code. Design and implement reusable, version-controlled infrastructure using Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or approved equivalents. Establish environment consistency, state management, code review, policy checks, and controlled promotion. 
 - Cloud-native platforms. Lead deployment of containerized and serverless workloads using services such as ECS, EKS, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, and appropriate managed services. Select technologies based on workload needs, operational complexity, and cost. 
 - CI/CD and release engineering. Build secure, repeatable pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery. Own build, test, artifact, scanning, deployment, approval, rollback, and release automation patterns across environments. 
 - AI-DLC enablement. Use Claude Code, Codex, or comparable tools to accelerate IaC, pipeline development, scripting, documentation, and troubleshooting. Define safe agent permissions, review gates, and policies for AI-generated infrastructure changes. 
 - End-to-end platform delivery. Own platform workstreams from discovery and design through provisioning, integration, testing, production rollout, and operational handover. Coordinate with application, architecture, security, networking, QA, and customer teams. 

Firefighter Mode

- A deployment fails before a customer milestone. You trace the pipeline, artifact, configuration, and infrastructure dependencies, restore a safe deployment path, and communicate the recovery plan. 
 - An application is unreachable or unstable in AWS. You investigate DNS, routing, security groups, IAM, load balancing, compute, and service telemetry to identify the cause and coordinate a verified fix. 
 - A production environment shows rising latency, error rates, or infrastructure cost. You use operational evidence to isolate the issue, implement appropriate scaling or optimization, and measure the result. 
 - An AI-generated Terraform or pipeline change introduces security or deployment risk. You block unsafe promotion, review the proposed changes, remediate the issue, and improve the automated guardrails. 

Systems Thinker Mode

- Secure cloud foundations. Establish account and environment isolation, VPC/network design, least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets management, logging, and approved connectivity. Partner with security and governance teams on policies and risk remediation. 
 - Reliability and operations. Design for availability, fault isolation, scaling, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery requirements. Establish SLOs where appropriate, monitoring, ing, runbooks, incident response, and tested recovery procedures. 
 - Platform standardization. Create reusable IaC modules, pipeline templates, container standards, environment baselines, and self-service patterns that reduce manual effort while preserving governance and traceability. 
 - Team enablement. Mentor DevOps and application engineers, review infrastructure designs and code, define ownership and operating procedures, and help teams adopt cloud and AI-DLC practices safely and independently. 
 - Delivery and cost accountability. Own technical dependencies, capacity, release readiness, and platform risks. Track deployment frequency, failure/recovery trends, infrastructure drift, service reliability, and cost; make optimization decisions using measurable evidence. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Experience. Typically 7+ years in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering, including at least 2 years leading technical delivery or cloud/platform architecture. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered. 
 - Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is an advantage. 
 - AWS and DevOps expertise. Strong hands-on experience designing and operating production AWS environments, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, Linux, networking, security, containers, scripting, and operational troubleshooting. 
 - Leadership and delivery. Proven ability to guide engineers, own infrastructure and deployment decisions, coordinate with application and security teams, and deliver production platforms with clear operational accountability. 

Technical Toolkit

We value demonstrated technical depth and the ability to learn adjacent technologies-not superficial familiarity with every tool listed below. 

- AWS architecture and networking. AWS Organizations/Control Tower familiarity, IAM, VPC, subnets, routing, security groups, VPC endpoints, Transit Gateway or VPN/Direct Connect where applicable, Route 53, load balancers, and AWS networking/security fundamentals. 
 - Compute, containers and serverless. EC2, ECS/Fargate, EKS/Kubernetes, ECR, Lambda, API Gateway, autoscaling, and appropriate managed storage/data services such as S3, RDS, or DynamoDB. Strong Docker and container troubleshooting experience. 
 - Infrastructure and automation. Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or comparable IaC; Bash and Python scripting; Git, reusable modules, environment/state management, infrastructure testing, and drift detection. 
 - CI/CD and DevSecOps. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild, or comparable platforms; artifact management, automated testing, security scanning, policy-as-code, secrets handling, approvals, and deployment strategies. 
 - Security and operations. IAM least privilege, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, or approved equivalents; observability, ing, incident response, backup/recovery, and cost optimization. 
 - Cloud-native architecture. High availability, disaster recovery, infrastructure resilience, service networking, event-driven integration, deployment patterns, and AWS Well-Architected principles. Familiarity with Bedrock, SageMaker, or AI workload infrastructure is an advantage. 
 - AI-first engineering. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or comparable tools; specification-driven infrastructure development, agent instructions/skills, approved tool access, context engineering, and human-verified automation. 

Skills

AWS, CI/CD, Kubernetes, AI tool

data.description:

Position Summary

AWS Architect-Lead Software Engineer II

Enterprise Performance

Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.

Level: Architect or equivalent

As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. 

Work you'll do

As a Lead Software Engineer II on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for: 

- Design, implement, and secure cloud-native architectures on Amazon Web Services (AWS) that support scalable, resilient, and audit-ready business solutions. 
 - Lead the development of advanced solutions involving generative artificial intelligence (AI), including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-based orchestration, and secure integration of large language model (LLM) services. 
 - Define and implement networking and security architectures across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including segmentation, encryption, identity controls, and secure connectivity patterns. 
 - Collaborate with solution architects, security architects, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with functional, operational, and compliance requirements. 
 - Establish architecture standards for high availability, observability, deployment automation, and performance optimization across application, data, and platform components. 

The team

The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients' toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations. 

Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, based on business requirements

Qualifications

Required: 

- 10+ years of experience designing and implementing secure, scalable architectures on Amazon Web Services (AWS), including cloud, data, and networking services. 
 - Experience deploying generative artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agent-based solutions in production environments. 
 - Experience designing AWS network architectures using Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC), AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Direct Connect, virtual private network (VPN), AWS PrivateLink, network access control lists (NACLs), and security groups. 
 - Experience implementing AWS security controls using Identity and Access Management (IAM), Key Management Service (KMS), AWS Secrets Manager, single sign-on (SSO), Amazon GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, AWS CloudTrail, AWS Shield, and AWS WAF. 
 - Experience designing distributed or cloud-native architectures, including event-driven systems, batch or streaming patterns, hybrid cloud, multi-region deployments, application programming interfaces (APIs), and monitoring or logging integrations. 
 - Experience using Python, Node. js, Bash, or Java, and infrastructure automation tools such as AWS CloudFormation, AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), or Terraform. 
 - Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Technology, or equivalent degree from an accredited university. 

Preferred: 

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification. 

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

 - Proficiency in data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling to derive actionable insights from complex datasets is an added advantage

Requirements

- PhD /Masters in Applied Mechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Microelectronics or Electrical and Electronics Engineering
 - 6-8 years RDA experience in the semiconductor industry working in the process development for Equipment/Applications
 - 6 - 8 years of experience in RDA Defect, semiconductor optical and electron beam inspection methods and e-beam technologies
 - Exposure in various tools like Klarity, JMP and deep understanding of defect mechanisms leading to failures
 - Proactive and passionate about learning and mentoring your team, and a leader drawn to creative problem solving and innovative solutions, will investigate process anomalies, root cause analysis, data manipulation, and correlations

data.description:
Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. Looking for a challenging role?

If you really want to make a difference, make it with us!

Job Summary

Lead and oversee Quality Control and testing operations for Medium Voltage (MV) Air Insulated Switchgear (AIS) panels, ensuring compliance with applicable quality standards, electrical safety regulations, and customer specifications. The role involves technical leadership, team management, quality assurance, testing operations, continuous improvement, and customer coordination. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership

- Lead and coordinate testing activities for MV AIS panels, typically in the 3. 3 kV to 36 kV range. 
 - Review and approve test procedures, protocols, and test reports. 
 - Analyze test results and troubleshoot complex technical issues during testing. 
 - Ensure adherence to technical specifications and applicable testing standards. 2. Team Management

- Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of test engineers and technicians. 
 - Allocate resources and schedule testing activities to achieve operational targets. 
 - Conduct performance evaluations and identify training requirements. 
 - Ensure adherence to safety procedures while maintaining team productivity and morale, particularly during high-pressure situations. 3. Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement

- Ensure compliance with relevant IEC, IEEE, and other applicable standards. 
 - Maintain testing equipment calibration, accuracy, and reliability. 
 - Implement quality control measures and validate testing documentation. 
 - Monitor monthly Factory Routine Test (FRT) and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) data and publish key performance indicators (KPIs). 
 - Collect and analyze error data and provide feedback to relevant departments to improve engineering inputs, drawings, and vendor workmanship. 
 - Monitor and control post-dispatch non-conformities (NCC) and site complaints within defined limits. 
 - Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects. 4. Project and Customer Management

- Coordinate with project managers to align testing schedules with project requirements. 
 - Monitor testing progress, resource utilization, budgets, and timelines. 
 - Coordinate with customers during witness testing and Factory Acceptance Tests. 
 - Ensure timely completion of testing activities and resolution of technical issues. 5. Audits and Compliance

- Participate in internal and external ISO audits, EHS audits, Energy Management System (EnMS) audits, and factory approval audits. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems and audit requirements. 
 - Maintain accurate testing and quality documentation. 6. Environment, Health and Safety (EHS)

- Ensure EHS compliance across shop-floor testing activities. 
 - Maintain records of safety training for testing engineers and technicians. 
 - Maintain safety and compliance documentation for service providers. 
 - Ensure adherence to Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA), Permit to Work (PTW), Toolbox Talks (TBT), and Last-Minute Risk Assessment (LMRA) processes. 
 - Promote electrical safety, arc-flash awareness, and safe working practices. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering. 
 - Additional certifications in switchgear testing are preferred. Experience

- 8-16 years of experience in MV switchgear testing. 
 - 3-5 years of experience in a team leadership or supervisory role. 
 - Strong background in electrical power distribution systems. Technical Skills

- Expertise in MV switchgear testing procedures and protocols. 
 - Hands-on experience with electrical testing equipment and tools. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 62271, IEEE C37 series, and other relevant standards. 
 - Understanding of protection relay systems and switchgear control schemes. 
 - Experience in test documentation, reporting, and data analysis. Leadership and Behavioral Competencies

- Strong team leadership and people management skills. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Effective communication and stakeholder management. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines under pressure. Safety Requirements

- Knowledge of electrical safety procedures and arc-flash safety protocols. 
 - Advanced electrical safety certification preferred. 
 - First aid and emergency response training preferred. 
 - Familiarity with electrical safety work permits and safe working procedures. Additional Requirements

- Willingness to travel for customer witness testing when required. 
 - Flexibility to work extended hours based on operational requirements. 
 - Proficiency in test report documentation and analysis tools. 

About Us

We're Siemens. A collection of over 379, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time, in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to build and optimize our core Ubuntu Linux GUI desktop application that powers our next-generation medical imaging devices. You will sit at the intersection of high-performance software engineering and medical hardware, processing live, raw X-ray data streams, executing real-time image processing, and orchestrating multi-threaded communication with complex physical hardware. 

If you love writing highly optimized C++ code, working close to the metal, and knowing your code directly impacts patient diagnostics and lives, this role is for you. 

What You Will Do

- Real-Time Data Processing: Build features to acquire raw X-ray frames directly from detectors, process them in real time using image processing libraries, and render them with ultra-low latency onto high-resolution monitors. 
 - Low-Level Hardware Integration: Interface the GUI application with complex external medical modules (X-ray Generators, Collimators, and Capacitive Touch Panels) over Serial (RS232/RS485), CAN 2. 0, and Ethernet communication protocols. 
 - Performance Engineering: Debug, profile, and push the performance boundaries of the Ubuntu Linux desktop app utilizing robust multi-threading techniques. 
 - Core Application Architecture: Own medical app workflows, including Patient Image Database Management, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and standard DICOM / PACS network and report generation configurations. 
 - Remote & Cloud Features: Implement robust, secure pipelines for remote access control, diagnostics, and secure over-the-air (OTA) software upgrades. 
 - Quality & Automation: Author comprehensive test plans, scripts, and build your own hardware-in-the-loop validation tools using Python. What We Are Looking For (Requirements)

- Education: BE/BTech or ME/MTech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, or Biomedical Engineering. 
 - C++ Expertise: 2 to 5 years of professional experience developing high-performance GUI desktop applications natively on Ubuntu Linux. 
 - Systems Architecture: Comfort using building systems and compilers like CMake, GCC, or ICC. 
 - Hardware Literacy: Direct experience handling physical serial interfaces and debugging hardware interactions using tools like Digital Storage Oscilloscopes etc. 
 - High-Quality Practices: Experience moving through the entire Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), adhering to rigorous quality assurance standards. Nice-to-Haves

- Experience navigating regulatory compliance frameworks or cybersecurity standards for medical devices. 
 - Familiarity using AI Prompt Engineering to accelerate debugging, documentation, and test script automation.

We take smart risks and Innovate Boldly, setting new standards and learning from every experience. Integrity First is our cornerstone-we value humility, authenticity, and respect for diversity, building trust in all we do. We Embrace Curiosity by empowering you to experiment, learn, and grow in a dynamic environment. At Cyara, our values drive us forward, shaping a culture where innovation and excellence thrive.

At Cyara, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace that embodies equal opportunity and champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). By celebrating our differences and championing inclusivity, we enrich our organization, make more thoughtful decisions, and drive collective success. 

Job Function Description: 
As a Senior Engineering Manager at Cyara, you will lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for delivering innovative, cloud-native software powering mission-critical customer engagement solutions. Working with globally distributed Product, Architecture, Customer Success, and Engineering teams, you will provide technical leadership, partner closely with engineers on architecture and design decisions, and translate business priorities into technical execution while fostering a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and customer focus. You will play a pivotal role in developing your team, driving technical quality, and delivering software that creates meaningful customer impact. 

This role is ideal for a leader who enjoys balancing people leadership with hands-on technical involvement and remains closely engaged in the team's architectural and engineering decisions.

 - Partnering with globally distributed Product Management, Architecture, Customer Success, Cloud Operations, and Engineering teams to align priorities and deliver customer value. 
 - Recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional engineering talent while supporting career growth and building an inclusive team culture

Let's talk about your skills/expertise: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3-5 years leading high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Proven success delivering complex SaaS or cloud-native software products in Agile environments. 
 - Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and modern software engineering practices, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to architecture, design, and technical decision-making
 - Demonstrated ability to lead engineers, influence technical direction, and partner effectively with globally distributed cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Experience building engineering teams through hiring, coaching, mentoring, and performance development. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with real-time communications, networking, or WebRTC technologies is highly desirable. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

Agencies: Thanks but we've got this one! Please, no phone calls or emails to any employees of Cyara outside of the Talent Acquisition team. Cyara's policy is to only accept resumes from Agencies via the Cyara Agency Portal. Agencies must have a valid fee agreement in place and they must have been assigned the specific requisition to which they submit resumes, by the Cyara Talent Acquisition team before submitting any CV's. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Cyara and, in the event, a candidate is submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT. 
 - Ability to read control circuits using Eplan as a resource. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT3. 
 - Experience designing, debugging and deploying software in VSTS development environment. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - Experience in Agile software design process and Test Driven Development methodologies. 
 - Familiarity and experience with AI and it's use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools
 - Strong proficiency in English with effective verbal, written. 

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing. 
 - A quick independent learner, able to digest and understand complex concepts. 
 - An intelligent thinker, able to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot, analyze, and propose solutions. 
 - Highly creative with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems. 
 - Capable of Working in a multi-disciplined international team with excellent personal organization skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
