data.title: Manager, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.description:
Are you passionate about leading engineering teams that build high-volume production systems using modern technologies?

Would you like to combine Java, Springboot and GEN AI experience with technical leadership in the healthcare space?

About The Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Healthcare vertical, our solutions focus on transforming operations and improving health outcomes across the healthcare industry. While our solutions are centered around robust data assets, we also leverage sophisticated technology, applied analytics and deep healthcare expertise while ensuring the highest standards of privacy and security to help healthcare organizations make confident decisions and solve complex challenges. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https: //risk. lexisnexis. com/healthcare. 

About The Team

We organize our engineering teams into collaborative Squads that bring together Software Engineers, Quality Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to build and deliver customer-focused solutions. 

Our teams value continuous learning, innovation, inclusivity, and shared ownership. We encourage engineers to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, mentor others, and help shape the future of our products and platforms. 

About The Role

You will lead and develop an engineering team delivering production systems and high-volume applications, while remaining close enough to the technology to contribute when needed. You will work across Engineering, Product, and Design, helping the team deliver commitments, solve complex technical challenges, and build expertise in Java, Springboot and GEN AI. 

Responsibilities

- Empower, guide, and maximize a team of mission-driven engineers to solve challenging problems in the aviation industry by building using cutting-edge technology. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering leadership and cross-functional partners (including Product, Design, Marketing) to establish roadmaps and strategy that help serve and grow the business and represent engineering-driven considerations to ensure all stakeholder groups are aligned on company priorities, expectations, and contingencies. 
 - Contribute to technical development and discussions as necessary to ensure the team is building technology that scales and meets the business needs by Providing both ongoing support and mentorship to direct reports, strategically aligning their skills, interests, and career aspirations with business needs; defining, streamlining, and guiding the projects they work on; and both initiating and inviting conversations around performance, development, and morale
 - Deliver results in the fast-paced environment of a growing startup while always treating team members and colleagues with empathy & humanity
 - Successfully partner and lead resources in solving complex business needs. Perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. Complete management responsibilities to include performance management, hiring and coaching of staff, and resource planning. 
 - Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies, procedures, and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems. 
 - Ensure all staff is provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible. Ensure all staff is provided with frequent feedback and coaching in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently. 
 - Manage and encourage new ideas from staff to foster improvements through innovations. Empower the staff to be accountable and responsible for their own actions and decisions. All other duties as assigned. 

Requirements

- Experience with technologies mainly focused on Java and Springboot background in addition to GEN AI exposure. 
 - Background in the healthcare space or related field is an added advantage with atleast 4+ years of team lead or engineering management experience with Proven track record of effectively developing direct reports through continual feedback and goal-setting and growing them through the ranks of an engineering organization. 
 - Advanced understanding of modern software development practices and methodologies, and the ability to roll up your sleeves and contribute when necessary
 - Experience directly working on or managing teams working on production systems and high-volume applications, successfully navigating the relationship between Engineering, Product, and Design teams with collaboration, mentoring, learning from other engineers, and treating colleagues with empathy and respect. 
 - Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with all stakeholders, internal drive to problem-solve, both creatively and pragmatically to scope, prioritize, and deliver on project commitments and learn new technologies quickly. 
 - Strong skills in setting, communicating, implementing, and achieving business objectives and goals through the direct management of others. 
 - Strong organization/project planning, time management, and change management skills across multiple functional groups and departments, and strong delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various size and complexity. 
 - Advanced problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions; and identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non-traditional education or experience. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to supporting your success.

data.description:

Office

About Company: 

ThermoFisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $25 billion and approximately 1, 30, 000 employees globally. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve elite analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market, and increase laboratory efficiency. 

Through our world-class brands-Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, and Unity Lab Services-we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and comprehensive services. 

About Team: 

We are the Digital Foundation Platform team - the software center of excellence (CoE) for Thermo Fisher Scientific. We develop and deliver foundational components, SaaS-based applications, digital lab (Cloud-based) tools, and foundational AI and agentic AI solutions to help scientists work more efficiently and precisely, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions

- Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science. 
 - Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way - where every device/product is connected, self-aware, and self-healing-thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science. 
 - Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability. 

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best-in-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Purpose: 

The Software Staff Engineer provides software and systems architectural and design leadership to multiple Software Development Scrum Teams delivering Connect Platform & Ecosystem, Customer tenancy, Authorization, and Digital product subscriptions and entitlements. The role is that of a Lead Developer who is motivated to actively contribute to the architecture, design, and development of new features. The person is also expected to perform all aspects of software development, including programming, system design, code review, design review, unit testing, and integration testing. In addition to that, the role also demands leading, empowering, mentoring, and providing ample guidance to the other team members with respect to technical challenges. 

Responsibilities: 

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflows, and pain points
 - Discover and prioritize high-value AI Business use cases with measurable impact
 - Translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures using existing reusable capabilities
 - Select the most appropriate AI models (LLMs, SLMs, multimodal, domain-specific) based on use case, performance, cost, and latency
 - Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including vector databases, indexing strategies, chunking, embedding models, and retrieval patterns
 - Identify and compose the right platform components, reusable services, tools, APIs, and agentic building blocks
 - Configure and orchestrate agents, multi-agent workflows, memory, tools, and enterprise integrations
 - Integrate enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, and external systems securely
 - Optimize prompts, reasoning workflows, model parameters, and inference strategies for accuracy and performance

As a Team Lead - Medium Voltage you will be responsible to lead a team of application/electrical engineers engaged in the engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) Motor Control Center (MCCs), Switchgear and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), customizing as per customer requirement utilizing the AutoCAD tools, while providing engineering support to the manufacturing plants of RA. This role reports to the Engineering Manager and is part of Global Engineering & Business Services group in India, catering to regional Rockwell Automation offices across the globe. It's a hybrid work environment working in 12: 00pm to 9: 00 pm shift located in Pune/Noida - India. 

Your Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor and develop a team of MV application/electrical engineers - allocating and prioritizing work, managing workload and ensuring on-time delivery, high quality engineering and customer satisfaction
 - Manage day-to-day execution of CTO/ETO projects within defined timelines, ensuring high quality engineering while leveraging standard and reusable engineering practices
 - Serve as the technical escalation point and subject-matter expert for MV products (MV MCCs, MV Switchgear, MV Drives), providing robust technical solutions, addressing queries and resolving technical deficiencies
 - Work closely with internal and external customers, and collaborate with global stakeholders across regions and time zones, to review requirements and deliver customized technical solutions that comply with electrical standards and Rockwell Automation's engineering practices
 - Coordinate overall system integration activities, maintaining accurate documentation and fostering effective collaboration across teams and functions
 - Drive capability development, continuous improvement and knowledge-sharing within the team - coaching engineers, building technical depth and supporting other initiatives
 - Monitor team performance, quality metrics, resource utilization and project KPIs, reporting progress and risks to the Execution Manager
 - Ensure strict adherence to international engineering standards (NEC, UL, CSA, IEC) by consistently applying them throughout order execution activities

The Essentials - You Will Have

- Bachelor's in Electrical / Electronics
 - Relevant Experience of more than 8-10 years in Hardware Designing for Medium Voltage MCC / Switchgear, Electrical knowledge and Automation Engineering
 - Minimum 3 years of experience in leading and managing an engineering team
 - Exposure of working in a global setup - collaborating with global stakeholders, customers and cross-functional teams across regions and time zones
 - Strong domain expertise in Medium Voltage Drives, PLC & MCC System Designing
 - Expertise of AutoCAD-Electrical software
 - Thorough knowledge of DOL & S/D Starters, VFDs, Soft-Starters, Intelligent Motor Control, Safety Product's System Designing
 - Knowledge of Electrical Components Selection, Busbar Calculation, Heat and Load Calculation
 - In depth knowledge of International Standards used for Design and Manufacturing

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- Field Installation & Commissioning experience on MV VFDs, MV Switchgear, PCC's, MCC's, PLC's & Instruments is preferrable
 - Gone through complete project life cycle from design phase to commissioning
 - Proven people-leadership skills - team building, mentoring, performance management and workload planning
 - Good Command on SAP Documentation and Part Management
 - Industry and application Knowledge, training skills, and familiar with Lean Six Sigma and EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) Principles. 
 - Experience with Creo software
 - Experience on Panel Testing, I/O Testing and FAT
 - Experience of managing or coordinating deliverables across a global / distributed engineering team is preferrable

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
 - Company volunteer and donation matching program - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

data.title: Sr Manager Client Technology
data.description:
About The Role

We are hiring a Manager, Cloud Platform Engineers to lead our India-based platform and automation engineering staff. This is a people-management role with real technical ownership -- you will be evaluated as much on your ability to review and stand behind your team's Kubernetes and Terraform work as on how you manage the people producing it. You will oversee day-to-day execution of AKS operations and Terraform-based automation, working in close coordination with the US-based Principal and Expert Platform Engineers who set the platform's architectural direction. 

This role exists to provide direct, hands-on management and accurate technical oversight of the India-based team -- including work planning, prioritization, quality review, and status reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform. Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality. 

What You'll Do

- Directly manage India-based Cloud Platform engineers, including workload assignment, prioritization, and day-to-day people management. 
 - Review and stand behind your team's Terraform module submissions and AKS configuration changes for correctness, adherence to documented standards, and production-readiness before they are considered complete. 
 - Enforce engineering process standards across the team: issue-based work tracking, triage and prioritization before work begins, work-in-progress limits, and daily status updates. 
 - Provide the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform with accurate, verified status reporting on the India-based team's work -- cross-checked against actual system and repository state, not summarized from memory or secondhand updates. 
 - Coordinate with the Principal and Expert Platform Engineers on platform architecture and standards, ensuring the India-based team's work aligns with the broader platform's GitOps, Terraform, and AKS conventions. 
 - Escalate technical or delivery risks early and directly, rather than allowing status to be discovered after the fact. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development for the India-based team, including closing gaps in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD fundamentals where needed. 
 - Apply policy-as-code and security standards already established on the platform (Kyverno or equivalent) when reviewing team output. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, including some prior people-management or formal technical-lead experience. 
 - Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally AKS specifically -- sufficient to personally review a team member's cluster or workload change and identify problems. 
 - Working Terraform experience, including the ability to review a submitted module for correctness, reusability, and adherence to documented standards. 
 - GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference. 
 - Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, verifiable status reporting to senior leadership. 
 - Experience managing engineers directly, including performance management, prioritization, and workload planning. 
 - Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing a distributed or offshore engineering team reporting to a manager in a different region. 
 - Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work. 
 - Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent). 
 - Background modernizing legacy automation (PowerShell or similar) toward Terraform or platform-native replacements.

About IDP

IDP is the global leader in international education services, delivering global success to students, test takers and our partners, through trusted human relationships, digital technology and customer research. An Australian-listed company, we operate in more than 50 countries around the world. 

Our team is comprised of over 7, 000 people of various nationalities, ages and cultural backgrounds. Proudly customer-first, our expert people are powered by global technology. Together, we offer unmatched services, helping local dreams become realities, all over the world. 

Learn more at www. careers. idp. com

Role purpose

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Engineering Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating multiple projects across diverse teams. Your primary focus will be on developing efficient processes, executing effective strategies, and ensuring the timely completion of projects. As an Engineering Manager, you will play a key role in researching and developing innovative products. You will also be responsible for creating project budgets and overseeing their successful execution throughout the year. Collaborating closely with various teams, you will ensure that projects are delivered on schedule and within budget, maintaining a high level of quality and adherence to organizational objectives. 

Key accountabilities

- Lead and propose necessary processes to ensure a structured and predictable approach to software Engineering. 
 - Define and drive the technical strategy and development methodology. 
 - Plan and execute strategies for completing projects on time. Implement a system for monitoring and tracking project progress 
 - Balance, creating and repaying technical debt, and developing new features. Use technology and automation to help manage technical debt. 
 - Collaborate with organizational leadership to develop an annual budget for the engineering department. Assess the tools and technologies required for efficient project development. Regularly assess the effectiveness of budget allocations. Work with leadership to allocate budgets for tools, training, and staffing needed to support 
 - Set clear expectations, goals, and objectives for each team. Ensure a balanced distribution of work among teams to optimize productivity. Encourage collaboration between teams to promote knowledge sharing and cross-functional problem-solving. Implement performance metrics to monitor the progress of each team. 
 - Organize team-building activities that involve both your internal team and the vendor's team. This could include workshops, training sessions, or even informal gathering. 
 - Evaluate how emerging technologies could impact the team's skill requirements and project outcomes. Identify any gaps between the existing skills and those required to meet current or future project needs. Determine the need for training and talent development. 
 - Delegate technical decisions to your senior engineers but ask the right questions to ensure that the product is scalable, secure, and reliable. 
 - Bridge the gap between product management and Engineering team by facilitating necessary interaction 
 - Anticipate and identify potential risks associated with the technical strategy, including technological challenges, resource constraints, and market changes. Develop mitigation plans to address identified risks, ensuring that the technical strategy remains resilient and adaptable. 
 - Evaluate, select, and implement monitoring tools and systems to enhance the observability of the engineering infrastructure. Set up effective alerting and notification systems to promptly respond to any anomalies or critical events, ensuring a proactive approach to system health. 
 - Establishing Support Processes: Define and implement robust support processes to ensure timely and effective resolution of incidents and customer issues. 
 - Demonstrate a forward-looking mindset by establishing and driving engineering and technology roadmaps aligned to business objectives. Leverage industry experience, emerging trends, AI capabilities, and engineering best practices to continuously improve software engineering, operational excellence, platform capabilities, and organizational maturity. Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and modern engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve productivity, quality, scalability, and speed to market. 

Required Experience

Minimum 6+ years of hard-core coding experience is mandatory

Excellent hands-on experience in coding in Python/Java, 'AWS/Microservices will be added advantage'

Good to have front-end framework knowledge like REACT/Angular. 

Over all 9-13 Experience is mandatory. 

Mandatory 2+ years of people management experience required .

data.title: Principal Software Engineer (SIEM)
data.description:
Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle. 

The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry's first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human-in-the-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team. 

Built cloud-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve. 

Securonix is recognized as a six-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers' Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience. 

Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world's leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve. 

With more than 1, 000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work. 

- We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability. 
 - We are customer driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes. 
 - We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast. 

That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations. 

Role Summary

The Principal Engineer shapes enterprise technical strategy and company-wide architecture for next-generation security platforms. This role modernizes legacy technologies and capabilities into scalable, AI-enabled systems, advancing security detection while improving delivery speed, reliability, and business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the modernization of legacy technologies and features, incorporating AI-enabled capabilities and AI-driven detection into scalable systems. 
 - Apply deep SIEM expertise and knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK techniques to guide security analytics, detection, and response capabilities. 
 - Strong communication and influence, with a record of connecting technical direction to business impact. 
 - Partner with Directors and Senior Directors to align architecture and engineering priorities with business and market needs. 
 - Establish architectural standards and best practices in collaboration with other Principal engineers. 
 - Mentor and develop Staff and Senior Staff Engineers, strengthening technical leadership across the organization. 

Qualifications

- 16+ years of engineering experience, including leadership of complex, large-scale systems. 
 - Proven ability to shape enterprise architecture and technical strategy across teams or products. 
 - Strong hands-on or architectural experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, microservices, DataLake concepts and LLM models. 
 - Experience with AI-driven development and AIDLC practices. 
 - Experience designing and delivering cloud-based systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Expertise in security and SIEM platforms, with practical knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK techniques. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy platforms and building scalable, AI-enabled systems and detection capabilities. 
 - Experience improving delivery speed through streamlined engineering models, automated validation, and deployment. 

Benefits

As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits: 

- Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7, 50, 000
 - Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law
 - Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10, 00, 000
 - Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered. 

Securonix, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. 

Securonix complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

data.title: Principle Systems Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong mentoring component -- you will design and build alongside the team while raising the technical bar for engineers earlier in their careers. You will work across infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and security tooling, with exposure to both legacy automation modernization and net-new platform capability. 

This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports, but you will be expected to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the team, including reviewing designs, pairing on complex problems, and setting technical direction by example. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build Azure infrastructure using a cloud native approach, leveraging managed services wherever they meet reliability and cost requirements. 
 - Lead technical execution of the migration of services from an on-premises data center to Azure, including dependency mapping, migration sequencing, and cutover risk management. 
 - Operate and extend our AKS-based platform, including GitOps deployment patterns, namespace isolation, and policy enforcement. 
 - Own and evolve reusable Terraform modules that other engineering teams consume, with clear interface contracts between platform-owned and application-owned infrastructure. 
 - Build and maintain observability coverage (metrics, logs, alerting) so that platform and application health are measurable and actionable, not just instrumented. 
 - Apply policy-as-code to enforce security, compliance, and operational standards across the platform, and reduce reliance on manual review gates. 
 - Design and review Identity and Access Management patterns, including workload identity, least-privilege access models, and secrets management -- with a clear bias away from static credentials. 
 - Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning for platform services, including failover design, RTO/RPO definition, and recovery testing. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and standards used across engineering teams building on the platform. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of the standard workflow, and evaluate where AI-driven platform capabilities (automated remediation, intelligent alerting, natural-language operational tooling) can be responsibly introduced into the platform itself. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code/design review, pairing, and informal technical coaching. Help less experienced engineers build sound judgment around idempotency, error handling, and migration candidacy when evaluating legacy automation. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, with demonstrated Principal-level scope (technical leadership without formal management). 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Azure, building cloud native architectures using managed services rather than defaulting to IaaS. 
 - Production experience running and operating Kubernetes at scale, ideally AKS specifically. 
 - Strong GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference. 
 - Experience leading or significantly contributing to a data center-to-cloud migration, including business continuity and disaster recovery planning. 
 - Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent) for security and compliance enforcement. 
 - Strong Identity and Access Management background: workload identity federation, least-privilege IAM design, secrets management patterns that avoid static credentials. 
 - Experience building and maintaining an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent). 
 - Solid Terraform experience, including designing reusable modules consumed by other teams, not just single-project usage. 
 - Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers -- through review, pairing, or informal technical leadership -- without formal authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing or operating hub-and-spoke network architectures in Azure. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design for multi-team, multi-repo environments (e. g. , GitHub Actions-based runner infrastructure). 
 - Exposure to evaluating or building genuinely AI-driven operational tooling (as distinct from rules-based automation mislabeled as AI). 
 - Experience presenting technical tradeoffs to both engineering and business stakeholders.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer – Infrastructure & Platform
data.description:
This is a remote position. 

Senior DevOps Engineer - Infrastructure & Platform
Reports to: Head of Infrastructure / Director of Platform Engineering

Team: Leads a DevOps team of 3

Experience: 8-10+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own our infrastructure and lead a small, growing team. We work with sensitive data belonging to vulnerable populations, so security and privacy aren't afterthoughts - they're core to how we build. You'll run multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, MongoDB Atlas), champion open-source tooling over vendor lock-in, and help shape an engineering culture that takes both craft and mission seriously. 

What You'll Do

Infrastructure & Reliability
Design and operate secure, highly-available infrastructure across AWS and GCP. Own MongoDB Atlas end-to-end (provisioning, scaling, backups, performance tuning). Drive infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Ansible) so environments are consistent and reproducible. 

Security & Privacy
Apply security best practices by default - IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management (OpenBao/Vault), vulnerability scanning. Treat data protection as a first-class requirement given the sensitivity of the populations we serve, not just a compliance checkbox. 

Open-Source Tooling
Evaluate, self-host, and own the lifecycle (upgrades, HA, patching) of open-source tools like SigNoz, SonarQube, and OpenBao - reducing vendor dependency without compromising reliability. 

Monitoring & Incident Response
Build observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) and intelligent alerting that cuts noise, not signal. Define SLIs/SLOs. Be a senior escalation point for major incidents and drive blameless postmortems. 

CI/CD & Automation
Maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitLab CI/GitHub Actions) with quality and security gates built in. Manage Kubernetes-based container orchestration and automate routine operational work. 

Leadership & Collaboration
Lead and develop a team of 3 DevOps engineers - workload, mentorship, growth. Build good processes, not just good infrastructure. Work closely with engineering, product, and security teams, and stay genuinely invested in why the work matters. 

What We're Looking For

- 8-10+ years across DevOps/SRE/Infrastructure, including experience leading or mentoring a team

- Strong hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, and hybrid/on-prem environments

- Proven track record self-hosting and operating open-source infrastructure tools in production

- Solid grounding in security and privacy engineering - this matters more here than in a typical infra role

- Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform/Ansible, and modern CI/CD

- Strong Linux administration and scripting (Bash, Python or Go)

- A genuine interest in our mission - this isn't a "just infra" role; you'll be working on systems that serve vulnerable communities, and that context should matter to you

- Clear communicator who can work across technical and non-technical teams

Good to have: MongoDB Atlas experience, observability/AIOps tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, SigNoz), FinOps/cost optimization, relevant certifications (AWS, GCP, CKA).

data.title: Lead Drive Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. data.title: Principle Systems Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong mentoring component -- you will design and build alongside the team while raising the technical bar for engineers earlier in their careers. You will work across infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and security tooling, with exposure to both legacy automation modernization and net-new platform capability. 

This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports, but you will be expected to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the team, including reviewing designs, pairing on complex problems, and setting technical direction by example. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build Azure infrastructure using a cloud native approach, leveraging managed services wherever they meet reliability and cost requirements. 
 - Lead technical execution of the migration of services from an on-premises data center to Azure, including dependency mapping, migration sequencing, and cutover risk management. 
 - Operate and extend our AKS-based platform, including GitOps deployment patterns, namespace isolation, and policy enforcement. 
 - Own and evolve reusable Terraform modules that other engineering teams consume, with clear interface contracts between platform-owned and application-owned infrastructure. 
 - Build and maintain observability coverage (metrics, logs, alerting) so that platform and application health are measurable and actionable, not just instrumented. 
 - Apply policy-as-code to enforce security, compliance, and operational standards across the platform, and reduce reliance on manual review gates. 
 - Design and review Identity and Access Management patterns, including workload identity, least-privilege access models, and secrets management -- with a clear bias away from static credentials. 
 - Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning for platform services, including failover design, RTO/RPO definition, and recovery testing. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and standards used across engineering teams building on the platform. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of the standard workflow, and evaluate where AI-driven platform capabilities (automated remediation, intelligent alerting, natural-language operational tooling) can be responsibly introduced into the platform itself. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code/design review, pairing, and informal technical coaching. Help less experienced engineers build sound judgment around idempotency, error handling, and migration candidacy when evaluating legacy automation. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, with demonstrated Principal-level scope (technical leadership without formal management). 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Azure, building cloud native architectures using managed services rather than defaulting to IaaS. 
 - Production experience running and operating Kubernetes at scale, ideally AKS specifically. 
 - Strong GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference. 
 - Experience leading or significantly contributing to a data center-to-cloud migration, including business continuity and disaster recovery planning. 
 - Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent) for security and compliance enforcement. 
 - Strong Identity and Access Management background: workload identity federation, least-privilege IAM design, secrets management patterns that avoid static credentials. 
 - Experience building and maintaining an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent). 
 - Solid Terraform experience, including designing reusable modules consumed by other teams, not just single-project usage. 
 - Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers -- through review, pairing, or informal technical leadership -- without formal authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing or operating hub-and-spoke network architectures in Azure. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design for multi-team, multi-repo environments (e. g. , GitHub Actions-based runner infrastructure). 
 - Exposure to evaluating or building genuinely AI-driven operational tooling (as distinct from rules-based automation mislabeled as AI). 
 - Experience presenting technical tradeoffs to both engineering and business stakeholders.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Windows Systems
data.description:
Overview

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team is responsible for the reliability, compatibility, performance, battery life, and sustainability of Windows devices. Our work spans hardware and OEM partners, the operating system, and application layers - helping protect, manage, and enhance the fundamentals of the Windows ecosystem. 

We are seeking a self-driven Senior Software Engineer to shape the next generation of Windows device optimizations. As advances in AI, silicon, and software create new opportunities, you will help make exceptional device fundamentals a defining feature of Windows PCs. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex systems problems, pursuing technical excellence, and delivering innovations that improve how people live, work, and play. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Analyze telemetry and trace data to characterize software and hardware behavior on individual devices and at scale. 
 - Diagnose complex system issues using low-level debugging and performance-analysis tools. 
 - Identify optimization opportunities and lead the design and architecture of improvements. 
 - Implement changes across hardware, operating-system, and application layers. 
 - Deliver robust, high-quality solutions while balancing performance, reliability, maintainability, and architectural consistency.

data.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care. 

At Edwards Lifesciences, the Intelligent Automation team enables scalable, efficient, and compliant business operations through workflow orchestration, robotic process automation (RPA), and integration. As a Senior Automation Developer focused on low-code platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Power Platform, UiPath), you will serve as a technical lead who shapes solution design, delivery approach, and engineering standards across a portfolio of automations. You will partner with process owners, product owners, analysts, architects, and IT teams to translate requirements into secure, reliable solutions; build reusable components and frameworks; and establish best practices that accelerate delivery and reduce operational risk. If you thrive in complex enterprise environments, excel at influencing without authority, and are energized by building governed automation capabilities that deliver measurable business value, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a patient-focused, innovation-driven organization. 

How you will make an impact: 

- Own end-to-end delivery of automation solutions using approved low-code tools (e. g. , Power Automate cloud/desktop, Power Apps, UiPath), from discovery and solution design through release, hypercare, and steady-state operations. 
 - Lead stakeholder workshops to understand current-state processes, define future-state workflows, document user stories/acceptance criteria, and align on measurable outcomes (cycle time, accuracy, compliance, cost). 
 - Design integration patterns leveraging connectors, APIs, and data services (e. g. , Dataverse/SQL) and ensure solutions align to enterprise integration, data-handling, and audit requirements. 
 - Engineer for resiliency by implementing standardized exception handling, structured logging, alerting/notifications, retry strategies, and proactive monitoring. 
 - Define and evolve team standards and reusable assets (templates, child flows, libraries, solution packages, framework components) to improve delivery speed, quality, and maintainability across the automation portfolio. 
 - Establish and enforce quality practices (unit/integration testing, peer reviews, test evidence) and drive defect remediation through UAT to meet release and validation expectations. 
 - Partner with security, infrastructure, and application owners to implement least-privilege access, credential management, and secure connectivity; proactively identify and mitigate control gaps. 
 - Own operational readiness: produce solution designs, runbooks, support models; lead incident triage, root-cause analysis, and preventative actions to improve service stability. 
 - Continuously improve existing automations (performance, resiliency, cost) by analyzing telemetry, reducing technical debt, and recommending platform capabilities and roadmap enhancements. 
 - Provide technical leadership across project teams by guiding design decisions, unblocking delivery, mentoring developers, and ensuring solutions conform to architecture, quality, and security standards. 
 - Drive technical excellence and innovation by evaluating new platform capabilities, establishing patterns for adoption, and sharing recommendations that improve the team's delivery velocity, maintainability, and compliance posture. 
 - Enable the broader automation community through demos, documentation, and reviews; coach citizen developers and project teams to operate within governance, ALM, and security standards. 

What you will need (Required): 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field 
 - 8+ years of experience developing and supporting automation solutions using low-code platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Power Platform-Power Automate/Power Apps/Dataverse-or UiPath), including design, build, test, deployment, and support. 
 - Proven ability to translate business needs into fit-for-purpose solution designs (user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria) and deliver automations in an Agile/Scrum environment while managing dependencies and risk. 
 - Hands-on experience with connectors/integrations (REST APIs, HTTP actions, webhooks) and data sources (Dataverse, SQL, SharePoint, SAP/ServiceNow or similar). 
 - Relevant certifications (strongly preferred but not required), such as Microsoft Power Platform (PL-100/PL-200/PL-400/PL-500) and/or UiPath certifications. 
 - Deep knowledge of platform governance and ALM (environments, solutions, connection references, DLP policies) with demonstrated experience establishing guardrails and delivery patterns; plus, working scripting/coding skills (e. g. , JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, or C#) to extend automations when needed. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills 
 - Excellent documentation and communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives and communicate to various levels of audience or to explain complex or technical matters in a manner suitable for non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong collaboration skills: ability to partner with business process owners, analysts, and IT teams to deliver automation outcomes and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong SDLC ownership (analysis, development, QA/UAT support, deployment, and post-go-live support) with a focus on reliability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Practical understanding of authentication/authorization concepts (service accounts, OAuth, MFA) and secure handling of sensitive data within automations. 
 - Ability to produce clear technical documentation (solution designs, data mappings, test evidence, runbooks) appropriate for regulated environments. 
 - Knowledge of best practices related to IT governance, operations, and administration. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with architects, platform administrators, and project/program managers to deliver automation solutions aligned to standards, roadmaps, and timelines. 
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including troubleshooting production issues and identifying continuous improvement opportunities. 
 - Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e. g. , pandemic protocols, Environmental Health & Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control. 

What else do we look for (Preferred): 

- Experience establishing and operating DevOps/ALM for low-code at scale (pipelines, solution packaging, automated testing) and applying source control practices (Git) for automation assets. 
 - Experience building enterprise-grade solutions using Power Platform (custom connectors, Power Fx, plugins) and/or UiPath (REFramework, Orchestrator) in a governed environment, including reusable architecture patterns and operational support models. 
 - Exposure to intelligent automation capabilities such as document processing (OCR/IDP), process mining, and/or AI-assisted automation, with an understanding of validation and quality requirements 
 - 4 years of relevant industry experience (e. g. , medical device, pharmaceuticals, etc. ) or in highly regulated environments preferred. 

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

data.description:
Tejaki - by Blowtrumpet Technologies

- South Delhi
 - Full-time / Intern / Early Career

ABOUT Tejaki

Tejaki is Blowtrumpet's publisher-facing supply-side platform (SSP), built for content creators who want transparent monetisation. Tejaki runs on offers - not blind bids - so creators know what they are earning and why. It supports multiple content formats and fair revenue distribution. Tejaki is a product under Blowtrumpet Technologies. 

THE ROLE

Architect the supply-side platform for creator trust - offer-based monetisation, transparent revenue sharing, publisher dashboards, and content-format pipelines. You own the system design that makes fair payouts possible. 

What You Will Do

- Define and evolve the system architecture - service boundaries, data models, API contracts, and deployment topology
 - Own the technology stack: evaluate, adopt, and retire tools and frameworks with clear ADRs
 - Design packaging, delivery, and release strategies - CI/CD, feature flags, rollback plans
 - Set testing strategy - unit, integration, contract, load, and chaos testing
 - Lead security architecture - threat modelling, access controls, data encryption, audit trails
 - Shape customer experience through technical decisions - latency budgets, reliability targets, graceful degradation
 - Mentor engineers and grow the architecture discipline within the team

What We Are Looking For

- 5+ years of software engineering with 2+ years in an architecture or tech-lead role
 - Deep expertise in Node. js/TypeScript, distributed systems, and API design
 - Experience with PostgreSQL (or equivalent), message queues, and event-driven architectures
 - Strong understanding of security - OWASP, zero-trust, secrets management, compliance
 - Track record of shipping and maintaining production systems under real traffic
 - Excellent written communication - you document decisions as clearly as you make them

EARLY CAREER & CAMPUS TALENT

We are actively inviting early-career graduates and final-year interns to consider long-term opportunities in innovation and establish stable careers with us in one of the most promising industry segments. If you are looking to create a ding in the universe, this may be your chance. 

Blowtrumpet is not just offering a job - we are offering a seat at the table where the future of advertising technology is being designed. You will work with small, focused teams, learn from practitioners, ship real products, and grow into a career that compounds. 

STATEMENT OF PURPOSE

Along with your application, please include a Statement of Purpose that covers: 

- What interests you in advertising and technology - what drew you to this space?
 - When you started programming, designing, exploring this opportunity, or engaging with the field - and what you have built or learned so far. 
 - Your 3-5 year career vision - where do you see yourself, what kind of work excites you, and what impact do you want to make?
 - How Blowtrumpet or this project fits into that picture - why us, why now, and what you hope to bring. 

WORKING AT BLOWTRUMPET

We function like a startup - and we are proud of it. That means you will wear multiple hats, take ownership beyond your title, and grow faster than you would in a larger organisation. We are looking for people who thrive on that kind of pace. 

A Few Things To Know Upfront

- Multi-functional by design. Everyone here contributes across boundaries. If you see a gap, you fill it. If you can learn it, you own it. 
 - Excellence is non-negotiable. We have no room for mediocrity. We would rather ship fewer things brilliantly than many things passably. 
 - Growth-oriented. We invest in training, mentorship, and giving you real responsibility early. Your growth is the company's growth. 
 - Early starts, disciplined days. We are based in South Delhi and our working day begins at 8 AM. We believe discipline creates freedom - starting early lets us work with focus, finish with intention, and keep stress low. 
 - Low stress, high standards. We keep the environment calm and supportive. People here help each other, cover for each other, and win together. The pressure comes from the pursuit of great work, not from mismanagement. 

How To Apply

Senior Development Manager - AI First Delivery & Transformation

LSEG Data | Corporate Actions

Role Purpose

The Engineering Manager is accountable for the delivery, migration, modernisation, and transformation of one or more Corporate Actions products. The role combines people leadership, technical leadership, product delivery accountability, and AI-first engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and commercially critical platforms. 

The successful candidate will lead teams through complex transformation programmes while establishing and scaling AI-enabled software delivery, multi-agent engineering practices, and governed engineering control planes across the Software Development Lifecycle. 

Technical

I lead AI-first engineering teams delivering complex products, migrations, and transformation programmes. I bring deep expertise in multi-agent software delivery, engineering control planes, agent orchestration, context engineering, and AI-enabled SDLC practices. 

I establish standards for agent-assisted requirements, architecture, development, testing, governance, security, and operations while ensuring human accountability remains clear for all material decisions. 

Mandatory Experience

Strong hands-on engineering background in either . NET/C# or Java enterprise development. 

Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell or Bash. 

Experience developing and operating containerised applications using Docker and modern cloud-native engineering practices. 

Experience leading engineering teams delivering distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and modern software platforms. 

Experience implementing AI-assisted or agent-enabled software delivery practices. 

Desirable Experience

React

Python

Go

Rust

C

C++

Azure

AWS

Kubernetes

Platform Engineering

AI orchestration frameworks, MCPs, agent governance, and model evaluation frameworks

Customer Focus

I ensure engineering teams remain focused on customer outcomes, service quality, and business value. I use AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve product quality, reduce operational friction, and modernise legacy platforms without compromising reliability or trust. 

Risk Management

I establish governance and control frameworks for AI-enabled engineering. I ensure agents, models, tools, and delivery workflows operate within defined security, compliance, operational resilience, and risk boundaries. 

I balance delivery speed with appropriate engineering controls, auditability, observability, and release readiness. 

Leadership

I lead high-performing engineering teams through product delivery, platform modernisation, cloud adoption, and large-scale transformation initiatives. 

I create a culture where engineers effectively collaborate with AI agents, enabling teams to focus on architecture, decision-making, innovation, and customer outcomes rather than repetitive execution. 

I coach and develop engineers, technical leads, and future leaders while building a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. 

Analytical

I use engineering, operational, delivery, and quality metrics to guide decisions and drive continuous improvement. 

I establish measurable evidence for AI effectiveness, engineering productivity, quality improvement, delivery acceleration, operational resilience, and business outcomes. 

Adaptability

I champion modern engineering practices and continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, agent frameworks, cloud-native architectures, and software delivery models. 

I help teams evolve from traditional software development approaches towards governed AI-native engineering operating models. 

Communication

I communicate complex technical, delivery, transformation, and AI-related concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

I build confidence in AI-enabled delivery by explaining risks, controls, trade-offs, and outcomes in a transparent and evidence-based manner. 

Key Accountabilities

Own delivery outcomes for assigned Corporate Actions products and platforms. 

Lead major migration, modernisation, and transformation initiatives. 

Drive adoption of AI-first software engineering practices. 

Establish and govern multi-agent software delivery capabilities. 

Improve engineering productivity, quality, and delivery predictability. 

Ensure operational resilience, security, compliance, and service stability. 

Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, and Operations teams to deliver business outcomes. 

Develop high-performing engineering teams and future technical leaders. 

Manage technical debt, engineering risk, and platform sustainability. 

Drive cloud adoption, automation, and platform simplification initiatives. 

Success Measures

The role will be considered successful when: 

Strategic transformation programmes are delivered successfully. 

Product roadmaps are delivered predictably and with high quality. 

Engineering productivity and automation maturity improve measurably. 

AI-enabled delivery capabilities are embedded across the SDLC. 

Operational risk, technical debt, and delivery friction are reduced. 

Platform reliability, resilience, and observability improve. 

Teams demonstrate strong engagement, capability growth, and retention. 

Stakeholders have confidence in engineering execution, governance, and delivery outcomes.
