data.description:
Who We Are

At Platform Science, we're working to connect everything that moves. Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe. 

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team. 

About The Role

Platform Science is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Core Product Development team in Chennai. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust manual and automated test suites across our web and mobile applications, ensuring our edge-to-cloud IoT solutions meet strict performance, stability, and quality standards. 

You will play an integral role across the complete software development lifecycle-designing automated UI and API tests, driving exploratory test sessions, and identifying system malfunctions early. Additionally, you will coordinate seamlessly across time zones, collaborating closely with our distributed teams and stakeholders in both India and the US. 

Essential Responsibilities (Measures Of Success)

- Full-Lifecycle Quality Assurance: Participate actively across all stages of product development, including new feature releases, platform upgrades, functional enhancements, performance testing, and defect resolution. 
 - Test Automation & Execution: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated UI and API test frameworks for web applications and mobile platforms (iOS and Android). 
 - Exploratory & Manual Testing: Execute rigorous exploratory tests on new features and bug fixes, blending manual validation with automated test suites. 
 - Defect Lifecycle Management: Identify, document, isolate, and track software defects in Jira with thorough root-cause investigations, logs, and clear reproduction steps. 
 - Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Proactively communicate project status, risks, and technical blockers; balance working hours between Indian and US time zones to attend client/sync calls and address critical production issues. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Research, evaluate, and adopt industry best practices in Quality Engineering, test automation, and Continuous Integration (CI). 

Target Capabilities & Skills

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Software QA Engineer or SDET. 
 - Core Programming: Strong coding proficiency in Java; knowledge or experience with Kotlin or JavaScript is a significant advantage. 
 - Mobile Test Automation: Proven hands-on experience authoring automated test scripts for native and hybrid mobile applications (iOS and Android) using Appium, Selenium, or WebdriverIO. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Deep understanding of backward compatibility testing across varying operating system versions and device configurations. 
 - Test Design Methodologies: Strong applied knowledge of test design techniques, including Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and Use Case testing. 
 - Agile QA Practices: Practical experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and exploratory testing patterns. 

Other Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (equivalent practical QA engineering experience will be considered in place of a degree). 
 - Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills to interact productively with engineering teams, leadership, and global stakeholders. 
 - Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex architectural documents, technical specs, diagrams, and data models. 
 - Mindset & Ownership: Demonstrates intellectual humility (learning actively from mistakes), self-motivation, high ownership, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision. 

Benefits

The company offers various benefits to regular, full-time employees including: 

- Provident fund and gratuity in accordance with applicable laws. 
 - Paid vacation, sick leave and holidays, in accordance with applicable laws. 
 - Twenty-Six weeks of paid maternity leave in accordance with applicable laws. 

(Note: The compensation details listed in India role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. )

Legal & Privacy Disclaimers

Platform Science collects your personal information to support its business operations, including for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and other business-related purposes as well as to be in legal compliance. You can review further details of such collection and use in our Privacy Policy (https: //www. platformscience. com/privacy-notice). 

Please note: This document is a description of a potential position with our company. Nothing within this document may be construed as an offer for employment or a promise of benefit or remuneration. Further, any representation made within this document is subject to the laws and restrictions of the jurisdiction where employment may be deemed to occur. The parameters and availability of this position are subject to change and based solely within the discretion of the company. In addition, the duties, responsibilities, and scope of this position may not be fully represented in this description or may change as required by the Company. 

Platform Science is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Position Overview: 

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Instrumentation & Electronics Engineer to join our team. ·                Review and analyze P&ID drawings, control schematics, and instrumentation layouts to ensure system integrity and compliance. 

·                Prepare and approve detailed control panel wiring diagrams, wiring schedules, terminal diagrams, and loop diagrams.

This Engineering Manager position will lead the CST Mechanical Engineering team supporting the Neuroscience portfolio. The manager will collaborate with global business and cross-functional partners to align priorities, strengthen engineering ownership, and ensure predictable delivery of high-quality engineering solutions. 

Primary Responsibilities: 

- Lead and develop a team of mechanical engineers supporting product development, sustaining engineering, technology advancement, and lifecycle management initiatives across the CST Neuroscience portfolio. 
 - Provide functional, technical, and operational leadership while establishing clear priorities, objectives, roles, and accountability across the team. 
 - Partner with global engineering and business leaders to understand portfolio priorities, define engagement models, and align team capabilities and resources with current and future program needs.

data.title: Principal Engineer - C++
data.description:
Let's be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth-powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set. 

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We're a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be CertifiedTM by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www. circana. com. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking Principal Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale. 

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. 
 - Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). 
 - Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. 
 - Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). 
 - Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). 
 - In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. 
 - Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e. g. , HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. 
 - Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. 
 - Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications: 

- Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
 - Modern C++ Expertise: 8+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. 
 - HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. 
 - Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. 
 - Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std: : atomic). 
 - Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e. g. , vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). 
 - Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc. )

Bonus Qualifications: 

- Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e. g. , ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). 
 - Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. 
 - Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. 
 - Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. 
 - Functional domain awareness - CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

- Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
 - Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. 
 - Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains. 

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily. 

Circana Behaviors: 

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work: 

- Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
 - Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
 - Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
 - Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
 - Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
 - Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
 - Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

data.title: Assistant Manager Quality, Emerging Growth Opportunites
data.description:
The role is based at Mumbai and reporting to Lead QA

Business Context and Opportunities

A global conglomerate, the Aditya Birla Group is in the League of Fortune 500. Anchored by an extraordinary force of over 150, 000 employees belonging to 100 nationalities, the Group is built on a strong foundation of stakeholder value creation. Backed by seven decades of responsible business practices, the Group operates leading businesses across metals, chemicals, textiles, cement, financial services, fashion retail, telecom, and renewable energy, with over 50% of revenues generated from international operations. 

The group expanded its Retail Footprint, leveraging the trust and synergy built over the years in luxury retail by launching its Jewellery brand Indriya, in June 2024. 

India's jewellery market is at an exciting inflection point. For decades, jewellery has largely been associated with weddings, family occasions, inheritance and long-term value. A new generation is now expanding what jewellery can mean. For Gen Z and young consumers, jewellery is increasingly about self-expression, identity, mood, styling, gifting and everyday confidence. It is no longer reserved only for milestone moments. It is becoming part of how young people show up each day, at college, at work, at a café, at a concert, on social media and in the moments that define their personal style. 

Project Tiara is our attempt to build a distinctly new-age jewellery brand for this generation. 

The brand is currently in its conceptualisation stage as a separate and independent business under the legal entity Novel Jewels (the creators of Indriya), backed by the trust, ambition and scale of the Aditya Birla Group. 

The Core Idea

Project Tiara is a jewellery brand will speak to young consumers who want jewellery that is stylish, affordable, versatile and relevant to their lives. It will focus on everyday wear, trend-responsive drops and pieces that can be worn, stacked, layered, mixed, matched and made personal. 

Where the Brand Will Play

Project Tiara is being imagined for the fast-growing daily wear and self-purchase jewellery space. This is a large, under-branded opportunity in India, where young consumers are actively looking for jewellery that feels more current, more expressive and more accessible than traditional fine jewellery. 

The brand will likely operate across digital-first channels, selective physical experiences, pop-ups and omni-channel journeys. It will be designed for a consumer who discovers on Instagram, engages through content, browses online, walks into stores and expects a seamless experience across all touchpoints. 

How We Aim To Differentiate

Project Tiara will be different from traditional jewellery brands in both product and personality. 

This brand will not simply sell jewellery. It will create a new buying behaviour, where jewellery becomes part of everyday identity, styling and self-expression. 

Why This Is Exciting

Project Tiara gives us the opportunity to build a brand from the ground up: the consumer lens, product strategy, design system, brand voice, digital ecosystem, supply chain model, retail experience and growth engine. 

It will also serve as an innovation sandbox for Novel Jewels, allowing us to experiment with new designs, faster drops, creator collaborations, digital storytelling, consumer communities and more agile ways of building a jewellery brand. 

The 3 to 5 Year Ambition

Over the next 3 to 5 years, the ambition is to build Project Tiara into a meaningful, scalable, national Gen Z jewellery brand. The plan is to create a strong digital-first foundation, build repeat-led consumer behaviour, expand through selective offline formats and create a brand that young India sees as expressive, aspirational and accessible. 

Project Tiara will also help Novel Jewels engage consumers early in their jewellery journey, creating a long-term relationship that can grow with them as their life stage, income and jewellery needs evolve. 

Why Join Us

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding team for a new consumer brand within one of India's most respected business groups. The team will have the chance to shape the brand's identity, product language, consumer experience, content engine, commercial model and growth journey from the very beginning. 

We are looking for people who are entrepreneurial, consumer-obsessed, culturally aware, digitally fluent and excited by the idea of building something that can redefine how young India experiences jewellery. 

Project Tiara is not just a new brand. It is a chance to reimagine jewellery for a new generation

Your Team Responsibilities

The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers - we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments. 

We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability, and adoption across the firm. 

Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems. 

As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation. 

What The Team Owns

- Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor 
 - Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
 - CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
 - SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
 - Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
 - Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI - simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases. 
 - Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform. 
 - Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily. 
 - Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points - find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds. 
 - Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers. 
 - Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities. 
 - Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build. 

Required

Your skills and experience that will help you excel

 - Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java. 
 - Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles. 
 - Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.

data.title: Director - Application Development
data.description:
About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

I. The Mission

You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a technical visionary who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an AI-first development culture (AIDLC) to set a new industry standard for productivity. 

As the Director of Application Development, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the Fintech and Banking sectors. 

You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. 

The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products. 

The Director of Application Development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams and foster strong cross-functional partnerships. 

II. The Core Mandate

- Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
 - The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. 
 - Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features. 
 - Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability. 
 - Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
 - Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. 
 - Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security. 
 - Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. 
 - Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. 
 - Organizational Mentorship
 - Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. 
 - Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. 

III. Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)

- Academic Excellence: B. Tech / B. E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA). 

IV. Experience & Skills

- Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). 
 - Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously. 
 - Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration. 
 - Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. 

High-Weightage Qualifications

- Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e. g. , LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing). 
 - Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud-native architectures. 
 - A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first-principles perspective and drive data-backed decisions. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Operational Efficiency: 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. 
 - System Reliability: Maintaining 99. 99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. 
 - Talent Retention: Reducing attrition among high-potential Senior Managers and Directors. 
 - Stakeholder Satisfaction: High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. 

V. Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to build an engineering org within the high-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

The RADAR product line is a rapidly expanding business within TI, investing to address the fast-growing segment in Industrial & automotive markets. This product line will enable a scalable portfolio using DSP and ARM multi-cores to support high-end applications in ADAS, body & Chassis and in Industrial space. Radar systems process digital information from sources like digital cameras, lasers, radar and other sensors to perform tasks such as lane departure warning or parking assistance. The processed information can be displayed on screens or announced via acoustical warning signals. The system has multifaceted features such as High precision ADC, extremely accurate chirp, wide range visibility and Faster scene processing abilities. As a Verification Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced RADAR products. You will be responsible for the verification of IP, Subsystem (SS), and System-on-Chip (SoC) designs, contributing to the development of robust verification methodologies, strategies and team.

Complete ownership of IP/subsystem/SOC DV ownership right from spec definition till the post silicon verification and solving the customer issues on need basis. This includes: 

- Build, Mentor and scale high preforming verification team across IP, Subsystem and SoC level
 - Lead verification activities for overall verification strategy, methodology, infrastructure and execution plans across multiple SoC programs. 
 - Verification strategy definition along with Verification plan to meet 100% spec to regression traceability along with signoff metrics. 
 - IP/SS/SOC verification covering functional and Firmware scenarios in RTL/PARTL, GLS/PAGLS modes.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Bachelor's/ Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering and data center infrastructure design.

Proven experience delivering electrical systems for mission-critical facilities.

data.title: Lead Quality Assurance, Emerging Growth Opportunites
data.description:
The role is based at Mumbai and reporting to the Head Merch. & Sourcing

Business Context and Opportunities

A global conglomerate, the Aditya Birla Group is in the League of Fortune 500. Anchored by an extraordinary force of over 150, 000 employees belonging to 100 nationalities, the Group is built on a strong foundation of stakeholder value creation. Backed by seven decades of responsible business practices, the Group operates leading businesses across metals, chemicals, textiles, cement, financial services, fashion retail, telecom, and renewable energy, with over 50% of revenues generated from international operations. 

The group expanded its Retail Footprint, leveraging the trust and synergy built over the years in luxury retail by launching its Jewellery brand Indriya, in June 2024. 

India's jewellery market is at an exciting inflection point. For decades, jewellery has largely been associated with weddings, family occasions, inheritance and long-term value. A new generation is now expanding what jewellery can mean. For Gen Z and young consumers, jewellery is increasingly about self-expression, identity, mood, styling, gifting and everyday confidence. It is no longer reserved only for milestone moments. It is becoming part of how young people show up each day, at college, at work, at a café, at a concert, on social media and in the moments that define their personal style. 

Project Tiara is our attempt to build a distinctly new-age jewellery brand for this generation. 

The brand is currently in its conceptualisation stage as a separate and independent business under the legal entity Novel Jewels (the creators of Indriya), backed by the trust, ambition and scale of the Aditya Birla Group. 

The Core Idea

Project Tiara is a jewellery brand will speak to young consumers who want jewellery that is stylish, affordable, versatile and relevant to their lives. It will focus on everyday wear, trend-responsive drops and pieces that can be worn, stacked, layered, mixed, matched and made personal. 

Where the Brand Will Play

Project Tiara is being imagined for the fast-growing daily wear and self-purchase jewellery space. This is a large, under-branded opportunity in India, where young consumers are actively looking for jewellery that feels more current, more expressive and more accessible than traditional fine jewellery. 

The brand will likely operate across digital-first channels, selective physical experiences, pop-ups and omni-channel journeys. It will be designed for a consumer who discovers on Instagram, engages through content, browses online, walks into stores and expects a seamless experience across all touchpoints. 

How We Aim To Differentiate

Project Tiara will be different from traditional jewellery brands in both product and personality. 

This brand will not simply sell jewellery. It will create a new buying behaviour, where jewellery becomes part of everyday identity, styling and self-expression. 

Why This Is Exciting

Project Tiara gives us the opportunity to build a brand from the ground up: the consumer lens, product strategy, design system, brand voice, digital ecosystem, supply chain model, retail experience and growth engine. 

It will also serve as an innovation sandbox for Novel Jewels, allowing us to experiment with new designs, faster drops, creator collaborations, digital storytelling, consumer communities and more agile ways of building a jewellery brand. 

The 3 to 5 Year Ambition

Over the next 3 to 5 years, the ambition is to build Project Tiara into a meaningful, scalable, national Gen Z jewellery brand. The plan is to create a strong digital-first foundation, build repeat-led consumer behaviour, expand through selective offline formats and create a brand that young India sees as expressive, aspirational and accessible. 

Project Tiara will also help Novel Jewels engage consumers early in their jewellery journey, creating a long-term relationship that can grow with them as their life stage, income and jewellery needs evolve. 

Why Join Us

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding team for a new consumer brand within one of India's most respected business groups. The team will have the chance to shape the brand's identity, product language, consumer experience, content engine, commercial model and growth journey from the very beginning. 

We are looking for people who are entrepreneurial, consumer-obsessed, culturally aware, digitally fluent and excited by the idea of building something that can redefine how young India experiences jewellery. 

Project Tiara is not just a new brand. It is a chance to reimagine jewellery for a new generation.

data.title: Embedded QA & Test Engineer
data.description:
Major Responsibilities

Embedded Gateway & IoT Connectivity Testing: 

- Test embedded C++ firmware on Linux/RTOS-based IoT gateways. 
 - Validate Azure IoT Hub communication workflows, including: 
 - Telemetry messaging
 - Cloud-to-device (C2D) commands
 - Device Twins
 - Device Provisioning Service (DPS)
 - Certificate rotation and secure connectivity
 - Validate message queueing, offline buffering, reconnect logic, and retry behavior under real-world network conditions

Industrial Protocol Testing: 
 - Develop and execute test cases for: 
 - Modbus Serial (RTU): timing behavior, register maps, function codes, exception handling. 
 - Modbus TCP: multi-client scenarios, socket recovery, error handling. 
 - CAN bus: arbitration, extended/standard IDs, error frames, bus overload, and edge-case behavior. 
 - Uses protocol analyzers, CAN interfaces, Modbus simulators, and logic analyzers to capture and analyze traffic. 
Firmware Update & OTA Lifecycle Validation: 

- Test firmware and system updates using hawkBit (deployment orchestration) and SWUpdate (A/B updates, failover, signing, rollback)
 - Validate update workflows under stress, including: 
 - Interrupted updates (power loss, network drop)
 - Corrupted image scenarios
 - Update rollback and fallback behavior
 - Ensure secure update chain-of-trust, signature verification, and partition layout integrity. 
Automation & CI/CD Integration: 

- Develop automated test suites using Python or C++ to validate firmware, protocols, OTA processes, and system services. 
 - Build hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test setups for regression, protocol simulation, and device behavior testing. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). 
 - Maintain automation tools for serial logging, bus capture, cloud message verification, and gateway diagnostics. 

Debugging & Quality Reporting: 

- Investigate firmware and system issues via logs, traces, core dumps, serial output, and protocol captures.

data.title: AI Architect
data.description:
The AI Architect designs, governs, and delivers production-grade AI capabilities, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows, as part of secure, scalable, and maintainable healthcare products. The role is weighted toward AI/GenAI architecture and core system architecture: distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. The AI Architect translates product goals, customer commitments, and engineering constraints into architecture that works end to end, from user experience and service boundaries through data pipelines, model and retrieval layers, integrations, deployment, and runtime monitoring. 

This is not a prompt-engineering or agent-building role in isolation. Prompts, models, and agents are components of a larger system, and this role is accountable for everything around them: service decomposition, contracts, data flow, state management, latency and cost budgets, failure handling, security and PHI protection, observability, evaluation, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who has shipped GenAI to production and can defend the full system design, not only the model layer. 

Key Outcomes

- Production GenAI and agentic AI capabilities delivered as reliable, secure, observable product features rather than isolated prototypes or demos. 
 - A reusable enterprise AI platform (model gateway, retrieval/RAG services, agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails) that product teams adopt consistently. 
 - End-to-end architectures in which AI components are properly integrated with microservices, APIs, event flows, data stores, identity, and cloud infrastructure, with clear service boundaries and contracts. 
 - AI systems that meet defined targets for quality, latency, availability, cost, and safety, with governance, PHI protection, and Responsible AI practices built in from the start. 
 - Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable AI-enabled solutions. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture of GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategy, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, memory and state management, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Design and evolve a shared enterprise AI platform: LLM gateway and model abstraction, prompt and configuration management, embedding and vector search services, agent orchestration (e. g. , LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), guardrails, and evaluation services. 
 - Define RAG and knowledge architectures end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, re-ranking, access control on retrieved content, data freshness, and grounding/citation strategy. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and LLMOps practices, including offline and online evaluation, golden datasets, regression testing of prompts and models, hallucination and quality metrics, A/B testing, and controlled model/version rollout and rollback. 
 - Drive AI governance, safety, and security: prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defenses, PII/PHI redaction, content filtering, auditability, model risk assessment, and alignment with Responsible AI and healthcare regulatory requirements such as HIPAA. 
 - Make and document build-vs-buy and model trade-off decisions (managed services such as AWS Bedrock vs. open-weight or self-hosted models) based on quality, latency, cost, data residency, and vendor risk. 
 - Own end-to-end system design for AI-enabled features: service decomposition, microservice boundaries, API and event contracts, synchronous vs. asynchronous patterns, data ownership, and integration with existing product and legacy systems. 
 - Design for non-functional requirements across the full stack: scalability, availability, resiliency (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, fallbacks, and graceful degradation when models fail), performance, latency and token-cost budgets, multi-tenancy, and disaster recovery. 
 - Define data architecture for AI workloads, including operational and analytical stores, vector databases, caching, streaming and event pipelines, data lineage, retention, and secure handling of clinical and patient data. 
 - Architect cloud-native deployment on AWS containers and Kubernetes/ECS, serverless, networking, identity and access, secrets management, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD for both application and AI artifacts. 
 - Define observability across AI and non-AI components together: distributed tracing across services and model calls, prompt/response logging with privacy controls, quality and drift monitoring, cost tracking, SLOs, and alerting. 
 - Define architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, API guidelines, and service templates that product teams can adopt consistently. 
 - Analyze current-state architecture, technical debt, and integration constraints to identify where AI can be introduced safely and where modernization must come first. 
 - Partner with product management to translate business priorities and customer commitments into technically feasible AI roadmaps, implementation strategies, and incremental releases with measurable outcomes. 
 - Build proofs of concept and reference implementations hands-on to validate feasibility, and define the path from proof of concept to production-hardened service. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and lightweight governance aligned to agile delivery, covering both AI-specific risks and core design quality. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers in GenAI engineering, system design, distributed systems, service ownership, and accountable AI practices. 
 - Document architecture decisions (ADRs), system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, AI model and prompt inventories, technical risks, and roadmaps in formats usable by engineers and product stakeholders. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT Enterprise to accelerate codebase exploration, design comparison, and documentation while retaining accountability for decisions. 
 - Track the evolving AI landscape (models, agent frameworks, protocols such as MCP, and evaluation methods) and turn relevant advances into pragmatic architecture guidance. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning/GenAI, TOGAF, AI Engineer, or CKA/CKAD are preferred when supported by practical implementation experience. 

Experience

- Overall Experience of 14+ years in software development and architecture. 
 - 8+ years of architecture or technical design experience across distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, and cloud platforms. 
 - 3+ years architecting and delivering AI/GenAI solutions, including at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based system running in production with real users. 
 - Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures for complex, high-scale applications, from service decomposition and data modeling through deployment, observability, and operations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI components into existing products and legacy systems, including reliability, latency, cost, and security trade-offs. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, LLMOps/MLOps, and AI governance in a regulated industry; healthcare/EHR experience is preferred. 

Skills

- Expert knowledge of GenAI architecture: LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector search, agentic and multi-agent patterns, tool/function calling, and frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. 
 - Expert knowledge of system design and distributed systems: microservices, domain-driven design, API design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), event-driven architecture, messaging and streaming, consistency and state management, caching, and scalability patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of AI quality and safety: evaluation frameworks, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, AI observability, and Responsible AI principles. 
 - Strong understanding of full-stack product engineering, relational, NoSQL, and vector databases, CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, security architecture (identity, encryption, zero trust), and performance engineering. 
 - Ability to reason about and quantify trade-offs across accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability, and to explain them clearly. 
 - Ability to create architecture decision records, reference architectures, system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture decisions and trade-offs. 

Abilities

- Thinks in systems: designs the full request path, data flow, and failure modes around AI components, not only the model or prompt. 
 - Influences across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership teams without relying only on formal authority. 
 - Balances innovation speed with production readiness, customer commitments, and regulatory obligations. 
 - Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental delivery plans, and executable engineering guidance. 
 - Mentors teams toward full-cycle ownership, reusable patterns, and accountable AI engineering practices. 
 - Maintains practical governance that improves quality and speed rather than increasing unnecessary process overhead. 

Tools and Technologies

- GenAI and LLM platforms: AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, and open-weight models (e. g. , Llama, Mistral); Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Agent and orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AWS Bedrock Agents. 
 - Vector and knowledge stores: pgvector, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate; knowledge graphs and graph databases such as Neo4j or Neptune. 
 - AI evaluation and observability: LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or similar; OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, and APM tools. 
 - Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, Angular/React, Node. js, and legacy technologies relevant to existing products. 
 - AWS services including Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, IAM, Cognito, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Aurora, DynamoDB, Glue, and SageMaker. 
 - Kafka/streaming, relational and NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, data lakes, and distributed computing tools where applicable. 
 - CI/CD and platform tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git/GitHub, NuGet, NPM, and feature management tools. 
 - AI-assisted engineering tools: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, Claude, and approved AI assistants; architecture and documentation tools for diagrams, ADRs, and service catalogs. 

AI Usage and Accountability Requirements

- AI capabilities must be designed as part of the full system, with defined service boundaries, fallbacks, and ownership; prompts and agents are not shipped as standalone artifacts. 
 - Every production AI feature must have defined evaluation criteria, quality thresholds, monitoring, and a rollback path before release. 
 - PHI/PII handling, access control on retrieved data, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop controls must be designed in from the start, aligned with HIPAA and organizational AI policy. 
 - Architecture decisions must remain traceable to business goals, quality attributes, cost, implementation feasibility, and known trade-offs. 
 - AI-assisted recommendations, including those from coding and architecture assistants, must be validated against product context, engineering constraints, performance needs, maintainability, and operational risk. 
 - Reusable prompts, agent patterns, evaluation datasets, reference architectures, and design-review checklists should be maintained as organizational assets. 

Success Measures / Accountable Outcomes

- Number of GenAI and agentic capabilities moved from proof of concept to production, and time from proof of concept to production. 
 - AI quality and reliability against agreed targets: groundedness/accuracy, hallucination and escalation rates, latency, availability, and cost per transaction. 
 - Adoption of the shared AI platform and reference architectures across product teams, and reduction in duplicated or one-off AI implementations. 
 - Reduction in production incidents, integration defects, and technical debt attributable to architecture, including in AI-enabled services. 
 - No critical AI security or PHI incidents, with audit-ready AI governance documentation. 
 - Improvement in delivery readiness for strategic AI product initiatives and customer-committed capabilities. 

AI Competency Alignment

Competency

Target Proficiency

GenAI and LLM Solution Architecture

Agentic AI and Multi-Agent System Design

RAG and Knowledge Architecture

Authority and Autonomy

Leads AI and system architecture decisions for product areas and complex initiatives. Determines AI platform direction, architecture approaches, standards, service models, and model and vendor choices in partnership with engineering, product, security, and compliance leadership. Holds authority to require architecture and AI readiness review before AI capabilities reach production. Work is reviewed through alignment with business goals, technical outcomes, product objectives, and departmental strategy.

data.description:

Job Description

As an SSD Firmware Validation Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc. , your responsibilities will include: 

Define Test Plan/Design, test cases and develop Test Scripts to validate Firmware for Enterprise and Datacenter class NVMe SSD products. As part of Firmware Test Engineering team, you would demonstrate high degree of skills to understand one or more areas of FW: Front End, Back end/Media management, FTL or Security. You would also exhibit high degree of competency in understanding NVMe/PCIe specifications, NVMe Cloud SSD Specifications, along with understanding Customer specific requirements. You will be working in partnership with Firmware development teams through the lifecycle of the product while finding defects and validating the fixes by create grey and Whitebox tests. Be able to demonstrate success in communicating status, issues, concerns, strategies of programs and projects - including development of appropriate indicators. Must be able to deal with ambiguity and operate with little direction to meet defined goals. Must be able to collaborate with others to achieve goals and task completion. Comprehend and articulate validation strategies, plans and status. Review, track and document test results and sightings Drive issues to closure by interfacing/collaborating with other product development team. 

Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering with 7+ years of experience in SSD Firmware Validation. 
 - Proficiency in using AI tools (Claude) in order to perform tasks efficiently. 
 - Understanding of Whitebox and grey box test methods for Enterprise / Datacenter SSD Firmware is strong plus. 
 - Good hands on experience in debugging NVMe Protocol issues using Lecroy/JDSU analyzers is highly desired. 
 - Must have prepared good test plans involving access patterns, NVMe protocols, FW test hooks and VS commands for one or more following areas of FW: Front End, Back End, FTL and Security. 
 - Integrate tests into an automated test environment and collaborate with test execution teams to drive validation plans/strategy. 
 - Good Knowledge of Linux operating system debugging and Coding in Python. 
 - Effective oral and written communication with strong analytical, problem solving, and project management skills
 - Demonstrated ability to work well with others and collaborate effectively in a team environment
 - Expert planning and tracking skills, able to see big picture, well-organized, focused on results, capable of managing multiple projects, excellent time management with respect to priorities and self-management. 
 - Must have excellent knowledge of system storage and the relationship to the platform ingredients: CPU, Memory, PCIe, drivers, OS, firmware, etc.

data.title: NAP Network Test Automation Development Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

As Network Test Automation Development Engineer is responsible for designing and developing scalable, intelligent test automation solutions for complex network systems. This role combines strong networking expertise with modern automation, CI/CD, and AI/ML technologies to ensure high quality, reliability, and faster delivery of carrier-grade, cloud-native network products. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for functional, regression, performance, and end‐to‐end network testing. 
 - Develop automated test suites using Python, Java, or Go with frameworks such as Robot Framework, pytest, and Selenium. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster release cycles. 
 - Apply AI/ML techniques for intelligent test case generation, anomaly detection, predictive defect analysis, and self‐healing automation. 
 - Analyze large volumes of test and network data to identify patterns, trends, and quality risks. 
 - Develop AI‐driven tools for network test data analysis, insights, and visualization. 
 - Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to ensure testability and timely defect resolution. 
 - Contribute to test strategy, code reviews, design discussions, and maintain automation documentation. 

Key Skills And Experience

You have: 

- Bachelor degree with 8-12 years of relevant experience. 7+ years of experience with strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Go for test automation and tool development. 
 - Hands‐on experience with test automation frameworks such as Robot Framework, pytest, Selenium, and Postman. 
 - Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures (TCP/IP, IP/MPLS, Routing & Switching, SDN/NFV, 4G/5G). 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar). 

It would be nice if you also had: 

- Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts applied to automation or data analysis. 
 - Exposure to ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit‐learn. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms and container technologies (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Strong analytical, problem‐solving, communication, and cross‐functional collaboration skills.

- Technical Lead in the IT Consulting Services team to work on various Guidewire implementation projects with Portal and EDGE implementation for our customers across the globe.

 - Real time knowledge and experience on enterprise system integration, Preferably from Insurance domain background.

 - Excellent leadership skills.

data.title: FIRMWARE TEST ENGINEER
data.description:
Company Description

ThreatXIntel is a growing Cybersecurity, IT Staffing, and Consulting company delivering end-to-end technology and security solutions. 

We are hiring for our corporate client. ThreatXIntel is the official hiring partner for this requirement. 

We are looking for an experienced Firmware Test Engineer with strong hands-on experience in embedded/firmware testing, communication interfaces, Linux testing, and test automation. 

Key Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Firmware Testing / Embedded Testing

• Strong understanding of UART, RS485 and SPI interfaces

• Experience with Linux OS testing

• Good understanding of communication protocols and validation of implementation

• Hands-on experience with RS485 interface tools and communication sniffing tools

• Exposure to test automation using Python

• Knowledge of Selenium or Playwright is preferred

• Strong debugging, defect tracking and analytical skills

• Good communication skills

Key Responsibilities

• Perform manual testing of physical access controllers and readers

• Set up and configure test environments involving access controllers and readers

• Execute detailed test plans, test cases and test scripts

• Identify, document and track defects/issues

• Develop and execute automated test scripts

• Perform Regression, Stress, Load, Performance and System Testing

• Validate communication protocols and interface implementations

• Analyze test failures and collaborate with development teams for resolution

What We're Looking For

Someone who is comfortable working close to the hardware + firmware + communication layer, rather than only performing application-level testing.

data.title: MS-AI4AI-PlatformBuild-Manager
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Job Title: AI Platform Build Manager

Role Overview: 

In the role of AI Platform Build Manager within EY GDS's Managed Services "AI for AI" team, you will be at the helm of pioneering AI/ML and Agentic project deliveries, with a keen focus on leveraging AWS or Azure GenAI, NLP, and Transformer models to drive innovation and solve complex challenges. Your leadership will be instrumental in managing a portfolio of Agentic engagements, fostering strong relationships with global clients and EY stakeholders, and steering your team towards delivering excellence. You will play a critical role in nurturing a team of high-caliber professionals, cultivating a culture of high performance, and maintaining EY's reputation as a leader in AI/ML and Agentic solutions. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Direct the complete lifecycle management of advanced analytics, Agentic ML, AI, and GenAI initiatives, with a focus on NLP and Transformer models, ensuring flawless integration with cloud services. 
 - Act as a mentor to junior team members, providing them with the training and insights needed to become proficient in AI/ML and cloud technologies. 
 - Display outstanding project management skills, leading the charge in the successful delivery of complex AI/ML projects, adhering to tight deadlines, and exceeding client expectations. 
 - Engage actively in problem-solving and hands-on technical delivery, committing to the highest levels of quality and pushing the envelope of innovation. 
 - Analytical Problem Solving - Possess the ability to dissect problems from a holistic perspective, rather than being constrained by specific techniques. 
 - Planning: Demonstrate the capacity to make significant contributions to both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning. 
 - Industry Knowledge - Stay informed about the latest developments in Data Science and AI, and adeptly apply this knowledge to a variety of scenarios. 
 - Integrated View - Skillfully consolidate diverse perspectives, data sources, and methodologies to address and resolve client issues effectively. 
 - Relationship Management - Cultivate and maintain strong, healthy relationships and partnerships with clients, EY partners, senior leaders, and team members at all levels. 
 - Knowledge of Analytical Tools - Have a solid understanding of the foundational features of Data Science tools such as Python, R, or SAS. 
 - Getting Work Done Through Others - Possess the leadership ability to delegate effectively, overseeing a team of 5-10 people or more. This role is not suited for those who prefer to work as individual contributors. 
 - Inspiring Others - Have the charisma and leadership qualities necessary to inspire and motivate team members, being a true people person. 

Skills and Attributes for Success: 

- Exceptional technical acumen in AWS cloud services, GenAI, NLP, and Transformer AI/ML models, coupled with a track record of successful implementations. 
 - Outstanding project management prowess, characterized by a methodical and results-driven approach to overseeing intricate AI/ML initiatives from concept to completion. 
 - Superior communication skills, with a talent for distilling complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and accessible language for a diverse array of stakeholders. 
 - Strategic insight and foresight, contributing to the overarching vision and strategic direction of the Data Sciences team, while staying attuned to the latest industry trends and technological advancements. 
 - Oversee ethical AI practices, ensuring fairness, accountability, and transparency in AI systems. 
 - Expert in AI governance, implementing and monitoring responsible AI frameworks. 
 - Manage risk and compliance with regulatory and ethical standards for AI deployment. 
 - Champion ethical decision-making in AI development and operational processes. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Methods, or a related field; advanced degrees or certifications in cloud/Agentic technologies (AWS, Azure) are strongly preferred. 
 - An MBA or equivalent experience in business management is highly valued. 
 - Relevant experience in advanced analytical/AI/Agentic Platform Build roles of 5-8 years
 - Demonstrated expertise in deploying AI/ML solutions on AWS or any other Hyperscaler and a deep understanding of advanced data modeling techniques. 

What We Offer: 

- A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact. 
 - Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement. 
 - A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth.

data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote is the content business unit of Nielsen that powers the world of media entertainment. Our metadata solutions help media and entertainment companies around the world deliver personalized content search and discovery, connecting audiences with the content they love. We're at the intersection of people and media entertainment. 

With our cutting-edge technology and solutions, we help audiences easily find TV shows, movies, music and sports across multiple platforms. As the world leader in entertainment data and services, we power the world's top streaming platforms, cable and satellite TV providers, media companies, consumer electronics manufacturers, music services and automakers to navigate and succeed in the competitive streaming world. Our metadata entertainment solutions have a global footprint of 80+ countries, 100K+ channels and catalogs, 70+ sports and 100M+ music tracks, all across 35 languages. 

Job Purpose

- Architect & Design our flagship metadata software solutions. 
 - Design applications with a Platform-first mentality where scale, consistency and reliability are at the core of every decision. 
 - Responsible for driving Technology & good practices in Engineering in their respective teams. 
 - Partner with the Product team to translate vague business requirements into concrete, feasible technical roadmaps. 
 - Actively participate in development along with team members for as much as 60% of their time, creating modules & systems that can then be treated as a working reflection of the best practices. 
 - Cross-System Integration ensuring data flow seamlessly & consistently across ingestion, processing and data deliveries to end customers. 
 - Work closely with Data Science, DevOps, and Frontend architects to ensure our backend infrastructure supports emerging needs. 
 - Being responsible for Scaling, Performance & Quality. 
 - Experiment with new & relevant technologies and tools, and drive adoption while measuring yourself on the impact you can create. 
 - Implementation of long-term technology vision for your teams. 
 - Creating architectures & designs for new solutions around existing and new problem spaces. 
 - Responsible for the architecture of your platform; ensuring it is aligned to the long term requirements and the platform vision. 
 - Drive technology & tool choices for your team & be responsible for them. 
 - Drive technology forums & rhythms in the team to drive best practices. Establish organization-wide engineering standards (coding guidelines, API contracts, security protocols, design standards) to ensure consistency across different teams. 
 - Mentor and guide Senior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration within the team
 - Going beyond your role and contributing to make the organization & business better. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of professional experience in software development
 - Experience in designing, developing and scaling enterprise grade applications, including developing solutions from scratch. 
 - In depth knowledge and proficiency of messaging queue concepts 
 - Proficiency in Java/Python frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, or similar. 
 - Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies (e. g. , HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus. 
 - Working knowledge of machine learning and data science concepts 
 - Champion of SDLC practices. Understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, etc. ). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as in a team environment. 
 - Strong understanding of application development, infrastructure management, data engineering and platform constructs. 
 - Deep understanding of various datastores: SQL & NoSQL. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Familiarity with containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices. 
 - Experience with test-driven development (TDD) and automated testing frameworks. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package. 
 - Opportunities for professional growth and development. 
 - A collaborative and inclusive work environment. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.description:
Technical Architect - Design for Test (DFT)

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 12-16 Years

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Architect - DFT to define and drive DFT architecture, methodology, and implementation for complex ASIC/SoC designs. The role requires deep technical expertise in MBIST, ATPG, scan insertion, and end-to-end DFT sign-off, with ownership of test architecture, coverage optimization, and design-for-manufacturing requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive DFT architecture and test strategies for complex IP and SoC designs. 
 - Own scan architecture, scan insertion, scan compression, and DFT RTL integration. 
 - Architect and implement MBIST solutions, including memory test algorithms, controller integration, and verification. 
 - Drive ATPG pattern generation, fault simulation, pattern validation, and test coverage closure. 
 - Develop DFT specifications, implementation plans, and sign-off methodologies. 
 - Optimize stuck-at, transition-delay, and other relevant fault coverage while managing test time and pattern volume. 
 - Drive DFT rule checking, testability analysis, and resolution of DFT violations. 
 - Collaborate with RTL, Physical Design, Verification, and Silicon Validation teams to ensure seamless DFT integration. 
 - Debug DFT-related issues and support silicon bring-up, manufacturing test, and yield improvement.

 - In-depth experience with MBIST architecture, integration, and verification. 
 - Strong understanding of scan compression, scan-chain architecture, and test-point insertion. 
 - Hands-on experience with ATPG pattern generation, fault modeling, fault simulation, and coverage analysis. 
 - Expertise in DFT rule checking, testability analysis, and DFT sign-off. 
 - Experience with industry-standard DFT tools such as Synopsys TestMAX, Siemens Tessent, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of stuck-at and transition-delay fault models, test coverage, and manufacturing test requirements. 
 - Knowledge of DFT timing, area, power, and physical implementation trade-offs. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LBIST, JTAG/IEEE 1149. 1, boundary scan, and hierarchical DFT. 
 - Exposure to advanced technology nodes and complex SoC test architectures. 
 - Experience with post-silicon DFT debug, ATE integration, and silicon yield analysis. 
 - Strong technical leadership, architecture documentation, and cross-functional problem-solving skills. Education

B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

data.description:
Why UKG

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That's what we do. 

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you'll get flexibility that's real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters-and so do you. 

We are looking for innovative and dynamic Senior Staff Software Engineers to join our dynamic team. This role provides an opportunity to lead projects and contribute to high-impact software solutions that are used by enterprises and users worldwide. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, operation, and maintenance of complex software systems, as well as mentoring junior colleagues. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to the technical foundation behind our flagship products and services. 

Skills

We are seeking engineers with diverse specialties and skills to join our dynamic team to innovate and solve complex problems. Our team is looking for exceptional engineers with expertise in the following areas: 

- Front End UI: (UI/UX design principles, responsive design, JavaScript frameworks)
 - Platform: (CI/CD Pipelines, IAC proficiency, Containerization/Orchestration, Cloud Platforms)
 - Back End: (API Development, Database Management, Security Practices, Message Queuing)
 - AI/ML: (Machine Learning Frameworks, Data Processing, Algorithm Development, Big Data Technologies, Domain Knowledge)

- Software Development: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code for various software applications and systems.

 - Architectural Design: Participate in design reviews with peers and stakeholders and in the architectural design of new features and systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Code Review: Diligent about reviewing code developed by other engineers, provide feedback and maintain a high bar of technical excellence to ensure code is adhering to industry standard best practices like coding guidelines, elegant, efficient and maintainable code, with observability built from ground up, unit tests etc.

 - Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as C++, C#, . NET, Python, Java, or JavaScript.

 - Proficiency with version control systems like GitHub and bug/work tracking systems like JIRA. 
 - Understanding of cloud technologies and DevOps principles. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry - because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg. com. 

UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.
