 - Experience building scalable automation frameworks for analytics, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. 
 - Strong telecom domain experience across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G technologies. 
 - In-depth understanding of SIP signaling, call flows, telecom protocols, voice services, and service assurance platforms. 
 - Experience validating telecom KPIs, network performance metrics, subscriber analytics, QoS/QoE measurements, alarms, and operational reporting systems. 
 - Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, model validation techniques, and AI-driven application testing. 
 - Experience validating feature engineering pipelines, data transformations, model outputs, and prediction results.

 - Experience validating dashboards, reporting platforms, trend analysis, anomaly detection outputs, and time-series analytics. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and automation development. 
 - Hands-on experience with PyTest and automated test execution frameworks. 
 - Expertise in REST API testing and validation using Postman and automation frameworks. 
 - Experience creating automated validation suites for APIs, data platforms, analytics services, and ML workflows. 
 - Experience with Git, Docker, Linux, Jira, Kubernetes, and CI/CD environments. 
 - Understanding of MLOps processes and model lifecycle validation. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Ability to independently investigate complex ML, telecom, and data-quality issues. 
 - Excellent documentation, reporting, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing - an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. 

NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group is the team that gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU silicon program from first power-on to high-volume production. We are hiring an HSIO Validation Engineer to own characterization and qualification of high-speed I/Os - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, and Ethernet - on brand-new silicon serving datacenter, AI, and client markets. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Own end-to-end characterization and validation of high-speed IO - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, Ethernet - from silicon die through package and board, on NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SoCs. 
 - Develop and execute validation test plans for silicon and SoC-level HSIO features - bring-up, corner qualification, stress, productization, and structured DOE across PVT, board, cable/connector, thermal, and firmware variables - left-shifting silicon failures before deployment. 
 - Drive power characterization and optimization across IO interconnects under workload-representative stimuli (MLPerf-class patterns at silicon/board level) - analyze trade-offs across V/F, lane config, and protocol state - and feed back into design, firmware, and binning. 
 - Drive systematic root-cause analysis for complex HSIO bugs - isolating contributions across silicon, package, board, firmware, and driver, with platform/thermal/mechanical partners when system context matters. Convert rack-observed failures into silicon/board reproducers so future spins fix the root cause upstream. 
 - Assess manufacturing and yield implications of HSIO margin distributions - identify gaps in scaling from chip to product, and feed back into binning and design. 
 - Develop and improve validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and margin-tracking infrastructure - increase efficiency and coverage as platform complexity grows. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical or Computer Engineering (or equivalent), with 3+ years in post-silicon HSIO validation, characterization, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Deep understanding of high-speed serial link protocols (PCIe Gen5+, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, CXL) and the underlying SERDES architecture - equalization, link training, electrical characterization - with strong signal integrity and jitter knowledge. 
 - Strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Hands-on with lab instrumentation (DSOs, BERTs, VNAs, protocol/logic analyzers, TDR), DOE/shmoo/margin-trending, and Python-based test automation - with a track record of driving cross-functional debug across chip, package, board, firmware, driver, and system teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Hands-on experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or NVLink validation on production silicon - link training, equalization tuning, BER margining, or compliance debug. 
 - Prior SERDES, mixed-signal, or analog circuit design experience - sufficient to independently form hypotheses, design Sim-to-Si correlation experiments, and propose silicon/system-side fixes during debug. 
 - Track record of translating rack-environment conditions (thermal, connector reliability, neighbor noise) into silicon/board characterization - finding marginality at die-and-board scale before it appears in the field. 
 - Comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to compress log triage, regression analysis, scripting, and reporting workflows.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. 

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day. 

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale. 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to join our Hyderabad team. In this role, you'll lead, build, and grow teams of world-class engineers, taking responsibility for their technical execution and impact through ambiguity as we scale. This role is based in our Hyderabad office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office. 

Get to know our Engineering team - what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. 

What You'll Be Doing

In this role, you will lead a multi-disciplinary team of engineers across various platforms. You will report to a Senior Engineering Manager or Engineering Director, helping to shape the future of our three-sided marketplace. 

Here's What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like

- Lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team of Backend, iOS, Android, and Web engineers, fostering a diverse and high-achieving environment. 
 - Drive technical and product strategy by setting clear project goals, guiding implementation choices, and ensuring your team hits group-level metrics. 
 - Champion a learning culture through active mentorship, helping engineers and emerging leaders accelerate their careers. 
 - Scale our engineering practices by implementing processes and values that improve team efficiency and code quality. 
 - Maintain technical engagement by contributing to code reviews and technical design, ensuring the health and observability of your team's systems. 

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: 

- Significant experience in people management, with at least 2 years spent leading engineering teams through performance reviews and goal setting. 
 - A strong technical background as a Software Engineer, with a proven ability to build user-focused products at pace. 
 - Demonstrated success in team building, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting the personal growth of colleagues. 
 - Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, managing both local and remote engineers to deliver high-impact projects. 
 - Experience collaborating across disciplines, working closely with Product, Design, and Operations to influence the broader roadmap. 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, You'll Do Work That Matters-solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That's Constantly Evolving. We're Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. 

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. 

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine-our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage. 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. 

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. 

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. 

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

data.description:
Job Description

Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team full-time in India. 

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4, 000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 

About The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. This role is ideal for someone who can work across frontend experiences, backend services, integrations, and agent workflow orchestration, helping turn business workflows into production-ready AI-enabled features. The engineer will work closely with product, architecture, AI engineering, and platform teams to build usable, secure, and scalable agent interfaces that connect into enterprise systems, data sources, LLM services, and internal client platform capabilities. You will help develop the end-to-end application layer for AI agents - from the user-facing screens where business users interact with agents, to the backend APIs and integration services that allow agents to retrieve data, trigger workflows, call enterprise systems, and return structured outputs. You will be expected to build clean frontend components, robust backend services, secure API integrations, and reusable patterns that accelerate the delivery of multiple agents across a wide range of use cases.

- Build full stack features for AI agent use cases, including chat interfaces, task review screens, approval flows, exception queues and operational dashboards

 - Connect agents with enterprise systems, databases, document stores, APIs and event-based workflows used within client environment

 - Implement secure, production-ready patterns for authentication, RBAC, tenant-aware data access, logging, testing, CI/CD and deployment support

Requirements

- Strong hands-on experience with React, TypeScript, modern frontend patterns and business application UI development

 - Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or similar relational databases; exposure to vector databases is beneficial

Desirable

 - Familiarity with AWS services, especially AWS Bedrock, API Gateway, Lambda, S3, and related cloud-native services

What's in it for you?

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
 - Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
 - Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
 - Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you'll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. 

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level. 

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can't wait to see you at Ciklum.

Overview: 

Guidepoint's Market Research Team is seeking a leader for its Survey Programming team, to help centralize, standardize, and grow a function dedicated to programming and coding questionnaires into web-based platforms, and conducting QA on programmed survey work. This position would be expected to work hours aligned with US-based colleagues on the East Coast. 

This can be a hybrid position out of one of our offices in India (Mumbai, Pune, ) or remote.

- Oversee a team of 6 survey programmers of differing experience levels, setting standards for quality assurance and timely delivery of questionnaires programmed into Qualtrics
 - Coordinate with other quantitative survey operational team leads (fieldwork, data automation) and client service staff/project managers to ensure effective cross-functional collaboration
 - Serve as a strategic lead for survey programming within the market research organization, helping to design processes, systems, and best practice documentation for survey programming at Guidepoint
 - Train and mentor junior staff on best practices for survey programming and coding, including improving efficiency in translating spec documents to final survey designs, effectively testing routing and randomization for accuracy, and using JavaScript and other custom web design languages to create custom layouts and presentations to meet client needs
 - Serve as a senior voice for internal communication, stepping in to resolve project issues between team members and operational staff, provide leadership on kickoffs for complex or sustained engagements, and serve as an advisor on sales or internal kick-off calls where demonstrated programming experience is needed
 - Consult as needed with survey project teams on survey design, making best-practice recommendations on question type or structure that will best work within our systems and reduce respondent burden, and flagging any designs that may be particularly time-consuming or challenging to execute successfully
 - Serve as a direct project manager on large or urgent work as-needed
 - Other duties as required

What You Have: 

- 10+ years experience in programming market research surveys in Qualtrics (strongly preferred) or another online survey platform (Decipher/Forsta, Alchemer, Sawtooth, Versive)
 - 3+ years experience managing teams of programmers or other operations staff in market research to achieve targets on volume, timeliness, and quality
 - Ability to interface with internal leaders, helping to set strategy and training goals for survey programming, identify and resolve problems at a project and strategic level as they arise
 - Experience with JavaScript/jQuery, HTML, and CSS for developing custom question types or presentations, including training and upskilling staff on web design languages and tools
 - Experience QAing surveys and designing survey QA processes and workflows to ensure that work aligns to requested spec/design work
 - Ability to consult and train on best practices for survey design and experience, flagging if survey designs may have issues that make them difficult for end-respondents to answer

- Competitive compensation 
 - Employee medical coverage 
 - Central office location 
 - Entrepreneurial environment, autonomy, and fast decisions

 - Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
 - Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies
 - Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
 - Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable
 - Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
 - Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs
 - Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests
 - Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off
 - Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
 - Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
 - Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy

Requirements

- 8+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
 - Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other non-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
 - Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
 - Solid SQL and data-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
 - A security-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
 - Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non-engineering stakeholders
 - Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
 - QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript-based) and integrating them into high-security CI/CD pipelines
 - AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
 - Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning

Desirable

- Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
 - Prior testing of multi-tenant SaaS isolation
 - Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
 - Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
 - Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
 - Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
 - Performance Testing: Experience testing high-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
 - Experience with qTest for test management

What's in it for you?

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
 - Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
 - Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
 - Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
 - Care: We've got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you'll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. 

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

data.title: Manager, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: Sr Software Engineer,  Now
data.description:
Description

Amazon is building India's Quick Commerce offering - Amazon Now - delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We build world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless operations across our network. We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for the team, owning the architecture and engineering direction across all of our charters - with a primary focus on the Selection experience: how we curate, manage, and scale the right assortment for every customer, in every city. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly fuel Amazon Now's expansion across India. You will set the technical bar for the team, drive the hardest design problems end-to-end, and multiply the impact of every engineer around you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection - curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
 - Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters - store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations - ensuring architectural coherence across them
 - Architect systems that onboard new stores rapidly across cities, and that scale reliably to hundreds of stores while maintaining low operational latencies
 - Lead the hardest design decisions end-to-end: evaluate trade-offs, simplify complexity, and set patterns the rest of the team builds on
 - Mentor and coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team
 - Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous, complex business problems into durable technical solutions
 - Champion operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), lead design reviews, and own a high quality bar for all deliverables

A day in the life

You'll review operational metrics to ensure system health across live stores, unblock engineers on their toughest technical challenges, and dive deep into system designs - weighing trade-offs and cutting complexity. You'll lead design reviews across the team's charters, mentor engineers on architecture patterns, and shape deployment plans for features rolling out across multiple cities, ensuring rollback strategies, monitoring, and alarms are in place before launch. As a senior, you'll help set technical direction and priorities, with Selection as your primary canvas. 

About The Team

Amazon Now builds the technology behind India's Quick Commerce experience - from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated for each neighborhood, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery in minutes. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving hard problems in real-time inventory, catalog and selection management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work reaches millions of customers who count on us for everyday essentials, fast. 

This role is the senior technical anchor of the team, setting architectural direction across every charter we own - with Selection as the primary focus. It's a rare scope: deep ownership of one of our most important problem spaces, combined with technical influence across the whole team. 

We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.title: Senior Manager - WSMD Lab (Copper Concentrate)
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Job Purpose

The QA Lab Head in a copper mining and smelting operation ensures the highest standards of quality across all stages of production by overseeing various lab functions. The role involves managing multiple labs, ensuring compliance with industry regulations, optimizing testing processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve quality control and operational efficiency. 

Responsibilities

Lab Operations Planning and Execution: 

- Manage daily and shift-wise laboratory testing activities in line with smelter production priorities. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, preparation, analysis, and reporting of samples from smelting, converting, refining, slag, dust, by-products, and related process streams. 
 - Coordinate with production, process, and quality teams to prioritize urgent samples and ensure quick analytical feedback for operational decisions. 
 - Monitor adherence to sample collection, labelling, preservation, testing, and reporting protocols to maintain reliability of results. 

Process Optimization And Continuous Improvement

- Identify improvement opportunities in sample preparation, testing turnaround time, analytical accuracy, and laboratory workflow efficiency. 
 - Support implementation of standard methods, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives within WSMD laboratory operations. 
 - Track routine operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions with the Lab Head and concerned departments. 
 - Assist in adoption of improved analytical practices, automation support, and digital tools for better lab productivity and data reliability. 

Quality Assurance And Control

- Ensure execution of quality control checks, calibration verification, standardization, and validation of analytical results as per defined procedures. 
 - Maintain compliance with approved laboratory SOPs, test methods, internal quality standards, and applicable statutory or customer requirements. 
 - Review routine test data for abnormalities, deviations, or inconsistencies and escalate critical issues to the WSMD Lab Head. 
 - Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for testing errors, repeat analysis, delays, and non-conformities. 

Equipment Readiness And Troubleshooting

- Ensure availability, calibration, routine checks, and proper functioning of laboratory instruments and equipment used for WSMD analysis. 
 - Coordinate with maintenance, OEMs, and service providers for troubleshooting, breakdown resolution, AMC support, and instrument reliability. 
 - Maintain equipment logbooks, calibration records, preventive maintenance schedules, and breakdown history for audit readiness. 
 - Support safe and correct operation of instruments by lab chemists, technicians, and shift personnel. 

HSE And Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure strict adherence to HSE requirements, PPE usage, chemical handling procedures, waste disposal norms, and emergency response protocols inside the WSMD Lab. 
 - Conduct routine safety observations, housekeeping checks, and compliance follow-ups in coordination with the Lab Head and Safety team. 
 - Support compliance with environmental and statutory requirements related to laboratory chemicals, residues, samples, and waste streams. 
 - Promote safe work practices among lab team members and ensure timely closure of safety observations and audit points. 

Cost Management And Budgeting

- Monitor consumption of chemicals, reagents, gases, standards, glassware, spares, and other laboratory consumables to support uninterrupted operations. 
 - Assist the Lab Head in inventory planning, PR follow-up, vendor coordination, and cost control initiatives for routine lab requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, optimize reagent usage, and improve cost efficiency without compromising testing quality. 
 - Maintain records of consumable usage, stock levels, and critical inventory items for operational planning and audit purposes. 

Shift Team Coordination And Capability Building

- Coordinate daily work allocation for lab chemists, technicians, samplers, and shift personnel as per testing load and operational requirements. 
 - Guide team members on standard test procedures, safe lab practices, instrument handling, documentation, and quality expectations. 
 - Support training, skill development, and multi-skilling of laboratory team members to build operational flexibility. 
 - Ensure continuity of laboratory operations during shifts, peak workload, audits, and absence of senior leadership, while developing readiness to succeed the WSMD Lead role in future. 

Reporting And Data Analytics

- Ensure timely preparation, review, and submission of routine analytical reports, shift reports, quality summaries, deviation reports, and MIS data. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation of sample records, test results, calibration data, corrective actions, and audit-related information. 
 - Analyze lab performance trends such as turnaround time, repeat testing, deviations, equipment uptime, and sample load to support improvement actions. 
 - Escalate critical quality trends, abnormal results, and urgent operational issues to the WSMD Lab Head and concerned stakeholders. 

Digitization And Tech Adoption

- Support use of SAP Lab/LIMS and other digital systems for sample tracking, result entry, report generation, and data traceability. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate digital updating of test results, equipment records, calibration schedules, and lab MIS. 
 - Assist in implementation of automation, dashboards, and data-driven reporting practices to improve laboratory efficiency. 
 - Promote disciplined data entry, record retention, and system compliance among lab team members. 

Qualifications

Education Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related science/engineering discipline

Master's degree in Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

Over 15 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the Copper Manufacturing industry

Relevant experience in laboratory operations, analytical quality control, or process lab functions, preferably in copper smelting, metals, mining, chemicals, or process industry environment; suitable for Senior Manager level with team coordination, operational ownership, and future leadership readiness

Certifications

Certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance

data.title: Architect - System Performance Verification and Analysis
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. 

NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today. Our work spans the full pre-silicon and post-silicon lifecycle: performance models, RTL simulation, emulation platforms, and silicon bringup. We catch bugs early, influence architecture and design decisions, and help ensure that the final product delivers the performance that our customers depend on. If you are passionate about building the hardware that underpins the future of AI and computing, this is where you belong. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Partner with System Architecture, Usecase Modeling, Unit Architecture/PV, and Design/Verification teams to define comprehensive performance test plans that reflect real product usecases. 
 - Drive full-chip SoC performance verification across all real engines and subsystems, running realistic concurrent workloads that represent how the product will be used by customers in the field. 
 - Execute performance test plans across the full verification stack: cycle-accurate performance models, RTL simulation, emulation platforms, and silicon, identifying bottlenecks and regressions at each stage. 
 - Debug performance failures through waveform analysis, signal-level queries, trace analysis, and system-level profiling to root-cause issues in the memory subsystem, fabric, or individual engines. 
 - Influence architecture and microarchitecture decisions by surfacing performance data and trade-off analysis to the design and architecture teams early in the product development cycle. 
 - Develop and maintain performance workloads, test suites, and infrastructure - including testbench components, performance simulators, analysis scripts, and automated regression flows. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted tools and automation to accelerate repetitive analysis tasks, improve coverage, and free up engineering time for higher-level problem solving. This includes using LLM-based assistants for querying results and specs, AI-driven triage of regressions, and intelligent tooling that improves over time. 
 - Drive methodology improvements to reduce verification turnaround time, improve coverage of representative workloads, and enable earlier performance insight in the product development cycle. 

What We Need To See

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. S. /M. Tech (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 3+ years of relevant experience in SoC or system-level architecture, performance verification, or hardware validation. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC architecture including GPU and CPU pipelines, memory subsystem design (caches, DRAM controllers, coherency), Network-on-Chip (NoC)/fabric architecture, and high-speed IO interfaces. 
 - Hands-on experience with RTL simulation and debug, including waveform-based debug and signal-level querying to isolate performance failures. 
 - Solid programming skills in Python and C/C++; scripting proficiency in Bash/Python for automation and analysis. Exposure to Verilog/SystemVerilog or SystemC/TLM is a strong plus. 
 - Strong debugging, data analysis, and statistical analysis skills - ability to synthesize large volumes of performance data into actionable insights. 
 - Experience with or exposure to pre-silicon performance analysis methodologies, including performance models, cycle-approximate simulators, or emulation platforms. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a large, globally distributed engineering organization. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Deep experience with RTL-level performance debug - particularly the ability to formulate precise signal queries and interpret waveforms to root-cause complex system-level interactions. 
 - Background in system-level performance analysis for GPU, AI accelerators, or high-bandwidth memory subsystems, with knowledge of bottleneck identification across multiple concurrent engines. 
 - Demonstrated use of AI and LLM-based tools (e. g. , NVIDIA NIM/NeMo, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, or similar agentic frameworks) to measurably improve your own engineering productivity - whether for automated analysis, natural-language querying of data, intelligent triage, or workflow automation. 
 - Experience building or deploying ML/AI-assisted tooling in an engineering or EDA context (e. g. , regression analysis, anomaly detection, test generation, coverage closure). 
 - Expertise in data analysis and visualization - ability to build dashboards and tooling that surface performance trends clearly to both engineering and architecture stakeholders.

Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows.  - Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
 - Analyze data trends and develop solutions
 - Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
 - Create and maintain quality metrics reports

A day in the life

Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows - reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. Description

Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence. 

Key job responsibilities

- Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
 - Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
 - Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
 - Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
 - Analyze data trends and develop solutions
 - Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
 - Create and maintain quality metrics reports
 - Handle customer escalations and recommendations
 - Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
 - Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life

Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows - reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams. 

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams). 

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality. 

About The Team

The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have hands-on experience building automated tests and a drive to keep growing their skills.

On a typical day, you will: 

- Work alongside a highly collaborative and talented engineering team.

Required Skills

Skills and attributes for success

- Curious, lifelong learner who is excited to develop new skills and explore new technologies. 
 - Passionate about software quality, automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - At least 2 years of experience developing software in Python. 
 - Experience developing automated test pipelines for Python-based ETL processes. 
 - Experience consuming REST APIs using Python. 
 - Working knowledge of asynchronous Python (asyncio) and strategies for testing asynchronous code. 
 - Experience translating business requirements into automated functional tests. 

Nice to have

- Experience developing automated tests for Apache Airflow pipelines. 
 - Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience testing data-intensive or distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with AWS services commonly used in data pipelines. 

What We Look For

We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you. A BE or B-Tech in computer Science, or equivalent is a great preference.

 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Why join our team?

We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology. 

Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you're ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you've come to the right place.

ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations. 

Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. As Manager - AI Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists delivering GenAI-powered solutions, agentic AI systems, LLM-integrated applications, machine learning models, and retrieval-enabled intelligent products. This role combines technical leadership, people management, delivery accountability, and product ownership. You will be responsible for ensuring that the team delivers scalable, secure, supportable, and business-relevant AI and ML solutions from discovery through production operation and continuous improvement. 

This is not a lightweight line-management role. The successful candidate must be technically strong enough to guide senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads, make sound architectural and implementation trade-offs, and raise the engineering bar of the team. You are expected to provide hands-on technical direction across LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration, RAG, ML model development, MLOps, cloud-native application delivery, integrations, observability, and SDLC discipline, while also building a culture of accountability, ownership, experimentation rigor, and engineering excellence. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Lead AI Engineers, Lead Data Scientists, Platform teams, DevOps, Security, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into implementable engineering work and durable product outcomes.

- Lead and mentor a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists across varying experience levels, including senior engineers and technical leads, ensuring strong delivery quality, modeling rigor, engineering discipline, and technical growth

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI / ML engineering, data science, solution engineering, or technology delivery, including strong experience building and operating production-grade intelligent systems

 - Strong hands-on or design-level experience with LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise GenAI delivery
 - Strong experience designing or guiding implementations involving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings pipelines, vector search, grounding strategies, and retrieval optimization using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
 - Strong understanding of machine learning model development, including feature engineering, model training, validation, tuning, evaluation, performance interpretation, and production-readiness considerations
 - Practical experience guiding or reviewing MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, drift detection, retraining readiness, and reproducibility
 - Experience building and deploying AI- and ML-enabled cloud-native services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes / AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization, deployment automation, secure delivery practices, and operational readiness for AI-driven and ML-enabled systems
 - Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) interaction models, memory / context management approaches, and other distributed AI coordination patterns
 - Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry, Log Analytics, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent platforms, including monitoring of reliability, latency, cost, runtime behavior, and model / workflow health
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI implementation patterns, including multi-step orchestration, tool calling, context management, and workflow decomposition

 - Demonstrated ability to translate business and product needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI / ML engineering solutions, while guiding teams on implementation trade-offs, experimentation choices, and delivery sequencing

Preferred Qualifications

Department Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active SIP based microservices across multi-site deployments. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and architect high-throughput, stateless SIP microservices using Go, achieving strict performance targets such as 5, 000+ TPS and sub-15ms latency budgets. 
 - Implement complex protocol translation layers to convert inbound SIP-over-TCP/TLS traffic from load balancers into high-speed SIP-over-ZeroMQ traffic for internal stateless services. 
 - Engineer advanced concurrency models utilizing ZeroMQ Router/Dealer socket pooling and internal thread-bridging patterns to prevent mutex bottlenecks and ensure thread-safe message passing under heavy load. 
 - Integrate distributed state and security mechanisms, including automated cryptographic key rotation using discovery tools for leader election and secured vaults for private key storage. 
 - Enforce surge protection and reliability by building multi-layered throttling, distributed batch schedulers, and exponential backoff handling
 - Partner with Network and Infrastructure teams to define advanced load balancer routing frameworks, DNS SRV query logic, and implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) for end-to-end observability. 

Basic Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

- Knowledge of SIP/VOIP & related telecom protocols. 
 - Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in c++/c
 - Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, stateless proxies and Finite State Machines (FSM). 
 - Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including gRPC and RabbitMQ. 
 - Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and GridGain. 
 - Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and ElasticSearch. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. 
 - Industry Experience - 8+ years

Travel Requirements

Under 10%

None

Experienced

Yes

- Design and develop modern, responsive, and maintainable web applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS.

Location

Pune

Engineering and CTO

10054453

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg delivers billions of data points to hundreds of thousands of customers daily. When markets move, our customers need their data immediately and without fail. That's not a nice-to-have. It's the whole product. 

The Data License Reliability & Analytics group exists to make sure that promise holds - and to make sure we keep it efficiently. Our new Pune-based DL Optimization & Automation team will build the AI tooling and the context layer that lets engineers, SREs, and AI agents across Data License reason about our systems the way our most experienced people do: which pipelines feed which products, where capacity is wasted, which risks are real, and what to fix first. 

Role

In this role, you'll build and lead a team that puts AI to work on one of the most demanding data platforms in financial services. Your team will create intelligent systems that make Data License leaner, safer, and easier to run: 

Smarter use of infrastructure - finding where compute, storage, and other system resources are over-provisioned or idle, and turning that insight into action. 

Sharper data products - analyzing how the datasets in our Data License packages are built, delivered, and used, so we can keep improving what we offer clients. 

Security, risk, and compliance on autopilot - automating the evidence-gathering, tracking, and reporting that keep us ahead of evolving regulatory and security requirements. 

Maintenance that runs itself - finding the routine upkeep that consumes engineering time and handing it to machines. 

Underpinning all of this is an AI context layer you'll help design: a living, machine-readable understanding of our systems, data, and dependencies that lets engineers and AI agents answer hard questions in minutes instead of weeks. 

You will lead a team of four engineers, setting its technical direction and driving projects from idea to delivery. You'll work closely with engineering teams across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure - as well as our reliability teams in New York and Dublin - turning their hardest operational questions into tools they rely on every day. 

What You'd Actually Be Working On

- Building and leading the team. Build and grow a team of four engineers. Set a high bar for engineering quality and analytical rigor, run the team's planning and delivery, and create an environment where people ship useful things quickly and learn fast. You'll stay hands-on - this is a lead who writes code and reviews designs, not just one who runs meetings. 
 - The AI context layer. Design and evolve the knowledge foundation our AI tools stand on: architecture knowledge bases, semantic models and ontologies of our data and services, and knowledge graphs that connect code, configuration, telemetry, and incident history. You'll own retrieval quality across RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, decide how knowledge is structured, verified, and kept fresh, and make sure an agent's answer can always be traced back to a source. 
 - AI-driven optimization of systems, processes, and architecture. Turn one-off investigations into repeatable tooling. Build analytics that find underused machines and tenancies, unneeded storage and datasets, and architectural bottlenecks - and quantify the impact of acting on them. If we answered a question once by hand, you'll be figuring out how to answer it on demand. 
 - Agents and MCP tooling. Build MCP servers and AI agents that expose Data License systems and knowledge to engineers and to other agents, and use agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns to compose them into multi-step workflows. Work on context retrieval, prompt and tool design, evaluation frameworks, and the feedback loops that make these systems more accurate over time. 
 - Risk and compliance analytics. Own the automated analytics behind regulatory and risk programs such as emerging cyber-resilience regulation and enterprise risk management: scanning codebases and inventories, tracking remediation, and producing evidence that holds up to scrutiny from auditors and leadership. 
 - Tools people actually use. Build the web applications, dashboards, and reports (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) that put these insights in front of engineers, managers, and leadership, and make them self-service. 
 - Shaping the AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC). Help define how Data License builds software with AI agents - agentic development workflows, guardrails, and evaluation. Your team will be an early adopter and an example for the rest of the organization. 
 - Partnering across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure. Work directly with application, platform, and SRE teams to understand their problems, review designs, and bring data to architecture decisions. You'll be the person teams come to when they want to know what a change will really cost, what it will save, and what it might break. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years writing production software, with strong Python and solid JavaScript/TypeScript
 - 2+ years leading engineers - as a team lead, tech lead, or in a role where you owned a team's technical direction and delivery
 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent hands-on experience
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs: RAG pipelines, prompt and tool design, agents, or evaluation of AI output quality
 - Experience building full-stack applications, including React front-ends and Python back-end services and APIs
 - A data-driven mindset: you measure before you optimize, you show your evidence, and you're skeptical of conclusions - including an AI's - that can't be traced to a source
 - Strong communication skills. You'll lead a team in Pune while partnering with teams in New York, Dublin, and elsewhere, so you need to explain trade-offs clearly and build consensus without authority
 - Willingness to pick up new tools fast - this field changes month to month

What Would Set You Apart

- Experience with GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic modeling
 - Building or deploying MCP servers, multi-agent systems, or agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols in production
 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for LLM and agent systems - retrieval accuracy, groundedness, regression testing
 - Background in SRE, observability, or infrastructure analytics: capacity planning, cost and utilization optimization, telemetry (metrics, logs, traces)
 - Familiarity with data platforms such as Spark, Iceberg, Trino, or PostgreSQL
 - Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud or virtualized compute environments
 - Exposure to software supply-chain security, regulatory compliance, or risk management programs

Job Description

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking). 
 - Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks - both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) - so we can measure whether agents are improving. 
 - Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals. 
 - Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform. 
 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring. 
 - Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.
