data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers in the technology field. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. The NVIDIA Silicon Co-Design Group is seeking a versatile engineer to join our High Speed SERDES IO electrical validation team. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

This role focuses on industry-leading high-speed interconnects such as PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, and UFS. You will perform bring-up and electrical validation with a strong emphasis on quality, stability, and efficiency. Additionally, you will leverage AI-assisted workflows, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance validation quality, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve engineering efficiency. This position offers the opportunity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, technology-driven environment influencing product lines that span artificial intelligence, consumer graphics, self-driving cars, and more. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Execute electrical validation for PCIe, Ethernet, USB3, and UFS interfaces for NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SOCs, ensuring adherence to signal integrity standards. 
 - Engage with cross-functional engineering teams to facilitate the design and development process, leveraging your knowledge of firmware/driver interactions and circuit design. 
 - Analyze complex HSIO bugs by applying strong debugging techniques and collaborating with various teams for rapid resolution. 
 - Diagnose issues and validate high-speed interfaces using modern lab equipment, including DSOs and BERT, with expert-level proficiency. 
 - Develop and apply test/debug programs using scripting languages (such as Perl and Python) to perform stress and failure analysis on high-speed interfaces. 
 - Innovate methodologies that leverage AI-assisted workflows and data-driven analytics to enhance debugging efficiency and improve validation quality. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electronics Engineering (or equivalent experience) with at least 3 years of relevant experience. 
 - Deep high-speed/SERDES electrical validation and tuning experience, with strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in electrical validation of PCIe (or similar) protocols, hands-on with lab equipment (DSOs, BERT, protocol analyzers), and scripting skills (Perl, Python) for developing test/debug programs. 
 - Proven experience in building AI solutions specifically in the context of electrical and silicon validation, including designing and implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation frameworks to enhance engineering productivity and validation quality. 

If you are energized by challenging problems, real ownership, deep work, and AI-enabled engineering at scale, we'd love to talk to you.

data.title: QA Engineer - Networking L2/L3 Testing | 4 - 8 yrs
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco IOS XR Routing and BNG Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco's carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across Layer 2, Layer 3, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, and web-scale customers operating some of the world's largest and most demanding networks. 

Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing and Broadband Network Gateway capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations. 

Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and troubleshooting workflows. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing and BNG features. 
 - Validate BNG subscriber technologies, including IPoE, PPP, PPPoE, DHCPv4/DHCPv6, DHCP relay, Prefix Delegation, RADIUS, AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, subscriber policies, and session lifecycle management. 
 - Test Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies such as Ethernet, VLAN, QinQ, LACP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, Segment Routing, L2VPN, L3VPN, EVPN, ECMP, BFD, QoS, and high-availability mechanisms. 
 - Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools. 
 - Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms. 
 - Validate control-plane, forwarding-plane, subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, software upgrade, rollback, process restart, route churn, and subscriber churn scenarios. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data. 
 - Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing. 
 - Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation. 
 - Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. 
 - 4 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Strong knowledge of BNG architecture and subscriber-management technologies, including PPP/PPPoE, DHCP, RADIUS, AAA, accounting, and subscriber session management. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and MPLS. 
 - Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios. 
 - Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working experience of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack. 
 - Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools. 
 - Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing BNG and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, or NCS 5500/5700. 
 - Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent. 
 - Knowledge of advanced BNG features, including subscriber QoS, dynamic policy activation, etc. 
 - Experience with L2VPN, EVPN, telemetry, and network programmability. 
 - Familiarity with scale and performance characterization. 
 - CCNP Service Provider, CCIE Service Provider, DevNet Professional, or equivalent technical knowledge. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join the ZPA engineering team. This is a hybrid role based in Hyderabad, reporting to the Senior Manager of Engineering, ZPA. You'll lead a team of 6-8 software engineers building the world's largest cloud security platform from the ground up. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Oversee and lead a team of engineers to develop high-quality software that is performant, scalable, reusable, extensible, secure, supportable, and reliable
 - Lead the design and implementation of scalable, high-availability distributed systems using technologies like Kafka, Elasticsearch, Druid, Opensearch
 - Deliver high-quality, reliable microservices and highly distributed solutions while ensuring overall system reliability
 - Monitor system performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and optimize security to maintain high availability for critical cloud systems
 - Collaborate with product managers and other engineering leaders to translate technical goals into measurable business results

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. 
 - You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 10+ years of engineering leadership experience, including 3+ years managing global teams across the entire SDLC
 - Deep knowledge of distributed software architectures, cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure), and system monitoring solutions
 - Proven ability to lead teams in delivering highly distributed solutions
 - Skilled at partnering with product management to turn technical vision into impactful execution

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

Collaboration & Mentorship

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal Software Engineer

Job Overview

You'll join the Real Time Payments (RTP) Platform, Tooling & Engineering Enablement team as a senior technical individual contributor. We uplift engineering across RTP and act as a force multiplier for the program. We align RTP to Mastercard standards and push beyond them across platform, CI/CD, and governance, while driving developer experience and AI enablement. You'll bring deep SME knowledge and experience to complex and open problems across the RTP program. You'll work with many teams across RTP Engineering, while owning your time and output. 

How success is measured

The Team Is Measured On Four Key Areas

- Developer Experience - DX improves across RTP and stays above the Mastercard benchmark
 - Innovation & Architecture - the right technology comes into RTP, and what works is shared back with the enterprise
 - AI Enablement - AI is adopted consistently and acts as a force multiplier across RTP
 - Standards & Governance - Mastercard and RTP standards embedded, with teams, including our own, held to them

Major Accountabilities

- Bring SME expertise to drive significant improvements to how RTP builds, tests, and ships software
 - Architect secure, resilient, and scalable solutions with clear, well-documented designs
 - Take on open and uncertain problems, analysing data and areas of failure or inefficiency, and turn findings into clear recommendations
 - Look ahead at engineering practice, identifying where approved technology can improve how RTP works
 - Drive practical AI adoption across RTP Engineering teams using approved tools
 - Help embed standards and governance by driving adoption, auditing how we work, and turning gaps into actions we own or items for the program tech roadmap
 - Support program-wide teams, customers, and initiatives
 - Make complex technical topics accessible to leadership through clear communication and reporting
 - Coach and mentor engineers across cross-functional teams

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering, or equivalent experience

Knowledge / Experience

- Strong experience in software engineering and architecture, with Java desired
 - Strong experience in platform engineering and cloud
 - Strong experience in CI/CD
 - Experience in technical leadership, setting direction on complex technical problems
 - Experience using AI in day-to-day engineering, such as AI coding assistants and agents, and driving its adoption across teams
 - Experience embedding engineering standards, including design, secure coding, and testing
 - Experience preparing and delivering executive-level presentations to business and technology audiences
 - Experience mentoring and developing engineers in a high-performance culture
 - Experience influencing teams without direct authority
 - Knowledge of payments, or experience working in a regulated industry

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.description:
Job Description: 

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Platform architecture and evolution

Function - Infrastructure & Operations

Coverage - Across all clients

Role Overview

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is the senior technical owner of Merkle Denmark's cloud platform architecture. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the cloud foundations, guardrails, and platform capabilities that underpin client operations - ensuring environments are reliable, secure, and well-governed. 

The role is a hands-on specialist position. It sets the direction for how cloud infrastructure is designed, built, and hardened across client accounts, and provides deep technical input on complex incidents, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. People leadership, resource allocation, and day-to-day team direction sit with the Engineering Director. 

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering

- Architect and build cloud foundations and platform capabilities across client environments. 
 - Define secure-by-design patterns, guardrails, and platform standards for Cloud Operations to operate within. 
 - Design resilience and continuity architecture, including backup/restore strategy and disaster recovery. 
 - Own and evolve infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices and tooling standards. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of the platform approach, ensuring it evolves with client needs and industry practice. 
 - Provide specialist guidance to Cloud Operations Engineers during complex incident investigations, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. 
 - Assess and respond to critical CVEs and security advisory items, coordinating with dentsu EMEA security where required. 

Operational Governance

- Define platform-level patterns that support incident management, change management, SLA governance, and on-call practice. 
 - Provide senior technical input on P1/critical incidents and client-impacting situations where infrastructure or platform expertise is needed. 
 - Ensure platform ownership responsibilities are clearly defined and applied - Cloud Ops owns production stability; Cloud Infrastructure owns design and evolution. 
 - Maintain platform design standards that support audit-readiness, NIS2, and client contractual obligations. 
 - Contribute to operational reporting quality, including platform health signals and SLA-relevant metrics. 

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

- Act as senior technical point of contact for client escalations requiring infrastructure or platform expertise. 
 - Collaborate with Project Managers and delivery teams on change planning, release readiness, and deployment governance. 
 - Contribute to account-level technical conversations, including architecture reviews and SLA design. 
 - Support pre-sales and proposal work where infrastructure architecture or managed operations expertise is required. 

Must-Have Skillset -

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer -Over 8+ years of exp

- Cloud Architecture Expertise (Azure, AWS, or GCP)Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud platforms Define platform guardrails and architecture standards
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC)Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent Building and maintaining automated infrastructure deployments
 - Cloud Security & Compliance Secure-by-design architecture principles Platform-level security controls, vulnerability/CVE management Understanding of compliance frameworks, governance, and audit requirements
 - Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Design and implementation of DR, backup, restore, and resilience strategiesHigh availability and fault-tolerant architecture design
 - ITIL / ITSM Knowledge Strong understanding of: Incident Management hange Management Problem Management SLA Governance
 - Critical Incident & Escalation Management Experience providing technical leadership during P1/P0 incidents Root cause analysis and architecture-level problem resolution
 - Operational Governance Define platform standards, operational patterns, and best practices Support incident, change, and service management frameworks
 - Client & Stakeholder Management Act as senior technical advisor during architecture reviews Experience working directly with enterprise clients and stakeholders
 - Multi-Cloud & Managed Services Experience Experience in professional services, managed operations, or multi-client environments Understanding of contractual obligations, SLAs, and service delivery models
 - Technical Skills Networking (VNet/VPC, VPN, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls)Windows/Linux Server Administration Containers & Kubernetes Monitoring & Observability tools Automation and Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
 - Experience with NIS2, GDPR, and data processing regulations
 - Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or CI/CD expertise
 - Excellent written and verbal English communication Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders

Nice-to-Have

- Danish language proficiency
 - Public sector or enterprise platform experience

Working Context

The role sits within the Merkle Denmark engineering organisation, reporting to the CTO and working closely with the Engineering Director, Infrastructure & Operations. The Infrastructure & Operations function is distributed across Denmark, Bulgaria, India, and the Philippines, and operates across multiple client accounts including public sector and enterprise digital platforms. 

The function works within a ticket-first, evidence-driven operational model. Production is owned by Cloud Operations; platform architecture and guardrails are owned by Cloud Infrastructure Engineering. This separation of duties supports governance, auditability, and clear accountability.

data.title: Senior AI Business Automation Engineer (Dot Compliance) - Technology IT
data.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. 

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

Signant Health is seeking a Senior AI Business Automation Engineer who works in two modes. In one, you embed with functional Subject Matter Experts - learning their workflows, including the workarounds and group knowledge that never appear in process documents, then designing, prototyping, and delivering the custom technical solutions that transform how those teams operate. In the other, you work on a small, focused delivery squad - leading or contributing - shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. 

Both modes share the same spirit: find business processes ripe for reinvention, rebuild them with an AI-first mindset, and put working code in front of real users fast. The role sits inside IT and carries the full weight of our infrastructure, data, integration, automation, and information security standards required of a clinical-trial technology provider. Code ships to production through regular, incremental delivery against real workflow data - not to a slide deck. Success is measured by how many workflows you've permanently transformed and how consistently your business teams start every task with an AI tool. 

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

- Flex between two modes: embedded with an assigned cohort of business SMEs, observing how work actually happens - the workarounds, shared spreadsheets, group knowledge - to find the highest-leverage workflows for an AI-first redesign; and contributing to or leading small delivery squads shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. Either way, the discipline is the same: get close to the real work, find the leverage, rebuild rather than automate as-is. 
 - Design, prototype, and deliver working solutions - custom tools, AI agents, automations, reusable skills - tailored to each engagement's workflows, delivered incrementally against real workflow data so value lands continuously, not just at project end. 
 - Coach and partner with the business users you work alongside - SMEs or squad stakeholders - through a progression: awareness, first win, regular AI integration, full workflow transformation. 
 - Develop and deploy AI agents using LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, end-to-end automations across REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party SaaS, and secure data pipelines - built to enterprise standards. 
 - Build every solution for handoff from day one - documentation, observability, and runbooks so other engineers can operate, diagnose, and evolve it without you. 
 - Recognise patterns across engagements and scale what works: a tool built for one SME should become reusable for peers; a proven pattern should be documented for other engineers. 
 - Translate observed business problems into technical solutions and share wins visibly with your cohort and leadership, articulating ROI, effort, and risk honestly enough to make prioritisation easy. 
 - Participate in end-to-end testing and quality validation of AI, automation, and integrated solutions before production deployment. 
 - Use AI development tools fluently throughout the build lifecycle - coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for rapid prototyping, LLMs for mining workflow signals from tickets and transcripts, AI-assisted drafting of designs, runbooks, and tests - while applying rigorous evaluation discipline (golden datasets, eval harnesses, regression suites, hallucination/grounding checks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints) before production deployment. 
 - Ensure automation solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and maintainability, with working knowledge of SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements. 
 - Mentor both directions: upskill business users to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows, and support junior engineers with reusable patterns, solution designs, runbooks, and executive-ready status reports. 
 - Participate in and extend internal automation platforms to support more advanced workflows, reusable modules, and greater process autonomy. 

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential: 

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise automation, software development, or IT engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating workflow automation (self-hosted or cloud) with REST API and webhook integrations across enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - 2+ years building with the modern AI development toolkit: LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent), MCP servers and clients, agent frameworks and agentic workflow patterns, AI coding assistants as a daily driver, structured prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation grounded in enterprise data, and eval harnesses for measuring agent accuracy and safety in production. 
 - Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python; experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to engineering teams and executives; experience authoring business cases, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for continuous improvement and delivering measurable business outcomes through technology. 
 - Demonstrated ability to discover real workflows by working closely with practitioners - surfacing workarounds, shared spreadsheets, and undocumented group knowledge that determine whether an AI solution works on real edge cases. 
 - Comfortable operating in small, high-velocity delivery teams - able to lead or contribute on a squad of 2-4 engineers, hold a clear delivery line under time pressure, and partner well with stakeholders who expect working software fast. Desirable: 

- Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, project management, or enterprise automation platforms (e. g. ITIL, PMP, or platform-specific). 
 - Experience with iPaaS integration platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, or Workato) connecting ERP, HRIS, CRM, and ITSM systems. 
 - Global experience collaborating with distributed teams to deliver enterprise technology initiatives. 
 - Experience using AI itself to discover and redesign workflows - analysing transaction histories, ticket logs, or content repositories with LLMs to surface bottlenecks, or building agentic prototypes in hours to test a hypothesis before a full build. 

Platform-Specific Requirements - Dot Compliance Track

Essential: 

- 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and extending the Dot Compliance eQMS (built on Salesforce), including CAPA, Deviations, Audits, Change Control, Document Control, and Training Management workflows. 
 - Proven experience building and deploying custom Salesforce Apex triggers/classes, Lightning Web Components, and Flow automations in a validated Dot Compliance production environment. 
 - Proficiency in Apex and SOQL, plus JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, for scripting and integration on the Salesforce/Dot Compliance platform. 
 - Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into Dot Compliance quality workflows (e. g. automated CAPA root-cause drafting, deviation triage, audit-readiness summarisation) grounded in regulated GxP data. Desirable: 

- Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification and/or Dot Compliance administrator or configuration credentials. 

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster - improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. 

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation - not just maintain the status quo. 

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. 

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough - we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment. 

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

Id: 20973

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.description:
Job Family

Software Application & Development (India)

Travel Required

None

Clearance Required

What You Will Do

We are seeking a QA Tester to ensure the quality, functionality, accessibility, and performance of websites built on Sitecore AI and related digital experience technologies. In this role, you will plan and execute manual and automated testing across web pages, components, forms, content workflows, APIs, integrations, and releases. You will work closely with developers, content authors, product owners, designers, and delivery partners to identify defects early, expand automated test coverage, and deliver reliable, secure, and user-friendly digital experiences across browsers, devices, and environments. 

- Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Sitecore AI websites, features, components, forms, content updates, integrations, and releases. 
 - Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, end-to-end, cross-browser, responsive, accessibility, performance, and visual testing across supported environments. 
 - Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical website journeys, reusable components, APIs, and regression scenarios using modern web test automation frameworks. 
 - Validate Sitecore AI authoring experiences, page and component configuration, content publishing, personalization, search, forms, analytics tagging, consent behavior, and third-party integrations. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and review results to support release readiness and rapid defect detection. 
 - Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or logs, severity, and business impact; verify fixes through retesting and regression testing. 
 - Partner with developers, designers, content teams, and product owners to clarify acceptance criteria, identify test risks, and improve testability early in the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Create and maintain reusable automation utilities, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and reporting that improve test reliability and reduce manual effort. 
 - Track test execution, automation coverage, defect trends, escaped defects, and release quality metrics, and communicate findings and risks clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to quality standards, test documentation, peer reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of website testing practices. 

What You Will Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - At least 4 years of experience in software quality assurance, with hands-on responsibility for testing websites or web applications in enterprise environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of QA methods, the software development lifecycle, test design techniques, defect management, risk-based testing, and release validation. 
 - Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and working knowledge of another scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, or C#. 
 - Experience testing modern websites and web applications, including responsive layouts, reusable components, navigation, search, forms, content publishing, APIs, and third-party integrations. 
 - Experience with API testing tools and techniques, including request validation, response validation, authentication, error handling, and integration scenarios. 
 - Experience with Git-based workflows, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution, test reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Ability to use browser developer tools, logs, network traces, and test evidence to isolate and communicate website defects effectively. 
 - Experience validating cross-browser and cross-device behavior, accessibility, performance, security-related requirements, analytics tagging, and production readiness. 
 - Ability to write clear test cases, automation code, defect reports, test summaries, and release-quality recommendations. 
 - Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, review test assets, troubleshoot failures, and share testing and automation knowledge with team members. 

What Would Be Nice To Have

- Hands-on testing experience with Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, Experience Edge, or another composable digital experience platform. 
 - Experience testing React and Next. js websites deployed through Vercel, Microsoft Azure, or another cloud platform. 
 - Experience with Selenium, REST clients, accessibility testing tools, visual regression tools, and performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. 
 - Experience designing maintainable automation frameworks using page objects, fixtures, data-driven testing, mocking, parallel execution, retry strategies, and actionable reporting. 
 - Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jira, test management platforms, and browser or device testing services. 
 - Relevant certification in Sitecore, software testing, test automation, accessibility, cloud technologies, or web quality engineering. 
 - Experience testing high-traffic, multilingual, personalized, or regulated enterprise websites and coordinating quality activities with distributed delivery teams. 

About Guidehouse India

At Guidehouse India, we're redefining what's possible by creating opportunities that change lives. Guidehouse is a global professional services firm that delivers advisory, technology, and managed services to clients across both the commercial and public sectors. Our teams turn bold ideas into solutions that transform industries, strengthen communities, and drive meaningful impact worldwide. 

Across our Chennai, Trivandrum, and Gurugram locations, you'll find opportunities where your passion and curiosity help shape what comes next. With cutting edge benefits, innovative learning and development programs, and a people first culture, we empower our people to lead with purpose. 

We continue to expand our teams and capabilities across India, investing in state-of-the-art offices and high impact work. Here, you'll collaborate with experts from around the world, build deep expertise, explore new domains, and accelerate your professional growth while making a real impact. 

What We Offer

At Guidehouse India, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our people and their families at every stage of life. We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to help you thrive both inside and outside the workplace. 

Our benefits include resources such as in house physician consultations, nutritious food options at the workplace, and confidential counseling through our Employee Assistance Program, along with other wellness focused offerings that support your overall well being. 

Our comprehensive learning and development programs ensure you're continuously upskilled and ready to tackle what's next, so you can shape your own career path while contributing to meaningful, purpose driven work. 

Important Fraud Notice

All official recruitment communications from Guidehouse will come from email addresses ending in @guidehouse. com or @myworkday. com. Guidehouse never charges fees, requests money transfers, or collects payments from educational institutions for recruitment events. Please do not share banking or personal financial information with anyone claiming to represent Guidehouse for hiring purposes. 

Contact Us

If you have visited our website to explore career opportunities or to apply for a position and have questions, please contact the Guidehouse Recruiting team at IndiaRecruiting@guidehouse. com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and used only as required to support the recruitment process. 

To learn more about Guidehouse in India, visit www. guidehouse. com/india. 

Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

data.title: AI Architect
data.description:
The AI Architect defines and guides scalable, maintainable, AI-enabled product architecture for modern product delivery and legacy modernization. This role translates product goals, customer commitments, engineering constraints, and modernization needs into practical architecture, service models, integration patterns, technical standards, and reusable solution accelerators. The role is expected to use AI tools to improve architecture discovery, documentation, design comparison, codebase understanding, modernization planning, and engineering enablement while maintaining accountability for technical decisions. 

Key Outcomes

- Clear architecture direction for new product features, modernization, cloud adoption, integrations, and scalable product capabilities. 
 - Reduced technical debt and increased maintainability through service modeling, architecture standards, reusable patterns, and modernization roadmaps. 
 - Improved engineering productivity through AI-assisted architecture documentation, codebase analysis, design accelerators, and internal architecture bots. 
 - Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable technical solutions. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead product architecture for new capabilities, modernization initiatives, service decomposition, API strategies, integration patterns, data flows, cloud adoption, and non-functional requirements. 
 - Use GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, and approved AI tools to accelerate codebase exploration, design option comparison, architecture documentation, sequence diagrams, ADR, risk analysis, and modernization planning. 
 - Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical service models that support product initiatives, integration requirements, operational needs, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Define architecture standards, design patterns, API guidelines, service boundaries, data handling patterns, observability expectations, and quality attributes for product teams. 
 - Analyze current-state architecture, product performance, reliability, scalability, technical debt, integration constraints, and modernization opportunities. 
 - Partner with product management to translate business priorities and customer commitments into technically feasible roadmaps, implementation strategies, and release increments. 
 - Guide engineers and QA teams on design decisions, testability, service contracts, performance risks, backward compatibility, and modernization safety. 
 - Create proofs of concept to evaluate feasibility, desirability, viability, and operational impact of emerging technologies, cloud capabilities, AI-enabled engineering accelerators, and internal bots. 
 - Establish product-level architecture governance that is lightweight, practical, and aligned to agile delivery
 - Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers in system design, service ownership, technical debt management, AI-assisted architecture practices, and full-cycle engineering standards. 
 - Document architecture decisions, diagrams, service catalogs, integration patterns, technical risks, and modernization roadmaps in formats usable by engineers and product stakeholders. 
 - Continuously review industry trends and internal product constraints to evolve architecture practices, technology direction, and AI-enabled engineering adoption. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline is preferred. 
 - Cloud, architecture, DevOps, data, or AI-related certifications are preferred when supported by practical implementation experience. 

Experience

- Overall Experience of 14+ years in software development and architecture. 
 - 8+ years of software development, product engineering, architecture, or technical design experience. 
 - 5+ years of senior technical leadership, architecture ownership, product modernization, service design, integration architecture, or platform engineering experience is preferred. 
 - Proven experience designing scalable, secure, maintainable, high-performance product architectures for complex applications. 
 - Experience with legacy modernization, cloud services, distributed systems, API design, data architecture, technical debt management, and cross-functional solutioning. 
 - Experience using AI tools for architecture analysis, documentation, codebase understanding, proof-of-concept acceleration, or engineering enablement is preferred. 

Skills

- Expert knowledge of software architecture, system design, service modeling, integration patterns, cloud-native design, distributed systems, and non-functional requirements. 
 - Strong understanding of full-stack product engineering, databases, APIs, event-driven systems, CI/CD, observability, performance, reliability, and security principles. 
 - Ability to use AI tools to analyze legacy systems, summarize codebase behavior, compare design alternatives, identify risks, draft documentation, and accelerate proof-of-concept work. 
 - Ability to create architecture decision records, diagrams, service catalogs, modernization roadmaps, technical standards, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture decisions and trade-offs. 

Abilities

- Influences across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, data, and leadership teams without relying only on formal authority. 
 - Balances long-term architecture health with customer commitments and delivery constraints. 
 - Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental modernization plans, and executable engineering guidance. 
 - Mentors teams toward full-cycle ownership, reusable patterns, and accountable AI-enabled engineering practices. 
 - Maintains practical governance that improves quality and speed rather than increasing unnecessary process overhead. 

Tools and Technologies

- GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, Claude, approved AI assistants for architecture exploration, documentation, code explanation, modernization analysis, proof-of-concept acceleration, and engineering enablement. 
 - Architecture and documentation tools for diagrams, ADRs, service catalogs, backlog alignment, and architecture reviews. 
 - C#, . NET/. NET Core, NET Framework, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, SQL, APIs, microservices, Angular/React, Node. js, and legacy technologies relevant to existing products. 
 - AWS services including Lambda, ECS, S3, IAM, Cognito, Step Functions, SQS, CloudWatch, Aurora, Glue; Azure services where applicable. 
 - Kafka/streaming, relational and NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, data lakes, distributed computing tools where applicable. 
 - CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Terraform, Docker, Git/Gerrit/GitHub, NuGet, NPM, Yarn, and feature management tools.

 - Drive production readiness for releases including operational runbooks, monitoring/alerting, capacity planning, DR considerations, and rollback plans. 
 - Enable self-service adoption through templates, pipeline scaffolding, reusable modules, and reference architectures. 

Containers / Kubernetes (Multi-Platform)

- Deliver and support containerized platform services and workloads using Kubernetes across enterprise environments including AWS EKS, Azure AKS, Google GKE, and Red Hat OpenShift. 
 - Apply Kubernetes best practices including RBAC, namespaces, ingress/controller patterns, autoscaling, rollout/rollback strategies, secrets/config management, and cluster upgrade planning. 
 - Partner with security and architecture to define and enforce standards for container security, image management, and runtime controls. 

DevOps, CI/CD, IaC & Automation

- Drive adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, release automation, and engineering quality gates. 
 - Lead platform automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Python (or equivalent) to improve speed, consistency, and reliability. 
 - Establish standards for code quality, peer review, documentation, and reusable assets (modules, playbooks, pipeline templates). 

Agile Delivery - Scrum Master (Mandatory)

- Serve as the Scrum Master for one or more squads; facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Coach team members and stakeholders on agile practices including definition of ready/done, estimation, capacity planning, and continuous improvement. 
 - Maintain delivery predictability using agile/flow metrics (velocity/throughput trends, burn-down/up, WIP, dependency and impediment tracking). 
 - Proactively remove impediments and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure delivery commitments are met. 

Delivery Governance, Risk & Quality

- Own delivery governance for the platform portfolio including planning, status reporting, milestone management, budget awareness, and release governance. 
 - Identify and mitigate risks; manage escalations, resolve conflicts, and drive timely decisions across stakeholders. 
 - Ensure quality assurance procedures and engagement reviews are performed consistently; drive corrective actions and prevent recurrence through continuous improvement. 
 - Validate delivery processes and propose enhancements to improve throughput, quality, and operational stability. 

Stakeholder Management & Communication

- Build relationships with technology and business leaders (up to Senior Engineering Lead, Product Owners, and Solution Architects). 
 - Understand business roadmap and translate priorities into clear delivery plans, risks, and dependencies. 
 - Coordinate effectively with onshore/offshore stakeholders; ensure transparency and alignment with US counterparts. 

People Leadership & Talent Management

- Lead and develop a high-performing team across multiple roles and technologies; set goals, provide coaching, and deliver timely performance feedback. 
 - Drive staffing plans (skill mix), partnering with Talent Acquisition; ensure timely backfills. 
 - Foster a culture of inclusion, accountability, innovation, documentation discipline, and continuous learning. 
 - Support engagement and retention through recognition, career development, mentorship, and growth plans. 

Enterprise Contribution

- Contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives and standardization efforts; promote reuse of patterns/assets to improve platform delivery at scale. 

QUALIFICATION

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent experience. 

Experience

- 10-12 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, with a focus on networking. 
 - 8+ years experience delivering and supporting large-scale enterprise technology solutions, with significant experience in cloud/platform engineering. 
 - 4+ years experience leading teams and/or multiple squads in a global delivery model (onshore/offshore). 
 - Proven leadership in a highly matrixed organization, driving outcomes through influence, governance, and collaboration. 
 - Mandatory: demonstrated experience performing Scrum Master responsibilities for engineering teams in an enterprise agile environment. 

Strong Understanding And Practical Experience With

- Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, and/or GCP (multi-cloud exposure preferred)
 - Kubernetes and containers: including enterprise platforms EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift
 - Infrastructure as Code / Automation: Terraform (preferred), Ansible, Python scripting
 - CI/CD and release automation: implementing and improving pipelines and quality controls
 - Production readiness fundamentals: monitoring/alerting, incident readiness, runbooks, capacity and lifecycle management. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in the healthcare domain. 
 - Experience establishing platform standards such as landing zones, policy-as-code, identity patterns, and environment governance across multiple clouds. 
 - Experience with observability platforms and practices (metrics/logs/traces; dashboards and alerting). 
 - Knowledge, Skills & Competencies
 - Technical / Platform
 - Strong understanding of enterprise cloud/platform operating models and solution architecture concepts. 
 - Ability to guide teams on secure-by-design practices, automation-first delivery, and reliable platform operations. 
 - Strong familiarity with engineering best practices: code reviews, testing strategy, release governance, documentation. 
 - Delivery & Leadership. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, escalation management, and conflict resolution skills. 
 - Ability to drive execution with urgency while maintaining quality and compliance expectations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach teams, develop talent, and lead through change. 
 - Leadership Behaviors. 
 - Accessible and empathetic leader who actively listens and encourages diverse input. 
 - Recognizes contributions and builds a high-engagement, inclusive culture. 
 - Resilient and adaptable; continuously challenges self and team to improve performance and skills. 

Certifications Are a Plus (not Required), Such As

- Scrum: CSM / PSM / SAFe Scrum Master/PMP
 - Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP professional-level
 - Kubernetes: CKA/CKAD
 - Domain: AHM250 (preferred)

Skills And Competencies

- People management experience
 - Scrum and agile expertise
 - Experience in AWS/GCP/Azure cloud services development
 - AWS/Azure/GCP certified professional
 - Python
 - Cloud formation/ARM/Cloud deployment manager/control tower/EKS/GKE/AKS

Good to have skills : NA

This is a key leadership role within the product engineering organization, responsible for overseeing and guiding complex technical projects, driving innovation leveraging AI, and ensuring the successful delivery of high- quality software products. This role may involve a combination of hands-on technical work, strategic planning, and team leadership among other responsibilities. If you have the drive to lead and mentor engineering teams, the ability to set a technology vision for greenfield/brownfield SaaS products and excellent communication skills to work with cross-functional teams, including product management and other stakeholders, this position is for you

Project Oversight: Ensure successful delivery of projects, from concept to production. 

Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning.

Expertise in object-oriented/modern languages (C#, Java, Python, Go or similar)
