data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

About The Role

Join the Vertical Solutions team and build UiPath's most ambitious product - an AI agentic orchestration platform that's been recognized as our Invention of the Year for two consecutive years. As a Principal Software Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of our Act 2 strategy, building the infrastructure that allows enterprises to seamlessly orchestrate AI agents, robots, and human-in-the-loop workflows to achieve critical business outcomes. 

You'll be working with Lax and the Maestro backend team to build the core orchestration engine that powers enterprise AI automation. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role on UiPath's biggest strategic bet. 

What You'll Do

- Build and Scale: Design, develop, and maintain full stack for Vertical Solutions products leveraging AI Coding Assistants. 
 - Hands-On Development: Write production-quality code daily, leveraging AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc. ) to enhance your development workflow
 - Prototype and Ship: Take ideas from Prototype to validate with real customers and turn the ones that prove value into production systems. 
 - Measure what matters: Design evaluations, measure quality against real customer data, and understand when metrics mislead. Our systems are often non-deterministic. Responsible shipping means measuring honestly, not chasing vanity numbers. 
 - Customer-Centric Engineering: Deeply understand who will use the features you build and why they need them, translating customer needs into elegant technical solutions
 - Ensure Reliability: Contribute to building highly scalable, reliable distributed systems that enterprises depend on. 

What We're Looking For

- Builder mindset - you enjoy turning ideas into working systems and taking ownership from Concept through, Customer impact and Production
 - Strong full stack knowledge including frontend systems like React and backend systems -Python and/or C# - most Vertical Solutions product development is Python (agents, APIs, ETL), while core platform work includes C#, frontend in React. Willingness to work across both is important. 
 - Experience building production AI systems - LLMs, tool-calling, multi-agent architectures, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), structured outputs, orchestration, and evaluation of model behavior in real-world workflows
 - Distributed systems experience - designing resilient systems with idempotency, replay ability, state management, and long-running jobs
 - Strong analytical thinking - able to reason quantitatively about system quality and make sound decisions using imperfect signals
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid prototyping - able to move from idea to proof-of-concept quickly and iterate based on customer feedback. 
 - Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus. 

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience. 
 - 13+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on distributed systems and backend architecture. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more system-level languages - Javascript / C# / Java etc
 - Full-stack experience: ability to work across backend services and frontend layers (REST/GraphQL APIs, basic UI integration, component contracts). 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, architectural design patterns, system design, and data structures & algorithms. 
 - Experience with React, TypeScript, or other modern frontend frameworks for deeper full-stack contribution. 
 - Strong grasp of multithreading, asynchronous programming, synchronization, and cloud-native programming models. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud ecosystems: Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Proficiency with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and coding agents (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to integrate these into daily engineering workflows. 
 - Experience driving team adoption of AI-powered productivity tools - setting norms, measuring impact, and iterating on usage patterns. 
 - Familiarity with modern engineering practices: agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills; proven success collaborating with globally distributed teams and managing complex, time-bound deliverables. 
 - Ability to understand, communicate, and drive complex technical decisions with stakeholders at all levels. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus. 
 - Data science and evaluation
 - Experience with applied ML techniques such as classification, anomaly detection, ranking, or predictive modeling
 - Experience evaluating AI systems using experimentation, metrics, and empirical analysis to improve quality and reliability
 - Data and retrieval systems
 - Experience with large-scale data platforms (Snowflake, columnar warehouses, denormalized data models)
 - Familiarity with retrieval-heavy architectures, RAG systems, or citation-grounded AI workflows
 - Engineering for trustworthy AI
 - Experience blending deterministic and probabilistic systems (rules engines + AI)
 - Experience designing eval-driven systems, regression testing for LLM outputs, or human-in-the-loop review workflows
 - Platform and product development
 - Frontend familiarity (React, TypeScript)
 - Workflow orchestration platforms (Temporal, Airflow, Maestro, BPMN, Step Functions)
 - Kubernetes and distributed infrastructure
 - Experience in startups, applied research, or 0→1 product environments
 - Open-source contributions

How We Work

Vertical Solutions operates like an internal startup inside UiPath: small teams, fast iteration, and real customers in the loop. We build quickly, test ideas with users, and turn the best ones into products. Some ideas won't make it - that's expected. You'll work in short cycles, demo frequently, and adapt as we learn. We care more about solving the right problem than protecting a plan that no longer fits. If you enjoy ambiguity, rapid feedback, and building where product boundaries move fast, you'll likely thrive here. 

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI technology that's shaping the future of enterprise automation
 - Be part of a team building Times top 100 Invention of the Year (2 years running)
 - Collaborate with talented engineers who value rapid iteration and customer impact
 - Contribute to UiPath's Act 2 strategy - our most important product initiative

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 4B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

What You Will Need

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and org-wide impact
 - Deep backend and distributed systems expertise, including experience designing services with clear ownership, strong reliability, and well-defined interfaces
 - High agency and bias toward shipping, with the ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into narrow launches, fast feedback loops, and durable technical foundations
 - AI-native engineering mindset, with hands-on experience using AI tools to move faster and the judgment to know when correctness, security, and architecture need deeper human ownership

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling. com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

data.description:
Role: Sr. Java Fullstack Developer

Exp: 3-5 Years

Work Mode: Work From Office

Time: 10am - 8pm ( 9hrs working + 1 hr break)

Job Description

About RChilli

RChilli is an HR Tech company that builds AI-powered resume parsing, JD parsing, skills taxonomy, search and match, and AI agents for recruitment. Its products plug into leading HR platforms, including Oracle HCM, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow and Salesforce, and power hiring for enterprises, ATS vendors and job boards worldwide. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Java Developer with 3-5 years of experience to join our Integrations team. You will build the ERP/HCM integrations, Chrome extensions, microservices, backend APIs and front-end screens that connect RChilli's AI products to platforms like Oracle HCM, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow and Salesforce. 

What you'll do

ERP / HCM integrations

- Build and maintain integrations with Oracle HCM, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Salesforce and other ERP/HR platforms. 
 - Work with REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, OAuth and data mapping between RChilli and client systems. 
 - Debug integration failures and resolve client tickets on time. 

Chrome extension

- Develop and enhance RChilli's Chrome extension (Browser Assistant) using JavaScript/TypeScript and Manifest V3. 
 - Work with content scripts, service workers, Chrome APIs and secure communication with backend services. 

Microservices and backend APIs

- Build scalable microservices and REST APIs in Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Design database schemas and write efficient queries (MySQL/PostgreSQL, MongoDB). 
 - Deploy and monitor services on AWS. 

Front-end development

- Build responsive UI screens with React or Angular, HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript. 
 - Connect front-end screens to backend APIs and keep the user experience fast and clean. 

Quality and delivery

- Write unit tests, pass code reviews and SonarQube quality gates. 
 - Deliver committed sprint tasks on time and document your work. 

What you'll bring

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience as a Java / Full Stack Developer. 
 - Good command of Core Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs and microservices basics. 
 - Experience with at least one front-end framework (React or Angular) plus JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3. 
 - Working knowledge of Chrome extension development (Manifest V3, content scripts, Chrome APIs) or strong JavaScript skills to pick it up fast. 
 - Exposure to third-party or ERP/HCM integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML and webhooks. 
 - Comfortable with SQL databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL); basic MongoDB is a plus. 
 - Familiar with Git, Postman and Agile/Scrum ways of working. 
 - Good problem-solving and clear communication. 

Good to have

- Hands-on work with Oracle HCM, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow or Salesforce APIs. 
 - A published Chrome extension or browser add-on. 
 - TypeScript, Node. js or Python. 
 - AWS basics (EC2, S3, Lambda), Docker and CI/CD. 
 - Unit testing (JUnit, Jest) and SonarQube. 
 - Exposure to LLM/GenAI APIs. 
 - Interest in HR Tech or SaaS products. 

How success is measured

In your first year, you will be measured on these outcomes: 

Area What good looks like

Sprint delivery Assigned sprint tasks closed on time

Client tickets Integration and extension tickets fixed within agreed timelines

Integrations ERP/HCM integrations run with a high success rate and few failures

Chrome extension Stable releases with no critical bugs reaching users

Code quality Code passes reviews and SonarQube quality gates, with unit tests

Performance APIs and UI screens stay fast as usage grows

Why join RChilli

- Work on AI products used by global enterprises and leading HR platforms. 
 - Get end-to-end exposure: integrations, browser extensions, backend and front end. 
 - Learn from senior engineers and grow into a senior developer role. 
 - A collaborative, product-focused team in Mohali.

data.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY INFORMATION SECURITY

Job posting

AI and Automation Engineering Lead, Associate Director

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build. 

EY focuses on high ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. 

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust. 

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value. 

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI. 

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function. 

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people. 

Areas of focus

- AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output. 
 - Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes. 
 - Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time. 
 - Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it. 
 - AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program. 

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include: 

- Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems. 
 - Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces. 
 - Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take. 
 - Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them. 
 - Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue. 
 - Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data. 
 - Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved. 
 - Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program. 
 - Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others. 
 - Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality. 
 - Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums. 
 - Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on. 
 - Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual. 
 - Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations. 
 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership. 
 - Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders. 
 - Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience. 
 - Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program. 
 - Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues. 
 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines. 
 - Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production. 
 - Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK. 
 - Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task. 
 - Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable. 
 - Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent. 
 - Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph. 
 - Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs. 
 - A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes. 
 - Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling. 
 - Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it. 
 - Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience. 
 - Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources. 
 - Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path. 
 - Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation. 
 - Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience. 
 - Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling. 
 - Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers. 
 - Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering. 

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used. 

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Software Engineer- DevOps for Workflow Innovation in Barco Control Rooms @Barco

About Barco

Barco designs technology to enable bright outcomes around the world. Seeing beyond the image, we develop visualization and collaboration solutions to help you work together, share insights, and wow audiences. Our focus is on three core markets: Enterprise (from meeting and control rooms to corporate spaces), Healthcare (from the radiology department to the operating room), and Entertainment (from movie theaters to live events and attractions). We have a team of 3, 600 employees, located in 90 countries, whose passion for technology is captured in 400 granted patents. As part of BCR Software Development group at Barco our vision is to be a world-class software team partnering with our businesses to offer successful software solutions and outcomes that delight our customers and set the trend in our dynamic markets. 

BCR (Barco Control Rooms)

The Barco Control Rooms business unit is making workflow and visualization solutions for the Control Room market since 1994 to help operators collect, visualize and share critical information for optimal mission-critical decision making. Today, we are still the number one choice for control room professionals who want to stay on top of their situational awareness with 12000+ installations for critical infrastructure and critical operations. 

Software Engineer - DevOps for Workflow Innovation @ Barco

We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the Barco CTRL Workflow Innovation team and support the development of a new AI-driven product from the ground up. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms. 

About The Role

As a Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities. 

- Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, environment management, configuration, and deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code practices. 
 - Enable deployment and operation of AI/ML workloads, including model serving, inference workflows, RAG-based components, vector search services, and related data/AI services. 
 - Support cloud-to-edge deployment and operational patterns for AI capabilities, including lightweight model packaging, inference deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management for Edge AI scenarios. 
 - Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities.

A Hybrid working model

The expectation is that working life at WPP Production will involve working from the office for about 50% of the time for most people. What does SDET do at WPP Production?

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help pioneer the creation of large scale automation solutions. At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

This is a deeply technical leadership role, not a people-management role.

You Will Set The Technical North Star For The Platform, Translate Company Strategy Into a Multi-year Architecture Roadmap, And Ensure Architectural Alignment Across All Product Pillars. data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About The Role
About Soar and how we build : 
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation. 
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here. 
How we work : 
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either. 
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current. 
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end. 
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers. 
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run. 
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed. 
Role Summary: We rely heavily on AI to build, test, and improve software. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead a team of engineers working with AI agents, keep delivery focused, and ensure every release meets a high quality bar. You will combine people leadership with practical technical oversight and help your team become more effective every week. Key Responsibilities: 

- Own the team's delivery from requirements through production, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and accountability. 
 - Coach engineers to use AI agents effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation; contribute directly when needed. 
 - Help the team break complex work into reviewable tasks, provide relevant context to agents, and validate results against product requirements. 
 - Review designs and critical code changes, challenge unsupported AI assumptions, and ensure changes remain understandable and maintainable. 
 - Embed automated tests, peer review, CI checks, security checks, and end-to-end validation into delivery; keep human review accountable for release decisions. 
 - Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps to resolve blockers, prepare releases, and address production issues and recurring defects. 
 - Run regular one-to-ones, give actionable feedback, support career growth, and manage workloads sustainably. 
 - Improve team practices using evidence from delivery lead time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage costs. 
Requirements
Requirements: 

- Typically 7+ years in software engineering and 2+ years leading engineers or managing a team; equivalent demonstrated impact is welcome. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building production applications, with sound knowledge of APIs, databases, testing, CI/CD, and cloud systems. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents to deliver production software and helping other engineers adopt them effectively. 
 - Ability to review and debug AI-generated code, identify missing edge cases, and select appropriate automated and human validation. 
 - Strong planning, communication, and coaching skills, with a record of creating clarity and delivering through a team. 
Nice to have : 
Experience building reusable agent workflows, integrating engineering tools through APIs or MCP, or delivering software in fintech or another regulated environment. 
What success looks like : 
The team ships tested features predictably, resolves issues quickly, and demonstrates improving quality and productivity. Engineers use AI effectively while understanding and owning the systems they deliver.

data.title: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer – Medical Device Integration & Connectivity
data.description:
Role Summary

Arthrex seeks a highly motivated, technically skilled Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join the Software Quality Assurance team in Pune, India. 

This position focuses on testing medical device software, connected devices, healthcare interoperability, and network-based applications. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in HL7, DICOM, . NET/C#, device networking, IoT technologies, and Modality Worklist (MWL) integration. 

The role requires a proactive, detail-oriented engineer who owns software quality, demonstrates strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, and can work independently while collaborating effectively with global development and SQA teams. 

This is a full-time, on-site position at the Pune office, where hands-on access to medical devices and test equipment is essential. Employment type: Full-Time (1 FTE). 

Role Description

- Develop, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and test procedures for medical device software and connected systems. 
 - Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing across software and hardware environments. 
 - Validate communication between medical devices, hospital systems, and enterprise applications. 
 - Identify, document, investigate, and troubleshoot software defects in collaboration with developers. 
 - Identify quality risks, testing gaps, and opportunities to improve test coverage. 
 - Participate in requirements reviews, technical discussions, and software design reviews. 
 - Test healthcare interoperability protocols, including HL7 and DICOM, and validate DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL) and imaging workflows. 
 - NoSQL distributed database
 - Healthcare IT, medical imaging, and connected-device environments are suitable
 - People overlap with ACT hours, working to 10 am PST. We will try to make all meetings between 8 a. m. and 10 a. m. PST. We will also like this person to come to the office each day to work with the devices. 
 - Validate connectivity with PACS, RIS, HIS/EMR, and other healthcare information systems. 
 - Test IoT-connected devices, cloud-connected applications, and device-to-server communication. 
 - Analyze network traffic, application logs, and protocol messages to diagnose integration issues. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts and utilities using C# and . NET. 
 - Perform API, database, and backend integration testing. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot networks involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, and related protocols; use Wireshark and other diagnostic tools. 
 - Support physical medical device setup, configuration, firmware/software updates, and network connectivity testing. 
 - Use AI-assisted testing tools where appropriate to improve test design, automation, defect analysis, and testing efficiency while maintaining reliability and traceability
 - Collaborate with developers, systems engineers, product owners, and global SQA teams; communicate progress, defects, and quality risks clearly. 
 - Maintain accurate test documentation, execution evidence, and defect records in line with quality processes for regulated medical device software. 
 - Take ownership of assigned testing activities and drive issues through resolution. 

Skill Requirements

PRIMARY SKILLS (MUST HAVE SKILLS): 

- 5+ years of experience in software QA, software testing, or software development. 
 - Hands-on experience with HL7, DICOM, and DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL). 
 - Proficiency in C# and . NET for software testing, automation, or development. 
 - Strong understanding of computer networking, TCP/IP, and network troubleshooting. 
 - Experience testing network-connected devices, embedded systems, or IoT applications. 
 - Experience with integration and end-to-end testing across multiple software and hardware components. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and technical problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to work independently and prioritize effectively. 
 - Ability to work full-time on-site at the Arthrex Pune office. 

Secondary Skills (good To Have)

- Experience in the medical device industry or regulated healthcare software environments. 
 - Familiarity with FDA software quality expectations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and software design controls. 
 - Experience with PACS, RIS, HIS, EMR/EHR, and medical imaging workflows. 
 - Experience with HL7 v2 messaging, DICOM networking services, and healthcare integration testing tools. 
 - Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, SQL, and database validation; Couchbase/NoSQL knowledge. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jira, Xray, or similar tools. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted test automation and AI-powered software development tools. 

Experience with cloud platforms, connected medical devices, or remote device management systems. 

Qualifications And Education Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5+ years of relevant experience in software QA, testing, or development.

As a Principal Software Developer, you will define the target web UI architecture to replace the existing WPF thick-client application, owning the strategy for decomposing the monolithic UI into independently deployable, containerized front-end modules

What The Role Offers

- Define target web UI architecture (Angular and/or React) to replace WPF thick client functionality
 - Own the micro-frontend decomposition strategy (e. g. , Module Federation) for breaking apart the monolithic UI
 - Define component library/design system standards, state management approach, and API integration patterns with backend microservices
 - Set standards for containerizing and deploying the web UI (Docker/Nginx, Kubernetes on GCP/GKE) using GitLab CI/CD and Artifactory
 - Produce high-quality architecture and design specifications; deliver POCs and estimates on technology choices
 - Lead architecture/design reviews to ensure quality and adherence to standards

What You Need To Succeed

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
 - 12+ years of enterprise product development/architecture experience
 - Deep expertise in Angular and/or React, TypeScript, and modern front-end architecture
 - Experience with micro-frontend architecture and decomposing monolithic UIs
 - Understanding of WPF/XAML sufficient to map legacy functionality to web equivalents
 - Experience with Docker/Nginx for static hosting and basic Kubernetes concepts on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
 - Strong understanding of design systems, accessibility (WCAG), and REST/GraphQL integration
 - Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills

Desired/Preferred Skills

- Experience leading WPF-to-web migration initiatives
 - Experience in C#, . NET Framework, and modern . NET (. NET 8+), with hands-on experience modernizing large enterprise applications.

One Last Thing

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. data.title: Senior Software Engineer, SSCS  Authentication
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model. 

You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program. 

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab. com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on. 

Some Of Our Projects Include

- Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
 - Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
 - Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
 - Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
 - Improving service accounts and secure automation
 - Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

What you'll do

- Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team. 
 - Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation. 
 - Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models. 
 - Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation. 
 - Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program. 
 - Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review. 
 - Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications. 
 - Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE. 
 - Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer. 

What you'll bring

- Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products. 
 - Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM). 
 - Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management. 
 - Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution. 
 - Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment. 
 - Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems. 
 - Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities. 

About The Team

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience. 

Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. 

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

data.description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as ROLE. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Associate Manager / Lead Specialist - Process Quality to drive manufacturing quality excellence and support our commitment to delivering world-class products. In this role, you will lead quality improvement initiatives, drive problem-solving activities, ensure compliance with quality standards, and collaborate cross-functionally to achieve zero-defect manufacturing. 

This position is ideal for a quality professional with strong experience in automotive manufacturing, process quality, problem-solving methodologies, and automotive core quality tools. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management & Continuous Improvement

- Drive shift quality activities and ensure compliance with company and customer quality standards. 
 - Lead cross-functional problem-solving teams using the 8D methodology. 
 - Analyze product and process non-conformities and implement effective corrective actions. 
 - Monitor and reduce DPMU levels through continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Support Zero Defect initiatives and quality improvement workshops. 
 - Ensure timely escalation and resolution of production quality concerns. 

Quality Assurance & Process Control

- Maintain and update quality planning documentation, including: 
 - Control Plans
 - PFMEA
 - Standard Work Instructions (SWI)
 - Visual Aids
 - Conduct and participate in: 
 - Process Audits
 - Product Audits
 - Dock Audits
 - Layout Inspections
 - Ensure adherence to Autoliv Standards and IATF requirements. 
 - Coordinate containment, disposition, and control of suspect products. 
Customer & Supplier Quality Support

- Support customer concern investigations and corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate with Customer Quality Engineers and Supplier Quality teams. 
 - Manage internal supplier quality issues and ensure closure of corrective actions. 
 - Follow up on ALIS/COP escalations and ensure timely closure. 

Operational Quality Excellence

- Analyze daily top rejection trends and drive corrective actions. 
 - Attend and resolve line Jidoka and production quality issues. 
 - Review, create, validate, and control MVP samples. 
 - Support laboratory testing activities and documentation updates. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong knowledge of automotive manufacturing quality systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in: 
 - Assembly Processes
 - Molding Processes
 - Laser Welding
 - Friction Welding
 - Defect Analysis
 - Expertise in automotive core tools: 
 - APQP
 - PPAP
 - PFMEA
 - SPC
 - Control Plans
 - Knowledge of IATF 16949 requirements. 
 - Experience using measurement equipment: 
 - Vernier Calipers
 - Pin Gauges
 - Height Gauges
 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings and GD&T. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and related documentation tools. 
What We're Looking For

Leadership Competencies

- Customer Focus
 - Global Perspective
 - Innovation Mindset
 - Sound Decision Making
 - Execution Excellence
 - Accountability
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Team Inspiration & Engagement
 - People Development
 - Trust Building

Personal Attributes

- Strong communication skills
 - Ownership mindset
 - Self-confidence and credibility
 - Results-oriented approach
 - Excellent problem-solving capabilities
 - Team player with a "One Team" mentality

Qualifications

✅ Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

Preferred

- IATF 16949 Internal Auditor Certification

Experience

- 10-12 years of experience in Process Quality within the automotive manufacturing industry. 
 - Proven experience in driving quality improvements and resolving manufacturing quality challenges. 
 - Ability to work independently while effectively leading cross-functional teams. 

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals. 

In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernizing business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Associate Test Analyst supports the Supply Chain Technology team by driving quality assurance and testing activities across core software applications. Operating within the Technology function, this role ensures software-based solutions, such as Blue Yonder and related enterprise supply chain platforms, are rigorously tested and validated before deployment into production. 

Working closely with project teams, functional analysts, developers, and business stakeholders, the Associate Test Analyst helps prevent defects, verifies functional requirements, and streamlines testing workflows. Through the application of both automated and structured manual testing practices, the role protects system stability and enables seamless technology delivery across Officeworks' supply chain capability. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Test Strategy and Execution: 

- Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and test scripts based on system functional requirements and business processes. 
 - Perform software-focused functional, integration, regression, and system testing across core supply chain applications such as Blue Yonder. 
 - Prepare accurate, high-quality test data aligned with solution designs and specific test case scenarios. 
 - Support developers and functional analysts during unit testing and early-stage defect identification. 

Test Automation and Continuous Improvement: 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test scripts for software applications to increase test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Evaluate software testing tools to enhance automation frameworks and decrease release cycle times. 
 - Identify continuous improvement opportunities across software QA methodologies and release control processes. 

Defect Management and Reporting: 

- Identify, document, and track software defects through to successful resolution using enterprise defect management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
 - Work closely with technical, functional, and third-party vendor teams to communicate defect severity and accelerate bug resolution. 
 - Deliver clear testing status reports and progress updates to project teams and IT management. 

User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Business Support: 

- Support business UAT testers during larger project rollouts by facilitating test environment readiness and defect tracking. 
 - Lead and coordinate UAT execution on smaller application releases and targeted functional updates. 
 - Assist in delivering solutions training and guidance to end-users prior to final deployment sign-off. 

Release Control and Deployment Verification: 

- Participate in release control checkpoints when application changes transition from build environments to test cycles. 
 - Execute production verification testing during post-deployment phases and hyper care support periods. 
 - Escalate risks or technical blockers that could impact release schedules, application quality, or project budgets. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Internal IT Delivery Teams: Collaborate with Supply Chain Functional Analysts, Developers, and Test Leads to align software testing cycles with delivery milestones. 
 - Internal Business Partners: Work directly with Supply Chain business operational teams and end-users to guide User Acceptance Testing and validate functional requirements. 
 - Quality Assurance Community: Partner with cross-functional QA peers across Officeworks Technology to share best practices and automation standards. 
 - Third-Party Software Vendors: Liaise with external application support and vendor consulting resources (e. g. , Blue Yonder, SAP) to manage integration defect resolution. 

What success looks like: 

- Software Quality and Reliability: High-quality software deployments delivered with minimal post-production defects across Supply Chain Tech applications. 
 - Automation Efficiency: Incremental growth in automated test coverage for regression suites, reducing manual testing effort and cycle times. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Strong collaborative relationships with business stakeholders and IT delivery teams, ensuring smooth UAT execution. 
 - Timely Issue Escalation: Swift identification, logging, and escalation of testing risks and defects to prevent schedule delays. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviors
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behavior
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviors and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust. 
 - We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide. 

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: Minimum 5+ years of dedicated software testing experience across manual and automated testing methodologies. 
 - Automation Capabilities: Proven experience creating and executing software automation test frameworks using industry-standard tools (e. g. , Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar). 
 - Supply Chain Software Context: Working knowledge or experience testing Enterprise Supply Chain/WMS/TMS software platforms (e. g. , Blue Yonder / JDA, SAP, or similar). Koerber HighJump, Manhattan WMS, SAP S/4 HANA
 - System SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) within Agile and Waterfall delivery frameworks. Hands on testing operational experience, with exposure DC/ CFC environment. 
 - Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking software (e. g. , Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM, Confluence). Qtest
 - Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to liaise effectively across technical and business stakeholders. 

Preferred: 

- Industry Experience: Prior testing experience within Retail, Omnichannel, or Supply Chain Logistics environments.

data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Advertising makes billions of decisions every day across search, native, shopping, display, audience, and AI-powered advertising experiences. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Architect to define the technical direction for Ads Quality at global scale. 

Quality decisions can depend on ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, account history, behavioral patterns, and signals that may be incomplete, delayed, noisy, or changing. The challenge is to turn this evidence into systems that are accurate, scalable, measurable, and continuously improving. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role spanning distributed systems, production AI, decision systems, entity intelligence, agentic workflows, and measurement. 

Responsibilities

Define the long-term architecture for Ads Quality across signals, entity understanding, model execution, decisioning, feedback, and measurement. 

Establish how quality systems should reason across ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, relationships, and behavior over time. 

Design architectures that support heterogeneous AI systems including lightweight models, multimodal models, LLMs, agents, and deterministic systems. 

Define how evidence, model outputs, confidence, calibration, thresholds, and decision policies come together in production. 

Set technical direction across real-time, nearline, and offline systems, balancing quality, latency, freshness, cost, and reliability. 

Drive convergence where common abstractions create leverage and challenge unnecessary duplication or complexity. 

Partner with Applied Science on how new model capabilities should shape system architecture. 

Prototype difficult ideas when that is the fastest way to establish technical feasibility. 

Influence implementation through design reviews, architecture guidance, and hands-on engagement with critical systems. 

Qualifications

15+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent technical depth. 

Deep experience architecting large-scale production systems spanning multiple teams. 

Strong expertise in distributed systems, production AI/ML systems, decision systems, or large-scale data platforms. 

Strong understanding of model serving, experimentation, evaluation, observability, rollout, and feedback loops. 

Ability to reason across software architecture and model behavior without treating ML as a black box. 

Track record of simplifying complex systems and turning ambiguous technical problems into durable architecture. 

Ability to influence senior engineers and technical leaders across organizational boundaries. 

Experience with advertising, quality systems, entity intelligence, multimodal AI, agentic systems, behavioral systems, or large-scale inference is valuable. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

data.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

The Data & Reporting Platform team powers ServiceTitan's growth by delivering high-quality, low-latency, and reliable data and BI products that enable trust, acceleration, and data-driven decision-making for our customers and across ServiceTitan. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to own the semantic model architecture at the heart of our data platform. The semantic layer is the single source of truth for business metrics and logic, and it powers critical data products such as Reporting, and Agentic Analytics. This role sits at the intersection of data modeling, platform engineering, and product thinking - you'll define how data is modeled, governed, and consumed at scale across multiple product surfaces. 

This is a T-shaped role: deep expertise in semantic modeling and data architecture, with the breadth to operate across the full data platform stack at the principal level. You'll partner closely with our Data Foundations team (which owns ingestion and storage), our Reporting team (which owns the reporting experience), and teams building agentic AI capabilities; ensuring the semantic layer is the performant, scalable, and extensible foundation they all depend on. 

What You'll Do

Semantic Model Architecture: Design and evolve the semantic modeling layer that serves as the single source of truth for metrics, dimensions, entities, and business logic across all data products. Define the standards for how semantic models are authored, versioned, tested, and governed. Evaluate and drive the semantic layer technology strategy (e. g. , dbt MetricFlow or equivalent). 

Data Product Enablement: Architect how the semantic layer is consumed across distinct product surfaces such as Reporting (high-performance BI platform for customers), and Agentic Analytics (metadata-rich, discoverable interfaces that enable AI agents to reason over and query the semantic layer). Partner with adjacent teams to ensure the semantic layer meets each product's unique requirements. 

Performance & Scale: Own query performance, materialization strategies, pre-aggregation patterns, and cost optimization. Ensure the semantic layer is highly performant and scalable as data volumes and consumer demand grow. 

Platform & Governance: Build the semantic layer as a true platform experience: self-service metric onboarding, developer-friendly abstractions, clear documentation, data validation, and governance guardrails. Make it easy for other teams to extend the semantic layer without compromising consistency or quality. 

Technical Leadership: Operate as a technical leader across the Data & Reporting Platform organization. Participate in and drive design sessions across teams. Mentor engineers, manage stakeholder and leadership alignment. Contribute to architecture decisions that span from data foundations through reporting and analytics. Champion high-quality code with corresponding test coverage. 

AI-Augmented Engineering: Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as a core part of your daily workflow. Drive adoption patterns, build team-specific contexts and workflows, and set the standard for how the team multiplies velocity through AI-assisted development. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering or Data Engineering roles, including experience with large-scale, high-traffic, fault-tolerant systems. 
 - Deep experience with semantic modeling, data engineering, data lakehouse, and data product development. Track record of building platform-level abstractions consumed by multiple product teams. 
 - Strong experience with the DBT ecosystem. Experience with semantic layer technologies (e. g. , dbt MetricFlow or similar) is highly preferred. 
 - Expert-level SQL and Python skills. Experience with query optimization, materialization strategies, and performance tuning at scale. 
 - Experience with modern data platform technologies: Snowflake, ClickHouse, or similar OLAP/columnar engines. Familiarity with Spark and streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis). 
 - Experience designing APIs and interfaces for domain specific data products. 
 - Demonstrated proficiency with AI coding tools (eg Claude, Cursor) as part of your regular engineering workflow; not just familiarity, but active daily use. 
 - Experience leading the architecture and design of systems (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling). 
 - Strong communication and technical writing skills. Ability to empathize with users and champion for their experience. 
 - B. S. , M. S. , or PhD in Computer Science or a related field. 

Highly preferred

- Experience building semantic layers that serve both human analysts and programmatic/AI consumers. 
 - Experience with data governance frameworks, metric versioning, or data product catalogs. 
 - Familiarity with LLM-friendly data interfaces; designing schemas and metadata that enable AI agents to discover and query data effectively. 
 - Experience with data validation and quality frameworks (e. g. , Monte Carlo, Great Expectations).

data.title: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer
data.description:
About Us

At Tally, we're driven by one core mission - making business simpler for everyone. As a pioneer in business management software, we've been the trusted partner of choice for ~3 million and 7. 5 million users across 100+ countries - many of them are MSMEs that form the backbone of global economies. 

Our journey is rooted in innovation, guided by deep empathy for customers, and driven by a commitment to excellence. With a legacy of trust and a future fueled by technology, we are shaping the way businesses manage accounting, inventory, compliance, and much more. 

We believe in honouring our people, nurturing potential, creating fearlessly, and mastering our craft - all while staying true to our values. If you are looking to make a real impact, grow with purpose, and be part of something meaningful, you'll find your place at Tally. 

As we continue to grow, we are working towards a larger ambition - to become the technology backbone for global economic progress. 

About Cloud Operations

Cloud Operations mission is to deliver the best-in-class connected services in public clouds for Tally's customers by ensuring unmatched reliability, strong security realized at the most optimal cost. Engineers here get to design, implement, and operationalize solutions leveraging deep cloud native technologies that ultimately deliver a flawless experience for our customers. 

Role: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer/Associate Staff Engineer

Experience: 7 - 12 years

Location: Bangalore

What You Will Own

In this role, you will own the reliability, scalability, and security of Tally's cloud infrastructure end-to-end, driving architectural decisions that shape the evolution of the platform. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to lead major infrastructure initiatives, provide technical direction, and mentor engineers through complex, business-critical deployments. You will also champion an automation-first approach and establish strong observability practices across the platform, proactively identifying systemic risks, preventing incidents, and driving permanent root-cause solutions instead of temporary fixes. 

Where your Expertise Meets Our Future

Deep, hands-on expertise architecting, configuring, and troubleshooting large-scale, production-grade services in OCI / AWS cloud environments, with a track record of resolving complex, ambiguous issues under pressure. 

Proven experience owning the full lifecycle of application deployment and management in OCI / AWS cloud, including capacity planning, performance optimization, cost governance, and driving reliability at scale. 

AWS and OCI cloud operations are central to this role - candidates with strong, demonstrable depth in either platform are encouraged to apply; you'llbe expected to quickly build cross-platform proficiency and bring senior-level judgment to design and operational trade-offs across both environments. 

Strong track record of designing, deploying, and running production Kubernetes clusters at scale using OCI OKE and/or AWS EKS, including cluster architecture decisions, workload management, upgrade strategy, and cluster health monitoring. 

Proven ability to lead rapid, high-pressure troubleshooting of complex, multi-layered infrastructure, OS, and application issues , acting as an escalation point and driving incidents through root cause analysis(RCA) to full service restoration. 

Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, mentor junior engineers, and represent the cloud operations function in cross-functional and leadership discussions. 

Intermediate Skills Required

Advanced expertise in configuring, hardening, and maintaining Linux hosts at scale, with strong shell scripting skills to build reusable operational tooling. 

Deep, hands-on expertise with container technology such as Docker, and strong command of the OCI OKE and AWS EKS ecosystems, including designing for scale and resilience. 

Strong command of network security architecture, including firewall rule management, network segmentation, zero-trust principles, and cloud security groups/NACLs, with the judgment to make and defend design trade-offs. 

Strong grounding in CI/CD pipeline design and DevOps principles, with experience improving pipeline reliability and deployment velocity across teams. 

Solid operational experience with database technologies such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB, including performance tuning and high-availability design. 

Strong Python skills for building automation and tooling, along with solid working knowledge of AWS boto3. 

The Scope of Your Influence

Act as a senior escalation point in the on-call rotation, leading incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues and driving thorough post-incident reviews. 

Own the deployment architecture and monitoring strategy for Tally's cloud, making the calls on design trade-offs and setting the standard other engineers follow. 

Lead deployment governance and change management, driving alignment across development, testing, and operations teams on patch and release strategy, ensuring changes roll out consistently and safely across all environments (development, staging, production). 

Proactively identify systemic in efficiencies and lead automation initiatives (scripting, configuration management, orchestration) that reduce manual toil across the team, not just your own workload. 

Own the performance and availability of Tally's cloud-based applications, setting SLOs and driving the team's response when they're at risk. 

Define, track, and improve operational KPIs including service availability, deployment success, incident response, and platform health. 

Success Measures

Effective deployment governance through active participation in change management and release reviews. 

Strong stakeholder engagement and operational communication across teams. 

Continuous improvement through automation, operational excellence, and incident reduction initiatives. 

Data-driven operational management through CloudOps metrics, reporting, and service health reviews. 

Demonstrated leadership in driving cross-functional operational outcomes and technical excellence. 

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps in the hiring process.

What You'll Do

Design and build highly scalable, resilient backend services for Order Management Systems (OMS) and Fulfillment Management Systems (FMS) serving multiple international markets (MX, CA, and beyond). 

Architect and implement multi-tenant / multi-market solutions that support locale-specific business rules, tax regulations, fulfillment models, and delivery SLAs across geographies.
