data.title: Principal/ Sr Engineer- Harness Engineering
data.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

Come join our Software Engineering team in a hands-on technical role at the heart of a new discipline: Harness Engineering. As AI coding agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). As a Senior Harness Engineer (Band D2), you'll independently own whole harness subsystems, set the standards other engineers build to, and be involved in the end-to-end lifecycle of turning raw model capability into production-grade engineering. 

What You'll Contribute

- Design, build, deploy, and support core components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on systems and leverage, not hand-writing application code. 
 - Own and evolve feedforward guides - agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods - and drive team-wide standardization so agents get it right the first time. 
 - Build feedback sensors - custom linters, static analysis, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues automatically before they reach human reviewers. 
 - Own quality gating and release criteria for agent-produced work, defining authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided and the escalation rules for what must route to a human. 
 - Establish LLM testing infrastructure and evaluation approaches that ensure AI-generated output meets quality and safety thresholds; apply consumer/contract testing (e. g. Pact) where service integration reliability matters. 
 - Run the steering loop - when an agent repeats a mistake, engineer a control so it can't happen again - deciding where each control runs in the path to production (fast pre-commit checks, heavier post-integration checks, or continuous drift-scanning sensors) to keep quality as far left as is economical, while treating repository knowledge as the system of record and fighting drift with continuous garbage collection. 
 - Improve observability into agent work and track the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate - using them to decide where to invest next. 
 - Partner with product and platform teams to turn specifications and acceptance criteria into enforceable controls. 
 - Serve as a source of technical expertise and mentor engineers across teams in harness practices and the effective, responsible use of AI tools. 

What We're Seeking

- Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience in software architecture, design, development, and testing, with a strong track record in large, complex codebases. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e. g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar), including building your own tooling or harnesses to make AI agents genuinely effective - not just using them as a power user. 
 - Proven ability to build engineering tooling across a modern stack, including linters, static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerized build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability. 
 - Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, and fitness functions, with a systems mindset that favors fixing the environment over fixing individual outputs. 
 - Judgment in choosing between deterministic controls (type checkers, linters, structural tests) and inferential, LLM-based controls (AI code review, LLM-as-judge), understanding the trade-offs between them. 
 - Experience owning quality-gating processes and defining release criteria to ensure engineering standards are consistently met. 
 - Working knowledge of the security surface unique to autonomous agents - prompt injection, tool/permission scoping, sandboxed execution, and audit trails - and designing least-privilege guardrails around them. 
 - Experience with consumer/contract testing approaches (e. g. Pact) to validate service integrations across distributed systems. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions, drive standards across teams, and evangelize best practices while incorporating feedback from internal users. 

Our Offer to You

- An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others. 
 - The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences. 
 - Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so. 
 - An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie. 

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today - Big Data analytics. You'll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more. 

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide: 

- Credit Scoring - FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders. 
 - Fraud Detection and Security - 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems. 
 - Lending - 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score. 

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO's solutions, placing us among the world's top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world's largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people - just like you - who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that's nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We'll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www. fico. com/Careers

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we're proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Quality Platform
data.description:
About The Company

Founders today are building global companies from day one - but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We're building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building. 

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment. 

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50, 000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J. P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we're building for the next generation of global companies. 

About The Role

Software quality and code volume are increasingly an engineering and AI problem. Leading teams now use agents to generate tests, detect coverage gaps before merge, and enforce quality through infrastructure rather than manual processes. 

At Aspire, we're already building this infrastructure. We have a merge guardrail in production that reads live product specs and blocks PRs when coverage gaps are detected. We are building an LLM pipeline that generates tests directly from specs, and a live traceability matrix that keeps specs, code, and test results in sync, along with AI-assisted code review. 

We are hiring a software engineer who builds AI systems and has a strong understanding of coding, testing and quality. You will design, build, and ship the AI tooling that makes quality automatic across Aspire's engineering organisation. 

What You'll Own

- The AI test generation pipeline. Build the LLM system that assesses product specs for gaps and testability, and converts them into automated tests. You will take it from POC to production, owning context retrieval across specs and codebases, prompt and agent design, evaluation frameworks for generation accuracy, and feedback loops based on live test results. 
 - The merge guardrail. The guardrail is live and blocks merges when coverage is missing or critical bugs are detected. You will improve its precision, scale it across all engineering tribes, and integrate it with the generation pipeline so it creates missing tests rather than only blocking for them. 
 - Reliable automation tooling. Build the intelligence layer behind our automation, including synthetic test data generation, AI agents that explore and verify flows, automated failure classification, and risk-based test selection, so that every alert is accurate and actionable. 
 - Quality platform ownership. Understand the spec, the code, and the failure modes, and build that understanding into systems. Contribute at the design stage, not after release. In a regulated fintech serving 50, 000+ businesses, quality gaps directly impact customers. Work closely with QA engineers to embed AI-assisted practices and use quality data (coverage, escape rates, flakiness) to drive decisions. 
 - Security regression in CI. Design and build automated security regression tests for our highest-risk API endpoints, ensuring every auth boundary is verified at merge. This is a MAS Singapore requirement and will be built from scratch. 

What We're Looking For

- Proven experience shipping AI systems. You have built and deployed an LLM application, agent, developer tool, or automation that replaced real manual work. You understand common failure modes such as hallucinations, context limits, and evaluation gaps, and how to address them. 
 - Strong software engineering with a quality mindset. You write production code, design systems, and build tools used by other engineers. You understand test architecture, coverage, and failure analysis well enough to define what good testing looks like. 
 - High standards. You address root causes rather than symptoms and treat production defects and flaky tests as system-level problems to eliminate. 
 - Ownership and initiative. You identify problems, validate them with data, and propose solutions without waiting to be assigned. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity. You are motivated by an evolving roadmap that starts with quality and extends to wider engineering workflows as we learn what works, and you want to help shape its direction. 

Technical Skills

- Strong software engineering in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building production services, internal tools, or developer platforms
 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG or context retrieval, agents or tool use, and output evaluation. Side projects, internal tools, or POCs count if they were shipped. 
 - Strong day-to-day use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of test automation and test architecture; Playwright experience is a strong plus
 - CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), including building tooling that integrates at PR and merge stages
 - Ability to read and reason about backend code, API contracts, and service boundaries
 - 5+ years in software engineering with meaningful exposure to development, testing, quality, or developer tooling, preferably including a fintech or regulated-environment project
 - Experience owning a system or product domain end-to-end
 - Familiarity with financial workflows such as payments, KYB/KYC, and transaction processing is a strong plus

What This Role Is NOT

- Building AI prototypes that never reach production. 
 - Waiting at the end of the delivery pipeline for a build. 
 - Maintaining a regression suite without evaluating its value. 
 - Treating quality as another team's responsibility. 

In Your First 90 Days, You'll Probably

- Become the go-to engineer for building quality into development workflows. 
 - Challenge at least one existing practice with data and propose a better approach. 
 - Review the codebase and identify the three biggest quality gaps based on data, propose solutions, and build tooling for at least one. 
 - Deliver a measurable improvement in quality via the test-generation pipeline, the merge guardrail, automation reliability, code review etc. 

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Aspire. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Aspire may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Aspire's Candidate Privacy Notice.

data.title: SASE Firewall QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

NETGEAR is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help validate our next-generation firewall and cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will build and maintain automated tests that verify firewall behavior across critical security domains including Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), and Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN). 

Working alongside firewall developers and senior QA engineers, you will automate functional, regression, and performance testing against real and simulated network traffic. You will not be expected to know every area of the stack on day one - we will support you in growing across it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain automated test suites that validate firewall functionality - policy and rule evaluation, NAT, stateful session handling, and traffic filtering across NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, SWG, VPN, and SD-WAN features. 
 - Build and maintain test topologies and lab environments, including virtual machines, containers, and physical firewall appliances. 
 - Generate and shape realistic network traffic to exercise the firewall data plane, and verify observed behavior against expected policy outcomes. 
 - Run test suites in CI, triage failures, distinguish product defects from environment and test issues, and file clear, reproducible defect reports with supporting packet captures and logs. 
 - Contribute to test plans and test-case design from firewall requirements, and help keep automation coverage mapped to those test cases. 
 - Support performance and scale testing - throughput, connections per second, and concurrent sessions - and help identify regressions. 
 - Work with developers to improve testability, and stay current with automation tooling, including AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and failure triage. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 2-4 years of professional experience in QA automation or test engineering, preferably for networking or security products. 
 - Strong automation scripting ability in Python and Bash, comfort working in Ubuntu or other Linux environments from the command line, and day-to-day use of Git. 
 - Working knowledge of networking protocols and traffic flows - TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, NAT, and routing fundamentals. 
 - Understanding of firewall fundamentals such as packet filtering, stateful connection tracking, NAT, and rule and policy evaluation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux networking and firewall tooling - iptables and nftables rule configuration, conntrack for session inspection, and iproute2 (ip addr, ip route, network namespaces, bridges, VLANs) for building and inspecting test topologies. 
 - Proficient in analyzing logs and network captures using tools such as Wireshark, tshark, and tcpdump. 
 - Experience with a test framework and runner such as pytest or Robot Framework.

This role is focused on building reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing mobile experiences while using AI-driven development practices to accelerate engineering velocity, improve quality, and unlock intelligent mobile capabilities.

 - Leads complete, high-impact mobile initiatives end-to-end across discovery, architecture, implementation, launch, and continuous improvement

 - Communicate clearly with product owners, UX/design, engineering leaders, backend teams, security, DevOps/SRE, QA, support, and business stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with business outcomes

- Leverage AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and mobile-specific automation to accelerate high-quality delivery

data.title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

The Senior AI Evals Test Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment - ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing, and sits within the Applied AI: Test Engineering team as a key technical authority. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build agent evaluation frameworks - create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
 - Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e. g. , Vertex AI, Gemini models)
 - Build golden datasets and test harnesses - curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
 - Establish eval-as-a-service - build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
 - Automate regression and drift detection - implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
 - Define eval taxonomies and rubrics - establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
 - Instrument production observability - build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
 - Benchmark and select models - run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
 - Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
 - Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies - functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) - tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
 - Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
 - Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e. g. , new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
 - Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
 - Provide technical leadership to engineers, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
 - Collaborate cross-functionally - work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
 - 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
 - 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
 - 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

Technical Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation - familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns - tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
 - Production experience with eval pipelines - building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
 - Proficiency in Python - strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service relevant to AI/ML (e. g. , Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
 - Statistical literacy - ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
 - Enterprise product sensibility - understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
 - Excellent communication - ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

Tech Stack

- Languages: Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
 - Test Automation: Selenium, Playwright
 - LLM Providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
 - Eval Tooling: DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
 - Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
 - Infrastructure: DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
 - Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e. g. , Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
 - Policy Background: Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
 - Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
 - Experience testing complex APIs, especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
 - Experience with prompt injection (Must) and data poisoning skills is a plus
 - Certifications in AI/ML, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning. AI specializations and software testing methodologies

Soft Skills

- Proven ability to lead without direct authority, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy. 
 - Experience working in agile environments, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones. 
 - Excellent communication and documentation skills, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders. 
 - Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

Nice to have

- Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
 - Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
 - Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)

Our software scales to support millions of devices across multiple device platforms. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. 

Meet the Team

The Transactional Systems Technology Team sits within Millennium's Information Technology organization. The team is responsible for the transaction processing platform, including trade lifecycle event processing, enrichment, and PnL calculations. It develops and operates technology that supports scalable data processing, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities for Operations and Middle Office teams. 

What You'll Do

- Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of software and AI engineers working across Java, Python, and Angular development. 
 - Deliver global software solutions that support trade lifecycle management across multiple asset classes. 
 - Build and operate high-throughput, low-latency trade processing solutions for booking, amendments, unwinds, novations, asset servicing, and other transaction workflows. 
 - Develop and operate GenAI services that transform unstructured data into structured pipelines for trade booking and reconciliation. 
 - Identify and deliver process improvements through automation, optimized data and model pipelines, and infrastructure enhancements that improve scalability, resiliency, and AI workload support. 
 - Deliver software using modern engineering practices, including automated testing, code review, version control, CI/CD, observability, and orchestration. 
 - Provide effective level-three production support for team-owned applications, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and operational quality. 
 - Partner with Core Technology, Operations, and Middle Office teams to define the strategic direction for global trade lifecycle processing. 

What You Bring

- Strong trade lifecycle domain experience, preferably in equities; fixed income experience is also advantageous. 
 - At least 15 years of professional Java development experience within capital markets or a fintech firm. 
 - At least 4 years of experience leading high-performing software development or AI engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrable experience delivering post-trade lifecycle solutions that support Operations and Middle Office teams. 
 - At least 3 years of development experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka and UI frameworks such as Angular. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Python and GenAI ecosystems, including the ability to develop services that support AI-enabled workflows. 
 - Experience building REST or GraphQL services using Java and Spring Boot, with strong SQL and relational database experience in production environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of modern SDLC and DevOps practices, Kubernetes or similar container deployment architectures, and AWS or GCP cloud services, combined with a delivery-focused, detail-oriented approach and effective use of AI-assisted development tools.

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers' implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

-Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Position Summary: 

The BU Quality Manager is responsible for implementing quality systems, processes and procedures to ensure product quality meets Sasmos HETs QA plan, guidelines & acceptance criteria. Qualifying suppliers, conducting first article inspection, addressing and resolving quality issues at various stages in production process is part of the role. This role is responsible to implement quality initiatives to improve product quality & reduce customer complaints. 

Key Responsibilities

- Participate in Corporate Quality Strategy & Planning
 - Develop BU Quality Assurance Plan
 - Oversee the BU Product Quality Assurance implementation
 - Develop & implement BU Testing Quality
 - Developing supplier capability to meet Sasmos HET's business objectives and defined quality standards 
 - Address customer complaints 
 - Monitor adherence to Systems and Process
 - Champion quality as a culture
 - Drive Continuous Improvement & Innovation
 - Lead Quality Team

Indicative activities

Participate in Corporate Quality Strategy & Planning: 

- Participate in developing & Implementing strategies to enhance plant quality control in consultation with the Corporate Quality Head
 - Identify, plan and initiate investment requirements e. g. , testing equipment, quality tools, systems in consultation with Corporate Quality Head
 - Participate in creating the Quality Policy for overall Sasmos along with the Quality team & in consultation with the Corporate Quality Head

Develop BU Quality Assurance Plan

- Develop guidelines & acceptance criteria for quality control activities in the BU in alignment with corporate goals & customer expectations, to maximize product quality and customer satisfaction through effective preventive controls
 - Periodically review the quality standards based on customer requirements and feedback and provide inputs to the BU QA team
 - Develop, maintain and review quality control charts & database
 - Participate in the New Part/ Product Development process by planning & conducting First Article Inspection for every part, develop the inspection criteria & testing techniques to meet customer requirements
 - Give recommendations to Production, Process Engineering, Product Engineering on specific quality parameters and non-conformities to assist in development of new parts or products. 

Oversee the BU Product Quality Assurance implementation

- Monitor quality control activities to ensure adherence to quality assurance acceptance criteria and safety standards. 
 - Supervise in-process quality checks at every step of the process to ensure that the products are produced as per customer specified dimensions and standards. 
 - Supervise the inspection of finished products to check if they meet the desired quality standards as specified by the customer. 
 - Create and implement a system to ensure product quality traceability throughout the process flow
 - Conduct Root cause analysis and take corrective actions to avoid repeat of chronic errors
 - Participate in BU/Plant level discussions to draw up action plans to arrest quality rejection occurrences
 - Ensure consistent quality across several & diverse projects & especially for long duration projects (USEC BU)

Develop & implement BU Testing Quality

- Develop and implement test programs that meet customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Oversee electrical testing activities, ensuring reliability and safety through rigorous testing protocols. 
 - Calibrate & maintain equipment in accordance with relevant approved procedures, work instructions & test methods. 

Developing supplier capability to meet Sasmos HET's business objectives and defined quality standards

- Conduct supplier evaluation audits to assess supplier capability in alignment to Sasmos HETs guidelines
 - Manage supplier quality assurance activities, including supplier qualifications, audits, and inspections. 
 - Ensure quality checks are conducted for all inward material/products in coordination with the Purchase team. 
 - Review, analyze quality issues critical in nature, ensure resolution, course of action for mitigation of issues are addressed in defining projects
 - Review visual inspection reports, photographic / video graphic evidence of the quality issue, digital testing records, for further analysis
 - Collaborate withstakeholders including Production, Quality, Customer Quality for inputs on supplier development projects, as necessary
 - Monitor supplier quality rating for progress and plan of action, ensure achievement of supplier capability / capacity to meet BU's requirements including volumes, cost, quality and delivery

Address customer complaints

- Monitor and manage customer complaints and provide corrective action to avoid recurrences. 
 - Participate in quality related discussions with Customers and facilitate cascading of the concerns to stakeholders in the BU
 - Support the BU head & BD head in discussions with the customers to resolve disputes with respect to customer rejections
 - Address customer complaints leading to warranty claims due to gaps in production processes through study, in-depth analysis, process improvements, tools and other techniques and recommend suitable action

Monitor adherence to Systems and Process

- Monitor QC systems and advise team on system performance, publish statistics regarding performance against set targets
 - Ensure adherence to Quality systems such as AS9100 etc
 - Act as the Management Representative for the Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with AS 9100 certification and aerospace standards. 
 - Oversee quality manuals, procedures, and audit processes, ensuring adherence to customer and certification body requirements. 
 - Ensure compilation of information on - Quality status, Complaint sample results, and major deviations sent regularly
 - Ensure SAP is updated regularly and accurately by the team. 

Champion quality as a culture

- Review training material periodically to standardize content as required for conducting training programs
 - Train BU production team in quality systems, tools and techniques to ensure that quality becomes the Way of Working

Drive Continuous Improvement & Innovation

- Promote continuous improvement initiatives in quality processes, leveraging industry trends and technological advancements

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - QA [T500-30168]
data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernizing business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust. 
 - We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide. 

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling. 
 - Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience. 
 - Stack Breadth: Broad technical exposure across front-end, back-end and integration layers. 
 - System Design: Strong system design judgement with the capability to evaluate, challenge and refine agent-generated architectural outputs. 
 - Technical Support: Experience supporting production cloud environments, including logging, alerting, incident response and observability. 
 - Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy and test automation across the software delivery lifecycle
 - Strong knowledge of functional, integration, regression and non-functional testing, including performance, resilience and security. 
 - Experience designing automated tests for APIs, distributed services and data-driven applications, with a shift-left approach to defect prevention. 
 - Hands-on experience testing AI/ML/GenAI applications using LLM evaluation frameworks such as Ragas or TruLens
 - Experience with Playwright, Postman, BrowserStack or equivalent tools, including setting up test frameworks. 
 - Experience owning production release quality, including automated smoke tests, release verification and appropriate use of synthetic test data. 

Preferred: 

- Retail and Commerce Exposure: Experience in retail, e-commerce, or complex omnichannel platform ecosystems. 
 - Advanced AI Tooling: Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks, model gateways, and evaluation platforms.

We are seeking an experienced Manager - Embedded Systems Development & Testing to lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for the design, development, integration, verification, and validation of embedded systems for next-generation medical devices. 

The role will provide technical and people leadership across the embedded product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through software/hardware development, system integration, verification, validation, and product release. 

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in embedded software, real-time systems, hardware/software integration, automated testing, system verification, and regulated product development, combined with the ability to build and lead engineering teams. 

What You will do: 

Key Responsibilities

- Engineering Leadership
 - Lead and manage embedded systems development and testing teams responsible for medical device products. Define engineering strategies, development processes, technical direction, and execution plans. 
 - Provide technical leadership across embedded software, firmware, system integration, and verification. Drive execution of multiple concurrent projects while balancing quality, schedule, cost, and technical risks. 
 - Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering metrics across the team. Partner with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams. 
 - Embedded Systems Development
 - Lead development of embedded software/firmware for medical devices and connected systems. Guide architecture and design decisions involving: Embedded C/C++RTOSMicrocontrollers and SoCsDevice driversCommunication protocolsUSB/BLE/Wi-Fi/EthernetSensor interfacesMotor/control systemsPower managementBootloaders and firmware update mechanisms
 - Ensure robust hardware/software integration and system-level performance. Drive reuse of software platforms, common architectures, libraries, and development frameworks across products. 
 - Verification & Validation
 - Lead development and execution of unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing strategies. Establish robust verification methodologies for embedded software and complete medical-device systems. 
 - Drive automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), simulation, test automation, and continuous integration where appropriate. Ensure traceability between: User Needs → System Requirements → Software Requirements → Design → Implementation → Verification
 - Review and approve verification strategies, test plans, test cases, and test results. Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of complex technical issues discovered during development and testing. 
 - Quality & Regulatory Compliance
 - Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable medical-device development processes and organizational quality systems. Work closely with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulations, such as: ISO 13485IEC 62304IEC 60601, where applicableISO 14971IEC 62366, where applicableCybersecurity requirements applicable to medical devicesApplicable FDA and international regulatory requirements
 - Ensure appropriate documentation, design controls, risk management, change control, and verification evidence throughout the product lifecycle. Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions as required. 
 - Test Automation & Engineering Excellence
 - Establish a modern automated testing strategy for embedded products. Increase automated test coverage and reduce dependence on manual testing. 
 - Promote: CI/CD for embedded systemsAutomated regression testingHardware-in-the-loop testingStatic and dynamic analysis Code coverage Unit testing Integration testing System-level testing. Establish engineering metrics to monitor product quality, test effectiveness, defect escape rates, and development efficiency. 
 - Technical Problem Solving
 - Act as an escalation point for complex embedded-system issues. Lead cross-functional investigation of difficult hardware/software/system failures. 
 - Drive structured root-cause analysis using methodologies such as 5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, and fault-tree analysis. Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented effectively. Provide technical guidance during field issues, customer escalations, and product investigations. 
 - People & Talent Leadership
 - Build, mentor, and retain a strong embedded engineering organization. Define team structure, roles, responsibilities, and technical career paths. Conduct performance management, coaching, and regular career development discussions. 
 - Identify technical skill gaps and establish training and development plans. Recruit high-quality embedded software, firmware, systems, and test engineers. Develop future technical leaders and engineering managers. 
 - Project & Program Execution
 - Work with program/project managers to develop realistic technical schedules and resource plans. Identify technical risks early and establish mitigation plans. 
 - Track milestones, dependencies, defects, technical debt, and engineering deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership. Support product launches and sustaining engineering activities. 

What You Need: 

Must Have

- 13-16 years embedded systems experience with 5+ years people-management/technical leadership. 
 - Strong embedded architecture and system-design knowledge across software, hardware, RTOS, drivers, and interfaces. 
 - Proven experience leading teams through end-to-end product development from requirements to release and sustaining. 
 - Strong understanding of verification, testing, quality, risk management, and regulated product development. 
 - Strong people leadership, mentoring, cross-functional influence, and execution skills. 

Good to have

- Medical-device / safety-critical / regulated product development experience. 
 - Experience with manufacturing/NPD, production, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of motor control, electromechanical systems, embedded Linux, connectivity, and cybersecurity. 
 - Experience with automation, HIL, CI/CD, static analysis, and automated testing. 
 - Previous experience as a Senior Staff/Staff Engineer or Embedded Architect before moving into people management.

The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

Role: Electrical Lead - Validation Lab

Department: New Product Development Location: Bengaluru, India Experience: 5-10 Years

Your Team: 

You'll be working with New Product Development - a group that runs on coffee and an infectious passion for building products that have never been built before. Our Flexible Energy Stack consists of the e^pack (battery pack) and e^pump (charging station), which unlock 15-minute rapid charging. 

Our philosophy: 

Break. Believe. Build. 

Break stuff, break assumptions, break the thumb rule. 

Believe in the team, the process, and through failures. 

Build fast, build passionately, build to simplify. 

Own it like you mean it. 

What you'll own: 

The Electrical Lead owns electrical validation of batteries, chargers and vehicle-level electrical systems end to end - and leads the team of hardware test engineers who execute it. You will be technically hands-on, set priorities across parallel programs, and thrive in a fast-moving startup where plans change weekly and the team is expected to adapt quickly. 

What you'll do: 

Technical ownership

- Own DVP&R planning and execution for battery packs, BMS hardware, chargers, wiring harnesses and electrical sub-systems
 - Translate product requirements and standards (AIS-156, AIS-038 Rev 2, AIS-048, IS 17017, IEC 61851, CMVR) into test plans, acceptance criteria and lab capacity
 - Review test data and reports; sign off on test results and drive root-cause analysis (8D, fishbone, 5-Why) with design, firmware and suppliers
 - Support certification and homologation testing with ARAI/ICAT and NABL labs - test witness, documentation and closure of observations
 - Drive supplier qualification testing for all components sourced for e^ products
 - Define lab infrastructure needs - equipment, fixtures, safety systems - and own HV safety practices in the lab

People & execution

- Lead, mentor and grow a team of hardware test engineers and technicians; set goals, run reviews and build skills
 - Run the team in an agile way - weekly sprint planning, daily stand-ups, visible test trackers, quick re-prioritisation
 - Balance capacity across multiple programs; flag risks and trade-offs early to program managers and leadership
 - Build a culture of ownership, safety, clean documentation and fast feedback
 - Participate in hiring and onboarding for the team

What you'll bring: 

- Education qualification
 - B. E. /B. Tech (M. Tech a plus) in Electrical, Electronics or EEE
 - 6-10 years in EV / automotive electrical validation, with deep hands-on experience in batteries/BMS and chargers
 - 2+ years of direct people management - leading engineers, assigning work, conducting performance reviews
 - Strong command of HV safety, battery and charger test methods, CAN diagnostics and lab instrumentation
 - Proven experience delivering DVP&R and supporting homologation in the Indian regulatory context
 - Comfortable with agile / sprint-based ways of working and changing priorities
 - Clear communicator with design, firmware, quality, supplier and leadership teams

Good to Have

- Experience setting up a validation lab or scaling a test team
 - Exposure to DFMEA, functional safety (ISO 26262) concepts, and test automation
 - Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

- All active electrical DVPs have owners, schedules and live trackers
 - Team runs on a predictable sprint rhythm with visible throughput
 - Certification tests for the current program cleared without major repeat runs

What matters to us: 

- Quality of work
 - Structured problem-solving
 - Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
 - Ability to multi-task and handle a dynamic working environment
 - Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

About Us: 

Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3, 000-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium-ion cells. data.title: SDET 3 - Model Evaluation
data.description:
About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirstTMmovement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirstTM Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www. aidash. com. 

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500TM ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024. 

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

The Platform ML team deploys and validates every ML model behind Aidash's products. These models process satellite imagery, geospatial data, and weather data. As an SDET-3, you will own end-to-end quality for these models, from training data preparation through inference pipelines to performance at production scale. You will validate both functional correctness and scaling behavior, and you will use agentic AI tools to move faster without lowering engineering standards. 

How You'll Make an Impact: 

- Own model quality before production. Build validation frameworks for computer vision models (preferably satellite or geospatial). Catch regressions in accuracy, precision/recall, and IoU before they reach customers. 
 - Build version-aware model regression. Set up pipelines that compare inference outputs across model versions on curated golden datasets. Every release should come with a clear, data-backed go/no-go signal. 
 - Make data quality a first-class gate. Validate training and evaluation datasets for label quality, class balance, geographic and seasonal coverage, leakage, and drift. Ensure models are tested on data that reflects real-world conditions. 
 - Validate inference at scale. Design load and benchmark tests for inference services and batch pipelines. Find the throughput, latency, and cost limits on AWS and Kubernetes before customers do. 
 - Harden the platform end-to-end. Automate API, contract, and data-pipeline tests across distributed services. Use logs, metrics, and traces to speed up root-cause analysis. 
 - Raise the bar for the team. Strengthen the shared automation frameworks and set standards for maintainable, non-flaky tests. Show how tools like Cursor and Claude can speed up test authoring, triage, and reporting while staying under human review. 
 - Influence release decisions. This is a high-visibility role. Your quality signals will directly shape what ships across Aidash's product lines

What we're looking for: 

We are looking for a senior QA engineer with deep backend automation experience who can validate ML models and backend systems end-to-end, and who actively uses agentic AI development tools (e. g. , Cursor, Claude) to accelerate test design, automation, debugging, and reporting - without compromising fundamentals, coverage, or engineering quality. 

- 8-10 years in software testing and test automation, with strong ownership of backend system quality 
 - Hands-on backend automation experience using at least one of: 
 - Java + RestAssured Or Python + pytest 
 - Experience testing ML applications (model/service behavior, data quality, inference pipelines, evaluation/regression of model-backed features) 
 - Broader stack familiarity: observability (logs/metrics/traces), cloud (AWS), contract testing, data-pipeline validation 
 - Experience improving shared automation frameworks and raising team standards for maintainable tests 
 - Solid grasp of testing fundamentals and best practices (test design, risk-based coverage, isolation, maintainability, flaky-test control, clear defect/RCA discipline) 
 - Strong coding ability in Java or Python (proficient in at least one), with willingness to learn the other (or additional languages) as needed 
 - Good understanding of backend system design and how services interact in distributed systems 
 - Practical exposure to databases - SQL and/or NoSQL (at least one is mandatory) 
 - Working knowledge of application deployment and underlying orchestration (e. g. , containers, Kubernetes, service rollout/health concepts) 
 - CI/CD pipelines - must have (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent): triggering suites, reading failures, improving pipeline reliability 
 - Performance testing - must have (JMeter/k6/Locust or equivalent): load/benchmark basics, interpreting results, flagging SLA/risk 
 - Exposure to agentic development tools such as Cursor and Claude (or similar) for coding, test authoring, log/triage assistance, and documentation - used with human review and quality gates

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to take ownership of our core card authorization platform. This high-throughput, low-latency platform processes real-time debit and prepaid transactions over ISO 8583 for major networks including Visa, Mastercard, Pulse, and Fiserv. Because every request operates under strict latency budgets, high availability, and PCI DSS compliance, every millisecond counts-and every failure carries direct financial impact. 

In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers, drive the architectural evolution of our network connectivity and authorization services, and continue to write production-grade code. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for platform upgrades, network certifications, and production incident management. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5-8 software engineers. 
 - Set coding standards, conduct architectural design reviews, perform code reviews, and foster technical excellence. 
 - Serve as the technical owner and primary point of contact for production health, network certifications, and platform upgrades. 

Core Architecture & Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain high-throughput, low-latency Java/Spring Boot microservices covering authorizations, financial transactions, advices, reversals, and stand-in processing. 
 - Manage long-lived client/server TCP connections to card networks, ensuring robust handling of sign-on/sign-off, echo tests, request/response matching, and automatic failovers. 
 - Architect distributed transaction boundaries ensuring data consistency across Oracle, Kafka, JMS, and downstream services through idempotency, compensation/saga patterns, and reversal handling. 
 - Implement resilient concurrency models: tune thread pools and executors, control backpressure, execute row-level/distributed locking, and eliminate race conditions on balances and card states. 
 - Build fault-tolerant systems using resilience patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, time limiters, retries, and graceful degradation). 

Platform Modernization & Security

- Drive platform modernization initiatives, including Spring Boot 2. 7 → 3. 5 / Jakarta EE migration, removing legacy RMI/JMX remoting, and containerizing microservices for Kubernetes deployment. 
 - Collaborate with Security and HSM teams to integrate EMV cryptogram processing (ARQC), CVV/dCVV/CVC3 validation, and HSM key management. 
 - Maintain strict PCI DSS compliance across all services (PAN masking, sensitive authentication data protection, secure logging, and secrets management). 

Operations & Stakeholder Engagement

- Define SLIs/SLOs and create comprehensive dashboards and alerts using Dynatrace and Splunk. 
 - Lead incident response efforts, drive root-cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent remediations. 
 - Partner with Product, Network/Scheme partners, QA, and Operations to navigate card network mandates, network certifications, and release schedules. 

Requirements & Qualifications

Must-Have Skills & Experience

- Experience & Leadership: 10-15 years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams or driving technical architecture. 
 - Core Java Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Java (11/17+), deep understanding of java. util. concurrent, JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and memory analysis. 
 - Spring Framework: Extensively hands-on with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices (Config, OpenFeign, Actuator, Security). 
 - Distributed Transactions & Systems: Proven expertise in transaction management trade-offs (2PC/XA vs. Saga pattern, outbox pattern, idempotent consumers/producers, and delivery semantics). 
 - Database & RDBMS: Deep relational database skills (Oracle preferred), including JDBC transaction isolation, SELECT . . . FOR UPDATE, deadlock analysis, and SQL query tuning. 
 - Messaging & Event Streaming: Real-world experience with event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (Avro, Schema Registry) and/or JMS (ActiveMQ). 
 - System Resilience: Hands-on experience implementing resilience frameworks (Resilience4j or similar) for high-availability systems running thousands of TPS. 
 - DevOps & Quality: Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/Jenkins), Gradle, static code/security analysis (SonarQube, SAST, Trivy), and test automation frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito). 
 - Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical trade-offs for engineers, product leads, and executive leadership. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- jPOS Framework: Experience with ISOMsg, custom packagers, channels (PostChannel, BaseChannel), ISOMUX/QMUX, ISOServer, and Q2 configuration. 
 - ISO 8583 Specifications: Hands-on experience with Visa Base I, Mastercard MIP/Debit, Pulse, or Fiserv STAR/Accel specifications (messages 0100/0110, 0200/0210, 0400/0420, 0800 network management, DE55 EMV TLV data). 
 - Observability Tools: Advanced usage of Dynatrace (PurePath, Smartscape, DQL) and Splunk (SPL query generation, alerting, dashboards). 
 - Advanced Concurrency: In-depth familiarity with ReentrantLock, StampedLock, distributed locks (ShedLock, Redisson), Java 21 Virtual Threads, and Micrometer metrics integration. 
 - Card Payments Domain: Understanding of EMV chip/contactless flows, stand-in processing, settlement, chargebacks, HSM integration (Atalla, Thales payShield), and key management (KEK, ZPK, key blocks). 
 - Infrastructure & Rules: Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (MSK, IAM), and business rules engines (Drools, Jess). 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - Direct experience in the Payments, Fintech, or Banking domain is strongly preferred. 
 - 10-15 years of professional experience in designing, coding, developing, and scaling high-throughput, enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in a technical lead or architectural capacity-driving system design, leading 5-8 engineers, and setting coding/quality standards. 
 - Proven track record of architecting low-latency, mission-critical distributed systems operating under strict SLAs and high concurrency.
