data.title: R&D Engineering, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the last decade and a half deep in the physics and architecture of embedded memory, and you know that the difference between a compiler that ships and one that stalls is usually buried in how well someone understood variation, power, and area tradeoffs six months before tape-out. You have moved from designing circuits yourself to leading the people who design them, and you still get pulled into the hardest debug sessions because you can see what others miss. 

Leading a team is not about delegation for you, it is about unblocking, teaching, and making sure your engineers have what they need to do their best work. You know when to let someone run with a problem and when to step in with a pointed question that changes the direction. You have managed projects across geographies and you understand that keeping a distributed team aligned takes more than status meetings, it takes clarity, trust, and follow-through. 

You do not wait for perfect information. When a layout is not converging or a characterization flow is producing questionable data, you dig in, ask the right people the right questions, and find a path forward. At Synopsys, you will lead a team building memory IP that powers the most advanced chips in the world, and the work you do will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of engineers developing SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architectures and circuit implementations across advanced FinFET nodes
 - Oversee the full memory design flow from architecture definition through schematic entry, simulation, layout planning, verification, characterization, and model generation
 - Drive low-power and area-efficient circuit design strategies, balancing performance, variation, and manufacturability constraints
 - Coordinate with CAD teams on layout verification, parasitic extraction, and compiler automation using Perl and Python
 - Manage project timelines, prioritize deliverables, and resolve technical and resourcing issues across multi-site teams
 - Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external customers, translating technical requirements into executable design plans
 - Mentor engineers on memory compiler development, transistor-level design, and advanced node challenges

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver embedded memory IP that powers cutting-edge semiconductor products for Synopsys customers across AI, automotive, and high-performance computing
 - Accelerate time-to-market for memory compilers by improving design flows, automation scripts, and characterization methodologies
 - Enable your team to solve complex variation and power challenges in deep submicron and FinFET technologies, raising the technical bar across the organization
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration between design, CAD, and verification teams, reducing integration friction and rework
 - Build a high-performing, motivated team that consistently delivers on schedule and grows technically under your leadership
 - Shape the roadmap for next-generation memory IP, influencing architecture decisions that affect product competitiveness
 - Contribute to Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner by delivering robust, scalable, and customer-focused memory solutions

What You'll Need

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech/MS in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from a recognized institute or university
 - 15+ years of hands-on experience in embedded memory design, including SRAM, Register File, TCAM, or ROM
 - Deep expertise across the full memory design flow: architecture, circuit design, layout, compiler automation, characterization, timing, and model generation
 - Proven experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex projects on schedule in a multi-site environment
 - Strong proficiency in Perl and Python for design automation and scripting
 - Hands-on experience with deep submicron and FinFET technologies, including variation-aware design techniques
 - Solid understanding of CMOS fundamentals, digital design, RC circuits, transfer function analysis, and CMOS fabrication processes

Who You Are

- You can walk into a layout review, spot the issue that is going to cause a timing violation three steps downstream, and explain the fix in a way that gets the team moving again
 - You manage multiple projects and shifting priorities without losing track of what matters most, and you communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly before they become blockers
 - You build trust across teams by following through, showing up when things get hard, and giving credit where it belongs
 - You know how to have the tough conversation when a design is not going to meet spec, and you do it early enough that the team has options
 - You mentor engineers not by giving answers but by asking the questions that help them think through the problem themselves
 - You stay current on memory design trends, advanced node challenges, and industry best practices, and you bring that knowledge back to your team

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Python, Cloud & GenAI)
data.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications. 

We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity. 

The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact. 

As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 

Role Overview

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization. 

Core Responsibilities

Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity. 

API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership. 

System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures. 

Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards. 

Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication. 

Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads. 

Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs. 

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles. 

Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery. 

Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns. 

LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization. 

RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality. 

AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks. 

Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management. 

Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows. 

Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Company Profile

Qualys is a leading provider of cloud-based security and compliance solutions, helping organizations identify vulnerabilities, manage cyber risk, and protect their IT infrastructure. 

The Module Loader is a critical component of Qualys Remote Vulnerability Detection and acts as the brain behind vulnerability assessment workflows. It plays a key role in orchestrating and executing the capabilities required to identify vulnerabilities across diverse enterprise environments and technologies. 

Given its central role in vulnerability detection, the Module Loader requires a high degree of accuracy, reliability, scalability, performance, and backward compatibility. The team works on complex engineering challenges involving vulnerability detection, networking, protocols, operating systems, security technologies, and large-scale enterprise environments. 

Be part of the team building and validating one of the foundational components powering Qualys vulnerability detection. 

Core Responsibility

As a Senior Software QA Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of the Module Loader and its remote vulnerability detection capabilities. 

This is a hands-on technical QA/SDET role where you will own quality from requirements and design through release and production. You will work closely with developers, security researchers, Product Management, and other engineering teams to understand vulnerability detection requirements and translate them into comprehensive test strategies. 

You will be expected to go beyond functional validation and understand how vulnerability detection works, identify potential gaps and edge cases, create complex test environments, automate validation, analyze failures, and troubleshoot problems across application, operating system, network, and protocol layers. 

You will have end-to-end quality ownership of features, including test design, automation, functional and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, regression qualification, debugging, and production issue analysis. 

Position Requirements

Eligible candidates should meet the following criteria. 

Required

- 4+ years of hands-on experience in Software QA, SDET, or Software Testing for complex enterprise software products. 
 - Strong experience in testing system-level, security, networking, or distributed applications, preferably on Linux/Unix platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with test automation using Python, Shell scripting, C/C++, or equivalent programming/scripting languages. 
 - Ability to independently understand complex feature requirements and technical designs and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and automation. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems, processes, services, file systems, permissions, package management, and system-level troubleshooting. 
 - Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, proxies, and client-server communication. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate failures across application, operating system, and network layers. 
 - Experience analyzing logs, network traffic, system behavior, application failures, CPU/memory utilization, and other diagnostic information to drive issues toward root cause. 
 - Experience in functional, integration, regression, negative, compatibility, upgrade, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Ability to identify corner cases, failure scenarios, environmental dependencies, and regression risks beyond documented requirements. 
 - Experience validating software across heterogeneous enterprise environments involving different operating systems, services, network configurations, and software versions. 
 - Experience with performance, scalability, reliability, and resiliency testing of enterprise products. 
 - Strong focus on an automation-first approach, with experience building maintainable and reusable automated tests and reducing repetitive manual validation. 
 - Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines and analyzing failures to differentiate product defects, automation failures, and environmental issues. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC/STLC, defect lifecycle, risk-based testing, release qualification, source control, and software engineering best practices. 
 - Ability to work independently with developers and other engineering teams to reproduce, debug, and drive complex product issues to closure. 
 - Strong analytical mindset with the ability to question assumptions and identify scenarios where expected vulnerability detection behavior may produce incorrect, incomplete, inconsistent, or unexpected results. 
 - Self-driven and quick learner with an interest in understanding new technologies, operating systems, protocols, applications, and security concepts. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage with different technical teams, seek clarification, challenge assumptions constructively, and build consensus. 

Desirable Requirements

- Experience in the Cyber Security, Vulnerability Management, Vulnerability Assessment, or Network Security domain. 
 - Understanding of vulnerability detection concepts and security assessment methodologies. 
 - Experience testing network scanners, vulnerability scanners, security products, or other network-intensive system software. 
 - Good knowledge of common enterprise protocols and services. 
 - Knowledge of SSL/TLS, certificates, authentication mechanisms, and cryptography fundamentals. 
 - Experience with packet analysis and network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark/tcpdump or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to C/C++ applications and debugging tools such as GDB. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining complex test environments consisting of multiple operating systems, applications, services, and network configurations. 
 - Exposure to containers, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience developing or enhancing QA automation frameworks, test infrastructure, or large-scale test environments. 

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's / Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline (M. E / M. Tech, B. E / B. Tech, MCA) and 4 to 6 years of relevant experience as a Senior Software QA Engineer, Software QA Engineer, SDET, Automation Engineer, Software Test Engineer, or a similar technical quality engineering role.

Atna. ai is a fast-growing, research-driven AI organization dedicated to pushing the boundaries of machine learning and computer vision. In this role, you will lead high-impact technical programs, mentor top-tier engineering talent, dissect state-of-the-art neural network architectures, and customize underlying model components to solve complex classification, segmentation, and forensic challenges. About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and Technical Engineering Director to lead our core AI engineering team and drive our synthetic media detection initiatives. In this role, you will lead high-impact technical programs, mentor top-tier engineering talent, dissect state-of-the-art neural network architectures, and customize underlying model components to solve complex classification, segmentation, and forensic challenges. You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge theoretical research, technical leadership, and scalable, real-world deployment. As the AI Engineering Director, you will provide strategic vision, technical leadership, and direct team management for an elite group of AI engineers. You will oversee the complete lifecycle of our synthetic media detection initiatives, guide architectural decisions, optimize delivery pipelines, and ensure your team translates complex research into performant, production-ready systems. 

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Mentorship

- Lead, mentor, and grow the engineering team, providing ongoing technical direction, career development, and performance guidance for direct reports. Resource & Project Roadmap

- Direct sprint planning, technical roadmaps, and resource allocation to effectively balance long-term foundational R&D with near-term delivery goals. Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with executive leadership, product teams, and infrastructure engineers to align AI strategy with broader business objectives. Technical & R&D Excellence

- Architecture & Fine-Tuning
 - Oversee and architect foundation models for deepfake image detection, image-to-image edit segmentation, and video/audio manipulation analysis. 
 - Core Model Engineering
 - Guide the deconstruction and customization of core architectural components-specifically Transformer encoders/decoders, multi-head attention blocks, and latent space embeddings. 
 - Advanced Neural Networks
 - Drive the implementation and iteration of CLIP-based multimodal models, Vision Transformers (ViT), and advanced U-Net architectures for cross-modal forensic analysis and spatial segmentation. 
 - Loss Function & Optimization
 - Oversee the development of specialized loss functions (e. g. , combined BCE + Dice, contrastive loss) and optimize gradient flows for subpixel boundary accuracy. 
 - Production Refactoring & MLOps
 - Ensure experimental PyTorch research code is refactored into highly optimized, production-ready Python pipelines with CPU/GPU inference optimization. 
 - Deployment & Infrastructure
 - Direct the deployment strategy for containerized AI microservices using Docker across multi-node Swarm clusters with GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. 

Required Skills

- Engineering Management: Proven leadership in managing technical teams, setting engineering standards, and driving execution. 
 - Deep Learning Stack: Deep proficiency in Python, PyTorch, NumPy, and CUDA tensor optimization. 
 - Model Architectures: Extensive expertise in Vision Transformers (ViT), CLIP embeddings, Auto-Encoders, and U-Net. 
 - DevOps & Infrastructure: Command of Docker, Docker Swarm, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Poetry, and FastAPI/Flask APIs. 

Preferred Skills

- Advanced expertise in latent space manipulation, transfer learning, and PCA. 
 - Experience combining graph algorithms with neural network probability maps. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in structuring multi-tiered engineering

data.title: AVP, Site Reliability Engineer - CloudOps (L10)
data.description:
Role Title : AVP, Site Reliability Engineer - CloudOps (L10)

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

The CloudOps SRE team ensures reliability, stability, and performance of cloud and hybrid platforms through monitoring, incident response, and automation. Working closely with engineering and infrastructure teams, it enables secure, scalable operations and supports ongoing technology modernization. 

Role Summary/Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - CloudOps at the AVP level to join our Technology organization. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence of mission-critical fintech platforms hosted across AWS, Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF/Tanzu), and Hybrid On-Premise environments. The role demands a strong engineering mindset with a passion for automation, observability, and continuous improvement, while partnering closely with Development, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to embed reliability into every layer of the product lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Reliability Engineering: Define, measure, and govern Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Error Budgets across business-critical applications; drive engineering practices that uphold them. 
 - Automation & Toil Reduction: Identify operational toil and engineer scalable automation solutions using
 - Cloud Migration & Modernization: Lead and contribute to migration of workloads from on-premise / PCF estates to AWS-native and containerized (Kubernetes/Docker) platforms, ensuring resilience and zero-business-impact cutovers. 
 - Observability: Build and enhance the observability stack across Prometheus, New Relic, Grafana, Splunk, CloudWatch and create actionable dashboards, golden signals, and intelligent alerting that reduce noise and accelerate triage. 
 - Incident & Change Management: Own major incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews; uphold ITIL-aligned change, problem, and release management disciplines. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in SRE, CloudOps, DevOps, or Production Engineering roles, preferably within the Fintech / Banking / Financial Services domain with overall 7+ years of industry experience. 
 - Minimum 5+ years of expertise across Cloud Platforms: AWS (EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, VPC), PCF / Tanzu, and Hybrid On-Premise environments. 
 - Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes and Docker at production scale. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (modules, state management, governance). 
 - CI/CD Tooling: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD (GitOps). 
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, and the ELK stack. 
 - Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra (operations and performance). 
 - Practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, and Change Management. 
 - Proven experience driving SLO/SLI frameworks, error budgets, and reliability KPIs in a regulated enterprise. 
 - Demonstrated success in cloud migration, modernization, and FinOps-led cost optimization programs. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills with the ability to engage technology and business leadership. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Hands-on experience in AWS/PCF/Hybrid environments with strong understanding of production support and cloud operations. 
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform (or equivalent IaC) for deployment and automation. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/ArgoCD) and observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, or ELK). 
 - Good incident/change management practices (ITIL-aligned), basic scripting (Shell/Python), and strong cross-team communication skills. 

Eligibility Criteria

- B. E. / B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - AWS Certification (e. g. , AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator / DevOps Engineer) will be considered an added advantage. 

Work Timings: 2: 00 PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events. 

For Internal Applicants

- Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
 - Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
 - Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
 - Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal)
 - L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible. 
 - L8+ Employees can apply

Grade/Level: 10

Job Family Group

Information Technology

data.description:
Career Area:

Job Description: 

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Job Definition

Leads and develops Systems Engineering teams across Engine Installation, Hydraulics Installation, Electrical Installation, Heavy Structures, Light Fabrications, and Work Tools, supporting MWL products across NPI, NTI, and Current Product Maintenance. Provides technical leadership and drives effective execution of product development, system integration, validation, production support, and continuous product improvement. 

Responsibilities

- Managing staffing, development, and performance management programs for engineering teams; motivating and developing project and team leaders. 
 - Providing specialized engineering technical support and consulting services to various areas of the organization. 
 - Assisting with high-impact, long duration engineering initiatives and projects; ensuring achievement of engineering plan and product quality. 
 - Maintaining product release plans and material plans; driving programs to completion on time and within budget. 

Degree Requirement

Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum. Preferably Mechanical or Electrical Engineering

Skill Descriptors

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. 

Level Extensive Experience: 

- Facilitates creation of the 'right' products and services to resolve customer business issues. 
 - Fosters strong customer relationships via delivery on commitments, open communication, and on-going feedback/improvement. 
 - Advises others on creating customer focused environments in various scenarios. 
 - Anticipates customer needs, focusing efforts to proactively meet needs and exceed customer expectations. 
 - Measures and observes customer satisfaction levels to ascertain and implement service improvement alternatives. 
 - Communicates and models the criticality of customer focus as an organizational strategy. 

Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Contributes to short-term operational plans. 
 - Anticipates and adapts to plan changes. 
 - Monitors progress of work against plan as required to meet objectives. 
 - Reports variances and makes agreed-upon corrections. 
 - Under guidance, develops tactical plan for own direct responsibility. 

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyse situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process. 
 - Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas. 
 - Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes. 
 - Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns. 
 - Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives. 

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. 

Level Extensive Experience: 

- Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort. 
 - Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts. 
 - Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate. 
 - Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes. 
 - Analyses and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies. 
 - Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems. 

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. 

Level Extensive Experience: 

- Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions. 
 - Engages appropriate subject matter resources to effectively resolve technical issues. 
 - Mentors others to enhance their technical competence and its application to achieve more effective technical solutions. 
 - Coaches others in promoting, defining, analysing, and providing superior technical solutions to business problems. 
 - Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues. 
 - Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs. 

Managing People: Knowledge of processes involved in managing people; ability to lead successful teams, and diligently address issues related to performance and conflicts at the workplace. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Assesses the amount of time and resources needed to accomplish a task; delegates work accordingly. 
 - Explains how the team's work contributes to the success of the organization; creates a shared vision. 
 - Reviews progress and performance of employees; addresses bottlenecks or concerns impending employee growth. 
 - Uses multiple channels such as meetings, e-mails, newsletters to communicate important messages with the team regularly. 
 - Works with employees to set and define performance standards and career development goals; supports in achieving them. 

Product Design and Development: Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production. 

Level Extensive Experience: 

- Develops organizational standards and processes in order to maximize complex product services' efficiency and effectiveness. 
 - Creates and introduces new techniques that expedite or simplify the development process. 
 - Supervises the management of multiple and diverse types of products or services. 
 - Develops proof-of-concept exercises to prove or disprove validity of proposed products. 
 - Advises on the appropriate solutions to complex product design and development problems. 
 - Designs working prototypes of a variety of proposed products or services. 

This position requires working onsite five days a week. 

Relocation is available for this position. 

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

October 15, 2026 - October 22, 2026

Job Title: Principal AI Quality Engineer

Location: Pune, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Years of Experience: 7+

The job

The role focuses on the technical implementation of AI within the Quality Engineering lifecycle by developing reusable AI assets, integrating AI capabilities into testing workflows, implementing AI-assisted automation and enabling quality engineering teams to adopt practical AI solutions that improve software quality, release confidence and engineering productivity. 

Working closely with Product QE Leads, the role provides technical expertise to implement consistent AI-enabled Quality Engineering practices across products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement the QE & AI Transformation roadmap across the product portfolio. 
 - Conduct QE and AI maturity assessments and provide technical recommendations for improvement. 
 - Develop and maintain AI-enabled QE standards, playbooks, templates and reusable assets. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted workflows across the QE lifecycle. 
 - Coach engineering teams on the effective use of AI-enabled Quality Engineering practices. 

Essential Requirements

- Extensive experience in Quality Engineering, test automation, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Strong understanding of automation frameworks, CI/CD, risk-based testing, and Quality Engineering best practices. 
 - Practical experience implementing AI-enabled Quality Engineering solutions and integrating AI tools into software engineering or Quality Engineering workflows. 
 - Experience developing reusable Quality Engineering standards, frameworks, and AI-enabled engineering assets. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical teams and stakeholders. 

Technical Skills

Desired skills and competencies

- Quality Engineering & AI Engineering - Quality Engineering, test automation, automation frameworks, CI/CD, risk-based testing, quality governance, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - AI-enabled Quality Engineering - AI-enabled testing, AI-assisted workflows, reusable AI skills & templates, prompt libraries, and AI-assisted automation. 
 - AI Tools & Integrations - AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI integrations with testing tools, and AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI development tools. 
 - AI Evaluation & Standards - AI evaluation, responsible AI principles, testing standards, reusable frameworks, engineering assets, and AI-enabled QE standards and playbooks. 

Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, product leaders, and senior executives. 
 - Strong documentation, facilitation, presentation, and technical leadership skills.

data.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world's most ambitious changemakers define the future. 

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution, " underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. 

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

This position sits within an agile data engineering team, owning the quality of end-to-end data pipelines from source ingestion through medallion-layer transformation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to BI/reporting consumption. The role suits someone who thinks like a data architect and builds/tests like an engineer, equally comfortable with pipeline design and hands-on SQL, PySpark, and automated data quality frameworks. 

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

The engineer independently owns the data testing strategy for their workstream, including a reusable SQL validation library usable for both manual and automated checks, and constructively challenges design or process decisions that risk data integrity or delivery quality. Works closely with Data Engineers, the QA Manager, Product/Project Managers, and business stakeholders. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Requirement, Project and Business Understanding (20%)

- Develop deep expertise in the data domain and business context source systems, transformation logic, medallion layers, and downstream BI consumption. 
 - Build a thorough understanding of the pipeline lifecycle (ingestion → staging → transformation → curated/BI layer). 
 - Review source-to-target mappings and transformation logic before test design begins. 
 - Support the team on data QA methodologies and processes, with guidance from QA leadership. Test Planning, Design, Execution, and Defect Management (35%)

- Own the data testing strategy across full, incremental, delta, and historical loads, including insert/update/delete/cancel and effective-dated transactions. 
 - Design and execute ETL/ELT validation, reconciliation, schema, null/completeness, and transformation test cases across the medallion architecture. 
 - Validate pipelines end-to-end source through Databricks/ADF/Spark to final BI output, confirming numbers, aggregations, and business logic tie out. 
 - Define and enforce data quality rules and build reusable checks; investigate anomalies and drive root-cause analysis with Data Engineers. 
 - Manage the defect lifecycle and prepare test evidence, quality dashboards, and RCA reporting for release sign-off.   SQL Script & Automation Engineering (20%)

- Build and maintain a structured, version-controlled Databricks/SQL validation queries usable standalone for manual checks and pluggable into automated regression/CI without rework. 
 - Own inline maintenance of the library: refactor as schemas evolve, retire obsolete checks, keep naming and parameterization consistent, and document each script's purpose, inputs, expected output, and edge cases so it stays usable by the wider team. 
 - Set up and maintain automated data testing frameworks (e. g. , Datagaps, PySpark-based checks) that consume the library for scheduled/CI-triggered runs. 
 - Work with Data Engineers to wire validation into CI/CD, ensuring failures surface with actionable, traceable output.   Collaboration (15%)

- Provide input into the test strategy mix (manual/automated/framework-driven) in partnership with QA leadership and data engineering. 
 - Constructively challenge decisions that risk data quality or testability and propose practical alternatives. 
 - Participate fully in agile ceremonies; raise risks and quality concerns early and clearly. 
 - Partner with the business to understand the wider data system and act as a quality partner for delivery.   Leadership (10%)

- Own data testing deliverables, including the health of the automation/SQL library, for the workstream. 
 - Lead or contribute to QA initiatives that raise the bar on data testing practice across the team. 
 - Mentor junior testers on ETL/data testing techniques, SQL standards, and automation tooling

ABOUT YOU

- Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), with the ability to trace a data point end-to-end into its BI report representation. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with Azure SQL/Databricks/Apache Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data validation and transformation testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory (pipelines, linked services), Azure Storage (partitioning, Parquet/Delta), and third-party API integrations (e. g. , Salesforce, etc. )
 - Advanced SQL for backend validation and reconciliation across SQL Server/PostgreSQL/Databricks, with emphasis on writing maintainable, reusable, parameterized scripts. 
 - Working knowledge of Python for test scripting and validation automation. 
 - Practical exposure to ETL/data quality tools, Datagaps DataOps Suite (good to have), or equivalent (DQX, QuerySurge, Informatica, Talend, DataStage, SSIS). 
 - Ability to define and apply data quality rules systematically (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness). 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted test generation or anomaly detection, with the ability to adapt checks for AI-produced and consumed data pipelines. 
 - Comfort with Agile/Kanban delivery, CI/CD practices, and defect management tooling (JIRA, Azure Boards, or similar). 
 - A curious, quality-first mindset confident to constructively challenge decisions when quality is at risk. 
 - Strong written/verbal communication and stakeholder partnership skills; strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving. 

Experience: 

- 4-6 years in data testing/automation, with hands-on ETL, Data Warehouse, and/or Big Data testing experience. 
 - Proven experience testing pipelines on Databricks/Spark within a medallion or layered Lakehouse architecture. 
 - Experience with Azure Data Factory and Azure cloud storage constructs. 
 - Experience validating data through to BI/reporting layers (Power BI, Tableau, or similar), not just the warehouse layer. 
 - Experience with data quality frameworks/rule design and writing SQL validation scripts reused across both manual testing and automated regression, ideally with exposure to a tool such as Datagaps. 
 - Experience with SDLC/STLC, Agile ceremonies, and defect lifecycle management; prior ownership of a test strategy independently is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or data validation tools

data.title: Senior Enterprise Cloud Software Engineer (Cloud Operations, AI Engineering, Azure & AWS)
data.description:
We are seeking a Senior Enterprise Cloud Software Engineer skilled in automation engineering, artificial intelligence, and cloud operations. This role represents a strategic evolution of two traditionally separate disciplines-Enterprise Cloud Software Development and Cloud Operations Engineering-into a single, high‐impact engineering role that designs, builds, and operates intelligent, automation‐first cloud platforms at enterprise scale. 

The Senior Enterprise Cloud Platform Engineer role redefines operations as software, embedding reliability, governance, security, and resilience directly into cloud services through code, automation, and AI‐assisted intelligence. 

You will help drive the future of cloud operations by creating programmable platforms, self‐healing systems, and AI‐augmented operational workflows across AWS and Azure, replacing manual toil with scalable, policy‐driven execution. 

Mission of the Role

- Transform Cloud Operations from reactive support into proactive, software‐defined platforms
 - Fuse software engineering rigor with operational ownership
 - Leverage automation, Infrastructure‐as‐Code, and AI to eliminate manual work at scale
 - Design systems that are secure, observable, resilient, and self‐optimizing by default
 - Act as a technical bridge between Engineering, Cloud Operations, Security, and Architecture

Technical Skills & Competencies

Enterprise Cloud Software Engineering

- Design and build enterprise‐grade cloud services, APIs, and automation platforms using a Python‐first stack (FastAPI/Django/Flask), with UI components where needed. 
 - Develop cloud‐native tooling and services using Azure and AWS SDKs to standardize provisioning, lifecycle management, and operational workflows. 
 - Apply modern software engineering practices: clean architecture, SOLID principles, automated testing, and CI/CD‐driven delivery. 
 - Design contract‐first APIs (REST/GraphQL) and event‐driven services to enable platform extensibility and integration. 

Cloud Operations Engineering (Software‐Defined)

- Own the full lifecycle of cloud platforms: design, build, operate, optimize, and decommission. 
 - Engineer automation‐first infrastructure operations, eliminating manual provisioning, patching, scaling, and recovery. 
 - Implement Infrastructure‐as‐Code frameworks using Terraform (modules, state management, drift detection) and supporting tools (Ansible, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation). 
 - Build and operate high‐availability, fault‐tolerant, and disaster‐resilient architectures across hybrid and multi‐cloud environments. 
 - Lead L3/L4 troubleshooting, root‐cause analysis, and reliability improvements for complex cloud incidents. 

AI‐Driven & Intelligent Operations

- Apply AI‐assisted CloudOps practices including anomaly detection, predictive insights, event correlation, and automated remediation. 
 - Design and operate intelligent runbooks and AI agents that execute operational decisions safely and audibly. 
 - Integrate approved GenAI and ML services into operational workflows while adhering to governance and responsible AI standards. 
 - Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and operational analysis. 

DevOps, CI/CD & Governance

- Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab. 
 - Implement policy‐as‐code, security guardrails, tagging standards, and cost‐optimization controls. 
 - Embed observability, APM, logging, and SLO/SLA practices into platforms from day one. 
 - Ensure platforms are built to be operable by design, not retrofitted for operations. 

Leadership & Engineering Influence

- Serve as a technical leader and mentor, elevating engineering and CloudOps maturity. 
 - Collaborate closely with Architecture, Security, Compliance, and Product teams. 
 - Establish standards, patterns, documentation, and reusable frameworks used across the enterprise. 
 - Drive continuous improvement, reliability engineering, and operational excellence. 

Required Qualifications

Education: 

- Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field

Experience

- More than 5 years of Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering
 - Hands-on experience in AI-based automation is highly desirable. 
 - Proven experience operating large-scale AWS and Azure environments

Certifications: 

- Advanced certification in AWS and Azure will be preferred. 
 - Terraform Associate
 - AI or ML Certification

Core Technical Expertise

- Deep hands‐on experience in AWS and Azure at enterprise scale
 - Strong proficiency in Python and scripting for automation and platform development
 - Advanced Terraform expertise with modular, reusable, enterprise‐grade designs
 - Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, EKS)
 - Strong understanding of networking, identity, security, and cloud governance
 - Experience with CI/CD, release management, and platform operationalization

AI & Advanced Automation

- Practical experience applying AI to operational workflows
 - Understanding of AI fundamentals, safe usage, and lifecycle governance
 - Ability to design AI‐assisted automation without compromising reliability or compliance

Engineering Mindset

- Strong architectural thinking and systems design skills
 - Passion for eliminating toil through code
 - Ability to operate independently while influencing across teams
 - Excellent communication and documentation skills

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About SkySpecs

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so that less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is helping to make this possible by automating the operations and maintenance of wind farms using advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon. 

SkySpecs launched the world's first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry. 

What will you be getting into?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape the future of our Horizon platform and the way we build software. Horizon is the platform behind SkySpecs' wind and solar inspection and asset-management business, and the work is hands-on, building end-to-end. 

As the cost of producing code falls, an engineer's impact comes more than ever from judgment, design, and outcomes, not volume. AI is central to how we work here, and we treat it as serious leverage: a force multiplier for engineers who already have strong instincts, not a substitute for them. We expect everyone to keep pushing what AI, automation, and agents make possible, and to bring the judgment that makes that leverage pay off. 

We do not separate thinking from doing. You will be expected to independently take broad, highly ambiguous problem statements, formulate scalable technical solutions, and participate directly in delivery by writing and owning production code. We value a founder's mindset; the people closest to the work are expected to challenge assumptions, optimize proposed approaches, and actively engineer high-impact business outcomes. 

This is a full-stack engineering role. While engineers may develop areas of deeper expertise, we expect everyone to be capable of working across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and developer tooling as needed to deliver outcomes. We value engineers who can understand the entire system, formulate end-to-end solutions, and contribute wherever the work requires. 

Our platform is built using AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node. js, Nest. js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL. 

IN A GIVEN WEEK, YOU WILL: 

[15%] Work with product managers, customers, internal users, and other engineers to understand requirements, constraints, and desired outcomes. 

[10%] Formulate solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and break work into executable milestones and implementation plans. 

[55%] Build and ship software: 

- Authoring and infrastructure as code. 
 - Designing and implementing new services and APIs. 
 - Building reusable user experiences and workflows. 
 - Improving reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity. 
 - Reviewing code generated by peers and by agents
 - Leveraging AI tools and autonomous agents to accelerate delivery. [20%] Improve Horizon, our engineering systems, and the way we work. Examples include: 

- Building internal tooling and automation. 
 - Improving documentation and architectural clarity. 
 - Reducing operational toil. 
 - Expanding AI and agent capabilities. 
 - Improving testing, observability, and deployment workflows. 
 - Exploring new ideas, experiments, and prototypes that could improve Horizon or the way we build software. 

Success is measured by outcomes delivered, not lines of code written. 

Requirements/Core Expectations: 

- 7+ years of experience designing, shipping, and operating production software systems. 
 - A proven track record of operating with absolute self-direction-capable of taking a loosely defined, high-level mandate and driving it to production with minimal to no supervision. 
 - Experience navigating the fast-paced, evolving environments typical of early-stage companies, scaling startups, or operating as a founding engineer. 
 - Growth & Leadership Readiness: While this role begins as an elite Individual Contributor, you possess the communication skills, high emotional intelligence (EQ), and mentoring instincts required to anchor, build, and formally lead an engineering team as the organization scales. 
 - Mastery of modern backend systems (e. g. , Node. js/TypeScript, Python, or Go) coupled with significant frontend architectural experience (e. g. , React, Angular, Vue). 
 - Advanced Infrastructure Experience: Direct production experience provisioning cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 
 - AI Integration Mastery: Deep familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, with a strong internal compass for auditing, correcting, and securing agent-generated outputs. 

Bonus Points for: 

- Familiarity with our stack: AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node. js, Nest. js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or automation systems. 
 - Experience operating distributed systems at scale. 
 - Background in utility-scale energy generation, emphasis on renewables

What We Value: 

- Own outcomes, not assignments: You focus on the final business value delivered, not just closing out tickets. 
 - Have strong opinions that are loosely held: You advocate fiercely for technical excellence but pivot gracefully when presented with better data. 
 - Operate with a founder's mentality: You are self-accountable, self-correcting, and proactively identify risks and scaling opportunities before they become critical. 
 - Create clarity from chaos: You excel at parsing noise, identifying core constraints, and bringing alignment to cross-functional teams. 

Perks of the Job: 

- Time Off: Generous leave policy-among the best in the industry. 
 - Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds. 
 - Impact: Contribute to building the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

Job Description

Job Description: 

Job Title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Engineering Manager to join our Defined Benefits (DB) Technology team in the Workplace Investing Technology Business Unit. In this role, you will be accountable for driving new client implementations, corporate action changes for existing clients, and ongoing maintenance of the Defined Benefits Calculation Engine-the core platform that computes participant pension benefits across a wide range of plan types, formulas, and regulatory requirements. You will be accountable for driving engineering execution, elevating technical craftsmanship, and developing strong, high-performing engineering teams that deliver accurate, timely, and compliant pension outcomes for our clients and their participants. 

We are looking for someone committed to developing both their own technical expertise and the expertise of those around them-bringing modern engineering thinking, innovation, and continuous improvement to the organization. This role is ideal for an engineering-focused leader who thrives on building world-class teams, strengthening engineering discipline, and delivering the complex, calculation-intensive platforms that serve as foundational capabilities for the Defined Benefits business. 

The Purpose of Your Role

As an engineering manager, you will combine deep technical and DB domain expertise with a passion for mentoring, coaching, and growing engineering talent. You will partner closely with other engineering teams, solution architecture, product owners, and pension benefit consultants (actuarial and plan-provision experts) to shape technical direction, translate complex plan rules and benefit formulas into robust engineering solutions, implement client-specific configurations, and ensure the teams you lead are aligned on the engineering approaches, standards, and best practices that guide how work gets done. You will be a steward of calculation accuracy, auditability, and regulatory compliance across the DB platform. 

The Value You Deliver

- Align engineering talent, skills, and team composition with DB platform strategy and priorities-enabling scalable, secure, and reliable pension calculation capabilities. 
 - Own engineering execution of new client implementations and corporate actions-mergers, spin-offs, freezes, amendments-delivering accurate, well-tested, auditable calculation outcomes on schedule. 
 - Mentor and empower engineers and managers to deepen expertise in Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems, cloud, and the DB calculation domain. 
 - Drive an agile, learning-oriented organization that embraces continuous improvement while respecting the rigor, traceability, and controls of a regulated pension environment. 
 - Champion engineering excellence-high standards for reliability, performance, resilience, security, calculation accuracy, and craftsmanship across all DB platform teams. 
 - Build trusted relationships with architecture, SRE, product leaders, and pension benefit consultants to align on platform strategy, technical direction, and execution. 
 - Lead adoption of modern engineering approaches-cloud-native architectures, DevOps, event-driven and distributed systems patterns, and AI/ML where applicable to DB calculations. 

The Skills That Are Key To This Role

- Strong Java/Spring Boot engineering abilities and experience guiding teams in modern service architecture, ideally applied to calculation-intensive or rules-driven financial systems. 
 - Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes orchestration, and containerization. 
 - Strong operational engineering skills-observability, reliability engineering, incident response, and performance tuning-with sensitivity to the accuracy, auditability, and controls required for pension calculations. 
 - Ability to lead complex client implementations and corporate action changes end to end-balancing delivery timelines, regulatory compliance, data quality, and calculation correctness. 
 - Ability to translate complex plan provisions, benefit formulas, and actuarial/regulatory requirements (e. g. , IRS/ERISA-driven rules) into accurate, testable calculation-engine logic and sound engineering controls. 
 - Systems thinking and deep problem-solving across interconnected ecosystems-benefit calculation logic, plan rules, and downstream payment flows-backed by rigorous test strategies (regression suites, parallel/shadow runs, reconciliation before go-live). 
 - Excellent communication and partnership skills with architecture, SRE, product teams, and pension benefit consultants, paired with a continuous learning mindset across cloud, AI, and platform modernization. 

The Expertise We're Looking For

- Deep domain knowledge of Defined Benefits, specifically the Calculation Engine, DBCS, and Workbook components, including benefit formulas, eligibility/vesting rules, plan provisions, and pension payment options. 
 - Hands-on understanding of new client implementation lifecycles and corporate actions-plan onboarding, amendments, mergers, acquisitions, spin-offs, freezes, and de-risking events-and how they translate into calculation-engine changes. 
 - Deep engineering expertise building and scaling platform capabilities, shared services, and foundational enterprise technologies, with advanced proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and modern integration frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated leadership experience guiding software engineers and engineering managers, providing mentorship, technical coaching, and career development to build high-performing teams. 
 - 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a strong command of agile delivery, iterative development practices, and robust CI/CD pipelines enabling reliable and automated deployments. 
 - Extensive experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms, with strong knowledge of AWS or Azure services and container orchestration (e. g. , Kubernetes), plus experience with AI-based coding productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot and LLM-enabled development workflows. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field, demonstrating a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and core engineering principles. 

How Your Work Impacts The Organization

Workplace Investing Technology helps our customers save and invest through workplace retirement savings plans, build lifetime relationships with customers and provide employers with cost-effective, integrated employee benefit solutions. WI serves customers online, over the phone, and through a nationwide network of investor centers. WI is also committed to helping drive employee retirement readiness by delivering leading-edge financial solutions to employers, including recordkeeping, cash management products and services and personal advisory services (PAS).

Job Title: Lead Wet Utilities Engineer

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a Lead Wet Utilities Engineer to lead the planning, design, and delivery of wet utilities systems for major infrastructure and industrial developments, including roads, rail, ports, and container terminals. The role covers stormwater and foul drainage, pressurised water networks (potable, firefighting, irrigation), pumping stations, water storage tanks, and hydrology / flood studies. The successful candidate will manage multidisciplinary design teams, ensure technical excellence, and provide strategic input to master planning and project delivery. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the end-to-end wet utilities design for major infrastructure and industrial projects, from concept through detailed design to IFC, including drainage, water supply, firefighting and irrigation systems, and associated pumping stations and reservoirs. 
 - Direct and review hydrology and hydraulic analyses to establish design flows, HFLs, catchment delineation, flood risk assessments, and flood protection measures, including the use of 1D/2D hydraulic models. 
 - Oversee hydraulic modelling and design of pressurised water networks and drainage networks (open channels, ditches, culverts, piped systems), including surge analysis, transient analysis, pump duty calculations, and system curve development. 
 - Lead preparation and approval of technical deliverables: design reports, drawings, hydraulic models, specifications, data sheets, bills of quantities, and tender documentation to meet project, client, and international code requirements. 
 - Coordinate closely with highways, rail, structures, electrical, mechanical, architectural, and environmental teams to ensure fully integrated wet utilities solutions and conflict-free layouts in complex corridors and industrial facilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership for drainage and water master planning, including system performance reviews, development assessments, operational scenario planning, and long-term capacity planning. 
 - Ensure compliance with relevant international and local standards and guidelines for water, wastewater, stormwater and flood management, and support interface with authorities for approvals. 
 - Support project managers with scope definition, fee estimates, schedules, risk registers and change management for wet utilities work packages; monitor progress, quality, and budget utilisation. 
 - Lead, mentor, and technically develop a team of wet utilities, drainage, water and hydrology engineers, including review of work, knowledge sharing, and support to training plans. 
 - Participate in client meetings, technical workshops, and design reviews; present technical solutions and defend design decisions in a clear and professional manner. 

Experience and Qualifications: 

- Experience: Typically, 14-15 years of experience in wet utilities engineering, with significant exposure to large-scale infrastructure or industrial projects (e. g. highways, rail, ports, container terminals, industrial cities), including leadership of multidisciplinary design teams

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, Environmental Engineering, or Process Engineering. 
 - Master's degree in water resources, Hydraulics, or a related field is preferred

Technical Skills: 

- Strong expertise in design of stormwater and foul drainage, culverts, channels, pressurised water networks, firefighting and irrigation systems, pumping stations, reservoirs, and water storage tanks. 
 - Advanced proficiency in hydraulic and hydrologic modelling software such as Bentley SewerGEMS/StormCAD, WaterGEMS/WaterCAD, WaterHAMMER, HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, and related tools; experience with surge/transient analysis is an advantage. 
 - Competence in Autodesk Civil 3D and AutoCAD for alignment, corridor and utilities modelling, and in GIS platforms for catchment delineation and flood hazard mapping. 
 - Thorough knowledge of relevant international codes and standards for water, wastewater, stormwater, and fire protection systems.

The Assistant Manager - New Product Introduction (NPI) acts as a technical and project leadership bridge between the Sr. Engineer - NPI and the Subject Matter Expert (SME) Manager. Description

The Quality Assurance Engineer specializing in automation testing plays a key role in building and maintaining robust Playwright-based automation frameworks and performance test suites.  - Implement and monitor automated functional, regression, smoke, and performance test suites for web applications and RESTful services. 
 - Configure, run, and monitor test execution in cloud and containerized environments (Docker, cloud hosted runners). 
 - Conduct performance and load testing to identify bottlenecks and validate application scalability. Develop test strategies, plans, and cases that ensure thorough coverage across functional, integration, and API layers.
