data.title: Solution Architect
data.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people's lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively. 

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable enterprise solutions across our digital platforms. This role will provide architectural leadership across multiple products and engineering teams, ensuring that solutions align with enterprise standards, business objectives, and long-term technology strategy. 

What you will do

Solution Architecture

- Design end-to-end technical solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable. 
 - Translate business and functional requirements into solution architectures and technical specifications. 
 - Define application, integration, data, and deployment architectures. 
 - Evaluate solution alternatives and recommend the most appropriate technology approach. 
 - Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise standards and long-term technology strategy. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Review solution designs, code, and technical decisions to ensure consistency and quality. 
 - Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers on architecture principles and best practices. 
 - Drive adoption of modern engineering practices and cloud-native architecture patterns. 
 - Promote reusable frameworks, shared services, and platform capabilities. 

Cloud Architecture

- Design cloud-native solutions using Microsoft Azure services. 
 - Define scalable deployment architectures using containers and Kubernetes where appropriate. 
 - Ensure solutions are secure, highly available, observable, and cost optimized. 
 - Guide engineering teams on cloud architecture, networking, security, and operational best practices. 

Application Architecture

Provide Architectural Leadership For Applications Built Using

- C#
 - . NET / ASP. NET Core
 - ReactJS
 - REST APIs
 - Microservices
 - Event-driven architectures
 - Messaging platforms
 - Distributed systems

Integration & API Design

- Design secure and scalable API-first solutions. 
 - Define integration strategies for internal and external systems. 
 - Establish API governance, versioning, authentication, and documentation standards. 
 - Review messaging and asynchronous communication patterns. 

Security & Compliance

- Ensure architecture follows secure-by-design principles. 
 - Incorporate authentication, authorization, encryption, and secrets management into solution designs. 
 - Apply industry security standards and secure coding practices. 
 - Support compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements. 

Engineering Collaboration

- Partner with Engineering Managers to support engineering delivery. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers to estimate complexity and define implementation roadmaps. 
 - Participate in backlog refinement and technical planning activities. 
 - Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation strategies. 

Architecture Governance

- Establish architecture principles, standards, and design guidelines. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews and technical design reviews. 
 - Ensure consistency across products and engineering teams. 
 - Drive technical debt management and modernization initiatives. 

Generative AI & AI-Ready Architecture

- Design integration patterns for Generative AI and LLM capabilities across products, including Azure OpenAI Service, Copilot Studio, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. 
 - Establish governance standards and guardrails for the responsible, secure, and compliant adoption of AI across the platform. 
 - Evaluate Generative AI and AI/ML platform components and recommend adoption strategies aligned with business and technology objectives. 
 - Define AI-ready application and data architectures that support LLM integration, vector search, and semantic retrieval patterns. 
 - Use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate architecture documentation, ADR production, and design artefact creation. 
 - Stay current with Azure AI platform capabilities and guide teams on their effective and responsible adoption. 

Architecture & Design

- Microservices
 - Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
 - Clean Architecture
 - SOLID Principles
 - Event-Driven Architecture
 - CQRS (preferred)
 - Design Patterns
 - API-first Design
 - Distributed Systems
 - High Availability and Disaster Recovery

What you bring

Experience

- BE/B. Tech degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. 
 - 12+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in Solution Architecture or Technical Architecture. 
 - Proven experience designing enterprise-scale applications using Microsoft technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in Azure cloud architecture and modern application design. 
 - Experience working in Agile software development environments. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

Technical Skills

- Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and modern application design. 
 - Experience designing solutions using: 
 - C#
 - . NET / ASP. NET Core
 - ReactJS
 - REST APIs
 - Microservices
 - Event-driven architectures
 - Distributed systems
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
 - SOLID Principles
 - Clean Architecture
 - API-first Design
 - High Availability and Disaster Recovery concepts
 - Experience defining architecture standards, governance frameworks, and reusable design patterns. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and API governance. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-204, AZ-400). 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms. 
 - Experience with SaaS platforms and multi-tenant architectures. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and cloud-native modernization initiatives. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) and their role in accelerating architecture and delivery workflows. 
 - Experience designing solutions within a medical device, hearing aid, or regulated healthcare environment is a strong advantage. Familiarity with regulated software architecture requirements - including software classification, design documentation, and requirements traceability - will be highly valued. 
 - Understanding of ISO 13485 Quality Management Systems and how QMS obligations influence architecture decisions - including audit trail design, data integrity controls, electronic records management, and alignment with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 or EU MDR 2017/745 for regulatory submissions. 
 - Awareness of risk management principles under ISO 14971 and their architectural implications, including hazard identification, risk mitigation through system design, and residual risk documentation for software components in safety-critical medical applications. 

Personal Competencies

- Strong architectural and strategic thinking abilities. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities. 
 - Proven mentoring and technical coaching skills. 
 - Ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and functions. 
 - Customer-focused mindset with a strong emphasis on quality, scalability, and continuous improvement. 

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services. 

Together with our 12, 000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world. 

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Role Description The Battery Failure Analysis Engineer role at HaiShi Automotive Engineering Services & Consulting is a full-time, on-site position based in chennai. The engineer will perform root-cause analysis of battery-related failures in automotive systems, using structured failure analysis and fault isolation techniques to identify defects and performance issues. Daily responsibilities include planning and executing test procedures, analyzing test data, documenting findings, and preparing clear technical reports and recommendations for design, manufacturing, and quality teams. The role collaborates closely with cross-functional engineering groups to improve product reliability, supports corrective actions, and contributes to continuous improvement of battery design, fabrication, and validation processes. Qualifications

Battery Failure Analysis Engineer in Chennai (Cell / Pack / BMS). 

- Key required skills: 
 - ✅ Hands‐on lithium‐ion cell teardown (cylindrical / prismatic / pouch) inside Ar glove‐box, mindful of preventing secondary sample damage 
 - ✅ Identify typical failure modes: lithium plating, SEI thickening, electrolyte dry‐out, delamination, ISC, capacity fade & swelling 
 - ✅ Perform root‐cause analysis via X‐Ray / CT, EIS, dQ/dV, SEM‐EDS characterization 
 - ✅ Read BMS schematics; troubleshoot Pack voltage anomalies, differentiate cell‐intrinsic defects, BMS sampling & harness faults 
 - ✅ CAN message parsing (CANoe / PCAN / ZLG), analyse BMS log data (V, I, SOC) 
 - ✅ Lab tools: multimeter, oscilloscope; prepare professional failure‐analysis reports

data.title: AI Test Architect
data.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people's lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively. 

We're looking for an AI Test Architect to define, implement, and scale the next generation of quality engineering powered by AI. You will own the test architecture strategy end-to-end-combining LLM-driven automation, computer vision, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems-to deliver robust, scalable, and privacy-first testing for mobile applications and hardware-integrated products. 

This is a senior, hands-on architecture role: you'll set the strategy, establish standards, lead technical decision-making, and build reusable platforms and frameworks while mentoring teams across QA, Dev, and DevOps. 

What You'll Do

- AI Test Strategy & Architecture
 - Define and maintain the enterprise test architecture, roadmap, and standards spanning functional, non-functional, integration, mobile, and HIL layers. 
 - Drive a shift-left and automation-first culture; architect frameworks that are modular, resilient, and easy to evolve. 
 - Establish test design principles, risk-based testing approaches, and coverage models aligned with business goals and compliance requirements. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and decision forums; evaluate build vs. buy for AI tooling and frameworks. 
 - AI-Driven Test Innovation (LLMs, RAG, CV/OCR)
 - Architect and implement RAG-based test generation using local LLMs (e. g. , Ollama, llama. cpp) and frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex to reason over requirements, app states, and logs. 
 - Build AI agents that can: interpret acceptance criteria, propose and prioritize test scenarios, and auto-generate test cases/scripts. 
 - Develop computer-vision and OCR pipelines (OpenCV, Tesseract, or equivalent) for precise UI validation, visual diffing, and visual regression analysis. 
 - Design models for UI anomaly detection, flakiness prediction, and self-healing locators beyond traditional Appium-style selectors. 
 - Automate localization testing for text, layout, and formatting across languages and screen sizes using AI. 
 - Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Mobile Systems
 - Define and evolve a Python-based HIL framework for end-to-end validation of Mobile/Desktop/WebApp interacting with hardware (e. g. , medical devices, sensors, wearables). 
 - Architect communication interfaces (USB, Bluetooth, Serial) and test harnesses to control/observe device interactions reliably at scale. 
 - Incorporate AI-driven adapters that learn device behaviors, detect drift, and improve robustness of HIL scenarios over time. 
 - Partner with mobile teams (Android/iOS) to integrate Appium/Espresso/XCUITest/FlaUI where appropriate and augment with AI components. 
 - On-Prem Infrastructure & MLOps for Test at Scale
 - Design on-prem/private-cloud inference infrastructure for low-latency, high-throughput model execution with strong data privacy guarantees. 
 - Containerize models and agents (Docker) and integrate into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for parallel execution and test-on-commit workflows. 
 - Implement continuous learning loops to leverage test failures, telemetry, and labels to retrain and improve models. 
 - Establish model lifecycle practices (versioning, evaluation, rollback, governance) using tools like MLflow/Langchain, self-hosted vector stores, and caching. 
 - Automation Platforms & Tooling
 - Extend or replace traditional frameworks (e. g. , Appium) with AI-assisted components that enhance stability and coverage. 
 - Build Python-based toolchains for model training/inference and integrations into test workflows; standardize reusable libraries and templates. 
 - Define reference architectures for UI, API, performance, security, and resilience testing; ensure seamless observability, logging, and triage workflows. 
 - Quality Governance, Metrics & Risk
 - Define quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and release readiness bars; ensure compliance and privacy-by-design. 
 - Track and publish leading indicators and outcome metrics-defect escape rate, test yield, visual regression detection rate, flakiness, mean-time-to-detect/triage, inference latency, infra utilization. 
 - Conduct root cause analyses and drive systemic fixes across tooling, test design, and pipelines. 
 - Audit processes for adherence to standards; champion continuous improvement. 
 - Technical Leadership & Enablement
 - Mentor QA engineers and SDETs on AI/ML testing, HIL, and architectural best practices. 
 - Facilitate collaboration across QA, Development, Data/ML, Security, and DevOps. 
 - Curate internal playbooks, patterns, sample repos, and training content to scale adoption. 

What You Bring

Must-Have

- 10+ years in Quality Engineering / Software Development, with 5+ years in test architecture / QA leadership. 
 - Strong Python expertise and hands-on experience with AI/ML in testing contexts. 
 - Proven experience training or fine-tuning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face. 
 - Solid background in Computer Vision (OpenCV) and OCR for UI/visual validation. 
 - Track record building automation frameworks for mobile and/or device-integrated systems, and clear understanding of limitations of traditional tools (e. g. , Appium). 
 - Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and deploying AI models into test or production environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define strategy, set standards, and lead cross-functional technical initiatives. 

Highly Desirable

- Hands-on with local LLMs (Ollama, llama. cpp) and RAG using LangChain/LlamaIndex. 
 - Prior experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) or Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing. 
 - Familiarity with Android/iOS ecosystems and tooling (ADB, Xcode, Fastlane, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox). 
 - Observability and analytics (e. g. , Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for test health and triage. 
 - Experience in regulated environments (e. g. , medical devices) and familiarity with risk management and compliance (e. g. , ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 14971, HIPAA/GDPR) is a plus. 

Soft Skills

- Strategic thinker with a builder's mindset and strong systems design instincts. 
 - Excellent communicator who simplifies complex concepts and aligns stakeholders. 
 - Strong ownership, bias for action, and comfort navigating ambiguity. 
 - Passion for mentoring and uplifting engineering excellence across teams. 

Success Metrics (Examples)

- >40% reduction in flaky test failures and >30% faster triage through AI triage/visual diffing. 
 - >25% increase in critical defect detection pre-release (vs. prior baseline). 
 - P95 AI inference latency within target SLA for CI pipelines. 
 - Adoption of standardized AI-assisted frameworks across X product teams within Y quarters. 
 - Documented compliance with privacy and model governance standards. 

Tech Stack (Indicative)

- Languages/Frameworks: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, LangChain/LlamaIndex
 - LLMs/Inference: Ollama, llama. cpp, local vector DBs (FAISS/Chroma), Triton Inference Server (optional)
 - Mobile & Automation: Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, FlaUI, and Azure DevOps
 - HIL/Protocols: USB, Bluetooth, Serial; vendor SDKs; Python-based device controllers
 - CI/CD & Infra: Azure DevOps, self hosted Ubuntu / MacOS instances
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging

Personal competencies

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
data.description:
Job Description

GreyOrange is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer in Test II to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and implementing automated test frameworks to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and create comprehensive testing strategies that encompass functional, integration, and performance testing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop automated test scripts and frameworks using industry-standard tools and technologies. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers to define testing criteria and ensure thorough testing coverage. 
 - Identify, analyze, and document defects in software applications, working with the development team to resolve issues quickly and efficiently. 
 - Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on software design and implementation. 
 - Monitor and report on testing progress, results, and metrics to ensure timely releases. 
 - Contribute to process improvements and best practices in the QA and testing lifecycle. 
 - Stay updated on the latest testing tools, trends, and technologies to continually enhance testing processes. 

Skills Required

- Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, or C#. 
 - Experience in test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, or similar. 
 - Proficient in version control systems such as Git. 
 - Solid understanding of software development methodologies, particularly Agile and Scrum. 
 - Knowledge of API testing tools like Postman or RestAssured. 
 - Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner is a plus. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders. 

Tools Required

- Selenium or other test automation frameworks. 
 - JUnit or TestNG for unit testing. 
 - Git for version control. 
 - Postman or RestAssured for API testing. 
 - JMeter or LoadRunner for performance testing. 
 - Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) tools like Jenkins or CircleCI. 
 - Bug tracking tools such as JIRA or Bugzilla. 

If you are passionate about quality assurance and have a desire to drive excellence in software development, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity at GreyOrange. Join us in building innovative solutions that redefine automation and robotics in supply chain operations.

data.title: ServiceNow Functional Testing
data.description:
Responsibilities

ServiceNow Functional Testing

- Analyze requirements and design functional test cases for ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, CMDB, etc. )
 - Execute manual and exploratory tests on ServiceNow forms, workflows, UI actions, Service Catalog items, and business rules
 - Validate data migration, import sets, transforms, and data integrity
 - Perform upgrade testing to ensure customizations continue to work post-ServiceNow upgrades

Automation & Test Framework

- Develop and maintain automated test scripts using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) or equivalent tools (Selenium, TestNG & Playwright)
 - Automate UI, API, and end-to-end business workflows on the ServiceNow platform
 - Create reusable test libraries, fixtures, and accelerators for ATF and external test frameworks
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. Jenkins, Azure DevOps)

API & Integration Testing

• Design and execute REST/SOAP API test cases for ServiceNow integrations with external systems

• Validate API contracts, authentication, authorization, payloads, error handling, and performance

• Perform end-to-end integration testing across microservices, middleware, and third-party services

Performance, Security & Compliance

• Conduct performance testing on critical ServiceNow processes and pages using tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner

• Validate access controls, ACLs, encryption, and security configurations in line with corporate policies

• Participate in vulnerability scans and assist with remediation verification

Quality Engineering Practices

• Employ shift-left testing by engaging in requirement reviews, design discussions, and early defect prevention

• Define quality metrics and gates for each sprint or release

• Track and report testing progress, defects, risks, and coverage to stakeholders

• Contribute to continuous improvement of QE best practices, standards, and playbooks

Collaboration & Communication

• Work closely with Product Owners, ServiceNow Developers, Architects, and Business Analysts to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria

• Facilitate defect triage sessions and support root-cause analysis

• Mentor junior testers and share knowledge of ServiceNow testing techniques

• Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects

Qualifications

Experience

• 5-8 years in software testing, with at least 2 years focused on ServiceNow testing

• Proven track record testing ServiceNow implementations, custom apps, and upgrades

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF)

• Hands-on experience with ServiceNow UI, workflows, form configurations, business rules, and client/server scripting (JavaScript)

• Proficient in REST/SOAP API testing (Postman, SoapUI, or similar)

• Familiarity with ServiceNow integrations (MID Server, IntegrationHub, web services)

• Experience with data migration tools and strategies (Import Sets, Transform Maps)

• Working knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and version control (Git)

• Good understanding of Agile methodologies and DevOps practices

• Test management experience with tools such as Jira, TestRail, or Azure Test Plans

Preferred Skills

• ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CAD, CSDM, etc. )

• ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification

• Exposure to performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner)

• Familiarity with ServiceNow Security Operations or Virtual Agent

• Basic scripting in PowerShell, Python, or TypeScript

Education / Professional qualifications

- Bachelor's/ Master's degree in an appropriate field from an accredited college/university.

data.title: Head of Software Engineering Edge Platform
data.description:
Head of Software Engineering

Tesco Technology | Bengaluru, India

About the role

Tesco operates a large, geographically distributed retail estate where technology is

fundamental to the day-to-day running of our stores. Critical retail capabilities, including

checkout, payments, stock management and colleague-facing applications, depend on

technology that must operate reliably at the edge, close to where our business operates. 

The Edge Platform provides the underlying computing environment and software capabilities

that enable applications to run across our stores. It encompasses edge computing, server

hardware, Linux operating systems, virtualisation, storage, platform software, infrastructure

automation and centralised management capabilities required to deploy, operate, secure and

maintain technology consistently across a diverse retail estate. 

The Edge Platform is business-critical to Tesco. Store technology must remain dependable

despite connectivity disruptions, constrained local resources and the complexity of managing

software and infrastructure changes across thousands of locations. Failures or poorly executed

changes can directly affect store operations, colleague productivity and customer experience. 

As Head of Software Engineering: Edge Platform, you will lead two major, interconnected

engineering priorities: modernising Tesco's edge virtualisation estate through the migration

from VMware to Proxmox, and building a robust, scalable software-driven Edge Management

Platform to provision, manage, monitor and maintain the retail edge estate throughout its

lifecycle. 

You will define the technology strategy and architecture, lead complex engineering and

migration programmes, and build a high-performing engineering organisation. You will combine

deep software engineering expertise with infrastructure knowledge, strategic thinking and

organisational leadership to simplify complexity, improve resilience, drive automation and

deliver a scalable, secure and cost-efficient platform for the future of Tesco's stores. 

This role requires a leader who can move seamlessly between enterprise-level strategy and

detailed technical decisions, balancing the safe execution of a large-scale infrastructure

transition with the long-term development of a modern software platform. 

Key responsibilities

1. Technology strategy and architecture

• Define and execute the Edge Platform engineering strategy, target architecture and

modernisation roadmap, aligned with Tesco's wider technology objectives. 

• Lead the evolution of the platform across edge computing, server hardware, Linux, 

virtualisation, storage, distributed systems and platform software, balancing reliability, 

scalability, security, cost and maintainability. 

• Establish architectural principles, engineering standards and reusable capabilities that

simplify the technology landscape and enable consistent operation across the retail

estate. 

• Make sound architectural decisions, challenge technical assumptions and balance

immediate delivery commitments with long-term platform sustainability. 

• Partner with enterprise and domain architects to ensure the Edge Platform integrates

effectively with wider infrastructure, cloud, network, security and store technology

capabilities. 

2. Virtualisation modernisation: VMware to Proxmox

• Own the engineering strategy and execution of Tesco's migration from VMware to

Proxmox across the edge estate, delivering a secure, reliable and cost-effective

alternative virtualisation platform. 

• Define the target architecture, migration patterns and repeatable build configurations

for different store environments, accounting for hardware compatibility, workloads, 

networking, storage and operational constraints. 

• Lead the assessment, design, engineering, testing and production validation of platform

variants before progressive rollout across the retail estate. 

• Establish automated approaches for hypervisor provisioning, configuration, workload

migration, upgrade management, validation, rollback and recovery. 

• Manage migration dependencies, technical risks, compatibility challenges and cross

functional delivery, ensuring changes are introduced safely without compromising

critical store operations. 

• Establish clear engineering ownership, documentation, knowledge transfer and

operational handover so the platform can be sustainably supported and evolved by

Tesco teams. 

3. Edge Management Platform engineering

• Lead the design and development of a robust, software-driven Edge Management

Platform that provides centralised management and lifecycle control of Tesco's

distributed edge estate. 

• Define a modular, API-first architecture that enables automated provisioning, 

configuration management, fleet inventory, health monitoring, software distribution, 

patching, upgrades and remote diagnostics. 

• Drive engineering across Java, Micronaut, microservices, REST APIs, Python

automation, Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, applying appropriate technologies

and architectural patterns to build maintainable, scalable platform capabilities. 

• Establish consistent abstractions and automation for managing different hardware

configurations, Linux environments, virtualisation platforms and store deployment

patterns. 

• Design for scale, resilience and intermittent connectivity, including safe handling of

disconnected stores, asynchronous operations, configuration drift, failed deployments

and recovery scenarios. 

• Build in observability, auditability, security controls, role-based access and policy

driven configuration to enable reliable and secure fleet-wide operations. 

• Create reusable platform services and self-service capabilities that reduce manual

effort, simplify store technology operations and enable consuming engineering teams to

deploy and manage workloads consistently. 

• Ensure the management platform evolves independently of individual infrastructure

technologies wherever practical, reducing future migration complexity and supporting

long-term technology flexibility. 

4. Software engineering and automation

• Set high engineering standards across software design, development, testing, 

deployment and production operations. 

• Champion automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure provisioning, configuration

management and observability to improve engineering productivity, release confidence

and operational consistency. 

• Establish repeatable approaches for building, testing, deploying and upgrading platform

software and infrastructure across diverse store environments. 

• Ensure software and infrastructure are designed for maintainability, resilience and

predictable operation, including stores with constrained resources or intermittent

connectivity. 

• Promote continuous improvement in engineering quality, developer productivity, 

deployment safety and operational efficiency. 

5. Engineering and people leadership

• Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organisation through Engineering

Managers, Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders. 

• Build the capabilities required to deliver both the virtualisation migration and the long

term Edge Management Platform roadmap, maintaining clear ownership and delivery

accountability across workstreams. 

• Establish a culture of engineering excellence, technical curiosity, collaboration, 

ownership and continuous improvement. 

• Develop engineering leaders, strengthen succession planning and build sustainable

internal expertise in edge computing, virtualisation, platform software and automation. 

• Empower teams to make decisions and deliver independently while maintaining clear

architectural standards and engineering governance. 

6. Reliability and operational excellence

• Drive platform reliability, security, resilience and operational readiness across the retail

estate. 

• Establish repeatable approaches for hardware and firmware lifecycle management, 

Linux upgrades, virtualisation maintenance, storage management, patching and

recovery. 

• Ensure platform releases and migration waves are thoroughly tested, progressively

deployed and supported by effective rollback and recovery strategies. 

• Establish service-level objectives, fleet health monitoring and operational metrics to

improve availability, incident recovery and service quality. 

• Partner with Infrastructure Operations, Cyber Security and Store Technology teams to

ensure the platform meets business-critical operational and security requirements. 

7. Strategic execution and commercial outcomes

• Translate business priorities into clear engineering roadmaps, investment plans, 

milestones and measurable outcomes. 

• Lead complex, cross-functional programmes, managing dependencies, risks and

competing priorities across engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, 

operations and store technology. 

• Balance the demands of the immediate VMware exit programme with investment in the

strategic Edge Management Platform, ensuring neither compromises the other. 

• Drive cost optimisation through automation, hardware consolidation, improved

compute and storage utilisation, technology standardisation and reduced operational

complexity. 

• Evaluate technology investments and supplier decisions based on long-term value, 

total cost of ownership, operational risk and strategic fit. 

• Influence senior stakeholders, communicate complex technical trade-offs in business

terms and build alignment around the platform strategy and migration roadmap. 

What you will bring

• 15+ years of experience in software engineering and technology, with a proven track

record of technical leadership, architecture and delivery of complex software platforms. 

• Significant experience leading multiple engineering teams, developing engineering

leaders and delivering large-scale technology transformation. 

• Strong technical foundations and credibility across Java, Micronaut or comparable Java

frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, Python automation and Terraform. 

• Solid experience with Linux operating systems, edge computing, server hardware, 

virtualisation and storage technologies, including the design, integration, deployment or

lifecycle management of infrastructure platforms. 

• Experience designing and evolving distributed systems, infrastructure software, fleet

management solutions or platform management systems operating at scale. 

• Experience leading major infrastructure modernisation or virtualisation migration

programmes, ideally involving VMware and Proxmox or comparable hypervisor

technologies. 

• Demonstrated ability to design and deliver software platforms for automated

provisioning, configuration management, fleet monitoring, lifecycle operations and

remote management. 

• Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated testing, 

configuration management, observability and production reliability. 

• Experience with hardware and software compatibility, operating system upgrades, 

firmware management, capacity planning and infrastructure lifecycle management. 

• Proven ability to define technical strategy, make architectural decisions and translate

long-term vision into executable roadmaps and measurable outcomes. 

• Strong people leadership skills, including developing Engineering Managers and senior

technical leaders, building effective teams and establishing accountability. 

• Commercial acumen, including investment planning, cost optimisation, supplier

management and total cost of ownership. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to

influence senior leaders, navigate competing priorities and make sound decisions in

complex enterprise environments. 

How success will be measured

• Virtualisation migration: Safe and predictable migration from VMware to Proxmox, 

successful validation of required store configurations, reduced legacy dependencies

and effective operational handover. 

• Edge Management Platform: Delivery of a scalable, secure and resilient management

platform with automated provisioning, fleet visibility, configuration management and

lifecycle capabilities. 

• Reliability and resilience: Improved platform availability, reduced incident impact and

stronger recovery capabilities across the retail estate. 

• Engineering effectiveness: Increased automation, improved software quality, faster and

more predictable delivery, and reduced manual intervention. 

• Infrastructure consistency: Improved configuration compliance, reduced drift and

standardised hardware, operating system and virtualisation lifecycle management. 

• Cost efficiency: Lower total cost of ownership, improved compute and storage

utilisation, reduced licensing exposure and lower operational overhead. 

• Security and operational readiness: Effective security controls, timely vulnerability

remediation, validated releases and sustainable operational support. 

• Organisation effectiveness: Strong engineering leadership, clear accountability, 

improved internal technical capability and effective collaboration across Tesco

Technology. 

Success will be measured against agreed baselines and targets, balancing the immediate

delivery of the virtualisation migration with the sustainable development of the strategic Edge

Management Platform. 

About Tesco

At Tesco, our purpose is serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every

day. Our technology teams build and operate the platforms that enable our colleagues to serve

customers effectively and keep our business running. 

We value collaboration, inclusion, continuous improvement and engineering excellence. 

Joining Tesco Technology means solving complex engineering challenges at scale and helping

shape the technology that supports our stores, colleagues and customers every day.

data.description:
Job Description

Overview

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Architect / Design Lead to join our product development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software architecture and solution design, with the ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation. This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on technical expertise, as well as strong leadership skills to guide engineering teams toward building scalable, secure, and high-quality systems. 

The Architect / Design Lead will play a key role in defining the product architecture, ensuring technical excellence, and collaborating with stakeholders across business, product, and engineering teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and maintain the overall product and system architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Lead the design of critical components, frameworks, and integration patterns. 
 - Review and validate technical solutions proposed by engineering teams, ensuring alignment with architectural principles and business goals. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams, fostering knowledge sharing and best practices. 
 - Drive adoption of secure coding practices, compliance with industry standards (e. g. , OWASP), and ensure adherence to architectural guidelines. 
 - Conduct design and code reviews to maintain quality standards. 
 - Identify risks and propose mitigation strategies for architectural and technical challenges. 
 - Support the migration and transition of responsibilities across locations, ensuring knowledge transfer and continuity of delivery. 
 - Stay up to date with emerging technologies and recommend their adoption where appropriate. 

Qualifications

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 12+ years of IT experience with at least 5 years in a software architecture or design leadership role. 
 - Strong expertise in enterprise application architecture, microservices, and cloud-native systems (AWS preferred). 
 - Proficiency in Java and related frameworks (Spring Boot), with solid understanding of frontend integration (React or similar). 
 - Strong experience with API design and integration (REST, event-driven, messaging systems). 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Deep understanding of security, performance optimization, and scalability principles. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Proven ability to mentor, guide, and influence technical teams. Nice to have

- Experience in the Banking or Payments industry. 
 - Exposure to architectural frameworks (TOGAF, SAFe) or certifications (e. g. , AWS Solutions Architect, Certified Software Architect). 
 - Knowledge of automated testing, quality gates, and code inspection tools (SonarQube, JFrog Xray). 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). 

Additional Information

At Endava, we're committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives-because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

The Principal Engineer role is a highly strategic position, operating at the same level as an Engineering Director. In the Developer Platform organization, you will be responsible for defining and executing the technical strategy for multiple key systems/technical areas that are of significant impact to the company's Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), developer experience, and core engineering productivity. 

The scope and impact of your work will span the interactions among multiple complex systems and engineering organizations, focusing on the end-to-end flow of software delivery, scaling Developer Platforms & Infrastructure, and leveraging AI to revolutionize productivity. You will sit at the center of driving these critical improvements, ensuring the platform scales to meet the company's growth. 

Your primary focus will be problem seeking. This involves not only defining plans for ambiguous problems (e. g. , "How do we scale our platform 10x while reducing costs?") but also identifying problems crucial for the future of engineering productivity and proposing plans for their resolution, such as the strategic integration of AI/ML into core developer workflows. 

What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will encompass technical leadership, strategic delivery and people growth with a focus on cross-functional impact across the Developer Platform and the wider Engineering organization: 

- Platform Strategy and AI-Powered Productivity
 - Define the long-term technical vision (3+ years) for the Developer Platform, including core infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and observability systems, ensuring they are cohesive and sustainable. 
 - Pioneer the integration of AI/ML not just for engineering tasks but to drive overall company productivity, transforming internal processes and tools. 
 - Identify and translate a future business opportunity or engineering productivity gap into a solvable, multi-quarter technical problem with a clear roadmap. 
 - Drive significant improvements in engineering velocity and quality by identifying and solving bottlenecks within the software development process and continually introducing innovation. 
 - Technical Leadership and Standards
 - Apply domain expertise across multiple system domains (e. g. , CI/CD, Observability, Cloud Infrastructure, Tooling) to drive future-proof, high-leverage platform solutions. 
 - Set standards for quality, structure, and operational excellence across all core platform systems. 
 - Be a Consensus Builder, resolving conflicting priorities and mitigating risks across dependent engineering teams. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of complex, cross-cutting projects (10-18 engineers' effort) from inception to operation. 
 - Engineering Influence & Growth: 
 - Drive and influence collaboration across the entire Engineering organization, establishing a unified software development vision. 
 - Act as a company ambassador through significant external contributions (e. g. , open-source, publications, standards committees). 
 - Master the craft of coaching, mentoring Staff Engineers for Principal-level impact, and raising the hiring bar
About You

- Typically 18+ years of industry experience in Software Engineering, with a significant focus on Developer Platforms, Infrastructure, or Core Tools. 
 - Demonstrated ability to function at a level equivalent to an Engineering Director in terms of strategic impact, scope of influence, and technical ownership. 
 - A proven track record of identifying, defining, and driving the technical strategy for high-impact initiatives across multiple complex, multi-organizational systems. 
 - Deep expertise in a general-purpose programming language (e. g. , Go, Java, C/C++, Scala, Python) and mastery in applying first principles thinking-actively questioning assumptions to create new knowledge and solutions for core engineering problems. 
 - Exceptional skills as a Consensus Builder and Cross-Functional Leader, adept at navigating conflicting priorities and influencing stakeholders across various teams to achieve a unified vision. 
 - Experience in architecting and scaling highly available, fault-tolerant Developer Platforms and Infrastructure. 
 - A demonstrable understanding of how to strategically leverage AI/ML to improve software development processes and overall company productivity. 
 - Ability to act as an effective coach and mentor, supporting the growth of engineers up to the Staff level. 
 - Capable of self-directing, managing time, and advocating for resources for activities that are critical for the company's future engineering velocity and platform stability.

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Hands-on design, development, deployment and lifecycle support of custom and COTS applications across the EMES scope above, used by Pharmaceutical Development within Global Product Development & Supply. 
 - Use Claude and GitHub Copilot as a core part of day-to-day engineering to accelerate delivery, while retaining full ownership of code quality, security, validation and maintainability. 
 - Build reusable AI solutions, agents and workflow automations that remove repetitive effort from the MES development and support lifecycle (code and test generation, document authoring, defect triage, validation deliverables). 
 - Drive AI adoption across the MES team and partner teams - run technical workshops and office hours, mentor engineers on prompting and AI best practices, and contribute to the Innovation/AI Community of Practice. 
 - Design, build and migrate workloads on AWS in support of cloud migration and next-generation manufacturing systems. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI and cloud technologies, develop proofs of concept, and measure adoption and productivity improvements against agreed metrics. 
 - Deliver project implementations and day-to-day operational support within a validated, GxP-regulated environment, including the associated CSV deliverables. 
 - Collaborate directly with business clients, IT Business Partners, site teams and other IT functions, and act as a functional mentor to more junior engineers. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, AI/Machine Learning or a related field, with 4-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience. 
 - Full stack - 4+ years building web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript with React and Node. js, plus Python for automation and AI-enabled services. 
 - AI-assisted engineering - demonstrable hands-on use of Claude (including Claude Code), GitHub Copilot or comparable assistants to build enterprise-grade production software, including prompt and context engineering, AI-assisted refactoring, test generation and documentation. 
 - AI enablement - experience building reusable AI assets (prompt libraries, agents, workflow automations, MCP-based integrations) and helping engineering teams adopt them. 
 - AWS - 3+ years designing and deploying solutions using services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway, IAM and CloudWatch, with infrastructure-as-code and cloud migration experience. 
 - Strong REST API design and system-to-system integration experience, and 4+ years in RDBMS/RDS such as SQL Server including data modelling and query tuning. 
 - SDLC, Agile, CI/CD and source control (GIT, GitHub, Azure DevOps), with experience managing deployments of varying complexity. 
 - Knowledge of computer systems validation (CSV), cGxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11 and data integrity requirements. 
 - Excellent communication, technical mentoring and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Enterprise generative AI platforms (Claude for Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, custom GPTs) and building Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to enterprise systems.

data.title: Automation Test Lead
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

QA Test Lead

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

 - Familiarity with Selenium best practices for managing locators and handling dynamic content. 
 - Good knowledge in Database & SQL. Ability to create & mine data using SQL queries.

 - Knowledge of integrating test automation with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI/CD
 - Proficiency with version control systems like Git for managing test scripts and collaborating with the development team. 
 - Familiarity with test management tools like JIRA, TestRail, or similar for tracking test cases, execution, and defect management. 
 - Ability to write and execute SQL queries for data validation and verification. 
 - Understanding of performance testing concepts and tools (e. g. , JMeter) for assessing application performance under load. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in Scrum ceremonies like stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration and reportingDesirable Experience

- Knowledge of Performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of Security testing. 
 - Knowledge of Mobile Automation Testing. Personal Skills: 

- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Ability to articulate and present different points-of-views on various topics related to project and otherwise. 
 - Successful teamwork experience and demonstrated leadership abilities are required. 
 - Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or any other equivalent degree. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

🛡️ Keeping Us Compliant

- Support FDA, GxP, Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) compliant solution delivery, documentation, and operations. 
 - Produce and maintain GxP documentation including SDLC deliverables, validation plans, requirements traceability, test scripts, testing evidence, deviations, approvals, and audit-ready records in alignment with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) expectations. 
 - Ensure quality processes and system changes meet regulatory, validation, inspection readiness, and compliance requirements. 

🤝 Collaborating & Innovating

- Build strong relationships with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Validation, Enterprise Platform, IT Business Partners, and external partners. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote adoption of emerging technologies. 
 - Lead stakeholder communications and influence cross-functional decision making. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to organizational capability development. 

What You'll Bring

- ✅ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - ✅ 5-7+ years of SAP QM experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. 
 - ✅ Strong experience in Inspection Management, Quality Notifications, Batch Management, Quality Master Data, and Quality Certificates. 
 - ✅ Experience supporting FDA-regulated and GxP-compliant environments, including Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) / Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) documentation, validation evidence, traceability, change control, and audit readiness. 
 - ✅ Knowledge of SAP QM integration with PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. 
 - ✅ Experience supporting SDLC, validation, testing, deployment, and operational support activities. 
 - ✅ Ability to apply AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and process mining to improve SAP QM delivery, documentation quality, incident prevention, testing efficiency, and compliance outcomes. 
 - ✅ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - ✅ Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies. 

Bonus Points If You Have. . . 

- ⭐ Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP/BIAP, cloud transformation initiatives, or enterprise integration platforms. 
 - ⭐ Experience with Batch Release Hub and advanced quality release processes. 
 - ⭐ Hands-on exposure to AI/GenAI, Copilot-style productivity tools, automation, process mining, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, or intelligent operational support in SAP, Quality, Manufacturing, or regulated environments. 
 - ⭐ Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry experience. 
 - ⭐ Experience supporting global SAP programs and enterprise-scale deployments.

You combine deep SAP Quality Management expertise with a passion for innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. You thrive in complex environments, build trusted partnerships across business and technology teams, and proactively leverage modern technologies such as AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, analytics, and cloud platforms to improve quality processes, reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and support better patient outcomes. Job Summary - Linux Automation Engineer

Experienced Linux Automation Engineer responsible for designing, developing, and managing enterprise-scale Linux infrastructure automation solutions, HPC cluster management platforms, and monitoring systems. The role focuses on automating server provisioning, operating system deployment, configuration management, patching, infrastructure lifecycle management, and cluster orchestration to improve operational efficiency and scalability. Based on the job description, the position also involves leading technical initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and driving best practices in software development, DevOps, and infrastructure automation. 

The position requires strong expertise in Linux administration, Python development, infrastructure automation tools, and observability platforms. The engineer is expected to build and enhance scalable backend systems, REST APIs, centralized monitoring solutions, and management dashboards while ensuring high availability, security, and maintainability of infrastructure environments. Responsibilities also include implementing CI/CD pipelines, integrating enterprise platforms, and supporting HPC environments through cluster provisioning, resource monitoring, scheduler integration, and performance analytics. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Technical Leadership: 

· Lead and mentor a team of Full Stack Developers, Backend Developers, and Automation Engineers. 

· Define technical architecture, coding standards, and development best practices. 

· Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and technical feasibility assessments. 

· Drive product roadmap discussions and technical decision-making. 

· Collaborate with Product, Infrastructure, Validation, and Support teams. 

2. Platform & Product Development: 

Architect and develop infrastructure management platforms, including: 

· HPC Cluster Management Tools

· Centralized Monitoring & Alerting Platforms

· Infrastructure Lifecycle Management Systems

· Asset & Inventory Management Solutions

· Capacity Planning & Analytics Platforms

· Infrastructure Automation & Orchestration Tools

3. Linux & Infrastructure Automation: 

Design automation frameworks for: 

· Server Provisioning

· OS Deployment & Configuration

· Firmware & Driver Compliance

· Cluster Deployment

· Patch Management

· Infrastructure Health Checks

· Automated Validation & Benchmarking

· Develop integrations with Linux-based infrastructure and enterprise platforms. 

4. Monitoring & Observability: 

Design centralized monitoring solutions for: 

· Servers

· Storage

· Networking

· GPU Clusters

· HPC Infrastructure

· Data Center Environments

· Integrate monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry, ELK, Redfish, SNMP, and IPMI. 

· Build predictive monitoring, alerting, and analytics capabilities. 

5. HPC & Cluster Management: 

Develop and enhance cluster management capabilities including: 

· Node Discovery & Registration

· Cluster Provisioning

· Resource Monitoring

· Job Monitoring

· Scheduler Integration (Slurm /Open HPC)

· Health & Performance Analytics

· Cluster Lifecycle Management

6. Software Engineering: 

· Design scalable backend architectures and REST APIs.

· Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices. 

· Ensure high availability, scalability, security, and maintainability of developed solutions.

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Overview

As part of a fast-paced team delivering innovative payment, digital commerce, and platform solutions, this role provides technical leadership across architecture, software engineering, AI-enabled development, and cloud-native modernization initiatives. The successful candidate will lead large-scale engineering programs, design scalable and secure solutions, drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices, and collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to deliver high-quality products. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Lead complex software engineering initiatives with significant business impact. 
 - Define and execute technology strategy, architecture roadmaps, and modernization programs. 
 - Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-performance, cloud-native applications and APIs. 
 - Drive decomposition of monolithic platforms into reusable microservices and domain-driven architectures. 
 - Partner with Product Managers, TPMs, Architects, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and third-party platforms to improve business outcomes and engineering efficiency. 
 - Develop Proofs of Concept (POCs) and validate new architectural approaches. 
 - Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, design reviews, automated testing, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-powered development tools and practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing efficiency, documentation, and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor engineers, foster technical growth, and promote a culture of innovation and continuous learning. 
 - Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and technical strategies effectively to leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Ensure adherence to security, compliance, quality, reliability, and software development standards. 

Education

ABOUT YOU

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. 

Experience & Qualifications

- Extensive experience designing, developing, and leading enterprise-scale software platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, PostgreSQL, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience building secure, resilient, high-availability applications in cloud environments. 
 - Proven ability to architect and deliver mission-critical systems at scale. 
 - Experience integrating external APIs, payment platforms, SaaS products, and third-party services. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture patterns, domain-driven design, event-driven architectures, and API-first development. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and cloud-native engineering practices. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants, intelligent code generation, automated testing, and developer productivity platforms. 
 - Demonstrated ability to learn, evaluate, and adopt emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI innovations. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 

Knowledge & Responsibilities

- Lead architecture and design decisions across multiple products, platforms, and engineering teams. 
 - Develop and maintain reference architectures, engineering standards, and best practices. 
 - Design and implement scalable APIs, microservices, integrations, and event-driven systems. 
 - Drive engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, observability, reliability engineering, and operational excellence. 
 - Build secure solutions aligned with Security by Design principles, OWASP standards, PCI-DSS, and enterprise security requirements. 
 - Optimize application performance, scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. 
 - Lead root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Establish development standards, automation frameworks, and quality metrics. 
 - Influence technical direction, backlog prioritization, and management of technical debt. 
 - Partner with engineering leadership to improve delivery velocity, reliability, and customer experience. 
 - Coach and mentor engineers through design sessions, technical reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities. 
 - Support talent acquisition, technical interviews, and team development. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled software engineering practices across the SDLC, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, documentation, observability, and operational support. 
 - Use data, metrics, and AI-driven insights to improve engineering effectiveness, developer experience, and platform reliability. 

Skills & Abilities

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical challenges. 
 - Expertise in software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native application design. 
 - Ability to balance business priorities, technical strategy, and long-term platform sustainability. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills for working with global, cross-functional teams. 
 - Hands-on engineering leader capable of contributing to architecture, design, coding, code reviews, and technical decision-making. 
 - Experience driving innovation, modernization, automation, and engineering productivity initiatives. 
 - Ability to lead multiple concurrent programs in a matrixed, geographically distributed environment. 

KEY TECHNOLOGY AREAS

- Java (Java 17+ preferred)
 - Spring Boot
 - RESTful APIs

 - Event-Driven Architecture
 - Distributed Systems

Cloud & Platform Engineering

data.description:
About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Senior Manager to lead development teams working on Corporate Accounting Data applications.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Golang (Product Engineering)
data.description:
ABOUT OOLIO: 

Oolio is a leading B2B SaaS platform transforming how hospitality venues operate and grow. Trusted by more than 22, 000 venues, we power mission-critical POS, payments, online ordering, kiosks, loyalty, kitchen management, and real-time insights - all within one connected ecosystem. 

We are building the operating system for modern hospitality - simplifying complex operations, accelerating service, and unlocking smarter, data-driven decisions. Built by hospitality professionals with decades of industry experience, we understand the realities of every shift, every service rush, and every guest interaction. From cafés and quick-service restaurants to pubs, multi-site groups, and stadiums, Oolio enables venues to operate seamlessly at scale. With next-business-day settlements, powerful third-party integrations, and 24/7 real human support, we go beyond software - we become long-term partners in growth. 

As a rapidly scaling product-led organisation, we're shaping the future of hospitality technology. 

We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale. 

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

At Oolio, Senior Backend Engineers - Golang are hands-on engineers who design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend systems. You will take ownership across the backend engineering lifecycle - from technical design and development through testing, deployment, observability, and production support. 

The role requires strong expertise in Golang, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies, and system performance. As AI continues to transform software engineering, you will also be encouraged to leverage AI-powered development tools, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance code quality, and solve real-world engineering problems. 

The primary focus of this role is hands-on backend engineering, with opportunities to contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices. You will work closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering teams to build customer-facing products and backend capabilities that support Oolio's growing global platform. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable and scalable backend services using Golang. 
 - Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable microservices with strong emphasis on performance, concurrency, maintainability, and reliability. 
 - Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, including HLD/LLD, service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns. 
 - Design and implement event-driven systems using asynchronous messaging, queues, pub/sub, and streaming patterns where appropriate. 
 - Build and maintain RESTful and/or gRPC APIs that power web, mobile, and third-party integrations. 
 - Work collaboratively across the stack when required, including integration with React and Node. js services to deliver end-to-end product features. 
 - Develop and operate cloud-native services deployed on AWS, leveraging Kubernetes and Docker for containerized environments. 
 - Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks as product usage and customer scale increase. 
 - Implement effective testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and performance testing. 
 - Contribute to observability best practices including structured logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting. 
 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards, coding practices, and overall code quality. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines. 
 - Mentor and support junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Leverage AI-powered development tools and automation to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and software delivery. 
 - Explore and adopt relevant AI capabilities and engineering tools that can solve practical software development and operational challenges. 

REQUIREMENTS: 

Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Product Engineering) - final role will depend on candidate experience, credentials, and interview outcomes

Experience: 5 - 9 Years

Education: Preferred - B. Tech/B. E/M. Tech/M. E/MCA/M. S

Technology Stack: 

(A) Core Engineering: 

Golang, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, REST APIs, gRPC, System Design (HLD/LLD), Performance Optimization, Testing Frameworks, AI-Powered Development Tooling

(B) Good/Nice to Have: 

ReactJS, NodeJS, GraphQL

OTHER REQUIREMENTS: 

- Strong hands-on experience building production-grade backend systems in SaaS or product-based organisations. 
 - Strong expertise in Golang, including concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, memory management, profiling, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven experience developing and operating scalable microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and system reliability principles. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or similar databases, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development and delivery practices. 
 - Good understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, fault tolerance, and production reliability. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing long-term improvements. 
 - Experience working in high-scale or high-transaction environments is highly desirable. 
 - Practical experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Exposure to AI-powered workflows across development, testing, documentation, deployment, or operational processes is a plus. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and engineering teams while taking ownership of assigned services and features. 
 - Strong focus on writing clean, maintainable, well-tested, and production-ready code.
